book.notes: Old Testament original is the Hebrew Masoretic text; New Testament original is the SBL Greek text. Transliteration is automatic and flagged. Hebrew verse numbering can differ from KJV numbering in a few psalms.

verses.original: תֶּאְשַׁם֙ שֹֽׁמְר֔וֹן כִּ֥י מָרְתָ֖ה בֵּֽ/אלֹהֶ֑י/הָ בַּ/חֶ֣רֶב יִפֹּ֔לוּ עֹלְלֵי/הֶ֣ם יְרֻטָּ֔שׁוּ וְ/הָרִיּוֹתָ֖י/ו יְבֻקָּֽעוּ
verses.translit: t'shm shmrvn khy mrth b'lhyh bchrb yplv 'llyhm yrtshv vhryvtyv ybq'v
verses.translation: O Israel, return unto the LORD thy God; for thou hast fallen by thine iniquity.

verses.original: שׁ֚וּבָ/ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַ֖ד יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ כִּ֥י כָשַׁ֖לְתָּ בַּ/עֲוֺנֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: shvbh yshr'l 'd yhvh 'lhykh khy khshlt b'vnkh
verses.translation: Take with you words, and turn to the LORD : say unto him, Take away all iniquity, and receive us graciously: so will we render the calves of our lips.

verses.original: קְח֤וּ עִמָּ/כֶם֙ דְּבָרִ֔ים וְ/שׁ֖וּבוּ אֶל יְהוָ֑ה אִמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֗י/ו כָּל תִּשָּׂ֤א עָוֺן֙ וְ/קַח ט֔וֹב וּֽ/נְשַׁלְּמָ֥ה פָרִ֖ים שְׂפָתֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: qchv 'mkhm dbrym vshvbv 'l yhvh 'mrv 'lyv khl tsh' 'vn vqch tvb vnshlmh prym shptynv
verses.translation: Asshur shall not save us; we will not ride upon horses: neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, Ye are our gods: for in thee the fatherless findeth mercy.

verses.original: אַשּׁ֣וּר לֹ֣א יוֹשִׁיעֵ֗/נוּ עַל סוּס֙ לֹ֣א נִרְכָּ֔ב וְ/לֹא נֹ֥אמַר ע֛וֹד אֱלֹהֵ֖י/נוּ לְ/מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָדֵ֑י/נוּ אֲשֶׁר בְּ/ךָ֖ יְרֻחַ֥ם יָתֽוֹם
verses.translit: 'shvr l' yvshy'nv 'l svs l' nrkhb vl' n'mr 'vd 'lhynv lm'shh ydynv 'shr bkh yrchm ytvm
verses.translation: I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely: for mine anger is turned away from him.

verses.original: אֶרְפָּא֙ מְשׁ֣וּבָתָ֔/ם אֹהֲבֵ֖/ם נְדָבָ֑ה כִּ֛י שָׁ֥ב אַפִּ֖/י מִמֶּֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: 'rp' mshvbtm 'hbm ndbh khy shb 'py mmnv
verses.translation: I will be as the dew unto Israel: he shall grow as the lily, and cast forth his roots as Lebanon.

verses.original: אֶהְיֶ֤ה כַ/טַּל֙ לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יִפְרַ֖ח כַּ/שּֽׁוֹשַׁנָּ֑ה וְ/יַ֥ךְ שָׁרָשָׁ֖י/ו כַּ/לְּבָנֽוֹן
verses.translit: 'hyh khtl lyshr'l yprch khshvshnh vykh shrshyv khlbnvn
verses.translation: His branches shall spread, and his beauty shall be as the olive tree, and his smell as Lebanon.

verses.original: יֵֽלְכוּ֙ יֹֽנְקוֹתָ֔י/ו וִ/יהִ֥י כַ/זַּ֖יִת הוֹד֑/וֹ וְ/רֵ֥יחַֽ ל֖/וֹ כַּ/לְּבָנֽוֹן
verses.translit: ylkhv ynqvtyv vyhy khzyt hvdv vrych lv khlbnvn
verses.translation: They that dwell under his shadow shall return; they shall revive as the corn, and grow as the vine: the scent thereof shall be as the wine of Lebanon.

verses.original: יָשֻׁ֨בוּ֙ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י בְ/צִלּ֔/וֹ יְחַיּ֥וּ דָגָ֖ן וְ/יִפְרְח֣וּ כַ/גָּ֑פֶן זִכְר֖/וֹ כְּ/יֵ֥ין לְבָנֽוֹן
verses.translit: yshbv yshby btslv ychyv dgn vyprchv khgpn zkhrv khyyn lbnvn
verses.translation: Ephraim shall say , What have I to do any more with idols? I have heard him , and observed him: I am like a green fir tree. From me is thy fruit found.

verses.original: אֶפְרַ֕יִם מַה לִּ֥/י ע֖וֹד לָֽ/עֲצַבִּ֑ים אֲנִ֧י עָנִ֣יתִי וַ/אֲשׁוּרֶ֗/נּוּ אֲנִי֙ כִּ/בְר֣וֹשׁ רַֽעֲנָ֔ן מִמֶּ֖/נִּי פֶּרְיְ/ךָ֥ נִמְצָֽא
verses.translit: 'prym mh ly 'vd l'tsbym 'ny 'nyty v'shvrnv 'ny khbrvsh r'nn mmny prykh nmts'
verses.translation: Who is wise, and he shall understand these things ? prudent, and he shall know them? for the ways of the LORD are right, and the just shall walk in them: but the transgressors shall fall therein.

verses.original: דְּבַר יְהוָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֔ה אֶל יוֹאֵ֖ל בֶּן פְּתוּאֵֽל
verses.translit: dbr yhvh 'shr hyh 'l yv'l bn ptv'l
verses.translation: The word of the LORD that came to Joel the son of Pethuel.

verses.original: שִׁמְעוּ זֹאת֙ הַ/זְּקֵנִ֔ים וְ/הַֽאֲזִ֔ינוּ כֹּ֖ל יוֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָ/אָ֑רֶץ הֶ/הָ֤יְתָה זֹּאת֙ בִּֽ/ימֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/אִ֖ם בִּ/ימֵ֥י אֲבֹֽתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: shm'v z't hzqnym vh'zynv khl yvshby h'rts hhyth z't bymykhm v'm bymy 'btykhm
verses.translation: Hear this, ye old men, and give ear, all ye inhabitants of the land. Hath this been in your days, or even in the days of your fathers?

verses.original: עָלֶ֖/יהָ לִ/בְנֵי/כֶ֣ם סַפֵּ֑רוּ וּ/בְנֵי/כֶם֙ לִ/בְנֵי/הֶ֔ם וּ/בְנֵי/הֶ֖ם לְ/ד֥וֹר אַחֵֽר
verses.translit: 'lyh lbnykhm sprv vbnykhm lbnyhm vbnyhm ldvr 'chr
verses.translation: Tell ye your children of it, and let your children tell their children, and their children another generation.

verses.original: יֶ֤תֶר הַ/גָּזָם֙ אָכַ֣ל הָֽ/אַרְבֶּ֔ה וְ/יֶ֥תֶר הָ/אַרְבֶּ֖ה אָכַ֣ל הַ/יָּ֑לֶק וְ/יֶ֣תֶר הַ/יֶּ֔לֶק אָכַ֖ל הֶ/חָסִֽיל
verses.translit: ytr hgzm 'khl h'rbh vytr h'rbh 'khl hylq vytr hylq 'khl hchsyl
verses.translation: That which the palmerworm hath left hath the locust eaten; and that which the locust hath left hath the cankerworm eaten; and that which the cankerworm hath left hath the caterpiller eaten.

verses.original: הָקִ֤יצוּ שִׁכּוֹרִים֙ וּ/בְכ֔וּ וְ/הֵילִ֖לוּ כָּל שֹׁ֣תֵי יָ֑יִן עַל עָסִ֕יס כִּ֥י נִכְרַ֖ת מִ/פִּי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: hqytsv shkhvrym vbkhv vhyllv khl shty yyn 'l 'sys khy nkhrt mpykhm
verses.translation: Awake, ye drunkards, and weep; and howl, all ye drinkers of wine, because of the new wine; for it is cut off from your mouth.

verses.original: כִּֽי גוֹי֙ עָלָ֣ה עַל אַרְצִ֔/י עָצ֖וּם וְ/אֵ֣ין מִסְפָּ֑ר שִׁנָּי/ו֙ שִׁנֵּ֣י אַרְיֵ֔ה וּֽ/מְתַלְּע֥וֹת לָבִ֖יא לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy gvy 'lh 'l 'rtsy 'tsvm v'yn mspr shnyv shny 'ryh vmtl'vt lby' lv
verses.translation: For a nation is come up upon my land, strong, and without number, whose teeth are the teeth of a lion, and he hath the cheek teeth of a great lion.

verses.original: שָׂ֤ם גַּפְנִ/י֙ לְ/שַׁמָּ֔ה וּ/תְאֵנָתִ֖/י לִ/קְצָפָ֑ה חָשֹׂ֤ף חֲשָׂפָ/הּ֙ וְ/הִשְׁלִ֔יךְ הִלְבִּ֖ינוּ שָׂרִיגֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: shm gpny lshmh vt'nty lqtsph chshf chshph vhshlykh hlbynv shrygyh
verses.translation: He hath laid my vine waste, and barked my fig tree: he hath made it clean bare, and cast it away; the branches thereof are made white.

verses.original: אֱלִ֕י כִּ/בְתוּלָ֥ה חֲגֻֽרַת שַׂ֖ק עַל בַּ֥עַל נְעוּרֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: 'ly khbtvlh chgrt shq 'l b'l n'vryh
verses.translation: Lament like a virgin girded with sackcloth for the husband of her youth.

verses.original: הָכְרַ֥ת מִנְחָ֛ה וָ/נֶ֖סֶךְ מִ/בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה אָֽבְלוּ֙ הַ/כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים מְשָׁרְתֵ֖י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: hkhrt mnchh vnskh mbyt yhvh 'blv hkhhnym mshrty yhvh
verses.translation: The meat offering and the drink offering is cut off from the house of the LORD ; the priests, the LORD’s ministers, mourn.

verses.original: שֻׁדַּ֣ד שָׂדֶ֔ה אָבְלָ֖ה אֲדָמָ֑ה כִּ֚י שֻׁדַּ֣ד דָּגָ֔ן הוֹבִ֥ישׁ תִּיר֖וֹשׁ אֻמְלַ֥ל יִצְהָֽר
verses.translit: shdd shdh 'blh 'dmh khy shdd dgn hvbysh tyrvsh 'mll ytshr
verses.translation: The field is wasted, the land mourneth; for the corn is wasted: the new wine is dried up, the oil languisheth.

verses.original: הֹבִ֣ישׁוּ אִכָּרִ֗ים הֵילִ֨ילוּ֙ כֹּֽרְמִ֔ים עַל חִטָּ֖ה וְ/עַל שְׂעֹרָ֑ה כִּ֥י אָבַ֖ד קְצִ֥יר שָׂדֶֽה
verses.translit: hbyshv 'khrym hylylv khrmym 'l chth v'l sh'rh khy 'bd qtsyr shdh
verses.translation: Be ye ashamed, O ye husbandmen; howl, O ye vinedressers, for the wheat and for the barley; because the harvest of the field is perished.

verses.original: הַ/גֶּ֣פֶן הוֹבִ֔ישָׁה וְ/הַ/תְּאֵנָ֖ה אֻמְלָ֑לָה רִמּ֞וֹן גַּם תָּמָ֣ר וְ/תַפּ֗וּחַ כָּל עֲצֵ֤י הַ/שָּׂדֶה֙ יָבֵ֔שׁוּ כִּֽי הֹבִ֥ישׁ שָׂשׂ֖וֹן מִן בְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם
verses.translit: hgpn hvbyshh vht'nh 'mllh rmvn gm tmr vtpvch khl 'tsy hshdh ybshv khy hbysh shshvn mn bny 'dm
verses.translation: The vine is dried up, and the fig tree languisheth; the pomegranate tree, the palm tree also, and the apple tree, even all the trees of the field, are withered: because joy is withered away from the sons of men.

verses.original: חִגְר֨וּ וְ/סִפְד֜וּ הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֗ים הֵילִ֨ילוּ֙ מְשָׁרְתֵ֣י מִזְבֵּ֔חַ בֹּ֚אוּ לִ֣ינוּ בַ/שַּׂקִּ֔ים מְשָׁרְתֵ֖י אֱלֹהָ֑/י כִּ֥י נִמְנַ֛ע מִ/בֵּ֥ית אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֖ם מִנְחָ֥ה וָ/נָֽסֶךְ
verses.translit: chgrv vspdv hkhhnym hylylv mshrty mzbch b'v lynv bshqym mshrty 'lhy khy nmn' mbyt 'lhykhm mnchh vnskh
verses.translation: Gird yourselves, and lament, ye priests: howl, ye ministers of the altar: come, lie all night in sackcloth, ye ministers of my God: for the meat offering and the drink offering is withholden from the house of your God.

verses.original: קַדְּשׁוּ צוֹם֙ קִרְא֣וּ עֲצָרָ֔ה אִסְפ֣וּ זְקֵנִ֗ים כֹּ֚ל יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָ/אָ֔רֶץ בֵּ֖ית יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/זַעֲק֖וּ אֶל יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: qdshv tsvm qr'v 'tsrh 'spv zqnym khl yshby h'rts byt yhvh 'lhykhm vz'qv 'l yhvh
verses.translation: Sanctify ye a fast, call a solemn assembly, gather the elders and all the inhabitants of the land into the house of the LORD your God, and cry unto the LORD ,

verses.original: אֲהָ֖הּ לַ/יּ֑וֹם כִּ֤י קָרוֹב֙ י֣וֹם יְהוָ֔ה וּ/כְ/שֹׁ֖ד מִ/שַׁדַּ֥י יָבֽוֹא
verses.translit: 'hh lyvm khy qrvb yvm yhvh vkhshd mshdy ybv'
verses.translation: Alas for the day! for the day of the LORD is at hand, and as a destruction from the Almighty shall it come.

verses.original: הֲ/ל֛וֹא נֶ֥גֶד עֵינֵ֖י/נוּ אֹ֣כֶל נִכְרָ֑ת מִ/בֵּ֥ית אֱלֹהֵ֖י/נוּ שִׂמְחָ֥ה וָ/גִֽיל
verses.translit: hlv' ngd 'ynynv 'khl nkhrt mbyt 'lhynv shmchh vgyl
verses.translation: Is not the meat cut off before our eyes, yea , joy and gladness from the house of our God?

verses.original: עָבְשׁ֣וּ פְרֻד֗וֹת תַּ֚חַת מֶגְרְפֹ֣תֵי/הֶ֔ם נָשַׁ֨מּוּ֙ אֹֽצָר֔וֹת נֶהֶרְס֖וּ מַמְּגֻר֑וֹת כִּ֥י הֹבִ֖ישׁ דָּגָֽן
verses.translit: 'bshv prdvt tcht mgrptyhm nshmv 'tsrvt nhrsv mmgrvt khy hbysh dgn
verses.translation: The seed is rotten under their clods, the garners are laid desolate, the barns are broken down; for the corn is withered.

verses.original: מַה נֶּאֶנְחָ֣ה בְהֵמָ֗ה נָבֹ֨כוּ֙ עֶדְרֵ֣י בָקָ֔ר כִּ֛י אֵ֥ין מִרְעֶ֖ה לָ/הֶ֑ם גַּם עֶדְרֵ֥י הַ/צֹּ֖אן נֶאְשָֽׁמוּ
verses.translit: mh n'nchh bhmh nbkhv 'dry bqr khy 'yn mr'h lhm gm 'dry hts'n n'shmv
verses.translation: How do the beasts groan! the herds of cattle are perplexed, because they have no pasture; yea, the flocks of sheep are made desolate.

verses.original: אֵלֶ֥י/ךָ יְהוָ֖ה אֶקְרָ֑א כִּ֣י אֵ֗שׁ אָֽכְלָה֙ נְא֣וֹת מִדְבָּ֔ר וְ/לֶ֣הָבָ֔ה לִהֲטָ֖ה כָּל עֲצֵ֥י הַ/שָּׂדֶֽה
verses.translit: 'lykh yhvh 'qr' khy 'sh 'khlh n'vt mdbr vlhbh lhth khl 'tsy hshdh
verses.translation: O LORD , to thee will I cry: for the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness, and the flame hath burned all the trees of the field.

verses.original: גַּם בַּהֲמ֥וֹת שָׂדֶ֖ה תַּעֲר֣וֹג אֵלֶ֑י/ךָ כִּ֤י יָֽבְשׁוּ֙ אֲפִ֣יקֵי מָ֔יִם וְ/אֵ֕שׁ אָכְלָ֖ה נְא֥וֹת הַ/מִּדְבָּֽר
verses.translit: gm bhmvt shdh t'rvg 'lykh khy ybshv 'pyqy mym v'sh 'khlh n'vt hmdbr
verses.translation: The beasts of the field cry also unto thee: for the rivers of waters are dried up, and the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness.

verses.original: תִּקְע֨וּ שׁוֹפָ֜ר בְּ/צִיּ֗וֹן וְ/הָרִ֨יעוּ֙ בְּ/הַ֣ר קָדְשִׁ֔/י יִרְגְּז֕וּ כֹּ֖ל יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָ/אָ֑רֶץ כִּֽי בָ֥א יוֹם יְהוָ֖ה כִּ֥י קָרֽוֹב
verses.translit: tq'v shvpr btsyvn vhry'v bhr qdshy yrgzv khl yshby h'rts khy b' yvm yhvh khy qrvb
verses.translation: Blow ye the trumpet in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain: let all the inhabitants of the land tremble: for the day of the LORD cometh, for it is nigh at hand;

verses.original: י֧וֹם חֹ֣שֶׁךְ וַ/אֲפֵלָ֗ה י֤וֹם עָנָן֙ וַ/עֲרָפֶ֔ל כְּ/שַׁ֖חַר פָּרֻ֣שׂ עַל הֶֽ/הָרִ֑ים עַ֚ם רַ֣ב וְ/עָצ֔וּם כָּמֹ֗/הוּ לֹ֤א נִֽהְיָה֙ מִן הָ֣/עוֹלָ֔ם וְ/אַֽחֲרָי/ו֙ לֹ֣א יוֹסֵ֔ף עַד שְׁנֵ֖י דּ֥וֹר וָ/דֽוֹר
verses.translit: yvm chshkh v'plh yvm 'nn v'rpl khshchr prsh 'l hhrym 'm rb v'tsvm khmhv l' nhyh mn h'vlm v'chryv l' yvsf 'd shny dvr vdvr
verses.translation: A day of darkness and of gloominess, a day of clouds and of thick darkness, as the morning spread upon the mountains: a great people and a strong; there hath not been ever the like, neither shall be any more after it, even to the years of many generations.

verses.original: לְ/פָנָי/ו֙ אָ֣כְלָה אֵ֔שׁ וְ/אַחֲרָ֖י/ו תְּלַהֵ֣ט לֶֽהָבָ֑ה כְּ/גַן עֵ֨דֶן הָ/אָ֜רֶץ לְ/פָנָ֗י/ו וְ/אַֽחֲרָי/ו֙ מִדְבַּ֣ר שְׁמָמָ֔ה וְ/גַם פְּלֵיטָ֖ה לֹא הָ֥יְתָה לּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: lpnyv 'khlh 'sh v'chryv tlht lhbh khgn 'dn h'rts lpnyv v'chryv mdbr shmmh vgm plyth l' hyth lv
verses.translation: A fire devoureth before them; and behind them a flame burneth: the land is as the garden of Eden before them, and behind them a desolate wilderness; yea, and nothing shall escape them.

verses.original: כְּ/מַרְאֵ֥ה סוּסִ֖ים מַרְאֵ֑/הוּ וּ/כְ/פָרָשִׁ֖ים כֵּ֥ן יְרוּצֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: khmr'h svsym mr'hv vkhprshym khn yrvtsvn
verses.translation: The appearance of them is as the appearance of horses; and as horsemen, so shall they run.

verses.original: כְּ/ק֣וֹל מַרְכָּב֗וֹת עַל רָאשֵׁ֤י הֶֽ/הָרִים֙ יְרַקֵּד֔וּ/ן כְּ/קוֹל֙ לַ֣הַב אֵ֔שׁ אֹכְלָ֖ה קָ֑שׁ כְּ/עַ֣ם עָצ֔וּם עֱר֖וּךְ מִלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: khqvl mrkhbvt 'l r'shy hhrym yrqdvn khqvl lhb 'sh 'khlh qsh kh'm 'tsvm 'rvkh mlchmh
verses.translation: Like the noise of chariots on the tops of mountains shall they leap, like the noise of a flame of fire that devoureth the stubble, as a strong people set in battle array.

verses.original: מִ/פָּנָ֖י/ו יָחִ֣ילוּ עַמִּ֑ים כָּל פָּנִ֖ים קִבְּצ֥וּ פָארֽוּר
verses.translit: mpnyv ychylv 'mym khl pnym qbtsv p'rvr
verses.translation: Before their face the people shall be much pained: all faces shall gather blackness.

verses.original: כְּ/גִבּוֹרִ֣ים יְרֻצ֔וּ/ן כְּ/אַנְשֵׁ֥י מִלְחָמָ֖ה יַעֲל֣וּ חוֹמָ֑ה וְ/אִ֤ישׁ בִּ/דְרָכָי/ו֙ יֵֽלֵכ֔וּ/ן וְ/לֹ֥א יְעַבְּט֖וּ/ן אֹרְחוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: khgbvrym yrtsvn kh'nshy mlchmh y'lv chvmh v'ysh bdrkhyv ylkhvn vl' y'btvn 'rchvtm
verses.translation: They shall run like mighty men; they shall climb the wall like men of war; and they shall march every one on his ways, and they shall not break their ranks:

verses.original: וְ/אִ֤ישׁ אָחִי/ו֙ לֹ֣א יִדְחָק֔וּ/ן גֶּ֥בֶר בִּ/מְסִלָּת֖/וֹ יֵֽלֵכ֑וּ/ן וּ/בְעַ֥ד הַ/שֶּׁ֛לַח יִפֹּ֖לוּ לֹ֥א יִבְצָֽעוּ
verses.translit: v'ysh 'chyv l' ydchqvn gbr bmsltv ylkhvn vb'd hshlch yplv l' ybts'v
verses.translation: Neither shall one thrust another; they shall walk every one in his path: and when they fall upon the sword, they shall not be wounded.

verses.original: בָּ/עִ֣יר יָשֹׁ֗קּוּ בַּֽ/חוֹמָה֙ יְרֻצ֔וּ/ן בַּ/בָּתִּ֖ים יַעֲל֑וּ בְּעַ֧ד הַ/חַלּוֹנִ֛ים יָבֹ֖אוּ כַּ/גַּנָּֽב
verses.translit: b'yr yshqv bchvmh yrtsvn bbtym y'lv b'd hchlvnym yb'v khgnb
verses.translation: They shall run to and fro in the city; they shall run upon the wall, they shall climb up upon the houses; they shall enter in at the windows like a thief.

verses.original: לְ/פָנָי/ו֙ רָ֣גְזָה אֶ֔רֶץ רָעֲשׁ֖וּ שָׁמָ֑יִם שֶׁ֤מֶשׁ וְ/יָרֵ֨חַ֙ קָדָ֔רוּ וְ/כוֹכָבִ֖ים אָסְפ֥וּ נָגְהָֽ/ם
verses.translit: lpnyv rgzh 'rts r'shv shmym shmsh vyrch qdrv vkhvkhbym 'spv nghm
verses.translation: The earth shall quake before them; the heavens shall tremble: the sun and the moon shall be dark, and the stars shall withdraw their shining:

verses.original: וַֽ/יהוָ֗ה נָתַ֤ן קוֹל/וֹ֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י חֵיל֔/וֹ כִּ֣י רַ֤ב מְאֹד֙ מַחֲנֵ֔/הוּ כִּ֥י עָצ֖וּם עֹשֵׂ֣ה דְבָר֑/וֹ כִּֽי גָד֧וֹל יוֹם יְהוָ֛ה וְ/נוֹרָ֥א מְאֹ֖ד וּ/מִ֥י יְכִילֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: vyhvh ntn qvlv lpny chylv khy rb m'd mchnhv khy 'tsvm 'shh dbrv khy gdvl yvm yhvh vnvr' m'd vmy ykhylnv
verses.translation: And the LORD shall utter his voice before his army: for his camp is very great: for he is strong that executeth his word: for the day of the LORD is great and very terrible; and who can abide it?

verses.original: וְ/גַם עַתָּה֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה שֻׁ֥בוּ עָדַ֖/י בְּ/כָל לְבַבְ/כֶ֑ם וּ/בְ/צ֥וֹם וּ/בְ/בְכִ֖י וּ/בְ/מִסְפֵּֽד
verses.translit: vgm 'th n'm yhvh shbv 'dy bkhl lbbkhm vbtsvm vbbkhy vbmspd
verses.translation: Therefore also now, saith the LORD , turn ye even to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning:

verses.original: וְ/קִרְע֤וּ לְבַבְ/כֶם֙ וְ/אַל בִּגְדֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/שׁ֖וּבוּ אֶל יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶ֑ם כִּֽי חַנּ֤וּן וְ/רַחוּם֙ ה֔וּא אֶ֤רֶךְ אַפַּ֨יִם֙ וְ/רַב חֶ֔סֶד וְ/נִחָ֖ם עַל הָ/רָעָֽה
verses.translit: vqr'v lbbkhm v'l bgdykhm vshvbv 'l yhvh 'lhykhm khy chnvn vrchvm hv' 'rkh 'pym vrb chsd vnchm 'l hr'h
verses.translation: And rend your heart, and not your garments, and turn unto the LORD your God: for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repenteth him of the evil.

verses.original: מִ֥י יוֹדֵ֖עַ יָשׁ֣וּב וְ/נִחָ֑ם וְ/הִשְׁאִ֤יר אַֽחֲרָי/ו֙ בְּרָכָ֔ה מִנְחָ֣ה וָ/נֶ֔סֶךְ לַ/יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: my yvd' yshvb vnchm vhsh'yr 'chryv brkhh mnchh vnskh lyhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: Who knoweth if he will return and repent, and leave a blessing behind him; even a meat offering and a drink offering unto the LORD your God?

verses.original: תִּקְע֥וּ שׁוֹפָ֖ר בְּ/צִיּ֑וֹן קַדְּשׁוּ צ֖וֹם קִרְא֥וּ עֲצָרָֽה
verses.translit: tq'v shvpr btsyvn qdshv tsvm qr'v 'tsrh
verses.translation: Blow the trumpet in Zion, sanctify a fast, call a solemn assembly:

verses.original: אִסְפוּ עָ֞ם קַדְּשׁ֤וּ קָהָל֙ קִבְצ֣וּ זְקֵנִ֔ים אִסְפוּ֙ עֽוֹלָלִ֔ים וְ/יֹנְקֵ֖י שָׁדָ֑יִם יֵצֵ֤א חָתָן֙ מֵֽ/חֶדְר֔/וֹ וְ/כַלָּ֖ה מֵ/חֻפָּתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: 'spv 'm qdshv qhl qbtsv zqnym 'spv 'vllym vynqy shdym yts' chtn mchdrv vkhlh mchpth
verses.translation: Gather the people, sanctify the congregation, assemble the elders, gather the children, and those that suck the breasts: let the bridegroom go forth of his chamber, and the bride out of her closet.

verses.original: בֵּ֤ין הָ/אוּלָם֙ וְ/לַ/מִּזְבֵּ֔חַ יִבְכּוּ֙ הַ/כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים מְשָׁרְתֵ֖י יְהוָ֑ה וְֽ/יֹאמְר֞וּ ח֧וּסָ/ה יְהוָ֣ה עַל עַמֶּ֗/ךָ וְ/אַל תִּתֵּ֨ן נַחֲלָתְ/ךָ֤ לְ/חֶרְפָּה֙ לִ/מְשָׁל בָּ֣/ם גּוֹיִ֔ם לָ֚/מָּה יֹאמְר֣וּ בָֽ/עַמִּ֔ים אַיֵּ֖ה אֱלֹהֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: byn h'vlm vlmzbch ybkhv hkhhnym mshrty yhvh vy'mrv chvsh yhvh 'l 'mkh v'l ttn nchltkh lchrph lmshl bm gvym lmh y'mrv b'mym 'yh 'lhyhm
verses.translation: Let the priests, the ministers of the LORD , weep between the porch and the altar, and let them say, Spare thy people, O LORD , and give not thine heritage to reproach, that the heathen should rule over them: wherefore should they say among the people, Where is their God?

verses.original: וַ/יְקַנֵּ֥א יְהוָ֖ה לְ/אַרְצ֑/וֹ וַ/יַּחְמֹ֖ל עַל עַמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyqn' yhvh l'rtsv vychml 'l 'mv
verses.translation: Then will the LORD be jealous for his land, and pity his people.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַן יְהוָ֜ה וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לְ/עַמּ֗/וֹ הִנְ/נִ֨י שֹׁלֵ֤חַ לָ/כֶם֙ אֶת הַ/דָּגָן֙ וְ/הַ/תִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְ/הַ/יִּצְהָ֔ר וּ/שְׂבַעְתֶּ֖ם אֹת֑/וֹ וְ/לֹא אֶתֵּ֨ן אֶתְ/כֶ֥ם ע֛וֹד חֶרְפָּ֖ה בַּ/גּוֹיִֽם
verses.translit: vy'n yhvh vy'mr l'mv hnny shlch lkhm 't hdgn vhtyrvsh vhytshr vshb'tm 'tv vl' 'tn 'tkhm 'vd chrph bgvym
verses.translation: Yea, the LORD will answer and say unto his people, Behold, I will send you corn, and wine, and oil, and ye shall be satisfied therewith: and I will no more make you a reproach among the heathen:

verses.original: וְֽ/אֶת הַ/צְּפוֹנִ֞י אַרְחִ֣יק מֵ/עֲלֵי/כֶ֗ם וְ/הִדַּחְתִּי/ו֮ אֶל אֶ֣רֶץ צִיָּ֣ה וּ/שְׁמָמָה֒ אֶת פָּנָ֗י/ו אֶל הַ/יָּם֙ הַ/קַּדְמֹנִ֔י וְ/סֹפ֖/וֹ אֶל הַ/יָּ֣ם הָ/אַֽחֲר֑וֹן וְ/עָלָ֣ה בָאְשׁ֗/וֹ וְ/תַ֨עַל֙ צַחֲנָת֔/וֹ כִּ֥י הִגְדִּ֖יל לַ/עֲשֽׂוֹת
verses.translit: v't htspvny 'rchyq m'lykhm vhdchtyv 'l 'rts tsyh vshmmh 't pnyv 'l hym hqdmny vspv 'l hym h'chrvn v'lh b'shv vt'l tschntv khy hgdyl l'shvt
verses.translation: But I will remove far off from you the northern army , and will drive him into a land barren and desolate, with his face toward the east sea, and his hinder part toward the utmost sea, and his stink shall come up, and his ill savour shall come up, because he hath done great things.

verses.original: אַל תִּֽירְאִ֖י אֲדָמָ֑ה גִּ֣ילִי וּ/שְׂמָ֔חִי כִּֽי הִגְדִּ֥יל יְהוָ֖ה לַ/עֲשֽׂוֹת
verses.translit: 'l tyr'y 'dmh gyly vshmchy khy hgdyl yhvh l'shvt
verses.translation: Fear not, O land; be glad and rejoice: for the LORD will do great things.

verses.original: אַל תִּֽירְאוּ֙ בַּהֲמ֣וֹת שָׂדַ֔י כִּ֥י דָשְׁא֖וּ נְא֣וֹת מִדְבָּ֑ר כִּֽי עֵץ֙ נָשָׂ֣א פִרְי֔/וֹ תְּאֵנָ֥ה וָ/גֶ֖פֶן נָתְנ֥וּ חֵילָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'l tyr'v bhmvt shdy khy dsh'v n'vt mdbr khy 'ts nsh' pryv t'nh vgpn ntnv chylm
verses.translation: Be not afraid, ye beasts of the field: for the pastures of the wilderness do spring, for the tree beareth her fruit, the fig tree and the vine do yield their strength.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֣י צִיּ֗וֹן גִּ֤ילוּ וְ/שִׂמְחוּ֙ בַּ/יהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶ֔ם כִּֽי נָתַ֥ן לָ/כֶ֛ם אֶת הַ/מּוֹרֶ֖ה לִ/צְדָקָ֑ה וַ/יּ֣וֹרֶד לָ/כֶ֗ם גֶּ֛שֶׁם מוֹרֶ֥ה וּ/מַלְק֖וֹשׁ בָּ/רִאשֽׁוֹן
verses.translit: vbny tsyvn gylv vshmchv byhvh 'lhykhm khy ntn lkhm 't hmvrh ltsdqh vyvrd lkhm gshm mvrh vmlqvsh br'shvn
verses.translation: Be glad then, ye children of Zion, and rejoice in the LORD your God: for he hath given you the former rain moderately, and he will cause to come down for you the rain, the former rain, and the latter rain in the first month .

verses.original: וּ/מָלְא֥וּ הַ/גֳּרָנ֖וֹת בָּ֑ר וְ/הֵשִׁ֥יקוּ הַ/יְקָבִ֖ים תִּיר֥וֹשׁ וְ/יִצְהָֽר
verses.translit: vml'v hgrnvt br vhshyqv hyqbym tyrvsh vytshr
verses.translation: And the floors shall be full of wheat, and the fats shall overflow with wine and oil.

verses.original: וְ/שִׁלַּמְתִּ֤י לָ/כֶם֙ אֶת הַ/שָּׁנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר֙ אָכַ֣ל הָֽ/אַרְבֶּ֔ה הַ/יֶּ֖לֶק וְ/הֶ/חָסִ֣יל וְ/הַ/גָּזָ֑ם חֵילִ/י֙ הַ/גָּד֔וֹל אֲשֶׁ֥ר שִׁלַּ֖חְתִּי בָּ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vshlmty lkhm 't hshnym 'shr 'khl h'rbh hylq vhchsyl vhgzm chyly hgdvl 'shr shlchty bkhm
verses.translation: And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten, the cankerworm, and the caterpiller, and the palmerworm, my great army which I sent among you.

verses.original: וַ/אֲכַלְתֶּ֤ם אָכוֹל֙ וְ/שָׂב֔וֹעַ וְ/הִלַּלְתֶּ֗ם אֶת שֵׁ֤ם יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵי/כֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֥ה עִמָּ/כֶ֖ם לְ/הַפְלִ֑יא וְ/לֹא יֵבֹ֥שׁוּ עַמִּ֖/י לְ/עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: v'khltm 'khvl vshbv' vhlltm 't shm yhvh 'lhykhm 'shr 'shh 'mkhm lhply' vl' ybshv 'my l'vlm
verses.translation: And ye shall eat in plenty, and be satisfied, and praise the name of the LORD your God, that hath dealt wondrously with you: and my people shall never be ashamed.

verses.original: וִ/ידַעְתֶּ֗ם כִּ֣י בְ/קֶ֤רֶב יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אָ֔נִי וַ/אֲנִ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֖ם וְ/אֵ֣ין ע֑וֹד וְ/לֹא יֵבֹ֥שׁוּ עַמִּ֖/י לְ/עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vyd'tm khy bqrb yshr'l 'ny v'ny yhvh 'lhykhm v'yn 'vd vl' ybshv 'my l'vlm
verses.translation: And ye shall know that I am in the midst of Israel, and that I am the LORD your God, and none else: and my people shall never be ashamed.
And it shall come to pass afterward, that I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your old men shall dream dreams, your young men shall see visions:
And also upon the servants and upon the handmaids in those days will I pour out my spirit.
And I will shew wonders in the heavens and in the earth, blood, and fire, and pillars of smoke.
The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and the terrible day of the LORD come.

And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the LORD shall be delivered: for in mount Zion and in Jerusalem shall be deliverance, as the LORD hath said, and in the remnant whom the LORD shall call.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֣ה אַֽחֲרֵי כֵ֗ן אֶשְׁפּ֤וֹךְ אֶת רוּחִ/י֙ עַל כָּל בָּשָׂ֔ר וְ/נִבְּא֖וּ בְּנֵי/כֶ֣ם וּ/בְנֽוֹתֵי/כֶ֑ם זִקְנֵי/כֶם֙ חֲלֹמ֣וֹת יַחֲלֹמ֔וּ/ן בַּח֣וּרֵי/כֶ֔ם חֶזְיֹנ֖וֹת יִרְאֽוּ
verses.translit: vhyh 'chry khn 'shpvkh 't rvchy 'l khl bshr vnb'v bnykhm vbnvtykhm zqnykhm chlmvt ychlmvn bchvrykhm chzynvt yr'v
verses.translation: For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I shall bring again the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem,

verses.original: וְ/גַ֥ם עַל הָֽ/עֲבָדִ֖ים וְ/עַל הַ/שְּׁפָח֑וֹת בַּ/יָּמִ֣ים הָ/הֵ֔מָּה אֶשְׁפּ֖וֹךְ אֶת רוּחִֽ/י
verses.translit: vgm 'l h'bdym v'l hshpchvt bymym hhmh 'shpvkh 't rvchy
verses.translation: I will also gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat, and will plead with them there for my people and for my heritage Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations, and parted my land.

verses.original: וְ/נָֽתַתִּי֙ מֽוֹפְתִ֔ים בַּ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם וּ/בָ/אָ֑רֶץ דָּ֣ם וָ/אֵ֔שׁ וְ/תִֽימֲר֖וֹת עָשָֽׁן
verses.translit: vntty mvptym bshmym vb'rts dm v'sh vtymrvt 'shn
verses.translation: And they have cast lots for my people; and have given a boy for an harlot, and sold a girl for wine, that they might drink.

verses.original: הַ/שֶּׁ֨מֶשׁ֙ יֵהָפֵ֣ךְ לְ/חֹ֔שֶׁךְ וְ/הַ/יָּרֵ֖חַ לְ/דָ֑ם לִ/פְנֵ֗י בּ֚וֹא י֣וֹם יְהוָ֔ה הַ/גָּד֖וֹל וְ/הַ/נּוֹרָֽא
verses.translit: hshmsh yhpkh lchshkh vhyrch ldm lpny bv' yvm yhvh hgdvl vhnvr'
verses.translation: Yea, and what have ye to do with me, O Tyre, and Zidon, and all the coasts of Palestine? will ye render me a recompence? and if ye recompense me, swiftly and speedily will I return your recompence upon your own head;

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה כֹּ֧ל אֲשֶׁר יִקְרָ֛א בְּ/שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה יִמָּלֵ֑ט כִּ֠י בְּ/הַר צִיּ֨וֹן וּ/בִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֜ם תִּֽהְיֶ֣ה פְלֵיטָ֗ה כַּֽ/אֲשֶׁר֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה וּ/בַ֨/שְּׂרִידִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה קֹרֵֽא
verses.translit: vhyh khl 'shr yqr' bshm yhvh ymlt khy bhr tsyvn vbyrvshlm thyh plyth kh'shr 'mr yhvh vbshrydym 'shr yhvh qr'
verses.translation: Because ye have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried into your temples my goodly pleasant things:
The children also of Judah and the children of Jerusalem have ye sold unto the Grecians, that ye might remove them far from their border.
Behold, I will raise them out of the place whither ye have sold them, and will return your recompence upon your own head:
And I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the children of Judah, and they shall sell them to the Sabeans, to a people far off: for the LORD hath spoken it .
Proclaim ye this among the Gentiles; Prepare war, wake up the mighty men, let all the men of war draw near; let them come up:
Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruninghooks into spears: let the weak say, I am strong.
Assemble yourselves, and come, all ye heathen, and gather yourselves together round about: thither cause thy mighty ones to come down, O LORD . shall bring down
Let the heathen be wakened, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat: for there will I sit to judge all the heathen round about.
Put ye in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe: come, get you down; for the press is full, the fats overflow; for their wickedness is great.
Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision: for the day of the LORD is near in the valley of decision.
The sun and the moon shall be darkened, and the stars shall withdraw their shining.

The LORD also shall roar out of Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the heavens and the earth shall shake: but the LORD will be the hope of his people, and the strength of the children of Israel.
So shall ye know that I am the LORD your God dwelling in Zion, my holy mountain: then shall Jerusalem be holy, and there shall no strangers pass through her any more.

And it shall come to pass in that day, that the mountains shall drop down new wine, and the hills shall flow with milk, and all the rivers of Judah shall flow with waters, and a fountain shall come forth of the house of the LORD , and shall water the valley of Shittim.
Egypt shall be a desolation, and Edom shall be a desolate wilderness, for the violence against the children of Judah, because they have shed innocent blood in their land.
But Judah shall dwell for ever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.
For I will cleanse their blood that I have not cleansed: for the LORD dwelleth in Zion. that

verses.original: דִּבְרֵ֣י עָמ֔וֹס אֲשֶׁר הָיָ֥ה בַ/נֹּקְדִ֖ים מִ/תְּק֑וֹעַ אֲשֶׁר֩ חָזָ֨ה עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל בִּ/ימֵ֣י עֻזִיָּ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֗ה וּ/בִ/ימֵ֞י יָרָבְעָ֤ם בֶּן יוֹאָשׁ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שְׁנָתַ֖יִם לִ/פְנֵ֥י הָ/רָֽעַשׁ
verses.translit: dbry 'mvs 'shr hyh bnqdym mtqv' 'shr chzh 'l yshr'l bymy 'zyh mlkh yhvdh vbymy yrb'm bn yv'sh mlkh yshr'l shntym lpny hr'sh
verses.translation: The words of Amos, who was among the herdmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמַ֓ר יְהוָה֙ מִ/צִיּ֣וֹן יִשְׁאָ֔ג וּ/מִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם יִתֵּ֣ן קוֹל֑/וֹ וְ/אָֽבְלוּ֙ נְא֣וֹת הָ/רֹעִ֔ים וְ/יָבֵ֖שׁ רֹ֥אשׁ הַ/כַּרְמֶֽל
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh mtsyvn ysh'g vmyrvshlm ytn qvlv v'blv n'vt hr'ym vybsh r'sh hkhrml
verses.translation: And he said, The LORD will roar from Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the habitations of the shepherds shall mourn, and the top of Carmel shall wither.

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה עַל שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵ֣י דַמֶּ֔שֶׂק וְ/עַל אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑/נּוּ עַל דּוּשָׁ֛/ם בַּ/חֲרֻצ֥וֹת הַ/בַּרְזֶ֖ל אֶת הַ/גִּלְעָֽד
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'l shlshh psh'y dmshq v'l 'rb'h l' 'shybnv 'l dvshm bchrtsvt hbrzl 't hgl'd
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD ; For three transgressions of Damascus, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron:

verses.original: וְ/שִׁלַּ֥חְתִּי אֵ֖שׁ בְּ/בֵ֣ית חֲזָאֵ֑ל וְ/אָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנ֥וֹת בֶּן הֲדָֽד
verses.translit: vshlchty 'sh bbyt chz'l v'khlh 'rmnvt bn hdd
verses.translation: But I will send a fire into the house of Hazael, which shall devour the palaces of Ben-hadad.

verses.original: וְ/שָֽׁבַרְתִּי֙ בְּרִ֣יחַ דַּמֶּ֔שֶׂק וְ/הִכְרַתִּ֤י יוֹשֵׁב֙ מִ/בִּקְעַת אָ֔וֶן וְ/תוֹמֵ֥ךְ שֵׁ֖בֶט מִ/בֵּ֣ית עֶ֑דֶן וְ/גָל֧וּ עַם אֲרָ֛ם קִ֖ירָ/ה אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vshbrty brych dmshq vhkhrty yvshb mbq't 'vn vtvmkh shbt mbyt 'dn vglv 'm 'rm qyrh 'mr yhvh
verses.translation: I will break also the bar of Damascus, and cut off the inhabitant from the plain of Aven, and him that holdeth the sceptre from the house of Eden: and the people of Syria shall go into captivity unto Kir, saith the LORD .

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה עַל שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵ֣י עַזָּ֔ה וְ/עַל אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑/נּוּ עַל הַגְלוֹתָ֛/ם גָּל֥וּת שְׁלֵמָ֖ה לְ/הַסְגִּ֥יר לֶ/אֱדֽוֹם
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'l shlshh psh'y 'zh v'l 'rb'h l' 'shybnv 'l hglvtm glvt shlmh lhsgyr l'dvm
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD ; For three transgressions of Gaza, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they carried away captive the whole captivity, to deliver them up to Edom:

verses.original: וְ/שִׁלַּ֥חְתִּי אֵ֖שׁ בְּ/חוֹמַ֣ת עַזָּ֑ה וְ/אָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנֹתֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vshlchty 'sh bchvmt 'zh v'khlh 'rmntyh
verses.translation: But I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza, which shall devour the palaces thereof:

verses.original: וְ/הִכְרַתִּ֤י יוֹשֵׁב֙ מֵֽ/אַשְׁדּ֔וֹד וְ/תוֹמֵ֥ךְ שֵׁ֖בֶט מֵֽ/אַשְׁקְל֑וֹן וַ/הֲשִׁיב֨וֹתִי יָדִ֜/י עַל עֶקְר֗וֹן וְ/אָֽבְדוּ֙ שְׁאֵרִ֣ית פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: vhkhrty yvshb m'shdvd vtvmkh shbt m'shqlvn vhshybvty ydy 'l 'qrvn v'bdv sh'ryt plshtym 'mr 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: And I will cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod, and him that holdeth the sceptre from Ashkelon, and I will turn mine hand against Ekron: and the remnant of the Philistines shall perish, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה עַל שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵי צֹ֔ר וְ/עַל אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑/נּוּ עַֽל הַסְגִּירָ֞/ם גָּל֤וּת שְׁלֵמָה֙ לֶ/אֱד֔וֹם וְ/לֹ֥א זָכְר֖וּ בְּרִ֥ית אַחִֽים
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'l shlshh psh'y tsr v'l 'rb'h l' 'shybnv 'l hsgyrm glvt shlmh l'dvm vl' zkhrv bryt 'chym
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD ; For three transgressions of Tyrus, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they delivered up the whole captivity to Edom, and remembered not the brotherly covenant:

verses.original: וְ/שִׁלַּ֥חְתִּי אֵ֖שׁ בְּ/ח֣וֹמַת צֹ֑ר וְ/אָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנֹתֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vshlchty 'sh bchvmt tsr v'khlh 'rmntyh
verses.translation: But I will send a fire on the wall of Tyrus, which shall devour the palaces thereof.

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה עַל שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵ֣י אֱד֔וֹם וְ/עַל אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑/נּוּ עַל רָדְפ֨/וֹ בַ/חֶ֤רֶב אָחִי/ו֙ וְ/שִׁחֵ֣ת רַחֲמָ֔י/ו וַ/יִּטְרֹ֤ף לָ/עַד֙ אַפּ֔/וֹ וְ/עֶבְרָת֖/וֹ שְׁמָ֥רָ/ה נֶֽצַח
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'l shlshh psh'y 'dvm v'l 'rb'h l' 'shybnv 'l rdpv bchrb 'chyv vshcht rchmyv vytrf l'd 'pv v'brtv shmrh ntsch
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD ; For three transgressions of Edom, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because he did pursue his brother with the sword, and did cast off all pity, and his anger did tear perpetually, and he kept his wrath for ever:

verses.original: וְ/שִׁלַּ֥חְתִּי אֵ֖שׁ בְּ/תֵימָ֑ן וְ/אָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנ֥וֹת בָּצְרָֽה
verses.translit: vshlchty 'sh btymn v'khlh 'rmnvt btsrh
verses.translation: But I will send a fire upon Teman, which shall devour the palaces of Bozrah.

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה עַל שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵ֣י בְנֵֽי עַמּ֔וֹן וְ/עַל אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑/נּוּ עַל בִּקְעָ/ם֙ הָר֣וֹת הַ/גִּלְעָ֔ד לְמַ֖עַן הַרְחִ֥יב אֶת גְּבוּלָֽ/ם
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'l shlshh psh'y bny 'mvn v'l 'rb'h l' 'shybnv 'l bq'm hrvt hgl'd lm'n hrchyb 't gbvlm
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD ; For three transgressions of the children of Ammon, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have ripped up the women with child of Gilead, that they might enlarge their border:

verses.original: וְ/הִצַּ֤תִּי אֵשׁ֙ בְּ/חוֹמַ֣ת רַבָּ֔ה וְ/אָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנוֹתֶ֑י/הָ בִּ/תְרוּעָה֙ בְּ/י֣וֹם מִלְחָמָ֔ה בְּ/סַ֖עַר בְּ/י֥וֹם סוּפָֽה
verses.translit: vhtsty 'sh bchvmt rbh v'khlh 'rmnvtyh btrv'h byvm mlchmh bs'r byvm svph
verses.translation: But I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah, and it shall devour the palaces thereof, with shouting in the day of battle, with a tempest in the day of the whirlwind:

verses.original: וְ/הָלַ֥ךְ מַלְכָּ֖/ם בַּ/גּוֹלָ֑ה ה֧וּא וְ/שָׂרָ֛י/ו יַחְדָּ֖ו אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhlkh mlkhm bgvlh hv' vshryv ychdv 'mr yhvh
verses.translation: And their king shall go into captivity, he and his princes together, saith the LORD .

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה עַל שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵ֣י מוֹאָ֔ב וְ/עַל אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑/נּוּ עַל שָׂרְפ֛/וֹ עַצְמ֥וֹת מֶֽלֶךְ אֱד֖וֹם לַ/שִּֽׂיד
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'l shlshh psh'y mv'b v'l 'rb'h l' 'shybnv 'l shrpv 'tsmvt mlkh 'dvm lshyd
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD ; For three transgressions of Moab, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime:

verses.original: וְ/שִׁלַּחְתִּי אֵ֣שׁ בְּ/מוֹאָ֔ב וְ/אָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנ֣וֹת הַ/קְּרִיּ֑וֹת וּ/מֵ֤ת בְּ/שָׁאוֹן֙ מוֹאָ֔ב בִּ/תְרוּעָ֖ה בְּ/ק֥וֹל שׁוֹפָֽר
verses.translit: vshlchty 'sh bmv'b v'khlh 'rmnvt hqryvt vmt bsh'vn mv'b btrv'h bqvl shvpr
verses.translation: But I will send a fire upon Moab, and it shall devour the palaces of Kerioth: and Moab shall die with tumult, with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet:

verses.original: וְ/הִכְרַתִּ֥י שׁוֹפֵ֖ט מִ/קִּרְבָּ֑/הּ וְ/כָל שָׂרֶ֛י/הָ אֶהֱר֥וֹג עִמּ֖/וֹ אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhkhrty shvpt mqrbh vkhl shryh 'hrvg 'mv 'mr yhvh
verses.translation: And I will cut off the judge from the midst thereof, and will slay all the princes thereof with him, saith the LORD .

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה עַל שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וְ/עַל אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑/נּוּ עַֽל מָאֳסָ֞/ם אֶת תּוֹרַ֣ת יְהוָ֗ה וְ/חֻקָּי/ו֙ לֹ֣א שָׁמָ֔רוּ וַ/יַּתְעוּ/ם֙ כִּזְבֵי/הֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר הָלְכ֥וּ אֲבוֹתָ֖/ם אַחֲרֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'l shlshh psh'y yhvdh v'l 'rb'h l' 'shybnv 'l m'sm 't tvrt yhvh vchqyv l' shmrv vyt'vm khzbyhm 'shr hlkhv 'bvtm 'chryhm
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD ; For three transgressions of Judah, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have despised the law of the LORD , and have not kept his commandments, and their lies caused them to err, after the which their fathers have walked:

verses.original: וְ/שִׁלַּ֥חְתִּי אֵ֖שׁ בִּֽ/יהוּדָ֑ה וְ/אָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנ֥וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vshlchty 'sh byhvdh v'khlh 'rmnvt yrvshlm
verses.translation: But I will send a fire upon Judah, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem.

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה עַל שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/עַל אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑/נּוּ עַל מִכְרָ֤/ם בַּ/כֶּ֨סֶף֙ צַדִּ֔יק וְ/אֶבְי֖וֹן בַּ/עֲב֥וּר נַעֲלָֽיִם
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'l shlshh psh'y yshr'l v'l 'rb'h l' 'shybnv 'l mkhrm bkhsf tsdyq v'byvn b'bvr n'lym
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD ; For three transgressions of Israel, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they sold the righteous for silver, and the poor for a pair of shoes;

verses.original: הַ/שֹּׁאֲפִ֤ים עַל עֲפַר אֶ֨רֶץ֙ בְּ/רֹ֣אשׁ דַּלִּ֔ים וְ/דֶ֥רֶךְ עֲנָוִ֖ים יַטּ֑וּ וְ/אִ֣ישׁ וְ/אָבִ֗י/ו יֵֽלְכוּ֙ אֶל הַֽ/נַּעֲרָ֔ה לְמַ֥עַן חַלֵּ֖ל אֶת שֵׁ֥ם קָדְשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: hsh'pym 'l 'pr 'rts br'sh dlym vdrkh 'nvym ytv v'ysh v'byv ylkhv 'l hn'rh lm'n chll 't shm qdshy
verses.translation: That pant after the dust of the earth on the head of the poor, and turn aside the way of the meek: and a man and his father will go in unto the same maid, to profane my holy name:

verses.original: וְ/עַל בְּגָדִ֤ים חֲבֻלִים֙ יַטּ֔וּ אֵ֖צֶל כָּל מִזְבֵּ֑חַ וְ/יֵ֤ין עֲנוּשִׁים֙ יִשְׁתּ֔וּ בֵּ֖ית אֱלֹהֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'l bgdym chblym ytv 'tsl khl mzbch vyyn 'nvshym yshtv byt 'lhyhm
verses.translation: And they lay themselves down upon clothes laid to pledge by every altar, and they drink the wine of the condemned in the house of their god.

verses.original: וְ/אָ֨נֹכִ֜י הִשְׁמַ֤דְתִּי אֶת הָֽ/אֱמֹרִי֙ מִ/פְּנֵי/הֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר כְּ/גֹ֤בַהּ אֲרָזִים֙ גָּבְה֔/וֹ וְ/חָסֹ֥ן ה֖וּא כָּֽ/אַלּוֹנִ֑ים וָ/אַשְׁמִ֤יד פִּרְי/וֹ֙ מִ/מַּ֔עַל וְ/שָׁרָשָׁ֖י/ו מִ/תָּֽחַת
verses.translit: v'nkhy hshmdty 't h'mry mpnyhm 'shr khgbh 'rzym gbhv vchsn hv' kh'lvnym v'shmyd pryv mm'l vshrshyv mtcht
verses.translation: Yet destroyed I the Amorite before them, whose height was like the height of the cedars, and he was strong as the oaks; yet I destroyed his fruit from above, and his roots from beneath.

verses.original: וְ/אָנֹכִ֛י הֶעֱלֵ֥יתִי אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וָ/אוֹלֵ֨ךְ אֶתְ/כֶ֤ם בַּ/מִּדְבָּר֙ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה לָ/רֶ֖שֶׁת אֶת אֶ֥רֶץ הָ/אֱמֹרִֽי
verses.translit: v'nkhy h'lyty 'tkhm m'rts mtsrym v'vlkh 'tkhm bmdbr 'rb'ym shnh lrsht 't 'rts h'mry
verses.translation: Also I brought you up from the land of Egypt, and led you forty years through the wilderness, to possess the land of the Amorite.

verses.original: וָ/אָקִ֤ים מִ/בְּנֵי/כֶם֙ לִ/נְבִיאִ֔ים וּ/מִ/בַּחוּרֵי/כֶ֖ם לִ/נְזִרִ֑ים הַ/אַ֥ף אֵֽין זֹ֛את בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: v'qym mbnykhm lnby'ym vmbchvrykhm lnzrym h'f 'yn z't bny yshr'l n'm yhvh
verses.translation: And I raised up of your sons for prophets, and of your young men for Nazarites. Is it not even thus, O ye children of Israel? saith the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/תַּשְׁק֥וּ אֶת הַ/נְּזִרִ֖ים יָ֑יִן וְ/עַל הַ/נְּבִיאִים֙ צִוִּיתֶ֣ם לֵ/אמֹ֔ר לֹ֖א תִּנָּבְאֽוּ
verses.translit: vtshqv 't hnzrym yyn v'l hnby'ym tsvytm l'mr l' tnb'v
verses.translation: But ye gave the Nazarites wine to drink; and commanded the prophets, saying, Prophesy not.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֛ה אָנֹכִ֥י מֵעִ֖יק תַּחְתֵּי/כֶ֑ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר תָּעִיק֙ הָ/עֲגָלָ֔ה הַֽ/מְלֵאָ֥ה לָ֖/הּ עָמִֽיר
verses.translit: hnh 'nkhy m'yq tchtykhm kh'shr t'yq h'glh hml'h lh 'myr
verses.translation: Behold, I am pressed under you, as a cart is pressed that is full of sheaves.

verses.original: וְ/אָבַ֤ד מָנוֹס֙ מִ/קָּ֔ל וְ/חָזָ֖ק לֹא יְאַמֵּ֣ץ כֹּח֑/וֹ וְ/גִבּ֖וֹר לֹא יְמַלֵּ֥ט נַפְשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'bd mnvs mql vchzq l' y'mts khchv vgbvr l' ymlt npshv
verses.translation: Therefore the flight shall perish from the swift, and the strong shall not strengthen his force, neither shall the mighty deliver himself:

verses.original: וְ/תֹפֵ֤שׂ הַ/קֶּ֨שֶׁת֙ לֹ֣א יַעֲמֹ֔ד וְ/קַ֥ל בְּ/רַגְלָ֖י/ו לֹ֣א יְמַלֵּ֑ט וְ/רֹכֵ֣ב הַ/סּ֔וּס לֹ֥א יְמַלֵּ֖ט נַפְשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: vtpsh hqsht l' y'md vql brglyv l' ymlt vrkhb hsvs l' ymlt npshv
verses.translation: Neither shall he stand that handleth the bow; and he that is swift of foot shall not deliver himself: neither shall he that rideth the horse deliver himself.

verses.original: וְ/אַמִּ֥יץ לִבּ֖/וֹ בַּ/גִּבּוֹרִ֑ים עָר֛וֹם יָנ֥וּס בַּ/יּוֹם הַ/ה֖וּא נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: v'myts lbv bgbvrym 'rvm ynvs byvm hhv' n'm yhvh
verses.translation: And he that is courageous among the mighty shall flee away naked in that day, saith the LORD .

verses.original: שִׁמְע֞וּ אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה עֲלֵי/כֶ֖ם בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עַ֚ל כָּל הַ/מִּשְׁפָּחָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר הֶעֱלֵ֛יתִי מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: shm'v 't hdbr hzh 'shr dbr yhvh 'lykhm bny yshr'l 'l khl hmshpchh 'shr h'lyty m'rts mtsrym l'mr
verses.translation: Hear this word that the LORD hath spoken against you, O children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up from the land of Egypt, saying,

verses.original: רַ֚ק אֶתְ/כֶ֣ם יָדַ֔עְתִּי מִ/כֹּ֖ל מִשְׁפְּח֣וֹת הָ/אֲדָמָ֑ה עַל כֵּן֙ אֶפְקֹ֣ד עֲלֵי/כֶ֔ם אֵ֖ת כָּל עֲוֺנֹֽתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: rq 'tkhm yd'ty mkhl mshpchvt h'dmh 'l khn 'pqd 'lykhm 't khl 'vntykhm
verses.translation: You only have I known of all the families of the earth: therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities.

verses.original: הֲ/יֵלְכ֥וּ שְׁנַ֖יִם יַחְדָּ֑ו בִּלְתִּ֖י אִם נוֹעָֽדוּ
verses.translit: hylkhv shnym ychdv blty 'm nv'dv
verses.translation: Can two walk together, except they be agreed?

verses.original: הֲ/יִשְׁאַ֤ג אַרְיֵה֙ בַּ/יַּ֔עַר וְ/טֶ֖רֶף אֵ֣ין ל֑/וֹ הֲ/יִתֵּ֨ן כְּפִ֤יר קוֹל/וֹ֙ מִ/מְּעֹ֣נָת֔/וֹ בִּלְתִּ֖י אִם לָכָֽד
verses.translit: hysh'g 'ryh by'r vtrf 'yn lv hytn khpyr qvlv mm'ntv blty 'm lkhd
verses.translation: Will a lion roar in the forest, when he hath no prey? will a young lion cry out of his den, if he have taken nothing?

verses.original: הֲ/תִפֹּ֤ל צִפּוֹר֙ עַל פַּ֣ח הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וּ/מוֹקֵ֖שׁ אֵ֣ין לָ֑/הּ הֲ/יַֽעֲלֶה פַּח֙ מִן הָ֣/אֲדָמָ֔ה וְ/לָכ֖וֹד לֹ֥א יִלְכּֽוֹד
verses.translit: htpl tspvr 'l pch h'rts vmvqsh 'yn lh hy'lh pch mn h'dmh vlkhvd l' ylkhvd
verses.translation: Can a bird fall in a snare upon the earth, where no gin is for him? shall one take up a snare from the earth, and have taken nothing at all?

verses.original: אִם יִתָּקַ֤ע שׁוֹפָר֙ בְּ/עִ֔יר וְ/עָ֖ם לֹ֣א יֶחֱרָ֑דוּ אִם תִּהְיֶ֤ה רָעָה֙ בְּ/עִ֔יר וַ/יהוָ֖ה לֹ֥א עָשָֽׂה
verses.translit: 'm ytq' shvpr b'yr v'm l' ychrdv 'm thyh r'h b'yr vyhvh l' 'shh
verses.translation: Shall a trumpet be blown in the city, and the people not be afraid? shall there be evil in a city, and the LORD hath not done it ? …: or, shall not the LORD do somewhat?

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֧א יַעֲשֶׂ֛ה אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִ֖ה דָּבָ֑ר כִּ֚י אִם גָּלָ֣ה סוֹד֔/וֹ אֶל עֲבָדָ֖י/ו הַ/נְּבִיאִֽים
verses.translit: khy l' y'shh 'dny yhvh dbr khy 'm glh svdv 'l 'bdyv hnby'ym
verses.translation: Surely the Lord GOD will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets.

verses.original: אַרְיֵ֥ה שָׁאָ֖ג מִ֣י לֹ֣א יִירָ֑א אֲדֹנָ֤/י יְהוִה֙ דִּבֶּ֔ר מִ֖י לֹ֥א יִנָּבֵֽא
verses.translit: 'ryh sh'g my l' yyr' 'dny yhvh dbr my l' ynb'
verses.translation: The lion hath roared, who will not fear? the Lord GOD hath spoken, who can but prophesy?

verses.original: הַשְׁמִ֨יעוּ֙ עַל אַרְמְנ֣וֹת בְּ/אַשְׁדּ֔וֹד וְ/עַֽל אַרְמְנ֖וֹת בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ/אִמְר֗וּ הֵאָֽסְפוּ֙ עַל הָרֵ֣י שֹׁמְר֔וֹן וּ/רְא֞וּ מְהוּמֹ֤ת רַבּוֹת֙ בְּ/תוֹכָ֔/הּ וַ/עֲשׁוּקִ֖ים בְּ/קִרְבָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: hshmy'v 'l 'rmnvt b'shdvd v'l 'rmnvt b'rts mtsrym v'mrv h'spv 'l hry shmrvn vr'v mhvmt rbvt btvkhh v'shvqym bqrbh
verses.translation: Publish in the palaces at Ashdod, and in the palaces in the land of Egypt, and say, Assemble yourselves upon the mountains of Samaria, and behold the great tumults in the midst thereof, and the oppressed in the midst thereof.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא יָדְע֥וּ עֲשׂוֹת נְכֹחָ֖ה נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה הָ/אֽוֹצְרִ֛ים חָמָ֥ס וָ/שֹׁ֖ד בְּ/אַרְמְנֽוֹתֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vl' yd'v 'shvt nkhchh n'm yhvh h'vtsrym chms vshd b'rmnvtyhm
verses.translation: For they know not to do right, saith the LORD , who store up violence and robbery in their palaces.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה צַ֖ר וּ/סְבִ֣יב הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/הוֹרִ֤ד מִמֵּ/ךְ֙ עֻזֵּ֔/ךְ וְ/נָבֹ֖זּוּ אַרְמְנוֹתָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr 'dny yhvh tsr vsbyb h'rts vhvrd mmkh 'zkh vnbzv 'rmnvtykh
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD ; An adversary there shall be even round about the land; and he shall bring down thy strength from thee, and thy palaces shall be spoiled.

verses.original: כֹּה֮ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָה֒ כַּ/אֲשֶׁר֩ יַצִּ֨יל הָ/רֹעֶ֜ה מִ/פִּ֧י הָ/אֲרִ֛י שְׁתֵּ֥י כְרָעַ֖יִם א֣וֹ בְדַל אֹ֑זֶן כֵּ֣ן יִנָּצְל֞וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הַ/יֹּֽשְׁבִים֙ בְּ/שֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן בִּ/פְאַ֥ת מִטָּ֖ה וּ/בִ/דְמֶ֥שֶׁק עָֽרֶשׂ
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh kh'shr ytsyl hr'h mpy h'ry shty khr'ym 'v bdl 'zn khn yntslv bny yshr'l hyshbym bshmrvn bp't mth vbdmshq 'rsh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD ; As the shepherd taketh out of the mouth of the lion two legs, or a piece of an ear; so shall the children of Israel be taken out that dwell in Samaria in the corner of a bed, and in Damascus in a couch.

verses.original: שִׁמְע֥וּ וְ/הָעִ֖ידוּ בְּ/בֵ֣ית יַֽעֲקֹ֑ב נְאֻם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י הַ/צְּבָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: shm'v vh'ydv bbyt y'qb n'm 'dny yhvh 'lhy htsb'vt
verses.translation: Hear ye, and testify in the house of Jacob, saith the Lord GOD , the God of hosts,

verses.original: כִּ֗י בְּ/י֛וֹם פָּקְדִ֥/י פִשְׁעֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עָלָ֑י/ו וּ/פָֽקַדְתִּי֙ עַל מִזְבְּח֣וֹת בֵּֽית אֵ֔ל וְ/נִגְדְּעוּ֙ קַרְנ֣וֹת הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וְ/נָפְל֖וּ לָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: khy byvm pqdy psh'y yshr'l 'lyv vpqdty 'l mzbchvt byt 'l vngd'v qrnvt hmzbch vnplv l'rts
verses.translation: That in the day that I shall visit the transgressions of Israel upon him I will also visit the altars of Beth-el: and the horns of the altar shall be cut off, and fall to the ground.

verses.original: וְ/הִכֵּיתִ֥י בֵית הַ/חֹ֖רֶף עַל בֵּ֣ית הַ/קָּ֑יִץ וְ/אָבְד֞וּ בָּתֵּ֣י הַ/שֵּׁ֗ן וְ/סָפ֛וּ בָּתִּ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhkhyty byt hchrf 'l byt hqyts v'bdv bty hshn vspv btym rbym n'm yhvh
verses.translation: And I will smite the winter house with the summer house; and the houses of ivory shall perish, and the great houses shall have an end, saith the LORD .

verses.original: שִׁמְע֞וּ הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֗ה פָּר֤וֹת הַ/בָּשָׁן֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּ/הַ֣ר שֹֽׁמְר֔וֹן הָ/עֹשְׁק֣וֹת דַּלִּ֔ים הָ/רֹצְצ֖וֹת אֶבְיוֹנִ֑ים הָ/אֹמְרֹ֥ת לַ/אֲדֹֽנֵי/הֶ֖ם הָבִ֥יאָ/ה וְ/נִשְׁתֶּֽה
verses.translit: shm'v hdbr hzh prvt hbshn 'shr bhr shmrvn h'shqvt dlym hrtstsvt 'byvnym h'mrt l'dnyhm hby'h vnshth
verses.translation: Hear this word, ye kine of Bashan, that are in the mountain of Samaria, which oppress the poor, which crush the needy, which say to their masters, Bring, and let us drink.

verses.original: נִשְׁבַּ֨ע אֲדֹנָ֤/י יְהוִה֙ בְּ/קָדְשׁ֔/וֹ כִּ֛י הִנֵּ֥ה יָמִ֖ים בָּאִ֣ים עֲלֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/נִשָּׂ֤א אֶתְ/כֶם֙ בְּ/צִנּ֔וֹת וְ/אַחֲרִיתְ/כֶ֖ן בְּ/סִיר֥וֹת דּוּגָֽה
verses.translit: nshb' 'dny yhvh bqdshv khy hnh ymym b'ym 'lykhm vnsh' 'tkhm btsnvt v'chrytkhn bsyrvt dvgh
verses.translation: The Lord GOD hath sworn by his holiness, that, lo, the days shall come upon you, that he will take you away with hooks, and your posterity with fishhooks.

verses.original: וּ/פְרָצִ֥ים תֵּצֶ֖אנָה אִשָּׁ֣ה נֶגְדָּ֑/הּ וְ/הִשְׁלַכְתֶּ֥נָה הַ/הַרְמ֖וֹנָ/ה נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vprtsym tts'nh 'shh ngdh vhshlkhtnh hhrmvnh n'm yhvh
verses.translation: And ye shall go out at the breaches, every cow at that which is before her; and ye shall cast them into the palace, saith the LORD .

verses.original: בֹּ֤אוּ בֵֽית אֵל֙ וּ/פִשְׁע֔וּ הַ/גִּלְגָּ֖ל הַרְבּ֣וּ לִ/פְשֹׁ֑עַ וְ/הָבִ֤יאוּ לַ/בֹּ֨קֶר֙ זִבְחֵי/כֶ֔ם לִ/שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת יָמִ֖ים מַעְשְׂרֹֽתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: b'v byt 'l vpsh'v hglgl hrbv lpsh' vhby'v lbqr zbchykhm lshlsht ymym m'shrtykhm
verses.translation: Come to Beth-el, and transgress; at Gilgal multiply transgression; and bring your sacrifices every morning, and your tithes after three years:

verses.original: וְ/קַטֵּ֤ר מֵֽ/חָמֵץ֙ תּוֹדָ֔ה וְ/קִרְא֥וּ נְדָב֖וֹת הַשְׁמִ֑יעוּ כִּ֣י כֵ֤ן אֲהַבְתֶּם֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: vqtr mchmts tvdh vqr'v ndbvt hshmy'v khy khn 'hbtm bny yshr'l n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: And offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving with leaven, and proclaim and publish the free offerings: for this liketh you, O ye children of Israel, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: וְ/גַם אֲנִי֩ נָתַ֨תִּי לָ/כֶ֜ם נִקְי֤וֹן שִׁנַּ֨יִם֙ בְּ/כָל עָ֣רֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/חֹ֣סֶר לֶ֔חֶם בְּ/כֹ֖ל מְקוֹמֹֽתֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/לֹֽא שַׁבְתֶּ֥ם עָדַ֖/י נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vgm 'ny ntty lkhm nqyvn shnym bkhl 'rykhm vchsr lchm bkhl mqvmtykhm vl' shbtm 'dy n'm yhvh
verses.translation: And I also have given you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, and want of bread in all your places: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/גַ֣ם אָנֹכִי֩ מָנַ֨עְתִּי מִ/כֶּ֜ם אֶת הַ/גֶּ֗שֶׁם בְּ/ע֨וֹד שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה חֳדָשִׁים֙ לַ/קָּצִ֔יר וְ/הִמְטַרְתִּי֙ עַל עִ֣יר אֶחָ֔ת וְ/עַל עִ֥יר אַחַ֖ת לֹ֣א אַמְטִ֑יר חֶלְקָ֤ה אַחַת֙ תִּמָּטֵ֔ר וְ/חֶלְקָ֛ה אֲשֶֽׁר לֹֽא תַמְטִ֥יר עָלֶ֖י/הָ תִּיבָֽשׁ
verses.translit: vgm 'nkhy mn'ty mkhm 't hgshm b'vd shlshh chdshym lqtsyr vhmtrty 'l 'yr 'cht v'l 'yr 'cht l' 'mtyr chlqh 'cht tmtr vchlqh 'shr l' tmtyr 'lyh tybsh
verses.translation: And also I have withholden the rain from you, when there were yet three months to the harvest: and I caused it to rain upon one city, and caused it not to rain upon another city: one piece was rained upon, and the piece whereupon it rained not withered.

verses.original: וְ/נָע֡וּ שְׁתַּיִם֩ שָׁלֹ֨שׁ עָרִ֜ים אֶל עִ֥יר אַחַ֛ת לִ/שְׁתּ֥וֹת מַ֖יִם וְ/לֹ֣א יִשְׂבָּ֑עוּ וְ/לֹֽא שַׁבְתֶּ֥ם עָדַ֖/י נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vn'v shtym shlsh 'rym 'l 'yr 'cht lshtvt mym vl' yshb'v vl' shbtm 'dy n'm yhvh
verses.translation: So two or three cities wandered unto one city, to drink water; but they were not satisfied: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD .

verses.original: הִכֵּ֣יתִי אֶתְ/כֶם֮ בַּ/שִּׁדָּפ֣וֹן וּ/בַ/יֵּרָקוֹן֒ הַרְבּ֨וֹת גַּנּוֹתֵי/כֶ֧ם וְ/כַרְמֵי/כֶ֛ם וּ/תְאֵנֵי/כֶ֥ם וְ/זֵיתֵי/כֶ֖ם יֹאכַ֣ל הַ/גָּזָ֑ם וְ/לֹֽא שַׁבְתֶּ֥ם עָדַ֖/י נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: hkhyty 'tkhm bshdpvn vbyrqvn hrbvt gnvtykhm vkhrmykhm vt'nykhm vzytykhm y'khl hgzm vl' shbtm 'dy n'm yhvh
verses.translation: I have smitten you with blasting and mildew: when your gardens and your vineyards and your fig trees and your olive trees increased, the palmerworm devoured them: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD .

verses.original: שִׁלַּ֨חְתִּי בָ/כֶ֥ם דֶּ֨בֶר֙ בְּ/דֶ֣רֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם הָרַ֤גְתִּי בַ/חֶ֨רֶב֙ בַּח֣וּרֵי/כֶ֔ם עִ֖ם שְׁבִ֣י סֽוּסֵי/כֶ֑ם וָ/אַעֲלֶ֞ה בְּאֹ֤שׁ מַחֲנֵי/כֶם֙ וּֽ/בְ/אַפְּ/כֶ֔ם וְ/לֹֽא שַׁבְתֶּ֥ם עָדַ֖/י נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: shlchty bkhm dbr bdrkh mtsrym hrgty bchrb bchvrykhm 'm shby svsykhm v''lh b'sh mchnykhm vb'pkhm vl' shbtm 'dy n'm yhvh
verses.translation: I have sent among you the pestilence after the manner of Egypt: your young men have I slain with the sword, and have taken away your horses; and I have made the stink of your camps to come up unto your nostrils: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD .

verses.original: הָפַ֣כְתִּי בָ/כֶ֗ם כְּ/מַהְפֵּכַ֤ת אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת סְדֹ֣ם וְ/אֶת עֲמֹרָ֔ה וַ/תִּהְי֕וּ כְּ/א֖וּד מֻצָּ֣ל מִ/שְׂרֵפָ֑ה וְ/לֹֽא שַׁבְתֶּ֥ם עָדַ֖/י נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: hpkhty bkhm khmhpkht 'lhym 't sdm v't 'mrh vthyv kh'vd mtsl mshrph vl' shbtm 'dy n'm yhvh
verses.translation: I have overthrown some of you, as God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and ye were as a firebrand plucked out of the burning: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD .

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֕ן כֹּ֥ה אֶעֱשֶׂה לְּ/ךָ֖ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עֵ֚קֶב כִּֽי זֹ֣את אֶֽעֱשֶׂה לָּ֔/ךְ הִכּ֥וֹן לִ/קְרַאת אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: lkhn khh ''shh lkh yshr'l 'qb khy z't ''shh lkh hkhvn lqr't 'lhykh yshr'l
verses.translation: Therefore thus will I do unto thee, O Israel: and because I will do this unto thee, prepare to meet thy God, O Israel.

verses.original: כִּ֡י הִנֵּה֩ יוֹצֵ֨ר הָרִ֜ים וּ/בֹרֵ֣א ר֗וּחַ וּ/מַגִּ֤יד לְ/אָדָם֙ מַה שֵּׂח֔/וֹ עֹשֵׂ֥ה שַׁ֨חַר֙ עֵיפָ֔ה וְ/דֹרֵ֖ךְ עַל בָּ֣מֳתֵי אָ֑רֶץ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy hnh yvtsr hrym vbr' rvch vmgyd l'dm mh shchv 'shh shchr 'yph vdrkh 'l bmty 'rts yhvh 'lhy tsb'vt shmv
verses.translation: For, lo, he that formeth the mountains, and createth the wind, and declareth unto man what is his thought, that maketh the morning darkness, and treadeth upon the high places of the earth, The LORD , The God of hosts, is his name.

verses.original: שִׁמְע֞וּ אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֜י נֹשֵׂ֧א עֲלֵי/כֶ֛ם קִינָ֖ה בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: shm'v 't hdbr hzh 'shr 'nkhy nsh' 'lykhm qynh byt yshr'l
verses.translation: Hear ye this word which I take up against you, even a lamentation, O house of Israel.

verses.original: נָֽפְלָה֙ לֹֽא תוֹסִ֣יף ק֔וּם בְּתוּלַ֖ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל נִטְּשָׁ֥ה עַל אַדְמָתָ֖/הּ אֵ֥ין מְקִימָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: nplh l' tvsyf qvm btvlt yshr'l ntshh 'l 'dmth 'yn mqymh
verses.translation: The virgin of Israel is fallen; she shall no more rise: she is forsaken upon her land; there is none to raise her up.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה הָ/עִ֛יר הַ/יֹּצֵ֥את אֶ֖לֶף תַּשְׁאִ֣יר מֵאָ֑ה וְ/הַ/יּוֹצֵ֥את מֵאָ֛ה תַּשְׁאִ֥יר עֲשָׂרָ֖ה לְ/בֵ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr 'dny yhvh h'yr hyts't 'lf tsh'yr m'h vhyvts't m'h tsh'yr 'shrh lbyt yshr'l
verses.translation: For thus saith the Lord GOD ; The city that went out by a thousand shall leave an hundred, and that which went forth by an hundred shall leave ten, to the house of Israel.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהוָ֖ה לְ/בֵ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל דִּרְשׁ֖וּ/נִי וִֽ/חְיֽוּ
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh lbyt yshr'l drshvny vchyv
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD unto the house of Israel, Seek ye me, and ye shall live:

verses.original: וְ/אַֽל תִּדְרְשׁוּ֙ בֵּֽית אֵ֔ל וְ/הַ/גִּלְגָּל֙ לֹ֣א תָבֹ֔אוּ וּ/בְאֵ֥ר שֶׁ֖בַע לֹ֣א תַעֲבֹ֑רוּ כִּ֤י הַ/גִּלְגָּל֙ גָּלֹ֣ה יִגְלֶ֔ה וּ/בֵֽית אֵ֖ל יִהְיֶ֥ה לְ/אָֽוֶן
verses.translit: v'l tdrshv byt 'l vhglgl l' tb'v vb'r shb' l' t'brv khy hglgl glh yglh vbyt 'l yhyh l'vn
verses.translation: But seek not Beth-el, nor enter into Gilgal, and pass not to Beer-sheba: for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity, and Beth-el shall come to nought.

verses.original: דִּרְשׁ֥וּ אֶת יְהוָ֖ה וִֽ/חְי֑וּ פֶּן יִצְלַ֤ח כָּ/אֵשׁ֙ בֵּ֣ית יוֹסֵ֔ף וְ/אָכְלָ֥ה וְ/אֵין מְכַבֶּ֖ה לְ/בֵֽית אֵֽל
verses.translit: drshv 't yhvh vchyv pn ytslch kh'sh byt yvsf v'khlh v'yn mkhbh lbyt 'l
verses.translation: Seek the LORD , and ye shall live; lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph, and devour it , and there be none to quench it in Beth-el.

verses.original: הַ/הֹפְכִ֥ים לְ/לַעֲנָ֖ה מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּ/צְדָקָ֖ה לָ/אָ֥רֶץ הִנִּֽיחוּ
verses.translit: hhpkhym ll'nh mshpt vtsdqh l'rts hnychv
verses.translation: Ye who turn judgment to wormwood, and leave off righteousness in the earth,

verses.original: עֹשֵׂ֨ה כִימָ֜ה וּ/כְסִ֗יל וְ/הֹפֵ֤ךְ לַ/בֹּ֨קֶר֙ צַלְמָ֔וֶת וְ/י֖וֹם לַ֣יְלָה הֶחְשִׁ֑יךְ הַ/קּוֹרֵ֣א לְ/מֵֽי הַ/יָּ֗ם וַֽ/יִּשְׁפְּכֵ֛/ם עַל פְּנֵ֥י הָ/אָ֖רֶץ יְהוָ֥ה שְׁמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'shh khymh vkhsyl vhpkh lbqr tslmvt vyvm lylh hchshykh hqvr' lmy hym vyshpkhm 'l pny h'rts yhvh shmv
verses.translation: Seek him that maketh the seven stars and Orion, and turneth the shadow of death into the morning, and maketh the day dark with night: that calleth for the waters of the sea, and poureth them out upon the face of the earth: The LORD is his name:

verses.original: הַ/מַּבְלִ֥יג שֹׁ֖ד עַל עָ֑ז וְ/שֹׁ֖ד עַל מִבְצָ֥ר יָבֽוֹא
verses.translit: hmblyg shd 'l 'z vshd 'l mbtsr ybv'
verses.translation: That strengtheneth the spoiled against the strong, so that the spoiled shall come against the fortress.

verses.original: שָׂנְא֥וּ בַ/שַּׁ֖עַר מוֹכִ֑יחַ וְ/דֹבֵ֥ר תָּמִ֖ים יְתָעֵֽבוּ
verses.translit: shn'v bsh'r mvkhych vdbr tmym yt'bv
verses.translation: They hate him that rebuketh in the gate, and they abhor him that speaketh uprightly.

verses.original: לָ֠/כֵן יַ֣עַן בּוֹשַׁסְ/כֶ֞ם עַל דָּ֗ל וּ/מַשְׂאַת בַּר֙ תִּקְח֣וּ מִמֶּ֔/נּוּ בָּתֵּ֥י גָזִ֛ית בְּנִיתֶ֖ם וְ/לֹא תֵ֣שְׁבוּ בָ֑/ם כַּרְמֵי חֶ֣מֶד נְטַעְתֶּ֔ם וְ/לֹ֥א תִשְׁתּ֖וּ אֶת יֵינָֽ/ם
verses.translit: lkhn y'n bvshskhm 'l dl vmsh't br tqchv mmnv bty gzyt bnytm vl' tshbv bm khrmy chmd nt'tm vl' tshtv 't yynm
verses.translation: Forasmuch therefore as your treading is upon the poor, and ye take from him burdens of wheat: ye have built houses of hewn stone, but ye shall not dwell in them; ye have planted pleasant vineyards, but ye shall not drink wine of them.

verses.original: כִּ֤י יָדַ֨עְתִּי֙ רַבִּ֣ים פִּשְׁעֵי/כֶ֔ם וַ/עֲצֻמִ֖ים חַטֹּֽאתֵי/כֶ֑ם צֹרְרֵ֤י צַדִּיק֙ לֹ֣קְחֵי כֹ֔פֶר וְ/אֶבְיוֹנִ֖ים בַּ/שַּׁ֥עַר הִטּֽוּ
verses.translit: khy yd'ty rbym psh'ykhm v'tsmym cht'tykhm tsrry tsdyq lqchy khpr v'byvnym bsh'r htv
verses.translation: For I know your manifold transgressions and your mighty sins: they afflict the just, they take a bribe, and they turn aside the poor in the gate from their right .

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן הַ/מַּשְׂכִּ֛יל בָּ/עֵ֥ת הַ/הִ֖יא יִדֹּ֑ם כִּ֛י עֵ֥ת רָעָ֖ה הִֽיא
verses.translit: lkhn hmshkhyl b't hhy' ydm khy 't r'h hy'
verses.translation: Therefore the prudent shall keep silence in that time; for it is an evil time.

verses.original: דִּרְשׁוּ ט֥וֹב וְ/אַל רָ֖ע לְמַ֣עַן תִּֽחְי֑וּ וִ/יהִי כֵ֞ן יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵֽי צְבָא֛וֹת אִתְּ/כֶ֖ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲמַרְתֶּֽם
verses.translit: drshv tvb v'l r' lm'n tchyv vyhy khn yhvh 'lhy tsb'vt 'tkhm kh'shr 'mrtm
verses.translation: Seek good, and not evil, that ye may live: and so the LORD , the God of hosts, shall be with you, as ye have spoken.

verses.original: שִׂנְאוּ רָע֙ וְ/אֶ֣הֱבוּ ט֔וֹב וְ/הַצִּ֥יגוּ בַ/שַּׁ֖עַר מִשְׁפָּ֑ט אוּלַ֗י יֶֽחֱנַ֛ן יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁאֵרִ֥ית יוֹסֵֽף
verses.translit: shn'v r' v'hbv tvb vhtsygv bsh'r mshpt 'vly ychnn yhvh 'lhy tsb'vt sh'ryt yvsf
verses.translation: Hate the evil, and love the good, and establish judgment in the gate: it may be that the LORD God of hosts will be gracious unto the remnant of Joseph.

verses.original: לָ֠/כֵן כֹּֽה אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י צְבָאוֹת֙ אֲדֹנָ֔/י בְּ/כָל רְחֹב֣וֹת מִסְפֵּ֔ד וּ/בְ/כָל חוּצ֖וֹת יֹאמְר֣וּ הוֹ ה֑וֹ וְ/קָרְא֤וּ אִכָּר֙ אֶל אֵ֔בֶל וּ/מִסְפֵּ֖ד אֶל י֥וֹדְעֵי נֶֽהִי
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy tsb'vt 'dny bkhl rchbvt mspd vbkhl chvtsvt y'mrv hv hv vqr'v 'khr 'l 'bl vmspd 'l yvd'y nhy
verses.translation: Therefore the LORD , the God of hosts, the Lord, saith thus; Wailing shall be in all streets; and they shall say in all the highways, Alas! alas! and they shall call the husbandman to mourning, and such as are skilful of lamentation to wailing.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/כָל כְּרָמִ֖ים מִסְפֵּ֑ד כִּֽי אֶעֱבֹ֥ר בְּ/קִרְבְּ/ךָ֖ אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vbkhl khrmym mspd khy ''br bqrbkh 'mr yhvh
verses.translation: And in all vineyards shall be wailing: for I will pass through thee, saith the LORD .

verses.original: ה֥וֹי הַ/מִּתְאַוִּ֖ים אֶת י֣וֹם יְהוָ֑ה לָ/מָּה זֶּ֥ה לָ/כֶ֛ם י֥וֹם יְהוָ֖ה הוּא חֹ֥שֶׁךְ וְ/לֹא אֽוֹר
verses.translit: hvy hmt'vym 't yvm yhvh lmh zh lkhm yvm yhvh hv' chshkh vl' 'vr
verses.translation: Woe unto you that desire the day of the LORD ! to what end is it for you? the day of the LORD is darkness, and not light.

verses.original: כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָנ֥וּס אִישׁ֙ מִ/פְּנֵ֣י הָ/אֲרִ֔י וּ/פְגָע֖/וֹ הַ/דֹּ֑ב וּ/בָ֣א הַ/בַּ֔יִת וְ/סָמַ֤ךְ יָד/וֹ֙ עַל הַ/קִּ֔יר וּ/נְשָׁכ֖/וֹ הַ/נָּחָֽשׁ
verses.translit: kh'shr ynvs 'ysh mpny h'ry vpg'v hdb vb' hbyt vsmkh ydv 'l hqyr vnshkhv hnchsh
verses.translation: As if a man did flee from a lion, and a bear met him; or went into the house, and leaned his hand on the wall, and a serpent bit him.

verses.original: הֲ/לֹא חֹ֛שֶׁךְ י֥וֹם יְהוָ֖ה וְ/לֹא א֑וֹר וְ/אָפֵ֖ל וְ/לֹא נֹ֥גַֽהּ לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hl' chshkh yvm yhvh vl' 'vr v'pl vl' ngh lv
verses.translation: Shall not the day of the LORD be darkness, and not light? even very dark, and no brightness in it?

verses.original: שָׂנֵ֥אתִי מָאַ֖סְתִּי חַגֵּי/כֶ֑ם וְ/לֹ֥א אָרִ֖יחַ בְּ/עַצְּרֹֽתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: shn'ty m'sty chgykhm vl' 'rych b'tsrtykhm
verses.translation: I hate, I despise your feast days, and I will not smell in your solemn assemblies.

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם תַּעֲלוּ לִ֥/י עֹל֛וֹת וּ/מִנְחֹתֵי/כֶ֖ם לֹ֣א אֶרְצֶ֑ה וְ/שֶׁ֥לֶם מְרִיאֵי/כֶ֖ם לֹ֥א אַבִּֽיט
verses.translit: khy 'm t'lv ly 'lvt vmnchtykhm l' 'rtsh vshlm mry'ykhm l' 'byt
verses.translation: Though ye offer me burnt offerings and your meat offerings, I will not accept them: neither will I regard the peace offerings of your fat beasts.

verses.original: הָסֵ֥ר מֵ/עָלַ֖/י הֲמ֣וֹן שִׁרֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/זִמְרַ֥ת נְבָלֶ֖י/ךָ לֹ֥א אֶשְׁמָֽע
verses.translit: hsr m'ly hmvn shrykh vzmrt nblykh l' 'shm'
verses.translation: Take thou away from me the noise of thy songs; for I will not hear the melody of thy viols.

verses.original: וְ/יִגַּ֥ל כַּ/מַּ֖יִם מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּ/צְדָקָ֖ה כְּ/נַ֥חַל אֵיתָֽן
verses.translit: vygl khmym mshpt vtsdqh khnchl 'ytn
verses.translation: But let judgment run down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream.

verses.original: הַ/זְּבָחִ֨ים וּ/מִנְחָ֜ה הִֽגַּשְׁתֶּם לִ֧/י בַ/מִּדְבָּ֛ר אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: hzbchym vmnchh hgshtm ly bmdbr 'rb'ym shnh byt yshr'l
verses.translation: Have ye offered unto me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years, O house of Israel?

verses.original: וּ/נְשָׂאתֶ֗ם אֵ֚ת סִכּ֣וּת מַלְכְּ/כֶ֔ם וְ/אֵ֖ת כִּיּ֣וּן צַלְמֵי/כֶ֑ם כּוֹכַב֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵי/כֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vnsh'tm 't skhvt mlkhkhm v't khyvn tslmykhm khvkhb 'lhykhm 'shr 'shytm lkhm
verses.translation: But ye have borne the tabernacle of your Moloch and Chiun your images, the star of your god, which ye made to yourselves.

verses.original: וְ/הִגְלֵיתִ֥י אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם מֵ/הָ֣לְאָה לְ/דַמָּ֑שֶׂק אָמַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhglyty 'tkhm mhl'h ldmshq 'mr yhvh 'lhy tsb'vt shmv
verses.translation: Therefore will I cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus, saith the LORD , whose name is The God of hosts.

verses.original: ה֚וֹי הַ/שַּׁאֲנַנִּ֣ים בְּ/צִיּ֔וֹן וְ/הַ/בֹּטְחִ֖ים בְּ/הַ֣ר שֹׁמְר֑וֹן נְקֻבֵי֙ רֵאשִׁ֣ית הַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם וּ/בָ֥אוּ לָ/הֶ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: hvy hsh'nnym btsyvn vhbtchym bhr shmrvn nqby r'shyt hgvym vb'v lhm byt yshr'l
verses.translation: Woe to them that are at ease in Zion, and trust in the mountain of Samaria, which are named chief of the nations, to whom the house of Israel came!

verses.original: עִבְר֤וּ כַֽלְנֵה֙ וּ/רְא֔וּ וּ/לְכ֥וּ מִ/שָּׁ֖ם חֲמַ֣ת רַבָּ֑ה וּ/רְד֣וּ גַת פְּלִשְׁתּ֗ים הֲ/טוֹבִים֙ מִן הַ/מַּמְלָכ֣וֹת הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה אִם רַ֥ב גְּבוּלָ֖/ם מִ/גְּבֻלְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: 'brv khlnh vr'v vlkhv mshm chmt rbh vrdv gt plshtym htvbym mn hmmlkhvt h'lh 'm rb gbvlm mgblkhm
verses.translation: Pass ye unto Calneh, and see; and from thence go ye to Hamath the great: then go down to Gath of the Philistines: be they better than these kingdoms? or their border greater than your border?

verses.original: הַֽ/מְנַדִּ֖ים לְ/י֣וֹם רָ֑ע וַ/תַּגִּישׁ֖וּ/ן שֶׁ֥בֶת חָמָֽס
verses.translit: hmndym lyvm r' vtgyshvn shbt chms
verses.translation: Ye that put far away the evil day, and cause the seat of violence to come near;

verses.original: הַ/שֹּֽׁכְבִים֙ עַל מִטּ֣וֹת שֵׁ֔ן וּ/סְרֻחִ֖ים עַל עַרְשׂוֹתָ֑/ם וְ/אֹכְלִ֤ים כָּרִים֙ מִ/צֹּ֔אן וַ/עֲגָלִ֖ים מִ/תּ֥וֹךְ מַרְבֵּֽק
verses.translit: hshkhbym 'l mtvt shn vsrchym 'l 'rshvtm v'khlym khrym mts'n v'glym mtvkh mrbq
verses.translation: That lie upon beds of ivory, and stretch themselves upon their couches, and eat the lambs out of the flock, and the calves out of the midst of the stall;

verses.original: הַ/פֹּרְטִ֖ים עַל פִּ֣י הַ/נָּ֑בֶל כְּ/דָוִ֕יד חָשְׁב֥וּ לָ/הֶ֖ם כְּלֵי שִֽׁיר
verses.translit: hprtym 'l py hnbl khdvyd chshbv lhm khly shyr
verses.translation: That chant to the sound of the viol, and invent to themselves instruments of musick, like David;

verses.original: הַ/שֹּׁתִ֤ים בְּ/מִזְרְקֵי֙ יַ֔יִן וְ/רֵאשִׁ֥ית שְׁמָנִ֖ים יִמְשָׁ֑חוּ וְ/לֹ֥א נֶחְל֖וּ עַל שֵׁ֥בֶר יוֹסֵֽף
verses.translit: hshtym bmzrqy yyn vr'shyt shmnym ymshchv vl' nchlv 'l shbr yvsf
verses.translation: That drink wine in bowls, and anoint themselves with the chief ointments: but they are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֛ן עַתָּ֥ה יִגְל֖וּ בְּ/רֹ֣אשׁ גֹּלִ֑ים וְ/סָ֖ר מִרְזַ֥ח סְרוּחִֽים
verses.translit: lkhn 'th yglv br'sh glym vsr mrzch srvchym
verses.translation: Therefore now shall they go captive with the first that go captive, and the banquet of them that stretched themselves shall be removed.

verses.original: נִשְׁבַּע֩ אֲדֹנָ֨/י יְהוִ֜ה בְּ/נַפְשׁ֗/וֹ נְאֻם יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י צְבָא֔וֹת מְתָאֵ֤ב אָֽנֹכִי֙ אֶת גְּא֣וֹן יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וְ/אַרְמְנֹתָ֖י/ו שָׂנֵ֑אתִי וְ/הִסְגַּרְתִּ֖י עִ֥יר וּ/מְלֹאָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: nshb' 'dny yhvh bnpshv n'm yhvh 'lhy tsb'vt mt'b 'nkhy 't g'vn y'qb v'rmntyv shn'ty vhsgrty 'yr vml'h
verses.translation: The Lord GOD hath sworn by himself, saith the LORD the God of hosts, I abhor the excellency of Jacob, and hate his palaces: therefore will I deliver up the city with all that is therein.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה אִם יִוָּ֨תְר֜וּ עֲשָׂרָ֧ה אֲנָשִׁ֛ים בְּ/בַ֥יִת אֶחָ֖ד וָ/מֵֽתוּ
verses.translit: vhyh 'm yvtrv 'shrh 'nshym bbyt 'chd vmtv
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, if there remain ten men in one house, that they shall die.

verses.original: וּ/נְשָׂא֞/וֹ דּוֹד֣/וֹ וּ/מְסָרְפ֗/וֹ לְ/הוֹצִ֣יא עֲצָמִים֮ מִן הַ/בַּיִת֒ וְ/אָמַ֞ר לַ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר בְּ/יַרְכְּתֵ֥י הַ/בַּ֛יִת הַ/ע֥וֹד עִמָּ֖/ךְ וְ/אָמַ֣ר אָ֑פֶס וְ/אָמַ֣ר הָ֔ס כִּ֛י לֹ֥א לְ/הַזְכִּ֖יר בְּ/שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vnsh'v dvdv vmsrpv lhvtsy' 'tsmym mn hbyt v'mr l'shr byrkhty hbyt h'vd 'mkh v'mr 'ps v'mr hs khy l' lhzkhyr bshm yhvh
verses.translation: And a man’s uncle shall take him up, and he that burneth him, to bring out the bones out of the house, and shall say unto him that is by the sides of the house, Is there yet any with thee? and he shall say, No. Then shall he say, Hold thy tongue: for we may not make mention of the name of the LORD .

verses.original: כִּֽי הִנֵּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ מְצַוֶּ֔ה וְ/הִכָּ֛ה הַ/בַּ֥יִת הַ/גָּד֖וֹל רְסִיסִ֑ים וְ/הַ/בַּ֥יִת הַ/קָּטֹ֖ן בְּקִעִֽים
verses.translit: khy hnh yhvh mtsvh vhkhh hbyt hgdvl rsysym vhbyt hqtn bq'ym
verses.translation: For, behold, the LORD commandeth, and he will smite the great house with breaches, and the little house with clefts.

verses.original: הַ/יְרֻצ֤וּ/ן בַּ/סֶּ֨לַע֙ סוּסִ֔ים אִֽם יַחֲר֖וֹשׁ בַּ/בְּקָרִ֑ים כִּֽי הֲפַכְתֶּ֤ם לְ/רֹאשׁ֙ מִשְׁפָּ֔ט וּ/פְרִ֥י צְדָקָ֖ה לְ/לַעֲנָֽה
verses.translit: hyrtsvn bsl' svsym 'm ychrvsh bbqrym khy hpkhtm lr'sh mshpt vpry tsdqh ll'nh
verses.translation: Shall horses run upon the rock? will one plow there with oxen? for ye have turned judgment into gall, and the fruit of righteousness into hemlock:

verses.original: הַ/שְּׂמֵחִ֖ים לְ/לֹ֣א דָבָ֑ר הָ/אֹ֣מְרִ֔ים הֲ/ל֣וֹא בְ/חָזְקֵ֔/נוּ לָקַ֥חְנוּ לָ֖/נוּ קַרְנָֽיִם
verses.translit: hshmchym ll' dbr h'mrym hlv' bchzqnv lqchnv lnv qrnym
verses.translation: Ye which rejoice in a thing of nought, which say, Have we not taken to us horns by our own strength?

verses.original: כִּ֡י הִנְ/נִי֩ מֵקִ֨ים עֲלֵי/כֶ֜ם בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל נְאֻם יְהוָ֛ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י הַ/צְּבָא֖וֹת גּ֑וֹי וְ/לָחֲצ֥וּ אֶתְ/כֶ֛ם מִ/לְּב֥וֹא חֲמָ֖ת עַד נַ֥חַל הָ/עֲרָבָֽה
verses.translit: khy hnny mqym 'lykhm byt yshr'l n'm yhvh 'lhy htsb'vt gvy vlchtsv 'tkhm mlbv' chmt 'd nchl h'rbh
verses.translation: But, behold, I will raise up against you a nation, O house of Israel, saith the LORD the God of hosts; and they shall afflict you from the entering in of Hemath unto the river of the wilderness.

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה הִרְאַ֨/נִי֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה וְ/הִנֵּה֙ יוֹצֵ֣ר גֹּבַ֔י בִּ/תְחִלַּ֖ת עֲל֣וֹת הַ/לָּ֑קֶשׁ וְ/הִ֨נֵּה לֶ֔קֶשׁ אַחַ֖ר גִּזֵּ֥י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: khh hr'ny 'dny yhvh vhnh yvtsr gby btchlt 'lvt hlqsh vhnh lqsh 'chr gzy hmlkh
verses.translation: Thus hath the Lord GOD shewed unto me; and, behold, he formed grasshoppers in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth; and, lo, it was the latter growth after the king’s mowings.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה אִם כִּלָּה֙ לֶֽ/אֱכוֹל֙ אֶת עֵ֣שֶׂב הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וָ/אֹמַ֗ר אֲדֹנָ֤/י יְהוִה֙ סְֽלַֽח נָ֔א מִ֥י יָק֖וּם יַֽעֲקֹ֑ב כִּ֥י קָטֹ֖ן הֽוּא
verses.translit: vhyh 'm khlh l'khvl 't 'shb h'rts v'mr 'dny yhvh slch n' my yqvm y'qb khy qtn hv'
verses.translation: And it came to pass, that when they had made an end of eating the grass of the land, then I said, O Lord GOD , forgive, I beseech thee: by whom shall Jacob arise? for he is small.

verses.original: נִחַ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה עַל זֹ֑את לֹ֥א תִהְיֶ֖ה אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: nchm yhvh 'l z't l' thyh 'mr yhvh
verses.translation: The LORD repented for this: It shall not be, saith the LORD .

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה הִרְאַ֨/נִי֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה קֹרֵ֛א לָ/רִ֥ב בָּ/אֵ֖שׁ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה וַ/תֹּ֨אכַל֙ אֶת תְּה֣וֹם רַבָּ֔ה וְ/אָכְלָ֖ה אֶת הַ/חֵֽלֶק
verses.translit: khh hr'ny 'dny yhvh vhnh qr' lrb b'sh 'dny yhvh vt'khl 't thvm rbh v'khlh 't hchlq
verses.translation: Thus hath the Lord GOD shewed unto me: and, behold, the Lord GOD called to contend by fire, and it devoured the great deep, and did eat up a part.

verses.original: וָ/אֹמַ֗ר אֲדֹנָ֤/י יְהוִה֙ חֲדַל נָ֔א מִ֥י יָק֖וּם יַעֲקֹ֑ב כִּ֥י קָטֹ֖ן הֽוּא
verses.translit: v'mr 'dny yhvh chdl n' my yqvm y'qb khy qtn hv'
verses.translation: Then said I, O Lord GOD , cease, I beseech thee: by whom shall Jacob arise? for he is small.

verses.original: נִחַ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה עַל זֹ֑את גַּם הִיא֙ לֹ֣א תִֽהְיֶ֔ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: nchm yhvh 'l z't gm hy' l' thyh 'mr 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: The LORD repented for this: This also shall not be, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה הִרְאַ֔/נִי וְ/הִנֵּ֧ה אֲדֹנָ֛/י נִצָּ֖ב עַל חוֹמַ֣ת אֲנָ֑ךְ וּ/בְ/יָד֖/וֹ אֲנָֽךְ
verses.translit: khh hr'ny vhnh 'dny ntsb 'l chvmt 'nkh vbydv 'nkh
verses.translation: Thus he shewed me: and, behold, the Lord stood upon a wall made by a plumbline, with a plumbline in his hand.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗/י מָֽה אַתָּ֤ה רֹאֶה֙ עָמ֔וֹס וָ/אֹמַ֖ר אֲנָ֑ךְ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲדֹנָ֗/י הִנְ/נִ֨י שָׂ֤ם אֲנָךְ֙ בְּ/קֶ֨רֶב֙ עַמִּ֣/י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹֽא אוֹסִ֥יף ע֖וֹד עֲב֥וֹר לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly mh 'th r'h 'mvs v'mr 'nkh vy'mr 'dny hnny shm 'nkh bqrb 'my yshr'l l' 'vsyf 'vd 'bvr lv
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto me, Amos, what seest thou? And I said, A plumbline. Then said the Lord, Behold, I will set a plumbline in the midst of my people Israel: I will not again pass by them any more:

verses.original: וְ/נָשַׁ֨מּוּ֙ בָּמ֣וֹת יִשְׂחָ֔ק וּ/מִקְדְּשֵׁ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יֶחֱרָ֑בוּ וְ/קַמְתִּ֛י עַל בֵּ֥ית יָרָבְעָ֖ם בֶּ/חָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vnshmv bmvt yshchq vmqdshy yshr'l ychrbv vqmty 'l byt yrb'm bchrb
verses.translation: And the high places of Isaac shall be desolate, and the sanctuaries of Israel shall be laid waste; and I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֗ח אֲמַצְיָה֙ כֹּהֵ֣ן בֵּֽית אֵ֔ל אֶל יָרָבְעָ֥ם מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵ/אמֹ֑ר קָשַׁ֨ר עָלֶ֜י/ךָ עָמ֗וֹס בְּ/קֶ֨רֶב֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹא תוּכַ֣ל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ לְ/הָכִ֖יל אֶת כָּל דְּבָרָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshlch 'mtsyh khhn byt 'l 'l yrb'm mlkh yshr'l l'mr qshr 'lykh 'mvs bqrb byt yshr'l l' tvkhl h'rts lhkhyl 't khl dbryv
verses.translation: Then Amaziah the priest of Beth-el sent to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, Amos hath conspired against thee in the midst of the house of Israel: the land is not able to bear all his words.

verses.original: כִּי כֹה֙ אָמַ֣ר עָמ֔וֹס בַּ/חֶ֖רֶב יָמ֣וּת יָרָבְעָ֑ם וְ/יִ֨שְׂרָאֵ֔ל גָּלֹ֥ה יִגְלֶ֖ה מֵ/עַ֥ל אַדְמָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr 'mvs bchrb ymvt yrb'm vyshr'l glh yglh m'l 'dmtv
verses.translation: For thus Amos saith, Jeroboam shall die by the sword, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of their own land.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֲמַצְיָה֙ אֶל עָמ֔וֹס חֹזֶ֕ה לֵ֥ךְ בְּרַח לְ/ךָ֖ אֶל אֶ֣רֶץ יְהוּדָ֑ה וֶ/אֱכָל שָׁ֣ם לֶ֔חֶם וְ/שָׁ֖ם תִּנָּבֵֽא
verses.translit: vy'mr 'mtsyh 'l 'mvs chzh lkh brch lkh 'l 'rts yhvdh v'khl shm lchm vshm tnb'
verses.translation: Also Amaziah said unto Amos, O thou seer, go, flee thee away into the land of Judah, and there eat bread, and prophesy there:

verses.original: וּ/בֵֽית אֵ֔ל לֹֽא תוֹסִ֥יף ע֖וֹד לְ/הִנָּבֵ֑א כִּ֤י מִקְדַּשׁ מֶ֨לֶךְ֙ ה֔וּא וּ/בֵ֥ית מַמְלָכָ֖ה הֽוּא
verses.translit: vbyt 'l l' tvsyf 'vd lhnb' khy mqdsh mlkh hv' vbyt mmlkhh hv'
verses.translation: But prophesy not again any more at Beth-el: for it is the king’s chapel, and it is the king’s court.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤עַן עָמוֹס֙ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל אֲמַצְיָ֔ה לֹא נָבִ֣יא אָנֹ֔כִי וְ/לֹ֥א בֶן נָבִ֖יא אָנֹ֑כִי כִּֽי בוֹקֵ֥ר אָנֹ֖כִי וּ/בוֹלֵ֥ס שִׁקְמִֽים
verses.translit: vy'n 'mvs vy'mr 'l 'mtsyh l' nby' 'nkhy vl' bn nby' 'nkhy khy bvqr 'nkhy vbvls shqmym
verses.translation: Then answered Amos, and said to Amaziah, I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet’s son; but I was an herdman, and a gatherer of sycomore fruit:

verses.original: וַ/יִּקָּחֵ֣/נִי יְהוָ֔ה מֵ/אַחֲרֵ֖י הַ/צֹּ֑אן וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלַ/י֙ יְהוָ֔ה לֵ֥ךְ הִנָּבֵ֖א אֶל עַמִּ֥/י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyqchny yhvh m'chry hts'n vy'mr 'ly yhvh lkh hnb' 'l 'my yshr'l
verses.translation: And the LORD took me as I followed the flock, and the LORD said unto me, Go, prophesy unto my people Israel.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֖ה שְׁמַ֣ע דְּבַר יְהוָ֑ה אַתָּ֣ה אֹמֵ֗ר לֹ֤א תִנָּבֵא֙ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/לֹ֥א תַטִּ֖יף עַל בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂחָֽק
verses.translit: v'th shm' dbr yhvh 'th 'mr l' tnb' 'l yshr'l vl' ttyf 'l byt yshchq
verses.translation: Now therefore hear thou the word of the LORD : Thou sayest, Prophesy not against Israel, and drop not thy word against the house of Isaac.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֞ן כֹּה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אִשְׁתְּ/ךָ֞ בָּ/עִ֤יר תִּזְנֶה֙ וּ/בָנֶ֤י/ךָ וּ/בְנֹתֶ֨י/ךָ֙ בַּ/חֶ֣רֶב יִפֹּ֔לוּ וְ/אַדְמָתְ/ךָ֖ בַּ/חֶ֣בֶל תְּחֻלָּ֑ק וְ/אַתָּ֗ה עַל אֲדָמָ֤ה טְמֵאָה֙ תָּמ֔וּת וְ/יִ֨שְׂרָאֵ֔ל גָּלֹ֥ה יִגְלֶ֖ה מֵ/עַ֥ל אַדְמָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr yhvh 'shtkh b'yr tznh vbnykh vbntykh bchrb yplv v'dmtkh bchbl tchlq v'th 'l 'dmh tm'h tmvt vyshr'l glh yglh m'l 'dmtv
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD ; Thy wife shall be an harlot in the city, and thy sons and thy daughters shall fall by the sword, and thy land shall be divided by line; and thou shalt die in a polluted land: and Israel shall surely go into captivity forth of his land.

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה הִרְאַ֖/נִי אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה וְ/הִנֵּ֖ה כְּל֥וּב קָֽיִץ
verses.translit: khh hr'ny 'dny yhvh vhnh khlvb qyts
verses.translation: Thus hath the Lord GOD shewed unto me: and behold a basket of summer fruit.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר מָֽה אַתָּ֤ה רֹאֶה֙ עָמ֔וֹס וָ/אֹמַ֖ר כְּל֣וּב קָ֑יִץ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗/י בָּ֤א הַ/קֵּץ֙ אֶל עַמִּ֣/י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹא אוֹסִ֥יף ע֖וֹד עֲב֥וֹר לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr mh 'th r'h 'mvs v'mr khlvb qyts vy'mr yhvh 'ly b' hqts 'l 'my yshr'l l' 'vsyf 'vd 'bvr lv
verses.translation: And he said, Amos, what seest thou? And I said, A basket of summer fruit. Then said the LORD unto me, The end is come upon my people of Israel; I will not again pass by them any more.

verses.original: וְ/הֵילִ֜ילוּ שִׁיר֤וֹת הֵיכָל֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה רַ֣ב הַ/פֶּ֔גֶר בְּ/כָל מָק֖וֹם הִשְׁלִ֥יךְ הָֽס
verses.translit: vhylylv shyrvt hykhl byvm hhv' n'm 'dny yhvh rb hpgr bkhl mqvm hshlykh hs
verses.translation: And the songs of the temple shall be howlings in that day, saith the Lord GOD : there shall be many dead bodies in every place; they shall cast them forth with silence.

verses.original: שִׁמְעוּ זֹ֕את הַ/שֹּׁאֲפִ֖ים אֶבְי֑וֹן וְ/לַ/שְׁבִּ֖ית ענוי עֲנִיֵּי אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: shm'v z't hsh'pym 'byvn vlshbyt 'nvy 'nyy 'rts
verses.translation: Hear this, O ye that swallow up the needy, even to make the poor of the land to fail,

verses.original: לֵ/אמֹ֗ר מָתַ֞י יַעֲבֹ֤ר הַ/חֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ וְ/נַשְׁבִּ֣ירָה שֶּׁ֔בֶר וְ/הַ/שַּׁבָּ֖ת וְ/נִפְתְּחָה בָּ֑ר לְ/הַקְטִ֤ין אֵיפָה֙ וּ/לְ/הַגְדִּ֣יל שֶׁ֔קֶל וּ/לְ/עַוֵּ֖ת מֹאזְנֵ֥י מִרְמָֽה
verses.translit: l'mr mty y'br hchdsh vnshbyrh shbr vhshbt vnptchh br lhqtyn 'yph vlhgdyl shql vl'vt m'zny mrmh
verses.translation: Saying, When will the new moon be gone, that we may sell corn? and the sabbath, that we may set forth wheat, making the ephah small, and the shekel great, and falsifying the balances by deceit?

verses.original: לִ/קְנ֤וֹת בַּ/כֶּ֨סֶף֙ דַּלִּ֔ים וְ/אֶבְי֖וֹן בַּ/עֲב֣וּר נַעֲלָ֑יִם וּ/מַפַּ֥ל בַּ֖ר נַשְׁבִּֽיר
verses.translit: lqnvt bkhsf dlym v'byvn b'bvr n'lym vmpl br nshbyr
verses.translation: That we may buy the poor for silver, and the needy for a pair of shoes; yea , and sell the refuse of the wheat?

verses.original: נִשְׁבַּ֥ע יְהוָ֖ה בִּ/גְא֣וֹן יַעֲקֹ֑ב אִם אֶשְׁכַּ֥ח לָ/נֶ֖צַח כָּל מַעֲשֵׂי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: nshb' yhvh bg'vn y'qb 'm 'shkhch lntsch khl m'shyhm
verses.translation: The LORD hath sworn by the excellency of Jacob, Surely I will never forget any of their works.

verses.original: הַ֤/עַל זֹאת֙ לֹֽא תִרְגַּ֣ז הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/אָבַ֖ל כָּל יוֹשֵׁ֣ב בָּ֑/הּ וְ/עָלְתָ֤ה כָ/אֹר֙ כֻּלָּ֔/הּ וְ/נִגְרְשָׁ֥ה ו/נשקה וְ/נִשְׁקְעָ֖ה כִּ/יא֥וֹר מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: h'l z't l' trgz h'rts v'bl khl yvshb bh v'lth kh'r khlh vngrshh vnshqh vnshq'h khy'vr mtsrym
verses.translation: Shall not the land tremble for this, and every one mourn that dwelleth therein? and it shall rise up wholly as a flood; and it shall be cast out and drowned, as by the flood of Egypt.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֣ה בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה וְ/הֵבֵאתִ֥י הַ/שֶּׁ֖מֶשׁ בַּֽ/צָּהֳרָ֑יִם וְ/הַחֲשַׁכְתִּ֥י לָ/אָ֖רֶץ בְּ/י֥וֹם אֽוֹר
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' n'm 'dny yhvh vhb'ty hshmsh btshrym vhchshkhty l'rts byvm 'vr
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the Lord GOD , that I will cause the sun to go down at noon, and I will darken the earth in the clear day:

verses.original: וְ/הָפַכְתִּ֨י חַגֵּי/כֶ֜ם לְ/אֵ֗בֶל וְ/כָל שִֽׁירֵי/כֶם֙ לְ/קִינָ֔ה וְ/הַעֲלֵיתִ֤י עַל כָּל מָתְנַ֨יִם֙ שָׂ֔ק וְ/עַל כָּל רֹ֖אשׁ קָרְחָ֑ה וְ/שַׂמְתִּ֨י/הָ֙ כְּ/אֵ֣בֶל יָחִ֔יד וְ/אַחֲרִיתָ֖/הּ כְּ/י֥וֹם מָֽר
verses.translit: vhpkhty chgykhm l'bl vkhl shyrykhm lqynh vh'lyty 'l khl mtnym shq v'l khl r'sh qrchh vshmtyh kh'bl ychyd v'chryth khyvm mr
verses.translation: And I will turn your feasts into mourning, and all your songs into lamentation; and I will bring up sackcloth upon all loins, and baldness upon every head; and I will make it as the mourning of an only son , and the end thereof as a bitter day.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה יָמִ֣ים בָּאִ֗ים נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה וְ/הִשְׁלַחְתִּ֥י רָעָ֖ב בָּ/אָ֑רֶץ לֹֽא רָעָ֤ב לַ/לֶּ֨חֶם֙ וְ/לֹֽא צָמָ֣א לַ/מַּ֔יִם כִּ֣י אִם לִ/שְׁמֹ֔עַ אֵ֖ת דִּבְרֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: hnh ymym b'ym n'm 'dny yhvh vhshlchty r'b b'rts l' r'b llchm vl' tsm' lmym khy 'm lshm' 't dbry yhvh
verses.translation: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord GOD , that I will send a famine in the land, not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the words of the LORD :

verses.original: וְ/נָעוּ֙ מִ/יָּ֣ם עַד יָ֔ם וּ/מִ/צָּפ֖וֹן וְ/עַד מִזְרָ֑ח יְשֽׁוֹטְט֛וּ לְ/בַקֵּ֥שׁ אֶת דְּבַר יְהוָ֖ה וְ/לֹ֥א יִמְצָֽאוּ
verses.translit: vn'v mym 'd ym vmtspvn v'd mzrch yshvttv lbqsh 't dbr yhvh vl' ymts'v
verses.translation: And they shall wander from sea to sea, and from the north even to the east, they shall run to and fro to seek the word of the LORD , and shall not find it .

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֨וֹם הַ/ה֜וּא תִּ֠תְעַלַּפְנָה הַ/בְּתוּלֹ֧ת הַ/יָּפ֛וֹת וְ/הַ/בַּחוּרִ֖ים בַּ/צָּמָֽא
