verses.translit: byvm hhv' tt'lpnh hbtvlt hypvt vhbchvrym btsm'
verses.translation: In that day shall the fair virgins and young men faint for thirst.

verses.original: הַ/נִּשְׁבָּעִים֙ בְּ/אַשְׁמַ֣ת שֹֽׁמְר֔וֹן וְ/אָמְר֗וּ חֵ֤י אֱלֹהֶ֨י/ךָ֙ דָּ֔ן וְ/חֵ֖י דֶּ֣רֶךְ בְּאֵֽר שָׁ֑בַע וְ/נָפְל֖וּ וְ/לֹא יָק֥וּמוּ עֽוֹד
verses.translit: hnshb'ym b'shmt shmrvn v'mrv chy 'lhykh dn vchy drkh b'r shb' vnplv vl' yqvmv 'vd
verses.translation: They that swear by the sin of Samaria, and say, Thy god, O Dan, liveth; and, The manner of Beer-sheba liveth; even they shall fall, and never rise up again.

verses.original: רָאִ֨יתִי אֶת אֲדֹנָ֜/י נִצָּ֣ב עַֽל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֗חַ וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ הַ֨ךְ הַ/כַּפְתּ֜וֹר וְ/יִרְעֲשׁ֣וּ הַ/סִּפִּ֗ים וּ/בְצַ֨עַ/ם֙ בְּ/רֹ֣אשׁ כֻּלָּ֔/ם וְ/אַחֲרִיתָ֖/ם בַּ/חֶ֣רֶב אֶהֱרֹ֑ג לֹֽא יָנ֤וּס לָ/הֶם֙ נָ֔ס וְ/לֹֽא יִמָּלֵ֥ט לָ/הֶ֖ם פָּלִֽיט
verses.translit: r'yty 't 'dny ntsb 'l hmzbch vy'mr hkh hkhptvr vyr'shv hspym vbts'm br'sh khlm v'chrytm bchrb 'hrg l' ynvs lhm ns vl' ymlt lhm plyt
verses.translation: I saw the Lord standing upon the altar: and he said, Smite the lintel of the door, that the posts may shake: and cut them in the head, all of them; and I will slay the last of them with the sword: he that fleeth of them shall not flee away, and he that escapeth of them shall not be delivered.

verses.original: אִם יַחְתְּר֣וּ בִ/שְׁא֔וֹל מִ/שָּׁ֖ם יָדִ֣/י תִקָּחֵ֑/ם וְ/אִֽם יַעֲלוּ֙ הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם מִ/שָּׁ֖ם אוֹרִידֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'm ychtrv bsh'vl mshm ydy tqchm v'm y'lv hshmym mshm 'vrydm
verses.translation: Though they dig into hell, thence shall mine hand take them; though they climb up to heaven, thence will I bring them down:

verses.original: וְ/אִם יֵחָֽבְאוּ֙ בְּ/רֹ֣אשׁ הַ/כַּרְמֶ֔ל מִ/שָּׁ֥ם אֲחַפֵּ֖שׂ וּ/לְקַחְתִּ֑י/ם וְ/אִם יִסָּ֨תְר֜וּ מִ/נֶּ֤גֶד עֵינַ/י֙ בְּ/קַרְקַ֣ע הַ/יָּ֔ם מִ/שָּׁ֛ם אֲצַוֶּ֥ה אֶת הַ/נָּחָ֖שׁ וּ/נְשָׁכָֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'm ychb'v br'sh hkhrml mshm 'chpsh vlqchtym v'm ystrv mngd 'yny bqrq' hym mshm 'tsvh 't hnchsh vnshkhm
verses.translation: And though they hide themselves in the top of Carmel, I will search and take them out thence; and though they be hid from my sight in the bottom of the sea, thence will I command the serpent, and he shall bite them:

verses.original: וְ/אִם יֵלְכ֤וּ בַ/שְּׁבִי֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י אֹֽיבֵי/הֶ֔ם מִ/שָּׁ֛ם אֲצַוֶּ֥ה אֶת הַ/חֶ֖רֶב וַ/הֲרָגָ֑תַ/ם וְ/שַׂמְתִּ֨י עֵינִ֧/י עֲלֵי/הֶ֛ם לְ/רָעָ֖ה וְ/לֹ֥א לְ/טוֹבָֽה
verses.translit: v'm ylkhv bshby lpny 'ybyhm mshm 'tsvh 't hchrb vhrgtm vshmty 'yny 'lyhm lr'h vl' ltvbh
verses.translation: And though they go into captivity before their enemies, thence will I command the sword, and it shall slay them: and I will set mine eyes upon them for evil, and not for good.

verses.original: וַ/אדֹנָ֨/י יְהוִ֜ה הַ/צְּבָא֗וֹת הַ/נּוֹגֵ֤עַ בָּ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ וַ/תָּמ֔וֹג וְ/אָבְל֖וּ כָּל י֣וֹשְׁבֵי בָ֑/הּ וְ/עָלְתָ֤ה כַ/יְאֹר֙ כֻּלָּ֔/הּ וְ/שָׁקְעָ֖ה כִּ/יאֹ֥ר מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: v'dny yhvh htsb'vt hnvg' b'rts vtmvg v'blv khl yvshby bh v'lth khy'r khlh vshq'h khy'r mtsrym
verses.translation: And the Lord GOD of hosts is he that toucheth the land, and it shall melt, and all that dwell therein shall mourn: and it shall rise up wholly like a flood; and shall be drowned, as by the flood of Egypt.

verses.original: הַ/בּוֹנֶ֤ה בַ/שָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ מעלות/ו מַעֲלוֹתָ֔י/ו וַ/אֲגֻדָּת֖/וֹ עַל אֶ֣רֶץ יְסָדָ֑/הּ הַ/קֹּרֵ֣א לְ/מֵֽי הַ/יָּ֗ם וַֽ/יִּשְׁפְּכֵ֛/ם עַל פְּנֵ֥י הָ/אָ֖רֶץ יְהוָ֥ה שְׁמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hbvnh bshmym m'lvtv m'lvtyv v'gdtv 'l 'rts ysdh hqr' lmy hym vyshpkhm 'l pny h'rts yhvh shmv
verses.translation: It is he that buildeth his stories in the heaven, and hath founded his troop in the earth; he that calleth for the waters of the sea, and poureth them out upon the face of the earth: The LORD is his name.

verses.original: הֲ/ל֣וֹא כִ/בְנֵי֩ כֻשִׁיִּ֨ים אַתֶּ֥ם לִ֛/י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה הֲ/ל֣וֹא אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הֶעֱלֵ֨יתִי֙ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וּ/פְלִשְׁתִּיִּ֥ים מִ/כַּפְתּ֖וֹר וַ/אֲרָ֥ם מִ/קִּֽיר
verses.translit: hlv' khbny khshyym 'tm ly bny yshr'l n'm yhvh hlv' 't yshr'l h'lyty m'rts mtsrym vplshtyym mkhptvr v'rm mqyr
verses.translation: Are ye not as children of the Ethiopians unto me, O children of Israel? saith the LORD . Have not I brought up Israel out of the land of Egypt? and the Philistines from Caphtor, and the Syrians from Kir?

verses.original: הִנֵּ֞ה עֵינֵ֣י אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֗ה בַּ/מַּמְלָכָה֙ הַֽ/חַטָּאָ֔ה וְ/הִשְׁמַדְתִּ֣י אֹתָ֔/הּ מֵ/עַ֖ל פְּנֵ֣י הָ/אֲדָמָ֑ה אֶ֗פֶס כִּ֠י לֹ֣א הַשְׁמֵ֥יד אַשְׁמִ֛יד אֶת בֵּ֥ית יַעֲקֹ֖ב נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: hnh 'yny 'dny yhvh bmmlkhh hcht'h vhshmdty 'th m'l pny h'dmh 'ps khy l' hshmyd 'shmyd 't byt y'qb n'm yhvh
verses.translation: Behold, the eyes of the Lord GOD are upon the sinful kingdom, and I will destroy it from off the face of the earth; saving that I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob, saith the LORD .

verses.original: כִּֽי הִנֵּ֤ה אָֽנֹכִי֙ מְצַוֶּ֔ה וַ/הֲנִע֥וֹתִי בְ/כָֽל הַ/גּוֹיִ֖ם אֶת בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִנּ֨וֹעַ֙ בַּ/כְּבָרָ֔ה וְ/לֹֽא יִפּ֥וֹל צְר֖וֹר אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: khy hnh 'nkhy mtsvh vhn'vty bkhl hgvym 't byt yshr'l kh'shr ynv' bkhbrh vl' ypvl tsrvr 'rts
verses.translation: For, lo, I will command, and I will sift the house of Israel among all nations, like as corn is sifted in a sieve, yet shall not the least grain fall upon the earth.

verses.original: בַּ/חֶ֣רֶב יָמ֔וּתוּ כֹּ֖ל חַטָּאֵ֣י עַמִּ֑/י הָ/אֹמְרִ֗ים לֹֽא תַגִּ֧ישׁ וְ/תַקְדִּ֛ים בַּעֲדֵ֖י/נוּ הָ/רָעָֽה
verses.translit: bchrb ymvtv khl cht'y 'my h'mrym l' tgysh vtqdym b'dynv hr'h
verses.translation: All the sinners of my people shall die by the sword, which say, The evil shall not overtake nor prevent us.

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא אָקִ֛ים אֶת סֻכַּ֥ת דָּוִ֖יד הַ/נֹּפֶ֑לֶת וְ/גָדַרְתִּ֣י אֶת פִּרְצֵי/הֶ֗ן וַ/הֲרִֽסֹתָי/ו֙ אָקִ֔ים וּ/בְנִיתִ֖י/הָ כִּ/ימֵ֥י עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: byvm hhv' 'qym 't skht dvyd hnplt vgdrty 't prtsyhn vhrstyv 'qym vbnytyh khymy 'vlm
verses.translation: In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David that is fallen, and close up the breaches thereof; and I will raise up his ruins, and I will build it as in the days of old:

verses.original: לְמַ֨עַן יִֽירְשׁ֜וּ אֶת שְׁאֵרִ֤ית אֱדוֹם֙ וְ/כָל הַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר נִקְרָ֥א שְׁמִ֖/י עֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם נְאֻם יְהוָ֖ה עֹ֥שֶׂה זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: lm'n yyrshv 't sh'ryt 'dvm vkhl hgvym 'shr nqr' shmy 'lyhm n'm yhvh 'shh z't
verses.translation: That they may possess the remnant of Edom, and of all the heathen, which are called by my name, saith the LORD that doeth this.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֨ה יָמִ֤ים בָּאִים֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה וְ/נִגַּ֤שׁ חוֹרֵשׁ֙ בַּ/קֹּצֵ֔ר וְ/דֹרֵ֥ךְ עֲנָבִ֖ים בְּ/מֹשֵׁ֣ךְ הַ/זָּ֑רַע וְ/הִטִּ֤יפוּ הֶֽ/הָרִים֙ עָסִ֔יס וְ/כָל הַ/גְּבָע֖וֹת תִּתְמוֹגַֽגְנָה
verses.translit: hnh ymym b'ym n'm yhvh vngsh chvrsh bqtsr vdrkh 'nbym bmshkh hzr' vhtypv hhrym 'sys vkhl hgb'vt ttmvggnh
verses.translation: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD , that the plowman shall overtake the reaper, and the treader of grapes him that soweth seed; and the mountains shall drop sweet wine, and all the hills shall melt.

verses.original: וְ/שַׁבְתִּי֮ אֶת שְׁב֣וּת עַמִּ֣/י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וּ/בָנ֞וּ עָרִ֤ים נְשַׁמּוֹת֙ וְ/יָשָׁ֔בוּ וְ/נָטְע֣וּ כְרָמִ֔ים וְ/שָׁת֖וּ אֶת יֵינָ֑/ם וְ/עָשׂ֣וּ גַנּ֔וֹת וְ/אָכְל֖וּ אֶת פְּרִי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vshbty 't shbvt 'my yshr'l vbnv 'rym nshmvt vyshbv vnt'v khrmym vshtv 't yynm v'shv gnvt v'khlv 't pryhm
verses.translation: And I will bring again the captivity of my people of Israel, and they shall build the waste cities, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and drink the wine thereof; they shall also make gardens, and eat the fruit of them.

verses.original: וּ/נְטַעְתִּ֖י/ם עַל אַדְמָתָ֑/ם וְ/לֹ֨א יִנָּתְשׁ֜וּ ע֗וֹד מֵ/עַ֤ל אַדְמָתָ/ם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַ֣תִּי לָ/הֶ֔ם אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vnt'tym 'l 'dmtm vl' yntshv 'vd m'l 'dmtm 'shr ntty lhm 'mr yhvh 'lhykh
verses.translation: And I will plant them upon their land, and they shall no more be pulled up out of their land which I have given them, saith the LORD thy God.

verses.original: חֲז֖וֹן עֹֽבַדְיָ֑ה כֹּֽה אָמַר֩ אֲדֹנָ֨/י יְהוִ֜ה לֶ/אֱד֗וֹם שְׁמוּעָ֨ה שָׁמַ֜עְנוּ מֵ/אֵ֤ת יְהוָה֙ וְ/צִיר֙ בַּ/גּוֹיִ֣ם שֻׁלָּ֔ח ק֛וּמוּ וְ/נָק֥וּמָה עָלֶי/הָ לַ/מִּלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: chzvn 'bdyh khh 'mr 'dny yhvh l'dvm shmv'h shm'nv m't yhvh vtsyr bgvym shlch qvmv vnqvmh 'lyh lmlchmh
verses.translation: The vision of Obadiah. Thus saith the Lord GOD concerning Edom; We have heard a rumour from the LORD , and an ambassador is sent among the heathen, Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֥ה קָטֹ֛ן נְתַתִּ֖י/ךָ בַּ/גּוֹיִ֑ם בָּז֥וּי אַתָּ֖ה מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: hnh qtn nttykh bgvym bzvy 'th m'd
verses.translation: Behold, I have made thee small among the heathen: thou art greatly despised.

verses.original: זְד֤וֹן לִבְּ/ךָ֙ הִשִּׁיאֶ֔/ךָ שֹׁכְנִ֥י בְ/חַגְוֵי סֶּ֖לַע מְר֣וֹם שִׁבְתּ֑/וֹ אֹמֵ֣ר בְּ/לִבּ֔/וֹ מִ֥י יוֹרִדֵ֖/נִי אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: zdvn lbkh hshy'kh shkhny bchgvy sl' mrvm shbtv 'mr blbv my yvrdny 'rts
verses.translation: The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee, thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high; that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?

verses.original: אִם תַּגְבִּ֣יהַּ כַּ/נֶּ֔שֶׁר וְ/אִם בֵּ֥ין כּֽוֹכָבִ֖ים שִׂ֣ים קִנֶּ֑/ךָ מִ/שָּׁ֥ם אוֹרִֽידְ/ךָ֖ נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'm tgbyh khnshr v'm byn khvkhbym shym qnkh mshm 'vrydkh n'm yhvh
verses.translation: Though thou exalt thyself as the eagle, and though thou set thy nest among the stars, thence will I bring thee down, saith the LORD .

verses.original: אִם גַּנָּבִ֤ים בָּאֽוּ לְ/ךָ֙ אִם שׁ֣וֹדְדֵי לַ֔יְלָה אֵ֣יךְ נִדְמֵ֔יתָה הֲ/ל֥וֹא יִגְנְב֖וּ דַּיָּ֑/ם אִם בֹּֽצְרִים֙ בָּ֣אוּ לָ֔/ךְ הֲ/ל֖וֹא יַשְׁאִ֥ירוּ עֹלֵלֽוֹת
verses.translit: 'm gnbym b'v lkh 'm shvddy lylh 'ykh ndmyth hlv' ygnbv dym 'm btsrym b'v lkh hlv' ysh'yrv 'llvt
verses.translation: If thieves came to thee, if robbers by night, (how art thou cut off!) would they not have stolen till they had enough? if the grapegatherers came to thee, would they not leave some grapes?

verses.original: אֵ֚יךְ נֶחְפְּשׂ֣וּ עֵשָׂ֔ו נִבְע֖וּ מַצְפֻּנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: 'ykh nchpshv 'shv nb'v mtspnyv
verses.translation: How are the things of Esau searched out! how are his hidden things sought up!

verses.original: עַֽד הַ/גְּב֣וּל שִׁלְּח֗וּ/ךָ כֹּ֚ל אַנְשֵׁ֣י בְרִיתֶ֔/ךָ הִשִּׁיא֛וּ/ךָ יָכְל֥וּ לְ/ךָ֖ אַנְשֵׁ֣י שְׁלֹמֶ֑/ךָ לַחְמְ/ךָ֗ יָשִׂ֤ימוּ מָזוֹר֙ תַּחְתֶּ֔י/ךָ אֵ֥ין תְּבוּנָ֖ה בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'd hgbvl shlchvkh khl 'nshy brytkh hshy'vkh ykhlv lkh 'nshy shlmkh lchmkh yshymv mzvr tchtykh 'yn tbvnh bv
verses.translation: All the men of thy confederacy have brought thee even to the border: the men that were at peace with thee have deceived thee, and prevailed against thee; they that eat thy bread have laid a wound under thee: there is none understanding in him.

verses.original: הֲ/ל֛וֹא בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/ה֖וּא נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה וְ/הַאֲבַדְתִּ֤י חֲכָמִים֙ מֵֽ/אֱד֔וֹם וּ/תְבוּנָ֖ה מֵ/הַ֥ר עֵשָֽׂו
verses.translit: hlv' byvm hhv' n'm yhvh vh'bdty chkhmym m'dvm vtbvnh mhr 'shv
verses.translation: Shall I not in that day, saith the LORD , even destroy the wise men out of Edom, and understanding out of the mount of Esau?

verses.original: וְ/חַתּ֥וּ גִבּוֹרֶ֖י/ךָ תֵּימָ֑ן לְמַ֧עַן יִכָּֽרֶת אִ֛ישׁ מֵ/הַ֥ר עֵשָׂ֖ו מִ/קָּֽטֶל
verses.translit: vchtv gbvrykh tymn lm'n ykhrt 'ysh mhr 'shv mqtl
verses.translation: And thy mighty men , O Teman, shall be dismayed, to the end that every one of the mount of Esau may be cut off by slaughter.

verses.original: מֵ/חֲמַ֛ס אָחִ֥י/ךָ יַעֲקֹ֖ב תְּכַסְּ/ךָ֣ בוּשָׁ֑ה וְ/נִכְרַ֖תָּ לְ/עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: mchms 'chykh y'qb tkhskh bvshh vnkhrt l'vlm
verses.translation: For thy violence against thy brother Jacob shame shall cover thee, and thou shalt be cut off for ever.

verses.original: בְּ/יוֹם֙ עֲמָֽדְ/ךָ֣ מִ/נֶּ֔גֶד בְּ/י֛וֹם שְׁב֥וֹת זָרִ֖ים חֵיל֑/וֹ וְ/נָכְרִ֞ים בָּ֣אוּ שער/ו שְׁעָרָ֗י/ו וְ/עַל יְרוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ יַדּ֣וּ גוֹרָ֔ל גַּם אַתָּ֖ה כְּ/אַחַ֥ד מֵ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: byvm 'mdkh mngd byvm shbvt zrym chylv vnkhrym b'v sh'rv sh'ryv v'l yrvshlm ydv gvrl gm 'th kh'chd mhm
verses.translation: In the day that thou stoodest on the other side, in the day that the strangers carried away captive his forces, and foreigners entered into his gates, and cast lots upon Jerusalem, even thou wast as one of them.

verses.original: וְ/אַל תֵּ֤רֶא בְ/יוֹם אָחִ֨י/ךָ֙ בְּ/י֣וֹם נָכְר֔/וֹ וְ/אַל תִּשְׂמַ֥ח לִ/בְנֵֽי יְהוּדָ֖ה בְּ/י֣וֹם אָבְדָ֑/ם וְ/אַל תַּגְדֵּ֥ל פִּ֖י/ךָ בְּ/י֥וֹם צָרָֽה
verses.translit: v'l tr' byvm 'chykh byvm nkhrv v'l tshmch lbny yhvdh byvm 'bdm v'l tgdl pykh byvm tsrh
verses.translation: But thou shouldest not have looked on the day of thy brother in the day that he became a stranger; neither shouldest thou have rejoiced over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction; neither shouldest thou have spoken proudly in the day of distress.

verses.original: אַל תָּב֤וֹא בְ/שַֽׁעַר עַמִּ/י֙ בְּ/י֣וֹם אֵידָ֔/ם אַל תֵּ֧רֶא גַם אַתָּ֛ה בְּ/רָעָת֖/וֹ בְּ/י֣וֹם אֵיד֑/וֹ וְ/אַל תִּשְׁלַ֥חְנָה בְ/חֵיל֖/וֹ בְּ/י֥וֹם אֵידֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'l tbv' bsh'r 'my byvm 'ydm 'l tr' gm 'th br'tv byvm 'ydv v'l tshlchnh bchylv byvm 'ydv
verses.translation: Thou shouldest not have entered into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity; yea, thou shouldest not have looked on their affliction in the day of their calamity, nor have laid hands on their substance in the day of their calamity;

verses.original: וְ/אַֽל תַּעֲמֹד֙ עַל הַ/פֶּ֔רֶק לְ/הַכְרִ֖ית אֶת פְּלִיטָ֑י/ו וְ/אַל תַּסְגֵּ֥ר שְׂרִידָ֖י/ו בְּ/י֥וֹם צָרָֽה
verses.translit: v'l t'md 'l hprq lhkhryt 't plytyv v'l tsgr shrydyv byvm tsrh
verses.translation: Neither shouldest thou have stood in the crossway, to cut off those of his that did escape; neither shouldest thou have delivered up those of his that did remain in the day of distress.

verses.original: כִּֽי קָר֥וֹב יוֹם יְהוָ֖ה עַל כָּל הַ/גּוֹיִ֑ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשִׂ֨יתָ֙ יֵעָ֣שֶׂה לָּ֔/ךְ גְּמֻלְ/ךָ֖ יָשׁ֥וּב בְּ/רֹאשֶֽׁ/ךָ
verses.translit: khy qrvb yvm yhvh 'l khl hgvym kh'shr 'shyt y'shh lkh gmlkh yshvb br'shkh
verses.translation: For the day of the LORD is near upon all the heathen: as thou hast done, it shall be done unto thee: thy reward shall return upon thine own head.

verses.original: כִּ֗י כַּֽ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר שְׁתִיתֶם֙ עַל הַ֣ר קָדְשִׁ֔/י יִשְׁתּ֥וּ כָֽל הַ/גּוֹיִ֖ם תָּמִ֑יד וְ/שָׁת֣וּ וְ/לָע֔וּ וְ/הָי֖וּ כְּ/ל֥וֹא הָיֽוּ
verses.translit: khy kh'shr shtytm 'l hr qdshy yshtv khl hgvym tmyd vshtv vl'v vhyv khlv' hyv
verses.translation: For as ye have drunk upon my holy mountain, so shall all the heathen drink continually, yea, they shall drink, and they shall swallow down, and they shall be as though they had not been.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/הַ֥ר צִיּ֛וֹן תִּהְיֶ֥ה פְלֵיטָ֖ה וְ/הָ֣יָה קֹ֑דֶשׁ וְ/יָֽרְשׁוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב אֵ֖ת מוֹרָֽשֵׁי/הֶם
verses.translit: vbhr tsyvn thyh plyth vhyh qdsh vyrshv byt y'qb 't mvrshyhm
verses.translation: But upon mount Zion shall be deliverance, and there shall be holiness; and the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֩ בֵית יַעֲקֹ֨ב אֵ֜שׁ וּ/בֵ֧ית יוֹסֵ֣ף לֶהָבָ֗ה וּ/בֵ֤ית עֵשָׂו֙ לְ/קַ֔שׁ וְ/דָלְק֥וּ בָ/הֶ֖ם וַ/אֲכָל֑וּ/ם וְ/לֹֽא יִֽהְיֶ֤ה שָׂרִיד֙ לְ/בֵ֣ית עֵשָׂ֔ו כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר
verses.translit: vhyh byt y'qb 'sh vbyt yvsf lhbh vbyt 'shv lqsh vdlqv bhm v'khlvm vl' yhyh shryd lbyt 'shv khy yhvh dbr
verses.translation: And the house of Jacob shall be a fire, and the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau for stubble, and they shall kindle in them, and devour them; and there shall not be any remaining of the house of Esau; for the LORD hath spoken it .

verses.original: וְ/יָרְשׁ֨וּ הַ/נֶּ֜גֶב אֶת הַ֣ר עֵשָׂ֗ו וְ/הַ/שְּׁפֵלָה֙ אֶת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וְ/יָרְשׁוּ֙ אֶת שְׂדֵ֣ה אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְ/אֵ֖ת שְׂדֵ֣ה שֹׁמְר֑וֹן וּ/בִנְיָמִ֖ן אֶת הַ/גִּלְעָֽד
verses.translit: vyrshv hngb 't hr 'shv vhshplh 't plshtym vyrshv 't shdh 'prym v't shdh shmrvn vbnymn 't hgl'd
verses.translation: And they of the south shall possess the mount of Esau; and they of the plain the Philistines: and they shall possess the fields of Ephraim, and the fields of Samaria: and Benjamin shall possess Gilead.

verses.original: וְ/גָלֻ֣ת הַֽ/חֵל הַ֠/זֶּה לִ/בְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל אֲשֶֽׁר כְּנַעֲנִים֙ עַד צָ֣רְפַ֔ת וְ/גָלֻ֥ת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּ/סְפָרַ֑ד יִֽרְשׁ֕וּ אֵ֖ת עָרֵ֥י הַ/נֶּֽגֶב
verses.translit: vglt hchl hzh lbny yshr'l 'shr khn'nym 'd tsrpt vglt yrvshlm 'shr bsprd yrshv 't 'ry hngb
verses.translation: And the captivity of this host of the children of Israel shall possess that of the Canaanites, even unto Zarephath; and the captivity of Jerusalem, which is in Sepharad, shall possess the cities of the south.

verses.original: וְ/עָל֤וּ מֽוֹשִׁעִים֙ בְּ/הַ֣ר צִיּ֔וֹן לִ/שְׁפֹּ֖ט אֶת הַ֣ר עֵשָׂ֑ו וְ/הָיְתָ֥ה לַֽ/יהוָ֖ה הַ/מְּלוּכָֽה
verses.translit: v'lv mvsh'ym bhr tsyvn lshpt 't hr 'shv vhyth lyhvh hmlvkhh
verses.translation: And saviours shall come up on mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau; and the kingdom shall be the LORD’s .

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ דְּבַר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל יוֹנָ֥ה בֶן אֲמִתַּ֖י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'l yvnh bn 'mty l'mr
verses.translation: Now the word of the LORD came unto Jonah the son of Amittai, saying,

verses.original: ק֠וּם לֵ֧ךְ אֶל נִֽינְוֵ֛ה הָ/עִ֥יר הַ/גְּדוֹלָ֖ה וּ/קְרָ֣א עָלֶ֑י/הָ כִּֽי עָלְתָ֥ה רָעָתָ֖/ם לְ/פָנָֽ/י
verses.translit: qvm lkh 'l nynvh h'yr hgdvlh vqr' 'lyh khy 'lth r'tm lpny
verses.translation: Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and cry against it; for their wickedness is come up before me.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֤קָם יוֹנָה֙ לִ/בְרֹ֣חַ תַּרְשִׁ֔ישָׁ/ה מִ/לִּ/פְנֵ֖י יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יֵּ֨רֶד יָפ֜וֹ וַ/יִּמְצָ֥א אָנִיָּ֣ה בָּאָ֣ה תַרְשִׁ֗ישׁ וַ/יִּתֵּ֨ן שְׂכָרָ֜/הּ וַ/יֵּ֤רֶד בָּ/הּ֙ לָ/ב֤וֹא עִמָּ/הֶם֙ תַּרְשִׁ֔ישָׁ/ה מִ/לִּ/פְנֵ֖י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyqm yvnh lbrch trshyshh mlpny yhvh vyrd ypv vymts' 'nyh b'h trshysh vytn shkhrh vyrd bh lbv' 'mhm trshyshh mlpny yhvh
verses.translation: But Jonah rose up to flee unto Tarshish from the presence of the LORD , and went down to Joppa; and he found a ship going to Tarshish: so he paid the fare thereof, and went down into it, to go with them unto Tarshish from the presence of the LORD .

verses.original: וַֽ/יהוָ֗ה הֵטִ֤יל רֽוּחַ גְּדוֹלָה֙ אֶל הַ/יָּ֔ם וַ/יְהִ֥י סַֽעַר גָּד֖וֹל בַּ/יָּ֑ם וְ/הָ֣/אֳנִיָּ֔ה חִשְּׁבָ֖ה לְ/הִשָּׁבֵֽר
verses.translit: vyhvh htyl rvch gdvlh 'l hym vyhy s'r gdvl bym vh'nyh chshbh lhshbr
verses.translation: But the LORD sent out a great wind into the sea, and there was a mighty tempest in the sea, so that the ship was like to be broken.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽירְא֣וּ הַ/מַּלָּחִ֗ים וַֽ/יִּזְעֲקוּ֮ אִ֣ישׁ אֶל אֱלֹהָי/ו֒ וַ/יָּטִ֨לוּ אֶת הַ/כֵּלִ֜ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר בָּֽ/אֳנִיָּה֙ אֶל הַ/יָּ֔ם לְ/הָקֵ֖ל מֵֽ/עֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/יוֹנָ֗ה יָרַד֙ אֶל יַרְכְּתֵ֣י הַ/סְּפִינָ֔ה וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֖ב וַ/יֵּרָדַֽם
verses.translit: vyyr'v hmlchym vyz'qv 'ysh 'l 'lhyv vytlv 't hkhlym 'shr b'nyh 'l hym lhql m'lyhm vyvnh yrd 'l yrkhty hspynh vyshkhb vyrdm
verses.translation: Then the mariners were afraid, and cried every man unto his god, and cast forth the wares that were in the ship into the sea, to lighten it of them. But Jonah was gone down into the sides of the ship; and he lay, and was fast asleep.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרַ֤ב אֵלָי/ו֙ רַ֣ב הַ/חֹבֵ֔ל וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר ל֖/וֹ מַה לְּ/ךָ֣ נִרְדָּ֑ם ק֚וּם קְרָ֣א אֶל אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ אוּלַ֞י יִתְעַשֵּׁ֧ת הָ/אֱלֹהִ֛ים לָ֖/נוּ וְ/לֹ֥א נֹאבֵֽד
verses.translit: vyqrb 'lyv rb hchbl vy'mr lv mh lkh nrdm qvm qr' 'l 'lhykh 'vly yt'sht h'lhym lnv vl' n'bd
verses.translation: So the shipmaster came to him, and said unto him, What meanest thou, O sleeper? arise, call upon thy God, if so be that God will think upon us, that we perish not.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֞וּ אִ֣ישׁ אֶל רֵעֵ֗/הוּ לְכוּ֙ וְ/נַפִּ֣ילָה גֽוֹרָל֔וֹת וְ/נֵ֣דְעָ֔ה בְּ/שֶׁ/לְּ/מִ֛י הָ/רָעָ֥ה הַ/זֹּ֖את לָ֑/נוּ וַ/יַּפִּ֨לוּ֙ גּֽוֹרָל֔וֹת וַ/יִּפֹּ֥ל הַ/גּוֹרָ֖ל עַל יוֹנָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'ysh 'l r'hv lkhv vnpylh gvrlvt vnd'h bshlmy hr'h hz't lnv vyplv gvrlvt vypl hgvrl 'l yvnh
verses.translation: And they said every one to his fellow, Come, and let us cast lots, that we may know for whose cause this evil is upon us. So they cast lots, and the lot fell upon Jonah.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֔י/ו הַגִּידָ/ה נָּ֣א לָ֔/נוּ בַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר לְ/מִי הָ/רָעָ֥ה הַ/זֹּ֖את לָ֑/נוּ מַה מְּלַאכְתְּ/ךָ֙ וּ/מֵ/אַ֣יִן תָּב֔וֹא מָ֣ה אַרְצֶ֔/ךָ וְ/אֵֽי מִ/זֶּ֥ה עַ֖ם אָֽתָּה
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'lyv hgydh n' lnv b'shr lmy hr'h hz't lnv mh ml'khtkh vm'yn tbv' mh 'rtskh v'y mzh 'm 'th
verses.translation: Then said they unto him, Tell us, we pray thee, for whose cause this evil is upon us; What is thine occupation? and whence comest thou? what is thy country? and of what people art thou?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר אֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם עִבְרִ֣י אָנֹ֑כִי וְ/אֶת יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י הַ/שָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ אֲנִ֣י יָרֵ֔א אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֥ה אֶת הַ/יָּ֖ם וְ/אֶת הַ/יַּבָּשָֽׁה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhm 'bry 'nkhy v't yhvh 'lhy hshmym 'ny yr' 'shr 'shh 't hym v't hybshh
verses.translation: And he said unto them, I am an Hebrew; and I fear the LORD , the God of heaven, which hath made the sea and the dry land . : or, JEHOVAH

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽירְא֤וּ הָֽ/אֲנָשִׁים֙ יִרְאָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֔ה וַ/יֹּאמְר֥וּ אֵלָ֖י/ו מַה זֹּ֣את עָשִׂ֑יתָ כִּֽי יָדְע֣וּ הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֗ים כִּֽי מִ/לִּ/פְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ ה֣וּא בֹרֵ֔חַ כִּ֥י הִגִּ֖יד לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyyr'v h'nshym yr'h gdvlh vy'mrv 'lyv mh z't 'shyt khy yd'v h'nshym khy mlpny yhvh hv' brch khy hgyd lhm
verses.translation: Then were the men exceedingly afraid, and said unto him, Why hast thou done this? For the men knew that he fled from the presence of the LORD , because he had told them.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֤וּ אֵלָי/ו֙ מַה נַּ֣עֲשֶׂה לָּ֔/ךְ וְ/יִשְׁתֹּ֥ק הַ/יָּ֖ם מֵֽ/עָלֵ֑י/נוּ כִּ֥י הַ/יָּ֖ם הוֹלֵ֥ךְ וְ/סֹעֵֽר
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'lyv mh n'shh lkh vyshtq hym m'lynv khy hym hvlkh vs'r
verses.translation: Then said they unto him, What shall we do unto thee, that the sea may be calm unto us? for the sea wrought, and was tempestuous.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵי/הֶ֗ם שָׂא֨וּ/נִי֙ וַ/הֲטִילֻ֣/נִי אֶל הַ/יָּ֔ם וְ/יִשְׁתֹּ֥ק הַ/יָּ֖ם מֵֽ/עֲלֵי/כֶ֑ם כִּ֚י יוֹדֵ֣עַ אָ֔נִי כִּ֣י בְ/שֶׁ/לִּ֔/י הַ/סַּ֧עַר הַ/גָּד֛וֹל הַ/זֶּ֖ה עֲלֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhm sh'vny vhtylny 'l hym vyshtq hym m'lykhm khy yvd' 'ny khy bshly hs'r hgdvl hzh 'lykhm
verses.translation: And he said unto them, Take me up, and cast me forth into the sea; so shall the sea be calm unto you: for I know that for my sake this great tempest is upon you.

verses.original: וַ/יַּחְתְּר֣וּ הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֗ים לְ/הָשִׁ֛יב אֶל הַ/יַּבָּשָׁ֖ה וְ/לֹ֣א יָכֹ֑לוּ כִּ֣י הַ/יָּ֔ם הוֹלֵ֥ךְ וְ/סֹעֵ֖ר עֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vychtrv h'nshym lhshyb 'l hybshh vl' ykhlv khy hym hvlkh vs'r 'lyhm
verses.translation: Nevertheless the men rowed hard to bring it to the land; but they could not: for the sea wrought, and was tempestuous against them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרְא֨וּ אֶל יְהוָ֜ה וַ/יֹּאמְר֗וּ אָנָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אַל נָ֣א נֹאבְדָ֗ה בְּ/נֶ֨פֶשׁ֙ הָ/אִ֣ישׁ הַ/זֶּ֔ה וְ/אַל תִּתֵּ֥ן עָלֵ֖י/נוּ דָּ֣ם נָקִ֑יא כִּֽי אַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָפַ֖צְתָּ עָשִֽׂיתָ
verses.translit: vyqr'v 'l yhvh vy'mrv 'nh yhvh 'l n' n'bdh bnpsh h'ysh hzh v'l ttn 'lynv dm nqy' khy 'th yhvh kh'shr chptst 'shyt
verses.translation: Wherefore they cried unto the LORD , and said, We beseech thee, O LORD , we beseech thee, let us not perish for this man’s life, and lay not upon us innocent blood: for thou, O LORD , hast done as it pleased thee.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׂאוּ֙ אֶת יוֹנָ֔ה וַ/יְטִלֻ֖/הוּ אֶל הַ/יָּ֑ם וַ/יַּעֲמֹ֥ד הַ/יָּ֖ם מִ/זַּעְפּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vysh'v 't yvnh vytlhv 'l hym vy'md hym mz'pv
verses.translation: So they took up Jonah, and cast him forth into the sea: and the sea ceased from her raging.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽירְא֧וּ הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֛ים יִרְאָ֥ה גְדוֹלָ֖ה אֶת יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יִּֽזְבְּחוּ זֶ֨בַח֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה וַֽ/יִּדְּר֖וּ נְדָרִֽים
verses.translit: vyyr'v h'nshym yr'h gdvlh 't yhvh vyzbchv zbch lyhvh vydrv ndrym
verses.translation: Then the men feared the LORD exceedingly, and offered a sacrifice unto the LORD , and made vows. , and vowed vows
Now the LORD had prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah. And Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.

verses.original: וַ/יְמַ֤ן יְהוָה֙ דָּ֣ג גָּד֔וֹל לִ/בְלֹ֖עַ אֶת יוֹנָ֑ה וַ/יְהִ֤י יוֹנָה֙ בִּ/מְעֵ֣י הַ/דָּ֔ג שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה יָמִ֖ים וּ/שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה לֵילֽוֹת
verses.translit: vymn yhvh dg gdvl lbl' 't yvnh vyhy yvnh bm'y hdg shlshh ymym vshlshh lylvt
verses.translation: Then Jonah prayed unto the LORD his God out of the fish’s belly,

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְפַּלֵּ֣ל יוֹנָ֔ה אֶל יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהָ֑י/ו מִ/מְּעֵ֖י הַ/דָּגָֽה
verses.translit: vytpll yvnh 'l yhvh 'lhyv mm'y hdgh
verses.translation: And said, I cried by reason of mine affliction unto the LORD , and he heard me; out of the belly of hell cried I, and thou heardest my voice.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר קָ֠רָאתִי מִ/צָּ֥רָה לִ֛/י אֶל יְהוָ֖ה וַֽ/יַּעֲנֵ֑/נִי מִ/בֶּ֧טֶן שְׁא֛וֹל שִׁוַּ֖עְתִּי שָׁמַ֥עְתָּ קוֹלִֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr qr'ty mtsrh ly 'l yhvh vy'nny mbtn sh'vl shv'ty shm't qvly
verses.translation: For thou hadst cast me into the deep, in the midst of the seas; and the floods compassed me about: all thy billows and thy waves passed over me.

verses.original: וַ/תַּשְׁלִיכֵ֤/נִי מְצוּלָה֙ בִּ/לְבַ֣ב יַמִּ֔ים וְ/נָהָ֖ר יְסֹבְבֵ֑/נִי כָּל מִשְׁבָּרֶ֥י/ךָ וְ/גַלֶּ֖י/ךָ עָלַ֥/י עָבָֽרוּ
verses.translit: vtshlykhny mtsvlh blbb ymym vnhr ysbbny khl mshbrykh vglykh 'ly 'brv
verses.translation: Then I said, I am cast out of thy sight; yet I will look again toward thy holy temple.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֣י אָמַ֔רְתִּי נִגְרַ֖שְׁתִּי מִ/נֶּ֣גֶד עֵינֶ֑י/ךָ אַ֚ךְ אוֹסִ֣יף לְ/הַבִּ֔יט אֶל הֵיכַ֖ל קָדְשֶֽׁ/ךָ
verses.translit: v'ny 'mrty ngrshty mngd 'ynykh 'kh 'vsyf lhbyt 'l hykhl qdshkh
verses.translation: The waters compassed me about, even to the soul: the depth closed me round about, the weeds were wrapped about my head.

verses.original: אֲפָפ֤וּ/נִי מַ֨יִם֙ עַד נֶ֔פֶשׁ תְּה֖וֹם יְסֹבְבֵ֑/נִי ס֖וּף חָב֥וּשׁ לְ/רֹאשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: 'ppvny mym 'd npsh thvm ysbbny svf chbvsh lr'shy
verses.translation: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains; the earth with her bars was about me for ever: yet hast thou brought up my life from corruption, O LORD my God.

verses.original: לְ/קִצְבֵ֤י הָרִים֙ יָרַ֔דְתִּי הָ/אָ֛רֶץ בְּרִחֶ֥י/הָ בַעֲדִ֖/י לְ/עוֹלָ֑ם וַ/תַּ֧עַל מִ/שַּׁ֛חַת חַיַּ֖/י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽ/י
verses.translit: lqtsby hrym yrdty h'rts brchyh b'dy l'vlm vt'l mshcht chyy yhvh 'lhy
verses.translation: When my soul fainted within me I remembered the LORD : and my prayer came in unto thee, into thine holy temple.

verses.original: בְּ/הִתְעַטֵּ֤ף עָלַ/י֙ נַפְשִׁ֔/י אֶת יְהוָ֖ה זָכָ֑רְתִּי וַ/תָּב֤וֹא אֵלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ תְּפִלָּתִ֔/י אֶל הֵיכַ֖ל קָדְשֶֽׁ/ךָ
verses.translit: bht'tf 'ly npshy 't yhvh zkhrty vtbv' 'lykh tplty 'l hykhl qdshkh
verses.translation: They that observe lying vanities forsake their own mercy.

verses.original: מְשַׁמְּרִ֖ים הַבְלֵי שָׁ֑וְא חַסְדָּ֖/ם יַעֲזֹֽבוּ
verses.translit: mshmrym hbly shv' chsdm y'zbv
verses.translation: But I will sacrifice unto thee with the voice of thanksgiving; I will pay that that I have vowed. Salvation is of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֗י בְּ/ק֤וֹל תּוֹדָה֙ אֶזְבְּחָה לָּ֔/ךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָדַ֖רְתִּי אֲשַׁלֵּ֑מָה יְשׁוּעָ֖תָ/ה לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: v'ny bqvl tvdh 'zbchh lkh 'shr ndrty 'shlmh yshv'th lyhvh
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto the fish, and it vomited out Jonah upon the dry land .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֧י דְבַר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל יוֹנָ֖ה שֵׁנִ֥ית לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'l yvnh shnyt l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came unto Jonah the second time, saying,

verses.original: ק֛וּם לֵ֥ךְ אֶל נִֽינְוֵ֖ה הָ/עִ֣יר הַ/גְּדוֹלָ֑ה וִּ/קְרָ֤א אֵלֶ֨י/הָ֙ אֶת הַ/קְּרִיאָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י דֹּבֵ֥ר אֵלֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: qvm lkh 'l nynvh h'yr hgdvlh vqr' 'lyh 't hqry'h 'shr 'nkhy dbr 'lykh
verses.translation: Arise, go unto Nineveh, that great city, and preach unto it the preaching that I bid thee.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣קָם יוֹנָ֗ה וַ/יֵּ֛לֶךְ אֶל נִֽינְוֶ֖ה כִּ/דְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה וְ/נִֽינְוֵ֗ה הָיְתָ֤ה עִיר גְּדוֹלָה֙ לֵֽ/אלֹהִ֔ים מַהֲלַ֖ךְ שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת יָמִֽים
verses.translit: vyqm yvnh vylkh 'l nynvh khdbr yhvh vnynvh hyth 'yr gdvlh l'lhym mhlkh shlsht ymym
verses.translation: So Jonah arose, and went unto Nineveh, according to the word of the LORD . Now Nineveh was an exceeding great city of three days’ journey.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֤חֶל יוֹנָה֙ לָ/ב֣וֹא בָ/עִ֔יר מַהֲלַ֖ךְ י֣וֹם אֶחָ֑ד וַ/יִּקְרָא֙ וַ/יֹּאמַ֔ר ע֚וֹד אַרְבָּעִ֣ים י֔וֹם וְ/נִֽינְוֵ֖ה נֶהְפָּֽכֶת
verses.translit: vychl yvnh lbv' b'yr mhlkh yvm 'chd vyqr' vy'mr 'vd 'rb'ym yvm vnynvh nhpkht
verses.translation: And Jonah began to enter into the city a day’s journey, and he cried, and said, Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּאֲמִ֛ינוּ אַנְשֵׁ֥י נִֽינְוֵ֖ה בֵּֽ/אלֹהִ֑ים וַ/יִּקְרְאוּ צוֹם֙ וַ/יִּלְבְּשׁ֣וּ שַׂקִּ֔ים מִ/גְּדוֹלָ֖/ם וְ/עַד קְטַנָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vy'mynv 'nshy nynvh b'lhym vyqr'v tsvm vylbshv shqym mgdvlm v'd qtnm
verses.translation: So the people of Nineveh believed God, and proclaimed a fast, and put on sackcloth, from the greatest of them even to the least of them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּגַּ֤ע הַ/דָּבָר֙ אֶל מֶ֣לֶך נִֽינְוֵ֔ה וַ/יָּ֨קָם֙ מִ/כִּסְא֔/וֹ וַ/יַּעֲבֵ֥ר אַדַּרְתּ֖/וֹ מֵֽ/עָלָ֑י/ו וַ/יְכַ֣ס שַׂ֔ק וַ/יֵּ֖שֶׁב עַל הָ/אֵֽפֶר
verses.translit: vyg' hdbr 'l mlkh nynvh vyqm mkhs'v vy'br 'drtv m'lyv vykhs shq vyshb 'l h'pr
verses.translation: For word came unto the king of Nineveh, and he arose from his throne, and he laid his robe from him, and covered him with sackcloth, and sat in ashes.

verses.original: וַ/יַּזְעֵ֗ק וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ בְּ/נִֽינְוֵ֔ה מִ/טַּ֧עַם הַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ וּ/גְדֹלָ֖י/ו לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הָ/אָדָ֨ם וְ/הַ/בְּהֵמָ֜ה הַ/בָּקָ֣ר וְ/הַ/צֹּ֗אן אַֽל יִטְעֲמוּ֙ מְא֔וּמָה אַ֨ל יִרְע֔וּ וּ/מַ֖יִם אַל יִשְׁתּֽוּ
verses.translit: vyz'q vy'mr bnynvh mt'm hmlkh vgdlyv l'mr h'dm vhbhmh hbqr vhts'n 'l yt'mv m'vmh 'l yr'v vmym 'l yshtv
verses.translation: And he caused it to be proclaimed and published through Nineveh by the decree of the king and his nobles, saying, Let neither man nor beast, herd nor flock, taste any thing: let them not feed, nor drink water:

verses.original: וְ/יִתְכַּסּ֣וּ שַׂקִּ֗ים הָֽ/אָדָם֙ וְ/הַ/בְּהֵמָ֔ה וְ/יִקְרְא֥וּ אֶל אֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּ/חָזְקָ֑ה וְ/יָשֻׁ֗בוּ אִ֚ישׁ מִ/דַּרְכּ֣/וֹ הָֽ/רָעָ֔ה וּ/מִן הֶ/חָמָ֖ס אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּ/כַפֵּי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vytkhsv shqym h'dm vhbhmh vyqr'v 'l 'lhym bchzqh vyshbv 'ysh mdrkhv hr'h vmn hchms 'shr bkhpyhm
verses.translation: But let man and beast be covered with sackcloth, and cry mightily unto God: yea, let them turn every one from his evil way, and from the violence that is in their hands.

verses.original: מִֽי יוֹדֵ֣עַ יָשׁ֔וּב וְ/נִחַ֖ם הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְ/שָׁ֛ב מֵ/חֲר֥וֹן אַפּ֖/וֹ וְ/לֹ֥א נֹאבֵֽד
verses.translit: my yvd' yshvb vnchm h'lhym vshb mchrvn 'pv vl' n'bd
verses.translation: Who can tell if God will turn and repent, and turn away from his fierce anger, that we perish not?

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤רְא הָֽ/אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶֽת מַ֣עֲשֵׂי/הֶ֔ם כִּי שָׁ֖בוּ מִ/דַּרְכָּ֣/ם הָ/רָעָ֑ה וַ/יִּנָּ֣חֶם הָ/אֱלֹהִ֗ים עַל הָ/רָעָ֛ה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֥ר לַ/עֲשׂוֹת לָ/הֶ֖ם וְ/לֹ֥א עָשָֽׂה
verses.translit: vyr' h'lhym 't m'shyhm khy shbv mdrkhm hr'h vynchm h'lhym 'l hr'h 'shr dbr l'shvt lhm vl' 'shh
verses.translation: And God saw their works, that they turned from their evil way; and God repented of the evil, that he had said that he would do unto them; and he did it not.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֥רַע אֶל יוֹנָ֖ה רָעָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֑ה וַ/יִּ֖חַר לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyr' 'l yvnh r'h gdvlh vychr lv
verses.translation: But it displeased Jonah exceedingly, and he was very angry.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְפַּלֵּ֨ל אֶל יְהוָ֜ה וַ/יֹּאמַ֗ר אָנָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ הֲ/לוֹא זֶ֣ה דְבָרִ֗/י עַד הֱיוֹתִ/י֙ עַל אַדְמָתִ֔/י עַל כֵּ֥ן קִדַּ֖מְתִּי לִ/בְרֹ֣חַ תַּרְשִׁ֑ישָׁ/ה כִּ֣י יָדַ֗עְתִּי כִּ֤י אַתָּה֙ אֵֽל חַנּ֣וּן וְ/רַח֔וּם אֶ֤רֶךְ אַפַּ֨יִם֙ וְ/רַב חֶ֔סֶד וְ/נִחָ֖ם עַל הָ/רָעָֽה
verses.translit: vytpll 'l yhvh vy'mr 'nh yhvh hlv' zh dbry 'd hyvty 'l 'dmty 'l khn qdmty lbrch trshyshh khy yd'ty khy 'th 'l chnvn vrchvm 'rkh 'pym vrb chsd vnchm 'l hr'h
verses.translation: And he prayed unto the LORD , and said, I pray thee, O LORD , was not this my saying, when I was yet in my country? Therefore I fled before unto Tarshish: for I knew that thou art a gracious God, and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repentest thee of the evil.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה קַח נָ֥א אֶת נַפְשִׁ֖/י מִמֶּ֑/נִּי כִּ֛י ט֥וֹב מוֹתִ֖/י מֵ/חַיָּֽ/י
verses.translit: v'th yhvh qch n' 't npshy mmny khy tvb mvty mchyy
verses.translation: Therefore now, O LORD , take, I beseech thee, my life from me; for it is better for me to die than to live.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֔ה הַ/הֵיטֵ֖ב חָ֥רָה לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh hhytb chrh lkh
verses.translation: Then said the LORD , Doest thou well to be angry?

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֤א יוֹנָה֙ מִן הָ/עִ֔יר וַ/יֵּ֖שֶׁב מִ/קֶּ֣דֶם לָ/עִ֑יר וַ/יַּעַשׂ֩ ל֨/וֹ שָׁ֜ם סֻכָּ֗ה וַ/יֵּ֤שֶׁב תַּחְתֶּ֨י/הָ֙ בַּ/צֵּ֔ל עַ֚ד אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִרְאֶ֔ה מַה יִּהְיֶ֖ה בָּ/עִֽיר
verses.translit: vyts' yvnh mn h'yr vyshb mqdm l'yr vy'sh lv shm skhh vyshb tchtyh btsl 'd 'shr yr'h mh yhyh b'yr
verses.translation: So Jonah went out of the city, and sat on the east side of the city, and there made him a booth, and sat under it in the shadow, till he might see what would become of the city.

verses.original: וַ/יְמַ֣ן יְהוָֽה אֱ֠לֹהִים קִיקָי֞וֹן וַ/יַּ֣עַל מֵ/עַ֣ל לְ/יוֹנָ֗ה לִֽ/הְי֥וֹת צֵל֙ עַל רֹאשׁ֔/וֹ לְ/הַצִּ֥יל ל֖/וֹ מֵ/רָֽעָת֑/וֹ וַ/יִּשְׂמַ֥ח יוֹנָ֛ה עַל הַ/קִּֽיקָי֖וֹן שִׂמְחָ֥ה גְדוֹלָֽה
verses.translit: vymn yhvh 'lhym qyqyvn vy'l m'l lyvnh lhyvt tsl 'l r'shv lhtsyl lv mr'tv vyshmch yvnh 'l hqyqyvn shmchh gdvlh
verses.translation: And the LORD God prepared a gourd, and made it to come up over Jonah, that it might be a shadow over his head, to deliver him from his grief. So Jonah was exceeding glad of the gourd.

verses.original: וַ/יְמַ֤ן הָֽ/אֱלֹהִים֙ תּוֹלַ֔עַת בַּ/עֲל֥וֹת הַ/שַּׁ֖חַר לַֽ/מָּחֳרָ֑ת וַ/תַּ֥ךְ אֶת הַ/קִּֽיקָי֖וֹן וַ/יִּיבָֽשׁ
verses.translit: vymn h'lhym tvl't b'lvt hshchr lmchrt vtkh 't hqyqyvn vyybsh
verses.translation: But God prepared a worm when the morning rose the next day, and it smote the gourd that it withered.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י כִּ/זְרֹ֣חַ הַ/שֶּׁ֗מֶשׁ וַ/יְמַ֨ן אֱלֹהִ֜ים ר֤וּחַ קָדִים֙ חֲרִישִׁ֔ית וַ/תַּ֥ךְ הַ/שֶּׁ֛מֶשׁ עַל רֹ֥אשׁ יוֹנָ֖ה וַ/יִּתְעַלָּ֑ף וַ/יִּשְׁאַ֤ל אֶת נַפְשׁ/וֹ֙ לָ/מ֔וּת וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר ט֥וֹב מוֹתִ֖/י מֵ/חַיָּֽ/י
verses.translit: vyhy khzrch hshmsh vymn 'lhym rvch qdym chryshyt vtkh hshmsh 'l r'sh yvnh vyt'lf vysh'l 't npshv lmvt vy'mr tvb mvty mchyy
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when the sun did arise, that God prepared a vehement east wind; and the sun beat upon the head of Jonah, that he fainted, and wished in himself to die, and said, It is better for me to die than to live.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל יוֹנָ֔ה הַ/הֵיטֵ֥ב חָרָֽה לְ/ךָ֖ עַל הַ/קִּֽיקָי֑וֹן וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר הֵיטֵ֥ב חָֽרָה לִ֖/י עַד מָֽוֶת
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym 'l yvnh hhytb chrh lkh 'l hqyqyvn vy'mr hytb chrh ly 'd mvt
verses.translation: And God said to Jonah, Doest thou well to be angry for the gourd? And he said, I do well to be angry, even unto death.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֔ה אַתָּ֥ה חַ֨סְתָּ֙ עַל הַ/קִּ֣יקָי֔וֹן אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא עָמַ֥לְתָּ בּ֖/וֹ וְ/לֹ֣א גִדַּלְתּ֑/וֹ שֶׁ/בִּן לַ֥יְלָה הָיָ֖ה וּ/בִן לַ֥יְלָה אָבָֽד
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'th chst 'l hqyqyvn 'shr l' 'mlt bv vl' gdltv shbn lylh hyh vbn lylh 'bd
verses.translation: Then said the LORD , Thou hast had pity on the gourd, for the which thou hast not laboured, neither madest it grow; which came up in a night, and perished in a night:

verses.original: וַֽ/אֲנִי֙ לֹ֣א אָח֔וּס עַל נִינְוֵ֖ה הָ/עִ֣יר הַ/גְּדוֹלָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֶשׁ בָּ֡/הּ הַרְבֵּה֩ מִֽ/שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵ֨ה רִבּ֜וֹ אָדָ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא יָדַע֙ בֵּין יְמִינ֣/וֹ לִ/שְׂמֹאל֔/וֹ וּ/בְהֵמָ֖ה רַבָּֽה
verses.translit: v'ny l' 'chvs 'l nynvh h'yr hgdvlh 'shr ysh bh hrbh mshtym 'shrh rbv 'dm 'shr l' yd' byn ymynv lshm'lv vbhmh rbh
verses.translation: And should not I spare Nineveh, that great city, wherein are more than sixscore thousand persons that cannot discern between their right hand and their left hand; and also much cattle?

verses.original: דְּבַר יְהוָ֣ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֗ה אֶל מִיכָה֙ הַ/מֹּ֣רַשְׁתִּ֔י בִּ/ימֵ֥י יוֹתָ֛ם אָחָ֥ז יְחִזְקִיָּ֖ה מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר חָזָ֥ה עַל שֹׁמְר֖וֹן וִ/ירֽוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: dbr yhvh 'shr hyh 'l mykhh hmrshty bymy yvtm 'chz ychzqyh mlkhy yhvdh 'shr chzh 'l shmrvn vyrvshlm
verses.translation: The word of the LORD that came to Micah the Morasthite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.

verses.original: שִׁמְעוּ֙ עַמִּ֣ים כֻּלָּ֔/ם הַקְשִׁ֖יבִי אֶ֣רֶץ וּ/מְלֹאָ֑/הּ וִ/יהִי֩ אֲדֹנָ֨/י יְהוִ֤ה בָּ/כֶם֙ לְ/עֵ֔ד אֲדֹנָ֖/י מֵ/הֵיכַ֥ל קָדְשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: shm'v 'mym khlm hqshyby 'rts vml'h vyhy 'dny yhvh bkhm l'd 'dny mhykhl qdshv
verses.translation: Hear, all ye people; hearken, O earth, and all that therein is: and let the Lord GOD be witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.

verses.original: כִּֽי הִנֵּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה יֹצֵ֣א מִ/מְּקוֹמ֑/וֹ וְ/יָרַ֥ד וְ/דָרַ֖ךְ עַל במותי בָּ֥מֳתֵי אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: khy hnh yhvh yts' mmqvmv vyrd vdrkh 'l bmvty bmty 'rts
verses.translation: For, behold, the LORD cometh forth out of his place, and will come down, and tread upon the high places of the earth.

verses.original: וְ/נָמַ֤סּוּ הֶֽ/הָרִים֙ תַּחְתָּ֔י/ו וְ/הָ/עֲמָקִ֖ים יִתְבַּקָּ֑עוּ כַּ/דּוֹנַג֙ מִ/פְּנֵ֣י הָ/אֵ֔שׁ כְּ/מַ֖יִם מֻגָּרִ֥ים בְּ/מוֹרָֽד
verses.translit: vnmsv hhrym tchtyv vh'mqym ytbq'v khdvng mpny h'sh khmym mgrym bmvrd
verses.translation: And the mountains shall be molten under him, and the valleys shall be cleft, as wax before the fire, and as the waters that are poured down a steep place.

verses.original: בְּ/פֶ֤שַׁע יַֽעֲקֹב֙ כָּל זֹ֔את וּ/בְ/חַטֹּ֖אות בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִֽי פֶ֣שַׁע יַעֲקֹ֗ב הֲ/לוֹא֙ שֹֽׁמְר֔וֹן וּ/מִי֙ בָּמ֣וֹת יְהוּדָ֔ה הֲ/ל֖וֹא יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: bpsh' y'qb khl z't vbcht'vt byt yshr'l my psh' y'qb hlv' shmrvn vmy bmvt yhvdh hlv' yrvshlm
verses.translation: For the transgression of Jacob is all this, and for the sins of the house of Israel. What is the transgression of Jacob? is it not Samaria? and what are the high places of Judah? are they not Jerusalem?

verses.original: וְ/שַׂמְתִּ֥י שֹׁמְר֛וֹן לְ/עִ֥י הַ/שָּׂדֶ֖ה לְ/מַטָּ֣עֵי כָ֑רֶם וְ/הִגַּרְתִּ֤י לַ/גַּי֙ אֲבָנֶ֔י/הָ וִ/יסֹדֶ֖י/הָ אֲגַלֶּֽה
verses.translit: vshmty shmrvn l'y hshdh lmt'y khrm vhgrty lgy 'bnyh vysdyh 'glh
verses.translation: Therefore I will make Samaria as an heap of the field, and as plantings of a vineyard: and I will pour down the stones thereof into the valley, and I will discover the foundations thereof.

verses.original: וְ/כָל פְּסִילֶ֣י/הָ יֻכַּ֗תּוּ וְ/כָל אֶתְנַנֶּ֨י/הָ֙ יִשָּׂרְפ֣וּ בָ/אֵ֔שׁ וְ/כָל עֲצַבֶּ֖י/הָ אָשִׂ֣ים שְׁמָמָ֑ה כִּ֠י מֵ/אֶתְנַ֤ן זוֹנָה֙ קִבָּ֔צָה וְ/עַד אֶתְנַ֥ן זוֹנָ֖ה יָשֽׁוּבוּ
verses.translit: vkhl psylyh ykhtv vkhl 'tnnyh yshrpv b'sh vkhl 'tsbyh 'shym shmmh khy m'tnn zvnh qbtsh v'd 'tnn zvnh yshvbv
verses.translation: And all the graven images thereof shall be beaten to pieces, and all the hires thereof shall be burned with the fire, and all the idols thereof will I lay desolate: for she gathered it of the hire of an harlot, and they shall return to the hire of an harlot.

verses.original: עַל זֹאת֙ אֶסְפְּדָ֣ה וְ/אֵילִ֔ילָה אֵילְכָ֥ה שילל שׁוֹלָ֖ל וְ/עָר֑וֹם אֶעֱשֶׂ֤ה מִסְפֵּד֙ כַּ/תַּנִּ֔ים וְ/אֵ֖בֶל כִּ/בְנ֥וֹת יַעֲנָֽה
verses.translit: 'l z't 'spdh v'ylylh 'ylkhh shyll shvll v'rvm ''shh mspd khtnym v'bl khbnvt y'nh
verses.translation: Therefore I will wail and howl, I will go stripped and naked: I will make a wailing like the dragons, and mourning as the owls.

verses.original: כִּ֥י אֲנוּשָׁ֖ה מַכּוֹתֶ֑י/הָ כִּי בָ֨אָה֙ עַד יְהוּדָ֔ה נָגַ֛ע עַד שַׁ֥עַר עַמִּ֖/י עַד יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: khy 'nvshh mkhvtyh khy b'h 'd yhvdh ng' 'd sh'r 'my 'd yrvshlm
verses.translation: For her wound is incurable; for it is come unto Judah; he is come unto the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.

verses.original: בְּ/גַת֙ אַל תַּגִּ֔ידוּ בָּכ֖וֹ אַל תִּבְכּ֑וּ בְּ/בֵ֣ית לְעַפְרָ֔ה עָפָ֖ר התפלשתי הִתְפַּלָּֽשִׁי
verses.translit: bgt 'l tgydv bkhv 'l tbkhv bbyt l'prh 'pr htplshty htplshy
verses.translation: Declare ye it not at Gath, weep ye not at all: in the house of Aphrah roll thyself in the dust.

verses.original: עִבְרִ֥י לָ/כֶ֛ם יוֹשֶׁ֥בֶת שָׁפִ֖יר עֶרְיָה בֹ֑שֶׁת לֹ֤א יָֽצְאָה֙ יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת צַֽאֲנָ֔ן מִסְפַּד֙ בֵּ֣ית הָאֵ֔צֶל יִקַּ֥ח מִ/כֶּ֖ם עֶמְדָּתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'bry lkhm yvshbt shpyr 'ryh bsht l' yts'h yvshbt ts'nn mspd byt h'tsl yqch mkhm 'mdtv
verses.translation: Pass ye away, thou inhabitant of Saphir, having thy shame naked: the inhabitant of Zaanan came not forth in the mourning of Beth-ezel; he shall receive of you his standing.

verses.original: כִּֽי חָ֥לָֽה לְ/ט֖וֹב יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת מָר֑וֹת כִּֽי יָ֤רַד רָע֙ מֵ/אֵ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה לְ/שַׁ֖עַר יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: khy chlh ltvb yvshbt mrvt khy yrd r' m't yhvh lsh'r yrvshlm
verses.translation: For the inhabitant of Maroth waited carefully for good: but evil came down from the LORD unto the gate of Jerusalem.

verses.original: רְתֹ֧ם הַ/מֶּרְכָּבָ֛ה לָ/רֶ֖כֶשׁ יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת לָכִ֑ישׁ רֵאשִׁ֨ית חַטָּ֥את הִיא֙ לְ/בַת צִיּ֔וֹן כִּי בָ֥/ךְ נִמְצְא֖וּ פִּשְׁעֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: rtm hmrkhbh lrkhsh yvshbt lkhysh r'shyt cht't hy' lbt tsyvn khy bkh nmts'v psh'y yshr'l
verses.translation: O thou inhabitant of Lachish, bind the chariot to the swift beast: she is the beginning of the sin to the daughter of Zion: for the transgressions of Israel were found in thee.

verses.original: לָ/כֵן֙ תִּתְּנִ֣י שִׁלּוּחִ֔ים עַ֖ל מוֹרֶ֣שֶׁת גַּ֑ת בָּתֵּ֤י אַכְזִיב֙ לְ/אַכְזָ֔ב לְ/מַלְכֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: lkhn ttny shlvchym 'l mvrsht gt bty 'khzyb l'khzb lmlkhy yshr'l
verses.translation: Therefore shalt thou give presents to Moresheth-gath: the houses of Achzib shall be a lie to the kings of Israel.

verses.original: עֹ֗ד הַ/יֹּרֵשׁ֙ אָ֣בִי לָ֔/ךְ יוֹשֶׁ֖בֶת מָֽרֵשָׁ֑ה עַד עֲדֻּלָּ֥ם יָב֖וֹא כְּב֥וֹד יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: 'd hyrsh 'by lkh yvshbt mrshh 'd 'dlm ybv' khbvd yshr'l
verses.translation: Yet will I bring an heir unto thee, O inhabitant of Mareshah: he shall come unto Adullam the glory of Israel.

verses.original: קָרְחִ֣י וָ/גֹ֔זִּי עַל בְּנֵ֖י תַּעֲנוּגָ֑יִ/ךְ הַרְחִ֤בִי קָרְחָתֵ/ךְ֙ כַּ/נֶּ֔שֶׁר כִּ֥י גָל֖וּ מִמֵּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: qrchy vgzy 'l bny t'nvgykh hrchby qrchtkh khnshr khy glv mmkh
verses.translation: Make thee bald, and poll thee for thy delicate children; enlarge thy baldness as the eagle; for they are gone into captivity from thee.

verses.original: ה֧וֹי חֹֽשְׁבֵי אָ֛וֶן וּ/פֹ֥עֲלֵי רָ֖ע עַל מִשְׁכְּבוֹתָ֑/ם בְּ/א֤וֹר הַ/בֹּ֨קֶר֙ יַעֲשׂ֔וּ/הָ כִּ֥י יֶשׁ לְ/אֵ֖ל יָדָֽ/ם
verses.translit: hvy chshby 'vn vp'ly r' 'l mshkhbvtm b'vr hbqr y'shvh khy ysh l'l ydm
verses.translation: Woe to them that devise iniquity, and work evil upon their beds! when the morning is light, they practise it, because it is in the power of their hand.

verses.original: וְ/חָמְד֤וּ שָׂדוֹת֙ וְ/גָזָ֔לוּ וּ/בָתִּ֖ים וְ/נָשָׂ֑אוּ וְ/עָֽשְׁקוּ֙ גֶּ֣בֶר וּ/בֵית֔/וֹ וְ/אִ֖ישׁ וְ/נַחֲלָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vchmdv shdvt vgzlv vbtym vnsh'v v'shqv gbr vbytv v'ysh vnchltv
verses.translation: And they covet fields, and take them by violence; and houses, and take them away: so they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנְ/נִ֥י חֹשֵׁ֛ב עַל הַ/מִּשְׁפָּחָ֥ה הַ/זֹּ֖את רָעָ֑ה אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹֽא תָמִ֨ישׁוּ מִ/שָּׁ֜ם צַוְּארֹֽתֵי/כֶ֗ם וְ/לֹ֤א תֵֽלְכוּ֙ רוֹמָ֔ה כִּ֛י עֵ֥ת רָעָ֖ה הִֽיא
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr yhvh hnny chshb 'l hmshpchh hz't r'h 'shr l' tmyshv mshm tsv'rtykhm vl' tlkhv rvmh khy 't r'h hy'
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD ; Behold, against this family do I devise an evil, from which ye shall not remove your necks; neither shall ye go haughtily: for this time is evil.

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֨וֹם הַ/ה֜וּא יִשָּׂ֧א עֲלֵי/כֶ֣ם מָשָׁ֗ל וְ/נָהָ֨ה נְהִ֤י נִֽהְיָה֙ אָמַר֙ שָׁד֣וֹד נְשַׁדֻּ֔נוּ חֵ֥לֶק עַמִּ֖/י יָמִ֑יר אֵ֚יךְ יָמִ֣ישׁ לִ֔/י לְ/שׁוֹבֵ֥ב שָׂדֵ֖י/נוּ יְחַלֵּֽק
verses.translit: byvm hhv' ysh' 'lykhm mshl vnhh nhy nhyh 'mr shdvd nshdnv chlq 'my ymyr 'ykh ymysh ly lshvbb shdynv ychlq
verses.translation: In that day shall one take up a parable against you, and lament with a doleful lamentation, and say, We be utterly spoiled: he hath changed the portion of my people: how hath he removed it from me! turning away he hath divided our fields.

verses.original: לָ/כֵן֙ לֹֽא יִֽהְיֶ֣ה לְ/ךָ֔ מַשְׁלִ֥יךְ חֶ֖בֶל בְּ/גוֹרָ֑ל בִּ/קְהַ֖ל יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: lkhn l' yhyh lkh mshlykh chbl bgvrl bqhl yhvh
verses.translation: Therefore thou shalt have none that shall cast a cord by lot in the congregation of the LORD .

verses.original: אַל תַּטִּ֖פוּ יַטִּיפ֑וּ/ן לֹֽא יַטִּ֣פוּ לָ/אֵ֔לֶּה לֹ֥א יִסַּ֖ג כְּלִמּֽוֹת
verses.translit: 'l ttpv ytypvn l' ytpv l'lh l' ysg khlmvt
verses.translation: Prophesy ye not, say they to them that prophesy: they shall not prophesy to them, that they shall not take shame.

verses.original: הֶ/אָמ֣וּר בֵּֽית יַעֲקֹ֗ב הֲ/קָצַר֙ ר֣וּחַ יְהוָ֔ה אִם אֵ֖לֶּה מַעֲלָלָ֑י/ו הֲ/ל֤וֹא דְבָרַ֨/י יֵיטִ֔יבוּ עִ֖ם הַ/יָּשָׁ֥ר הוֹלֵֽךְ
verses.translit: h'mvr byt y'qb hqtsr rvch yhvh 'm 'lh m'llyv hlv' dbry yytybv 'm hyshr hvlkh
verses.translation: O thou that art named the house of Jacob, is the spirit of the LORD straitened? are these his doings? do not my words do good to him that walketh uprightly?

verses.original: וְ/אֶתְמ֗וּל עַמִּ/י֙ לְ/אוֹיֵ֣ב יְקוֹמֵ֔ם מִ/מּ֣וּל שַׂלְמָ֔ה אֶ֖דֶר תַּפְשִׁט֑וּ/ן מֵ/עֹבְרִ֣ים בֶּ֔טַח שׁוּבֵ֖י מִלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: v'tmvl 'my l'vyb yqvmm mmvl shlmh 'dr tpshtvn m'brym btch shvby mlchmh
verses.translation: Even of late my people is risen up as an enemy: ye pull off the robe with the garment from them that pass by securely as men averse from war.

verses.original: נְשֵׁ֤י עַמִּ/י֙ תְּגָ֣רְשׁ֔וּ/ן מִ/בֵּ֖ית תַּֽעֲנֻגֶ֑י/הָ מֵ/עַל֙ עֹֽלָלֶ֔י/הָ תִּקְח֥וּ הֲדָרִ֖/י לְ/עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: nshy 'my tgrshvn mbyt t'ngyh m'l 'llyh tqchv hdry l'vlm
verses.translation: The women of my people have ye cast out from their pleasant houses; from their children have ye taken away my glory for ever.

verses.original: ק֣וּמוּ וּ/לְכ֔וּ כִּ֥י לֹא זֹ֖את הַ/מְּנוּחָ֑ה בַּ/עֲב֥וּר טָמְאָ֛ה תְּחַבֵּ֖ל וְ/חֶ֥בֶל נִמְרָֽץ
verses.translit: qvmv vlkhv khy l' z't hmnvchh b'bvr tm'h tchbl vchbl nmrts
verses.translation: Arise ye, and depart; for this is not your rest: because it is polluted, it shall destroy you , even with a sore destruction.

verses.original: לוּ אִ֞ישׁ הֹלֵ֥ךְ ר֨וּחַ֙ וָ/שֶׁ֣קֶר כִּזֵּ֔ב אַטִּ֣ף לְ/ךָ֔ לַ/יַּ֖יִן וְ/לַ/שֵּׁכָ֑ר וְ/הָיָ֥ה מַטִּ֖יף הָ/עָ֥ם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: lv 'ysh hlkh rvch vshqr khzb 'tf lkh lyyn vlshkhr vhyh mtyf h'm hzh
verses.translation: If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying , I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink; he shall even be the prophet of this people.

verses.original: אָסֹ֨ף אֶאֱסֹ֜ף יַעֲקֹ֣ב כֻּלָּ֗/ךְ קַבֵּ֤ץ אֲקַבֵּץ֙ שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יַ֥חַד אֲשִׂימֶ֖/נּוּ כְּ/צֹ֣אן בָּצְרָ֑ה כְּ/עֵ֨דֶר֙ בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ הַ/דָּֽבְר֔/וֹ תְּהִימֶ֖נָה מֵ/אָדָֽם
verses.translit: 'sf ''sf y'qb khlkh qbts 'qbts sh'ryt yshr'l ychd 'shymnv khts'n btsrh kh'dr btvkh hdbrv thymnh m'dm
verses.translation: I will surely assemble, O Jacob, all of thee; I will surely gather the remnant of Israel; I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah, as the flock in the midst of their fold: they shall make great noise by reason of the multitude of men.

verses.original: עָלָ֤ה הַ/פֹּרֵץ֙ לִ/פְנֵי/הֶ֔ם פָּֽרְצוּ֙ וַֽ/יַּעֲבֹ֔רוּ שַׁ֖עַר וַ/יֵּ֣צְאוּ ב֑/וֹ וַ/יַּעֲבֹ֤ר מַלְכָּ/ם֙ לִ/פְנֵי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יהוָ֖ה בְּ/רֹאשָֽׁ/ם
verses.translit: 'lh hprts lpnyhm prtsv vy'brv sh'r vyts'v bv vy'br mlkhm lpnyhm vyhvh br'shm
verses.translation: The breaker is come up before them: they have broken up, and have passed through the gate, and are gone out by it: and their king shall pass before them, and the LORD on the head of them.

verses.original: וָ/אֹמַ֗ר שִׁמְעוּ נָא֙ רָאשֵׁ֣י יַעֲקֹ֔ב וּ/קְצִינֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הֲ/ל֣וֹא לָ/כֶ֔ם לָ/דַ֖עַת אֶת הַ/מִּשְׁפָּֽט
verses.translit: v'mr shm'v n' r'shy y'qb vqtsyny byt yshr'l hlv' lkhm ld't 't hmshpt
verses.translation: And I said, Hear, I pray you, O heads of Jacob, and ye princes of the house of Israel; Is it not for you to know judgment?

verses.original: שֹׂ֥נְאֵי ט֖וֹב וְ/אֹ֣הֲבֵי רעה רָ֑ע גֹּזְלֵ֤י עוֹרָ/ם֙ מֵֽ/עֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם וּ/שְׁאֵרָ֖/ם מֵ/עַ֥ל עַצְמוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: shn'y tvb v'hby r'h r' gzly 'vrm m'lyhm vsh'rm m'l 'tsmvtm
verses.translation: Who hate the good, and love the evil; who pluck off their skin from off them, and their flesh from off their bones;

verses.original: וַ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָכְלוּ֮ שְׁאֵ֣ר עַמִּ/י֒ וְ/עוֹרָ/ם֙ מֵ/עֲלֵי/הֶ֣ם הִפְשִׁ֔יטוּ וְ/אֶת עַצְמֹֽתֵי/הֶ֖ם פִּצֵּ֑חוּ וּ/פָרְשׂוּ֙ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ/סִּ֔יר וּ/כְ/בָשָׂ֖ר בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ קַלָּֽחַת
verses.translit: v'shr 'khlv sh'r 'my v'vrm m'lyhm hpshytv v't 'tsmtyhm ptschv vprshv kh'shr bsyr vkhbshr btvkh qlcht
verses.translation: Who also eat the flesh of my people, and flay their skin from off them; and they break their bones, and chop them in pieces, as for the pot, and as flesh within the caldron.

verses.original: אָ֚ז יִזְעֲק֣וּ אֶל יְהוָ֔ה וְ/לֹ֥א יַעֲנֶ֖ה אוֹתָ֑/ם וְ/יַסְתֵּ֨ר פָּנָ֤י/ו מֵ/הֶם֙ בָּ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֔יא כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֵרֵ֖עוּ מַעַלְלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: 'z yz'qv 'l yhvh vl' y'nh 'vtm vystr pnyv mhm b't hhy' kh'shr hr'v m'llyhm
verses.translation: Then shall they cry unto the LORD , but he will not hear them: he will even hide his face from them at that time, as they have behaved themselves ill in their doings.

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה עַל הַ/נְּבִיאִ֖ים הַ/מַּתְעִ֣ים אֶת עַמִּ֑/י הַ/נֹּשְׁכִ֤ים בְּ/שִׁנֵּי/הֶם֙ וְ/קָרְא֣וּ שָׁל֔וֹם וַ/אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹא יִתֵּ֣ן עַל פִּי/הֶ֔ם וְ/קִדְּשׁ֥וּ עָלָ֖י/ו מִלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'l hnby'ym hmt'ym 't 'my hnshkhym bshnyhm vqr'v shlvm v'shr l' ytn 'l pyhm vqdshv 'lyv mlchmh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD concerning the prophets that make my people err, that bite with their teeth, and cry, Peace; and he that putteth not into their mouths, they even prepare war against him.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֞ן לַ֤יְלָה לָ/כֶם֙ מֵֽ/חָז֔וֹן וְ/חָשְׁכָ֥ה לָ/כֶ֖ם מִ/קְּסֹ֑ם וּ/בָ֤אָה הַ/שֶּׁ֨מֶשׁ֙ עַל הַ/נְּבִיאִ֔ים וְ/קָדַ֥ר עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: lkhn lylh lkhm mchzvn vchshkhh lkhm mqsm vb'h hshmsh 'l hnby'ym vqdr 'lyhm hyvm
verses.translation: Therefore night shall be unto you, that ye shall not have a vision; and it shall be dark unto you, that ye shall not divine; and the sun shall go down over the prophets, and the day shall be dark over them.

verses.original: וּ/בֹ֣שׁוּ הַ/חֹזִ֗ים וְ/חָֽפְרוּ֙ הַ/קֹּ֣סְמִ֔ים וְ/עָט֥וּ עַל שָׂפָ֖ם כֻּלָּ֑/ם כִּ֛י אֵ֥ין מַעֲנֵ֖ה אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vbshv hchzym vchprv hqsmym v'tv 'l shpm khlm khy 'yn m'nh 'lhym
verses.translation: Then shall the seers be ashamed, and the diviners confounded: yea, they shall all cover their lips; for there is no answer of God.

verses.original: וְ/אוּלָ֗ם אָנֹכִ֞י מָלֵ֤אתִי כֹ֨חַ֙ אֶת ר֣וּחַ יְהוָ֔ה וּ/מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּ/גְבוּרָ֑ה לְ/הַגִּ֤יד לְ/יַֽעֲקֹב֙ פִּשְׁע֔/וֹ וּ/לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל חַטָּאתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'vlm 'nkhy ml'ty khch 't rvch yhvh vmshpt vgbvrh lhgyd ly'qb psh'v vlyshr'l cht'tv
verses.translation: But truly I am full of power by the spirit of the LORD , and of judgment, and of might, to declare unto Jacob his transgression, and to Israel his sin.

verses.original: שִׁמְעוּ נָ֣א זֹ֗את רָאשֵׁי֙ בֵּ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֔ב וּ/קְצִינֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הַֽ/מֲתַעֲבִ֣ים מִשְׁפָּ֔ט וְ/אֵ֥ת כָּל הַ/יְשָׁרָ֖ה יְעַקֵּֽשׁוּ
verses.translit: shm'v n' z't r'shy byt y'qb vqtsyny byt yshr'l hmt'bym mshpt v't khl hyshrh y'qshv
verses.translation: Hear this, I pray you, ye heads of the house of Jacob, and princes of the house of Israel, that abhor judgment, and pervert all equity.

verses.original: בֹּנֶ֥ה צִיּ֖וֹן בְּ/דָמִ֑ים וִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בְּ/עַוְלָֽה
verses.translit: bnh tsyvn bdmym vyrvshlm b'vlh
verses.translation: They build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.

verses.original: רָאשֶׁ֣י/הָ בְּ/שֹׁ֣חַד יִשְׁפֹּ֗טוּ וְ/כֹהֲנֶ֨י/הָ֙ בִּ/מְחִ֣יר יוֹר֔וּ וּ/נְבִיאֶ֖י/הָ בְּ/כֶ֣סֶף יִקְסֹ֑מוּ וְ/עַל יְהוָה֙ יִשָּׁעֵ֣נוּ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר הֲ/ל֤וֹא יְהוָה֙ בְּ/קִרְבֵּ֔/נוּ לֹֽא תָב֥וֹא עָלֵ֖י/נוּ רָעָֽה
verses.translit: r'shyh bshchd yshptv vkhhnyh bmchyr yvrv vnby'yh bkhsf yqsmv v'l yhvh ysh'nv l'mr hlv' yhvh bqrbnv l' tbv' 'lynv r'h
verses.translation: The heads thereof judge for reward, and the priests thereof teach for hire, and the prophets thereof divine for money: yet will they lean upon the LORD , and say, Is not the LORD among us? none evil can come upon us.

verses.original: לָ/כֵן֙ בִּ/גְלַלְ/כֶ֔ם צִיּ֖וֹן שָׂדֶ֣ה תֵֽחָרֵ֑שׁ וִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ עִיִּ֣ין תִּֽהְיֶ֔ה וְ/הַ֥ר הַ/בַּ֖יִת לְ/בָמ֥וֹת יָֽעַר
verses.translit: lkhn bgllkhm tsyvn shdh tchrsh vyrvshlm 'yyn thyh vhr hbyt lbmvt y'r
verses.translation: Therefore shall Zion for your sake be plowed as a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of the forest.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֣ה בְּ/אַחֲרִ֣ית הַ/יָּמִ֗ים יִ֠הְיֶה הַ֣ר בֵּית יְהוָ֤ה נָכוֹן֙ בְּ/רֹ֣אשׁ הֶ/הָרִ֔ים וְ/נִשָּׂ֥א ה֖וּא מִ/גְּבָע֑וֹת וְ/נָהֲר֥וּ עָלָ֖י/ו עַמִּֽים
verses.translit: vhyh b'chryt hymym yhyh hr byt yhvh nkhvn br'sh hhrym vnsh' hv' mgb'vt vnhrv 'lyv 'mym
verses.translation: But in the last days it shall come to pass, that the mountain of the house of the LORD shall be established in the top of the mountains, and it shall be exalted above the hills; and people shall flow unto it.

verses.original: וְֽ/הָלְכ֞וּ גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֗ים וְ/אָֽמְרוּ֙ לְכ֣וּ וְ/נַעֲלֶ֣ה אֶל הַר יְהוָ֗ה וְ/אֶל בֵּית֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְ/יוֹרֵ֨/נוּ֙ מִ/דְּרָכָ֔י/ו וְ/נֵלְכָ֖ה בְּ/אֹֽרְחֹתָ֑י/ו כִּ֤י מִ/צִּיּוֹן֙ תֵּצֵ֣א תוֹרָ֔ה וּ/דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה מִ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vhlkhv gvym rbym v'mrv lkhv vn'lh 'l hr yhvh v'l byt 'lhy y'qb vyvrnv mdrkhyv vnlkhh b'rchtyv khy mtsyvn tts' tvrh vdbr yhvh myrvshlm
verses.translation: And many nations shall come, and say, Come, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD , and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for the law shall go forth of Zion, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁפַ֗ט בֵּ֚ין עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים וְ/הוֹכִ֛יחַ לְ/גוֹיִ֥ם עֲצֻמִ֖ים עַד רָח֑וֹק וְ/כִתְּת֨וּ חַרְבֹתֵי/הֶ֜ם לְ/אִתִּ֗ים וַ/חֲנִיתֹֽתֵי/הֶם֙ לְ/מַזְמֵר֔וֹת לֹֽא יִשְׂא֞וּ גּ֤וֹי אֶל גּוֹי֙ חֶ֔רֶב וְ/לֹא יִלְמְד֥וּ/ן ע֖וֹד מִלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: vshpt byn 'mym rbym vhvkhych lgvym 'tsmym 'd rchvq vkhttv chrbtyhm l'tym vchnyttyhm lmzmrvt l' ysh'v gvy 'l gvy chrb vl' ylmdvn 'vd mlchmh
verses.translation: And he shall judge among many people, and rebuke strong nations afar off; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up a sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.

verses.original: וְ/יָשְׁב֗וּ אִ֣ישׁ תַּ֧חַת גַּפְנ֛/וֹ וְ/תַ֥חַת תְּאֵנָת֖/וֹ וְ/אֵ֣ין מַחֲרִ֑יד כִּי פִ֛י יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת דִּבֵּֽר
verses.translit: vyshbv 'ysh tcht gpnv vtcht t'ntv v'yn mchryd khy py yhvh tsb'vt dbr
verses.translation: But they shall sit every man under his vine and under his fig tree; and none shall make them afraid: for the mouth of the LORD of hosts hath spoken it .

verses.original: כִּ֚י כָּל הָ֣/עַמִּ֔ים יֵלְכ֕וּ אִ֖ישׁ בְּ/שֵׁ֣ם אֱלֹהָ֑י/ו וַ/אֲנַ֗חְנוּ נֵלֵ֛ךְ בְּ/שֵׁם יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖י/נוּ לְ/עוֹלָ֥ם וָ/עֶֽד
verses.translit: khy khl h'mym ylkhv 'ysh bshm 'lhyv v'nchnv nlkh bshm yhvh 'lhynv l'vlm v'd
verses.translation: For all people will walk every one in the name of his god, and we will walk in the name of the LORD our God for ever and ever.

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֨וֹם הַ/ה֜וּא נְאֻם יְהוָ֗ה אֹֽסְפָה֙ הַ/צֹּ֣לֵעָ֔ה וְ/הַ/נִּדָּחָ֖ה אֲקַבֵּ֑צָה וַ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר הֲרֵעֹֽתִי
verses.translit: byvm hhv' n'm yhvh 'sph htsl'h vhndchh 'qbtsh v'shr hr'ty
verses.translation: In that day, saith the LORD , will I assemble her that halteth, and I will gather her that is driven out, and her that I have afflicted;

verses.original: וְ/שַׂמְתִּ֤י אֶת הַ/צֹּֽלֵעָה֙ לִ/שְׁאֵרִ֔ית וְ/הַ/נַּהֲלָאָ֖ה לְ/ג֣וֹי עָצ֑וּם וּ/מָלַ֨ךְ יְהוָ֤ה עֲלֵי/הֶם֙ בְּ/הַ֣ר צִיּ֔וֹן מֵ/עַתָּ֖ה וְ/עַד עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vshmty 't htsl'h lsh'ryt vhnhl'h lgvy 'tsvm vmlkh yhvh 'lyhm bhr tsyvn m'th v'd 'vlm
verses.translation: And I will make her that halted a remnant, and her that was cast far off a strong nation: and the LORD shall reign over them in mount Zion from henceforth, even for ever.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה מִגְדַּל עֵ֗דֶר עֹ֛פֶל בַּת צִיּ֖וֹן עָדֶ֣י/ךָ תֵּאתֶ֑ה וּ/בָאָ֗ה הַ/מֶּמְשָׁלָה֙ הָ/רִ֣אשֹׁנָ֔ה מַמְלֶ֖כֶת לְ/בַ֥ת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: v'th mgdl 'dr 'pl bt tsyvn 'dykh t'th vb'h hmmshlh hr'shnh mmlkht lbt yrvshlm
verses.translation: And thou, O tower of the flock, the strong hold of the daughter of Zion, unto thee shall it come, even the first dominion; the kingdom shall come to the daughter of Jerusalem.

verses.original: עַתָּ֕ה לָ֥/מָּה תָרִ֖יעִי רֵ֑עַ הֲ/מֶ֣לֶךְ אֵֽין בָּ֗/ךְ אִֽם יוֹעֲצֵ/ךְ֙ אָבָ֔ד כִּֽי הֶחֱזִיקֵ֥/ךְ חִ֖יל כַּ/יּוֹלֵדָֽה
verses.translit: 'th lmh try'y r' hmlkh 'yn bkh 'm yv'tskh 'bd khy hchzyqkh chyl khyvldh
verses.translation: Now why dost thou cry out aloud? is there no king in thee? is thy counsellor perished? for pangs have taken thee as a woman in travail.

verses.original: ח֧וּלִי וָ/גֹ֛חִי בַּת צִיּ֖וֹן כַּ/יּֽוֹלֵדָ֑ה כִּֽי עַתָּה֩ תֵצְאִ֨י מִ/קִּרְיָ֜ה וְ/שָׁכַ֣נְתְּ בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֗ה וּ/בָ֤את עַד בָּבֶל֙ שָׁ֣ם תִּנָּצֵ֔לִי שָׁ֚ם יִגְאָלֵ֣/ךְ יְהוָ֔ה מִ/כַּ֖ף אֹיְבָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: chvly vgchy bt tsyvn khyvldh khy 'th tts'y mqryh vshkhnt bshdh vb't 'd bbl shm tntsly shm yg'lkh yhvh mkhf 'ybykh
verses.translation: Be in pain, and labour to bring forth, O daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail: for now shalt thou go forth out of the city, and thou shalt dwell in the field, and thou shalt go even to Babylon; there shalt thou be delivered; there the LORD shall redeem thee from the hand of thine enemies.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֛ה נֶאֶסְפ֥וּ עָלַ֖יִ/ךְ גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֑ים הָ/אֹמְרִ֣ים תֶּחֱנָ֔ף וְ/תַ֥חַז בְּ/צִיּ֖וֹן עֵינֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: v'th n'spv 'lykh gvym rbym h'mrym tchnf vtchz btsyvn 'ynynv
verses.translation: Now also many nations are gathered against thee, that say, Let her be defiled, and let our eye look upon Zion.

verses.original: וְ/הֵ֗מָּה לֹ֤א יָֽדְעוּ֙ מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת יְהוָ֔ה וְ/לֹ֥א הֵבִ֖ינוּ עֲצָת֑/וֹ כִּ֥י קִבְּצָ֖/ם כֶּ/עָמִ֥יר גֹּֽרְנָ/ה
verses.translit: vhmh l' yd'v mchshbvt yhvh vl' hbynv 'tstv khy qbtsm kh'myr grnh
verses.translation: But they know not the thoughts of the LORD , neither understand they his counsel: for he shall gather them as the sheaves into the floor.

verses.original: ק֧וּמִי וָ/ד֣וֹשִׁי בַת צִיּ֗וֹן כִּֽי קַרְנֵ֞/ךְ אָשִׂ֤ים בַּרְזֶל֙ וּ/פַרְסֹתַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ אָשִׂ֣ים נְחוּשָׁ֔ה וַ/הֲדִקּ֖וֹת עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וְ/הַחֲרַמְתִּ֤י לַֽ/יהוָה֙ בִּצְעָ֔/ם וְ/חֵילָ֖/ם לַ/אֲד֥וֹן כָּל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: qvmy vdvshy bt tsyvn khy qrnkh 'shym brzl vprstykh 'shym nchvshh vhdqvt 'mym rbym vhchrmty lyhvh bts'm vchylm l'dvn khl h'rts
verses.translation: Arise and thresh, O daughter of Zion: for I will make thine horn iron, and I will make thy hoofs brass: and thou shalt beat in pieces many people: and I will consecrate their gain unto the LORD , and their substance unto the Lord of the whole earth.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֞ה בֵּֽית לֶ֣חֶם אֶפְרָ֗תָה צָעִיר֙ לִֽ/הְיוֹת֙ בְּ/אַלְפֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה מִמְּ/ךָ֙ לִ֣/י יֵצֵ֔א לִֽ/הְי֥וֹת מוֹשֵׁ֖ל בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּ/מוֹצָאֹתָ֥י/ו מִ/קֶּ֖דֶם מִ/ימֵ֥י עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: v'th byt lchm 'prth ts'yr lhyvt b'lpy yhvdh mmkh ly yts' lhyvt mvshl byshr'l vmvts'tyv mqdm mymy 'vlm
verses.translation: Now gather thyself in troops, O daughter of troops: he hath laid siege against us: they shall smite the judge of Israel with a rod upon the cheek.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֣ן יִתְּנֵ֔/ם עַד עֵ֥ת יוֹלֵדָ֖ה יָלָ֑דָה וְ/יֶ֣תֶר אֶחָ֔י/ו יְשׁוּב֖וּ/ן עַל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: lkhn ytnm 'd 't yvldh yldh vytr 'chyv yshvbvn 'l bny yshr'l
verses.translation: But thou, Beth-lehem Ephratah, though thou be little among the thousands of Judah, yet out of thee shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting.

verses.original: וְ/עָמַ֗ד וְ/רָעָה֙ בְּ/עֹ֣ז יְהוָ֔ה בִּ/גְא֕וֹן שֵׁ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י/ו וְ/יָשָׁ֕בוּ כִּֽי עַתָּ֥ה יִגְדַּ֖ל עַד אַפְסֵי אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: v'md vr'h b'z yhvh bg'vn shm yhvh 'lhyv vyshbv khy 'th ygdl 'd 'psy 'rts
verses.translation: Therefore will he give them up, until the time that she which travaileth hath brought forth: then the remnant of his brethren shall return unto the children of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֥ה זֶ֖ה שָׁל֑וֹם אַשּׁ֣וּר כִּֽי יָב֣וֹא בְ/אַרְצֵ֗/נוּ וְ/כִ֤י יִדְרֹךְ֙ בְּ/אַרְמְנֹתֵ֔י/נוּ וַ/הֲקֵמֹ֤נוּ עָלָי/ו֙ שִׁבְעָ֣ה רֹעִ֔ים וּ/שְׁמֹנָ֖ה נְסִיכֵ֥י אָדָֽם
verses.translit: vhyh zh shlvm 'shvr khy ybv' b'rtsnv vkhy ydrkh b'rmntynv vhqmnv 'lyv shb'h r'ym vshmnh nsykhy 'dm
verses.translation: And he shall stand and feed in the strength of the LORD , in the majesty of the name of the LORD his God; and they shall abide: for now shall he be great unto the ends of the earth.

verses.original: וְ/רָע֞וּ אֶת אֶ֤רֶץ אַשּׁוּר֙ בַּ/חֶ֔רֶב וְ/אֶת אֶ֥רֶץ נִמְרֹ֖ד בִּ/פְתָחֶ֑י/הָ וְ/הִצִּיל֙ מֵֽ/אַשּׁ֔וּר כִּֽי יָב֣וֹא בְ/אַרְצֵ֔/נוּ וְ/כִ֥י יִדְרֹ֖ךְ בִּ/גְבוּלֵֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: vr'v 't 'rts 'shvr bchrb v't 'rts nmrd bptchyh vhtsyl m'shvr khy ybv' b'rtsnv vkhy ydrkh bgbvlnv
verses.translation: And this man shall be the peace, when the Assyrian shall come into our land: and when he shall tread in our palaces, then shall we raise against him seven shepherds, and eight principal men.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֣ה שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֗ב בְּ/קֶ֨רֶב֙ עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים כְּ/טַל֙ מֵ/אֵ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה כִּ/רְבִיבִ֖ים עֲלֵי עֵ֑שֶׂב אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא יְקַוֶּה֙ לְ/אִ֔ישׁ וְ/לֹ֥א יְיַחֵ֖ל לִ/בְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם
verses.translit: vhyh sh'ryt y'qb bqrb 'mym rbym khtl m't yhvh khrbybym 'ly 'shb 'shr l' yqvh l'ysh vl' yychl lbny 'dm
verses.translation: And they shall waste the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod in the entrances thereof: thus shall he deliver us from the Assyrian, when he cometh into our land, and when he treadeth within our borders.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֩ שְׁאֵרִ֨ית יַעֲקֹ֜ב בַּ/גּוֹיִ֗ם בְּ/קֶ֨רֶב֙ עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים כְּ/אַרְיֵה֙ בְּ/בַהֲמ֣וֹת יַ֔עַר כִּ/כְפִ֖יר בְּ/עֶדְרֵי צֹ֑אן אֲשֶׁ֧ר אִם עָבַ֛ר וְ/רָמַ֥ס וְ/טָרַ֖ף וְ/אֵ֥ין מַצִּֽיל
verses.translit: vhyh sh'ryt y'qb bgvym bqrb 'mym rbym kh'ryh bbhmvt y'r khkhpyr b'dry ts'n 'shr 'm 'br vrms vtrf v'yn mtsyl
verses.translation: And the remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many people as a dew from the LORD , as the showers upon the grass, that tarrieth not for man, nor waiteth for the sons of men.

verses.original: תָּרֹ֥ם יָדְ/ךָ֖ עַל צָרֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/כָל אֹיְבֶ֖י/ךָ יִכָּרֵֽתוּ
verses.translit: trm ydkh 'l tsrykh vkhl 'ybykh ykhrtv
verses.translation: And the remnant of Jacob shall be among the Gentiles in the midst of many people as a lion among the beasts of the forest, as a young lion among the flocks of sheep: who, if he go through, both treadeth down, and teareth in pieces, and none can deliver.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֤ה בַ/יּוֹם הַ/הוּא֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה וְ/הִכְרַתִּ֥י סוּסֶ֖י/ךָ מִ/קִּרְבֶּ֑/ךָ וְ/הַאֲבַדְתִּ֖י מַרְכְּבֹתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' n'm yhvh vhkhrty svsykh mqrbkh vh'bdty mrkhbtykh
verses.translation: Thine hand shall be lifted up upon thine adversaries, and all thine enemies shall be cut off.

verses.original: וְ/הִכְרַתִּ֖י עָרֵ֣י אַרְצֶ֑/ךָ וְ/הָרַסְתִּ֖י כָּל מִבְצָרֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vhkhrty 'ry 'rtskh vhrsty khl mbtsrykh
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD , that I will cut off thy horses out of the midst of thee, and I will destroy thy chariots:

verses.original: וְ/הִכְרַתִּ֥י כְשָׁפִ֖ים מִ/יָּדֶ֑/ךָ וּֽ/מְעוֹנְנִ֖ים לֹ֥א יִֽהְיוּ לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vhkhrty khshpym mydkh vm'vnnym l' yhyv lkh
verses.translation: And I will cut off the cities of thy land, and throw down all thy strong holds:

verses.original: וְ/הִכְרַתִּ֧י פְסִילֶ֛י/ךָ וּ/מַצֵּבוֹתֶ֖י/ךָ מִ/קִּרְבֶּ֑/ךָ וְ/לֹֽא תִשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֥ה ע֖וֹד לְ/מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָדֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vhkhrty psylykh vmtsbvtykh mqrbkh vl' tshtchvh 'vd lm'shh ydykh
verses.translation: And I will cut off witchcrafts out of thine hand; and thou shalt have no more soothsayers:

verses.original: וְ/נָתַשְׁתִּ֥י אֲשֵׁירֶ֖י/ךָ מִ/קִּרְבֶּ֑/ךָ וְ/הִשְׁמַדְתִּ֖י עָרֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vntshty 'shyrykh mqrbkh vhshmdty 'rykh
verses.translation: Thy graven images also will I cut off, and thy standing images out of the midst of thee; and thou shalt no more worship the work of thine hands.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֜יתִי בְּ/אַ֧ף וּ/בְ/חֵמָ֛ה נָקָ֖ם אֶת הַ/גּוֹיִ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר לֹ֥א שָׁמֵֽעוּ
verses.translit: v'shyty b'f vbchmh nqm 't hgvym 'shr l' shm'v
verses.translation: And I will pluck up thy groves out of the midst of thee: so will I destroy thy cities.
And I will execute vengeance in anger and fury upon the heathen, such as they have not heard.

verses.original: שִׁמְעוּ נָ֕א אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר יְהוָ֖ה אֹמֵ֑ר ק֚וּם רִ֣יב אֶת הֶ/הָרִ֔ים וְ/תִשְׁמַ֥עְנָה הַ/גְּבָע֖וֹת קוֹלֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: shm'v n' 't 'shr yhvh 'mr qvm ryb 't hhrym vtshm'nh hgb'vt qvlkh
verses.translation: Hear ye now what the LORD saith; Arise, contend thou before the mountains, and let the hills hear thy voice.

verses.original: שִׁמְע֤וּ הָרִים֙ אֶת רִ֣יב יְהוָ֔ה וְ/הָ/אֵתָנִ֖ים מֹ֣סְדֵי אָ֑רֶץ כִּ֣י רִ֤יב לַֽ/יהוָה֙ עִם עַמּ֔/וֹ וְ/עִם יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יִתְוַכָּֽח
verses.translit: shm'v hrym 't ryb yhvh vh'tnym msdy 'rts khy ryb lyhvh 'm 'mv v'm yshr'l ytvkhch
verses.translation: Hear ye, O mountains, the LORD’s controversy, and ye strong foundations of the earth: for the LORD hath a controversy with his people, and he will plead with Israel.

verses.original: עַמִּ֛/י מֶה עָשִׂ֥יתִי לְ/ךָ֖ וּ/מָ֣ה הֶלְאֵתִ֑י/ךָ עֲנֵ֥ה בִּֽ/י
verses.translit: 'my mh 'shyty lkh vmh hl'tykh 'nh by
verses.translation: O my people, what have I done unto thee? and wherein have I wearied thee? testify against me.

verses.original: כִּ֤י הֶעֱלִתִ֨י/ךָ֙ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וּ/מִ/בֵּ֥ית עֲבָדִ֖ים פְּדִיתִ֑י/ךָ וָ/אֶשְׁלַ֣ח לְ/פָנֶ֔י/ךָ אֶת מֹשֶׁ֖ה אַהֲרֹ֥ן וּ/מִרְיָֽם
verses.translit: khy h'ltykh m'rts mtsrym vmbyt 'bdym pdytykh v'shlch lpnykh 't mshh 'hrn vmrym
verses.translation: For I brought thee up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed thee out of the house of servants; and I sent before thee Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.

verses.original: עַמִּ֗/י זְכָר נָא֙ מַה יָּעַ֗ץ בָּלָק֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מוֹאָ֔ב וּ/מֶה עָנָ֥ה אֹת֖/וֹ בִּלְעָ֣ם בֶּן בְּע֑וֹר מִן הַ/שִּׁטִּים֙ עַד הַ/גִּלְגָּ֔ל לְמַ֕עַן דַּ֖עַת צִדְק֥וֹת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'my zkhr n' mh y'ts blq mlkh mv'b vmh 'nh 'tv bl'm bn b'vr mn hshtym 'd hglgl lm'n d't tsdqvt yhvh
verses.translation: O my people, remember now what Balak king of Moab consulted, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim unto Gilgal; that ye may know the righteousness of the LORD .

verses.original: בַּ/מָּה֙ אֲקַדֵּ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה אִכַּ֖ף לֵ/אלֹהֵ֣י מָר֑וֹם הַ/אֲקַדְּמֶ֣/נּוּ בְ/עוֹל֔וֹת בַּ/עֲגָלִ֖ים בְּנֵ֥י שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: bmh 'qdm yhvh 'khf l'lhy mrvm h'qdmnv b'vlvt b'glym bny shnh
verses.translation: Wherewith shall I come before the LORD , and bow myself before the high God? shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves of a year old?

verses.original: הֲ/יִרְצֶ֤ה יְהוָה֙ בְּ/אַלְפֵ֣י אֵילִ֔ים בְּ/רִֽבְב֖וֹת נַֽחֲלֵי שָׁ֑מֶן הַ/אֶתֵּ֤ן בְּכוֹרִ/י֙ פִּשְׁעִ֔/י פְּרִ֥י בִטְנִ֖/י חַטַּ֥את נַפְשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: hyrtsh yhvh b'lpy 'ylym brbbvt nchly shmn h'tn bkhvry psh'y pry btny cht't npshy
verses.translation: Will the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams, or with ten thousands of rivers of oil? shall I give my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?

verses.original: הִגִּ֥יד לְ/ךָ֛ אָדָ֖ם מַה טּ֑וֹב וּ/מָֽה יְהוָ֞ה דּוֹרֵ֣שׁ מִמְּ/ךָ֗ כִּ֣י אִם עֲשׂ֤וֹת מִשְׁפָּט֙ וְ/אַ֣הֲבַת חֶ֔סֶד וְ/הַצְנֵ֥עַ לֶ֖כֶת עִם אֱלֹהֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: hgyd lkh 'dm mh tvb vmh yhvh dvrsh mmkh khy 'm 'shvt mshpt v'hbt chsd vhtsn' lkht 'm 'lhykh
verses.translation: He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?

verses.original: ק֤וֹל יְהוָה֙ לָ/עִ֣יר יִקְרָ֔א וְ/תוּשִׁיָּ֖ה יִרְאֶ֣ה שְׁמֶ֑/ךָ שִׁמְע֥וּ מַטֶּ֖ה וּ/מִ֥י יְעָדָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: qvl yhvh l'yr yqr' vtvshyh yr'h shmkh shm'v mth vmy y'dh
verses.translation: The LORD’s voice crieth unto the city, and the man of wisdom shall see thy name: hear ye the rod, and who hath appointed it.

verses.original: ע֗וֹד הַ/אִשׁ֙ בֵּ֣ית רָשָׁ֔ע אֹצְר֖וֹת רֶ֑שַׁע וְ/אֵיפַ֥ת רָז֖וֹן זְעוּמָֽה
verses.translit: 'vd h'sh byt rsh' 'tsrvt rsh' v'ypt rzvn z'vmh
verses.translation: Are there yet the treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and the scant measure that is abominable?

verses.original: הַ/אֶזְכֶּ֖ה בְּ/מֹ֣אזְנֵי רֶ֑שַׁע וּ/בְ/כִ֖יס אַבְנֵ֥י מִרְמָֽה
verses.translit: h'zkhh bm'zny rsh' vbkhys 'bny mrmh
verses.translation: Shall I count them pure with the wicked balances, and with the bag of deceitful weights?

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר עֲשִׁירֶ֨י/הָ֙ מָלְא֣וּ חָמָ֔ס וְ/יֹשְׁבֶ֖י/הָ דִּבְּרוּ שָׁ֑קֶר וּ/לְשׁוֹנָ֖/ם רְמִיָּ֥ה בְּ/פִי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: 'shr 'shyryh ml'v chms vyshbyh dbrv shqr vlshvnm rmyh bpyhm
verses.translation: For the rich men thereof are full of violence, and the inhabitants thereof have spoken lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their mouth.

verses.original: וְ/גַם אֲנִ֖י הֶחֱלֵ֣יתִי הַכּוֹתֶ֑/ךָ הַשְׁמֵ֖ם עַל חַטֹּאתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vgm 'ny hchlyty hkhvtkh hshmm 'l cht'tkh
verses.translation: Therefore also will I make thee sick in smiting thee, in making thee desolate because of thy sins.

verses.original: אַתָּ֤ה תֹאכַל֙ וְ/לֹ֣א תִשְׂבָּ֔ע וְ/יֶשְׁחֲ/ךָ֖ בְּ/קִרְבֶּ֑/ךָ וְ/תַסֵּג֙ וְ/לֹ֣א תַפְלִ֔יט וַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר תְּפַלֵּ֖ט לַ/חֶ֥רֶב אֶתֵּֽן
verses.translit: 'th t'khl vl' tshb' vyshchkh bqrbkh vtsg vl' tplyt v'shr tplt lchrb 'tn
verses.translation: Thou shalt eat, but not be satisfied; and thy casting down shall be in the midst of thee; and thou shalt take hold, but shalt not deliver; and that which thou deliverest will I give up to the sword.

verses.original: אַתָּ֥ה תִזְרַ֖ע וְ/לֹ֣א תִקְצ֑וֹר אַתָּ֤ה תִדְרֹֽךְ זַ֨יִת֙ וְ/לֹא תָס֣וּךְ שֶׁ֔מֶן וְ/תִיר֖וֹשׁ וְ/לֹ֥א תִשְׁתֶּה יָּֽיִן
verses.translit: 'th tzr' vl' tqtsvr 'th tdrkh zyt vl' tsvkh shmn vtyrvsh vl' tshth yyn
verses.translation: Thou shalt sow, but thou shalt not reap; thou shalt tread the olives, but thou shalt not anoint thee with oil; and sweet wine, but shalt not drink wine.

verses.original: וְ/יִשְׁתַּמֵּ֞ר חֻקּ֣וֹת עָמְרִ֗י וְ/כֹל֙ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה בֵית אַחְאָ֔ב וַ/תֵּלְכ֖וּ בְּ/מֹֽעֲצוֹתָ֑/ם לְמַעַן֩ תִּתִּ֨/י אֹתְ/ךָ֜ לְ/שַׁמָּ֗ה וְ/יֹשְׁבֶ֨י/הָ֙ לִ/שְׁרֵקָ֔ה וְ/חֶרְפַּ֥ת עַמִּ֖/י תִּשָּֽׂאוּ
verses.translit: vyshtmr chqvt 'mry vkhl m'shh byt 'ch'b vtlkhv bm'tsvtm lm'n tty 'tkh lshmh vyshbyh lshrqh vchrpt 'my tsh'v
verses.translation: For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of the house of Ahab, and ye walk in their counsels; that I should make thee a desolation, and the inhabitants thereof an hissing: therefore ye shall bear the reproach of my people.

verses.original: אַ֣לְלַי לִ֗/י כִּ֤י הָיִ֨יתִי֙ כְּ/אָסְפֵּי קַ֔יִץ כְּ/עֹלְלֹ֖ת בָּצִ֑יר אֵין אֶשְׁכּ֣וֹל לֶ/אֱכ֔וֹל בִּכּוּרָ֖ה אִוְּתָ֥ה נַפְשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: 'lly ly khy hyyty kh'spy qyts kh'llt btsyr 'yn 'shkhvl l'khvl bkhvrh 'vth npshy
verses.translation: Woe is me! for I am as when they have gathered the summer fruits, as the grapegleanings of the vintage: there is no cluster to eat: my soul desired the firstripe fruit.

verses.original: אָבַ֤ד חָסִיד֙ מִן הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/יָשָׁ֥ר בָּ/אָדָ֖ם אָ֑יִן כֻּלָּ/ם֙ לְ/דָמִ֣ים יֶאֱרֹ֔בוּ אִ֥ישׁ אֶת אָחִ֖י/הוּ יָצ֥וּדוּ חֵֽרֶם
verses.translit: 'bd chsyd mn h'rts vyshr b'dm 'yn khlm ldmym y'rbv 'ysh 't 'chyhv ytsvdv chrm
verses.translation: The good man is perished out of the earth: and there is none upright among men: they all lie in wait for blood; they hunt every man his brother with a net.

verses.original: עַל הָ/רַ֤ע כַּפַּ֨יִם֙ לְ/הֵיטִ֔יב הַ/שַּׂ֣ר שֹׁאֵ֔ל וְ/הַ/שֹּׁפֵ֖ט בַּ/שִׁלּ֑וּם וְ/הַ/גָּד֗וֹל דֹּבֵ֨ר הַוַּ֥ת נַפְשׁ֛/וֹ ה֖וּא וַֽ/יְעַבְּתֽוּ/הָ
verses.translit: 'l hr' khpym lhytyb hshr sh'l vhshpt bshlvm vhgdvl dbr hvt npshv hv' vy'btvh
verses.translation: That they may do evil with both hands earnestly, the prince asketh, and the judge asketh for a reward; and the great man , he uttereth his mischievous desire: so they wrap it up.

verses.original: טוֹבָ֣/ם כְּ/חֵ֔דֶק יָשָׁ֖ר מִ/מְּסוּכָ֑ה י֤וֹם מְצַפֶּ֨י/ךָ֙ פְּקֻדָּתְ/ךָ֣ בָ֔אָה עַתָּ֥ה תִהְיֶ֖ה מְבוּכָתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: tvbm khchdq yshr mmsvkhh yvm mtspykh pqdtkh b'h 'th thyh mbvkhtm
verses.translation: The best of them is as a brier: the most upright is sharper than a thorn hedge: the day of thy watchmen and thy visitation cometh; now shall be their perplexity.

verses.original: אַל תַּאֲמִ֣ינוּ בְ/רֵ֔עַ אַֽל תִּבְטְח֖וּ בְּ/אַלּ֑וּף מִ/שֹּׁכֶ֣בֶת חֵיקֶ֔/ךָ שְׁמֹ֖ר פִּתְחֵי פִֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: 'l t'mynv br' 'l tbtchv b'lvf mshkhbt chyqkh shmr ptchy pykh
verses.translation: Trust ye not in a friend, put ye not confidence in a guide: keep the doors of thy mouth from her that lieth in thy bosom.

verses.original: כִּֽי בֵן֙ מְנַבֵּ֣ל אָ֔ב בַּ֚ת קָמָ֣ה בְ/אִמָּ֔/הּ כַּלָּ֖ה בַּ/חֲמֹתָ֑/הּ אֹיְבֵ֥י אִ֖ישׁ אַנְשֵׁ֥י בֵיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy bn mnbl 'b bt qmh b'mh khlh bchmth 'yby 'ysh 'nshy bytv
verses.translation: For the son dishonoureth the father, the daughter riseth up against her mother, the daughter in law against her mother in law; a man’s enemies are the men of his own house.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִי֙ בַּ/יהוָ֣ה אֲצַפֶּ֔ה אוֹחִ֖ילָה לֵ/אלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעִ֑/י יִשְׁמָעֵ֖/נִי אֱלֹהָֽ/י
verses.translit: v'ny byhvh 'tsph 'vchylh l'lhy ysh'y yshm'ny 'lhy
verses.translation: Therefore I will look unto the LORD ; I will wait for the God of my salvation: my God will hear me.

verses.original: אַֽל תִּשְׂמְחִ֤י אֹיַ֨בְתִּ/י֙ לִ֔/י כִּ֥י נָפַ֖לְתִּי קָ֑מְתִּי כִּֽי אֵשֵׁ֣ב בַּ/חֹ֔שֶׁךְ יְהוָ֖ה א֥וֹר לִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'l tshmchy 'ybty ly khy nplty qmty khy 'shb bchshkh yhvh 'vr ly
verses.translation: Rejoice not against me, O mine enemy: when I fall, I shall arise; when I sit in darkness, the LORD shall be a light unto me.

verses.original: זַ֤עַף יְהוָה֙ אֶשָּׂ֔א כִּ֥י חָטָ֖אתִי ל֑/וֹ עַד֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָרִ֤יב רִיבִ/י֙ וְ/עָשָׂ֣ה מִשְׁפָּטִ֔/י יוֹצִיאֵ֣/נִי לָ/א֔וֹר אֶרְאֶ֖ה בְּ/צִדְקָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: z'f yhvh 'sh' khy cht'ty lv 'd 'shr yryb ryby v'shh mshpty yvtsy'ny l'vr 'r'h btsdqtv
verses.translation: I will bear the indignation of the LORD , because I have sinned against him, until he plead my cause, and execute judgment for me: he will bring me forth to the light, and I shall behold his righteousness.

verses.original: וְ/תֵרֶ֤א אֹיַ֨בְתִּ/י֙ וּ/תְכַסֶּ֣/הָ בוּשָׁ֔ה הָ/אֹמְרָ֣ה אֵלַ֔/י אַיּ֖/וֹ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יִ/ךְ עֵינַ/י֙ תִּרְאֶ֣ינָּה בָּ֔/הּ עַתָּ֛ה תִּֽהְיֶ֥ה לְ/מִרְמָ֖ס כְּ/טִ֥יט חוּצֽוֹת
verses.translit: vtr' 'ybty vtkhsh bvshh h'mrh 'ly 'yv yhvh 'lhykh 'yny tr'ynh bh 'th thyh lmrms khtyt chvtsvt
verses.translation: Then she that is mine enemy shall see it , and shame shall cover her which said unto me, Where is the LORD thy God? mine eyes shall behold her: now shall she be trodden down as the mire of the streets.

verses.original: י֖וֹם לִ/בְנ֣וֹת גְּדֵרָ֑יִ/ךְ י֥וֹם הַ/ה֖וּא יִרְחַק חֹֽק
verses.translit: yvm lbnvt gdrykh yvm hhv' yrchq chq
verses.translation: In the day that thy walls are to be built, in that day shall the decree be far removed.

verses.original: י֥וֹם הוּא֙ וְ/עָדֶ֣י/ךָ יָב֔וֹא לְ/מִנִּ֥י אַשּׁ֖וּר וְ/עָרֵ֣י מָצ֑וֹר וּ/לְ/מִנִּ֤י מָצוֹר֙ וְ/עַד נָהָ֔ר וְ/יָ֥ם מִ/יָּ֖ם וְ/הַ֥ר הָ/הָֽר
verses.translit: yvm hv' v'dykh ybv' lmny 'shvr v'ry mtsvr vlmny mtsvr v'd nhr vym mym vhr hhr
verses.translation: In that day also he shall come even to thee from Assyria, and from the fortified cities, and from the fortress even to the river, and from sea to sea, and from mountain to mountain.

verses.original: וְ/הָיְתָ֥ה הָ/אָ֛רֶץ לִ/שְׁמָמָ֖ה עַל יֹֽשְׁבֶ֑י/הָ מִ/פְּרִ֖י מַֽעַלְלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vhyth h'rts lshmmh 'l yshbyh mpry m'llyhm
verses.translation: Notwithstanding the land shall be desolate because of them that dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings.

verses.original: רְעֵ֧ה עַמְּ/ךָ֣ בְ/שִׁבְטֶ֗/ךָ צֹ֚אן נַֽחֲלָתֶ֔/ךָ שֹׁכְנִ֣י לְ/בָדָ֔ד יַ֖עַר בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ כַּרְמֶ֑ל יִרְע֥וּ בָשָׁ֛ן וְ/גִלְעָ֖ד כִּ/ימֵ֥י עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: r'h 'mkh bshbtkh ts'n nchltkh shkhny lbdd y'r btvkh khrml yr'v bshn vgl'd khymy 'vlm
verses.translation: Feed thy people with thy rod, the flock of thine heritage, which dwell solitarily in the wood, in the midst of Carmel: let them feed in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.

verses.original: כִּ/ימֵ֥י צֵאתְ/ךָ֖ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אַרְאֶ֖/נּוּ נִפְלָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: khymy ts'tkh m'rts mtsrym 'r'nv npl'vt
verses.translation: According to the days of thy coming out of the land of Egypt will I shew unto him marvellous things .

verses.original: יִרְא֤וּ גוֹיִם֙ וְ/יֵבֹ֔שׁוּ מִ/כֹּ֖ל גְּבֽוּרָתָ֑/ם יָשִׂ֤ימוּ יָד֙ עַל פֶּ֔ה אָזְנֵי/הֶ֖ם תֶּחֱרַֽשְׁנָה
verses.translit: yr'v gvym vybshv mkhl gbvrtm yshymv yd 'l ph 'znyhm tchrshnh
verses.translation: The nations shall see and be confounded at all their might: they shall lay their hand upon their mouth, their ears shall be deaf.

verses.original: יְלַחֲכ֤וּ עָפָר֙ כַּ/נָּחָ֔שׁ כְּ/זֹחֲלֵ֣י אֶ֔רֶץ יִרְגְּז֖וּ מִ/מִּסְגְּרֹֽתֵי/הֶ֑ם אֶל יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֨י/נוּ֙ יִפְחָ֔דוּ וְ/יִֽרְא֖וּ מִמֶּֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: ylchkhv 'pr khnchsh khzchly 'rts yrgzv mmsgrtyhm 'l yhvh 'lhynv ypchdv vyr'v mmkh
verses.translation: They shall lick the dust like a serpent, they shall move out of their holes like worms of the earth: they shall be afraid of the LORD our God, and shall fear because of thee.

verses.original: מִי אֵ֣ל כָּמ֗וֹ/ךָ נֹשֵׂ֤א עָוֺן֙ וְ/עֹבֵ֣ר עַל פֶּ֔שַׁע לִ/שְׁאֵרִ֖ית נַחֲלָת֑/וֹ לֹא הֶחֱזִ֤יק לָ/עַד֙ אַפּ֔/וֹ כִּֽי חָפֵ֥ץ חֶ֖סֶד הֽוּא
verses.translit: my 'l khmvkh nsh' 'vn v'br 'l psh' lsh'ryt nchltv l' hchzyq l'd 'pv khy chpts chsd hv'
verses.translation: Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity, and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in mercy.

verses.original: יָשׁ֣וּב יְרַֽחֲמֵ֔/נוּ יִכְבֹּ֖שׁ עֲוֺֽנֹתֵ֑י/נוּ וְ/תַשְׁלִ֛יךְ בִּ/מְצֻל֥וֹת יָ֖ם כָּל חַטֹּאותָֽ/ם
verses.translit: yshvb yrchmnv ykhbsh 'vntynv vtshlykh bmtslvt ym khl cht'vtm
verses.translation: He will turn again, he will have compassion upon us; he will subdue our iniquities; and thou wilt cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.

verses.original: תִּתֵּ֤ן אֱמֶת֙ לְ/יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב חֶ֖סֶד לְ/אַבְרָהָ֑ם אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתָּ לַ/אֲבֹתֵ֖י/נוּ מִ֥/ימֵי קֶֽדֶם
verses.translit: ttn 'mt ly'qb chsd l'brhm 'shr nshb't l'btynv mymy qdm
verses.translation: Thou wilt perform the truth to Jacob, and the mercy to Abraham, which thou hast sworn unto our fathers from the days of old.

verses.original: מַשָּׂ֖א נִֽינְוֵ֑ה סֵ֧פֶר חֲז֛וֹן נַח֖וּם הָ/אֶלְקֹשִֽׁי
verses.translit: msh' nynvh spr chzvn nchvm h'lqshy
verses.translation: The burden of Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.
