verses.original: אֵ֣ל קַנּ֤וֹא וְ/נֹקֵם֙ יְהוָ֔ה נֹקֵ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה וּ/בַ֣עַל חֵמָ֑ה נֹקֵ֤ם יְהוָה֙ לְ/צָרָ֔י/ו וְ/נוֹטֵ֥ר ה֖וּא לְ/אֹיְבָֽי/ו
verses.translit: 'l qnv' vnqm yhvh nqm yhvh vb'l chmh nqm yhvh ltsryv vnvtr hv' l'ybyv
verses.translation: God is jealous, and the LORD revengeth; the LORD revengeth, and is furious; the LORD will take vengeance on his adversaries, and he reserveth wrath for his enemies. is a jealous God, and a revenger, etc

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֗ה אֶ֤רֶךְ אַפַּ֨יִם֙ ו/גדול וּ/גְדָל כֹּ֔חַ וְ/נַקֵּ֖ה לֹ֣א יְנַקֶּ֑ה יְהוָ֗ה בְּ/סוּפָ֤ה וּ/בִ/שְׂעָרָה֙ דַּרְכּ֔/וֹ וְ/עָנָ֖ן אֲבַ֥ק רַגְלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: yhvh 'rkh 'pym vgdvl vgdl khch vnqh l' ynqh yhvh bsvph vbsh'rh drkhv v'nn 'bq rglyv
verses.translation: The LORD is slow to anger, and great in power, and will not at all acquit the wicked: the LORD hath his way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet.

verses.original: גּוֹעֵ֤ר בַּ/יָּם֙ וַֽ/יַּבְּשֵׁ֔/הוּ וְ/כָל הַ/נְּהָר֖וֹת הֶֽחֱרִ֑יב אֻמְלַ֤ל בָּשָׁן֙ וְ/כַרְמֶ֔ל וּ/פֶ֥רַח לְבָנ֖וֹן אֻמְלָֽל
verses.translit: gv'r bym vybshhv vkhl hnhrvt hchryb 'mll bshn vkhrml vprch lbnvn 'mll
verses.translation: He rebuketh the sea, and maketh it dry, and drieth up all the rivers: Bashan languisheth, and Carmel, and the flower of Lebanon languisheth.

verses.original: הָרִים֙ רָעֲשׁ֣וּ מִמֶּ֔/נּוּ וְ/הַ/גְּבָע֖וֹת הִתְמֹגָ֑גוּ וַ/תִּשָּׂ֤א הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ מִ/פָּנָ֔י/ו וְ/תֵבֵ֖ל וְ/כָל יֹ֥שְׁבֵי בָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: hrym r'shv mmnv vhgb'vt htmggv vtsh' h'rts mpnyv vtbl vkhl yshby bh
verses.translation: The mountains quake at him, and the hills melt, and the earth is burned at his presence, yea, the world, and all that dwell therein.

verses.original: לִ/פְנֵ֤י זַעְמ/וֹ֙ מִ֣י יַֽעֲמ֔וֹד וּ/מִ֥י יָק֖וּם בַּ/חֲר֣וֹן אַפּ֑/וֹ חֲמָת/וֹ֙ נִתְּכָ֣ה כָ/אֵ֔שׁ וְ/הַ/צֻּרִ֖ים נִתְּצ֥וּ מִמֶּֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: lpny z'mv my y'mvd vmy yqvm bchrvn 'pv chmtv ntkhh kh'sh vhtsrym nttsv mmnv
verses.translation: Who can stand before his indignation? and who can abide in the fierceness of his anger? his fury is poured out like fire, and the rocks are thrown down by him.

verses.original: ט֣וֹב יְהוָ֔ה לְ/מָע֖וֹז בְּ/י֣וֹם צָרָ֑ה וְ/יֹדֵ֖עַ חֹ֥סֵי בֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: tvb yhvh lm'vz byvm tsrh vyd' chsy bv
verses.translation: The LORD is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/שֶׁ֣טֶף עֹבֵ֔ר כָּלָ֖ה יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה מְקוֹמָ֑/הּ וְ/אֹיְבָ֖י/ו יְרַדֶּף חֹֽשֶׁךְ
verses.translit: vbshtf 'br khlh y'shh mqvmh v'ybyv yrdf chshkh
verses.translation: But with an overrunning flood he will make an utter end of the place thereof, and darkness shall pursue his enemies.

verses.original: מַה תְּחַשְּׁבוּ/ן֙ אֶל יְהוָ֔ה כָּלָ֖ה ה֣וּא עֹשֶׂ֑ה לֹֽא תָק֥וּם פַּעֲמַ֖יִם צָרָֽה
verses.translit: mh tchshbvn 'l yhvh khlh hv' 'shh l' tqvm p'mym tsrh
verses.translation: What do ye imagine against the LORD ? he will make an utter end: affliction shall not rise up the second time.

verses.original: כִּ֚י עַד סִירִ֣ים סְבֻכִ֔ים וּ/כְ/סָבְאָ֖/ם סְבוּאִ֑ים אֻ֨כְּל֔וּ כְּ/קַ֥שׁ יָבֵ֖שׁ מָלֵֽא
verses.translit: khy 'd syrym sbkhym vkhsb'm sbv'ym 'khlv khqsh ybsh ml'
verses.translation: For while they be folden together as thorns, and while they are drunken as drunkards, they shall be devoured as stubble fully dry.

verses.original: מִמֵּ֣/ךְ יָצָ֔א חֹשֵׁ֥ב עַל יְהוָ֖ה רָעָ֑ה יֹעֵ֖ץ בְּלִיָּֽעַל
verses.translit: mmkh yts' chshb 'l yhvh r'h y'ts bly'l
verses.translation: There is one come out of thee, that imagineth evil against the LORD , a wicked counsellor.

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אִם שְׁלֵמִים֙ וְ/כֵ֣ן רַבִּ֔ים וְ/כֵ֥ן נָגֹ֖זּוּ וְ/עָבָ֑ר וְ/עִ֨נִּתִ֔/ךְ לֹ֥א אֲעַנֵּ֖/ךְ עֽוֹד
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'm shlmym vkhn rbym vkhn ngzv v'br v'ntkh l' ''nkh 'vd
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD ; Though they be quiet, and likewise many, yet thus shall they be cut down, when he shall pass through. Though I have afflicted thee, I will afflict thee no more.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֕ה אֶשְׁבֹּ֥ר מֹטֵ֖/הוּ מֵֽ/עָלָ֑יִ/ךְ וּ/מוֹסְרֹתַ֖יִ/ךְ אֲנַתֵּֽק
verses.translit: v'th 'shbr mthv m'lykh vmvsrtykh 'ntq
verses.translation: For now will I break his yoke from off thee, and will burst thy bonds in sunder.

verses.original: וְ/צִוָּ֤ה עָלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ יְהוָ֔ה לֹֽא יִזָּרַ֥ע מִ/שִּׁמְ/ךָ֖ ע֑וֹד מִ/בֵּ֨ית אֱלֹהֶ֜י/ךָ אַכְרִ֨ית פֶּ֧סֶל וּ/מַסֵּכָ֛ה אָשִׂ֥ים קִבְרֶ֖/ךָ כִּ֥י קַלּֽוֹתָ
verses.translit: vtsvh 'lykh yhvh l' yzr' mshmkh 'vd mbyt 'lhykh 'khryt psl vmskhh 'shym qbrkh khy qlvt
verses.translation: And the LORD hath given a commandment concerning thee, that no more of thy name be sown: out of the house of thy gods will I cut off the graven image and the molten image: I will make thy grave; for thou art vile.

Behold upon the mountains the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace! O Judah, keep thy solemn feasts, perform thy vows: for the wicked shall no more pass through thee; he is utterly cut off.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֨ה עַל הֶ/הָרִ֜ים רַגְלֵ֤י מְבַשֵּׂר֙ מַשְׁמִ֣יעַ שָׁל֔וֹם חָגִּ֧י יְהוּדָ֛ה חַגַּ֖יִ/ךְ שַׁלְּמִ֣י נְדָרָ֑יִ/ךְ כִּי֩ לֹ֨א יוֹסִ֥יף ע֛וֹד ל/עבור לַֽ/עֲבָר בָּ֥/ךְ בְּלִיַּ֖עַל כֻּלֹּ֥/ה נִכְרָֽת
verses.translit: hnh 'l hhrym rgly mbshr mshmy' shlvm chgy yhvdh chgykh shlmy ndrykh khy l' yvsyf 'vd l'bvr l'br bkh bly'l khlh nkhrt
verses.translation: He that dasheth in pieces is come up before thy face: keep the munition, watch the way, make thy loins strong, fortify thy power mightily.

verses.original: עָלָ֥ה מֵפִ֛יץ עַל פָּנַ֖יִ/ךְ נָצ֣וֹר מְצֻרָ֑ה צַפֵּה דֶ֨רֶךְ֙ חַזֵּ֣ק מָתְנַ֔יִם אַמֵּ֥ץ כֹּ֖חַ מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: 'lh mpyts 'l pnykh ntsvr mtsrh tsph drkh chzq mtnym 'mts khch m'd
verses.translation: For the LORD hath turned away the excellency of Jacob, as the excellency of Israel: for the emptiers have emptied them out, and marred their vine branches.

verses.original: כִּ֣י שָׁ֤ב יְהוָה֙ אֶת גְּא֣וֹן יַעֲקֹ֔ב כִּ/גְא֖וֹן יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֤י בְקָקוּ/ם֙ בֹּֽקְקִ֔ים וּ/זְמֹרֵי/הֶ֖ם שִׁחֵֽתוּ
verses.translit: khy shb yhvh 't g'vn y'qb khg'vn yshr'l khy bqqvm bqqym vzmryhm shchtv
verses.translation: The shield of his mighty men is made red, the valiant men are in scarlet: the chariots shall be with flaming torches in the day of his preparation, and the fir trees shall be terribly shaken.

verses.original: מָגֵ֨ן גִּבֹּרֵ֜י/הוּ מְאָדָּ֗ם אַנְשֵׁי חַ֨יִל֙ מְתֻלָּעִ֔ים בְּ/אֵשׁ פְּלָד֥וֹת הָ/רֶ֖כֶב בְּ/י֣וֹם הֲכִינ֑/וֹ וְ/הַ/בְּרֹשִׁ֖ים הָרְעָֽלוּ
verses.translit: mgn gbryhv m'dm 'nshy chyl mtl'ym b'sh pldvt hrkhb byvm hkhynv vhbrshym hr'lv
verses.translation: The chariots shall rage in the streets, they shall justle one against another in the broad ways: they shall seem like torches, they shall run like the lightnings.

verses.original: בַּֽ/חוּצוֹת֙ יִתְהוֹלְל֣וּ הָ/רֶ֔כֶב יִֽשְׁתַּקְשְׁק֖וּ/ן בָּ/רְחֹב֑וֹת מַרְאֵי/הֶן֙ כַּ/לַּפִּידִ֔ם כַּ/בְּרָקִ֖ים יְרוֹצֵֽצוּ
verses.translit: bchvtsvt ythvllv hrkhb yshtqshqvn brchbvt mr'yhn khlpydm khbrqym yrvtstsv
verses.translation: He shall recount his worthies: they shall stumble in their walk; they shall make haste to the wall thereof, and the defence shall be prepared.

verses.original: יִזְכֹּר֙ אַדִּירָ֔י/ו יִכָּשְׁל֖וּ ב/הלכות/ם בַּ/הֲלִֽיכָתָ֑/ם יְמַֽהֲרוּ֙ חֽוֹמָתָ֔/הּ וְ/הֻכַ֖ן הַ/סֹּכֵֽךְ
verses.translit: yzkhr 'dyryv ykhshlv bhlkhvtm bhlykhtm ymhrv chvmth vhkhn hskhkh
verses.translation: The gates of the rivers shall be opened, and the palace shall be dissolved.

verses.original: שַׁעֲרֵ֥י הַ/נְּהָר֖וֹת נִפְתָּ֑חוּ וְ/הַֽ/הֵיכָ֖ל נָמֽוֹג
verses.translit: sh'ry hnhrvt nptchv vhhykhl nmvg
verses.translation: And Huzzab shall be led away captive, she shall be brought up, and her maids shall lead her as with the voice of doves, tabering upon their breasts.

verses.original: וְ/הֻצַּ֖ב גֻּלְּתָ֣ה הֹֽעֲלָ֑תָה וְ/אַמְהֹתֶ֗י/הָ מְנַֽהֲגוֹת֙ כְּ/ק֣וֹל יוֹנִ֔ים מְתֹפְפֹ֖ת עַל לִבְבֵ/הֶֽן
verses.translit: vhtsb glth h'lth v'mhtyh mnhgvt khqvl yvnym mtppt 'l lbbhn
verses.translation: But Nineveh is of old like a pool of water: yet they shall flee away. Stand, stand, shall they cry; but none shall look back.

verses.original: וְ/נִינְוֵ֥ה כִ/בְרֵֽכַת מַ֖יִם מִ֣/ימֵי הִ֑יא וְ/הֵ֣מָּה נָסִ֔ים עִמְד֥וּ עֲמֹ֖דוּ וְ/אֵ֥ין מַפְנֶֽה
verses.translit: vnynvh khbrkht mym mymy hy' vhmh nsym 'mdv 'mdv v'yn mpnh
verses.translation: Take ye the spoil of silver, take the spoil of gold: for there is none end of the store and glory out of all the pleasant furniture.

verses.original: בֹּ֥זּוּ כֶ֖סֶף בֹּ֣זּוּ זָהָ֑ב וְ/אֵ֥ין קֵ֨צֶה֙ לַ/תְּכוּנָ֔ה כָּבֹ֕ד מִ/כֹּ֖ל כְּלִ֥י חֶמְדָּֽה
verses.translit: bzv khsf bzv zhb v'yn qtsh ltkhvnh khbd mkhl khly chmdh
verses.translation: She is empty, and void, and waste: and the heart melteth, and the knees smite together, and much pain is in all loins, and the faces of them all gather blackness.

verses.original: בּוּקָ֥ה וּ/מְבוּקָ֖ה וּ/מְבֻלָּקָ֑ה וְ/לֵ֨ב נָמֵ֜ס וּ/פִ֣ק בִּרְכַּ֗יִם וְ/חַלְחָלָה֙ בְּ/כָל מָתְנַ֔יִם וּ/פְנֵ֥י כֻלָּ֖/ם קִבְּצ֥וּ פָארֽוּר
verses.translit: bvqh vmbvqh vmblqh vlb nms vpq brkhym vchlchlh bkhl mtnym vpny khlm qbtsv p'rvr
verses.translation: Where is the dwelling of the lions, and the feedingplace of the young lions, where the lion, even the old lion, walked, and the lion’s whelp, and none made them afraid?

verses.original: אַיֵּה֙ מְע֣וֹן אֲרָי֔וֹת וּ/מִרְעֶ֥ה ה֖וּא לַ/כְּפִרִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָלַךְ֩ אַרְיֵ֨ה לָבִ֥יא שָׁ֛ם גּ֥וּר אַרְיֵ֖ה וְ/אֵ֥ין מַחֲרִֽיד
verses.translit: 'yh m'vn 'ryvt vmr'h hv' lkhprym 'shr hlkh 'ryh lby' shm gvr 'ryh v'yn mchryd
verses.translation: The lion did tear in pieces enough for his whelps, and strangled for his lionesses, and filled his holes with prey, and his dens with ravin.

verses.original: אַרְיֵ֤ה טֹרֵף֙ בְּ/דֵ֣י גֹֽרוֹתָ֔י/ו וּ/מְחַנֵּ֖ק לְ/לִבְאֹתָ֑י/ו וַ/יְמַלֵּא טֶ֣רֶף חֹרָ֔י/ו וּ/מְעֹֽנֹתָ֖י/ו טְרֵפָֽה
verses.translit: 'ryh trf bdy grvtyv vmchnq llb'tyv vyml' trf chryv vm'ntyv trph
verses.translation: Behold, I am against thee, saith the LORD of hosts, and I will burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword shall devour thy young lions: and I will cut off thy prey from the earth, and the voice of thy messengers shall no more be heard.

verses.original: ה֖וֹי עִ֣יר דָּמִ֑ים כֻּלָּ֗/הּ כַּ֤חַשׁ פֶּ֨רֶק֙ מְלֵאָ֔ה לֹ֥א יָמִ֖ישׁ טָֽרֶף
verses.translit: hvy 'yr dmym khlh khchsh prq ml'h l' ymysh trf
verses.translation: Woe to the bloody city! it is all full of lies and robbery; the prey departeth not;

verses.original: ק֣וֹל שׁ֔וֹט וְ/ק֖וֹל רַ֣עַשׁ אוֹפָ֑ן וְ/ס֣וּס דֹּהֵ֔ר וּ/מֶרְכָּבָ֖ה מְרַקֵּדָֽה
verses.translit: qvl shvt vqvl r'sh 'vpn vsvs dhr vmrkhbh mrqdh
verses.translation: The noise of a whip, and the noise of the rattling of the wheels, and of the pransing horses, and of the jumping chariots.

verses.original: פָּרָ֣שׁ מַעֲלֶ֗ה וְ/לַ֤הַב חֶ֨רֶב֙ וּ/בְרַ֣ק חֲנִ֔ית וְ/רֹ֥ב חָלָ֖ל וְ/כֹ֣בֶד פָּ֑גֶר וְ/אֵ֥ין קֵ֨צֶה֙ לַ/גְּוִיָּ֔ה יכשלו וְ/כָשְׁל֖וּ בִּ/גְוִיָּתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: prsh m'lh vlhb chrb vbrq chnyt vrb chll vkhbd pgr v'yn qtsh lgvyh ykhshlv vkhshlv bgvytm
verses.translation: The horseman lifteth up both the bright sword and the glittering spear: and there is a multitude of slain, and a great number of carcases; and there is none end of their corpses; they stumble upon their corpses:

verses.original: מֵ/רֹב֙ זְנוּנֵ֣י זוֹנָ֔ה ט֥וֹבַת חֵ֖ן בַּעֲלַ֣ת כְּשָׁפִ֑ים הַ/מֹּכֶ֤רֶת גּוֹיִם֙ בִּ/זְנוּנֶ֔י/הָ וּ/מִשְׁפָּח֖וֹת בִּ/כְשָׁפֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: mrb znvny zvnh tvbt chn b'lt khshpym hmkhrt gvym bznvnyh vmshpchvt bkhshpyh
verses.translation: Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot, the mistress of witchcrafts, that selleth nations through her whoredoms, and families through her witchcrafts.

verses.original: הִנְ/נִ֣י אֵלַ֗יִ/ךְ נְאֻם֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וְ/גִלֵּיתִ֥י שׁוּלַ֖יִ/ךְ עַל פָּנָ֑יִ/ךְ וְ/הַרְאֵיתִ֤י גוֹיִם֙ מַעְרֵ֔/ךְ וּ/מַמְלָכ֖וֹת קְלוֹנֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: hnny 'lykh n'm yhvh tsb'vt vglyty shvlykh 'l pnykh vhr'yty gvym m'rkh vmmlkhvt qlvnkh
verses.translation: Behold, I am against thee, saith the LORD of hosts; and I will discover thy skirts upon thy face, and I will shew the nations thy nakedness, and the kingdoms thy shame.

verses.original: וְ/הִשְׁלַכְתִּ֥י עָלַ֛יִ/ךְ שִׁקֻּצִ֖ים וְ/נִבַּלְתִּ֑י/ךְ וְ/שַׂמְתִּ֖י/ךְ כְּ/רֹֽאִי
verses.translit: vhshlkhty 'lykh shqtsym vnbltykh vshmtykh khr'y
verses.translation: And I will cast abominable filth upon thee, and make thee vile, and will set thee as a gazingstock.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֤ה כָל רֹאַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ יִדּ֣וֹד מִמֵּ֔/ךְ וְ/אָמַר֙ שָׁדְּדָ֣ה נִֽינְוֵ֔ה מִ֖י יָנ֣וּד לָ֑/הּ מֵ/אַ֛יִן אֲבַקֵּ֥שׁ מְנַחֲמִ֖ים לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vhyh khl r'ykh ydvd mmkh v'mr shddh nynvh my ynvd lh m'yn 'bqsh mnchmym lkh
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that all they that look upon thee shall flee from thee, and say, Nineveh is laid waste: who will bemoan her? whence shall I seek comforters for thee?

verses.original: הֲ/תֵֽיטְבִי֙ מִ/נֹּ֣א אָמ֔וֹן הַ/יֹּֽשְׁבָה֙ בַּ/יְאֹרִ֔ים מַ֖יִם סָבִ֣יב לָ֑/הּ אֲשֶׁר חֵ֣יל יָ֔ם מִ/יָּ֖ם חוֹמָתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: htytby mn' 'mvn hyshbh by'rym mym sbyb lh 'shr chyl ym mym chvmth
verses.translation: Art thou better than populous No, that was situate among the rivers, that had the waters round about it, whose rampart was the sea, and her wall was from the sea?

verses.original: כּ֥וּשׁ עָצְמָ֛/ה וּ/מִצְרַ֖יִם וְ/אֵ֣ין קֵ֑צֶה פּ֣וּט וְ/לוּבִ֔ים הָי֖וּ בְּ/עֶזְרָתֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: khvsh 'tsmh vmtsrym v'yn qtsh pvt vlvbym hyv b'zrtkh
verses.translation: Ethiopia and Egypt were her strength, and it was infinite; Put and Lubim were thy helpers.

verses.original: גַּם הִ֗יא לַ/גֹּלָה֙ הָלְכָ֣ה בַ/שֶּׁ֔בִי גַּ֧ם עֹלָלֶ֛י/הָ יְרֻטְּשׁ֖וּ בְּ/רֹ֣אשׁ כָּל חוּצ֑וֹת וְ/עַל נִכְבַּדֶּ֨י/הָ֙ יַדּ֣וּ גוֹרָ֔ל וְ/כָל גְּדוֹלֶ֖י/הָ רֻתְּק֥וּ בַ/זִּקִּֽים
verses.translit: gm hy' lglh hlkhh bshby gm 'llyh yrtshv br'sh khl chvtsvt v'l nkhbdyh ydv gvrl vkhl gdvlyh rtqv bzqym
verses.translation: Yet was she carried away, she went into captivity: her young children also were dashed in pieces at the top of all the streets: and they cast lots for her honourable men, and all her great men were bound in chains.

verses.original: גַּם אַ֣תְּ תִּשְׁכְּרִ֔י תְּהִ֖י נַֽעֲלָמָ֑ה גַּם אַ֛תְּ תְּבַקְשִׁ֥י מָע֖וֹז מֵ/אוֹיֵֽב
verses.translit: gm 't tshkhry thy n'lmh gm 't tbqshy m'vz m'vyb
verses.translation: Thou also shalt be drunken: thou shalt be hid, thou also shalt seek strength because of the enemy.

verses.original: כָּ֨ל מִבְצָרַ֔יִ/ךְ תְּאֵנִ֖ים עִם בִּכּוּרִ֑ים אִם יִנּ֕וֹעוּ וְ/נָפְל֖וּ עַל פִּ֥י אוֹכֵֽל
verses.translit: khl mbtsrykh t'nym 'm bkhvrym 'm ynv'v vnplv 'l py 'vkhl
verses.translation: All thy strong holds shall be like fig trees with the firstripe figs: if they be shaken, they shall even fall into the mouth of the eater.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֨ה עַמֵּ֤/ךְ נָשִׁים֙ בְּ/קִרְבֵּ֔/ךְ לְ/אֹ֣יְבַ֔יִ/ךְ פָּת֥וֹחַ נִפְתְּח֖וּ שַׁעֲרֵ֣י אַרְצֵ֑/ךְ אָכְלָ֥ה אֵ֖שׁ בְּרִיחָֽיִ/ך
verses.translit: hnh 'mkh nshym bqrbkh l'ybykh ptvch nptchv sh'ry 'rtskh 'khlh 'sh brychykh
verses.translation: Behold, thy people in the midst of thee are women: the gates of thy land shall be set wide open unto thine enemies: the fire shall devour thy bars.

verses.original: מֵ֤י מָצוֹר֙ שַֽׁאֲבִי לָ֔/ךְ חַזְּקִ֖י מִבְצָרָ֑יִ/ךְ בֹּ֧אִי בַ/טִּ֛יט וְ/רִמְסִ֥י בַ/חֹ֖מֶר הַחֲזִ֥יקִי מַלְבֵּֽן
verses.translit: my mtsvr sh'by lkh chzqy mbtsrykh b'y btyt vrmsy bchmr hchzyqy mlbn
verses.translation: Draw thee waters for the siege, fortify thy strong holds: go into clay, and tread the morter, make strong the brickkiln.

verses.original: שָׁ֚ם תֹּאכְלֵ֣/ךְ אֵ֔שׁ תַּכְרִיתֵ֣/ךְ חֶ֔רֶב תֹּאכְלֵ֖/ךְ כַּ/יָּ֑לֶק הִתְכַּבֵּ֣ד כַּ/יֶּ֔לֶק הִֽתְכַּבְּדִ֖י כָּ/אַרְבֶּֽה
verses.translit: shm t'khlkh 'sh tkhrytkh chrb t'khlkh khylq htkhbd khylq htkhbdy kh'rbh
verses.translation: There shall the fire devour thee; the sword shall cut thee off, it shall eat thee up like the cankerworm: make thyself many as the cankerworm, make thyself many as the locusts.

verses.original: הִרְבֵּית֙ רֹֽכְלַ֔יִ/ךְ מִ/כּוֹכְבֵ֖י הַ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם יֶ֥לֶק פָּשַׁ֖ט וַ/יָּעֹֽף
verses.translit: hrbyt rkhlykh mkhvkhby hshmym ylq psht vy'f
verses.translation: Thou hast multiplied thy merchants above the stars of heaven: the cankerworm spoileth, and flieth away.

verses.original: מִנְּזָרַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ כָּֽ/אַרְבֶּ֔ה וְ/טַפְסְרַ֖יִ/ךְ כְּ/ג֣וֹב גֹּבָ֑י הַֽ/חוֹנִ֤ים בַּ/גְּדֵרוֹת֙ בְּ/י֣וֹם קָרָ֔ה שֶׁ֤מֶשׁ זָֽרְחָה֙ וְ/נוֹדַ֔ד וְ/לֹֽא נוֹדַ֥ע מְקוֹמ֖/וֹ אַיָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: mnzrykh kh'rbh vtpsrykh khgvb gby hchvnym bgdrvt byvm qrh shmsh zrchh vnvdd vl' nvd' mqvmv 'ym
verses.translation: Thy crowned are as the locusts, and thy captains as the great grasshoppers, which camp in the hedges in the cold day, but when the sun ariseth they flee away, and their place is not known where they are .

verses.original: נָמ֤וּ רֹעֶ֨י/ךָ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר יִשְׁכְּנ֖וּ אַדִּירֶ֑י/ךָ נָפֹ֧שׁוּ עַמְּ/ךָ֛ עַל הֶ/הָרִ֖ים וְ/אֵ֥ין מְקַבֵּֽץ
verses.translit: nmv r'ykh mlkh 'shvr yshkhnv 'dyrykh npshv 'mkh 'l hhrym v'yn mqbts
verses.translation: Thy shepherds slumber, O king of Assyria: thy nobles shall dwell in the dust: thy people is scattered upon the mountains, and no man gathereth them .

verses.original: אֵין כֵּהָ֣ה לְ/שִׁבְרֶ֔/ךָ נַחְלָ֖ה מַכָּתֶ֑/ךָ כֹּ֣ל שֹׁמְעֵ֣י שִׁמְעֲ/ךָ֗ תָּ֤קְעוּ כַף֙ עָלֶ֔י/ךָ כִּ֗י עַל מִ֛י לֹֽא עָבְרָ֥ה רָעָתְ/ךָ֖ תָּמִֽיד
verses.translit: 'yn khhh lshbrkh nchlh mkhtkh khl shm'y shm'kh tq'v khf 'lykh khy 'l my l' 'brh r'tkh tmyd
verses.translation: There is no healing of thy bruise; thy wound is grievous: all that hear the bruit of thee shall clap the hands over thee: for upon whom hath not thy wickedness passed continually?

verses.original: הַ/מַּשָׂא֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָזָ֔ה חֲבַקּ֖וּק הַ/נָּבִֽיא
verses.translit: hmsh' 'shr chzh chbqvq hnby'
verses.translation: The burden which Habakkuk the prophet did see.

verses.original: עַד אָ֧נָה יְהוָ֛ה שִׁוַּ֖עְתִּי וְ/לֹ֣א תִשְׁמָ֑ע אֶזְעַ֥ק אֵלֶ֛י/ךָ חָמָ֖ס וְ/לֹ֥א תוֹשִֽׁיעַ
verses.translit: 'd 'nh yhvh shv'ty vl' tshm' 'z'q 'lykh chms vl' tvshy'
verses.translation: O LORD , how long shall I cry, and thou wilt not hear! even cry out unto thee of violence, and thou wilt not save!

verses.original: לָ֣/מָּה תַרְאֵ֤/נִי אָ֨וֶן֙ וְ/עָמָ֣ל תַּבִּ֔יט וְ/שֹׁ֥ד וְ/חָמָ֖ס לְ/נֶגְדִּ֑/י וַ/יְהִ֧י רִ֦יב וּ/מָד֖וֹן יִשָּֽׂא
verses.translit: lmh tr'ny 'vn v'ml tbyt vshd vchms lngdy vyhy ryb vmdvn ysh'
verses.translation: Why dost thou shew me iniquity, and cause me to behold grievance? for spoiling and violence are before me: and there are that raise up strife and contention.

verses.original: עַל כֵּן֙ תָּפ֣וּג תּוֹרָ֔ה וְ/לֹֽא יֵצֵ֥א לָ/נֶ֖צַח מִשְׁפָּ֑ט כִּ֤י רָשָׁע֙ מַכְתִּ֣יר אֶת הַ/צַּדִּ֔יק עַל כֵּ֛ן יֵצֵ֥א מִשְׁפָּ֖ט מְעֻקָּֽל
verses.translit: 'l khn tpvg tvrh vl' yts' lntsch mshpt khy rsh' mkhtyr 't htsdyq 'l khn yts' mshpt m'ql
verses.translation: Therefore the law is slacked, and judgment doth never go forth: for the wicked doth compass about the righteous; therefore wrong judgment proceedeth.

verses.original: רְא֤וּ בַ/גּוֹיִם֙ וְֽ/הַבִּ֔יטוּ וְ/הִֽתַּמְּה֖וּ תְּמָ֑הוּ כִּי פֹ֨עַל֙ פֹּעֵ֣ל בִּֽ/ימֵי/כֶ֔ם לֹ֥א תַאֲמִ֖ינוּ כִּ֥י יְסֻפָּֽר
verses.translit: r'v bgvym vhbytv vhtmhv tmhv khy p'l p'l bymykhm l' t'mynv khy yspr
verses.translation: Behold ye among the heathen, and regard, and wonder marvellously: for I will work a work in your days, which ye will not believe, though it be told you .

verses.original: כִּֽי הִנְ/נִ֤י מֵקִים֙ אֶת הַ/כַּשְׂדִּ֔ים הַ/גּ֖וֹי הַ/מַּ֣ר וְ/הַ/נִּמְהָ֑ר הַֽ/הוֹלֵךְ֙ לְ/מֶרְחֲבֵי אֶ֔רֶץ לָ/רֶ֖שֶׁת מִשְׁכָּנ֥וֹת לֹּא לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy hnny mqym 't hkhshdym hgvy hmr vhnmhr hhvlkh lmrchby 'rts lrsht mshkhnvt l' lv
verses.translation: For, lo, I raise up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation, which shall march through the breadth of the land, to possess the dwellingplaces that are not theirs.

verses.original: אָיֹ֥ם וְ/נוֹרָ֖א ה֑וּא מִמֶּ֕/נּוּ מִשְׁפָּט֥/וֹ וּ/שְׂאֵת֖/וֹ יֵצֵֽא
verses.translit: 'ym vnvr' hv' mmnv mshptv vsh'tv yts'
verses.translation: They are terrible and dreadful: their judgment and their dignity shall proceed of themselves.

verses.original: וְ/קַלּ֨וּ מִ/נְּמֵרִ֜ים סוּסָ֗י/ו וְ/חַדּוּ֙ מִ/זְּאֵ֣בֵי עֶ֔רֶב וּ/פָ֖שׁוּ פָּֽרָשָׁ֑י/ו וּ/פָֽרָשָׁי/ו֙ מֵ/רָח֣וֹק יָבֹ֔אוּ יָעֻ֕פוּ כְּ/נֶ֖שֶׁר חָ֥שׁ לֶ/אֱכֽוֹל
verses.translit: vqlv mnmrym svsyv vchdv mz'by 'rb vpshv prshyv vprshyv mrchvq yb'v y'pv khnshr chsh l'khvl
verses.translation: Their horses also are swifter than the leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves: and their horsemen shall spread themselves, and their horsemen shall come from far; they shall fly as the eagle that hasteth to eat.

verses.original: כֻּלֹּ/ה֙ לְ/חָמָ֣ס יָב֔וֹא מְגַמַּ֥ת פְּנֵי/הֶ֖ם קָדִ֑ימָ/ה וַ/יֶּאֱסֹ֥ף כַּ/ח֖וֹל שֶֽׁבִי
verses.translit: khlh lchms ybv' mgmt pnyhm qdymh vy'sf khchvl shby
verses.translation: They shall come all for violence: their faces shall sup up as the east wind, and they shall gather the captivity as the sand.

verses.original: וְ/הוּא֙ בַּ/מְּלָכִ֣ים יִתְקַלָּ֔ס וְ/רֹזְנִ֖ים מִשְׂחָ֣ק ל֑/וֹ ה֚וּא לְ/כָל מִבְצָ֣ר יִשְׂחָ֔ק וַ/יִּצְבֹּ֥ר עָפָ֖ר וַֽ/יִּלְכְּדָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vhv' bmlkhym ytqls vrznym mshchq lv hv' lkhl mbtsr yshchq vytsbr 'pr vylkhdh
verses.translation: And they shall scoff at the kings, and the princes shall be a scorn unto them: they shall deride every strong hold; for they shall heap dust, and take it.

verses.original: אָ֣ז חָלַ֥ף ר֛וּחַ וַֽ/יַּעֲבֹ֖ר וְ/אָשֵׁ֑ם ז֥וּ כֹח֖/וֹ לֵ/אלֹהֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'z chlf rvch vy'br v'shm zv khchv l'lhv
verses.translation: Then shall his mind change, and he shall pass over, and offend, imputing this his power unto his god.

verses.original: הֲ/ל֧וֹא אַתָּ֣ה מִ/קֶּ֗דֶם יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהַ֛/י קְדֹשִׁ֖/י לֹ֣א נָמ֑וּת יְהוָה֙ לְ/מִשְׁפָּ֣ט שַׂמְתּ֔/וֹ וְ/צ֖וּר לְ/הוֹכִ֥יחַ יְסַדְתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hlv' 'th mqdm yhvh 'lhy qdshy l' nmvt yhvh lmshpt shmtv vtsvr lhvkhych ysdtv
verses.translation: Art thou not from everlasting, O LORD my God, mine Holy One? we shall not die. O LORD , thou hast ordained them for judgment; and, O mighty God, thou hast established them for correction.

verses.original: טְה֤וֹר עֵינַ֨יִם֙ מֵ/רְא֣וֹת רָ֔ע וְ/הַבִּ֥יט אֶל עָמָ֖ל לֹ֣א תוּכָ֑ל לָ֤/מָּה תַבִּיט֙ בּֽוֹגְדִ֔ים תַּחֲרִ֕ישׁ בְּ/בַלַּ֥ע רָשָׁ֖ע צַדִּ֥יק מִמֶּֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: thvr 'ynym mr'vt r' vhbyt 'l 'ml l' tvkhl lmh tbyt bvgdym tchrysh bbl' rsh' tsdyq mmnv
verses.translation: Thou art of purer eyes than to behold evil, and canst not look on iniquity: wherefore lookest thou upon them that deal treacherously, and holdest thy tongue when the wicked devoureth the man that is more righteous than he?

verses.original: וַ/תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אָדָ֖ם כִּ/דְגֵ֣י הַ/יָּ֑ם כְּ/רֶ֖מֶשׂ לֹא מֹשֵׁ֥ל בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vt'shh 'dm khdgy hym khrmsh l' mshl bv
verses.translation: And makest men as the fishes of the sea, as the creeping things, that have no ruler over them?

verses.original: כֻּלֹּ/ה֙ בְּ/חַכָּ֣ה הֵֽעֲלָ֔ה יְגֹרֵ֣/הוּ בְ/חֶרְמ֔/וֹ וְ/יַאַסְפֵ֖/הוּ בְּ/מִכְמַרְתּ֑/וֹ עַל כֵּ֖ן יִשְׂמַ֥ח וְ/יָגִֽיל
verses.translit: khlh bchkhh h'lh ygrhv bchrmv vy'sphv bmkhmrtv 'l khn yshmch vygyl
verses.translation: They take up all of them with the angle, they catch them in their net, and gather them in their drag: therefore they rejoice and are glad.

verses.original: עַל כֵּן֙ יְזַבֵּ֣חַ לְ/חֶרְמ֔/וֹ וִֽ/יקַטֵּ֖ר לְ/מִכְמַרְתּ֑/וֹ כִּ֤י בָ/הֵ֨מָּה֙ שָׁמֵ֣ן חֶלְק֔/וֹ וּ/מַאֲכָל֖/וֹ בְּרִאָֽה
verses.translit: 'l khn yzbch lchrmv vyqtr lmkhmrtv khy bhmh shmn chlqv vm'khlv br'h
verses.translation: Therefore they sacrifice unto their net, and burn incense unto their drag; because by them their portion is fat, and their meat plenteous.

verses.original: הַ֥/עַל כֵּ֖ן יָרִ֣יק חֶרְמ֑/וֹ וְ/תָמִ֛יד לַ/הֲרֹ֥ג גּוֹיִ֖ם לֹ֥א יַחְמֽוֹל
verses.translit: h'l khn yryq chrmv vtmyd lhrg gvym l' ychmvl
verses.translation: Shall they therefore empty their net, and not spare continually to slay the nations?

verses.original: עַל מִשְׁמַרְתִּ֣/י אֶעֱמֹ֔דָה וְ/אֶֽתְיַצְּבָ֖ה עַל מָצ֑וֹר וַ/אֲצַפֶּ֗ה לִ/רְאוֹת֙ מַה יְדַבֶּר בִּ֔/י וּ/מָ֥ה אָשִׁ֖יב עַל תּוֹכַחְתִּֽ/י
verses.translit: 'l mshmrty ''mdh v'tytsbh 'l mtsvr v'tsph lr'vt mh ydbr by vmh 'shyb 'l tvkhchty
verses.translation: I will stand upon my watch, and set me upon the tower, and will watch to see what he will say unto me, and what I shall answer when I am reproved.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲנֵ֤/נִי יְהוָה֙ וַ/יֹּ֔אמֶר כְּת֣וֹב חָז֔וֹן וּ/בָאֵ֖ר עַל הַ/לֻּח֑וֹת לְמַ֥עַן יָר֖וּץ ק֥וֹרֵא בֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'nny yhvh vy'mr khtvb chzvn vb'r 'l hlchvt lm'n yrvts qvr' bv
verses.translation: And the LORD answered me, and said, Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it.

verses.original: כִּ֣י ע֤וֹד חָזוֹן֙ לַ/מּוֹעֵ֔ד וְ/יָפֵ֥חַ לַ/קֵּ֖ץ וְ/לֹ֣א יְכַזֵּ֑ב אִם יִתְמַהְמָהּ֙ חַכֵּה ל֔/וֹ כִּֽי בֹ֥א יָבֹ֖א לֹ֥א יְאַחֵֽר
verses.translit: khy 'vd chzvn lmv'd vypch lqts vl' ykhzb 'm ytmhmh chkhh lv khy b' yb' l' y'chr
verses.translation: For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not tarry.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה עֻפְּלָ֔ה לֹא יָשְׁרָ֥ה נַפְשׁ֖/וֹ בּ֑/וֹ וְ/צַדִּ֖יק בֶּ/אֱמוּנָת֥/וֹ יִחְיֶֽה
verses.translit: hnh 'plh l' yshrh npshv bv vtsdyq b'mvntv ychyh
verses.translation: Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him: but the just shall live by his faith.

verses.original: וְ/אַף֙ כִּֽי הַ/יַּ֣יִן בּוֹגֵ֔ד גֶּ֥בֶר יָהִ֖יר וְ/לֹ֣א יִנְוֶ֑ה אֲשֶׁר֩ הִרְחִ֨יב כִּ/שְׁא֜וֹל נַפְשׁ֗/וֹ וְ/ה֤וּא כַ/מָּ֨וֶת֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יִשְׂבָּ֔ע וַ/יֶּאֱסֹ֤ף אֵלָי/ו֙ כָּל הַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם וַ/יִּקְבֹּ֥ץ אֵלָ֖י/ו כָּל הָ/עַמִּֽים
verses.translit: v'f khy hyyn bvgd gbr yhyr vl' ynvh 'shr hrchyb khsh'vl npshv vhv' khmvt vl' yshb' vy'sf 'lyv khl hgvym vyqbts 'lyv khl h'mym
verses.translation: Yea also, because he transgresseth by wine, he is a proud man, neither keepeth at home, who enlargeth his desire as hell, and is as death, and cannot be satisfied, but gathereth unto him all nations, and heapeth unto him all people:

verses.original: הֲ/לוֹא אֵ֣לֶּה כֻלָּ֗/ם עָלָי/ו֙ מָשָׁ֣ל יִשָּׂ֔אוּ וּ/מְלִיצָ֖ה חִיד֣וֹת ל֑/וֹ וְ/יֹאמַ֗ר ה֚וֹי הַ/מַּרְבֶּ֣ה לֹּא ל֔/וֹ עַד מָתַ֕י וּ/מַכְבִּ֥יד עָלָ֖י/ו עַבְטִֽיט
verses.translit: hlv' 'lh khlm 'lyv mshl ysh'v vmlytsh chydvt lv vy'mr hvy hmrbh l' lv 'd mty vmkhbyd 'lyv 'btyt
verses.translation: Shall not all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his! how long? and to him that ladeth himself with thick clay!

verses.original: הֲ/ל֣וֹא פֶ֗תַע יָק֨וּמוּ֙ נֹשְׁכֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/יִקְצ֖וּ מְזַעְזְעֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/הָיִ֥יתָ לִ/מְשִׁסּ֖וֹת לָֽ/מוֹ
verses.translit: hlv' pt' yqvmv nshkhykh vyqtsv mz'z'ykh vhyyt lmshsvt lmv
verses.translation: Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee, and awake that shall vex thee, and thou shalt be for booties unto them?

verses.original: כִּֽי אַתָּ֤ה שַׁלּ֨וֹתָ֙ גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֔ים יְשָׁלּ֖וּ/ךָ כָּל יֶ֣תֶר עַמִּ֑ים מִ/דְּמֵ֤י אָדָם֙ וַ/חֲמַס אֶ֔רֶץ קִרְיָ֖ה וְ/כָל יֹ֥שְׁבֵי בָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: khy 'th shlvt gvym rbym yshlvkh khl ytr 'mym mdmy 'dm vchms 'rts qryh vkhl yshby bh
verses.translation: Because thou hast spoiled many nations, all the remnant of the people shall spoil thee; because of men’s blood, and for the violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein.

verses.original: ה֗וֹי בֹּצֵ֛עַ בֶּ֥צַע רָ֖ע לְ/בֵית֑/וֹ לָ/שׂ֤וּם בַּ/מָּרוֹם֙ קִנּ֔/וֹ לְ/הִנָּצֵ֖ל מִ/כַּף רָֽע
verses.translit: hvy bts' bts' r' lbytv lshvm bmrvm qnv lhntsl mkhf r'
verses.translation: Woe to him that coveteth an evil covetousness to his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the power of evil!

verses.original: יָעַ֥צְתָּ בֹּ֖שֶׁת לְ/בֵיתֶ֑/ךָ קְצוֹת עַמִּ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים וְ/חוֹטֵ֥א נַפְשֶֽׁ/ךָ
verses.translit: y'tst bsht lbytkh qtsvt 'mym rbym vchvt' npshkh
verses.translation: Thou hast consulted shame to thy house by cutting off many people, and hast sinned against thy soul.

verses.original: כִּי אֶ֖בֶן מִ/קִּ֣יר תִּזְעָ֑ק וְ/כָפִ֖יס מֵ/עֵ֥ץ יַעֲנֶֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: khy 'bn mqyr tz'q vkhpys m'ts y'nnh
verses.translation: For the stone shall cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the timber shall answer it.

verses.original: ה֛וֹי בֹּנֶ֥ה עִ֖יר בְּ/דָמִ֑ים וְ/כוֹנֵ֥ן קִרְיָ֖ה בְּ/עַוְלָֽה
verses.translit: hvy bnh 'yr bdmym vkhvnn qryh b'vlh
verses.translation: Woe to him that buildeth a town with blood, and stablisheth a city by iniquity!

verses.original: הֲ/ל֣וֹא הִנֵּ֔ה מֵ/אֵ֖ת יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת וְ/יִֽיגְע֤וּ עַמִּים֙ בְּ/דֵי אֵ֔שׁ וּ/לְאֻמִּ֖ים בְּ/דֵי רִ֥יק יִעָֽפוּ
verses.translit: hlv' hnh m't yhvh tsb'vt vyyg'v 'mym bdy 'sh vl'mym bdy ryq y'pv
verses.translation: Behold, is it not of the LORD of hosts that the people shall labour in the very fire, and the people shall weary themselves for very vanity?

verses.original: כִּ֚י תִּמָּלֵ֣א הָ/אָ֔רֶץ לָ/דַ֖עַת אֶת כְּב֣וֹד יְהוָ֑ה כַּ/מַּ֖יִם יְכַסּ֥וּ עַל יָֽם
verses.translit: khy tml' h'rts ld't 't khbvd yhvh khmym ykhsv 'l ym
verses.translation: For the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the LORD , as the waters cover the sea.

verses.original: ה֚וֹי מַשְׁקֵ֣ה רֵעֵ֔/הוּ מְסַפֵּ֥חַ חֲמָתְ/ךָ֖ וְ/אַ֣ף שַׁכֵּ֑ר לְמַ֥עַן הַבִּ֖יט עַל מְעוֹרֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: hvy mshqh r'hv mspch chmtkh v'f shkhr lm'n hbyt 'l m'vryhm
verses.translation: Woe unto him that giveth his neighbour drink, that puttest thy bottle to him , and makest him drunken also, that thou mayest look on their nakedness!

verses.original: שָׂבַ֤עְתָּ קָלוֹן֙ מִ/כָּב֔וֹד שְׁתֵ֥ה גַם אַ֖תָּה וְ/הֵֽעָרֵ֑ל תִּסּ֣וֹב עָלֶ֗י/ךָ כּ֚וֹס יְמִ֣ין יְהוָ֔ה וְ/קִיקָל֖וֹן עַל כְּבוֹדֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: shb't qlvn mkhbvd shth gm 'th vh'rl tsvb 'lykh khvs ymyn yhvh vqyqlvn 'l khbvdkh
verses.translation: Thou art filled with shame for glory: drink thou also, and let thy foreskin be uncovered: the cup of the LORD’s right hand shall be turned unto thee, and shameful spewing shall be on thy glory.

verses.original: כִּ֣י חֲמַ֤ס לְבָנוֹן֙ יְכַסֶּ֔/ךָּ וְ/שֹׁ֥ד בְּהֵמ֖וֹת יְחִיתַ֑/ן מִ/דְּמֵ֤י אָדָם֙ וַ/חֲמַס אֶ֔רֶץ קִרְיָ֖ה וְ/כָל יֹ֥שְׁבֵי בָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: khy chms lbnvn ykhskh vshd bhmvt ychytn mdmy 'dm vchms 'rts qryh vkhl yshby bh
verses.translation: For the violence of Lebanon shall cover thee, and the spoil of beasts, which made them afraid, because of men’s blood, and for the violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein.

verses.original: מָֽה הוֹעִ֣יל פֶּ֗סֶל כִּ֤י פְסָל/וֹ֙ יֹֽצְר֔/וֹ מַסֵּכָ֖ה וּ/מ֣וֹרֶה שָּׁ֑קֶר כִּ֣י בָטַ֞ח יֹצֵ֤ר יִצְר/וֹ֙ עָלָ֔י/ו לַ/עֲשׂ֖וֹת אֱלִילִ֥ים אִלְּמִֽים
verses.translit: mh hv'yl psl khy pslv ytsrv mskhh vmvrh shqr khy btch ytsr ytsrv 'lyv l'shvt 'lylym 'lmym
verses.translation: What profiteth the graven image that the maker thereof hath graven it; the molten image, and a teacher of lies, that the maker of his work trusteth therein, to make dumb idols?

verses.original: ה֣וֹי אֹמֵ֤ר לָ/עֵץ֙ הָקִ֔יצָ/ה ע֖וּרִי לְ/אֶ֣בֶן דּוּמָ֑ם ה֣וּא יוֹרֶ֔ה הִנֵּה ה֗וּא תָּפוּשׂ֙ זָהָ֣ב וָ/כֶ֔סֶף וְ/כָל ר֖וּחַ אֵ֥ין בְּ/קִרְבּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hvy 'mr l'ts hqytsh 'vry l'bn dvmm hv' yvrh hnh hv' tpvsh zhb vkhsf vkhl rvch 'yn bqrbv
verses.translation: Woe unto him that saith to the wood, Awake; to the dumb stone, Arise, it shall teach! Behold, it is laid over with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all in the midst of it.

verses.original: וַֽ/יהוָ֖ה בְּ/הֵיכַ֣ל קָדְשׁ֑/וֹ הַ֥ס מִ/פָּנָ֖י/ו כָּל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vyhvh bhykhl qdshv hs mpnyv khl h'rts
verses.translation: But the LORD is in his holy temple: let all the earth keep silence before him.

verses.original: תְּפִלָּ֖ה לַ/חֲבַקּ֣וּק הַ/נָּבִ֑יא עַ֖ל שִׁגְיֹנֽוֹת
verses.translit: tplh lchbqvq hnby' 'l shgynvt
verses.translation: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet upon Shigionoth.

verses.original: יְהוָ֗ה שָׁמַ֣עְתִּי שִׁמְעֲ/ךָ֮ יָרֵאתִי֒ יְהוָ֗ה פָּֽעָלְ/ךָ֙ בְּ/קֶ֤רֶב שָׁנִים֙ חַיֵּ֔י/הוּ בְּ/קֶ֥רֶב שָׁנִ֖ים תּוֹדִ֑יעַ בְּ/רֹ֖גֶז רַחֵ֥ם תִּזְכּֽוֹר
verses.translit: yhvh shm'ty shm'kh yr'ty yhvh p'lkh bqrb shnym chyyhv bqrb shnym tvdy' brgz rchm tzkhvr
verses.translation: O LORD , I have heard thy speech, and was afraid: O LORD , revive thy work in the midst of the years, in the midst of the years make known; in wrath remember mercy.

verses.original: אֱל֨וֹהַ֙ מִ/תֵּימָ֣ן יָב֔וֹא וְ/קָד֥וֹשׁ מֵֽ/הַר פָּארָ֖ן סֶ֑לָה כִּסָּ֤ה שָׁמַ֨יִם֙ הוֹד֔/וֹ וּ/תְהִלָּת֖/וֹ מָלְאָ֥ה הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: 'lvh mtymn ybv' vqdvsh mhr p'rn slh khsh shmym hvdv vthltv ml'h h'rts
verses.translation: God came from Teman, and the Holy One from mount Paran. Selah. His glory covered the heavens, and the earth was full of his praise.

verses.original: וְ/נֹ֨גַהּ֙ כָּ/א֣וֹר תִּֽהְיֶ֔ה קַרְנַ֥יִם מִ/יָּד֖/וֹ ל֑/וֹ וְ/שָׁ֖ם חֶבְי֥וֹן עֻזֹּֽ/ה
verses.translit: vngh kh'vr thyh qrnym mydv lv vshm chbyvn 'zh
verses.translation: And his brightness was as the light; he had horns coming out of his hand: and there was the hiding of his power.

verses.original: לְ/פָנָ֖י/ו יֵ֣לֶךְ דָּ֑בֶר וְ/יֵצֵ֥א רֶ֖שֶׁף לְ/רַגְלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: lpnyv ylkh dbr vyts' rshf lrglyv
verses.translation: Before him went the pestilence, and burning coals went forth at his feet.

verses.original: עָמַ֣ד וַ/יְמֹ֣דֶד אֶ֗רֶץ רָאָה֙ וַ/יַּתֵּ֣ר גּוֹיִ֔ם וַ/יִּתְפֹּֽצְצוּ֙ הַרְרֵי עַ֔ד שַׁח֖וּ גִּבְע֣וֹת עוֹלָ֑ם הֲלִיכ֥וֹת עוֹלָ֖ם לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'md vymdd 'rts r'h vytr gvym vytptstsv hrry 'd shchv gb'vt 'vlm hlykhvt 'vlm lv
verses.translation: He stood, and measured the earth: he beheld, and drove asunder the nations; and the everlasting mountains were scattered, the perpetual hills did bow: his ways are everlasting.

verses.original: תַּ֣חַת אָ֔וֶן רָאִ֖יתִי אָהֳלֵ֣י כוּשָׁ֑ן יִרְגְּז֕וּ/ן יְרִיע֖וֹת אֶ֥רֶץ מִדְיָֽן
verses.translit: tcht 'vn r'yty 'hly khvshn yrgzvn yry'vt 'rts mdyn
verses.translation: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction: and the curtains of the land of Midian did tremble.

verses.original: הֲ/בִ/נְהָרִים֙ חָרָ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה אִ֤ם בַּ/נְּהָרִים֙ אַפֶּ֔/ךָ אִם בַּ/יָּ֖ם עֶבְרָתֶ֑/ךָ כִּ֤י תִרְכַּב֙ עַל סוּסֶ֔י/ךָ מַרְכְּבֹתֶ֖י/ךָ יְשׁוּעָֽה
verses.translit: hbnhrym chrh yhvh 'm bnhrym 'pkh 'm bym 'brtkh khy trkhb 'l svsykh mrkhbtykh yshv'h
verses.translation: Was the LORD displeased against the rivers? was thine anger against the rivers? was thy wrath against the sea, that thou didst ride upon thine horses and thy chariots of salvation?

verses.original: עֶרְיָ֤ה תֵעוֹר֙ קַשְׁתֶּ֔/ךָ שְׁבֻע֥וֹת מַטּ֖וֹת אֹ֣מֶר סֶ֑לָה נְהָר֖וֹת תְּבַקַּע אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: 'ryh t'vr qshtkh shb'vt mtvt 'mr slh nhrvt tbq' 'rts
verses.translation: Thy bow was made quite naked, according to the oaths of the tribes, even thy word. Selah. Thou didst cleave the earth with rivers.

verses.original: רָא֤וּ/ךָ יָחִ֨ילוּ֙ הָרִ֔ים זֶ֥רֶם מַ֖יִם עָבָ֑ר נָתַ֤ן תְּהוֹם֙ קוֹל֔/וֹ ר֖וֹם יָדֵ֥י/הוּ נָשָֽׂא
verses.translit: r'vkh ychylv hrym zrm mym 'br ntn thvm qvlv rvm ydyhv nsh'
verses.translation: The mountains saw thee, and they trembled: the overflowing of the water passed by: the deep uttered his voice, and lifted up his hands on high.

verses.original: שֶׁ֥מֶשׁ יָרֵ֖חַ עָ֣מַד זְבֻ֑לָ/ה לְ/א֤וֹר חִצֶּ֨י/ךָ֙ יְהַלֵּ֔כוּ לְ/נֹ֖גַהּ בְּרַ֥ק חֲנִיתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: shmsh yrch 'md zblh l'vr chtsykh yhlkhv lngh brq chnytkh
verses.translation: The sun and moon stood still in their habitation: at the light of thine arrows they went, and at the shining of thy glittering spear.

verses.original: בְּ/זַ֖עַם תִּצְעַד אָ֑רֶץ בְּ/אַ֖ף תָּד֥וּשׁ גּוֹיִֽם
verses.translit: bz'm tts'd 'rts b'f tdvsh gvym
verses.translation: Thou didst march through the land in indignation, thou didst thresh the heathen in anger.

verses.original: יָצָ֨אתָ֙ לְ/יֵ֣שַׁע עַמֶּ֔/ךָ לְ/יֵ֖שַׁע אֶת מְשִׁיחֶ֑/ךָ מָחַ֤צְתָּ רֹּאשׁ֙ מִ/בֵּ֣ית רָשָׁ֔ע עָר֛וֹת יְס֥וֹד עַד צַוָּ֖אר סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: yts't lysh' 'mkh lysh' 't mshychkh mchtst r'sh mbyt rsh' 'rvt ysvd 'd tsv'r slh
verses.translation: Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people, even for salvation with thine anointed; thou woundedst the head out of the house of the wicked, by discovering the foundation unto the neck. Selah.

verses.original: נָקַ֤בְתָּ בְ/מַטָּי/ו֙ רֹ֣אשׁ פרז/ו פְּרָזָ֔י/ו יִסְעֲר֖וּ לַ/הֲפִיצֵ֑/נִי עֲלִ֣יצֻתָ֔/ם כְּמוֹ לֶ/אֱכֹ֥ל עָנִ֖י בַּ/מִּסְתָּֽר
verses.translit: nqbt bmtyv r'sh przv przyv ys'rv lhpytsny 'lytstm khmv l'khl 'ny bmstr
verses.translation: Thou didst strike through with his staves the head of his villages: they came out as a whirlwind to scatter me: their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly.

verses.original: דָּרַ֥כְתָּ בַ/יָּ֖ם סוּסֶ֑י/ךָ חֹ֖מֶר מַ֥יִם רַבִּֽים
verses.translit: drkht bym svsykh chmr mym rbym
verses.translation: Thou didst walk through the sea with thine horses, through the heap of great waters.

verses.original: שָׁמַ֣עְתִּי וַ/תִּרְגַּ֣ז בִּטְנִ֗/י לְ/קוֹל֙ צָלֲל֣וּ שְׂפָתַ֔/י יָב֥וֹא רָקָ֛ב בַּ/עֲצָמַ֖/י וְ/תַחְתַּ֣/י אֶרְגָּ֑ז אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָנ֨וּחַ֙ לְ/י֣וֹם צָרָ֔ה לַ/עֲל֖וֹת לְ/עַ֥ם יְגוּדֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: shm'ty vtrgz btny lqvl tsllv shpty ybv' rqb b'tsmy vtchty 'rgz 'shr 'nvch lyvm tsrh l'lvt l'm ygvdnv
verses.translation: When I heard, my belly trembled; my lips quivered at the voice: rottenness entered into my bones, and I trembled in myself, that I might rest in the day of trouble: when he cometh up unto the people, he will invade them with his troops.

verses.original: כִּֽי תְאֵנָ֣ה לֹֽא תִפְרָ֗ח וְ/אֵ֤ין יְבוּל֙ בַּ/גְּפָנִ֔ים כִּחֵשׁ֙ מַעֲשֵׂה זַ֔יִת וּ/שְׁדֵמ֖וֹת לֹא עָ֣שָׂה אֹ֑כֶל גָּזַ֤ר מִ/מִּכְלָה֙ צֹ֔אן וְ/אֵ֥ין בָּקָ֖ר בָּ/רְפָתִֽים
verses.translit: khy t'nh l' tprch v'yn ybvl bgpnym khchsh m'shh zyt vshdmvt l' 'shh 'khl gzr mmkhlh ts'n v'yn bqr brptym
verses.translation: Although the fig tree shall not blossom, neither shall fruit be in the vines; the labour of the olive shall fail, and the fields shall yield no meat; the flock shall be cut off from the fold, and there shall be no herd in the stalls:

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֖י בַּ/יהוָ֣ה אֶעְל֑וֹזָה אָגִ֖ילָה בֵּ/אלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעִֽ/י
verses.translit: v'ny byhvh ''lvzh 'gylh b'lhy ysh'y
verses.translation: Yet I will rejoice in the LORD , I will joy in the God of my salvation.

verses.original: יְהוִ֤הּ אֲדֹנָ/י֙ חֵילִ֔/י וַ/יָּ֤שֶׂם רַגְלַ/י֙ כָּֽ/אַיָּל֔וֹת וְ/עַ֥ל בָּמוֹתַ֖/י יַדְרִכֵ֑/נִי לַ/מְנַצֵּ֖חַ בִּ/נְגִינוֹתָֽי
verses.translit: yhvh 'dny chyly vyshm rgly kh'ylvt v'l bmvty ydrkhny lmntsch bngynvty
verses.translation: The LORD God is my strength, and he will make my feet like hinds’ feet , and he will make me to walk upon mine high places. To the chief singer on my stringed instruments.

verses.original: דְּבַר יְהוָ֣ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֗ה אֶל צְפַנְיָה֙ בֶּן כּוּשִׁ֣י בֶן גְּדַלְיָ֔ה בֶּן אֲמַרְיָ֖ה בֶּן חִזְקִיָּ֑ה בִּ/ימֵ֛י יֹאשִׁיָּ֥הוּ בֶן אָמ֖וֹן מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: dbr yhvh 'shr hyh 'l tspnyh bn khvshy bn gdlyh bn 'mryh bn chzqyh bymy y'shyhv bn 'mvn mlkh yhvdh
verses.translation: The word of the LORD which came unto Zephaniah the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hizkiah, in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah.

verses.original: אָסֹ֨ף אָסֵ֜ף כֹּ֗ל מֵ/עַ֛ל פְּנֵ֥י הָ/אֲדָמָ֖ה נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'sf 'sf khl m'l pny h'dmh n'm yhvh
verses.translation: I will utterly consume all things from off the land, saith the LORD .

verses.original: אָסֵ֨ף אָדָ֜ם וּ/בְהֵמָ֗ה אָסֵ֤ף עוֹף הַ/שָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ וּ/דְגֵ֣י הַ/יָּ֔ם וְ/הַ/מַּכְשֵׁל֖וֹת אֶת הָ/רְשָׁעִ֑ים וְ/הִכְרַתִּ֣י אֶת הָ/אָדָ֗ם מֵ/עַ֛ל פְּנֵ֥י הָ/אֲדָמָ֖ה נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'sf 'dm vbhmh 'sf 'vf hshmym vdgy hym vhmkhshlvt 't hrsh'ym vhkhrty 't h'dm m'l pny h'dmh n'm yhvh
verses.translation: I will consume man and beast; I will consume the fowls of the heaven, and the fishes of the sea, and the stumblingblocks with the wicked; and I will cut off man from off the land, saith the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/נָטִ֤יתִי יָדִ/י֙ עַל יְהוּדָ֔ה וְ/עַ֖ל כָּל יוֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/הִכְרַתִּ֞י מִן הַ/מָּק֤וֹם הַ/זֶּה֙ אֶת שְׁאָ֣ר הַ/בַּ֔עַל אֶת שֵׁ֥ם הַ/כְּמָרִ֖ים עִם הַ/כֹּהֲנִֽים
verses.translit: vntyty ydy 'l yhvdh v'l khl yvshby yrvshlm vhkhrty mn hmqvm hzh 't sh'r hb'l 't shm hkhmrym 'm hkhhnym
verses.translation: I will also stretch out mine hand upon Judah, and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and I will cut off the remnant of Baal from this place, and the name of the Chemarims with the priests;

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ/מִּשְׁתַּחֲוִ֥ים עַל הַ/גַּגּ֖וֹת לִ/צְבָ֣א הַ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם וְ/אֶת הַ/מִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוִים֙ הַ/נִּשְׁבָּעִ֣ים לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה וְ/הַ/נִּשְׁבָּעִ֖ים בְּ/מַלְכָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: v't hmshtchvym 'l hggvt ltsb' hshmym v't hmshtchvym hnshb'ym lyhvh vhnshb'ym bmlkhm
verses.translation: And them that worship the host of heaven upon the housetops; and them that worship and that swear by the LORD , and that swear by Malcham;

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ/נְּסוֹגִ֖ים מֵ/אַחֲרֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא בִקְשׁ֥וּ אֶת יְהוָ֖ה וְ/לֹ֥א דְרָשֻֽׁ/הוּ
verses.translit: v't hnsvgym m'chry yhvh v'shr l' bqshv 't yhvh vl' drshhv
verses.translation: And them that are turned back from the LORD ; and those that have not sought the LORD , nor enquired for him.

verses.original: הַ֕ס מִ/פְּנֵ֖י אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה כִּ֤י קָרוֹב֙ י֣וֹם יְהוָ֔ה כִּֽי הֵכִ֧ין יְהוָ֛ה זֶ֖בַח הִקְדִּ֥ישׁ קְרֻאָֽי/ו
verses.translit: hs mpny 'dny yhvh khy qrvb yvm yhvh khy hkhyn yhvh zbch hqdysh qr'yv
verses.translation: Hold thy peace at the presence of the Lord GOD : for the day of the LORD is at hand: for the LORD hath prepared a sacrifice, he hath bid his guests.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה בְּ/יוֹם֙ זֶ֣בַח יְהוָ֔ה וּ/פָקַדְתִּ֥י עַל הַ/שָּׂרִ֖ים וְ/עַל בְּנֵ֣י הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וְ/עַ֥ל כָּל הַ/לֹּבְשִׁ֖ים מַלְבּ֥וּשׁ נָכְרִֽי
verses.translit: vhyh byvm zbch yhvh vpqdty 'l hshrym v'l bny hmlkh v'l khl hlbshym mlbvsh nkhry
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in the day of the LORD’s sacrifice, that I will punish the princes, and the king’s children, and all such as are clothed with strange apparel.

verses.original: וּ/פָקַדְתִּ֗י עַ֧ל כָּל הַ/דּוֹלֵ֛ג עַל הַ/מִּפְתָּ֖ן בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֑וּא הַֽ/מְמַלְאִ֛ים בֵּ֥ית אֲדֹנֵי/הֶ֖ם חָמָ֥ס וּ/מִרְמָֽה
verses.translit: vpqdty 'l khl hdvlg 'l hmptn byvm hhv' hmml'ym byt 'dnyhm chms vmrmh
verses.translation: In the same day also will I punish all those that leap on the threshold, which fill their masters’ houses with violence and deceit.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֩ בַ/יּ֨וֹם הַ/ה֜וּא נְאֻם יְהוָ֗ה ק֤וֹל צְעָקָה֙ מִ/שַּׁ֣עַר הַ/דָּגִ֔ים וִֽ/ילָלָ֖ה מִן הַ/מִּשְׁנֶ֑ה וְ/שֶׁ֥בֶר גָּד֖וֹל מֵ/הַ/גְּבָעֽוֹת
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' n'm yhvh qvl ts'qh msh'r hdgym vyllh mn hmshnh vshbr gdvl mhgb'vt
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD , that there shall be the noise of a cry from the fish gate, and an howling from the second, and a great crashing from the hills.

verses.original: הֵילִ֖ילוּ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הַ/מַּכְתֵּ֑שׁ כִּ֤י נִדְמָה֙ כָּל עַ֣ם כְּנַ֔עַן נִכְרְת֖וּ כָּל נְטִ֥ילֵי כָֽסֶף
verses.translit: hylylv yshby hmkhtsh khy ndmh khl 'm khn'n nkhrtv khl ntyly khsf
verses.translation: Howl, ye inhabitants of Maktesh, for all the merchant people are cut down; all they that bear silver are cut off.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֙ בָּ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֔יא אֲחַפֵּ֥שׂ אֶת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בַּ/נֵּר֑וֹת וּ/פָקַדְתִּ֣י עַל הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֗ים הַ/קֹּֽפְאִים֙ עַל שִׁמְרֵי/הֶ֔ם הָ/אֹֽמְרִים֙ בִּ/לְבָבָ֔/ם לֹֽא יֵיטִ֥יב יְהוָ֖ה וְ/לֹ֥א יָרֵֽעַ
verses.translit: vhyh b't hhy' 'chpsh 't yrvshlm bnrvt vpqdty 'l h'nshym hqp'ym 'l shmryhm h'mrym blbbm l' yytyb yhvh vl' yr'
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass at that time, that I will search Jerusalem with candles, and punish the men that are settled on their lees: that say in their heart, The LORD will not do good, neither will he do evil.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֤ה חֵילָ/ם֙ לִ/מְשִׁסָּ֔ה וּ/בָתֵּי/הֶ֖ם לִ/שְׁמָמָ֑ה וּ/בָנ֤וּ בָתִּים֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יֵשֵׁ֔בוּ וְ/נָטְע֣וּ כְרָמִ֔ים וְ/לֹ֥א יִשְׁתּ֖וּ אֶת יֵינָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vhyh chylm lmshsh vbtyhm lshmmh vbnv btym vl' yshbv vnt'v khrmym vl' yshtv 't yynm
verses.translation: Therefore their goods shall become a booty, and their houses a desolation: they shall also build houses, but not inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, but not drink the wine thereof.

verses.original: קָר֤וֹב יוֹם יְהוָה֙ הַ/גָּד֔וֹל קָר֖וֹב וּ/מַהֵ֣ר מְאֹ֑ד ק֚וֹל י֣וֹם יְהוָ֔ה מַ֥ר צֹרֵ֖חַ שָׁ֥ם גִּבּֽוֹר
verses.translit: qrvb yvm yhvh hgdvl qrvb vmhr m'd qvl yvm yhvh mr tsrch shm gbvr
verses.translation: The great day of the LORD is near, it is near, and hasteth greatly, even the voice of the day of the LORD : the mighty man shall cry there bitterly.

verses.original: י֥וֹם עֶבְרָ֖ה הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֑וּא י֧וֹם צָרָ֣ה וּ/מְצוּקָ֗ה י֤וֹם שֹׁאָה֙ וּ/מְשׁוֹאָ֔ה י֥וֹם חֹ֨שֶׁךְ֙ וַ/אֲפֵלָ֔ה י֥וֹם עָנָ֖ן וַ/עֲרָפֶֽל
verses.translit: yvm 'brh hyvm hhv' yvm tsrh vmtsvqh yvm sh'h vmshv'h yvm chshkh v'plh yvm 'nn v'rpl
verses.translation: That day is a day of wrath, a day of trouble and distress, a day of wasteness and desolation, a day of darkness and gloominess, a day of clouds and thick darkness,

verses.original: י֥וֹם שׁוֹפָ֖ר וּ/תְרוּעָ֑ה עַ֚ל הֶ/עָרִ֣ים הַ/בְּצֻר֔וֹת וְ/עַ֖ל הַ/פִּנּ֥וֹת הַ/גְּבֹהֽוֹת
verses.translit: yvm shvpr vtrv'h 'l h'rym hbtsrvt v'l hpnvt hgbhvt
verses.translation: A day of the trumpet and alarm against the fenced cities, and against the high towers.

verses.original: וַ/הֲצֵרֹ֣תִי לָ/אָדָ֗ם וְ/הָֽלְכוּ֙ כַּֽ/עִוְרִ֔ים כִּ֥י לַֽ/יהוָ֖ה חָטָ֑אוּ וְ/שֻׁפַּ֤ךְ דָּמָ/ם֙ כֶּֽ/עָפָ֔ר וּ/לְחֻמָ֖/ם כַּ/גְּלָלִֽים
verses.translit: vhtsrty l'dm vhlkhv kh'vrym khy lyhvh cht'v vshpkh dmm kh'pr vlchmm khgllym
verses.translation: And I will bring distress upon men, that they shall walk like blind men, because they have sinned against the LORD : and their blood shall be poured out as dust, and their flesh as the dung.

verses.original: גַּם כַּסְפָּ֨/ם גַּם זְהָבָ֜/ם לֹֽא יוּכַ֣ל לְ/הַצִּילָ֗/ם בְּ/יוֹם֙ עֶבְרַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה וּ/בְ/אֵשׁ֙ קִנְאָת֔/וֹ תֵּאָכֵ֖ל כָּל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ כִּֽי כָלָ֤ה אַךְ נִבְהָלָה֙ יַֽעֲשֶׂ֔ה אֵ֥ת כָּל יֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: gm khspm gm zhbm l' yvkhl lhtsylm byvm 'brt yhvh vb'sh qn'tv t'khl khl h'rts khy khlh 'kh nbhlh y'shh 't khl yshby h'rts
verses.translation: Neither their silver nor their gold shall be able to deliver them in the day of the LORD’s wrath; but the whole land shall be devoured by the fire of his jealousy: for he shall make even a speedy riddance of all them that dwell in the land.

verses.original: הִֽתְקוֹשְׁשׁ֖וּ וָ/ק֑וֹשּׁוּ הַ/גּ֖וֹי לֹ֥א נִכְסָֽף
verses.translit: htqvshshv vqvshv hgvy l' nkhsf
verses.translation: Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired;

verses.original: בְּ/טֶ֨רֶם֙ לֶ֣דֶת חֹ֔ק כְּ/מֹ֖ץ עָ֣בַר י֑וֹם בְּ/טֶ֣רֶם לֹא יָב֣וֹא עֲלֵי/כֶ֗ם חֲרוֹן֙ אַף יְהוָ֔ה בְּ/טֶ֨רֶם֙ לֹא יָב֣וֹא עֲלֵי/כֶ֔ם י֖וֹם אַף יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: btrm ldt chq khmts 'br yvm btrm l' ybv' 'lykhm chrvn 'f yhvh btrm l' ybv' 'lykhm yvm 'f yhvh
verses.translation: Before the decree bring forth, before the day pass as the chaff, before the fierce anger of the LORD come upon you, before the day of the LORD’s anger come upon you.

verses.original: בַּקְּשׁ֤וּ אֶת יְהוָה֙ כָּל עַנְוֵ֣י הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִשְׁפָּט֖/וֹ פָּעָ֑לוּ בַּקְּשׁוּ צֶ֨דֶק֙ בַּקְּשׁ֣וּ עֲנָוָ֔ה אוּלַי֙ תִּסָּ֣תְר֔וּ בְּ/י֖וֹם אַף יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: bqshv 't yhvh khl 'nvy h'rts 'shr mshptv p'lv bqshv tsdq bqshv 'nvh 'vly tstrv byvm 'f yhvh
verses.translation: Seek ye the LORD , all ye meek of the earth, which have wrought his judgment; seek righteousness, seek meekness: it may be ye shall be hid in the day of the LORD’s anger.

verses.original: כִּ֤י עַזָּה֙ עֲזוּבָ֣ה תִֽהְיֶ֔ה וְ/אַשְׁקְל֖וֹן לִ/שְׁמָמָ֑ה אַשְׁדּ֗וֹד בַּֽ/צָּהֳרַ֨יִם֙ יְגָ֣רְשׁ֔וּ/הָ וְ/עֶקְר֖וֹן תֵּעָקֵֽר
verses.translit: khy 'zh 'zvbh thyh v'shqlvn lshmmh 'shdvd btshrym ygrshvh v'qrvn t'qr
verses.translation: For Gaza shall be forsaken, and Ashkelon a desolation: they shall drive out Ashdod at the noon day, and Ekron shall be rooted up.

verses.original: ה֗וֹי יֹֽשְׁבֵ֛י חֶ֥בֶל הַ/יָּ֖ם גּ֣וֹי כְּרֵתִ֑ים דְּבַר יְהוָ֣ה עֲלֵי/כֶ֗ם כְּנַ֨עַן֙ אֶ֣רֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וְ/הַאֲבַדְתִּ֖י/ךְ מֵ/אֵ֥ין יוֹשֵֽׁב
verses.translit: hvy yshby chbl hym gvy khrtym dbr yhvh 'lykhm khn'n 'rts plshtym vh'bdtykh m'yn yvshb
verses.translation: Woe unto the inhabitants of the sea coast, the nation of the Cherethites! the word of the LORD is against you; O Canaan, the land of the Philistines, I will even destroy thee, that there shall be no inhabitant.

verses.original: וְֽ/הָיְתָ֞ה חֶ֣בֶל הַ/יָּ֗ם נְוֺ֛ת כְּרֹ֥ת רֹעִ֖ים וְ/גִדְר֥וֹת צֹֽאן
verses.translit: vhyth chbl hym nvt khrt r'ym vgdrvt ts'n
verses.translation: And the sea coast shall be dwellings and cottages for shepherds, and folds for flocks.

verses.original: וְ/הָ֣יָה חֶ֗בֶל לִ/שְׁאֵרִ֛ית בֵּ֥ית יְהוּדָ֖ה עֲלֵי/הֶ֣ם יִרְע֑וּ/ן בְּ/בָתֵּ֣י אַשְׁקְל֗וֹן בָּ/עֶ֨רֶב֙ יִרְבָּצ֔וּ/ן כִּ֧י יִפְקְדֵ֛/ם יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/הֶ֖ם וְ/שָׁ֥ב שבות/ם שְׁבִיתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vhyh chbl lsh'ryt byt yhvdh 'lyhm yr'vn bbty 'shqlvn b'rb yrbtsvn khy ypqdm yhvh 'lhyhm vshb shbvtm shbytm
verses.translation: And the coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Judah; they shall feed thereupon: in the houses of Ashkelon shall they lie down in the evening: for the LORD their God shall visit them, and turn away their captivity. : or, when, etc

verses.original: שָׁמַ֨עְתִּי֙ חֶרְפַּ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב וְ/גִדּוּפֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֑וֹן אֲשֶׁ֤ר חֵֽרְפוּ֙ אֶת עַמִּ֔/י וַ/יַּגְדִּ֖ילוּ עַל גְּבוּלָֽ/ם
verses.translit: shm'ty chrpt mv'b vgdvpy bny 'mvn 'shr chrpv 't 'my vygdylv 'l gbvlm
verses.translation: I have heard the reproach of Moab, and the revilings of the children of Ammon, whereby they have reproached my people, and magnified themselves against their border.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֣ן חַי אָ֡נִי נְאֻם֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כִּֽי מוֹאָ֞ב כִּ/סְדֹ֤ם תִּֽהְיֶה֙ וּ/בְנֵ֤י עַמּוֹן֙ כַּֽ/עֲמֹרָ֔ה מִמְשַׁ֥ק חָר֛וּל וּ/מִכְרֵה מֶ֥לַח וּ/שְׁמָמָ֖ה עַד עוֹלָ֑ם שְׁאֵרִ֤ית עַמִּ/י֙ יְבָזּ֔וּ/ם וְ/יֶ֥תֶר גוי גּוֹיִ֖/י יִנְחָלֽוּ/ם
verses.translit: lkhn chy 'ny n'm yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l khy mv'b khsdm thyh vbny 'mvn kh'mrh mmshq chrvl vmkhrh mlch vshmmh 'd 'vlm sh'ryt 'my ybzvm vytr gvy gvyy ynchlvm
verses.translation: Therefore as I live, saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, Surely Moab shall be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah, even the breeding of nettles, and saltpits, and a perpetual desolation: the residue of my people shall spoil them, and the remnant of my people shall possess them.

verses.original: זֹ֥את לָ/הֶ֖ם תַּ֣חַת גְּאוֹנָ֑/ם כִּ֤י חֵֽרְפוּ֙ וַ/יַּגְדִּ֔לוּ עַל עַ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: z't lhm tcht g'vnm khy chrpv vygdlv 'l 'm yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: This shall they have for their pride, because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of the LORD of hosts.

verses.original: נוֹרָ֤א יְהוָה֙ עֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם כִּ֣י רָזָ֔ה אֵ֖ת כָּל אֱלֹהֵ֣י הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/יִשְׁתַּֽחֲווּ ל/וֹ֙ אִ֣ישׁ מִ/מְּקוֹמ֔/וֹ כֹּ֖ל אִיֵּ֥י הַ/גּוֹיִֽם
verses.translit: nvr' yhvh 'lyhm khy rzh 't khl 'lhy h'rts vyshtchvv lv 'ysh mmqvmv khl 'yy hgvym
verses.translation: The LORD will be terrible unto them: for he will famish all the gods of the earth; and men shall worship him, every one from his place, even all the isles of the heathen.

verses.original: גַּם אַתֶּ֣ם כּוּשִׁ֔ים חַֽלְלֵ֥י חַרְבִּ֖/י הֵֽמָּה
verses.translit: gm 'tm khvshym chlly chrby hmh
verses.translation: Ye Ethiopians also, ye shall be slain by my sword.

verses.original: וְ/יֵ֤ט יָד/וֹ֙ עַל צָפ֔וֹן וִֽ/יאַבֵּ֖ד אֶת אַשּׁ֑וּר וְ/יָשֵׂ֤ם אֶת נִֽינְוֵה֙ לִ/שְׁמָמָ֔ה צִיָּ֖ה כַּ/מִּדְבָּֽר
verses.translit: vyt ydv 'l tspvn vy'bd 't 'shvr vyshm 't nynvh lshmmh tsyh khmdbr
verses.translation: And he will stretch out his hand against the north, and destroy Assyria; and will make Nineveh a desolation, and dry like a wilderness.

verses.original: וְ/רָבְצ֨וּ בְ/תוֹכָ֤/הּ עֲדָרִים֙ כָּל חַיְת/וֹ ג֔וֹי גַּם קָאַת֙ גַּם קִפֹּ֔ד בְּ/כַפְתֹּרֶ֖י/הָ יָלִ֑ינוּ ק֠וֹל יְשׁוֹרֵ֤ר בַּֽ/חַלּוֹן֙ חֹ֣רֶב בַּ/סַּ֔ף כִּ֥י אַרְזָ֖ה עֵרָֽה
verses.translit: vrbtsv btvkhh 'drym khl chytv gvy gm q't gm qpd bkhptryh ylynv qvl yshvrr bchlvn chrb bsf khy 'rzh 'rh
verses.translation: And flocks shall lie down in the midst of her, all the beasts of the nations: both the cormorant and the bittern shall lodge in the upper lintels of it; their voice shall sing in the windows; desolation shall be in the thresholds: for he shall uncover the cedar work.

verses.original: זֹ֞֠את הָ/עִ֤יר הָ/עַלִּיזָה֙ הַ/יּוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת לָ/בֶ֔טַח הָ/אֹֽמְרָה֙ בִּ/לְבָבָ֔/הּ אֲנִ֖י וְ/אַפְסִ֣/י ע֑וֹד אֵ֣יךְ הָיְתָ֣ה לְ/שַׁמָּ֗ה מַרְבֵּץ֙ לַֽ/חַיָּ֔ה כֹּ֚ל עוֹבֵ֣ר עָלֶ֔י/הָ יִשְׁרֹ֖ק יָנִ֥יעַ יָדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: z't h'yr h'lyzh hyvshbt lbtch h'mrh blbbh 'ny v'psy 'vd 'ykh hyth lshmh mrbts lchyh khl 'vbr 'lyh yshrq yny' ydv
verses.translation: This is the rejoicing city that dwelt carelessly, that said in her heart, I am , and there is none beside me: how is she become a desolation, a place for beasts to lie down in! every one that passeth by her shall hiss, and wag his hand.

verses.original: ה֥וֹי מֹרְאָ֖ה וְ/נִגְאָלָ֑ה הָ/עִ֖יר הַ/יּוֹנָֽה
verses.translit: hvy mr'h vng'lh h'yr hyvnh
verses.translation: Woe to her that is filthy and polluted, to the oppressing city!

verses.original: לֹ֤א שָֽׁמְעָה֙ בְּ/ק֔וֹל לֹ֥א לָקְחָ֖ה מוּסָ֑ר בַּֽ/יהוָה֙ לֹ֣א בָטָ֔חָה אֶל אֱלֹהֶ֖י/הָ לֹ֥א קָרֵֽבָה
verses.translit: l' shm'h bqvl l' lqchh mvsr byhvh l' btchh 'l 'lhyh l' qrbh
verses.translation: She obeyed not the voice; she received not correction; she trusted not in the LORD ; she drew not near to her God.

verses.original: שָׂרֶ֣י/הָ בְ/קִרְבָּ֔/הּ אֲרָי֖וֹת שֹֽׁאֲגִ֑ים שֹׁפְטֶ֨י/הָ֙ זְאֵ֣בֵי עֶ֔רֶב לֹ֥א גָרְמ֖וּ לַ/בֹּֽקֶר
verses.translit: shryh bqrbh 'ryvt sh'gym shptyh z'by 'rb l' grmv lbqr
verses.translation: Her princes within her are roaring lions; her judges are evening wolves; they gnaw not the bones till the morrow.

verses.original: נְבִיאֶ֨י/הָ֙ פֹּֽחֲזִ֔ים אַנְשֵׁ֖י בֹּֽגְד֑וֹת כֹּהֲנֶ֨י/הָ֙ חִלְּלוּ קֹ֔דֶשׁ חָמְס֖וּ תּוֹרָֽה
verses.translit: nby'yh pchzym 'nshy bgdvt khhnyh chllv qdsh chmsv tvrh
verses.translation: Her prophets are light and treacherous persons: her priests have polluted the sanctuary, they have done violence to the law.

verses.original: יְהוָ֤ה צַדִּיק֙ בְּ/קִרְבָּ֔/הּ לֹ֥א יַעֲשֶׂ֖ה עַוְלָ֑ה בַּ/בֹּ֨קֶר בַּ/בֹּ֜קֶר מִשְׁפָּט֨/וֹ יִתֵּ֤ן לָ/אוֹר֙ לֹ֣א נֶעְדָּ֔ר וְ/לֹֽא יוֹדֵ֥עַ עַוָּ֖ל בֹּֽשֶׁת
verses.translit: yhvh tsdyq bqrbh l' y'shh 'vlh bbqr bbqr mshptv ytn l'vr l' n'dr vl' yvd' 'vl bsht
verses.translation: The just LORD is in the midst thereof; he will not do iniquity: every morning doth he bring his judgment to light, he faileth not; but the unjust knoweth no shame.

verses.original: הִכְרַ֣תִּי גוֹיִ֗ם נָשַׁ֨מּוּ֙ פִּנּוֹתָ֔/ם הֶחֱרַ֥בְתִּי חֽוּצוֹתָ֖/ם מִ/בְּלִ֣י עוֹבֵ֑ר נִצְדּ֧וּ עָרֵי/הֶ֛ם מִ/בְּלִי אִ֖ישׁ מֵ/אֵ֥ין יוֹשֵֽׁב
verses.translit: hkhrty gvym nshmv pnvtm hchrbty chvtsvtm mbly 'vbr ntsdv 'ryhm mbly 'ysh m'yn yvshb
verses.translation: I have cut off the nations: their towers are desolate; I made their streets waste, that none passeth by: their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, that there is none inhabitant.

verses.original: אָמַ֜רְתִּי אַךְ תִּירְאִ֤י אוֹתִ/י֙ תִּקְחִ֣י מוּסָ֔ר וְ/לֹֽא יִכָּרֵ֣ת מְעוֹנָ֔/הּ כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר פָּקַ֖דְתִּי עָלֶ֑י/הָ אָכֵן֙ הִשְׁכִּ֣ימוּ הִשְׁחִ֔יתוּ כֹּ֖ל עֲלִילוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'mrty 'kh tyr'y 'vty tqchy mvsr vl' ykhrt m'vnh khl 'shr pqdty 'lyh 'khn hshkhymv hshchytv khl 'lylvtm
verses.translation: I said, Surely thou wilt fear me, thou wilt receive instruction; so their dwelling should not be cut off, howsoever I punished them: but they rose early, and corrupted all their doings.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֤ן חַכּוּ לִ/י֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה לְ/י֖וֹם קוּמִ֣/י לְ/עַ֑ד כִּ֣י מִשְׁפָּטִ/י֩ לֶ/אֱסֹ֨ף גּוֹיִ֜ם לְ/קָבְצִ֣/י מַמְלָכ֗וֹת לִ/שְׁפֹּ֨ךְ עֲלֵי/הֶ֤ם זַעְמִ/י֙ כֹּ֚ל חֲר֣וֹן אַפִּ֔/י כִּ֚י בְּ/אֵ֣שׁ קִנְאָתִ֔/י תֵּאָכֵ֖ל כָּל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: lkhn chkhv ly n'm yhvh lyvm qvmy l'd khy mshpty l'sf gvym lqbtsy mmlkhvt lshpkh 'lyhm z'my khl chrvn 'py khy b'sh qn'ty t'khl khl h'rts
verses.translation: Therefore wait ye upon me, saith the LORD , until the day that I rise up to the prey: for my determination is to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms, to pour upon them mine indignation, even all my fierce anger: for all the earth shall be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.

verses.original: כִּֽי אָ֛ז אֶהְפֹּ֥ךְ אֶל עַמִּ֖ים שָׂפָ֣ה בְרוּרָ֑ה לִ/קְרֹ֤א כֻלָּ/ם֙ בְּ/שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה לְ/עָבְד֖/וֹ שְׁכֶ֥ם אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: khy 'z 'hpkh 'l 'mym shph brvrh lqr' khlm bshm yhvh l'bdv shkhm 'chd
verses.translation: For then will I turn to the people a pure language, that they may all call upon the name of the LORD , to serve him with one consent.

verses.original: מֵ/עֵ֖בֶר לְ/נַֽהֲרֵי כ֑וּשׁ עֲתָרַ/י֙ בַּת פוּצַ֔/י יוֹבִל֖וּ/ן מִנְחָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: m'br lnhry khvsh 'try bt pvtsy yvblvn mnchty
verses.translation: From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia my suppliants, even the daughter of my dispersed, shall bring mine offering.

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא לֹ֤א תֵב֨וֹשִׁי֙ מִ/כֹּ֣ל עֲלִילֹתַ֔יִ/ךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּשַׁ֖עַתְּ בִּ֑/י כִּי אָ֣ז אָסִ֣יר מִ/קִּרְבֵּ֗/ךְ עַלִּיזֵי֙ גַּאֲוָתֵ֔/ךְ וְ/לֹֽא תוֹסִ֧פִי לְ/גָבְהָ֛ה ע֖וֹד בְּ/הַ֥ר קָדְשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: byvm hhv' l' tbvshy mkhl 'lyltykh 'shr psh't by khy 'z 'syr mqrbkh 'lyzy g'vtkh vl' tvspy lgbhh 'vd bhr qdshy
verses.translation: In that day shalt thou not be ashamed for all thy doings, wherein thou hast transgressed against me: for then I will take away out of the midst of thee them that rejoice in thy pride, and thou shalt no more be haughty because of my holy mountain.

verses.original: וְ/הִשְׁאַרְתִּ֣י בְ/קִרְבֵּ֔/ךְ עַ֥ם עָנִ֖י וָ/דָ֑ל וְ/חָס֖וּ בְּ/שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhsh'rty bqrbkh 'm 'ny vdl vchsv bshm yhvh
verses.translation: I will also leave in the midst of thee an afflicted and poor people, and they shall trust in the name of the LORD .

verses.original: שְׁאֵרִ֨ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל לֹֽא יַעֲשׂ֤וּ עַוְלָה֙ וְ/לֹא יְדַבְּר֣וּ כָזָ֔ב וְ/לֹֽא יִמָּצֵ֥א בְּ/פִי/הֶ֖ם לְשׁ֣וֹן תַּרְמִ֑ית כִּֽי הֵ֛מָּה יִרְע֥וּ וְ/רָבְצ֖וּ וְ/אֵ֥ין מַחֲרִֽיד
verses.translit: sh'ryt yshr'l l' y'shv 'vlh vl' ydbrv khzb vl' ymts' bpyhm lshvn trmyt khy hmh yr'v vrbtsv v'yn mchryd
verses.translation: The remnant of Israel shall not do iniquity, nor speak lies; neither shall a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth: for they shall feed and lie down, and none shall make them afraid.

verses.original: רָנִּי֙ בַּת צִיּ֔וֹן הָרִ֖יעוּ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל שִׂמְחִ֤י וְ/עָלְזִי֙ בְּ/כָל לֵ֔ב בַּ֖ת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: rny bt tsyvn hry'v yshr'l shmchy v'lzy bkhl lb bt yrvshlm
verses.translation: Sing, O daughter of Zion; shout, O Israel; be glad and rejoice with all the heart, O daughter of Jerusalem.

verses.original: הֵסִ֤יר יְהוָה֙ מִשְׁפָּטַ֔יִ/ךְ פִּנָּ֖ה אֹֽיְבֵ֑/ךְ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל יְהוָה֙ בְּ/קִרְבֵּ֔/ךְ לֹא תִֽירְאִ֥י רָ֖ע עֽוֹד
verses.translit: hsyr yhvh mshptykh pnh 'ybkh mlkh yshr'l yhvh bqrbkh l' tyr'y r' 'vd
verses.translation: The LORD hath taken away thy judgments, he hath cast out thine enemy: the king of Israel, even the LORD , is in the midst of thee: thou shalt not see evil any more.

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא יֵאָמֵ֥ר לִ/ירֽוּשָׁלִַ֖ם אַל תִּירָ֑אִי צִיּ֖וֹן אַל יִרְפּ֥וּ יָדָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: byvm hhv' y'mr lyrvshlm 'l tyr'y tsyvn 'l yrpv ydykh
verses.translation: In that day it shall be said to Jerusalem, Fear thou not: and to Zion, Let not thine hands be slack.

verses.original: יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהַ֛יִ/ךְ בְּ/קִרְבֵּ֖/ך גִּבּ֣וֹר יוֹשִׁ֑יעַ יָשִׂ֨ישׂ עָלַ֜יִ/ךְ בְּ/שִׂמְחָ֗ה יַחֲרִישׁ֙ בְּ/אַ֣הֲבָת֔/וֹ יָגִ֥יל עָלַ֖יִ/ךְ בְּ/רִנָּֽה
verses.translit: yhvh 'lhykh bqrbkh gbvr yvshy' yshysh 'lykh bshmchh ychrysh b'hbtv ygyl 'lykh brnh
verses.translation: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.

verses.original: נוּגֵ֧י מִ/מּוֹעֵ֛ד אָסַ֖פְתִּי מִמֵּ֣/ךְ הָי֑וּ מַשְׂאֵ֥ת עָלֶ֖י/הָ חֶרְפָּֽה
verses.translit: nvgy mmv'd 'spty mmkh hyv msh't 'lyh chrph
verses.translation: I will gather them that are sorrowful for the solemn assembly, who are of thee, to whom the reproach of it was a burden.

verses.original: הִנְ/נִ֥י עֹשֶׂ֛ה אֶת כָּל מְעַנַּ֖יִ/ךְ בָּ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֑יא וְ/הוֹשַׁעְתִּ֣י אֶת הַ/צֹּלֵעָ֗ה וְ/הַ/נִּדָּחָה֙ אֲקַבֵּ֔ץ וְ/שַׂמְתִּי/ם֙ לִ/תְהִלָּ֣ה וּ/לְ/שֵׁ֔ם בְּ/כָל הָ/אָ֖רֶץ בָּשְׁתָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: hnny 'shh 't khl m'nykh b't hhy' vhvsh'ty 't htsl'h vhndchh 'qbts vshmtym lthlh vlshm bkhl h'rts bshtm
verses.translation: Behold, at that time I will undo all that afflict thee: and I will save her that halteth, and gather her that was driven out; and I will get them praise and fame in every land where they have been put to shame.

verses.original: בָּ/עֵ֤ת הַ/הִיא֙ אָבִ֣יא אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם וּ/בָ/עֵ֖ת קַבְּצִ֣/י אֶתְ/כֶ֑ם כִּֽי אֶתֵּ֨ן אֶתְ/כֶ֜ם לְ/שֵׁ֣ם וְ/לִ/תְהִלָּ֗ה בְּ/כֹל֙ עַמֵּ֣י הָ/אָ֔רֶץ בְּ/שׁוּבִ֧/י אֶת שְׁבוּתֵי/כֶ֛ם לְ/עֵינֵי/כֶ֖ם אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: b't hhy' 'by' 'tkhm vb't qbtsy 'tkhm khy 'tn 'tkhm lshm vlthlh bkhl 'my h'rts bshvby 't shbvtykhm l'ynykhm 'mr yhvh
verses.translation: At that time will I bring you again , even in the time that I gather you: for I will make you a name and a praise among all people of the earth, when I turn back your captivity before your eyes, saith the LORD .

verses.original: בִּ/שְׁנַ֤ת שְׁתַּ֨יִם֙ לְ/דָרְיָ֣וֶשׁ הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ בַּ/חֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ הַ/שִּׁשִּׁ֔י בְּ/י֥וֹם אֶחָ֖ד לַ/חֹ֑דֶשׁ הָיָ֨ה דְבַר יְהוָ֜ה בְּ/יַד חַגַּ֣י הַ/נָּבִ֗יא אֶל זְרֻבָּבֶ֤ל בֶּן שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵל֙ פַּחַ֣ת יְהוּדָ֔ה וְ/אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֧עַ בֶּן יְהוֹצָדָ֛ק הַ/כֹּהֵ֥ן הַ/גָּד֖וֹל לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: bshnt shtym ldryvsh hmlkh bchdsh hshshy byvm 'chd lchdsh hyh dbr yhvh byd chgy hnby' 'l zrbbl bn sh'lty'l pcht yhvdh v'l yhvsh' bn yhvtsdq hkhhn hgdvl l'mr
verses.translation: In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, in the first day of the month, came the word of the LORD by Haggai the prophet unto Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, saying,

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הָ/עָ֤ם הַ/זֶּה֙ אָֽמְר֔וּ לֹ֥א עֶת בֹּ֛א עֶת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה לְ/הִבָּנֽוֹת
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt l'mr h'm hzh 'mrv l' 't b' 't byt yhvh lhbnvt
verses.translation: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, saying, This people say, The time is not come, the time that the LORD’s house should be built.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ דְּבַר יְהוָ֔ה בְּ/יַד חַגַּ֥י הַ/נָּבִ֖יא לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh byd chgy hnby' l'mr
verses.translation: Then came the word of the LORD by Haggai the prophet, saying,

verses.original: הַ/עֵ֤ת לָ/כֶם֙ אַתֶּ֔ם לָ/שֶׁ֖בֶת בְּ/בָתֵּי/כֶ֣ם סְפוּנִ֑ים וְ/הַ/בַּ֥יִת הַ/זֶּ֖ה חָרֵֽב
verses.translit: h't lkhm 'tm lshbt bbtykhm spvnym vhbyt hzh chrb
verses.translation: Is it time for you, O ye, to dwell in your cieled houses, and this house lie waste?

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֕ה כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת שִׂ֥ימוּ לְבַבְ/כֶ֖ם עַל דַּרְכֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'th khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt shymv lbbkhm 'l drkhykhm
verses.translation: Now therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts; Consider your ways.

verses.original: זְרַעְתֶּ֨ם הַרְבֵּ֜ה וְ/הָבֵ֣א מְעָ֗ט אָכ֤וֹל וְ/אֵין לְ/שָׂבְעָה֙ שָׁת֣וֹ וְ/אֵין לְ/שָׁכְרָ֔ה לָב֖וֹשׁ וְ/אֵין לְ/חֹ֣ם ל֑/וֹ וְ/הַ֨/מִּשְׂתַּכֵּ֔ר מִשְׂתַּכֵּ֖ר אֶל צְר֥וֹר נָקֽוּב
verses.translit: zr'tm hrbh vhb' m't 'khvl v'yn lshb'h shtv v'yn lshkhrh lbvsh v'yn lchm lv vhmshtkhr mshtkhr 'l tsrvr nqvb
verses.translation: Ye have sown much, and bring in little; ye eat, but ye have not enough; ye drink, but ye are not filled with drink; ye clothe you, but there is none warm; and he that earneth wages earneth wages to put it into a bag with holes.

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת שִׂ֥ימוּ לְבַבְ/כֶ֖ם עַל דַּרְכֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt shymv lbbkhm 'l drkhykhm
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Consider your ways.

verses.original: עֲל֥וּ הָ/הָ֛ר וַ/הֲבֵאתֶ֥ם עֵ֖ץ וּ/בְנ֣וּ הַ/בָּ֑יִת וְ/אֶרְצֶה בּ֥/וֹ ו/אכבד וְ/אֶכָּבְדָ֖ה אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'lv hhr vhb'tm 'ts vbnv hbyt v'rtsh bv v'khbd v'khbdh 'mr yhvh
verses.translation: Go up to the mountain, and bring wood, and build the house; and I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified, saith the LORD .

verses.original: פָּנֹ֤ה אֶל הַרְבֵּה֙ וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה לִ/מְעָ֔ט וַ/הֲבֵאתֶ֥ם הַ/בַּ֖יִת וְ/נָפַ֣חְתִּי ב֑/וֹ יַ֣עַן מֶ֗ה נְאֻם֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת יַ֗עַן בֵּיתִ/י֙ אֲשֶׁר ה֣וּא חָרֵ֔ב וְ/אַתֶּ֥ם רָצִ֖ים אִ֥ישׁ לְ/בֵיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: pnh 'l hrbh vhnh lm't vhb'tm hbyt vnpchty bv y'n mh n'm yhvh tsb'vt y'n byty 'shr hv' chrb v'tm rtsym 'ysh lbytv
verses.translation: Ye looked for much, and, lo, it came to little; and when ye brought it home, I did blow upon it. Why? saith the LORD of hosts. Because of mine house that is waste, and ye run every man unto his own house.

verses.original: עַל כֵּ֣ן עֲלֵי/כֶ֔ם כָּלְא֥וּ שָמַ֖יִם מִ/טָּ֑ל וְ/הָ/אָ֖רֶץ כָּלְאָ֥ה יְבוּלָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: 'l khn 'lykhm khl'v shmym mtl vh'rts khl'h ybvlh
verses.translation: Therefore the heaven over you is stayed from dew, and the earth is stayed from her fruit.

verses.original: וָ/אֶקְרָ֨א חֹ֜רֶב עַל הָ/אָ֣רֶץ וְ/עַל הֶ/הָרִ֗ים וְ/עַל הַ/דָּגָן֙ וְ/עַל הַ/תִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְ/עַל הַ/יִּצְהָ֔ר וְ/עַ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר תּוֹצִ֖יא הָ/אֲדָמָ֑ה וְ/עַל הָֽ/אָדָם֙ וְ/עַל הַ/בְּהֵמָ֔ה וְ/עַ֖ל כָּל יְגִ֥יעַ כַּפָּֽיִם
verses.translit: v'qr' chrb 'l h'rts v'l hhrym v'l hdgn v'l htyrvsh v'l hytshr v'l 'shr tvtsy' h'dmh v'l h'dm v'l hbhmh v'l khl ygy' khpym
verses.translation: And I called for a drought upon the land, and upon the mountains, and upon the corn, and upon the new wine, and upon the oil, and upon that which the ground bringeth forth, and upon men, and upon cattle, and upon all the labour of the hands.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֣ע זְרֻבָּבֶ֣ל בֶּֽן שַׁלְתִּיאֵ֡ל וִ/יהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בֶּן יְהוֹצָדָק֩ הַ/כֹּהֵ֨ן הַ/גָּד֜וֹל וְ/כֹ֣ל שְׁאֵרִ֣ית הָ/עָ֗ם בְּ/קוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/עַל דִּבְרֵי֙ חַגַּ֣י הַ/נָּבִ֔יא כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר שְׁלָח֖/וֹ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יִּֽירְא֥וּ הָ/עָ֖ם מִ/פְּנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyshm' zrbbl bn shlty'l vyhvsh' bn yhvtsdq hkhhn hgdvl vkhl sh'ryt h'm bqvl yhvh 'lhyhm v'l dbry chgy hnby' kh'shr shlchv yhvh 'lhyhm vyyr'v h'm mpny yhvh
verses.translation: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed the voice of the LORD their God, and the words of Haggai the prophet, as the LORD their God had sent him, and the people did fear before the LORD .

verses.original: וַ֠/יֹּאמֶר חַגַּ֞י מַלְאַ֧ךְ יְהוָ֛ה בְּ/מַלְאֲכ֥וּת יְהוָ֖ה לָ/עָ֣ם לֵ/אמֹ֑ר אֲנִ֥י אִתְּ/כֶ֖ם נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr chgy ml'kh yhvh bml'khvt yhvh l'm l'mr 'ny 'tkhm n'm yhvh
verses.translation: Then spake Haggai the LORD’s messenger in the LORD’s message unto the people, saying, I am with you, saith the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣עַר יְהוָ֡ה אֶת רוּחַ֩ זְרֻבָּבֶ֨ל בֶּן שַׁלְתִּיאֵ֜ל פַּחַ֣ת יְהוּדָ֗ה וְ/אֶת ר֨וּחַ֙ יְהוֹשֻׁ֤עַ בֶּן יְהוֹצָדָק֙ הַ/כֹּהֵ֣ן הַ/גָּד֔וֹל וְֽ/אֶת ר֔וּחַ כֹּ֖ל שְׁאֵרִ֣ית הָ/עָ֑ם וַ/יָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ וַ/יַּעֲשׂ֣וּ מְלָאכָ֔ה בְּ/בֵית יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'r yhvh 't rvch zrbbl bn shlty'l pcht yhvdh v't rvch yhvsh' bn yhvtsdq hkhhn hgdvl v't rvch khl sh'ryt h'm vyb'v vy'shv ml'khh bbyt yhvh tsb'vt 'lhyhm
verses.translation: And the LORD stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they came and did work in the house of the LORD of hosts, their God,

verses.translit: byvm 'shrym v'rb'h lchdsh bshshy bshnt shtym ldryvsh hmlkh
verses.translation: In the four and twentieth day of the sixth month, in the second year of Darius the king.

verses.original: בַּ/שְּׁבִיעִ֕י בְּ/עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְ/אֶחָ֖ד לַ/חֹ֑דֶשׁ הָיָה֙ דְּבַר יְהוָ֔ה בְּ/יַד חַגַּ֥י הַ/נָּבִ֖יא לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: bshby'y b'shrym v'chd lchdsh hyh dbr yhvh byd chgy hnby' l'mr
verses.translation: In the seventh month , in the one and twentieth day of the month, came the word of the LORD by the prophet Haggai, saying,

verses.original: אֱמָר נָ֗א אֶל זְרֻבָּבֶ֤ל בֶּן שַׁלְתִּיאֵל֙ פַּחַ֣ת יְהוּדָ֔ה וְ/אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֥עַ בֶּן יְהוֹצָדָ֖ק הַ/כֹּהֵ֣ן הַ/גָּד֑וֹל וְ/אֶל שְׁאֵרִ֥ית הָ/עָ֖ם לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: 'mr n' 'l zrbbl bn shlty'l pcht yhvdh v'l yhvsh' bn yhvtsdq hkhhn hgdvl v'l sh'ryt h'm l'mr
verses.translation: Speak now to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, and to the residue of the people, saying,

verses.original: מִ֤י בָ/כֶם֙ הַ/נִּשְׁאָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֤ר רָאָה֙ אֶת הַ/בַּ֣יִת הַ/זֶּ֔ה בִּ/כְבוֹד֖/וֹ הָ/רִאשׁ֑וֹן וּ/מָ֨ה אַתֶּ֜ם רֹאִ֤ים אֹת/וֹ֙ עַ֔תָּה הֲ/ל֥וֹא כָמֹ֛/הוּ כְּ/אַ֖יִן בְּ/עֵינֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: my bkhm hnsh'r 'shr r'h 't hbyt hzh bkhbvdv hr'shvn vmh 'tm r'ym 'tv 'th hlv' khmhv kh'yn b'ynykhm
verses.translation: Who is left among you that saw this house in her first glory? and how do ye see it now? is it not in your eyes in comparison of it as nothing?

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֣ה חֲזַ֣ק זְרֻבָּבֶ֣ל נְאֻם יְהוָ֡ה וַ/חֲזַ֣ק יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בֶּן יְהוֹצָדָק֩ הַ/כֹּהֵ֨ן הַ/גָּד֜וֹל וַ/חֲזַ֨ק כָּל עַ֥ם הָ/אָ֛רֶץ נְאֻם יְהוָ֖ה וַֽ/עֲשׂ֑וּ כִּֽי אֲנִ֣י אִתְּ/כֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: v'th chzq zrbbl n'm yhvh vchzq yhvsh' bn yhvtsdq hkhhn hgdvl vchzq khl 'm h'rts n'm yhvh v'shv khy 'ny 'tkhm n'm yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: Yet now be strong, O Zerubbabel, saith the LORD ; and be strong, O Joshua, son of Josedech, the high priest; and be strong, all ye people of the land, saith the LORD , and work: for I am with you, saith the LORD of hosts:

verses.original: אֶֽת הַ/דָּבָ֞ר אֲשֶׁר כָּרַ֤תִּי אִתְּ/כֶם֙ בְּ/צֵאתְ/כֶ֣ם מִ/מִּצְרַ֔יִם וְ/רוּחִ֖/י עֹמֶ֣דֶת בְּ/תוֹכְ/כֶ֑ם אַל תִּירָֽאוּ
verses.translit: 't hdbr 'shr khrty 'tkhm bts'tkhm mmtsrym vrvchy 'mdt btvkhkhm 'l tyr'v
verses.translation: According to the word that I covenanted with you when ye came out of Egypt, so my spirit remaineth among you: fear ye not.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת ע֥וֹד אַחַ֖ת מְעַ֣ט הִ֑יא וַ/אֲנִ֗י מַרְעִישׁ֙ אֶת הַ/שָּׁמַ֣יִם וְ/אֶת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/אֶת הַ/יָּ֖ם וְ/אֶת הֶ/חָרָבָֽה
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'vd 'cht m't hy' v'ny mr'ysh 't hshmym v't h'rts v't hym v't hchrbh
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD of hosts; Yet once, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, and the earth, and the sea, and the dry land;

verses.original: וְ/הִרְעַשְׁתִּי֙ אֶת כָּל הַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם וּ/בָ֖אוּ חֶמְדַּ֣ת כָּל הַ/גּוֹיִ֑ם וּ/מִלֵּאתִ֞י אֶת הַ/בַּ֤יִת הַ/זֶּה֙ כָּב֔וֹד אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vhr'shty 't khl hgvym vb'v chmdt khl hgvym vml'ty 't hbyt hzh khbvd 'mr yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: And I will shake all nations, and the desire of all nations shall come: and I will fill this house with glory, saith the LORD of hosts.

verses.original: לִ֥/י הַ/כֶּ֖סֶף וְ/לִ֣/י הַ/זָּהָ֑ב נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: ly hkhsf vly hzhb n'm yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: The silver is mine, and the gold is mine, saith the LORD of hosts.

verses.original: גָּד֣וֹל יִֽהְיֶ֡ה כְּבוֹד֩ הַ/בַּ֨יִת הַ/זֶּ֤ה הָ/אַֽחֲרוֹן֙ מִן הָ֣/רִאשׁ֔וֹן אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת וּ/בַ/מָּק֤וֹם הַ/זֶּה֙ אֶתֵּ֣ן שָׁל֔וֹם נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: gdvl yhyh khbvd hbyt hzh h'chrvn mn hr'shvn 'mr yhvh tsb'vt vbmqvm hzh 'tn shlvm n'm yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: The glory of this latter house shall be greater than of the former, saith the LORD of hosts: and in this place will I give peace, saith the LORD of hosts.

verses.original: בְּ/עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וְ/אַרְבָּעָה֙ לַ/תְּשִׁיעִ֔י בִּ/שְׁנַ֥ת שְׁתַּ֖יִם לְ/דָרְיָ֑וֶשׁ הָיָה֙ דְּבַר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל חַגַּ֥י הַ/נָּבִ֖יא לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: b'shrym v'rb'h ltshy'y bshnt shtym ldryvsh hyh dbr yhvh 'l chgy hnby' l'mr
verses.translation: In the four and twentieth day of the ninth month , in the second year of Darius, came the word of the LORD by Haggai the prophet, saying,

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת שְׁאַל נָ֧א אֶת הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֛ים תּוֹרָ֖ה לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt sh'l n' 't hkhhnym tvrh l'mr
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Ask now the priests concerning the law, saying,

verses.original: הֵ֣ן יִשָּׂא אִ֨ישׁ בְּשַׂר קֹ֜דֶשׁ בִּ/כְנַ֣ף בִּגְד֗/וֹ וְ/נָגַ֣ע בִּ֠/כְנָפ/וֹ אֶל הַ/לֶּ֨חֶם וְ/אֶל הַ/נָּזִ֜יד וְ/אֶל הַ/יַּ֧יִן וְ/אֶל שֶׁ֛מֶן וְ/אֶל כָּל מַאֲכָ֖ל הֲ/יִקְדָּ֑שׁ וַ/יַּעֲנ֧וּ הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֛ים וַ/יֹּאמְר֖וּ לֹֽא
verses.translit: hn ysh' 'ysh bshr qdsh bkhnf bgdv vng' bkhnpv 'l hlchm v'l hnzyd v'l hyyn v'l shmn v'l khl m'khl hyqdsh vy'nv hkhhnym vy'mrv l'
verses.translation: If one bear holy flesh in the skirt of his garment, and with his skirt do touch bread, or pottage, or wine, or oil, or any meat, shall it be holy? And the priests answered and said, No.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר חַגַּ֔י אִם יִגַּ֧ע טְמֵא נֶ֛פֶשׁ בְּ/כָל אֵ֖לֶּה הֲ/יִטְמָ֑א וַ/יַּעֲנ֧וּ הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֛ים וַ/יֹּאמְר֖וּ יִטְמָֽא
verses.translit: vy'mr chgy 'm yg' tm' npsh bkhl 'lh hytm' vy'nv hkhhnym vy'mrv ytm'
verses.translation: Then said Haggai, If one that is unclean by a dead body touch any of these, shall it be unclean? And the priests answered and said, It shall be unclean.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַן חַגַּ֜י וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר כֵּ֣ן הָֽ/עָם הַ֠/זֶּה וְ/כֵן הַ/גּ֨וֹי הַ/זֶּ֤ה לְ/פָנַ/י֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה וְ/כֵ֖ן כָּל מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יְדֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַקְרִ֛יבוּ שָׁ֖ם טָמֵ֥א הֽוּא
verses.translit: vy'n chgy vy'mr khn h'm hzh vkhn hgvy hzh lpny n'm yhvh vkhn khl m'shh ydyhm v'shr yqrybv shm tm' hv'
verses.translation: Then answered Haggai, and said, So is this people, and so is this nation before me, saith the LORD ; and so is every work of their hands; and that which they offer there is unclean.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּה֙ שִֽׂימוּ נָ֣א לְבַבְ/כֶ֔ם מִן הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּ֖ה וָ/מָ֑עְלָ/ה מִ/טֶּ֧רֶם שֽׂוּם אֶ֛בֶן אֶל אֶ֖בֶן בְּ/הֵיכַ֥ל יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: v'th shymv n' lbbkhm mn hyvm hzh vm'lh mtrm shvm 'bn 'l 'bn bhykhl yhvh
verses.translation: And now, I pray you, consider from this day and upward, from before a stone was laid upon a stone in the temple of the LORD :

verses.original: מִֽ/הְיוֹתָ֥/ם בָּא֙ אֶל עֲרֵמַ֣ת עֶשְׂרִ֔ים וְ/הָיְתָ֖ה עֲשָׂרָ֑ה בָּ֣א אֶל הַ/יֶּ֗קֶב לַ/חְשֹׂף֙ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים פּוּרָ֔ה וְ/הָיְתָ֖ה עֶשְׂרִֽים
verses.translit: mhyvtm b' 'l 'rmt 'shrym vhyth 'shrh b' 'l hyqb lchshf chmshym pvrh vhyth 'shrym
verses.translation: Since those days were, when one came to an heap of twenty measures , there were but ten: when one came to the pressfat for to draw out fifty vessels out of the press, there were but twenty.

verses.original: הִכֵּ֨יתִי אֶתְ/כֶ֜ם בַּ/שִּׁדָּפ֤וֹן וּ/בַ/יֵּֽרָקוֹן֙ וּ/בַ/בָּרָ֔ד אֵ֖ת כָּל מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יְדֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/אֵין אֶתְ/כֶ֥ם אֵלַ֖/י נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: hkhyty 'tkhm bshdpvn vbyrqvn vbbrd 't khl m'shh ydykhm v'yn 'tkhm 'ly n'm yhvh
verses.translation: I smote you with blasting and with mildew and with hail in all the labours of your hands; yet ye turned not to me, saith the LORD .

verses.original: שִׂימוּ נָ֣א לְבַבְ/כֶ֔ם מִן הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּ֖ה וָ/מָ֑עְלָ/ה מִ/יּוֹם֩ עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְ/אַרְבָּעָ֜ה לַ/תְּשִׁיעִ֗י לְ/מִן הַ/יּ֛וֹם אֲשֶׁר יֻסַּ֥ד הֵֽיכַל יְהוָ֖ה שִׂ֥ימוּ לְבַבְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: shymv n' lbbkhm mn hyvm hzh vm'lh myvm 'shrym v'rb'h ltshy'y lmn hyvm 'shr ysd hykhl yhvh shymv lbbkhm
verses.translation: Consider now from this day and upward, from the four and twentieth day of the ninth month, even from the day that the foundation of the LORD’s temple was laid, consider it .

verses.original: הַ/ע֤וֹד הַ/זֶּ֨רַע֙ בַּ/מְּגוּרָ֔ה וְ/עַד הַ/גֶּ֨פֶן וְ/הַ/תְּאֵנָ֧ה וְ/הָ/רִמּ֛וֹן וְ/עֵ֥ץ הַ/זַּ֖יִת לֹ֣א נָשָׂ֑א מִן הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּ֖ה אֲבָרֵֽךְ
verses.translit: h'vd hzr' bmgvrh v'd hgpn vht'nh vhrmvn v'ts hzyt l' nsh' mn hyvm hzh 'brkh
verses.translation: Is the seed yet in the barn? yea, as yet the vine, and the fig tree, and the pomegranate, and the olive tree, hath not brought forth: from this day will I bless you .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֨י דְבַר יְהוָ֤ה שֵׁנִית֙ אֶל חַגַּ֔י בְּ/עֶשְׂרִ֧ים וְ/אַרְבָּעָ֛ה לַ/חֹ֖דֶשׁ לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh shnyt 'l chgy b'shrym v'rb'h lchdsh l'mr
verses.translation: And again the word of the LORD came unto Haggai in the four and twentieth day of the month, saying,

verses.original: אֱמֹ֕ר אֶל זְרֻבָּבֶ֥ל פַּֽחַת יְהוּדָ֖ה לֵ/אמֹ֑ר אֲנִ֣י מַרְעִ֔ישׁ אֶת הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם וְ/אֶת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: 'mr 'l zrbbl pcht yhvdh l'mr 'ny mr'ysh 't hshmym v't h'rts
verses.translation: Speak to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, saying, I will shake the heavens and the earth;

verses.original: וְ/הָֽפַכְתִּי֙ כִּסֵּ֣א מַמְלָכ֔וֹת וְ/הִ֨שְׁמַדְתִּ֔י חֹ֖זֶק מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הַ/גּוֹיִ֑ם וְ/הָפַכְתִּ֤י מֶרְכָּבָה֙ וְ/רֹ֣כְבֶ֔י/הָ וְ/יָרְד֤וּ סוּסִים֙ וְ/רֹ֣כְבֵי/הֶ֔ם אִ֖ישׁ בְּ/חֶ֥רֶב אָחִֽי/ו
verses.translit: vhpkhty khs' mmlkhvt vhshmdty chzq mmlkhvt hgvym vhpkhty mrkhbh vrkhbyh vyrdv svsym vrkhbyhm 'ysh bchrb 'chyv
verses.translation: And I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms, and I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the heathen; and I will overthrow the chariots, and those that ride in them; and the horses and their riders shall come down, every one by the sword of his brother.

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֣וּא נְאֻם יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֡וֹת אֶ֠קָּחֲ/ךָ זְרֻבָּבֶ֨ל בֶּן שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵ֤ל עַבְדִּ/י֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה וְ/שַׂמְתִּ֖י/ךָ כַּֽ/חוֹתָ֑ם כִּֽי בְ/ךָ֣ בָחַ֔רְתִּי נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: byvm hhv' n'm yhvh tsb'vt 'qchkh zrbbl bn sh'lty'l 'bdy n'm yhvh vshmtykh khchvtm khy bkh bchrty n'm yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: In that day, saith the LORD of hosts, will I take thee, O Zerubbabel, my servant, the son of Shealtiel, saith the LORD , and will make thee as a signet: for I have chosen thee, saith the LORD of hosts.

verses.original: בַּ/חֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ הַ/שְּׁמִינִ֔י בִּ/שְׁנַ֥ת שְׁתַּ֖יִם לְ/דָרְיָ֑וֶשׁ הָיָ֣ה דְבַר יְהוָ֗ה אֶל זְכַרְיָה֙ בֶּן בֶּ֣רֶכְיָ֔ה בֶּן עִדּ֥וֹ הַ/נָּבִ֖יא לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: bchdsh hshmyny bshnt shtym ldryvsh hyh dbr yhvh 'l zkhryh bn brkhyh bn 'dv hnby' l'mr
verses.translation: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the LORD unto Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying,

verses.original: קָצַ֧ף יְהוָ֛ה עַל אֲבֽוֹתֵי/כֶ֖ם קָֽצֶף
verses.translit: qtsf yhvh 'l 'bvtykhm qtsf
verses.translation: The LORD hath been sore displeased with your fathers.

verses.original: וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵ/הֶ֗ם כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת שׁ֣וּבוּ אֵלַ֔/י נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת וְ/אָשׁ֣וּב אֲלֵי/כֶ֔ם אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: v'mrt 'lhm khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt shvbv 'ly n'm yhvh tsb'vt v'shvb 'lykhm 'mr yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: Therefore say thou unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Turn ye unto me, saith the LORD of hosts, and I will turn unto you, saith the LORD of hosts.

verses.original: אַל תִּהְי֣וּ כַ/אֲבֹֽתֵי/כֶ֡ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר קָרְאֽוּ אֲלֵי/הֶם֩ הַ/נְּבִיאִ֨ים הָ/רִֽאשֹׁנִ֜ים לֵ/אמֹ֗ר כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת שׁ֤וּבוּ נָא֙ מִ/דַּרְכֵי/כֶ֣ם הָ/רָעִ֔ים ו/מעלילי/כם וּ/מַֽעֲלְלֵי/כֶ֖ם הָֽ/רָעִ֑ים וְ/לֹ֥א שָׁמְע֛וּ וְ/לֹֽא הִקְשִׁ֥יבוּ אֵלַ֖/י נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'l thyv kh'btykhm 'shr qr'v 'lyhm hnby'ym hr'shnym l'mr khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt shvbv n' mdrkhykhm hr'ym vm'lylykhm vm'llykhm hr'ym vl' shm'v vl' hqshybv 'ly n'm yhvh
verses.translation: Be ye not as your fathers, unto whom the former prophets have cried, saying, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Turn ye now from your evil ways, and from your evil doings: but they did not hear, nor hearken unto me, saith the LORD .

verses.original: אֲבֽוֹתֵי/כֶ֖ם אַיֵּה הֵ֑ם וְ/הַ֨/נְּבִאִ֔ים הַ/לְ/עוֹלָ֖ם יִֽחְיֽוּ
