verses.translit: 'bvtykhm 'yh hm vhnb'ym hl'vlm ychyv
verses.translation: Your fathers, where are they? and the prophets, do they live for ever?

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ דְּבָרַ֣/י וְ/חֻקַּ֗/י אֲשֶׁ֤ר צִוִּ֨יתִי֙ אֶת עֲבָדַ֣/י הַ/נְּבִיאִ֔ים הֲ/ל֥וֹא הִשִּׂ֖יגוּ אֲבֹתֵי/כֶ֑ם וַ/יָּשׁ֣וּבוּ וַ/יֹּאמְר֗וּ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר זָמַ֜ם יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ לַ/עֲשׂ֣וֹת לָ֔/נוּ כִּ/דְרָכֵ֨י/נוּ֙ וּ/כְ/מַ֣עֲלָלֵ֔י/נוּ כֵּ֖ן עָשָׂ֥ה אִתָּֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: 'kh dbry vchqy 'shr tsvyty 't 'bdy hnby'ym hlv' hshygv 'btykhm vyshvbv vy'mrv kh'shr zmm yhvh tsb'vt l'shvt lnv khdrkhynv vkhm'llynv khn 'shh 'tnv
verses.translation: But my words and my statutes, which I commanded my servants the prophets, did they not take hold of your fathers? and they returned and said, Like as the LORD of hosts thought to do unto us, according to our ways, and according to our doings, so hath he dealt with us.

verses.original: בְּ/יוֹם֩ עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְ/אַרְבָּעָ֜ה לְ/עַשְׁתֵּֽי עָשָׂ֥ר חֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ הוּא חֹ֣דֶשׁ שְׁבָ֔ט בִּ/שְׁנַ֥ת שְׁתַּ֖יִם לְ/דָרְיָ֑וֶשׁ הָיָ֣ה דְבַר יְהוָ֗ה אֶל זְכַרְיָה֙ בֶּן בֶּ֣רֶכְיָ֔הוּ בֶּן עִדּ֥וֹא הַ/נָּבִ֖יא לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: byvm 'shrym v'rb'h l'shty 'shr chdsh hv' chdsh shbt bshnt shtym ldryvsh hyh dbr yhvh 'l zkhryh bn brkhyhv bn 'dv' hnby' l'mr
verses.translation: Upon the four and twentieth day of the eleventh month, which is the month Sebat, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the LORD unto Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying,

verses.original: רָאִ֣יתִי הַ/לַּ֗יְלָה וְ/הִנֵּה אִישׁ֙ רֹכֵב֙ עַל ס֣וּס אָדֹ֔ם וְ/ה֣וּא עֹמֵ֔ד בֵּ֥ין הַ/הֲדַסִּ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ/מְּצֻלָ֑ה וְ/אַחֲרָי/ו֙ סוּסִ֣ים אֲדֻמִּ֔ים שְׂרֻקִּ֖ים וּ/לְבָנִֽים
verses.translit: r'yty hlylh vhnh 'ysh rkhb 'l svs 'dm vhv' 'md byn hhdsym 'shr bmtslh v'chryv svsym 'dmym shrqym vlbnym
verses.translation: I saw by night, and behold a man riding upon a red horse, and he stood among the myrtle trees that were in the bottom; and behind him were there red horses, speckled, and white.

verses.original: וָ/אֹמַ֖ר מָה אֵ֣לֶּה אֲדֹנִ֑/י וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗/י הַ/מַּלְאָךְ֙ הַ/דֹּבֵ֣ר בִּ֔/י אֲנִ֥י אַרְאֶ֖/ךָּ מָה הֵ֥מָּה אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: v'mr mh 'lh 'dny vy'mr 'ly hml'kh hdbr by 'ny 'r'kh mh hmh 'lh
verses.translation: Then said I, O my lord, what are these? And the angel that talked with me said unto me, I will shew thee what these be .

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֗עַן הָ/אִ֛ישׁ הָ/עֹמֵ֥ד בֵּין הַ/הַדַסִּ֖ים וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר אֵ֚לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁלַ֣ח יְהוָ֔ה לְ/הִתְהַלֵּ֖ךְ בָּ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vy'n h'ysh h'md byn hhdsym vy'mr 'lh 'shr shlch yhvh lhthlkh b'rts
verses.translation: And the man that stood among the myrtle trees answered and said, These are they whom the LORD hath sent to walk to and fro through the earth.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּעֲנ֞וּ אֶת מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֗ה הָֽ/עֹמֵד֙ בֵּ֣ין הַ/הֲדַסִּ֔ים וַ/יֹּאמְר֖וּ הִתְהַלַּ֣כְנוּ בָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה כָל הָ/אָ֖רֶץ יֹשֶׁ֥בֶת וְ/שֹׁקָֽטֶת
verses.translit: vy'nv 't ml'kh yhvh h'md byn hhdsym vy'mrv hthlkhnv b'rts vhnh khl h'rts yshbt vshqtt
verses.translation: And they answered the angel of the LORD that stood among the myrtle trees, and said, We have walked to and fro through the earth, and, behold, all the earth sitteth still, and is at rest.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַן מַלְאַךְ יְהוָה֮ וַ/יֹּאמַר֒ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת עַד מָתַ֗י אַתָּה֙ לֹֽא תְרַחֵ֣ם אֶת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְ/אֵ֖ת עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר זָעַ֔מְתָּה זֶ֖ה שִׁבְעִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: vy'n ml'kh yhvh vy'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'd mty 'th l' trchm 't yrvshlm v't 'ry yhvdh 'shr z'mth zh shb'ym shnh
verses.translation: Then the angel of the LORD answered and said, O LORD of hosts, how long wilt thou not have mercy on Jerusalem and on the cities of Judah, against which thou hast had indignation these threescore and ten years?

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַן יְהוָ֗ה אֶת הַ/מַּלְאָ֛ךְ הַ/דֹּבֵ֥ר בִּ֖/י דְּבָרִ֣ים טוֹבִ֑ים דְּבָרִ֖ים נִחֻמִֽים
verses.translit: vy'n yhvh 't hml'kh hdbr by dbrym tvbym dbrym nchmym
verses.translation: And the LORD answered the angel that talked with me with good words and comfortable words.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗/י הַ/מַּלְאָךְ֙ הַ/דֹּבֵ֣ר בִּ֔/י קְרָ֣א לֵ/אמֹ֔ר כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת קִנֵּ֧אתִי לִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֛ם וּ/לְ/צִיּ֖וֹן קִנְאָ֥ה גְדוֹלָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly hml'kh hdbr by qr' l'mr khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt qn'ty lyrvshlm vltsyvn qn'h gdvlh
verses.translation: So the angel that communed with me said unto me, Cry thou, saying, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with a great jealousy.

verses.original: וְ/קֶ֤צֶף גָּדוֹל֙ אֲנִ֣י קֹצֵ֔ף עַל הַ/גּוֹיִ֖ם הַ/שַּֽׁאֲנַנִּ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֲנִי֙ קָצַ֣פְתִּי מְּעָ֔ט וְ/הֵ֖מָּה עָזְר֥וּ לְ/רָעָֽה
verses.translit: vqtsf gdvl 'ny qtsf 'l hgvym hsh'nnym 'shr 'ny qtspty m't vhmh 'zrv lr'h
verses.translation: And I am very sore displeased with the heathen that are at ease: for I was but a little displeased, and they helped forward the affliction.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֞ן כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה שַׁ֤בְתִּי לִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ בְּֽ/רַחֲמִ֔ים בֵּיתִ/י֙ יִבָּ֣נֶה בָּ֔/הּ נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת ו/קוה וְ/קָ֥ו יִנָּטֶ֖ה עַל יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr yhvh shbty lyrvshlm brchmym byty ybnh bh n'm yhvh tsb'vt vqvh vqv ynth 'l yrvshlm
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD ; I am returned to Jerusalem with mercies: my house shall be built in it, saith the LORD of hosts, and a line shall be stretched forth upon Jerusalem.

verses.original: ע֣וֹד קְרָ֣א לֵ/אמֹ֗ר כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת ע֛וֹד תְּפוּצֶ֥ינָה עָרַ֖/י מִ/טּ֑וֹב וְ/נִחַ֨ם יְהוָ֥ה עוֹד֙ אֶת צִיּ֔וֹן וּ/בָחַ֥ר ע֖וֹד בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: 'vd qr' l'mr khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'vd tpvtsynh 'ry mtvb vnchm yhvh 'vd 't tsyvn vbchr 'vd byrvshlm
verses.translation: Cry yet, saying, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; My cities through prosperity shall yet be spread abroad; and the LORD shall yet comfort Zion, and shall yet choose Jerusalem.
Then lifted I up mine eyes, and saw, and behold four horns.
And I said unto the angel that talked with me, What be these? And he answered me, These are the horns which have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem.
And the LORD shewed me four carpenters.

Then said I, What come these to do? And he spake, saying, These are the horns which have scattered Judah, so that no man did lift up his head: but these are come to fray them, to cast out the horns of the Gentiles, which lifted up their horn over the land of Judah to scatter it.

verses.original: וָ/אֶשָּׂ֥א אֶת עֵינַ֖/י וָ/אֵ֑רֶא וְ/הִנֵּ֖ה אַרְבַּ֥ע קְרָנֽוֹת
verses.translit: v'sh' 't 'yny v'r' vhnh 'rb' qrnvt
verses.translation: I lifted up mine eyes again, and looked, and behold a man with a measuring line in his hand.

verses.original: וָ/אֹמַ֗ר אֶל הַ/מַּלְאָ֛ךְ הַ/דֹּבֵ֥ר בִּ֖/י מָה אֵ֑לֶּה וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔/י אֵ֤לֶּה הַ/קְּרָנוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר זֵר֣וּ אֶת יְהוּדָ֔ה אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וִ/ירוּשָׁלָֽם
verses.translit: v'mr 'l hml'kh hdbr by mh 'lh vy'mr 'ly 'lh hqrnvt 'shr zrv 't yhvdh 't yshr'l vyrvshlm
verses.translation: Then said I, Whither goest thou? And he said unto me, To measure Jerusalem, to see what is the breadth thereof, and what is the length thereof.

verses.original: וַ/יַּרְאֵ֣/נִי יְהוָ֔ה אַרְבָּעָ֖ה חָרָשִֽׁים
verses.translit: vyr'ny yhvh 'rb'h chrshym
verses.translation: And, behold, the angel that talked with me went forth, and another angel went out to meet him,

verses.original: וָ/אֹמַ֕ר מָ֛ה אֵ֥לֶּה בָאִ֖ים לַֽ/עֲשׂ֑וֹת וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לֵ/אמֹ֗ר אֵ֣לֶּה הַ/קְּרָנ֞וֹת אֲשֶׁר זֵ֣רוּ אֶת יְהוּדָ֗ה כְּ/פִי אִישׁ֙ לֹא נָשָׂ֣א רֹאשׁ֔/וֹ וַ/יָּבֹ֤אוּ אֵ֨לֶּה֙ לְ/הַחֲרִ֣יד אֹתָ֔/ם לְ/יַדּ֞וֹת אֶת קַרְנ֣וֹת הַ/גּוֹיִ֗ם הַ/נֹּשְׂאִ֥ים קֶ֛רֶן אֶל אֶ֥רֶץ יְהוּדָ֖ה לְ/זָרוֹתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: v'mr mh 'lh b'ym l'shvt vy'mr l'mr 'lh hqrnvt 'shr zrv 't yhvdh khpy 'ysh l' nsh' r'shv vyb'v 'lh lhchryd 'tm lydvt 't qrnvt hgvym hnsh'ym qrn 'l 'rts yhvdh lzrvth
verses.translation: And said unto him, Run, speak to this young man, saying, Jerusalem shall be inhabited as towns without walls for the multitude of men and cattle therein:

verses.original: וָ/אֶשָּׂ֥א עֵינַ֛/י וָ/אֵ֖רֶא וְ/הִנֵּה אִ֑ישׁ וּ/בְ/יָד֖/וֹ חֶ֥בֶל מִדָּֽה
verses.translit: v'sh' 'yny v'r' vhnh 'ysh vbydv chbl mdh
verses.translation: For I, saith the LORD , will be unto her a wall of fire round about, and will be the glory in the midst of her.

verses.original: וָ/אֹמַ֕ר אָ֖נָה אַתָּ֣ה הֹלֵ֑ךְ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗/י לָ/מֹד֙ אֶת יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם לִ/רְא֥וֹת כַּ/מָּֽה רָחְבָּ֖/הּ וְ/כַ/מָּ֥ה אָרְכָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: v'mr 'nh 'th hlkh vy'mr 'ly lmd 't yrvshlm lr'vt khmh rchbh vkhmh 'rkhh
verses.translation: Ho, ho, come forth , and flee from the land of the north, saith the LORD : for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven, saith the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֗ה הַ/מַּלְאָ֛ךְ הַ/דֹּבֵ֥ר בִּ֖/י יֹצֵ֑א וּ/מַלְאָ֣ךְ אַחֵ֔ר יֹצֵ֖א לִ/קְרָאתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhnh hml'kh hdbr by yts' vml'kh 'chr yts' lqr'tv
verses.translation: Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔/ו רֻ֗ץ דַּבֵּ֛ר אֶל הַ/נַּ֥עַר הַלָּ֖ז לֵ/אמֹ֑ר פְּרָזוֹת֙ תֵּשֵׁ֣ב יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם מֵ/רֹ֥ב אָדָ֛ם וּ/בְהֵמָ֖ה בְּ/תוֹכָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lv rts dbr 'l hn'r hlz l'mr przvt tshb yrvshlm mrb 'dm vbhmh btvkhh
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD of hosts; After the glory hath he sent me unto the nations which spoiled you: for he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֤י אֶֽהְיֶה לָּ/הּ֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה ח֥וֹמַת אֵ֖שׁ סָבִ֑יב וּ/לְ/כָב֖וֹד אֶֽהְיֶ֥ה בְ/תוֹכָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: v'ny 'hyh lh n'm yhvh chvmt 'sh sbyb vlkhbvd 'hyh btvkhh
verses.translation: For, behold, I will shake mine hand upon them, and they shall be a spoil to their servants: and ye shall know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me.

verses.original: ה֣וֹי ה֗וֹי וְ/נֻ֛סוּ מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ צָפ֖וֹן נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֠י כְּ/אַרְבַּ֞ע רוּח֧וֹת הַ/שָּׁמַ֛יִם פֵּרַ֥שְׂתִּי אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: hvy hvy vnsv m'rts tspvn n'm yhvh khy kh'rb' rvchvt hshmym prshty 'tkhm n'm yhvh
verses.translation: Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Zion: for, lo, I come, and I will dwell in the midst of thee, saith the LORD .

verses.original: ה֥וֹי צִיּ֖וֹן הִמָּלְטִ֑י יוֹשֶׁ֖בֶת בַּת בָּבֶֽל
verses.translit: hvy tsyvn hmlty yvshbt bt bbl
verses.translation: And many nations shall be joined to the LORD in that day, and shall be my people: and I will dwell in the midst of thee, and thou shalt know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me unto thee.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֣ה אָמַר֮ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָאוֹת֒ אַחַ֣ר כָּב֔וֹד שְׁלָחַ֕/נִי אֶל הַ/גּוֹיִ֖ם הַ/שֹּׁלְלִ֣ים אֶתְ/כֶ֑ם כִּ֚י הַ/נֹּגֵ֣עַ בָּ/כֶ֔ם נֹגֵ֖עַ בְּ/בָבַ֥ת עֵינֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'chr khbvd shlchny 'l hgvym hshllym 'tkhm khy hng' bkhm ng' bbbt 'ynv
verses.translation: And the LORD shall inherit Judah his portion in the holy land, and shall choose Jerusalem again.

verses.original: כִּ֠י הִנְ/נִ֨י מֵנִ֤יף אֶת יָדִ/י֙ עֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/הָי֥וּ שָׁלָ֖ל לְ/עַבְדֵי/הֶ֑ם וִֽ/ידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּֽי יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁלָחָֽ/נִי
verses.translit: khy hnny mnyf 't ydy 'lyhm vhyv shll l'bdyhm vyd'tm khy yhvh tsb'vt shlchny
verses.translation: Be silent, O all flesh, before the LORD : for he is raised up out of his holy habitation.

verses.original: וַ/יַּרְאֵ֗/נִי אֶת יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ֙ הַ/כֹּהֵ֣ן הַ/גָּד֔וֹל עֹמֵ֕ד לִ/פְנֵ֖י מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֑ה וְ/הַ/שָּׂטָ֛ן עֹמֵ֥ד עַל יְמִינ֖/וֹ לְ/שִׂטְנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyr'ny 't yhvsh' hkhhn hgdvl 'md lpny ml'kh yhvh vhshtn 'md 'l ymynv lshtnv
verses.translation: And he shewed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of the LORD , and Satan standing at his right hand to resist him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל הַ/שָּׂטָ֗ן יִגְעַ֨ר יְהוָ֤ה בְּ/ךָ֙ הַ/שָּׂטָ֔ן וְ/יִגְעַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ בְּ/ךָ֔ הַ/בֹּחֵ֖ר בִּ/ירֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם הֲ/ל֧וֹא זֶ֦ה א֖וּד מֻצָּ֥ל מֵ/אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l hshtn yg'r yhvh bkh hshtn vyg'r yhvh bkh hbchr byrvshlm hlv' zh 'vd mtsl m'sh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Satan, The LORD rebuke thee, O Satan; even the LORD that hath chosen Jerusalem rebuke thee: is not this a brand plucked out of the fire?

verses.original: וִ/יהוֹשֻׁ֕עַ הָיָ֥ה לָבֻ֖שׁ בְּגָדִ֣ים צוֹאִ֑ים וְ/עֹמֵ֖ד לִ/פְנֵ֥י הַ/מַּלְאָֽךְ
verses.translit: vyhvsh' hyh lbsh bgdym tsv'ym v'md lpny hml'kh
verses.translation: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and stood before the angel.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַן וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר אֶל הָ/עֹמְדִ֤ים לְ/פָנָי/ו֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר הָסִ֛ירוּ הַ/בְּגָדִ֥ים הַ/צֹּאִ֖ים מֵ/עָלָ֑י/ו וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗י/ו רְאֵ֨ה הֶעֱבַ֤רְתִּי מֵ/עָלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ עֲוֺנֶ֔/ךָ וְ/הַלְבֵּ֥שׁ אֹתְ/ךָ֖ מַחֲלָצֽוֹת
verses.translit: vy'n vy'mr 'l h'mdym lpnyv l'mr hsyrv hbgdym hts'ym m'lyv vy'mr 'lyv r'h h'brty m'lykh 'vnkh vhlbsh 'tkh mchltsvt
verses.translation: And he answered and spake unto those that stood before him, saying, Take away the filthy garments from him. And unto him he said, Behold, I have caused thine iniquity to pass from thee, and I will clothe thee with change of raiment.

verses.original: וָ/אֹמַ֕ר יָשִׂ֛ימוּ צָנִ֥יף טָה֖וֹר עַל רֹאשׁ֑/וֹ וַ/יָּשִׂימוּ֩ הַ/צָּנִ֨יף הַ/טָּה֜וֹר עַל רֹאשׁ֗/וֹ וַ/יַּלְבִּשֻׁ֨/הוּ֙ בְּגָדִ֔ים וּ/מַלְאַ֥ךְ יְהוָ֖ה עֹמֵֽד
verses.translit: v'mr yshymv tsnyf thvr 'l r'shv vyshymv htsnyf hthvr 'l r'shv vylbshhv bgdym vml'kh yhvh 'md
verses.translation: And I said, Let them set a fair mitre upon his head. So they set a fair mitre upon his head, and clothed him with garments. And the angel of the LORD stood by.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨עַד֙ מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֔ה בִּ/יהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vy'd ml'kh yhvh byhvsh' l'mr
verses.translation: And the angel of the LORD protested unto Joshua, saying,

verses.original: כֹּה אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת אִם בִּ/דְרָכַ֤/י תֵּלֵךְ֙ וְ/אִ֣ם אֶת מִשְׁמַרְתִּ֣/י תִשְׁמֹ֔ר וְ/גַם אַתָּה֙ תָּדִ֣ין אֶת בֵּיתִ֔/י וְ/גַ֖ם תִּשְׁמֹ֣ר אֶת חֲצֵרָ֑/י וְ/נָתַתִּ֤י לְ/ךָ֙ מַהְלְכִ֔ים בֵּ֥ין הָ/עֹמְדִ֖ים הָ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'm bdrkhy tlkh v'm 't mshmrty tshmr vgm 'th tdyn 't byty vgm tshmr 't chtsry vntty lkh mhlkhym byn h'mdym h'lh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; If thou wilt walk in my ways, and if thou wilt keep my charge, then thou shalt also judge my house, and shalt also keep my courts, and I will give thee places to walk among these that stand by.

verses.original: שְֽׁמַֽע נָ֞א יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ הַ/כֹּהֵ֣ן הַ/גָּד֗וֹל אַתָּה֙ וְ/רֵעֶ֨י/ךָ֙ הַ/יֹּשְׁבִ֣ים לְ/פָנֶ֔י/ךָ כִּֽי אַנְשֵׁ֥י מוֹפֵ֖ת הֵ֑מָּה כִּֽי הִנְ/נִ֥י מֵבִ֛יא אֶת עַבְדִּ֖/י צֶֽמַח
verses.translit: shm' n' yhvsh' hkhhn hgdvl 'th vr'ykh hyshbym lpnykh khy 'nshy mvpt hmh khy hnny mby' 't 'bdy tsmch
verses.translation: Hear now, O Joshua the high priest, thou, and thy fellows that sit before thee: for they are men wondered at: for, behold, I will bring forth my servant the BRANCH.

verses.original: כִּ֣י הִנֵּ֣ה הָ/אֶ֗בֶן אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָתַ֨תִּי֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ עַל אֶ֥בֶן אַחַ֖ת שִׁבְעָ֣ה עֵינָ֑יִם הִנְ/נִ֧י מְפַתֵּ֣חַ פִּתֻּחָ֗/הּ נְאֻם֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וּ/מַשְׁתִּ֛י אֶת עֲוֺ֥ן הָ/אָֽרֶץ הַ/הִ֖יא בְּ/י֥וֹם אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: khy hnh h'bn 'shr ntty lpny yhvsh' 'l 'bn 'cht shb'h 'ynym hnny mptch ptchh n'm yhvh tsb'vt vmshty 't 'vn h'rts hhy' byvm 'chd
verses.translation: For behold the stone that I have laid before Joshua; upon one stone shall be seven eyes: behold, I will engrave the graving thereof, saith the LORD of hosts, and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא נְאֻם֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת תִּקְרְא֖וּ אִ֣ישׁ לְ/רֵעֵ֑/הוּ אֶל תַּ֥חַת גֶּ֖פֶן וְ/אֶל תַּ֥חַת תְּאֵנָֽה
verses.translit: byvm hhv' n'm yhvh tsb'vt tqr'v 'ysh lr'hv 'l tcht gpn v'l tcht t'nh
verses.translation: In that day, saith the LORD of hosts, shall ye call every man his neighbour under the vine and under the fig tree.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֕שָׁב הַ/מַּלְאָ֖ךְ הַ/דֹּבֵ֣ר בִּ֑/י וַ/יְעִירֵ֕/נִי כְּ/אִ֖ישׁ אֲשֶׁר יֵע֥וֹר מִ/שְּׁנָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyshb hml'kh hdbr by vy'yrny kh'ysh 'shr y'vr mshntv
verses.translation: And the angel that talked with me came again, and waked me, as a man that is wakened out of his sleep,

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔/י מָ֥ה אַתָּ֖ה רֹאֶ֑ה ו/יאמר וָ/אֹמַ֡ר רָאִ֣יתִי וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה מְנוֹרַת֩ זָהָ֨ב כֻּלָּ֜/הּ וְ/גֻלָּ֣הּ עַל רֹאשָׁ֗/הּ וְ/שִׁבְעָ֤ה נֵרֹתֶ֨י/הָ֙ עָלֶ֔י/הָ שִׁבְעָ֤ה וְ/שִׁבְעָה֙ מֽוּצָק֔וֹת לַ/נֵּר֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל רֹאשָֽׁ/הּ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly mh 'th r'h vy'mr v'mr r'yty vhnh mnvrt zhb khlh vglh 'l r'shh vshb'h nrtyh 'lyh shb'h vshb'h mvtsqvt lnrvt 'shr 'l r'shh
verses.translation: And said unto me, What seest thou? And I said, I have looked, and behold a candlestick all of gold, with a bowl upon the top of it, and his seven lamps thereon, and seven pipes to the seven lamps, which are upon the top thereof:

verses.original: וּ/שְׁנַ֥יִם זֵיתִ֖ים עָלֶ֑י/הָ אֶחָד֙ מִ/ימִ֣ין הַ/גֻּלָּ֔ה וְ/אֶחָ֖ד עַל שְׂמֹאלָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vshnym zytym 'lyh 'chd mymyn hglh v'chd 'l shm'lh
verses.translation: And two olive trees by it, one upon the right side of the bowl, and the other upon the left side thereof.

verses.original: וָ/אַ֨עַן֙ וָֽ/אֹמַ֔ר אֶל הַ/מַּלְאָ֛ךְ הַ/דֹּבֵ֥ר בִּ֖/י לֵ/אמֹ֑ר מָה אֵ֖לֶּה אֲדֹנִֽ/י
verses.translit: v''n v'mr 'l hml'kh hdbr by l'mr mh 'lh 'dny
verses.translation: So I answered and spake to the angel that talked with me, saying, What are these, my lord?

verses.original: וַ֠/יַּעַן הַ/מַּלְאָ֞ךְ הַ/דֹּבֵ֥ר בִּ/י֙ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔/י הֲ/ל֥וֹא יָדַ֖עְתָּ מָה הֵ֣מָּה אֵ֑לֶּה וָ/אֹמַ֖ר לֹ֥א אֲדֹנִֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'n hml'kh hdbr by vy'mr 'ly hlv' yd't mh hmh 'lh v'mr l' 'dny
verses.translation: Then the angel that talked with me answered and said unto me, Knowest thou not what these be? And I said, No, my lord.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֜עַן וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלַ/י֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר זֶ֚ה דְּבַר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל זְרֻבָּבֶ֖ל לֵ/אמֹ֑ר לֹ֤א בְ/חַ֨יִל֙ וְ/לֹ֣א בְ/כֹ֔חַ כִּ֣י אִם בְּ/רוּחִ֔/י אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vy'n vy'mr 'ly l'mr zh dbr yhvh 'l zrbbl l'mr l' bchyl vl' bkhch khy 'm brvchy 'mr yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: Then he answered and spake unto me, saying, This is the word of the LORD unto Zerubbabel, saying, Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, saith the LORD of hosts.

verses.original: מִֽי אַתָּ֧ה הַֽר הַ/גָּד֛וֹל לִ/פְנֵ֥י זְרֻבָּבֶ֖ל לְ/מִישֹׁ֑ר וְ/הוֹצִיא֙ אֶת הָ/אֶ֣בֶן הָ/רֹאשָׁ֔ה תְּשֻׁא֕וֹת חֵ֥ן חֵ֖ן לָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: my 'th hr hgdvl lpny zrbbl lmyshr vhvtsy' 't h'bn hr'shh tsh'vt chn chn lh
verses.translation: Who art thou, O great mountain? before Zerubbabel thou shalt become a plain: and he shall bring forth the headstone thereof with shoutings, crying , Grace, grace unto it.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

verses.original: יְדֵ֣י זְרֻבָּבֶ֗ל יִסְּד֛וּ הַ/בַּ֥יִת הַ/זֶּ֖ה וְ/יָדָ֣י/ו תְּבַצַּ֑עְנָה וְ/יָ֣דַעְתָּ֔ כִּֽי יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁלָחַ֥/נִי אֲלֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: ydy zrbbl ysdv hbyt hzh vydyv tbts'nh vyd't khy yhvh tsb'vt shlchny 'lykhm
verses.translation: The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house; his hands shall also finish it; and thou shalt know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me unto you.

verses.original: כִּ֣י מִ֣י בַז֮ לְ/י֣וֹם קְטַנּוֹת֒ וְ/שָׂמְח֗וּ וְ/רָא֞וּ אֶת הָ/אֶ֧בֶן הַ/בְּדִ֛יל בְּ/יַ֥ד זְרֻבָּבֶ֖ל שִׁבְעָה אֵ֑לֶּה עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה הֵ֥מָּה מְשׁוֹטְטִ֖ים בְּ/כָל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: khy my bz lyvm qtnvt vshmchv vr'v 't h'bn hbdyl byd zrbbl shb'h 'lh 'yny yhvh hmh mshvttym bkhl h'rts
verses.translation: For who hath despised the day of small things? for they shall rejoice, and shall see the plummet in the hand of Zerubbabel with those seven; they are the eyes of the LORD , which run to and fro through the whole earth. shall rejoice

verses.original: וָ/אַ֖עַן וָ/אֹמַ֣ר אֵלָ֑י/ו מַה שְּׁנֵ֤י הַ/זֵּיתִים֙ הָ/אֵ֔לֶה עַל יְמִ֥ין הַ/מְּנוֹרָ֖ה וְ/עַל שְׂמֹאולָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: v''n v'mr 'lyv mh shny hzytym h'lh 'l ymyn hmnvrh v'l shm'vlh
verses.translation: Then answered I, and said unto him, What are these two olive trees upon the right side of the candlestick and upon the left side thereof?

verses.original: וָ/אַ֣עַן שֵׁנִ֔ית וָ/אֹמַ֖ר אֵלָ֑י/ו מַה שְׁתֵּ֞י שִׁבֲּלֵ֣י הַ/זֵּיתִ֗ים אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּ/יַ֗ד שְׁנֵי֙ צַנְתְּר֣וֹת הַ/זָּהָ֔ב הַֽ/מְרִיקִ֥ים מֵ/עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם הַ/זָּהָֽב
verses.translit: v''n shnyt v'mr 'lyv mh shty shbly hzytym 'shr byd shny tsntrvt hzhb hmryqym m'lyhm hzhb
verses.translation: And I answered again, and said unto him, What be these two olive branches which through the two golden pipes empty the golden oil out of themselves?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלַ/י֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר הֲ/ל֥וֹא יָדַ֖עְתָּ מָה אֵ֑לֶּה וָ/אֹמַ֖ר לֹ֥א אֲדֹנִֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly l'mr hlv' yd't mh 'lh v'mr l' 'dny
verses.translation: And he answered me and said, Knowest thou not what these be ? And I said, No, my lord.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר אֵ֖לֶּה שְׁנֵ֣י בְנֵֽי הַ/יִּצְהָ֑ר הָ/עֹמְדִ֖ים עַל אֲד֥וֹן כָּל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lh shny bny hytshr h'mdym 'l 'dvn khl h'rts
verses.translation: Then said he, These are the two anointed ones, that stand by the Lord of the whole earth.

verses.original: וָ/אָשׁ֕וּב וָ/אֶשָּׂ֥א עֵינַ֖/י וָֽ/אֶרְאֶ֑ה וְ/הִנֵּ֖ה מְגִלָּ֥ה עָפָֽה
verses.translit: v'shvb v'sh' 'yny v'r'h vhnh mglh 'ph
verses.translation: Then I turned, and lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and behold a flying roll.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔/י מָ֥ה אַתָּ֖ה רֹאֶ֑ה וָ/אֹמַ֗ר אֲנִ֤י רֹאֶה֙ מְגִלָּ֣ה עָפָ֔ה אָרְכָּ/הּ֙ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים בָּֽ/אַמָּ֔ה וְ/רָחְבָּ֖/הּ עֶ֥שֶׂר בָּ/אַמָּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly mh 'th r'h v'mr 'ny r'h mglh 'ph 'rkhh 'shrym b'mh vrchbh 'shr b'mh
verses.translation: And he said unto me, What seest thou? And I answered, I see a flying roll; the length thereof is twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof ten cubits.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔/י זֹ֚את הָֽ/אָלָ֔ה הַ/יּוֹצֵ֖את עַל פְּנֵ֣י כָל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ כִּ֣י כָל הַ/גֹּנֵ֗ב מִ/זֶּה֙ כָּמ֣וֹ/הָ נִקָּ֔ה וְ/כָל הַ/נִּ֨שְׁבָּ֔ע מִ/זֶּ֖ה כָּמ֥וֹ/הָ נִקָּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly z't h'lh hyvts't 'l pny khl h'rts khy khl hgnb mzh khmvh nqh vkhl hnshb' mzh khmvh nqh
verses.translation: Then said he unto me, This is the curse that goeth forth over the face of the whole earth: for every one that stealeth shall be cut off as on this side according to it; and every one that sweareth shall be cut off as on that side according to it.

verses.original: הוֹצֵאתִ֗י/הָ נְאֻם֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וּ/בָ֨אָה֙ אֶל בֵּ֣ית הַ/גַּנָּ֔ב וְ/אֶל בֵּ֛ית הַ/נִּשְׁבָּ֥ע בִּ/שְׁמִ֖/י לַ/שָּׁ֑קֶר וְ/לָ֨נֶה֙ בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ בֵּית֔/וֹ וְ/כִלַּ֖תּ/וּ וְ/אֶת עֵצָ֥י/ו וְ/אֶת אֲבָנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: hvts'tyh n'm yhvh tsb'vt vb'h 'l byt hgnb v'l byt hnshb' bshmy lshqr vlnh btvkh bytv vkhltv v't 'tsyv v't 'bnyv
verses.translation: I will bring it forth, saith the LORD of hosts, and it shall enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him that sweareth falsely by my name: and it shall remain in the midst of his house, and shall consume it with the timber thereof and the stones thereof.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֕א הַ/מַּלְאָ֖ךְ הַ/דֹּבֵ֣ר בִּ֑/י וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔/י שָׂ֣א נָ֤א עֵינֶ֨י/ךָ֙ וּ/רְאֵ֔ה מָ֖ה הַ/יּוֹצֵ֥את הַ/זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: vyts' hml'kh hdbr by vy'mr 'ly sh' n' 'ynykh vr'h mh hyvts't hz't
verses.translation: Then the angel that talked with me went forth, and said unto me, Lift up now thine eyes, and see what is this that goeth forth.

verses.original: וָ/אֹמַ֖ר מַה הִ֑יא וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר זֹ֤את הָֽ/אֵיפָה֙ הַ/יּוֹצֵ֔את וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר זֹ֥את עֵינָ֖/ם בְּ/כָל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: v'mr mh hy' vy'mr z't h'yph hyvts't vy'mr z't 'ynm bkhl h'rts
verses.translation: And I said, What is it? And he said, This is an ephah that goeth forth. He said moreover, This is their resemblance through all the earth.

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֛ה כִּכַּ֥ר עֹפֶ֖רֶת נִשֵּׂ֑את וְ/זֹאת֙ אִשָּׁ֣ה אַחַ֔ת יוֹשֶׁ֖בֶת בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ הָ/אֵיפָֽה
verses.translit: vhnh khkhr 'prt nsh't vz't 'shh 'cht yvshbt btvkh h'yph
verses.translation: And, behold, there was lifted up a talent of lead: and this is a woman that sitteth in the midst of the ephah.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ זֹ֣את הָ/רִשְׁעָ֔ה וַ/יַּשְׁלֵ֥ךְ אֹתָ֖/הּ אֶל תּ֣וֹךְ הָֽ/אֵיפָ֑ה וַ/יַּשְׁלֵ֛ךְ אֶת אֶ֥בֶן הָ/עֹפֶ֖רֶת אֶל פִּֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vy'mr z't hrsh'h vyshlkh 'th 'l tvkh h'yph vyshlkh 't 'bn h'prt 'l pyh
verses.translation: And he said, This is wickedness. And he cast it into the midst of the ephah; and he cast the weight of lead upon the mouth thereof.

verses.original: וָ/אֶשָּׂ֨א עֵינַ֜/י וָ/אֵ֗רֶא וְ/הִנֵּה֩ שְׁתַּ֨יִם נָשִׁ֤ים יֽוֹצְאוֹת֙ וְ/ר֣וּחַ בְּ/כַנְפֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/לָ/הֵ֥נָּה כְנָפַ֖יִם כְּ/כַנְפֵ֣י הַ/חֲסִידָ֑ה וַ/תִּשֶּׂ֨אנָה֙ אֶת הָ֣/אֵיפָ֔ה בֵּ֥ין הָ/אָ֖רֶץ וּ/בֵ֥ין הַ/שָּׁמָֽיִם
verses.translit: v'sh' 'yny v'r' vhnh shtym nshym yvts'vt vrvch bkhnpyhm vlhnh khnpym khkhnpy hchsydh vtsh'nh 't h'yph byn h'rts vbyn hshmym
verses.translation: Then lifted I up mine eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came out two women, and the wind was in their wings; for they had wings like the wings of a stork: and they lifted up the ephah between the earth and the heaven.

verses.original: וָ/אֹמַ֕ר אֶל הַ/מַּלְאָ֖ךְ הַ/דֹּבֵ֣ר בִּ֑/י אָ֛נָה הֵ֥מָּה מֽוֹלִכ֖וֹת אֶת הָ/אֵיפָֽה
verses.translit: v'mr 'l hml'kh hdbr by 'nh hmh mvlkhvt 't h'yph
verses.translation: Then said I to the angel that talked with me, Whither do these bear the ephah?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔/י לִ/בְנֽוֹת לָ֥/הֿ בַ֖יִת בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ שִׁנְעָ֑ר וְ/הוּכַ֛ן וְ/הֻנִּ֥יחָה שָּׁ֖ם עַל מְכֻנָתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly lbnvt lh byt b'rts shn'r vhvkhn vhnychh shm 'l mkhnth
verses.translation: And he said unto me, To build it an house in the land of Shinar: and it shall be established, and set there upon her own base.

verses.original: וָ/אָשֻׁ֗ב וָ/אֶשָּׂ֤א עֵינַ/י֙ וָֽ/אֶרְאֶ֔ה וְ/הִנֵּ֨ה אַרְבַּ֤ע מַרְכָּבוֹת֙ יֹֽצְא֔וֹת מִ/בֵּ֖ין שְׁנֵ֣י הֶֽ/הָרִ֑ים וְ/הֶ/הָרִ֖ים הָרֵ֥י נְחֹֽשֶׁת
verses.translit: v'shb v'sh' 'yny v'r'h vhnh 'rb' mrkhbvt yts'vt mbyn shny hhrym vhhrym hry nchsht
verses.translation: And I turned, and lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came four chariots out from between two mountains; and the mountains were mountains of brass.

verses.original: בַּ/מֶּרְכָּבָ֥ה הָ/רִֽאשֹׁנָ֖ה סוּסִ֣ים אֲדֻמִּ֑ים וּ/בַ/מֶּרְכָּבָ֥ה הַ/שֵּׁנִ֖ית סוּסִ֥ים שְׁחֹרִֽים
verses.translit: bmrkhbh hr'shnh svsym 'dmym vbmrkhbh hshnyt svsym shchrym
verses.translation: In the first chariot were red horses; and in the second chariot black horses;

verses.original: וּ/בַ/מֶּרְכָּבָ֥ה הַ/שְּׁלִשִׁ֖ית סוּסִ֣ים לְבָנִ֑ים וּ/בַ/מֶּרְכָּבָה֙ הָ/רְבִעִ֔ית סוּסִ֥ים בְּרֻדִּ֖ים אֲמֻצִּֽים
verses.translit: vbmrkhbh hshlshyt svsym lbnym vbmrkhbh hrb'yt svsym brdym 'mtsym
verses.translation: And in the third chariot white horses; and in the fourth chariot grisled and bay horses.

verses.original: וָ/אַ֨עַן֙ וָֽ/אֹמַ֔ר אֶל הַ/מַּלְאָ֖ךְ הַ/דֹּבֵ֣ר בִּ֑/י מָה אֵ֖לֶּה אֲדֹנִֽ/י
verses.translit: v''n v'mr 'l hml'kh hdbr by mh 'lh 'dny
verses.translation: Then I answered and said unto the angel that talked with me, What are these, my lord?

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַן הַ/מַּלְאָ֖ךְ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֑/י אֵ֗לֶּה אַרְבַּע֙ רֻח֣וֹת הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם יוֹצְא֕וֹת מֵֽ/הִתְיַצֵּ֖ב עַל אֲד֥וֹן כָּל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vy'n hml'kh vy'mr 'ly 'lh 'rb' rchvt hshmym yvts'vt mhtytsb 'l 'dvn khl h'rts
verses.translation: And the angel answered and said unto me, These are the four spirits of the heavens, which go forth from standing before the Lord of all the earth.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר בָּ֞/הּ הַ/סּוּסִ֣ים הַ/שְּׁחֹרִ֗ים יֹֽצְאִים֙ אֶל אֶ֣רֶץ צָפ֔וֹן וְ/הַ/לְּבָנִ֔ים יָצְא֖וּ אֶל אַֽחֲרֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/הַ֨/בְּרֻדִּ֔ים יָצְא֖וּ אֶל אֶ֥רֶץ הַ/תֵּימָֽן
verses.translit: 'shr bh hsvsym hshchrym yts'ym 'l 'rts tspvn vhlbnym yts'v 'l 'chryhm vhbrdym yts'v 'l 'rts htymn
verses.translation: The black horses which are therein go forth into the north country; and the white go forth after them; and the grisled go forth toward the south country.

verses.original: וְ/הָ/אֲמֻצִּ֣ים יָצְא֗וּ וַ/יְבַקְשׁוּ֙ לָ/לֶ֨כֶת֙ לְ/הִתְהַלֵּ֣ך בָּ/אָ֔רֶץ וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר לְכ֖וּ הִתְהַלְּכ֣וּ בָ/אָ֑רֶץ וַ/תִּתְהַלַּ֖כְנָה בָּ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vh'mtsym yts'v vybqshv llkht lhthlkh b'rts vy'mr lkhv hthlkhv b'rts vtthlkhnh b'rts
verses.translation: And the bay went forth, and sought to go that they might walk to and fro through the earth: and he said, Get you hence, walk to and fro through the earth. So they walked to and fro through the earth.

verses.original: וַ/יַּזְעֵ֣ק אֹתִ֔/י וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר אֵלַ֖/י לֵ/אמֹ֑ר רְאֵ֗ה הַ/יּֽוֹצְאִים֙ אֶל אֶ֣רֶץ צָפ֔וֹן הֵנִ֥יחוּ אֶת רוּחִ֖/י בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ צָפֽוֹן
verses.translit: vyz'q 'ty vydbr 'ly l'mr r'h hyvts'ym 'l 'rts tspvn hnychv 't rvchy b'rts tspvn
verses.translation: Then cried he upon me, and spake unto me, saying, Behold, these that go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

verses.original: לָק֨וֹחַ֙ מֵ/אֵ֣ת הַ/גּוֹלָ֔ה מֵ/חֶלְדַּ֕י וּ/מֵ/אֵ֥ת טוֹבִיָּ֖ה וּ/מֵ/אֵ֣ת יְדַֽעְיָ֑ה וּ/בָאתָ֤ אַתָּה֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא וּ/בָ֗אתָ בֵּ֚ית יֹאשִׁיָּ֣ה בֶן צְפַנְיָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר בָּ֖אוּ מִ/בָּבֶֽל
verses.translit: lqvch m't hgvlh mchldy vm't tvbyh vm't yd'yh vb't 'th byvm hhv' vb't byt y'shyh bn tspnyh 'shr b'v mbbl
verses.translation: Take of them of the captivity, even of Heldai, of Tobijah, and of Jedaiah, which are come from Babylon, and come thou the same day, and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah;

verses.original: וְ/לָקַחְתָּ֥ כֶֽסֶף וְ/זָהָ֖ב וְ/עָשִׂ֣יתָ עֲטָר֑וֹת וְ/שַׂמְתָּ֗ בְּ/רֹ֛אשׁ יְהוֹשֻׁ֥עַ בֶּן יְהוֹצָדָ֖ק הַ/כֹּהֵ֥ן הַ/גָּדֽוֹל
verses.translit: vlqcht khsf vzhb v'shyt 'trvt vshmt br'sh yhvsh' bn yhvtsdq hkhhn hgdvl
verses.translation: Then take silver and gold, and make crowns, and set them upon the head of Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest;

verses.original: וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֤ אֵלָי/ו֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הִנֵּה אִ֞ישׁ צֶ֤מַח שְׁמ/וֹ֙ וּ/מִ/תַּחְתָּ֣י/ו יִצְמָ֔ח וּ/בָנָ֖ה אֶת הֵיכַ֥ל יְהוָֽהּ
verses.translit: v'mrt 'lyv l'mr khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt l'mr hnh 'ysh tsmch shmv vmtchtyv ytsmch vbnh 't hykhl yhvh
verses.translation: And speak unto him, saying, Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, saying, Behold the man whose name is The BRANCH; and he shall grow up out of his place, and he shall build the temple of the LORD :

verses.original: וְ֠/הוּא יִבְנֶ֞ה אֶת הֵיכַ֤ל יְהוָה֙ וְ/הֽוּא יִשָּׂ֣א ה֔וֹד וְ/יָשַׁ֥ב וּ/מָשַׁ֖ל עַל כִּסְא֑/וֹ וְ/הָיָ֤ה כֹהֵן֙ עַל כִּסְא֔/וֹ וַ/עֲצַ֣ת שָׁל֔וֹם תִּהְיֶ֖ה בֵּ֥ין שְׁנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vhv' ybnh 't hykhl yhvh vhv' ysh' hvd vyshb vmshl 'l khs'v vhyh khhn 'l khs'v v'tst shlvm thyh byn shnyhm
verses.translation: Even he shall build the temple of the LORD ; and he shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule upon his throne; and he shall be a priest upon his throne: and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.

verses.original: וְ/הָ/עֲטָרֹ֗ת תִּֽהְיֶה֙ לְ/חֵ֨לֶם֙ וּ/לְ/טוֹבִיָּ֣ה וְ/לִ/ידַֽעְיָ֔ה וּ/לְ/חֵ֖ן בֶּן צְפַנְיָ֑ה לְ/זִכָּר֖וֹן בְּ/הֵיכַ֥ל יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vh'trt thyh lchlm vltvbyh vlyd'yh vlchn bn tspnyh lzkhrvn bhykhl yhvh
verses.translation: And the crowns shall be to Helem, and to Tobijah, and to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in the temple of the LORD .

verses.original: וּ/רְחוֹקִ֣ים יָבֹ֗אוּ וּ/בָנוּ֙ בְּ/הֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֔ה וִ/ידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּֽי יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁלָחַ֣/נִי אֲלֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/הָיָה֙ אִם שָׁמ֣וֹעַ תִּשְׁמְע֔וּ/ן בְּ/ק֖וֹל יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vrchvqym yb'v vbnv bhykhl yhvh vyd'tm khy yhvh tsb'vt shlchny 'lykhm vhyh 'm shmv' tshm'vn bqvl yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: And they that are far off shall come and build in the temple of the LORD , and ye shall know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me unto you. And this shall come to pass, if ye will diligently obey the voice of the LORD your God.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ בִּ/שְׁנַ֣ת אַרְבַּ֔ע לְ/דָרְיָ֖וֶשׁ הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ הָיָ֨ה דְבַר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל זְכַרְיָ֗ה בְּ/אַרְבָּעָ֛ה לַ/חֹ֥דֶשׁ הַ/תְּשִׁעִ֖י בְּ/כִסְלֵֽו
verses.translit: vyhy bshnt 'rb' ldryvsh hmlkh hyh dbr yhvh 'l zkhryh b'rb'h lchdsh htsh'y bkhslv
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Darius, that the word of the LORD came unto Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month, even in Chisleu;

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַח֙ בֵּֽית אֵ֔ל שַׂר אֶ֕צֶר וְ/רֶ֥גֶם מֶ֖לֶךְ וַֽ/אֲנָשָׁ֑י/ו לְ/חַלּ֖וֹת אֶת פְּנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyshlch byt 'l shr 'tsr vrgm mlkh v'nshyv lchlvt 't pny yhvh
verses.translation: When they had sent unto the house of God Sherezer and Regem-melech, and their men, to pray before the LORD ,

verses.original: לֵ/אמֹ֗ר אֶל הַ/כֹּֽהֲנִים֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ לְ/בֵית יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וְ/אֶל הַ/נְּבִיאִ֖ים לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הַֽ/אֶבְכֶּה֙ בַּ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/חֲמִשִׁ֔י הִנָּזֵ֕ר כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔יתִי זֶ֖ה כַּ/מֶּ֥ה שָׁנִֽים
verses.translit: l'mr 'l hkhhnym 'shr lbyt yhvh tsb'vt v'l hnby'ym l'mr h'bkhh bchdsh hchmshy hnzr kh'shr 'shyty zh khmh shnym
verses.translation: And to speak unto the priests which were in the house of the LORD of hosts, and to the prophets, saying, Should I weep in the fifth month, separating myself, as I have done these so many years?

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֛י דְּבַר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh tsb'vt 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: Then came the word of the LORD of hosts unto me, saying,

verses.original: אֱמֹר֙ אֶל כָּל עַ֣ם הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/אֶל הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים לֵ/אמֹ֑ר כִּֽי צַמְתֶּ֨ם וְ/סָפ֜וֹד בַּ/חֲמִישִׁ֣י וּ/בַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֗י וְ/זֶה֙ שִׁבְעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה הֲ/צ֥וֹם צַמְתֻּ֖/נִי אָֽנִי
verses.translit: 'mr 'l khl 'm h'rts v'l hkhhnym l'mr khy tsmtm vspvd bchmyshy vbshby'y vzh shb'ym shnh htsvm tsmtny 'ny
verses.translation: Speak unto all the people of the land, and to the priests, saying, When ye fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh month , even those seventy years, did ye at all fast unto me, even to me?

verses.original: וְ/כִ֥י תֹאכְל֖וּ וְ/כִ֣י תִשְׁתּ֑וּ הֲ/ל֤וֹא אַתֶּם֙ הָ/אֹ֣כְלִ֔ים וְ/אַתֶּ֖ם הַ/שֹּׁתִֽים
verses.translit: vkhy t'khlv vkhy tshtv hlv' 'tm h'khlym v'tm hshtym
verses.translation: And when ye did eat, and when ye did drink, did not ye eat for yourselves , and drink for yourselves ?

verses.original: הֲ/ל֣וֹא אֶת הַ/דְּבָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר קָרָ֤א יְהוָה֙ בְּ/יַד֙ הַ/נְּבִיאִ֣ים הָ/רִֽאשֹׁנִ֔ים בִּ/הְי֤וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ יֹשֶׁ֣בֶת וּ/שְׁלֵוָ֔ה וְ/עָרֶ֖י/הָ סְבִיבֹתֶ֑י/הָ וְ/הַ/נֶּ֥גֶב וְ/הַ/שְּׁפֵלָ֖ה יֹשֵֽׁב
verses.translit: hlv' 't hdbrym 'shr qr' yhvh byd hnby'ym hr'shnym bhyvt yrvshlm yshbt vshlvh v'ryh sbybtyh vhngb vhshplh yshb
verses.translation: Should ye not hear the words which the LORD hath cried by the former prophets, when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity, and the cities thereof round about her, when men inhabited the south and the plain?

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ דְּבַר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל זְכַרְיָ֖ה לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'l zkhryh l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came unto Zechariah, saying,

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת לֵ/אמֹ֑ר מִשְׁפַּ֤ט אֱמֶת֙ שְׁפֹ֔טוּ וְ/חֶ֣סֶד וְ/רַֽחֲמִ֔ים עֲשׂ֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ אֶת אָחִֽי/ו
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt l'mr mshpt 'mt shptv vchsd vrchmym 'shv 'ysh 't 'chyv
verses.translation: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, saying, Execute true judgment, and shew mercy and compassions every man to his brother:

verses.original: וְ/אַלְמָנָ֧ה וְ/יָת֛וֹם גֵּ֥ר וְ/עָנִ֖י אַֽל תַּעֲשֹׁ֑קוּ וְ/רָעַת֙ אִ֣ישׁ אָחִ֔י/ו אַֽל תַּחְשְׁב֖וּ בִּ/לְבַבְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'lmnh vytvm gr v'ny 'l t'shqv vr't 'ysh 'chyv 'l tchshbv blbbkhm
verses.translation: And oppress not the widow, nor the fatherless, the stranger, nor the poor; and let none of you imagine evil against his brother in your heart.

verses.original: וַ/יְמָאֲנ֣וּ לְ/הַקְשִׁ֔יב וַ/יִּתְּנ֥וּ כָתֵ֖ף סֹרָ֑רֶת וְ/אָזְנֵי/הֶ֖ם הִכְבִּ֥ידוּ מִ/שְּׁמֽוֹעַ
verses.translit: vym'nv lhqshyb vytnv khtf srrt v'znyhm hkhbydv mshmv'
verses.translation: But they refused to hearken, and pulled away the shoulder, and stopped their ears, that they should not hear.

verses.original: וְ/לִבָּ֞/ם שָׂ֣מוּ שָׁמִ֗יר מִ֠/שְּׁמוֹעַ אֶת הַ/תּוֹרָ֤ה וְ/אֶת הַ/דְּבָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר שָׁלַ֜ח יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ בְּ/רוּח֔/וֹ בְּ/יַ֖ד הַ/נְּבִיאִ֣ים הָ/רִֽאשֹׁנִ֑ים וַֽ/יְהִי֙ קֶ֣צֶף גָּד֔וֹל מֵ/אֵ֖ת יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vlbm shmv shmyr mshmv' 't htvrh v't hdbrym 'shr shlch yhvh tsb'vt brvchv byd hnby'ym hr'shnym vyhy qtsf gdvl m't yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: Yea, they made their hearts as an adamant stone, lest they should hear the law, and the words which the LORD of hosts hath sent in his spirit by the former prophets: therefore came a great wrath from the LORD of hosts.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י כַ/אֲשֶׁר קָרָ֖א וְ/לֹ֣א שָׁמֵ֑עוּ כֵּ֤ן יִקְרְאוּ֙ וְ/לֹ֣א אֶשְׁמָ֔ע אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr qr' vl' shm'v khn yqr'v vl' 'shm' 'mr yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: Therefore it is come to pass, that as he cried, and they would not hear; so they cried, and I would not hear, saith the LORD of hosts:

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֣סָעֲרֵ֗/ם עַ֤ל כָּל הַ/גּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא יְדָע֔וּ/ם וְ/הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ נָשַׁ֣מָּה אַֽחֲרֵי/הֶ֔ם מֵֽ/עֹבֵ֖ר וּ/מִ/שָּׁ֑ב וַ/יָּשִׂ֥ימוּ אֶֽרֶץ חֶמְדָּ֖ה לְ/שַׁמָּֽה
verses.translit: v's'rm 'l khl hgvym 'shr l' yd'vm vh'rts nshmh 'chryhm m'br vmshb vyshymv 'rts chmdh lshmh
verses.translation: But I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations whom they knew not. Thus the land was desolate after them, that no man passed through nor returned: for they laid the pleasant land desolate.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֛י דְּבַר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh tsb'vt l'mr
verses.translation: Again the word of the LORD of hosts came to me , saying,

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת קִנֵּ֥אתִי לְ/צִיּ֖וֹן קִנְאָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֑ה וְ/חֵמָ֥ה גְדוֹלָ֖ה קִנֵּ֥אתִי לָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt qn'ty ltsyvn qn'h gdvlh vchmh gdvlh qn'ty lh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; I was jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and I was jealous for her with great fury.

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה שַׁ֚בְתִּי אֶל צִיּ֔וֹן וְ/שָׁכַנְתִּ֖י בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/נִקְרְאָ֤ה יְרוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ עִ֣יר הָֽ/אֱמֶ֔ת וְ/הַר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת הַ֥ר הַ/קֹּֽדֶשׁ
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh shbty 'l tsyvn vshkhnty btvkh yrvshlm vnqr'h yrvshlm 'yr h'mt vhr yhvh tsb'vt hr hqdsh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD ; I am returned unto Zion, and will dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and Jerusalem shall be called a city of truth; and the mountain of the LORD of hosts the holy mountain.

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת עֹ֤ד יֵֽשְׁבוּ֙ זְקֵנִ֣ים וּ/זְקֵנ֔וֹת בִּ/רְחֹב֖וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/אִ֧ישׁ מִשְׁעַנְתּ֛/וֹ בְּ/יָד֖/וֹ מֵ/רֹ֥ב יָמִֽים
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'd yshbv zqnym vzqnvt brchbvt yrvshlm v'ysh msh'ntv bydv mrb ymym
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; There shall yet old men and old women dwell in the streets of Jerusalem, and every man with his staff in his hand for very age.

verses.original: וּ/רְחֹב֤וֹת הָ/עִיר֙ יִמָּ֣לְא֔וּ יְלָדִ֖ים וִֽ/ילָד֑וֹת מְשַׂחֲקִ֖ים בִּ/רְחֹֽבֹתֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vrchbvt h'yr yml'v yldym vyldvt mshchqym brchbtyh
verses.translation: And the streets of the city shall be full of boys and girls playing in the streets thereof.

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת כִּ֣י יִפָּלֵ֗א בְּ/עֵינֵי֙ שְׁאֵרִית֙ הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֔ה בַּ/יָּמִ֖ים הָ/הֵ֑ם גַּם בְּ/עֵינַ/י֙ יִפָּלֵ֔א נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt khy ypl' b'yny sh'ryt h'm hzh bymym hhm gm b'yny ypl' n'm yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; If it be marvellous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in these days, should it also be marvellous in mine eyes? saith the LORD of hosts.

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת הִנְ/נִ֥י מוֹשִׁ֛יעַ אֶת עַמִּ֖/י מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִזְרָ֑ח וּ/מֵ/אֶ֖רֶץ מְב֥וֹא הַ/שָּֽׁמֶשׁ
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt hnny mvshy' 't 'my m'rts mzrch vm'rts mbv' hshmsh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Behold, I will save my people from the east country, and from the west country;

verses.original: וְ/הֵבֵאתִ֣י אֹתָ֔/ם וְ/שָׁכְנ֖וּ בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/הָיוּ לִ֣/י לְ/עָ֗ם וַֽ/אֲנִי֙ אֶהְיֶ֤ה לָ/הֶם֙ לֵֽ/אלֹהִ֔ים בֶּ/אֱמֶ֖ת וּ/בִ/צְדָקָֽה
verses.translit: vhb'ty 'tm vshkhnv btvkh yrvshlm vhyv ly l'm v'ny 'hyh lhm l'lhym b'mt vbtsdqh
verses.translation: And I will bring them, and they shall dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God, in truth and in righteousness.

verses.original: כֹּֽה אָמַר֮ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָאוֹת֒ תֶּחֱזַ֣קְנָה יְדֵי/כֶ֔ם הַ/שֹּֽׁמְעִים֙ בַּ/יָּמִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה אֵ֖ת הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה מִ/פִּי֙ הַ/נְּבִיאִ֔ים אֲ֠שֶׁר בְּ/י֞וֹם יֻסַּ֨ד בֵּית יְהוָ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת הַ/הֵיכָ֖ל לְ/הִבָּנֽוֹת
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt tchzqnh ydykhm hshm'ym bymym h'lh 't hdbrym h'lh mpy hnby'ym 'shr byvm ysd byt yhvh tsb'vt hhykhl lhbnvt
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Let your hands be strong, ye that hear in these days these words by the mouth of the prophets, which were in the day that the foundation of the house of the LORD of hosts was laid, that the temple might be built.

verses.original: כִּ֗י לִ/פְנֵי֙ הַ/יָּמִ֣ים הָ/הֵ֔ם שְׂכַ֤ר הָֽ/אָדָם֙ לֹ֣א נִֽהְיָ֔ה וּ/שְׂכַ֥ר הַ/בְּהֵמָ֖ה אֵינֶ֑/נָּה וְ/לַ/יּוֹצֵ֨א וְ/לַ/בָּ֤א אֵין שָׁלוֹם֙ מִן הַ/צָּ֔ר וַ/אֲשַׁלַּ֥ח אֶת כָּל הָ/אָדָ֖ם אִ֥ישׁ בְּ/רֵעֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: khy lpny hymym hhm shkhr h'dm l' nhyh vshkhr hbhmh 'ynnh vlyvts' vlb' 'yn shlvm mn htsr v'shlch 't khl h'dm 'ysh br'hv
verses.translation: For before these days there was no hire for man, nor any hire for beast; neither was there any peace to him that went out or came in because of the affliction: for I set all men every one against his neighbour.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה לֹ֣א כַ/יָּמִ֤ים הָ/רִֽאשֹׁנִים֙ אֲנִ֔י לִ/שְׁאֵרִ֖ית הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֑ה נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: v'th l' khymym hr'shnym 'ny lsh'ryt h'm hzh n'm yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: But now I will not be unto the residue of this people as in the former days, saith the LORD of hosts.

verses.original: כִּֽי זֶ֣רַע הַ/שָּׁל֗וֹם הַ/גֶּ֜פֶן תִּתֵּ֤ן פִּרְיָ/הּ֙ וְ/הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ תִּתֵּ֣ן אֶת יְבוּלָ֔/הּ וְ/הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם יִתְּנ֣וּ טַלָּ֑/ם וְ/הִנְחַלְתִּ֗י אֶת שְׁאֵרִ֛ית הָ/עָ֥ם הַ/זֶּ֖ה אֶת כָּל אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: khy zr' hshlvm hgpn ttn pryh vh'rts ttn 't ybvlh vhshmym ytnv tlm vhnchlty 't sh'ryt h'm hzh 't khl 'lh
verses.translation: For the seed shall be prosperous; the vine shall give her fruit, and the ground shall give her increase, and the heavens shall give their dew; and I will cause the remnant of this people to possess all these things .

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֡ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁר֩ הֱיִיתֶ֨ם קְלָלָ֜ה בַּ/גּוֹיִ֗ם בֵּ֤ית יְהוּדָה֙ וּ/בֵ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כֵּ֚ן אוֹשִׁ֣יעַ אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם וִ/הְיִיתֶ֖ם בְּרָכָ֑ה אַל תִּירָ֖אוּ תֶּחֱזַ֥קְנָה יְדֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vhyh kh'shr hyytm qllh bgvym byt yhvdh vbyt yshr'l khn 'vshy' 'tkhm vhyytm brkhh 'l tyr'v tchzqnh ydykhm
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that as ye were a curse among the heathen, O house of Judah, and house of Israel; so will I save you, and ye shall be a blessing: fear not, but let your hands be strong.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֣ה אָמַר֮ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָאוֹת֒ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר זָמַמְ֜תִּי לְ/הָרַ֣ע לָ/כֶ֗ם בְּ/הַקְצִ֤יף אֲבֹֽתֵי/כֶם֙ אֹתִ֔/י אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת וְ/לֹ֖א נִחָֽמְתִּי
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt kh'shr zmmty lhr' lkhm bhqtsyf 'btykhm 'ty 'mr yhvh tsb'vt vl' nchmty
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD of hosts; As I thought to punish you, when your fathers provoked me to wrath, saith the LORD of hosts, and I repented not:

verses.original: כֵּ֣ן שַׁ֤בְתִּי זָמַ֨מְתִּי֙ בַּ/יָּמִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה לְ/הֵיטִ֥יב אֶת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וְ/אֶת בֵּ֣ית יְהוּדָ֑ה אַל תִּירָֽאוּ
verses.translit: khn shbty zmmty bymym h'lh lhytyb 't yrvshlm v't byt yhvdh 'l tyr'v
verses.translation: So again have I thought in these days to do well unto Jerusalem and to the house of Judah: fear ye not.

verses.original: אֵ֥לֶּה הַ/דְּבָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּֽעֲשׂ֑וּ דַּבְּר֤וּ אֱמֶת֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֶת רֵעֵ֔/הוּ אֱמֶת֙ וּ/מִשְׁפַּ֣ט שָׁל֔וֹם שִׁפְט֖וּ בְּ/שַׁעֲרֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: 'lh hdbrym 'shr t'shv dbrv 'mt 'ysh 't r'hv 'mt vmshpt shlvm shptv bsh'rykhm
verses.translation: These are the things that ye shall do; Speak ye every man the truth to his neighbour; execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates:

verses.original: וְ/אִ֣ישׁ אֶת רָעַ֣ת רֵעֵ֗/הוּ אַֽל תַּחְשְׁבוּ֙ בִּ/לְבַבְ/כֶ֔ם וּ/שְׁבֻ֥עַת שֶׁ֖קֶר אַֽל תֶּאֱהָ֑בוּ כִּ֧י אֶת כָּל אֵ֛לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׂנֵ֖אתִי נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: v'ysh 't r't r'hv 'l tchshbv blbbkhm vshb't shqr 'l t'hbv khy 't khl 'lh 'shr shn'ty n'm yhvh
verses.translation: And let none of you imagine evil in your hearts against his neighbour; and love no false oath: for all these are things that I hate, saith the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֛י דְּבַר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh tsb'vt 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD of hosts came unto me, saying,

verses.original: כֹּֽה אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת צ֣וֹם הָ/רְבִיעִ֡י וְ/צ֣וֹם הַ/חֲמִישִׁי֩ וְ/צ֨וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֜י וְ/צ֣וֹם הָ/עֲשִׂירִ֗י יִהְיֶ֤ה לְ/בֵית יְהוּדָה֙ לְ/שָׂשׂ֣וֹן וּ/לְ/שִׂמְחָ֔ה וּֽ/לְ/מֹעֲדִ֖ים טוֹבִ֑ים וְ/הָ/אֱמֶ֥ת וְ/הַ/שָּׁל֖וֹם אֱהָֽבוּ
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt tsvm hrby'y vtsvm hchmyshy vtsvm hshby'y vtsvm h'shyry yhyh lbyt yhvdh lshshvn vlshmchh vlm'dym tvbym vh'mt vhshlvm 'hbv
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; The fast of the fourth month , and the fast of the fifth, and the fast of the seventh, and the fast of the tenth, shall be to the house of Judah joy and gladness, and cheerful feasts; therefore love the truth and peace.

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת עֹ֚ד אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָבֹ֣אוּ עַמִּ֔ים וְ/יֹשְׁבֵ֖י עָרִ֥ים רַבּֽוֹת
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'd 'shr yb'v 'mym vyshby 'rym rbvt
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; It shall yet come to pass , that there shall come people, and the inhabitants of many cities:

verses.original: וְֽ/הָלְכ֡וּ יֹשְׁבֵי֩ אַחַ֨ת אֶל אַחַ֜ת לֵ/אמֹ֗ר נֵלְכָ֤ה הָלוֹךְ֙ לְ/חַלּוֹת֙ אֶת פְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וּ/לְ/בַקֵּ֖שׁ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת אֵלְכָ֖ה גַּם אָֽנִי
verses.translit: vhlkhv yshby 'cht 'l 'cht l'mr nlkhh hlvkh lchlvt 't pny yhvh vlbqsh 't yhvh tsb'vt 'lkhh gm 'ny
verses.translation: And the inhabitants of one city shall go to another, saying, Let us go speedily to pray before the LORD , and to seek the LORD of hosts: I will go also.

verses.original: וּ/בָ֨אוּ עַמִּ֤ים רַבִּים֙ וְ/גוֹיִ֣ם עֲצוּמִ֔ים לְ/בַקֵּ֛שׁ אֶת יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וּ/לְ/חַלּ֖וֹת אֶת פְּנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vb'v 'mym rbym vgvym 'tsvmym lbqsh 't yhvh tsb'vt byrvshlm vlchlvt 't pny yhvh
verses.translation: Yea, many people and strong nations shall come to seek the LORD of hosts in Jerusalem, and to pray before the LORD .

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַר֮ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָאוֹת֒ בַּ/יָּמִ֣ים הָ/הֵ֔מָּה אֲשֶׁ֤ר יַחֲזִ֨יקוּ֙ עֲשָׂרָ֣ה אֲנָשִׁ֔ים מִ/כֹּ֖ל לְשֹׁנ֣וֹת הַ/גּוֹיִ֑ם וְֽ/הֶחֱזִ֡יקוּ בִּ/כְנַף֩ אִ֨ישׁ יְהוּדִ֜י לֵ/אמֹ֗ר נֵֽלְכָה֙ עִמָּ/כֶ֔ם כִּ֥י שָׁמַ֖עְנוּ אֱלֹהִ֥ים עִמָּ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt bymym hhmh 'shr ychzyqv 'shrh 'nshym mkhl lshnvt hgvym vhchzyqv bkhnf 'ysh yhvdy l'mr nlkhh 'mkhm khy shm'nv 'lhym 'mkhm
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; In those days it shall come to pass , that ten men shall take hold out of all languages of the nations, even shall take hold of the skirt of him that is a Jew, saying, We will go with you: for we have heard that God is with you.

verses.original: מַשָּׂ֤א דְבַר יְהוָה֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ חַדְרָ֔ךְ וְ/דַמֶּ֖שֶׂק מְנֻחָת֑/וֹ כִּ֤י לַֽ/יהוָה֙ עֵ֣ין אָדָ֔ם וְ/כֹ֖ל שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: msh' dbr yhvh b'rts chdrkh vdmshq mnchtv khy lyhvh 'yn 'dm vkhl shbty yshr'l
verses.translation: The burden of the word of the LORD in the land of Hadrach, and Damascus shall be the rest thereof: when the eyes of man, as of all the tribes of Israel, shall be toward the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/גַם חֲמָ֖ת תִּגְבָּל בָּ֑/הּ צֹ֣ר וְ/צִיד֔וֹן כִּ֥י חָֽכְמָ֖ה מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vgm chmt tgbl bh tsr vtsydvn khy chkhmh m'd
verses.translation: And Hamath also shall border thereby; Tyrus, and Zidon, though it be very wise.

verses.original: וַ/תִּ֥בֶן צֹ֛ר מָצ֖וֹר לָ֑/הּ וַ/תִּצְבָּר כֶּ֨סֶף֙ כֶּֽ/עָפָ֔ר וְ/חָר֖וּץ כְּ/טִ֥יט חוּצֽוֹת
verses.translit: vtbn tsr mtsvr lh vttsbr khsf kh'pr vchrvts khtyt chvtsvt
verses.translation: And Tyrus did build herself a strong hold, and heaped up silver as the dust, and fine gold as the mire of the streets.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה אֲדֹנָ/י֙ יֽוֹרִשֶׁ֔/נָּה וְ/הִכָּ֥ה בַ/יָּ֖ם חֵילָ֑/הּ וְ/הִ֖יא בָּ/אֵ֥שׁ תֵּאָכֵֽל
verses.translit: hnh 'dny yvrshnh vhkhh bym chylh vhy' b'sh t'khl
verses.translation: Behold, the Lord will cast her out, and he will smite her power in the sea; and she shall be devoured with fire.

verses.original: תֵּרֶ֨א אַשְׁקְל֜וֹן וְ/תִירָ֗א וְ/עַזָּה֙ וְ/תָחִ֣יל מְאֹ֔ד וְ/עֶקְר֖וֹן כִּֽי הֹבִ֣ישׁ מֶבָּטָ֑/הּ וְ/אָ֤בַד מֶ֨לֶךְ֙ מֵֽ/עַזָּ֔ה וְ/אַשְׁקְל֖וֹן לֹ֥א תֵשֵֽׁב
verses.translit: tr' 'shqlvn vtyr' v'zh vtchyl m'd v'qrvn khy hbysh mbth v'bd mlkh m'zh v'shqlvn l' tshb
verses.translation: Ashkelon shall see it , and fear; Gaza also shall see it , and be very sorrowful, and Ekron; for her expectation shall be ashamed; and the king shall perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon shall not be inhabited.

verses.original: וְ/יָשַׁ֥ב מַמְזֵ֖ר בְּ/אַשְׁדּ֑וֹד וְ/הִכְרַתִּ֖י גְּא֥וֹן פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים
verses.translit: vyshb mmzr b'shdvd vhkhrty g'vn plshtym
verses.translation: And a bastard shall dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.

verses.original: וַ/הֲסִרֹתִ֨י דָמָ֜י/ו מִ/פִּ֗י/ו וְ/שִׁקֻּצָי/ו֙ מִ/בֵּ֣ין שִׁנָּ֔י/ו וְ/נִשְׁאַ֥ר גַּם ה֖וּא לֵֽ/אלֹהֵ֑י/נוּ וְ/הָיָה֙ כְּ/אַלֻּ֣ף בִּֽ/יהוּדָ֔ה וְ/עֶקְר֖וֹן כִּ/יבוּסִֽי
verses.translit: vhsrty dmyv mpyv vshqtsyv mbyn shnyv vnsh'r gm hv' l'lhynv vhyh kh'lf byhvdh v'qrvn khybvsy
verses.translation: And I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth: but he that remaineth, even he, shall be for our God, and he shall be as a governor in Judah, and Ekron as a Jebusite.

verses.original: וְ/חָנִ֨יתִי לְ/בֵיתִ֤/י מִצָּבָה֙ מֵ/עֹבֵ֣ר וּ/מִ/שָּׁ֔ב וְ/לֹֽא יַעֲבֹ֧ר עֲלֵי/הֶ֛ם ע֖וֹד נֹגֵ֑שׂ כִּ֥י עַתָּ֖ה רָאִ֥יתִי בְ/עֵינָֽ/י
verses.translit: vchnyty lbyty mtsbh m'br vmshb vl' y'br 'lyhm 'vd ngsh khy 'th r'yty b'yny
verses.translation: And I will encamp about mine house because of the army, because of him that passeth by, and because of him that returneth: and no oppressor shall pass through them any more: for now have I seen with mine eyes.

verses.original: גִּילִ֨י מְאֹ֜ד בַּת צִיּ֗וֹן הָרִ֨יעִי֙ בַּ֣ת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם הִנֵּ֤ה מַלְכֵּ/ךְ֙ יָ֣בוֹא לָ֔/ךְ צַדִּ֥יק וְ/נוֹשָׁ֖ע ה֑וּא עָנִי֙ וְ/רֹכֵ֣ב עַל חֲמ֔וֹר וְ/עַל עַ֖יִר בֶּן אֲתֹנֽוֹת
verses.translit: gyly m'd bt tsyvn hry'y bt yrvshlm hnh mlkhkh ybv' lkh tsdyq vnvsh' hv' 'ny vrkhb 'l chmvr v'l 'yr bn 'tnvt
verses.translation: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, thy King cometh unto thee: he is just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, and upon a colt the foal of an ass.

verses.original: וְ/הִכְרַתִּי רֶ֣כֶב מֵ/אֶפְרַ֗יִם וְ/סוּס֙ מִ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְ/נִכְרְתָה֙ קֶ֣שֶׁת מִלְחָמָ֔ה וְ/דִבֶּ֥ר שָׁל֖וֹם לַ/גּוֹיִ֑ם וּ/מָשְׁל/וֹ֙ מִ/יָּ֣ם עַד יָ֔ם וּ/מִ/נָּהָ֖ר עַד אַפְסֵי אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vhkhrty rkhb m'prym vsvs myrvshlm vnkhrth qsht mlchmh vdbr shlvm lgvym vmshlv mym 'd ym vmnhr 'd 'psy 'rts
verses.translation: And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim, and the horse from Jerusalem, and the battle bow shall be cut off: and he shall speak peace unto the heathen: and his dominion shall be from sea even to sea, and from the river even to the ends of the earth.

verses.original: גַּם אַ֣תְּ בְּ/דַם בְּרִיתֵ֗/ךְ שִׁלַּ֤חְתִּי אֲסִירַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ מִ/בּ֔וֹר אֵ֥ין מַ֖יִם בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: gm 't bdm brytkh shlchty 'syrykh mbvr 'yn mym bv
verses.translation: As for thee also, by the blood of thy covenant I have sent forth thy prisoners out of the pit wherein is no water.

verses.original: שׁ֚וּבוּ לְ/בִצָּר֔וֹן אֲסִירֵ֖י הַ/תִּקְוָ֑ה גַּם הַ/יּ֕וֹם מַגִּ֥יד מִשְׁנֶ֖ה אָשִׁ֥יב לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: shvbv lbtsrvn 'syry htqvh gm hyvm mgyd mshnh 'shyb lkh
verses.translation: Turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of hope: even to day do I declare that I will render double unto thee;

verses.original: כִּֽי דָרַ֨כְתִּי לִ֜/י יְהוּדָ֗ה קֶ֚שֶׁת מִלֵּ֣אתִי אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְ/עוֹרַרְתִּ֤י בָנַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ צִיּ֔וֹן עַל בָּנַ֖יִ/ךְ יָוָ֑ן וְ/שַׂמְתִּ֖י/ךְ כְּ/חֶ֥רֶב גִּבּֽוֹר
verses.translit: khy drkhty ly yhvdh qsht ml'ty 'prym v'vrrty bnykh tsyvn 'l bnykh yvn vshmtykh khchrb gbvr
verses.translation: When I have bent Judah for me, filled the bow with Ephraim, and raised up thy sons, O Zion, against thy sons, O Greece, and made thee as the sword of a mighty man.

verses.original: וַֽ/יהוָה֙ עֲלֵי/הֶ֣ם יֵֽרָאֶ֔ה וְ/יָצָ֥א כַ/בָּרָ֖ק חִצּ֑/וֹ וַֽ/אדֹנָ֤/י יְהֹוִה֙ בַּ/שּׁוֹפָ֣ר יִתְקָ֔ע וְ/הָלַ֖ךְ בְּ/סַעֲר֥וֹת תֵּימָֽן
verses.translit: vyhvh 'lyhm yr'h vyts' khbrq chtsv v'dny yhvh bshvpr ytq' vhlkh bs'rvt tymn
verses.translation: And the LORD shall be seen over them, and his arrow shall go forth as the lightning: and the Lord GOD shall blow the trumpet, and shall go with whirlwinds of the south.

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה צְבָאוֹת֮ יָגֵ֣ן עֲלֵי/הֶם֒ וְ/אָכְל֗וּ וְ/כָֽבְשׁוּ֙ אַבְנֵי קֶ֔לַע וְ/שָׁת֥וּ הָמ֖וּ כְּמוֹ יָ֑יִן וּ/מָֽלְאוּ֙ כַּ/מִּזְרָ֔ק כְּ/זָוִיּ֖וֹת מִזְבֵּֽחַ
verses.translit: yhvh tsb'vt ygn 'lyhm v'khlv vkhbshv 'bny ql' vshtv hmv khmv yyn vml'v khmzrq khzvyvt mzbch
verses.translation: The LORD of hosts shall defend them; and they shall devour, and subdue with sling stones; and they shall drink, and make a noise as through wine; and they shall be filled like bowls, and as the corners of the altar.

verses.original: וְֽ/הוֹשִׁיעָ֞/ם יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵי/הֶ֛ם בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/ה֖וּא כְּ/צֹ֣אן עַמּ֑/וֹ כִּ֚י אַבְנֵי נֵ֔זֶר מִֽתְנוֹסְס֖וֹת עַל אַדְמָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhvshy'm yhvh 'lhyhm byvm hhv' khts'n 'mv khy 'bny nzr mtnvssvt 'l 'dmtv
verses.translation: And the LORD their God shall save them in that day as the flock of his people: for they shall be as the stones of a crown, lifted up as an ensign upon his land.

verses.original: כִּ֥י מַה טּוּב֖/וֹ וּ/מַה יָפְי֑/וֹ דָּגָן֙ בַּֽחוּרִ֔ים וְ/תִיר֖וֹשׁ יְנוֹבֵ֥ב בְּתֻלֽוֹת
verses.translit: khy mh tvbv vmh ypyv dgn bchvrym vtyrvsh ynvbb btlvt
verses.translation: For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! corn shall make the young men cheerful, and new wine the maids.

verses.original: שַׁאֲל֨וּ מֵ/יְהוָ֤ה מָטָר֙ בְּ/עֵ֣ת מַלְק֔וֹשׁ יְהוָ֖ה עֹשֶׂ֣ה חֲזִיזִ֑ים וּ/מְטַר גֶּ֨שֶׁם֙ יִתֵּ֣ן לָ/הֶ֔ם לְ/אִ֖ישׁ עֵ֥שֶׂב בַּ/שָּׂדֶֽה
verses.translit: sh'lv myhvh mtr b't mlqvsh yhvh 'shh chzyzym vmtr gshm ytn lhm l'ysh 'shb bshdh
verses.translation: Ask ye of the LORD rain in the time of the latter rain; so the LORD shall make bright clouds, and give them showers of rain, to every one grass in the field.

verses.original: כִּ֧י הַ/תְּרָפִ֣ים דִּבְּרוּ אָ֗וֶן וְ/הַ/קּֽוֹסְמִים֙ חָ֣זוּ שֶׁ֔קֶר וַֽ/חֲלֹמוֹת֙ הַ/שָּׁ֣וא יְדַבֵּ֔רוּ הֶ֖בֶל יְנַֽחֵמ֑וּ/ן עַל כֵּן֙ נָסְע֣וּ כְמוֹ צֹ֔אן יַעֲנ֖וּ כִּֽי אֵ֥ין רֹעֶֽה
verses.translit: khy htrpym dbrv 'vn vhqvsmym chzv shqr vchlmvt hshv' ydbrv hbl ynchmvn 'l khn ns'v khmv ts'n y'nv khy 'yn r'h
verses.translation: For the idols have spoken vanity, and the diviners have seen a lie, and have told false dreams; they comfort in vain: therefore they went their way as a flock, they were troubled, because there was no shepherd.

verses.original: עַל הָֽ/רֹעִים֙ חָרָ֣ה אַפִּ֔/י וְ/עַל הָ/עַתּוּדִ֖ים אֶפְק֑וֹד כִּֽי פָקַד֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֤וֹת אֶת עֶדְר/וֹ֙ אֶת בֵּ֣ית יְהוּדָ֔ה וְ/שָׂ֣ם אוֹתָ֔/ם כְּ/ס֥וּס הוֹד֖/וֹ בַּ/מִּלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: 'l hr'ym chrh 'py v'l h'tvdym 'pqvd khy pqd yhvh tsb'vt 't 'drv 't byt yhvdh vshm 'vtm khsvs hvdv bmlchmh
verses.translation: Mine anger was kindled against the shepherds, and I punished the goats: for the LORD of hosts hath visited his flock the house of Judah, and hath made them as his goodly horse in the battle.

verses.original: מִמֶּ֤/נּוּ פִנָּה֙ מִמֶּ֣/נּוּ יָתֵ֔ד מִמֶּ֖/נּוּ קֶ֣שֶׁת מִלְחָמָ֑ה מִמֶּ֛/נּוּ יֵצֵ֥א כָל נוֹגֵ֖שׂ יַחְדָּֽו
verses.translit: mmnv pnh mmnv ytd mmnv qsht mlchmh mmnv yts' khl nvgsh ychdv
verses.translation: Out of him came forth the corner, out of him the nail, out of him the battle bow, out of him every oppressor together.

verses.original: וְ/הָי֨וּ כְ/גִבֹּרִ֜ים בּוֹסִ֨ים בְּ/טִ֤יט חוּצוֹת֙ בַּ/מִּלְחָמָ֔ה וְ/נִ֨לְחֲמ֔וּ כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עִמָּ֑/ם וְ/הֹבִ֖ישׁוּ רֹכְבֵ֥י סוּסִֽים
verses.translit: vhyv khgbrym bvsym btyt chvtsvt bmlchmh vnlchmv khy yhvh 'mm vhbyshv rkhby svsym
verses.translation: And they shall be as mighty men , which tread down their enemies in the mire of the streets in the battle: and they shall fight, because the LORD is with them, and the riders on horses shall be confounded.

verses.original: וְ/גִבַּרְתִּ֣י אֶת בֵּ֣ית יְהוּדָ֗ה וְ/אֶת בֵּ֤ית יוֹסֵף֙ אוֹשִׁ֔יעַ וְ/הֽוֹשְׁבוֹתִי/ם֙ כִּ֣י רִֽחַמְתִּ֔י/ם וְ/הָי֖וּ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא זְנַחְתִּ֑י/ם כִּ֗י אֲנִ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/הֶ֖ם וְ/אֶעֱנֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: vgbrty 't byt yhvdh v't byt yvsf 'vshy' vhvshbvtym khy rchmtym vhyv kh'shr l' znchtym khy 'ny yhvh 'lhyhm v''nm
verses.translation: And I will strengthen the house of Judah, and I will save the house of Joseph, and I will bring them again to place them; for I have mercy upon them: and they shall be as though I had not cast them off: for I am the LORD their God, and will hear them.

verses.original: וְ/הָי֤וּ כְ/גִבּוֹר֙ אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְ/שָׂמַ֥ח לִבָּ֖/ם כְּמוֹ יָ֑יִן וּ/בְנֵי/הֶם֙ יִרְא֣וּ וְ/שָׂמֵ֔חוּ יָגֵ֥ל לִבָּ֖/ם בַּ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhyv khgbvr 'prym vshmch lbm khmv yyn vbnyhm yr'v vshmchv ygl lbm byhvh
verses.translation: And they of Ephraim shall be like a mighty man , and their heart shall rejoice as through wine: yea, their children shall see it , and be glad; their heart shall rejoice in the LORD .

verses.original: אֶשְׁרְקָ֥ה לָ/הֶ֛ם וַ/אֲקַבְּצֵ֖/ם כִּ֣י פְדִיתִ֑י/ם וְ/רָב֖וּ כְּמ֥וֹ רָבֽוּ
verses.translit: 'shrqh lhm v'qbtsm khy pdytym vrbv khmv rbv
verses.translation: I will hiss for them, and gather them; for I have redeemed them: and they shall increase as they have increased.

verses.original: וְ/אֶזְרָעֵ/ם֙ בָּֽ/עַמִּ֔ים וּ/בַ/מֶּרְחַקִּ֖ים יִזְכְּר֑וּ/נִי וְ/חָי֥וּ אֶת בְּנֵי/הֶ֖ם וָ/שָֽׁבוּ
verses.translit: v'zr'm b'mym vbmrchqym yzkhrvny vchyv 't bnyhm vshbv
verses.translation: And I will sow them among the people: and they shall remember me in far countries; and they shall live with their children, and turn again.

verses.original: וַ/הֲשִֽׁיבוֹתִי/ם֙ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וּ/מֵֽ/אַשּׁ֖וּר אֲקַבְּצֵ֑/ם וְ/אֶל אֶ֨רֶץ גִּלְעָ֤ד וּ/לְבָנוֹן֙ אֲבִיאֵ֔/ם וְ/לֹ֥א יִמָּצֵ֖א לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vhshybvtym m'rts mtsrym vm'shvr 'qbtsm v'l 'rts gl'd vlbnvn 'by'm vl' ymts' lhm
verses.translation: I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt, and gather them out of Assyria; and I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon; and place shall not be found for them.

verses.original: וְ/עָבַ֨ר בַּ/יָּ֜ם צָרָ֗ה וְ/הִכָּ֤ה בַ/יָּם֙ גַּלִּ֔ים וְ/הֹבִ֕ישׁוּ כֹּ֖ל מְצוּל֣וֹת יְאֹ֑ר וְ/הוּרַד֙ גְּא֣וֹן אַשּׁ֔וּר וְ/שֵׁ֥בֶט מִצְרַ֖יִם יָסֽוּר
verses.translit: v'br bym tsrh vhkhh bym glym vhbyshv khl mtsvlvt y'r vhvrd g'vn 'shvr vshbt mtsrym ysvr
verses.translation: And he shall pass through the sea with affliction, and shall smite the waves in the sea, and all the deeps of the river shall dry up: and the pride of Assyria shall be brought down, and the sceptre of Egypt shall depart away.

verses.original: וְ/גִבַּרְתִּי/ם֙ בַּֽ/יהוָ֔ה וּ/בִ/שְׁמ֖/וֹ יִתְהַלָּ֑כוּ נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vgbrtym byhvh vbshmv ythlkhv n'm yhvh
verses.translation: And I will strengthen them in the LORD ; and they shall walk up and down in his name, saith the LORD .

verses.original: פְּתַ֥ח לְבָנ֖וֹן דְּלָתֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/תֹאכַ֥ל אֵ֖שׁ בַּ/אֲרָזֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: ptch lbnvn dltykh vt'khl 'sh b'rzykh
verses.translation: Open thy doors, O Lebanon, that the fire may devour thy cedars.

verses.original: הֵילֵ֤ל בְּרוֹשׁ֙ כִּֽי נָ֣פַל אֶ֔רֶז אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַדִּרִ֖ים שֻׁדָּ֑דוּ הֵילִ֨ילוּ֙ אַלּוֹנֵ֣י בָשָׁ֔ן כִּ֥י יָרַ֖ד יַ֥עַר ה/בצור הַ/בָּצִֽיר
verses.translit: hyll brvsh khy npl 'rz 'shr 'drym shddv hylylv 'lvny bshn khy yrd y'r hbtsvr hbtsyr
verses.translation: Howl, fir tree; for the cedar is fallen; because the mighty are spoiled: howl, O ye oaks of Bashan; for the forest of the vintage is come down.

verses.original: ק֚וֹל יִֽלְלַ֣ת הָ/רֹעִ֔ים כִּ֥י שֻׁדְּדָ֖ה אַדַּרְתָּ֑/ם ק֚וֹל שַׁאֲגַ֣ת כְּפִירִ֔ים כִּ֥י שֻׁדַּ֖ד גְּא֥וֹן הַ/יַּרְדֵּֽן
verses.translit: qvl yllt hr'ym khy shddh 'drtm qvl sh'gt khpyrym khy shdd g'vn hyrdn
verses.translation: There is a voice of the howling of the shepherds; for their glory is spoiled: a voice of the roaring of young lions; for the pride of Jordan is spoiled.

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑/י רְעֵ֖ה אֶת צֹ֥אן הַ/הֲרֵגָֽה
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy r'h 't ts'n hhrgh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD my God; Feed the flock of the slaughter;

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר קֹנֵי/הֶ֤ן יַֽהֲרְגֻ/ן֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יֶאְשָׁ֔מוּ וּ/מֹכְרֵי/הֶ֣ן יֹאמַ֔ר בָּר֥וּךְ יְהוָ֖ה וַ/אעְשִׁ֑ר וְ/רֹ֣עֵי/הֶ֔ם לֹ֥א יַחְמ֖וֹל עֲלֵי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: 'shr qnyhn yhrgn vl' y'shmv vmkhryhn y'mr brvkh yhvh v''shr vr'yhm l' ychmvl 'lyhn
verses.translation: Whose possessors slay them, and hold themselves not guilty: and they that sell them say, Blessed be the LORD ; for I am rich: and their own shepherds pity them not.

verses.original: כִּ֠י לֹ֣א אֶחְמ֥וֹל ע֛וֹד עַל יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָ/אָ֖רֶץ נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה וְ/הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֜י מַמְצִ֣יא אֶת הָ/אָדָ֗ם אִ֤ישׁ בְּ/יַד רֵעֵ֨/הוּ֙ וּ/בְ/יַ֣ד מַלְכּ֔/וֹ וְ/כִתְּתוּ֙ אֶת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/לֹ֥א אַצִּ֖יל מִ/יָּדָֽ/ם
verses.translit: khy l' 'chmvl 'vd 'l yshby h'rts n'm yhvh vhnh 'nkhy mmtsy' 't h'dm 'ysh byd r'hv vbyd mlkhv vkhttv 't h'rts vl' 'tsyl mydm
verses.translation: For I will no more pity the inhabitants of the land, saith the LORD : but, lo, I will deliver the men every one into his neighbour’s hand, and into the hand of his king: and they shall smite the land, and out of their hand I will not deliver them .

verses.original: וָֽ/אֶרְעֶה֙ אֶת צֹ֣אן הַֽ/הֲרֵגָ֔ה לָ/כֵ֖ן עֲנִיֵּ֣י הַ/צֹּ֑אן וָ/אֶקַּֽח לִ֞/י שְׁנֵ֣י מַקְל֗וֹת לְ/אַחַ֞ד קָרָ֤אתִי נֹ֨עַם֙ וּ/לְ/אַחַד֙ קָרָ֣אתִי חֹֽבְלִ֔ים וָ/אֶרְעֶ֖ה אֶת הַ/צֹּֽאן
verses.translit: v'r'h 't ts'n hhrgh lkhn 'nyy hts'n v'qch ly shny mqlvt l'chd qr'ty n'm vl'chd qr'ty chblym v'r'h 't hts'n
verses.translation: And I will feed the flock of slaughter, even you, O poor of the flock. And I took unto me two staves; the one I called Beauty, and the other I called Bands; and I fed the flock.

verses.original: וָ/אַכְחִ֛ד אֶת שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת הָ/רֹעִ֖ים בְּ/יֶ֣רַח אֶחָ֑ד וַ/תִּקְצַ֤ר נַפְשִׁ/י֙ בָּ/הֶ֔ם וְ/גַם נַפְשָׁ֖/ם בָּחֲלָ֥ה בִֽ/י
verses.translit: v'khchd 't shlsht hr'ym byrch 'chd vtqtsr npshy bhm vgm npshm bchlh by
verses.translation: Three shepherds also I cut off in one month; and my soul lothed them, and their soul also abhorred me.

verses.original: וָ/אֹמַ֕ר לֹ֥א אֶרְעֶ֖ה אֶתְ/כֶ֑ם הַ/מֵּתָ֣ה תָמ֗וּת וְ/הַ/נִּכְחֶ֨דֶת֙ תִּכָּחֵ֔ד וְ/הַ֨/נִּשְׁאָר֔וֹת תֹּאכַ֕לְנָה אִשָּׁ֖ה אֶת בְּשַׂ֥ר רְעוּתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: v'mr l' 'r'h 'tkhm hmth tmvt vhnkhchdt tkhchd vhnsh'rvt t'khlnh 'shh 't bshr r'vth
verses.translation: Then said I, I will not feed you: that that dieth, let it die; and that that is to be cut off, let it be cut off; and let the rest eat every one the flesh of another.

verses.original: וָ/אֶקַּ֤ח אֶת מַקְלִ/י֙ אֶת נֹ֔עַם וָ/אֶגְדַּ֖ע אֹת֑/וֹ לְ/הָפֵיר֙ אֶת בְּרִיתִ֔/י אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּרַ֖תִּי אֶת כָּל הָ/עַמִּֽים
verses.translit: v'qch 't mqly 't n'm v'gd' 'tv lhpyr 't bryty 'shr khrty 't khl h'mym
verses.translation: And I took my staff, even Beauty, and cut it asunder, that I might break my covenant which I had made with all the people.

verses.original: וַ/תֻּפַ֖ר בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֑וּא וַ/יֵּדְע֨וּ כֵ֜ן עֲנִיֵּ֤י הַ/צֹּאן֙ הַ/שֹּׁמְרִ֣ים אֹתִ֔/י כִּ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה הֽוּא
verses.translit: vtpr byvm hhv' vyd'v khn 'nyy hts'n hshmrym 'ty khy dbr yhvh hv'
verses.translation: And it was broken in that day: and so the poor of the flock that waited upon me knew that it was the word of the LORD .

verses.original: וָ/אֹמַ֣ר אֲלֵי/הֶ֗ם אִם ט֧וֹב בְּ/עֵינֵי/כֶ֛ם הָב֥וּ שְׂכָרִ֖/י וְ/אִם לֹ֣א חֲדָ֑לוּ וַ/יִּשְׁקְל֥וּ אֶת שְׂכָרִ֖/י שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים כָּֽסֶף
verses.translit: v'mr 'lyhm 'm tvb b'ynykhm hbv shkhry v'm l' chdlv vyshqlv 't shkhry shlshym khsf
verses.translation: And I said unto them, If ye think good, give me my price; and if not, forbear. So they weighed for my price thirty pieces of silver.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗/י הַשְׁלִיכֵ֨/הוּ֙ אֶל הַ/יּוֹצֵ֔ר אֶ֣דֶר הַ/יְקָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָקַ֖רְתִּי מֵֽ/עֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם וָֽ/אֶקְחָ/ה֙ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים הַ/כֶּ֔סֶף וָ/אַשְׁלִ֥יךְ אֹת֛/וֹ בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה אֶל הַ/יּוֹצֵֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly hshlykhhv 'l hyvtsr 'dr hyqr 'shr yqrty m'lyhm v'qchh shlshym hkhsf v'shlykh 'tv byt yhvh 'l hyvtsr
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto me, Cast it unto the potter: a goodly price that I was prised at of them. And I took the thirty pieces of silver, and cast them to the potter in the house of the LORD .

verses.original: וָֽ/אֶגְדַּע֙ אֶת מַקְלִ֣/י הַ/שֵּׁנִ֔י אֵ֖ת הַ/חֹֽבְלִ֑ים לְ/הָפֵר֙ אֶת הָֽ/אַחֲוָ֔ה בֵּ֥ין יְהוּדָ֖ה וּ/בֵ֥ין יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: v'gd' 't mqly hshny 't hchblym lhpr 't h'chvh byn yhvdh vbyn yshr'l
verses.translation: Then I cut asunder mine other staff, even Bands, that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֑/י ע֣וֹד קַח לְ/ךָ֔ כְּלִ֖י רֹעֶ֥ה אֱוִלִֽי
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly 'vd qch lkh khly r'h 'vly
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto me, Take unto thee yet the instruments of a foolish shepherd.

verses.original: כִּ֣י הִנֵּֽה אָנֹכִי֩ מֵקִ֨ים רֹעֶ֜ה בָּ/אָ֗רֶץ הַ/נִּכְחָד֤וֹת לֹֽא יִפְקֹד֙ הַ/נַּ֣עַר לֹֽא יְבַקֵּ֔שׁ וְ/הַ/נִּשְׁבֶּ֖רֶת לֹ֣א יְרַפֵּ֑א הַ/נִּצָּבָה֙ לֹ֣א יְכַלְכֵּ֔ל וּ/בְשַׂ֤ר הַ/בְּרִיאָה֙ יֹאכַ֔ל וּ/פַרְסֵי/הֶ֖ן יְפָרֵֽק
verses.translit: khy hnh 'nkhy mqym r'h b'rts hnkhchdvt l' ypqd hn'r l' ybqsh vhnshbrt l' yrp' hntsbh l' ykhlkhl vbshr hbry'h y'khl vprsyhn yprq
verses.translation: For, lo, I will raise up a shepherd in the land, which shall not visit those that be cut off, neither shall seek the young one, nor heal that that is broken, nor feed that that standeth still: but he shall eat the flesh of the fat, and tear their claws in pieces.

verses.original: ה֣וֹי רֹעִ֤י הָֽ/אֱלִיל֙ עֹזְבִ֣י הַ/צֹּ֔אן חֶ֥רֶב עַל זְרוֹע֖/וֹ וְ/עַל עֵ֣ין יְמִינ֑/וֹ זְרֹע/וֹ֙ יָב֣וֹשׁ תִּיבָ֔שׁ וְ/עֵ֥ין יְמִינ֖/וֹ כָּהֹ֥ה תִכְהֶֽה
verses.translit: hvy r'y h'lyl 'zby hts'n chrb 'l zrv'v v'l 'yn ymynv zr'v ybvsh tybsh v'yn ymynv khhh tkhhh
verses.translation: Woe to the idol shepherd that leaveth the flock! the sword shall be upon his arm, and upon his right eye: his arm shall be clean dried up, and his right eye shall be utterly darkened.

verses.original: מַשָּׂ֥א דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל נְאֻם יְהוָ֗ה נֹטֶ֤ה שָׁמַ֨יִם֙ וְ/יֹסֵ֣ד אָ֔רֶץ וְ/יֹצֵ֥ר רֽוּחַ אָדָ֖ם בְּ/קִרְבּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: msh' dbr yhvh 'l yshr'l n'm yhvh nth shmym vysd 'rts vytsr rvch 'dm bqrbv
verses.translation: The burden of the word of the LORD for Israel, saith the LORD , which stretcheth forth the heavens, and layeth the foundation of the earth, and formeth the spirit of man within him.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה אָ֠נֹכִי שָׂ֣ם אֶת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֧ם סַף רַ֛עַל לְ/כָל הָ/עַמִּ֖ים סָבִ֑יב וְ/גַ֧ם עַל יְהוּדָ֛ה יִֽהְיֶ֥ה בַ/מָּצ֖וֹר עַל יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: hnh 'nkhy shm 't yrvshlm sf r'l lkhl h'mym sbyb vgm 'l yhvdh yhyh bmtsvr 'l yrvshlm
verses.translation: Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of trembling unto all the people round about, when they shall be in the siege both against Judah and against Jerusalem.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֣ה בַ/יּוֹם הַ֠/הוּא אָשִׂ֨ים אֶת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם אֶ֤בֶן מַֽעֲמָסָה֙ לְ/כָל הָ֣/עַמִּ֔ים כָּל עֹמְסֶ֖י/הָ שָׂר֣וֹט יִשָּׂרֵ֑טוּ וְ/נֶאֶסְפ֣וּ עָלֶ֔י/הָ כֹּ֖ל גּוֹיֵ֥י הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' 'shym 't yrvshlm 'bn m'msh lkhl h'mym khl 'msyh shrvt yshrtv vn'spv 'lyh khl gvyy h'rts
verses.translation: And in that day will I make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all people: all that burden themselves with it shall be cut in pieces, though all the people of the earth be gathered together against it.

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֨וֹם הַ/ה֜וּא נְאֻם יְהוָ֗ה אַכֶּ֤ה כָל סוּס֙ בַּ/תִּמָּה֔וֹן וְ/רֹכְב֖/וֹ בַּ/שִּׁגָּע֑וֹן וְ/עַל בֵּ֤ית יְהוּדָה֙ אֶפְקַ֣ח אֶת עֵינַ֔/י וְ/כֹל֙ ס֣וּס הָֽ/עַמִּ֔ים אַכֶּ֖ה בַּֽ/עִוָּרֽוֹן
verses.translit: byvm hhv' n'm yhvh 'khh khl svs btmhvn vrkhbv bshg'vn v'l byt yhvdh 'pqch 't 'yny vkhl svs h'mym 'khh b'vrvn
verses.translation: In that day, saith the LORD , I will smite every horse with astonishment, and his rider with madness: and I will open mine eyes upon the house of Judah, and will smite every horse of the people with blindness.

verses.original: וְ/אָֽמְר֛וּ אַלֻּפֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה בְּ/לִבָּ֑/ם אַמְצָ֥ה לִ/י֙ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם בַּ/יהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'mrv 'lpy yhvdh blbm 'mtsh ly yshby yrvshlm byhvh tsb'vt 'lhyhm
verses.translation: And the governors of Judah shall say in their heart, The inhabitants of Jerusalem shall be my strength in the LORD of hosts their God.

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֡וּא אָשִׂים֩ אֶת אַלֻּפֵ֨י יְהוּדָ֜ה כְּֽ/כִיּ֧וֹר אֵ֣שׁ בְּ/עֵצִ֗ים וּ/כְ/לַפִּ֥יד אֵשׁ֙ בְּ/עָמִ֔יר וְ/אָ֨כְל֜וּ עַל יָמִ֧ין וְ/עַל שְׂמֹ֛אול אֶת כָּל הָ/עַמִּ֖ים סָבִ֑יב וְ/יָשְׁבָ֨ה יְרוּשָׁלִַ֥ם ע֛וֹד תַּחְתֶּ֖י/הָ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: byvm hhv' 'shym 't 'lpy yhvdh khkhyvr 'sh b'tsym vkhlpyd 'sh b'myr v'khlv 'l ymyn v'l shm'vl 't khl h'mym sbyb vyshbh yrvshlm 'vd tchtyh byrvshlm
verses.translation: In that day will I make the governors of Judah like an hearth of fire among the wood, and like a torch of fire in a sheaf; and they shall devour all the people round about, on the right hand and on the left: and Jerusalem shall be inhabited again in her own place, even in Jerusalem.

verses.original: וְ/הוֹשִׁ֧יעַ יְהוָ֛ה אֶת אָהֳלֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה בָּ/רִֽאשֹׁנָ֑ה לְמַ֨עַן לֹֽא תִגְדַּ֜ל תִּפְאֶ֣רֶת בֵּית דָּוִ֗יד וְ/תִפְאֶ֛רֶת יֹשֵׁ֥ב יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם עַל יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vhvshy' yhvh 't 'hly yhvdh br'shnh lm'n l' tgdl tp'rt byt dvyd vtp'rt yshb yrvshlm 'l yhvdh
verses.translation: The LORD also shall save the tents of Judah first, that the glory of the house of David and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem do not magnify themselves against Judah.

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא יָגֵ֤ן יְהוָה֙ בְּעַד֙ יוֹשֵׁ֣ב יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְ/הָיָ֞ה הַ/נִּכְשָׁ֥ל בָּ/הֶ֛ם בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/ה֖וּא כְּ/דָוִ֑יד וּ/בֵ֤ית דָּוִיד֙ כֵּֽ/אלֹהִ֔ים כְּ/מַלְאַ֥ךְ יְהוָ֖ה לִ/פְנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: byvm hhv' ygn yhvh b'd yvshb yrvshlm vhyh hnkhshl bhm byvm hhv' khdvyd vbyt dvyd kh'lhym khml'kh yhvh lpnyhm
verses.translation: In that day shall the LORD defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and he that is feeble among them at that day shall be as David; and the house of David shall be as God, as the angel of the LORD before them.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֖ה בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֑וּא אֲבַקֵּ֗שׁ לְ/הַשְׁמִיד֙ אֶת כָּל הַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם הַ/בָּאִ֖ים עַל יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' 'bqsh lhshmyd 't khl hgvym hb'ym 'l yrvshlm
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁפַכְתִּי֩ עַל בֵּ֨ית דָּוִ֜יד וְ/עַ֣ל יוֹשֵׁ֣ב יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם ר֤וּחַ חֵן֙ וְ/תַ֣חֲנוּנִ֔ים וְ/הִבִּ֥יטוּ אֵלַ֖/י אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר דָּקָ֑רוּ וְ/סָפְד֣וּ עָלָ֗י/ו כְּ/מִסְפֵּד֙ עַל הַ/יָּחִ֔יד וְ/הָמֵ֥ר עָלָ֖י/ו כְּ/הָמֵ֥ר עַֽל הַ/בְּכֽוֹר
verses.translit: vshpkhty 'l byt dvyd v'l yvshb yrvshlm rvch chn vtchnvnym vhbytv 'ly 't 'shr dqrv vspdv 'lyv khmspd 'l hychyd vhmr 'lyv khhmr 'l hbkhvr
verses.translation: And I will pour upon the house of David, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the spirit of grace and of supplications: and they shall look upon me whom they have pierced, and they shall mourn for him, as one mourneth for his only son , and shall be in bitterness for him, as one that is in bitterness for his firstborn.

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא יִגְדַּ֤ל הַ/מִּסְפֵּד֙ בִּ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם כְּ/מִסְפַּ֥ד הֲדַדְ רִמּ֖וֹן בְּ/בִקְעַ֥ת מְגִדּֽוֹן
verses.translit: byvm hhv' ygdl hmspd byrvshlm khmspd hdd rmvn bbq't mgdvn
verses.translation: In that day shall there be a great mourning in Jerusalem, as the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddon.

verses.original: וְ/סָפְדָ֣ה הָ/אָ֔רֶץ מִשְׁפָּח֥וֹת מִשְׁפָּח֖וֹת לְ/בָ֑ד מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת בֵּית דָּוִ֤יד לְ/בָד֙ וּ/נְשֵׁי/הֶ֣ם לְ/בָ֔ד מִשְׁפַּ֤חַת בֵּית נָתָן֙ לְ/בָ֔ד וּ/נְשֵׁי/הֶ֖ם לְ/בָֽד
verses.translit: vspdh h'rts mshpchvt mshpchvt lbd mshpcht byt dvyd lbd vnshyhm lbd mshpcht byt ntn lbd vnshyhm lbd
verses.translation: And the land shall mourn, every family apart; the family of the house of David apart, and their wives apart; the family of the house of Nathan apart, and their wives apart;

verses.original: מִשְׁפַּ֤חַת בֵּית לֵוִי֙ לְ/בָ֔ד וּ/נְשֵׁי/הֶ֖ם לְ/בָ֑ד מִשְׁפַּ֤חַת הַ/שִּׁמְעִי֙ לְ/בָ֔ד וּ/נְשֵׁי/הֶ֖ם לְ/בָֽד
verses.translit: mshpcht byt lvy lbd vnshyhm lbd mshpcht hshm'y lbd vnshyhm lbd
verses.translation: The family of the house of Levi apart, and their wives apart; the family of Shimei apart, and their wives apart;

verses.original: כֹּ֗ל הַ/מִּשְׁפָּחוֹת֙ הַ/נִּשְׁאָר֔וֹת מִשְׁפָּחֹ֥ת מִשְׁפָּחֹ֖ת לְ/בָ֑ד וּ/נְשֵׁי/הֶ֖ם לְ/בָֽד
verses.translit: khl hmshpchvt hnsh'rvt mshpcht mshpcht lbd vnshyhm lbd
verses.translation: All the families that remain, every family apart, and their wives apart.

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא יִֽהְיֶה֙ מָק֣וֹר נִפְתָּ֔ח לְ/בֵ֥ית דָּוִ֖יד וּ/לְ/יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם לְ/חַטַּ֖את וּ/לְ/נִדָּֽה
verses.translit: byvm hhv' yhyh mqvr nptch lbyt dvyd vlyshby yrvshlm lcht't vlndh
verses.translation: In that day there shall be a fountain opened to the house of David and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem for sin and for uncleanness.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֩ בַ/יּ֨וֹם הַ/ה֜וּא נְאֻ֣ם יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת אַכְרִ֞ית אֶת שְׁמ֤וֹת הָֽ/עֲצַבִּים֙ מִן הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/לֹ֥א יִזָּכְר֖וּ ע֑וֹד וְ/גַ֧ם אֶת הַ/נְּבִיאִ֛ים וְ/אֶת ר֥וּחַ הַ/טֻּמְאָ֖ה אַעֲבִ֥יר מִן הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' n'm yhvh tsb'vt 'khryt 't shmvt h'tsbym mn h'rts vl' yzkhrv 'vd vgm 't hnby'ym v't rvch htm'h ''byr mn h'rts
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD of hosts, that I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land, and they shall no more be remembered: and also I will cause the prophets and the unclean spirit to pass out of the land.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה כִּֽי יִנָּבֵ֣א אִישׁ֮ עוֹד֒ וְ/אָמְר֣וּ אֵ֠לָי/ו אָבִ֨י/ו וְ/אִמּ֤/וֹ יֹֽלְדָי/ו֙ לֹ֣א תִֽחְיֶ֔ה כִּ֛י שֶׁ֥קֶר דִּבַּ֖רְתָּ בְּ/שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה וּ/דְקָרֻ֜/הוּ אָבִ֧י/הוּ וְ/אִמּ֛/וֹ יֹלְדָ֖י/ו בְּ/הִנָּבְאֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhyh khy ynb' 'ysh 'vd v'mrv 'lyv 'byv v'mv yldyv l' tchyh khy shqr dbrt bshm yhvh vdqrhv 'byhv v'mv yldyv bhnb'v
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that when any shall yet prophesy, then his father and his mother that begat him shall say unto him, Thou shalt not live; for thou speakest lies in the name of the LORD : and his father and his mother that begat him shall thrust him through when he prophesieth.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֣ה בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא יֵבֹ֧שׁוּ הַ/נְּבִיאִ֛ים אִ֥ישׁ מֵ/חֶזְיֹנ֖/וֹ בְּ/הִנָּֽבְאֹת֑/וֹ וְ/לֹ֧א יִלְבְּשׁ֛וּ אַדֶּ֥רֶת שֵׂעָ֖ר לְמַ֥עַן כַּחֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' ybshv hnby'ym 'ysh mchzynv bhnb'tv vl' ylbshv 'drt sh'r lm'n khchsh
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the prophets shall be ashamed every one of his vision, when he hath prophesied; neither shall they wear a rough garment to deceive:

verses.original: וְ/אָמַ֕ר לֹ֥א נָבִ֖יא אָנֹ֑כִי אִישׁ עֹבֵ֤ד אֲדָמָה֙ אָנֹ֔כִי כִּ֥י אָדָ֖ם הִקְנַ֥/נִי מִ/נְּעוּרָֽ/י
verses.translit: v'mr l' nby' 'nkhy 'ysh 'bd 'dmh 'nkhy khy 'dm hqnny mn'vry
verses.translation: But he shall say, I am no prophet, I am an husbandman; for man taught me to keep cattle from my youth.

verses.original: וְ/אָמַ֣ר אֵלָ֔י/ו מָ֧ה הַ/מַּכּ֛וֹת הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה בֵּ֣ין יָדֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/אָמַ֕ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֻכֵּ֖יתִי בֵּ֥ית מְאַהֲבָֽ/י
verses.translit: v'mr 'lyv mh hmkhvt h'lh byn ydykh v'mr 'shr hkhyty byt m'hby
verses.translation: And one shall say unto him, What are these wounds in thine hands? Then he shall answer, Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends.

verses.original: חֶ֗רֶב עוּרִ֤י עַל רֹעִ/י֙ וְ/עַל גֶּ֣בֶר עֲמִיתִ֔/י נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת הַ֤ךְ אֶת הָֽ/רֹעֶה֙ וּ/תְפוּצֶ֣יןָ הַ/צֹּ֔אן וַ/הֲשִׁבֹתִ֥י יָדִ֖/י עַל הַ/צֹּעֲרִֽים
verses.translit: chrb 'vry 'l r'y v'l gbr 'myty n'm yhvh tsb'vt hkh 't hr'h vtpvtsyn hts'n vhshbty ydy 'l hts'rym
verses.translation: Awake, O sword, against my shepherd, and against the man that is my fellow, saith the LORD of hosts: smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered: and I will turn mine hand upon the little ones.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֤ה בְ/כָל הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה פִּֽי שְׁנַ֣יִם בָּ֔/הּ יִכָּרְת֖וּ יִגְוָ֑עוּ וְ/הַ/שְּׁלִשִׁ֖ית יִוָּ֥תֶר בָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vhyh bkhl h'rts n'm yhvh py shnym bh ykhrtv ygv'v vhshlshyt yvtr bh
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that in all the land, saith the LORD , two parts therein shall be cut off and die; but the third shall be left therein.

verses.original: וְ/הֵבֵאתִ֤י אֶת הַ/שְּׁלִשִׁית֙ בָּ/אֵ֔שׁ וּ/צְרַפְתִּי/ם֙ כִּ/צְרֹ֣ף אֶת הַ/כֶּ֔סֶף וּ/בְחַנְתִּ֖י/ם כִּ/בְחֹ֣ן אֶת הַ/זָּהָ֑ב ה֣וּא יִקְרָ֣א בִ/שְׁמִ֗/י וַֽ/אֲנִי֙ אֶעֱנֶ֣ה אֹת֔/וֹ אָמַ֨רְתִּי֙ עַמִּ֣/י ה֔וּא וְ/ה֥וּא יֹאמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽ/י
verses.translit: vhb'ty 't hshlshyt b'sh vtsrptym khtsrf 't hkhsf vbchntym khbchn 't hzhb hv' yqr' bshmy v'ny ''nh 'tv 'mrty 'my hv' vhv' y'mr yhvh 'lhy
verses.translation: And I will bring the third part through the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will try them as gold is tried: they shall call on my name, and I will hear them: I will say, It is my people: and they shall say, The LORD is my God.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֥ה יֽוֹם בָּ֖א לַֽ/יהוָ֑ה וְ/חֻלַּ֥ק שְׁלָלֵ֖/ךְ בְּ/קִרְבֵּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: hnh yvm b' lyhvh vchlq shllkh bqrbkh
verses.translation: Behold, the day of the LORD cometh, and thy spoil shall be divided in the midst of thee.

verses.original: וְ/אָסַפְתִּ֨י אֶת כָּל הַ/גּוֹיִ֥ם אֶֽל יְרוּשָׁלִַם֮ לַ/מִּלְחָמָה֒ וְ/נִלְכְּדָ֣ה הָ/עִ֗יר וְ/נָשַׁ֨סּוּ֙ הַ/בָּ֣תִּ֔ים וְ/הַ/נָּשִׁ֖ים תשגלנה תִּשָּׁכַ֑בְנָה וְ/יָצָ֞א חֲצִ֤י הָ/עִיר֙ בַּ/גּוֹלָ֔ה וְ/יֶ֣תֶר הָ/עָ֔ם לֹ֥א יִכָּרֵ֖ת מִן הָ/עִֽיר
verses.translit: v'spty 't khl hgvym 'l yrvshlm lmlchmh vnlkhdh h'yr vnshsv hbtym vhnshym tshglnh tshkhbnh vyts' chtsy h'yr bgvlh vytr h'm l' ykhrt mn h'yr
verses.translation: For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle; and the city shall be taken, and the houses rifled, and the women ravished; and half of the city shall go forth into captivity, and the residue of the people shall not be cut off from the city.

verses.original: וְ/יָצָ֣א יְהוָ֔ה וְ/נִלְחַ֖ם בַּ/גּוֹיִ֣ם הָ/הֵ֑ם כְּ/י֥וֹם הִֽלָּחֲמ֖/ו בְּ/י֥וֹם קְרָֽב
verses.translit: vyts' yhvh vnlchm bgvym hhm khyvm hlchmv byvm qrb
verses.translation: Then shall the LORD go forth, and fight against those nations, as when he fought in the day of battle.
