verses.original: וְ/עָמְד֣וּ רַגְלָ֣י/ו בַּ/יּוֹם הַ֠/הוּא עַל הַ֨ר הַ/זֵּתִ֜ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר עַל פְּנֵ֥י יְרוּשָׁלִַם֮ מִ/קֶּדֶם֒ וְ/נִבְקַע֩ הַ֨ר הַ/זֵּיתִ֤ים מֵֽ/חֶצְי/וֹ֙ מִזְרָ֣חָ/ה וָ/יָ֔מָּ/ה גֵּ֖יא גְּדוֹלָ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד וּ/מָ֨שׁ חֲצִ֥י הָ/הָ֛ר צָפ֖וֹנָ/ה וְ/חֶצְי/וֹ נֶֽגְבָּ/ה
verses.translit: v'mdv rglyv byvm hhv' 'l hr hztym 'shr 'l pny yrvshlm mqdm vnbq' hr hzytym mchtsyv mzrchh vymh gy' gdvlh m'd vmsh chtsy hhr tspvnh vchtsyv ngbh
verses.translation: And his feet shall stand in that day upon the mount of Olives, which is before Jerusalem on the east, and the mount of Olives shall cleave in the midst thereof toward the east and toward the west, and there shall be a very great valley; and half of the mountain shall remove toward the north, and half of it toward the south.

verses.original: וְ/נַסְתֶּ֣ם גֵּֽיא הָרַ֗/י כִּֽי יַגִּ֣יעַ גֵּי הָרִים֮ אֶל אָצַל֒ וְ/נַסְתֶּ֗ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר נַסְתֶּם֙ מִ/פְּנֵ֣י הָ/רַ֔עַשׁ בִּ/ימֵ֖י עֻזִּיָּ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וּ/בָא֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהַ֔/י כָּל קְדֹשִׁ֖ים עִמָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vnstm gy' hry khy ygy' gy hrym 'l 'tsl vnstm kh'shr nstm mpny hr'sh bymy 'zyh mlkh yhvdh vb' yhvh 'lhy khl qdshym 'mkh
verses.translation: And ye shall flee to the valley of the mountains; for the valley of the mountains shall reach unto Azal: yea, ye shall flee, like as ye fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah: and the LORD my God shall come, and all the saints with thee.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֖ה בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֑וּא לֹֽא יִהְיֶ֣ה א֔וֹר יְקָר֖וֹת יקפאו/ן וְ/קִפָּאֽוֹן
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' l' yhyh 'vr yqrvt yqp'vn vqp'vn
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the light shall not be clear, nor dark:

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֣ה יוֹם אֶחָ֗ד ה֛וּא יִוָּדַ֥ע לַֽ/יהוָ֖ה לֹא י֣וֹם וְ/לֹא לָ֑יְלָה וְ/הָיָ֥ה לְ/עֵֽת עֶ֖רֶב יִֽהְיֶה אֽוֹר
verses.translit: vhyh yvm 'chd hv' yvd' lyhvh l' yvm vl' lylh vhyh l't 'rb yhyh 'vr
verses.translation: But it shall be one day which shall be known to the LORD , not day, nor night: but it shall come to pass, that at evening time it shall be light.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֣ה בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא יֵצְא֤וּ מַֽיִם חַיִּים֙ מִ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם חֶצְיָ֗/ם אֶל הַ/יָּם֙ הַ/קַּדְמוֹנִ֔י וְ/חֶצְיָ֖/ם אֶל הַ/יָּ֣ם הָ/אַחֲר֑וֹן בַּ/קַּ֥יִץ וּ/בָ/חֹ֖רֶף יִֽהְיֶֽה
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' yts'v mym chyym myrvshlm chtsym 'l hym hqdmvny vchtsym 'l hym h'chrvn bqyts vbchrf yhyh
verses.translation: And it shall be in that day, that living waters shall go out from Jerusalem; half of them toward the former sea, and half of them toward the hinder sea: in summer and in winter shall it be.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה לְ/מֶ֖לֶךְ עַל כָּל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא יִהְיֶ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶחָ֖ד וּ/שְׁמ֥/וֹ אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: vhyh yhvh lmlkh 'l khl h'rts byvm hhv' yhyh yhvh 'chd vshmv 'chd
verses.translation: And the LORD shall be king over all the earth: in that day shall there be one LORD , and his name one.

verses.original: יִסּ֨וֹב כָּל הָ/אָ֤רֶץ כָּ/עֲרָבָה֙ מִ/גֶּ֣בַע לְ/רִמּ֔וֹן נֶ֖גֶב יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְֽ/רָאֲמָה֩ וְ/יָשְׁבָ֨ה תַחְתֶּ֜י/הָ לְ/מִ/שַּׁ֣עַר בִּנְיָמִ֗ן עַד מְק֞וֹם שַׁ֤עַר הָֽ/רִאשׁוֹן֙ עַד שַׁ֣עַר הַ/פִּנִּ֔ים וּ/מִגְדַּ֣ל חֲנַנְאֵ֔ל עַ֖ד יִקְבֵ֥י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: ysvb khl h'rts kh'rbh mgb' lrmvn ngb yrvshlm vr'mh vyshbh tchtyh lmsh'r bnymn 'd mqvm sh'r hr'shvn 'd sh'r hpnym vmgdl chnn'l 'd yqby hmlkh
verses.translation: All the land shall be turned as a plain from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem: and it shall be lifted up, and inhabited in her place, from Benjamin’s gate unto the place of the first gate, unto the corner gate, and from the tower of Hananeel unto the king’s winepresses.

verses.original: וְ/יָ֣שְׁבוּ בָ֔/הּ וְ/חֵ֖רֶם לֹ֣א יִֽהְיֶה ע֑וֹד וְ/יָשְׁבָ֥ה יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם לָ/בֶֽטַח
verses.translit: vyshbv bh vchrm l' yhyh 'vd vyshbh yrvshlm lbtch
verses.translation: And men shall dwell in it, and there shall be no more utter destruction; but Jerusalem shall be safely inhabited.

verses.original: וְ/זֹ֣את תִּֽהְיֶ֣ה הַ/מַּגֵּפָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִגֹּ֤ף יְהוָה֙ אֶת כָּל הָ֣/עַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר צָבְא֖וּ עַל יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם הָמֵ֣ק בְּשָׂר֗/וֹ וְ/הוּא֙ עֹמֵ֣ד עַל רַגְלָ֔י/ו וְ/עֵינָי/ו֙ תִּמַּ֣קְנָה בְ/חֹֽרֵי/הֶ֔ן וּ/לְשׁוֹנ֖/וֹ תִּמַּ֥ק בְּ/פִי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vz't thyh hmgph 'shr ygf yhvh 't khl h'mym 'shr tsb'v 'l yrvshlm hmq bshrv vhv' 'md 'l rglyv v'ynyv tmqnh bchryhn vlshvnv tmq bpyhm
verses.translation: And this shall be the plague wherewith the LORD will smite all the people that have fought against Jerusalem; Their flesh shall consume away while they stand upon their feet, and their eyes shall consume away in their holes, and their tongue shall consume away in their mouth.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא תִּֽהְיֶ֧ה מְהֽוּמַת יְהוָ֛ה רַבָּ֖ה בָּ/הֶ֑ם וְ/הֶחֱזִ֗יקוּ אִ֚ישׁ יַ֣ד רֵעֵ֔/הוּ וְ/עָלְתָ֥ה יָד֖/וֹ עַל יַ֥ד רֵעֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' thyh mhvmt yhvh rbh bhm vhchzyqv 'ysh yd r'hv v'lth ydv 'l yd r'hv
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, that a great tumult from the LORD shall be among them; and they shall lay hold every one on the hand of his neighbour, and his hand shall rise up against the hand of his neighbour.

verses.original: וְ/גַ֨ם יְהוּדָ֔ה תִּלָּחֵ֖ם בִּ/ירֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/אֻסַּף֩ חֵ֨יל כָּל הַ/גּוֹיִ֜ם סָבִ֗יב זָהָ֥ב וָ/כֶ֛סֶף וּ/בְגָדִ֖ים לָ/רֹ֥ב מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vgm yhvdh tlchm byrvshlm v'sf chyl khl hgvym sbyb zhb vkhsf vbgdym lrb m'd
verses.translation: And Judah also shall fight at Jerusalem; and the wealth of all the heathen round about shall be gathered together, gold, and silver, and apparel, in great abundance.

verses.original: וְ/כֵ֨ן תִּֽהְיֶ֜ה מַגֵּפַ֣ת הַ/סּ֗וּס הַ/פֶּ֨רֶד֙ הַ/גָּמָ֣ל וְ/הַ/חֲמ֔וֹר וְ/כָ֨ל הַ/בְּהֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִהְיֶ֖ה בַּ/מַּחֲנ֣וֹת הָ/הֵ֑מָּה כַּ/מַּגֵּפָ֖ה הַ/זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: vkhn thyh mgpt hsvs hprd hgml vhchmvr vkhl hbhmh 'shr yhyh bmchnvt hhmh khmgph hz't
verses.translation: And so shall be the plague of the horse, of the mule, of the camel, and of the ass, and of all the beasts that shall be in these tents, as this plague.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה כָּל הַ/נּוֹתָר֙ מִ/כָּל הַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם הַ/בָּאִ֖ים עַל יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/עָל֞וּ מִ/דֵּ֧י שָׁנָ֣ה בְ/שָׁנָ֗ה לְ/הִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֺת֙ לְ/מֶ֨לֶךְ֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וְ/לָ/חֹ֖ג אֶת חַ֥ג הַ/סֻּכּֽוֹת
verses.translit: vhyh khl hnvtr mkhl hgvym hb'ym 'l yrvshlm v'lv mdy shnh bshnh lhshtchvt lmlkh yhvh tsb'vt vlchg 't chg hskhvt
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that every one that is left of all the nations which came against Jerusalem shall even go up from year to year to worship the King, the LORD of hosts, and to keep the feast of tabernacles.

verses.original: וְ֠/הָיָה אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא יַעֲלֶ֜ה מֵ/אֵ֨ת מִשְׁפְּח֤וֹת הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ אֶל יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם לְ/הִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֔ת לְ/מֶ֖לֶךְ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת וְ/לֹ֥א עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם יִהְיֶ֥ה הַ/גָּֽשֶׁם
verses.translit: vhyh 'shr l' y'lh m't mshpchvt h'rts 'l yrvshlm lhshtchvt lmlkh yhvh tsb'vt vl' 'lyhm yhyh hgshm
verses.translation: And it shall be, that whoso will not come up of all the families of the earth unto Jerusalem to worship the King, the LORD of hosts, even upon them shall be no rain.

verses.original: וְ/אִם מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת מִצְרַ֧יִם לֹֽא תַעֲלֶ֛ה וְ/לֹ֥א בָאָ֖ה וְ/לֹ֣א עֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם תִּֽהְיֶ֣ה הַ/מַּגֵּפָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִגֹּ֤ף יְהוָה֙ אֶת הַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א יַֽעֲל֔וּ לָ/חֹ֖ג אֶת חַ֥ג הַ/סֻּכּֽוֹת
verses.translit: v'm mshpcht mtsrym l' t'lh vl' b'h vl' 'lyhm thyh hmgph 'shr ygf yhvh 't hgvym 'shr l' y'lv lchg 't chg hskhvt
verses.translation: And if the family of Egypt go not up, and come not, that have no rain; there shall be the plague, wherewith the LORD will smite the heathen that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles.

verses.original: זֹ֥את תִּהְיֶ֖ה חַטַּ֣את מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ/חַטַּאת֙ כָּל הַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א יַֽעֲל֔וּ לָ/חֹ֖ג אֶת חַ֥ג הַ/סֻּכּֽוֹת
verses.translit: z't thyh cht't mtsrym vcht't khl hgvym 'shr l' y'lv lchg 't chg hskhvt
verses.translation: This shall be the punishment of Egypt, and the punishment of all nations that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles.

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא יִֽהְיֶה֙ עַל מְצִלּ֣וֹת הַ/סּ֔וּס קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַֽ/יהוָ֑ה וְ/הָיָ֤ה הַ/סִּירוֹת֙ בְּ/בֵ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה כַּ/מִּזְרָקִ֖ים לִ/פְנֵ֥י הַ/מִּזְבֵּֽחַ
verses.translit: byvm hhv' yhyh 'l mtslvt hsvs qdsh lyhvh vhyh hsyrvt bbyt yhvh khmzrqym lpny hmzbch
verses.translation: In that day shall there be upon the bells of the horses, HOLINESS UNTO THE LORD ; and the pots in the LORD’s house shall be like the bowls before the altar.

verses.original: וְ֠/הָיָה כָּל סִ֨יר בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֜ם וּ/בִֽ/יהוּדָ֗ה קֹ֚דֶשׁ לַ/יהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וּ/בָ֨אוּ֙ כָּל הַ/זֹּ֣בְחִ֔ים וְ/לָקְח֥וּ מֵ/הֶ֖ם וּ/בִשְּׁל֣וּ בָ/הֶ֑ם וְ/לֹא יִהְיֶ֨ה כְנַעֲנִ֥י ע֛וֹד בְּ/בֵית יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/הֽוּא
verses.translit: vhyh khl syr byrvshlm vbyhvdh qdsh lyhvh tsb'vt vb'v khl hzbchym vlqchv mhm vbshlv bhm vl' yhyh khn'ny 'vd bbyt yhvh tsb'vt byvm hhv'
verses.translation: Yea, every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah shall be holiness unto the LORD of hosts: and all they that sacrifice shall come and take of them, and seethe therein: and in that day there shall be no more the Canaanite in the house of the LORD of hosts.

verses.original: מַשָּׂ֥א דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בְּ/יַ֖ד מַלְאָכִֽי
verses.translit: msh' dbr yhvh 'l yshr'l byd ml'khy
verses.translation: The burden of the word of the LORD to Israel by Malachi.

verses.original: אָהַ֤בְתִּי אֶתְ/כֶם֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה וַ/אֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם בַּ/מָּ֣ה אֲהַבְתָּ֑/נוּ הֲ/לוֹא אָ֨ח עֵשָׂ֤ו לְ/יַֽעֲקֹב֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה וָ/אֹהַ֖ב אֶֽת יַעֲקֹֽב
verses.translit: 'hbty 'tkhm 'mr yhvh v'mrtm bmh 'hbtnv hlv' 'ch 'shv ly'qb n'm yhvh v'hb 't y'qb
verses.translation: I have loved you, saith the LORD . Yet ye say, Wherein hast thou loved us? Was not Esau Jacob’s brother? saith the LORD : yet I loved Jacob,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת עֵשָׂ֖ו שָׂנֵ֑אתִי וָ/אָשִׂ֤ים אֶת הָרָי/ו֙ שְׁמָמָ֔ה וְ/אֶת נַחֲלָת֖/וֹ לְ/תַנּ֥וֹת מִדְבָּֽר
verses.translit: v't 'shv shn'ty v'shym 't hryv shmmh v't nchltv ltnvt mdbr
verses.translation: And I hated Esau, and laid his mountains and his heritage waste for the dragons of the wilderness.

verses.original: כִּֽי תֹאמַ֨ר אֱד֜וֹם רֻשַּׁ֗שְׁנוּ וְ/נָשׁוּב֙ וְ/נִבְנֶ֣ה חֳרָב֔וֹת כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת הֵ֥מָּה יִבְנ֖וּ וַ/אֲנִ֣י אֶהֱר֑וֹס וְ/קָרְא֤וּ לָ/הֶם֙ גְּב֣וּל רִשְׁעָ֔ה וְ/הָ/עָ֛ם אֲשֶׁר זָעַ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה עַד עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: khy t'mr 'dvm rshshnv vnshvb vnbnh chrbvt khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt hmh ybnv v'ny 'hrvs vqr'v lhm gbvl rsh'h vh'm 'shr z'm yhvh 'd 'vlm
verses.translation: Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places; thus saith the LORD of hosts, They shall build, but I will throw down; and they shall call them, The border of wickedness, and, The people against whom the LORD hath indignation for ever.

verses.original: וְ/עֵינֵי/כֶ֖ם תִּרְאֶ֑ינָה וְ/אַתֶּ֤ם תֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ יִגְדַּ֣ל יְהוָ֔ה מֵ/עַ֖ל לִ/גְב֥וּל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: v'ynykhm tr'ynh v'tm t'mrv ygdl yhvh m'l lgbvl yshr'l
verses.translation: And your eyes shall see, and ye shall say, The LORD will be magnified from the border of Israel.

verses.original: בֵּ֛ן יְכַבֵּ֥ד אָ֖ב וְ/עֶ֣בֶד אֲדֹנָ֑י/ו וְ/אִם אָ֣ב אָ֣נִי אַיֵּ֣ה כְבוֹדִ֡/י וְ/אִם אֲדוֹנִ֣ים אָנִי֩ אַיֵּ֨ה מוֹרָאִ֜/י אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת לָ/כֶם֙ הַ/כֹּֽהֲנִים֙ בּוֹזֵ֣י שְׁמִ֔/י וַ/אֲמַרְתֶּ֕ם בַּ/מֶּ֥ה בָזִ֖ינוּ אֶת שְׁמֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: bn ykhbd 'b v'bd 'dnyv v'm 'b 'ny 'yh khbvdy v'm 'dvnym 'ny 'yh mvr'y 'mr yhvh tsb'vt lkhm hkhhnym bvzy shmy v'mrtm bmh bzynv 't shmkh
verses.translation: A son honoureth his father, and a servant his master: if then I be a father, where is mine honour? and if I be a master, where is my fear? saith the LORD of hosts unto you, O priests, that despise my name. And ye say, Wherein have we despised thy name?

verses.original: מַגִּישִׁ֤ים עַֽל מִזְבְּחִ/י֙ לֶ֣חֶם מְגֹאָ֔ל וַ/אֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם בַּ/מֶּ֣ה גֵֽאַלְנ֑וּ/ךָ בֶּ/אֱמָרְ/כֶ֕ם שֻׁלְחַ֥ן יְהוָ֖ה נִבְזֶ֥ה הֽוּא
verses.translit: mgyshym 'l mzbchy lchm mg'l v'mrtm bmh g'lnvkh b'mrkhm shlchn yhvh nbzh hv'
verses.translation: Ye offer polluted bread upon mine altar; and ye say, Wherein have we polluted thee? In that ye say, The table of the LORD is contemptible.

verses.original: וְ/כִֽי תַגִּשׁ֨וּ/ן עִוֵּ֤ר לִ/זְבֹּ֨חַ֙ אֵ֣ין רָ֔ע וְ/כִ֥י תַגִּ֛ישׁוּ פִּסֵּ֥חַ וְ/חֹלֶ֖ה אֵ֣ין רָ֑ע הַקְרִיבֵ֨/הוּ נָ֜א לְ/פֶחָתֶ֗/ךָ הֲ/יִּרְצְ/ךָ֙ א֚וֹ הֲ/יִשָּׂ֣א פָנֶ֔י/ךָ אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vkhy tgshvn 'vr lzbch 'yn r' vkhy tgyshv psch vchlh 'yn r' hqrybhv n' lpchtkh hyrtskh 'v hysh' pnykh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: And if ye offer the blind for sacrifice, is it not evil? and if ye offer the lame and sick, is it not evil? offer it now unto thy governor; will he be pleased with thee, or accept thy person? saith the LORD of hosts.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֛ה חַלּוּ נָ֥א פְנֵי אֵ֖ל וִֽ/יחָנֵ֑/נוּ מִ/יֶּדְ/כֶם֙ הָ֣יְתָה זֹּ֔את הֲ/יִשָּׂ֤א מִ/כֶּם֙ פָּנִ֔ים אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: v'th chlv n' pny 'l vychnnv mydkhm hyth z't hysh' mkhm pnym 'mr yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: And now, I pray you, beseech God that he will be gracious unto us: this hath been by your means: will he regard your persons? saith the LORD of hosts.

verses.original: מִ֤י גַם בָּ/כֶם֙ וְ/יִסְגֹּ֣ר דְּלָתַ֔יִם וְ/לֹֽא תָאִ֥ירוּ מִזְבְּחִ֖/י חִנָּ֑ם אֵֽין לִ֨/י חֵ֜פֶץ בָּ/כֶ֗ם אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וּ/מִנְחָ֖ה לֹֽא אֶרְצֶ֥ה מִ/יֶּדְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: my gm bkhm vysgr dltym vl' t'yrv mzbchy chnm 'yn ly chpts bkhm 'mr yhvh tsb'vt vmnchh l' 'rtsh mydkhm
verses.translation: Who is there even among you that would shut the doors for nought? neither do ye kindle fire on mine altar for nought. I have no pleasure in you, saith the LORD of hosts, neither will I accept an offering at your hand.

verses.original: כִּ֣י מִ/מִּזְרַח שֶׁ֜מֶשׁ וְ/עַד מְבוֹא֗/וֹ גָּד֤וֹל שְׁמִ/י֙ בַּ/גּוֹיִ֔ם וּ/בְ/כָל מָק֗וֹם מֻקְטָ֥ר מֻגָּ֛שׁ לִ/שְׁמִ֖/י וּ/מִנְחָ֣ה טְהוֹרָ֑ה כִּֽי גָד֤וֹל שְׁמִ/י֙ בַּ/גּוֹיִ֔ם אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: khy mmzrch shmsh v'd mbv'v gdvl shmy bgvym vbkhl mqvm mqtr mgsh lshmy vmnchh thvrh khy gdvl shmy bgvym 'mr yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: For from the rising of the sun even unto the going down of the same my name shall be great among the Gentiles; and in every place incense shall be offered unto my name, and a pure offering: for my name shall be great among the heathen, saith the LORD of hosts.

verses.original: וְ/אַתֶּ֖ם מְחַלְּלִ֣ים אוֹת֑/וֹ בֶּ/אֱמָרְ/כֶ֗ם שֻׁלְחַ֤ן אֲדֹנָ/י֙ מְגֹאָ֣ל ה֔וּא וְ/נִיב֖/וֹ נִבְזֶ֥ה אָכְלֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'tm mchllym 'vtv b'mrkhm shlchn 'dny mg'l hv' vnybv nbzh 'khlv
verses.translation: But ye have profaned it, in that ye say, The table of the LORD is polluted; and the fruit thereof, even his meat, is contemptible.

verses.original: וַ/אֲמַרְתֶּם֩ הִנֵּ֨ה מַ/תְּלָאָ֜ה וְ/הִפַּחְתֶּ֣ם אוֹת֗/וֹ אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וַ/הֲבֵאתֶ֣ם גָּז֗וּל וְ/אֶת הַ/פִּסֵּ֨חַ֙ וְ/אֶת הַ֣/חוֹלֶ֔ה וַ/הֲבֵאתֶ֖ם אֶת הַ/מִּנְחָ֑ה הַ/אֶרְצֶ֥ה אוֹתָ֛/הּ מִ/יֶּדְ/כֶ֖ם אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: v'mrtm hnh mtl'h vhpchtm 'vtv 'mr yhvh tsb'vt vhb'tm gzvl v't hpsch v't hchvlh vhb'tm 't hmnchh h'rtsh 'vth mydkhm 'mr yhvh
verses.translation: Ye said also, Behold, what a weariness is it! and ye have snuffed at it, saith the LORD of hosts; and ye brought that which was torn, and the lame, and the sick; thus ye brought an offering: should I accept this of your hand? saith the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/אָר֣וּר נוֹכֵ֗ל וְ/יֵ֤שׁ בְּ/עֶדְר/וֹ֙ זָכָ֔ר וְ/נֹדֵ֛ר וְ/זֹבֵ֥חַ מָשְׁחָ֖ת לַֽ/אדֹנָ֑/י כִּי֩ מֶ֨לֶךְ גָּד֜וֹל אָ֗נִי אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וּ/שְׁמִ֖/י נוֹרָ֥א בַ/גּוֹיִֽם
verses.translit: v'rvr nvkhl vysh b'drv zkhr vndr vzbch mshcht l'dny khy mlkh gdvl 'ny 'mr yhvh tsb'vt vshmy nvr' bgvym
verses.translation: But cursed be the deceiver, which hath in his flock a male, and voweth, and sacrificeth unto the Lord a corrupt thing: for I am a great King, saith the LORD of hosts, and my name is dreadful among the heathen.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה אֲלֵי/כֶ֛ם הַ/מִּצְוָ֥ה הַ/זֹּ֖את הַ/כֹּהֲנִֽים
verses.translit: v'th 'lykhm hmtsvh hz't hkhhnym
verses.translation: And now, O ye priests, this commandment is for you.

verses.original: אִם לֹ֣א תִשְׁמְע֡וּ וְ/אִם לֹא֩ תָשִׂ֨ימוּ עַל לֵ֜ב לָ/תֵ֧ת כָּב֣וֹד לִ/שְׁמִ֗/י אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וְ/שִׁלַּחְתִּ֤י בָ/כֶם֙ אֶת הַ/מְּאֵרָ֔ה וְ/אָרוֹתִ֖י אֶת בִּרְכֽוֹתֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/גַם֙ אָרוֹתִ֔י/הָ כִּ֥י אֵינְ/כֶ֖ם שָׂמִ֥ים עַל לֵֽב
verses.translit: 'm l' tshm'v v'm l' tshymv 'l lb ltt khbvd lshmy 'mr yhvh tsb'vt vshlchty bkhm 't hm'rh v'rvty 't brkhvtykhm vgm 'rvtyh khy 'ynkhm shmym 'l lb
verses.translation: If ye will not hear, and if ye will not lay it to heart, to give glory unto my name, saith the LORD of hosts, I will even send a curse upon you, and I will curse your blessings: yea, I have cursed them already, because ye do not lay it to heart.

verses.original: הִנְ/נִ֨י גֹעֵ֤ר לָ/כֶם֙ אֶת הַ/זֶּ֔רַע וְ/זֵרִ֤יתִי פֶ֨רֶשׁ֙ עַל פְּנֵי/כֶ֔ם פֶּ֖רֶשׁ חַגֵּי/כֶ֑ם וְ/נָשָׂ֥א אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם אֵלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: hnny g'r lkhm 't hzr' vzryty prsh 'l pnykhm prsh chgykhm vnsh' 'tkhm 'lyv
verses.translation: Behold, I will corrupt your seed, and spread dung upon your faces, even the dung of your solemn feasts; and one shall take you away with it.

verses.original: וִֽ/ידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּ֚י שִׁלַּ֣חְתִּי אֲלֵי/כֶ֔ם אֵ֖ת הַ/מִּצְוָ֣ה הַ/זֹּ֑את לִֽ/הְי֤וֹת בְּרִיתִ/י֙ אֶת לֵוִ֔י אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vyd'tm khy shlchty 'lykhm 't hmtsvh hz't lhyvt bryty 't lvy 'mr yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: And ye shall know that I have sent this commandment unto you, that my covenant might be with Levi, saith the LORD of hosts.

verses.original: בְּרִיתִ֣/י הָיְתָ֣ה אִתּ֗/וֹ הַֽ/חַיִּים֙ וְ/הַ֨/שָּׁל֔וֹם וָ/אֶתְּנֵֽ/ם ל֥/וֹ מוֹרָ֖א וַ/יִּֽירָאֵ֑/נִי וּ/מִ/פְּנֵ֥י שְׁמִ֖/י נִחַ֥ת הֽוּא
verses.translit: bryty hyth 'tv hchyym vhshlvm v'tnm lv mvr' vyyr'ny vmpny shmy ncht hv'
verses.translation: My covenant was with him of life and peace; and I gave them to him for the fear wherewith he feared me, and was afraid before my name.

verses.original: תּוֹרַ֤ת אֱמֶת֙ הָיְתָ֣ה בְּ/פִ֔י/הוּ וְ/עַוְלָ֖ה לֹא נִמְצָ֣א בִ/שְׂפָתָ֑י/ו בְּ/שָׁל֤וֹם וּ/בְ/מִישׁוֹר֙ הָלַ֣ךְ אִתִּ֔/י וְ/רַבִּ֖ים הֵשִׁ֥יב מֵ/עָוֺֽן
verses.translit: tvrt 'mt hyth bpyhv v'vlh l' nmts' bshptyv bshlvm vbmyshvr hlkh 'ty vrbym hshyb m'vn
verses.translation: The law of truth was in his mouth, and iniquity was not found in his lips: he walked with me in peace and equity, and did turn many away from iniquity.

verses.original: כִּֽי שִׂפְתֵ֤י כֹהֵן֙ יִשְׁמְרוּ דַ֔עַת וְ/תוֹרָ֖ה יְבַקְשׁ֣וּ מִ/פִּ֑י/הוּ כִּ֛י מַלְאַ֥ךְ יְהוָֽה צְבָא֖וֹת הֽוּא
verses.translit: khy shpty khhn yshmrv d't vtvrh ybqshv mpyhv khy ml'kh yhvh tsb'vt hv'
verses.translation: For the priest’s lips should keep knowledge, and they should seek the law at his mouth: for he is the messenger of the LORD of hosts.

verses.original: וְ/אַתֶּם֙ סַרְתֶּ֣ם מִן הַ/דֶּ֔רֶךְ הִכְשַׁלְתֶּ֥ם רַבִּ֖ים בַּ/תּוֹרָ֑ה שִֽׁחַתֶּם֙ בְּרִ֣ית הַ/לֵּוִ֔י אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: v'tm srtm mn hdrkh hkhshltm rbym btvrh shchtm bryt hlvy 'mr yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: But ye are departed out of the way; ye have caused many to stumble at the law; ye have corrupted the covenant of Levi, saith the LORD of hosts.

verses.original: וְ/גַם אֲנִ֞י נָתַ֧תִּי אֶתְ/כֶ֛ם נִבְזִ֥ים וּ/שְׁפָלִ֖ים לְ/כָל הָ/עָ֑ם כְּ/פִ֗י אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֵֽינְ/כֶם֙ שֹׁמְרִ֣ים אֶת דְּרָכַ֔/י וְ/נֹשְׂאִ֥ים פָּנִ֖ים בַּ/תּוֹרָֽה
verses.translit: vgm 'ny ntty 'tkhm nbzym vshplym lkhl h'm khpy 'shr 'ynkhm shmrym 't drkhy vnsh'ym pnym btvrh
verses.translation: Therefore have I also made you contemptible and base before all the people, according as ye have not kept my ways, but have been partial in the law.

verses.original: הֲ/ל֨וֹא אָ֤ב אֶחָד֙ לְ/כֻלָּ֔/נוּ הֲ/ל֛וֹא אֵ֥ל אֶֽחָ֖ד בְּרָאָ֑/נוּ מַדּ֗וּעַ נִבְגַּד֙ אִ֣ישׁ בְּ/אָחִ֔י/ו לְ/חַלֵּ֖ל בְּרִ֥ית אֲבֹתֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: hlv' 'b 'chd lkhlnv hlv' 'l 'chd br'nv mdv' nbgd 'ysh b'chyv lchll bryt 'btynv
verses.translation: Have we not all one father? hath not one God created us? why do we deal treacherously every man against his brother, by profaning the covenant of our fathers?

verses.original: בָּגְדָ֣ה יְהוּדָ֔ה וְ/תוֹעֵבָ֛ה נֶעֶשְׂתָ֥ה בְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וּ/בִ/ירֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כִּ֣י חִלֵּ֣ל יְהוּדָ֗ה קֹ֤דֶשׁ יְהוָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָהֵ֔ב וּ/בָעַ֖ל בַּת אֵ֥ל נֵכָֽר
verses.translit: bgdh yhvdh vtv'bh n'shth byshr'l vbyrvshlm khy chll yhvdh qdsh yhvh 'shr 'hb vb'l bt 'l nkhr
verses.translation: Judah hath dealt treacherously, and an abomination is committed in Israel and in Jerusalem; for Judah hath profaned the holiness of the LORD which he loved, and hath married the daughter of a strange god.

verses.original: יַכְרֵ֨ת יְהוָ֜ה לָ/אִ֨ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יַעֲשֶׂ֨/נָּה֙ עֵ֣ר וְ/עֹנֶ֔ה מֵ/אָהֳלֵ֖י יַֽעֲקֹ֑ב וּ/מַגִּ֣ישׁ מִנְחָ֔ה לַֽ/יהוָ֖ה צְבָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: ykhrt yhvh l'ysh 'shr y'shnh 'r v'nh m'hly y'qb vmgysh mnchh lyhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: The LORD will cut off the man that doeth this, the master and the scholar, out of the tabernacles of Jacob, and him that offereth an offering unto the LORD of hosts.

verses.original: וְ/זֹאת֙ שֵׁנִ֣ית תַּֽעֲשׂ֔וּ כַּסּ֤וֹת דִּמְעָה֙ אֶת מִזְבַּ֣ח יְהוָ֔ה בְּכִ֖י וַֽ/אֲנָקָ֑ה מֵ/אֵ֣ין ע֗וֹד פְּנוֹת֙ אֶל הַ/מִּנְחָ֔ה וְ/לָ/קַ֥חַת רָצ֖וֹן מִ/יֶּדְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vz't shnyt t'shv khsvt dm'h 't mzbch yhvh bkhy v'nqh m'yn 'vd pnvt 'l hmnchh vlqcht rtsvn mydkhm
verses.translation: And this have ye done again, covering the altar of the LORD with tears, with weeping, and with crying out, insomuch that he regardeth not the offering any more, or receiveth it with good will at your hand.

verses.original: וַ/אֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם עַל מָ֑ה עַ֡ל כִּי יְהוָה֩ הֵעִ֨יד בֵּינְ/ךָ֜ וּ/בֵ֣ין אֵ֣שֶׁת נְעוּרֶ֗י/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתָּה֙ בָּגַ֣דְתָּה בָּ֔/הּ וְ/הִ֥יא חֲבֶרְתְּ/ךָ֖ וְ/אֵ֥שֶׁת בְּרִיתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: v'mrtm 'l mh 'l khy yhvh h'yd bynkh vbyn 'sht n'vrykh 'shr 'th bgdth bh vhy' chbrtkh v'sht brytkh
verses.translation: Yet ye say, Wherefore? Because the LORD hath been witness between thee and the wife of thy youth, against whom thou hast dealt treacherously: yet is she thy companion, and the wife of thy covenant.

verses.original: וְ/לֹא אֶחָ֣ד עָשָׂ֗ה וּ/שְׁאָ֥ר ר֨וּחַ֙ ל֔/וֹ וּ/מָה֙ הָֽ/אֶחָ֔ד מְבַקֵּ֖שׁ זֶ֣רַע אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְ/נִשְׁמַרְתֶּם֙ בְּ/ר֣וּחֲ/כֶ֔ם וּ/בְ/אֵ֥שֶׁת נְעוּרֶ֖י/ךָ אַל יִבְגֹּֽד
verses.translit: vl' 'chd 'shh vsh'r rvch lv vmh h'chd mbqsh zr' 'lhym vnshmrtm brvchkhm vb'sht n'vrykh 'l ybgd
verses.translation: And did not he make one? Yet had he the residue of the spirit. And wherefore one? That he might seek a godly seed. Therefore take heed to your spirit, and let none deal treacherously against the wife of his youth.

verses.original: כִּֽי שָׂנֵ֣א שַׁלַּ֗ח אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/כִסָּ֤ה חָמָס֙ עַל לְבוּשׁ֔/וֹ אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת וְ/נִשְׁמַרְתֶּ֥ם בְּ/רוּחֲ/כֶ֖ם וְ/לֹ֥א תִבְגֹּֽדוּ
verses.translit: khy shn' shlch 'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l vkhsh chms 'l lbvshv 'mr yhvh tsb'vt vnshmrtm brvchkhm vl' tbgdv
verses.translation: For the LORD , the God of Israel, saith that he hateth putting away: for one covereth violence with his garment, saith the LORD of hosts: therefore take heed to your spirit, that ye deal not treacherously.

verses.original: הוֹגַעְתֶּ֤ם יְהוָה֙ בְּ/דִבְרֵי/כֶ֔ם וַ/אֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם בַּ/מָּ֣ה הוֹגָ֑עְנוּ בֶּ/אֱמָרְ/כֶ֗ם כָּל עֹ֨שֵׂה רָ֜ע ט֣וֹב בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה וּ/בָ/הֶם֙ ה֣וּא חָפֵ֔ץ א֥וֹ אַיֵּ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י הַ/מִּשְׁפָּֽט
verses.translit: hvg'tm yhvh bdbrykhm v'mrtm bmh hvg'nv b'mrkhm khl 'shh r' tvb b'yny yhvh vbhm hv' chpts 'v 'yh 'lhy hmshpt
verses.translation: Ye have wearied the LORD with your words. Yet ye say, Wherein have we wearied him? When ye say, Every one that doeth evil is good in the sight of the LORD , and he delighteth in them; or, Where is the God of judgment?

verses.original: הִנְ/נִ֤י שֹׁלֵחַ֙ מַלְאָכִ֔/י וּ/פִנָּה דֶ֖רֶךְ לְ/פָנָ֑/י וּ/פִתְאֹם֩ יָב֨וֹא אֶל הֵיכָל֜/וֹ הָ/אָד֣וֹן אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּ֣ם מְבַקְשִׁ֗ים וּ/מַלְאַ֨ךְ הַ/בְּרִ֜ית אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּ֤ם חֲפֵצִים֙ הִנֵּה בָ֔א אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: hnny shlch ml'khy vpnh drkh lpny vpt'm ybv' 'l hykhlv h'dvn 'shr 'tm mbqshym vml'kh hbryt 'shr 'tm chptsym hnh b' 'mr yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: Behold, I will send my messenger, and he shall prepare the way before me: and the Lord, whom ye seek, shall suddenly come to his temple, even the messenger of the covenant, whom ye delight in: behold, he shall come, saith the LORD of hosts.

verses.original: וּ/מִ֤י מְכַלְכֵּל֙ אֶת י֣וֹם בּוֹא֔/וֹ וּ/מִ֥י הָ/עֹמֵ֖ד בְּ/הֵרָֽאוֹת֑/וֹ כִּֽי הוּא֙ כְּ/אֵ֣שׁ מְצָרֵ֔ף וּ/כְ/בֹרִ֖ית מְכַבְּסִֽים
verses.translit: vmy mkhlkhl 't yvm bv'v vmy h'md bhr'vtv khy hv' kh'sh mtsrf vkhbryt mkhbsym
verses.translation: But who may abide the day of his coming? and who shall stand when he appeareth? for he is like a refiner’s fire, and like fullers’ soap:

verses.original: וְ/יָשַׁ֨ב מְצָרֵ֤ף וּ/מְטַהֵר֙ כֶּ֔סֶף וְ/טִהַ֤ר אֶת בְּנֵֽי לֵוִי֙ וְ/זִקַּ֣ק אֹתָ֔/ם כַּ/זָּהָ֖ב וְ/כַ/כָּ֑סֶף וְ/הָיוּ֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה מַגִּישֵׁ֥י מִנְחָ֖ה בִּ/צְדָקָֽה
verses.translit: vyshb mtsrf vmthr khsf vthr 't bny lvy vzqq 'tm khzhb vkhkhsf vhyv lyhvh mgyshy mnchh btsdqh
verses.translation: And he shall sit as a refiner and purifier of silver: and he shall purify the sons of Levi, and purge them as gold and silver, that they may offer unto the LORD an offering in righteousness.

verses.original: וְ/עָֽרְבָה֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה מִנְחַ֥ת יְהוּדָ֖ה וִ/ירֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כִּ/ימֵ֣י עוֹלָ֔ם וּ/כְ/שָׁנִ֖ים קַדְמֹנִיּֽוֹת
verses.translit: v'rbh lyhvh mncht yhvdh vyrvshlm khymy 'vlm vkhshnym qdmnyvt
verses.translation: Then shall the offering of Judah and Jerusalem be pleasant unto the LORD , as in the days of old, and as in former years.

verses.original: וְ/קָרַבְתִּ֣י אֲלֵי/כֶם֮ לַ/מִּשְׁפָּט֒ וְ/הָיִ֣יתִי עֵ֣ד מְמַהֵ֗ר בַּֽ/מְכַשְּׁפִים֙ וּ/בַ/מְנָ֣אֲפִ֔ים וּ/בַ/נִּשְׁבָּעִ֖ים לַ/שָּׁ֑קֶר וּ/בְ/עֹשְׁקֵ֣י שְׂכַר שָׂ֠כִיר אַלְמָנָ֨ה וְ/יָת֤וֹם וּ/מַטֵּי גֵר֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יְרֵא֔וּ/נִי אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vqrbty 'lykhm lmshpt vhyyty 'd mmhr bmkhshpym vbmn'pym vbnshb'ym lshqr vb'shqy shkhr shkhyr 'lmnh vytvm vmty gr vl' yr'vny 'mr yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: And I will come near to you to judgment; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, and against the adulterers, and against false swearers, and against those that oppress the hireling in his wages, the widow, and the fatherless, and that turn aside the stranger from his right , and fear not me, saith the LORD of hosts.

verses.original: כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לֹ֣א שָׁנִ֑יתִי וְ/אַתֶּ֥ם בְּנֵֽי יַעֲקֹ֖ב לֹ֥א כְלִיתֶֽם
verses.translit: khy 'ny yhvh l' shnyty v'tm bny y'qb l' khlytm
verses.translation: For I am the LORD , I change not; therefore ye sons of Jacob are not consumed.

verses.original: לְ/מִ/ימֵ֨י אֲבֹתֵי/כֶ֜ם סַרְתֶּ֤ם מֵֽ/חֻקַּ/י֙ וְ/לֹ֣א שְׁמַרְתֶּ֔ם שׁ֤וּבוּ אֵלַ/י֙ וְ/אָשׁ֣וּבָה אֲלֵי/כֶ֔ם אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת וַ/אֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם בַּ/מֶּ֥ה נָשֽׁוּב
verses.translit: lmymy 'btykhm srtm mchqy vl' shmrtm shvbv 'ly v'shvbh 'lykhm 'mr yhvh tsb'vt v'mrtm bmh nshvb
verses.translation: Even from the days of your fathers ye are gone away from mine ordinances, and have not kept them . Return unto me, and I will return unto you, saith the LORD of hosts. But ye said, Wherein shall we return?

verses.original: הֲ/יִקְבַּ֨ע אָדָ֜ם אֱלֹהִ֗ים כִּ֤י אַתֶּם֙ קֹבְעִ֣ים אֹתִ֔/י וַ/אֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם בַּ/מֶּ֣ה קְבַעֲנ֑וּ/ךָ הַֽ/מַּעֲשֵׂ֖ר וְ/הַ/תְּרוּמָֽה
verses.translit: hyqb' 'dm 'lhym khy 'tm qb'ym 'ty v'mrtm bmh qb'nvkh hm'shr vhtrvmh
verses.translation: Will a man rob God? Yet ye have robbed me. But ye say, Wherein have we robbed thee? In tithes and offerings.

verses.original: בַּ/מְּאֵרָה֙ אַתֶּ֣ם נֵֽאָרִ֔ים וְ/אֹתִ֖/י אַתֶּ֣ם קֹבְעִ֑ים הַ/גּ֖וֹי כֻּלּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: bm'rh 'tm n'rym v'ty 'tm qb'ym hgvy khlv
verses.translation: Ye are cursed with a curse: for ye have robbed me, even this whole nation.

verses.original: הָבִ֨יאוּ אֶת כָּל הַֽ/מַּעֲשֵׂ֜ר אֶל בֵּ֣ית הָ/אוֹצָ֗ר וִ/יהִ֥י טֶ֨רֶף֙ בְּ/בֵיתִ֔/י וּ/בְחָנ֤וּ/נִי נָא֙ בָּ/זֹ֔את אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת אִם לֹ֧א אֶפְתַּ֣ח לָ/כֶ֗ם אֵ֚ת אֲרֻבּ֣וֹת הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וַ/הֲרִיקֹתִ֥י לָ/כֶ֛ם בְּרָכָ֖ה עַד בְּלִי דָֽי
verses.translit: hby'v 't khl hm'shr 'l byt h'vtsr vyhy trf bbyty vbchnvny n' bz't 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'm l' 'ptch lkhm 't 'rbvt hshmym vhryqty lkhm brkhh 'd bly dy
verses.translation: Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse, that there may be meat in mine house, and prove me now herewith, saith the LORD of hosts, if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there shall not be room enough to receive it .

verses.original: וְ/גָעַרְתִּ֤י לָ/כֶם֙ בָּֽ/אֹכֵ֔ל וְ/לֹֽא יַשְׁחִ֥ת לָ/כֶ֖ם אֶת פְּרִ֣י הָ/אֲדָמָ֑ה וְ/לֹא תְשַׁכֵּ֨ל לָ/כֶ֤ם הַ/גֶּ֨פֶן֙ בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֔ה אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vg'rty lkhm b'khl vl' yshcht lkhm 't pry h'dmh vl' tshkhl lkhm hgpn bshdh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: And I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground; neither shall your vine cast her fruit before the time in the field, saith the LORD of hosts.

verses.original: וְ/אִשְּׁר֥וּ אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם כָּל הַ/גּוֹיִ֑ם כִּֽי תִהְי֤וּ אַתֶּם֙ אֶ֣רֶץ חֵ֔פֶץ אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: v'shrv 'tkhm khl hgvym khy thyv 'tm 'rts chpts 'mr yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: And all nations shall call you blessed: for ye shall be a delightsome land, saith the LORD of hosts.

verses.original: חָזְק֥וּ עָלַ֛/י דִּבְרֵי/כֶ֖ם אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה וַ/אֲמַרְתֶּ֕ם מַה נִּדְבַּ֖רְנוּ עָלֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: chzqv 'ly dbrykhm 'mr yhvh v'mrtm mh ndbrnv 'lykh
verses.translation: Your words have been stout against me, saith the LORD . Yet ye say, What have we spoken so much against thee?

verses.original: אֲמַרְתֶּ֕ם שָׁ֖וְא עֲבֹ֣ד אֱלֹהִ֑ים וּ/מַה בֶּ֗צַע כִּ֤י שָׁמַ֨רְנוּ֙ מִשְׁמַרְתּ֔/וֹ וְ/כִ֤י הָלַ֨כְנוּ֙ קְדֹ֣רַנִּ֔ית מִ/פְּנֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: 'mrtm shv' 'bd 'lhym vmh bts' khy shmrnv mshmrtv vkhy hlkhnv qdrnyt mpny yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: Ye have said, It is vain to serve God: and what profit is it that we have kept his ordinance, and that we have walked mournfully before the LORD of hosts?

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֕ה אֲנַ֖חְנוּ מְאַשְּׁרִ֣ים זֵדִ֑ים גַּם נִבְנוּ֙ עֹשֵׂ֣י רִשְׁעָ֔ה גַּ֧ם בָּחֲנ֛וּ אֱלֹהִ֖ים וַ/יִּמָּלֵֽטוּ
verses.translit: v'th 'nchnv m'shrym zdym gm nbnv 'shy rsh'h gm bchnv 'lhym vymltv
verses.translation: And now we call the proud happy; yea, they that work wickedness are set up; yea, they that tempt God are even delivered.

verses.original: אָ֧ז נִדְבְּר֛וּ יִרְאֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אִ֣ישׁ אֶת רֵעֵ֑/הוּ וַ/יַּקְשֵׁ֤ב יְהוָה֙ וַ/יִּשְׁמָ֔ע וַ֠/יִּכָּתֵב סֵ֣פֶר זִכָּר֤וֹן לְ/פָנָי/ו֙ לְ/יִרְאֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וּ/לְ/חֹשְׁבֵ֖י שְׁמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'z ndbrv yr'y yhvh 'ysh 't r'hv vyqshb yhvh vyshm' vykhtb spr zkhrvn lpnyv lyr'y yhvh vlchshby shmv
verses.translation: Then they that feared the LORD spake often one to another: and the LORD hearkened, and heard it , and a book of remembrance was written before him for them that feared the LORD , and that thought upon his name.

verses.original: וְ/הָ֣יוּ לִ֗/י אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת לַ/יּ֕וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י עֹשֶׂ֣ה סְגֻלָּ֑ה וְ/חָמַלְתִּ֣י עֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם כַּֽ/אֲשֶׁר֙ יַחְמֹ֣ל אִ֔ישׁ עַל בְּנ֖/וֹ הָ/עֹבֵ֥ד אֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhyv ly 'mr yhvh tsb'vt lyvm 'shr 'ny 'shh sglh vchmlty 'lyhm kh'shr ychml 'ysh 'l bnv h'bd 'tv
verses.translation: And they shall be mine, saith the LORD of hosts, in that day when I make up my jewels; and I will spare them, as a man spareth his own son that serveth him.

verses.original: וְ/שַׁבְתֶּם֙ וּ/רְאִיתֶ֔ם בֵּ֥ין צַדִּ֖יק לְ/רָשָׁ֑ע בֵּ֚ין עֹבֵ֣ד אֱלֹהִ֔ים לַ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר לֹ֥א עֲבָדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vshbtm vr'ytm byn tsdyq lrsh' byn 'bd 'lhym l'shr l' 'bdv
verses.translation: Then shall ye return, and discern between the righteous and the wicked, between him that serveth God and him that serveth him not.

For, behold, the day cometh, that shall burn as an oven; and all the proud, yea, and all that do wickedly, shall be stubble: and the day that cometh shall burn them up, saith the LORD of hosts, that it shall leave them neither root nor branch.
But unto you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings; and ye shall go forth, and grow up as calves of the stall.
And ye shall tread down the wicked; for they shall be ashes under the soles of your feet in the day that I shall do this , saith the LORD of hosts.
Remember ye the law of Moses my servant, which I commanded unto him in Horeb for all Israel, with the statutes and judgments.
Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and dreadful day of the LORD :
And he shall turn the heart of the fathers to the children, and the heart of the children to their fathers, lest I come and smite the earth with a curse.

verses.original: Βίβλος γενέσεως Ἰησοῦ χριστοῦ υἱοῦ Δαυὶδ υἱοῦ Ἀβραάμ.
verses.translit: Vivlos geneseos Iisou hristou yiou Dayid yiou Avraam.
verses.translation: The book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.

verses.original: Ἀβραὰμ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰσαάκ, Ἰσαὰκ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰακώβ, Ἰακὼβ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰούδαν καὶ τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ,
verses.translit: Avraam egennisen ton Isaak, Isaak de egennisen ton Iakov, Iakov de egennisen ton Ioydan kai tous adelfous autou,
verses.translation: Abraham begat Isaac; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat Judas and his brethren;

verses.original: Ἰούδας δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Φαρὲς καὶ τὸν Ζάρα ἐκ τῆς Θαμάρ, Φαρὲς δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἑσρώμ, Ἑσρὼμ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀράμ,
verses.translit: Ioydas de egennisen ton Fares kai ton Zara ek tes Thamar, Fares de egennisen ton Esrom, Esrom de egennisen ton Aram,
verses.translation: And Judas begat Phares and Zara of Thamar; and Phares begat Esrom; and Esrom begat Aram;

verses.original: Ἀρὰμ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀμιναδάβ, Ἀμιναδὰβ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ναασσών, Ναασσὼν δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σαλμών,
verses.translit: Aram de egennisen ton Aminadav, Aminadav de egennisen ton Naasson, Naasson de egennisen ton Salmon,
verses.translation: And Aram begat Aminadab; and Aminadab begat Naasson; and Naasson begat Salmon;

verses.original: Σαλμὼν δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν ⸂Βόες ἐκ τῆς Ῥαχάβ, Βόες⸃ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν ⸂Ἰωβὴδ ἐκ τῆς Ῥούθ, Ἰωβὴδ⸃ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰεσσαί,
verses.translit: Salmon de egennisen ton Voes ek tes Rahav, Voes de egennisen ton Ioved ek tes Royth, Ioved de egennisen ton Iessai,
verses.translation: And Salmon begat Booz of Rachab; and Booz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;

verses.original: Ἰεσσαὶ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Δαυὶδ τὸν βασιλέα. Δαυὶδ ⸀δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σολομῶνα ἐκ τῆς τοῦ Οὐρίου,
verses.translit: Iessai de egennisen ton Dayid ton vasilea. Dayid de egennisen ton Solomona ek tes tou Ourioy,
verses.translation: And Jesse begat David the king; and David the king begat Solomon of her that had been the wife of Urias;

verses.original: Σολομὼν δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ῥοβοάμ, Ῥοβοὰμ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀβιά, Ἀβιὰ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν ⸂Ἀσάφ,
verses.translit: Solomon de egennisen ton Rovoam, Rovoam de egennisen ton Avia, Avia de egennisen ton Asaf,
verses.translation: And Solomon begat Roboam; and Roboam begat Abia; and Abia begat Asa;

verses.original: Ἀσὰφ⸃ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰωσαφάτ, Ἰωσαφὰτ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰωράμ, Ἰωρὰμ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ὀζίαν,
verses.translit: Asaf de egennisen ton Iosafat, Iosafat de egennisen ton Ioram, Ioram de egennisen ton Ozian,
verses.translation: And Asa begat Josaphat; and Josaphat begat Joram; and Joram begat Ozias;

verses.original: Ὀζίας δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰωαθάμ, Ἰωαθὰμ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀχάζ, Ἀχὰζ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἑζεκίαν,
verses.translit: Ozias de egennisen ton Ioatham, Ioatham de egennisen ton Ahaz, Ahaz de egennisen ton Ezekian,
verses.translation: And Ozias begat Joatham; and Joatham begat Achaz; and Achaz begat Ezekias;

verses.original: Ἑζεκίας δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Μανασσῆ, Μανασσῆς δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν ⸂Ἀμώς, Ἀμὼς⸃ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰωσίαν,
verses.translit: Ezekias de egennisen ton Manasse, Manasses de egennisen ton Amos, Amos de egennisen ton Iosian,
verses.translation: And Ezekias begat Manasses; and Manasses begat Amon; and Amon begat Josias;

verses.original: Ἰωσίας δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰεχονίαν καὶ τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τῆς μετοικεσίας Βαβυλῶνος.
verses.translit: Iosias de egennisen ton Iehonian kai tous adelfous autou epi tes metoikesias Vavylonos.
verses.translation: And Josias begat Jechonias and his brethren, about the time they were carried away to Babylon:

verses.original: Μετὰ δὲ τὴν μετοικεσίαν Βαβυλῶνος Ἰεχονίας ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σαλαθιήλ, Σαλαθιὴλ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ζοροβαβέλ,
verses.translit: Meta de ten metoikesian Vavylonos Iehonias egennisen ton Salathiil, Salathiel de egennisen ton Zorovavel,
verses.translation: And after they were brought to Babylon, Jechonias begat Salathiel; and Salathiel begat Zorobabel;

verses.original: Ζοροβαβὲλ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀβιούδ, Ἀβιοὺδ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἐλιακίμ, Ἐλιακὶμ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀζώρ,
verses.translit: Zorovavel de egennisen ton Avioyd, Avioud de egennisen ton Eliakim, Eliakim de egennisen ton Azor,
verses.translation: And Zorobabel begat Abiud; and Abiud begat Eliakim; and Eliakim begat Azor;

verses.original: Ἀζὼρ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σαδώκ, Σαδὼκ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀχίμ, Ἀχὶμ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἐλιούδ,
verses.translit: Azor de egennisen ton Sadok, Sadok de egennisen ton Ahim, Ahim de egennisen ton Elioyd,
verses.translation: And Azor begat Sadoc; and Sadoc begat Achim; and Achim begat Eliud;

verses.original: Ἐλιοὺδ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἐλεάζαρ, Ἐλεάζαρ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ματθάν, Ματθὰν δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰακώβ,
verses.translit: Elioud de egennisen ton Eleazar, Eleazar de egennisen ton Matthan, Matthan de egennisen ton Iakov,
verses.translation: And Eliud begat Eleazar; and Eleazar begat Matthan; and Matthan begat Jacob;

verses.original: Ἰακὼβ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰωσὴφ τὸν ἄνδρα Μαρίας, ἐξ ἧς ἐγεννήθη Ἰησοῦς ὁ λεγόμενος χριστός.
verses.translit: Iakov de egennisen ton Iosef ton andra Marias, ex es egennithi Iisous o legomenos hristos.
verses.translation: And Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.

verses.original: Πᾶσαι οὖν αἱ γενεαὶ ἀπὸ Ἀβραὰμ ἕως Δαυὶδ γενεαὶ δεκατέσσαρες, καὶ ἀπὸ Δαυὶδ ἕως τῆς μετοικεσίας Βαβυλῶνος γενεαὶ δεκατέσσαρες, καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς μετοικεσίας Βαβυλῶνος ἕως τοῦ χριστοῦ γενεαὶ δεκατέσσαρες.
verses.translit: Pasai oun ai geneai apo Avraam eos Dayid geneai dekatessares, kai apo Dayid eos tes metoikesias Vavylonos geneai dekatessares, kai apo tes metoikesias Vavylonos eos tou hristou geneai dekatessares.
verses.translation: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon are fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Christ are fourteen generations.

verses.original: Τοῦ δὲ ⸀Ἰησοῦ χριστοῦ ἡ ⸀γένεσις οὕτως ἦν. ⸀μνηστευθείσης τῆς μητρὸς αὐτοῦ Μαρίας τῷ Ἰωσήφ, πρὶν ἢ συνελθεῖν αὐτοὺς εὑρέθη ἐν γαστρὶ ἔχουσα ἐκ πνεύματος ἁγίου.
verses.translit: Tou de Iisou hristou e genesis outos en. mnisteytheisis tes mitros autou Marias to Iosif, prin e synelthein autous eurethi en gastri ehoysa ek pneymatos agioy.
verses.translation: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost.

verses.original: Ἰωσὴφ δὲ ὁ ἀνὴρ αὐτῆς, δίκαιος ὢν καὶ μὴ θέλων αὐτὴν ⸀δειγματίσαι, ἐβουλήθη λάθρᾳ ἀπολῦσαι αὐτήν.
verses.translit: Iosef de o aner autes, dikaios on kai me thelon auten deigmatisai, evoylithi lathra apolusai autin.
verses.translation: Then Joseph her husband, being a just man , and not willing to make her a publick example, was minded to put her away privily.

verses.original: ταῦτα δὲ αὐτοῦ ἐνθυμηθέντος ἰδοὺ ἄγγελος κυρίου κατʼ ὄναρ ἐφάνη αὐτῷ λέγων· Ἰωσὴφ υἱὸς Δαυίδ, μὴ φοβηθῇς παραλαβεῖν ⸀Μαρίαν τὴν γυναῖκά σου, τὸ γὰρ ἐν αὐτῇ γεννηθὲν ἐκ πνεύματός ἐστιν ἁγίου·
verses.translit: tauta de autou enthymithentos idou aggelos kyrioy kat' onar efani auto legon* Iosef yios Dayid, me fovithes paralavein Marian ten gynaika soy, to gar en aute gennithen ek pneymatos estin agioy*
verses.translation: But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Ghost.

verses.original: τέξεται δὲ υἱὸν καὶ καλέσεις τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦν, αὐτὸς γὰρ σώσει τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν αὐτῶν.
verses.translit: texetai de yion kai kaleseis to onoma autou Iisoun, autos gar sosei ton laon autou apo ton amartion auton.
verses.translation: And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people from their sins.

verses.original: τοῦτο δὲ ὅλον γέγονεν ἵνα πληρωθῇ τὸ ῥηθὲν ⸀ὑπὸ κυρίου διὰ τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος·
verses.translit: touto de olon gegonen ina plirothe to Rithen upo kyrioy dia tou profitoy legontos*
verses.translation: Now all this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying,

verses.original: Ἰδοὺ ἡ παρθένος ἐν γαστρὶ ἕξει καὶ τέξεται υἱόν, καὶ καλέσουσιν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἐμμανουήλ· ὅ ἐστιν μεθερμηνευόμενον Μεθʼ ἡμῶν ὁ θεός.
verses.translit: Idou e parthenos en gastri exei kai texetai yion, kai kalesoysin to onoma autou Emmanoyil* o estin methermineyomenon Meth' emon o theos.
verses.translation: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, God with us.

verses.original: ⸀ἐγερθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰωσὴφ ἀπὸ τοῦ ὕπνου ἐποίησεν ὡς προσέταξεν αὐτῷ ὁ ἄγγελος κυρίου καὶ παρέλαβεν τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ·
verses.translit: egertheis de o Iosef apo tou upnoy epoiisen os prosetaxen auto o aggelos kyrioy kai parelaven ten gynaika autou*
verses.translation: Then Joseph being raised from sleep did as the angel of the Lord had bidden him, and took unto him his wife:

verses.original: καὶ οὐκ ἐγίνωσκεν αὐτὴν ἕως οὗ ἔτεκεν ⸀υἱόν· καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦν.
verses.translit: kai ouk eginosken auten eos ou eteken yion* kai ekalesen to onoma autou Iisoun.
verses.translation: And knew her not till she had brought forth her firstborn son: and he called his name JESUS.

verses.original: Τοῦ δὲ Ἰησοῦ γεννηθέντος ἐν Βηθλέεμ τῆς Ἰουδαίας ἐν ἡμέραις Ἡρῴδου τοῦ βασιλέως, ἰδοὺ μάγοι ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν παρεγένοντο εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα
verses.translit: Tou de Iisou gennithentos en Vithleem tes Ioydaias en emerais Erodoy tou vasileos, idou magoi apo anatolon paregenonto eis Ierosolyma
verses.translation: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judaea in the days of Herod the king, behold, there came wise men from the east to Jerusalem,

verses.original: λέγοντες· Ποῦ ἐστιν ὁ τεχθεὶς βασιλεὺς τῶν Ἰουδαίων; εἴδομεν γὰρ αὐτοῦ τὸν ἀστέρα ἐν τῇ ἀνατολῇ καὶ ἤλθομεν προσκυνῆσαι αὐτῷ.
verses.translit: legontes* Pou estin o tehtheis vasileus ton Ioydaion; eidomen gar autou ton astera en te anatole kai elthomen proskynesai auto.
verses.translation: Saying, Where is he that is born King of the Jews? for we have seen his star in the east, and are come to worship him.

verses.original: ἀκούσας δὲ ⸂ὁ βασιλεὺς Ἡρῴδης⸃ ἐταράχθη καὶ πᾶσα Ἱεροσόλυμα μετʼ αὐτοῦ,
verses.translit: akoysas de o vasileus Erodis etarahthi kai pasa Ierosolyma met' autou,
verses.translation: When Herod the king had heard these things , he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.

verses.original: καὶ συναγαγὼν πάντας τοὺς ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ γραμματεῖς τοῦ λαοῦ ἐπυνθάνετο παρʼ αὐτῶν ποῦ ὁ χριστὸς γεννᾶται.
verses.translit: kai synagagon pantas tous arhiereis kai grammateis tou laou epynthaneto par' auton pou o hristos gennatai.
verses.translation: And when he had gathered all the chief priests and scribes of the people together, he demanded of them where Christ should be born.

verses.original: οἱ δὲ εἶπαν αὐτῷ· Ἐν Βηθλέεμ τῆς Ἰουδαίας· οὕτως γὰρ γέγραπται διὰ τοῦ προφήτου·
verses.translit: oi de eipan auto* En Vithleem tes Ioydaias* outos gar gegraptai dia tou profitoy*
verses.translation: And they said unto him, In Bethlehem of Judaea: for thus it is written by the prophet,

verses.original: Καὶ σύ, Βηθλέεμ γῆ Ἰούδα, οὐδαμῶς ἐλαχίστη εἶ ἐν τοῖς ἡγεμόσιν Ἰούδα· ἐκ σοῦ γὰρ ἐξελεύσεται ἡγούμενος, ὅστις ποιμανεῖ τὸν λαόν μου τὸν Ἰσραήλ.
verses.translit: Kai sy, Vithleem ge Ioyda, oudamos elahisti ei en tois egemosin Ioyda* ek sou gar exeleysetai egoymenos, ostis poimanei ton laon moy ton Israil.
verses.translation: And thou Bethlehem, in the land of Juda, art not the least among the princes of Juda: for out of thee shall come a Governor, that shall rule my people Israel.

verses.original: Τότε Ἡρῴδης λάθρᾳ καλέσας τοὺς μάγους ἠκρίβωσεν παρʼ αὐτῶν τὸν χρόνον τοῦ φαινομένου ἀστέρος,
verses.translit: Tote Erodis lathra kalesas tous magoys ekrivosen par' auton ton hronon tou fainomenoy asteros,
verses.translation: Then Herod, when he had privily called the wise men, enquired of them diligently what time the star appeared.

verses.original: καὶ πέμψας αὐτοὺς εἰς Βηθλέεμ εἶπεν· Πορευθέντες ⸂ἐξετάσατε ἀκριβῶς⸃ περὶ τοῦ παιδίου· ἐπὰν δὲ εὕρητε, ἀπαγγείλατέ μοι, ὅπως κἀγὼ ἐλθὼν προσκυνήσω αὐτῷ.
verses.translit: kai pempsas autous eis Vithleem eipen* Poreythentes exetasate akrivos peri tou paidioy* epan de eurite, apaggeilate moi, opos kago elthon proskyniso auto.
verses.translation: And he sent them to Bethlehem, and said, Go and search diligently for the young child; and when ye have found him , bring me word again, that I may come and worship him also.

verses.original: οἱ δὲ ἀκούσαντες τοῦ βασιλέως ἐπορεύθησαν, καὶ ἰδοὺ ὁ ἀστὴρ ὃν εἶδον ἐν τῇ ἀνατολῇ προῆγεν αὐτούς, ἕως ἐλθὼν ⸀ἐστάθη ἐπάνω οὗ ἦν τὸ παιδίον.
verses.translit: oi de akoysantes tou vasileos eporeythisan, kai idou o aster on eidon en te anatole proegen autoys, eos elthon estathi epano ou en to paidion.
verses.translation: When they had heard the king, they departed; and, lo, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, till it came and stood over where the young child was.

verses.original: ἰδόντες δὲ τὸν ἀστέρα ἐχάρησαν χαρὰν μεγάλην σφόδρα.
verses.translit: idontes de ton astera eharisan haran megalin sfodra.
verses.translation: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceeding great joy.

verses.original: καὶ ἐλθόντες εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν εἶδον τὸ παιδίον μετὰ Μαρίας τῆς μητρὸς αὐτοῦ, καὶ πεσόντες προσεκύνησαν αὐτῷ, καὶ ἀνοίξαντες τοὺς θησαυροὺς αὐτῶν προσήνεγκαν αὐτῷ δῶρα, χρυσὸν καὶ λίβανον καὶ σμύρναν.
verses.translit: kai elthontes eis ten oikian eidon to paidion meta Marias tes mitros autou, kai pesontes prosekynisan auto, kai anoixantes tous thisayrous auton prosinegkan auto dora, hryson kai livanon kai smyrnan.
verses.translation: And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.

verses.original: καὶ χρηματισθέντες κατʼ ὄναρ μὴ ἀνακάμψαι πρὸς Ἡρῴδην διʼ ἄλλης ὁδοῦ ἀνεχώρησαν εἰς τὴν χώραν αὐτῶν.
verses.translit: kai hrimatisthentes kat' onar me anakampsai pros Erodin di' allis odou anehorisan eis ten horan auton.
verses.translation: And being warned of God in a dream that they should not return to Herod, they departed into their own country another way.

verses.original: Ἀναχωρησάντων δὲ αὐτῶν ἰδοὺ ἄγγελος κυρίου ⸂φαίνεται κατʼ ὄναρ⸃ τῷ Ἰωσὴφ λέγων· Ἐγερθεὶς παράλαβε τὸ παιδίον καὶ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ φεῦγε εἰς Αἴγυπτον, καὶ ἴσθι ἐκεῖ ἕως ἂν εἴπω σοι· μέλλει γὰρ Ἡρῴδης ζητεῖν τὸ παιδίον τοῦ ἀπολέσαι αὐτό.
verses.translit: Anahorisanton de auton idou aggelos kyrioy fainetai kat' onar to Iosef legon* Egertheis paralave to paidion kai ten mitera autou kai feuge eis Aigypton, kai isthi ekei eos an eipo soi* mellei gar Erodis zitein to paidion tou apolesai auto.
verses.translation: And when they were departed, behold, the angel of the Lord appeareth to Joseph in a dream, saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and be thou there until I bring thee word: for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ ἐγερθεὶς παρέλαβε τὸ παιδίον καὶ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ νυκτὸς καὶ ἀνεχώρησεν εἰς Αἴγυπτον,
verses.translit: o de egertheis parelave to paidion kai ten mitera autou nyktos kai anehorisen eis Aigypton,
verses.translation: When he arose, he took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt:

verses.original: καὶ ἦν ἐκεῖ ἕως τῆς τελευτῆς Ἡρῴδου· ἵνα πληρωθῇ τὸ ῥηθὲν ⸀ὑπὸ κυρίου διὰ τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος· Ἐξ Αἰγύπτου ἐκάλεσα τὸν υἱόν μου.
verses.translit: kai en ekei eos tes teleytes Erodoy* ina plirothe to Rithen upo kyrioy dia tou profitoy legontos* Ex Aigyptoy ekalesa ton yion moy.
verses.translation: And was there until the death of Herod: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying, Out of Egypt have I called my son.

verses.original: Τότε Ἡρῴδης ἰδὼν ὅτι ἐνεπαίχθη ὑπὸ τῶν μάγων ἐθυμώθη λίαν, καὶ ἀποστείλας ἀνεῖλεν πάντας τοὺς παῖδας τοὺς ἐν Βηθλέεμ καὶ ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς ὁρίοις αὐτῆς ἀπὸ διετοῦς καὶ κατωτέρω, κατὰ τὸν χρόνον ὃν ἠκρίβωσεν παρὰ τῶν μάγων.
verses.translit: Tote Erodis idon oti enepaihthi upo ton magon ethymothi lian, kai aposteilas aneilen pantas tous paidas tous en Vithleem kai en pasi tois oriois autes apo dietous kai katotero, kata ton hronon on ekrivosen para ton magon.
verses.translation: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked of the wise men, was exceeding wroth, and sent forth, and slew all the children that were in Bethlehem, and in all the coasts thereof, from two years old and under, according to the time which he had diligently enquired of the wise men.

verses.original: τότε ἐπληρώθη τὸ ῥηθὲν ⸀διὰ Ἰερεμίου τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος·
verses.translit: tote eplirothi to Rithen dia Ieremioy tou profitoy legontos*
verses.translation: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet, saying,

verses.original: Φωνὴ ἐν Ῥαμὰ ⸀ἠκούσθη, κλαυθμὸς καὶ ὀδυρμὸς πολύς· Ῥαχὴλ κλαίουσα τὰ τέκνα αὐτῆς, καὶ οὐκ ἤθελεν παρακληθῆναι ὅτι οὐκ εἰσίν.
verses.translit: Fone en Rama ekoysthi, klaythmos kai odyrmos polys* Rahel klaioysa ta tekna autes, kai ouk ethelen paraklithenai oti ouk eisin.
verses.translation: In Rama was there a voice heard, lamentation, and weeping, and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children, and would not be comforted, because they are not.

verses.original: Τελευτήσαντος δὲ τοῦ Ἡρῴδου ἰδοὺ ἄγγελος κυρίου ⸂φαίνεται κατʼ ὄναρ⸃ τῷ Ἰωσὴφ ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ
verses.translit: Teleytisantos de tou Erodoy idou aggelos kyrioy fainetai kat' onar to Iosef en Aigypto
verses.translation: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeareth in a dream to Joseph in Egypt,

verses.original: λέγων· Ἐγερθεὶς παράλαβε τὸ παιδίον καὶ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ πορεύου εἰς γῆν Ἰσραήλ, τεθνήκασιν γὰρ οἱ ζητοῦντες τὴν ψυχὴν τοῦ παιδίου.
verses.translit: legon* Egertheis paralave to paidion kai ten mitera autou kai poreyoy eis gen Israil, tethnikasin gar oi zitountes ten psyhen tou paidioy.
verses.translation: Saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel: for they are dead which sought the young child’s life.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ ἐγερθεὶς παρέλαβε τὸ παιδίον καὶ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ ⸀εἰσῆλθεν εἰς γῆν Ἰσραήλ.
verses.translit: o de egertheis parelave to paidion kai ten mitera autou kai eiselthen eis gen Israil.
verses.translation: And he arose, and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.

verses.original: ἀκούσας δὲ ὅτι Ἀρχέλαος ⸀βασιλεύει τῆς Ἰουδαίας ἀντὶ ⸂τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ Ἡρῴδου⸃ ἐφοβήθη ἐκεῖ ἀπελθεῖν· χρηματισθεὶς δὲ κατʼ ὄναρ ἀνεχώρησεν εἰς τὰ μέρη τῆς Γαλιλαίας,
verses.translit: akoysas de oti Arhelaos vasileyei tes Ioydaias anti tou patros autou Erodoy efovithi ekei apelthein* hrimatistheis de kat' onar anehorisen eis ta meri tes Galilaias,
verses.translation: But when he heard that Archelaus did reign in Judaea in the room of his father Herod, he was afraid to go thither: notwithstanding, being warned of God in a dream, he turned aside into the parts of Galilee:

verses.original: καὶ ἐλθὼν κατῴκησεν εἰς πόλιν λεγομένην Ναζαρέτ, ὅπως πληρωθῇ τὸ ῥηθὲν διὰ τῶν προφητῶν ὅτι Ναζωραῖος κληθήσεται.
verses.translit: kai elthon katokisen eis polin legomenin Nazaret, opos plirothe to Rithen dia ton profiton oti Nazoraios klithisetai.
verses.translation: And he came and dwelt in a city called Nazareth: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophets, He shall be called a Nazarene.

verses.original: Ἐν δὲ ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις παραγίνεται Ἰωάννης ὁ βαπτιστὴς κηρύσσων ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τῆς Ἰουδαίας
verses.translit: En de tais emerais ekeinais paraginetai Ioannis o vaptistes kirysson en te erimo tes Ioydaias
verses.translation: In those days came John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judaea,

verses.original: ⸀καὶ λέγων· Μετανοεῖτε, ἤγγικεν γὰρ ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν.
verses.translit: kai legon* Metanoeite, eggiken gar e vasileia ton ouranon.
verses.translation: And saying, Repent ye: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.

verses.original: οὗτος γάρ ἐστιν ὁ ῥηθεὶς ⸀διὰ Ἠσαΐου τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος· Φωνὴ βοῶντος ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ· Ἑτοιμάσατε τὴν ὁδὸν κυρίου, εὐθείας ποιεῖτε τὰς τρίβους αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: outos gar estin o Ritheis dia EsaIoy tou profitoy legontos* Fone voontos en te erimo* Etoimasate ten odon kyrioy, eutheias poieite tas trivoys autou.
verses.translation: For this is he that was spoken of by the prophet Esaias, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.

verses.original: αὐτὸς δὲ ὁ Ἰωάννης εἶχεν τὸ ἔνδυμα αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τριχῶν καμήλου καὶ ζώνην δερματίνην περὶ τὴν ὀσφὺν αὐτοῦ, ἡ δὲ τροφὴ ⸂ἦν αὐτοῦ⸃ ἀκρίδες καὶ μέλι ἄγριον.
verses.translit: autos de o Ioannis eihen to endyma autou apo trihon kamiloy kai zonin dermatinin peri ten osfun autou, e de trofe en autou akrides kai meli agrion.
verses.translation: And the same John had his raiment of camel’s hair, and a leathern girdle about his loins; and his meat was locusts and wild honey.

verses.original: τότε ἐξεπορεύετο πρὸς αὐτὸν Ἱεροσόλυμα καὶ πᾶσα ἡ Ἰουδαία καὶ πᾶσα ἡ περίχωρος τοῦ Ἰορδάνου,
verses.translit: tote exeporeyeto pros auton Ierosolyma kai pasa e Ioydaia kai pasa e perihoros tou Iordanoy,
verses.translation: Then went out to him Jerusalem, and all Judaea, and all the region round about Jordan,

verses.original: καὶ ἐβαπτίζοντο ἐν τῷ Ἰορδάνῃ ⸀ποταμῷ ὑπʼ αὐτοῦ ἐξομολογούμενοι τὰς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν.
verses.translit: kai evaptizonto en to Iordane potamo up' autou exomologoymenoi tas amartias auton.
verses.translation: And were baptized of him in Jordan, confessing their sins.

verses.original: Ἰδὼν δὲ πολλοὺς τῶν Φαρισαίων καὶ Σαδδουκαίων ἐρχομένους ἐπὶ τὸ βάπτισμα ⸀αὐτοῦ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Γεννήματα ἐχιδνῶν, τίς ὑπέδειξεν ὑμῖν φυγεῖν ἀπὸ τῆς μελλούσης ὀργῆς;
verses.translit: Idon de pollous ton Farisaion kai Saddoykaion erhomenoys epi to vaptisma autou eipen autois* Gennimata ehidnon, tis upedeixen umin fygein apo tes melloysis orges;
verses.translation: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

verses.original: ποιήσατε οὖν καρπὸν ἄξιον τῆς μετανοίας
verses.translit: poiisate oun karpon axion tes metanoias
verses.translation: Bring forth therefore fruits meet for repentance:

verses.original: καὶ μὴ δόξητε λέγειν ἐν ἑαυτοῖς· Πατέρα ἔχομεν τὸν Ἀβραάμ, λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν ὅτι δύναται ὁ θεὸς ἐκ τῶν λίθων τούτων ἐγεῖραι τέκνα τῷ Ἀβραάμ.
verses.translit: kai me doxite legein en eaytois* Patera ehomen ton Avraam, lego gar umin oti dynatai o theos ek ton lithon toyton egeirai tekna to Avraam.
verses.translation: And think not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, that God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.

verses.original: ἤδη ⸀δὲ ἡ ἀξίνη πρὸς τὴν ῥίζαν τῶν δένδρων κεῖται· πᾶν οὖν δένδρον μὴ ποιοῦν καρπὸν καλὸν ἐκκόπτεται καὶ εἰς πῦρ βάλλεται.
verses.translit: edi de e axini pros ten Rizan ton dendron keitai* pan oun dendron me poioun karpon kalon ekkoptetai kai eis pur valletai.
verses.translation: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: therefore every tree which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.

verses.original: Ἐγὼ μὲν ⸂ὑμᾶς βαπτίζω⸃ ἐν ὕδατι εἰς μετάνοιαν· ὁ δὲ ὀπίσω μου ἐρχόμενος ἰσχυρότερός μού ἐστιν, οὗ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἱκανὸς τὰ ὑποδήματα βαστάσαι· αὐτὸς ὑμᾶς βαπτίσει ἐν πνεύματι ἁγίῳ ⸂καὶ πυρί⸃·
verses.translit: Ego men umas vaptizo en udati eis metanoian* o de opiso moy erhomenos ishyroteros moy estin, ou ouk eimi ikanos ta upodimata vastasai* autos umas vaptisei en pneymati agio kai pyri*
verses.translation: I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance: but he that cometh after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to bear: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost, and with fire:

verses.original: οὗ τὸ πτύον ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ, καὶ διακαθαριεῖ τὴν ἅλωνα αὐτοῦ καὶ συνάξει τὸν σῖτον αὐτοῦ εἰς τὴν ⸀ἀποθήκην, τὸ δὲ ἄχυρον κατακαύσει πυρὶ ἀσβέστῳ.
verses.translit: ou to ptyon en te heiri autou, kai diakathariei ten alona autou kai synaxei ton siton autou eis ten apothikin, to de ahyron katakaysei pyri asvesto.
verses.translation: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and gather his wheat into the garner; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.

verses.original: Τότε παραγίνεται ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας ἐπὶ τὸν Ἰορδάνην πρὸς τὸν Ἰωάννην τοῦ βαπτισθῆναι ὑπʼ αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: Tote paraginetai o Iisous apo tes Galilaias epi ton Iordanin pros ton Ioannin tou vaptisthenai up' autou.
verses.translation: Then cometh Jesus from Galilee to Jordan unto John, to be baptized of him.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ ⸀Ἰωάννης διεκώλυεν αὐτὸν λέγων· Ἐγὼ χρείαν ἔχω ὑπὸ σοῦ βαπτισθῆναι, καὶ σὺ ἔρχῃ πρός με;
verses.translit: o de Ioannis diekolyen auton legon* Ego hreian eho upo sou vaptisthenai, kai su erhe pros me;
verses.translation: But John forbad him, saying, I have need to be baptized of thee, and comest thou to me?

verses.original: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν ⸂πρὸς αὐτόν⸃· Ἄφες ἄρτι, οὕτως γὰρ πρέπον ἐστὶν ἡμῖν πληρῶσαι πᾶσαν δικαιοσύνην. τότε ἀφίησιν αὐτόν.
verses.translit: apokritheis de o Iisous eipen pros auton* Afes arti, outos gar prepon estin emin plirosai pasan dikaiosynin. tote afiisin auton.
verses.translation: And Jesus answering said unto him, Suffer it to be so now: for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness. Then he suffered him.

verses.original: ⸂βαπτισθεὶς δὲ⸃ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ⸂εὐθὺς ἀνέβη⸃ ἀπὸ τοῦ ὕδατος· καὶ ἰδοὺ ⸀ἠνεῴχθησαν οἱ οὐρανοί, καὶ εἶδεν ⸀πνεῦμα θεοῦ καταβαῖνον ὡσεὶ ⸀περιστερὰν ἐρχόμενον ἐπʼ αὐτόν·
verses.translit: vaptistheis de o Iisous euthus anevi apo tou udatos* kai idou eneohthisan oi ouranoi, kai eiden pneuma theou katavainon osei peristeran erhomenon ep' auton*
verses.translation: And Jesus, when he was baptized, went up straightway out of the water: and, lo, the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove, and lighting upon him:

verses.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ φωνὴ ἐκ τῶν οὐρανῶν λέγουσα· Οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ υἱός μου ὁ ἀγαπητός, ἐν ᾧ εὐδόκησα.
verses.translit: kai idou fone ek ton ouranon legoysa* Outos estin o yios moy o agapitos, en o eudokisa.
verses.translation: And lo a voice from heaven, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

verses.original: Τότε ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀνήχθη εἰς τὴν ἔρημον ὑπὸ τοῦ πνεύματος, πειρασθῆναι ὑπὸ τοῦ διαβόλου.
verses.translit: Tote o Iisous anihthi eis ten erimon upo tou pneymatos, peirasthenai upo tou diavoloy.
verses.translation: Then was Jesus led up of the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil.

verses.original: καὶ νηστεύσας ἡμέρας τεσσεράκοντα καὶ νύκτας τεσσεράκοντα ὕστερον ἐπείνασεν.
verses.translit: kai nisteysas emeras tesserakonta kai nyktas tesserakonta usteron epeinasen.
verses.translation: And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was afterward an hungred.

verses.original: καὶ προσελθὼν ⸂ὁ πειράζων εἶπεν αὐτῷ⸃· Εἰ υἱὸς εἶ τοῦ θεοῦ, εἰπὲ ἵνα οἱ λίθοι οὗτοι ἄρτοι γένωνται.
verses.translit: kai proselthon o peirazon eipen auto* Ei yios ei tou theou, eipe ina oi lithoi outoi artoi genontai.
verses.translation: And when the tempter came to him, he said, If thou be the Son of God, command that these stones be made bread.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν· Γέγραπται· Οὐκ ἐπʼ ἄρτῳ μόνῳ ζήσεται ⸀ὁ ἄνθρωπος, ἀλλʼ ⸀ἐπὶ παντὶ ῥήματι ἐκπορευομένῳ διὰ στόματος θεοῦ.
verses.translit: o de apokritheis eipen* Gegraptai* Ouk ep' arto mono zisetai o anthropos, all' epi panti Rimati ekporeyomeno dia stomatos theou.
verses.translation: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.

verses.original: Τότε παραλαμβάνει αὐτὸν ὁ διάβολος εἰς τὴν ἁγίαν πόλιν, καὶ ⸀ἔστησεν αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὸ πτερύγιον τοῦ ἱεροῦ,
verses.translit: Tote paralamvanei auton o diavolos eis ten agian polin, kai estisen auton epi to pterygion tou ierou,
verses.translation: Then the devil taketh him up into the holy city, and setteth him on a pinnacle of the temple,

verses.original: καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ· Εἰ υἱὸς εἶ τοῦ θεοῦ, βάλε σεαυτὸν κάτω· γέγραπται γὰρ ὅτι Τοῖς ἀγγέλοις αὐτοῦ ἐντελεῖται περὶ σοῦ καὶ ἐπὶ χειρῶν ἀροῦσίν σε, μήποτε προσκόψῃς πρὸς λίθον τὸν πόδα σου.
verses.translit: kai legei auto* Ei yios ei tou theou, vale seayton kato* gegraptai gar oti Tois aggelois autou enteleitai peri sou kai epi heiron arousin se, mipote proskopses pros lithon ton poda soy.
verses.translation: And saith unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down: for it is written, He shall give his angels charge concerning thee: and in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.

verses.original: ἔφη αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Πάλιν γέγραπται· Οὐκ ἐκπειράσεις κύριον τὸν θεόν σου.
verses.translit: efi auto o Iisous* Palin gegraptai* Ouk ekpeiraseis kyrion ton theon soy.
verses.translation: Jesus said unto him, It is written again, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.

verses.original: Πάλιν παραλαμβάνει αὐτὸν ὁ διάβολος εἰς ὄρος ὑψηλὸν λίαν, καὶ δείκνυσιν αὐτῷ πάσας τὰς βασιλείας τοῦ κόσμου καὶ τὴν δόξαν αὐτῶν
verses.translit: Palin paralamvanei auton o diavolos eis oros upsilon lian, kai deiknysin auto pasas tas vasileias tou kosmoy kai ten doxan auton
verses.translation: Again, the devil taketh him up into an exceeding high mountain, and sheweth him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them;

verses.original: καὶ ⸀εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Ταῦτά ⸂σοι πάντα⸃ δώσω, ἐὰν πεσὼν προσκυνήσῃς μοι.
verses.translit: kai eipen auto* Tauta soi panta doso, ean peson proskynises moi.
verses.translation: And saith unto him, All these things will I give thee, if thou wilt fall down and worship me.

verses.original: τότε λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· ⸀Ὕπαγε, Σατανᾶ· γέγραπται γάρ· Κύριον τὸν θεόν σου προσκυνήσεις καὶ αὐτῷ μόνῳ λατρεύσεις.
verses.translit: tote legei auto o Iisous* Upage, Satana* gegraptai gar* Kyrion ton theon soy proskyniseis kai auto mono latreyseis.
verses.translation: Then saith Jesus unto him, Get thee hence, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.

verses.original: τότε ἀφίησιν αὐτὸν ὁ διάβολος, καὶ ἰδοὺ ἄγγελοι προσῆλθον καὶ διηκόνουν αὐτῷ.
verses.translit: tote afiisin auton o diavolos, kai idou aggeloi proselthon kai diikonoyn auto.
verses.translation: Then the devil leaveth him, and, behold, angels came and ministered unto him.

verses.original: Ἀκούσας ⸀δὲ ὅτι Ἰωάννης παρεδόθη ἀνεχώρησεν εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν.
verses.translit: Akoysas de oti Ioannis paredothi anehorisen eis ten Galilaian.
verses.translation: Now when Jesus had heard that John was cast into prison, he departed into Galilee;

verses.original: καὶ καταλιπὼν τὴν Ναζαρὰ ἐλθὼν κατῴκησεν εἰς Καφαρναοὺμ τὴν παραθαλασσίαν ἐν ὁρίοις Ζαβουλὼν καὶ Νεφθαλίμ·
verses.translit: kai katalipon ten Nazara elthon katokisen eis Kafarnaoum ten parathalassian en oriois Zavoylon kai Nefthalim*
verses.translation: And leaving Nazareth, he came and dwelt in Capernaum, which is upon the sea coast, in the borders of Zabulon and Nephthalim:

verses.original: ἵνα πληρωθῇ τὸ ῥηθὲν διὰ Ἠσαΐου τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος·
verses.translit: ina plirothe to Rithen dia EsaIoy tou profitoy legontos*
verses.translation: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,

verses.original: Γῆ Ζαβουλὼν καὶ γῆ Νεφθαλίμ, ὁδὸν θαλάσσης, πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου, Γαλιλαία τῶν ἐθνῶν,
verses.translit: Ge Zavoylon kai ge Nefthalim, odon thalassis, peran tou Iordanoy, Galilaia ton ethnon,
verses.translation: The land of Zabulon, and the land of Nephthalim, by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles;

verses.original: ὁ λαὸς ὁ καθήμενος ἐν ⸀σκοτίᾳ ⸂φῶς εἶδεν⸃ μέγα, καὶ τοῖς καθημένοις ἐν χώρᾳ καὶ σκιᾷ θανάτου φῶς ἀνέτειλεν αὐτοῖς.
verses.translit: o laos o kathimenos en skotia fos eiden mega, kai tois kathimenois en hora kai skia thanatoy fos aneteilen autois.
verses.translation: The people which sat in darkness saw great light; and to them which sat in the region and shadow of death light is sprung up.

verses.original: Ἀπὸ τότε ἤρξατο ὁ Ἰησοῦς κηρύσσειν καὶ λέγειν· Μετανοεῖτε, ἤγγικεν γὰρ ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν.
verses.translit: Apo tote erxato o Iisous kiryssein kai legein* Metanoeite, eggiken gar e vasileia ton ouranon.
verses.translation: From that time Jesus began to preach, and to say, Repent: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.

verses.original: Περιπατῶν δὲ παρὰ τὴν θάλασσαν τῆς Γαλιλαίας εἶδεν δύο ἀδελφούς, Σίμωνα τὸν λεγόμενον Πέτρον καὶ Ἀνδρέαν τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ, βάλλοντας ἀμφίβληστρον εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν, ἦσαν γὰρ ἁλιεῖς·
verses.translit: Peripaton de para ten thalassan tes Galilaias eiden dyo adelfoys, Simona ton legomenon Petron kai Andrean ton adelfon autou, vallontas amfivlistron eis ten thalassan, esan gar alieis*
verses.translation: And Jesus, walking by the sea of Galilee, saw two brethren, Simon called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.

verses.original: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς· Δεῦτε ὀπίσω μου, καὶ ποιήσω ὑμᾶς ἁλιεῖς ἀνθρώπων.
verses.translit: kai legei autois* Deute opiso moy, kai poiiso umas alieis anthropon.
verses.translation: And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.

verses.original: οἱ δὲ εὐθέως ἀφέντες τὰ δίκτυα ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ.
verses.translit: oi de eutheos afentes ta diktya ekoloythisan auto.
verses.translation: And they straightway left their nets, and followed him.

verses.original: Καὶ προβὰς ἐκεῖθεν εἶδεν ἄλλους δύο ἀδελφούς, Ἰάκωβον τὸν τοῦ Ζεβεδαίου καὶ Ἰωάννην τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ, ἐν τῷ πλοίῳ μετὰ Ζεβεδαίου τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτῶν καταρτίζοντας τὰ δίκτυα αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐκάλεσεν αὐτούς.
verses.translit: Kai provas ekeithen eiden alloys dyo adelfoys, Iakovon ton tou Zevedaioy kai Ioannin ton adelfon autou, en to ploio meta Zevedaioy tou patros auton katartizontas ta diktya auton, kai ekalesen autoys.
verses.translation: And going on from thence, he saw other two brethren, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in a ship with Zebedee their father, mending their nets; and he called them.

verses.original: οἱ δὲ εὐθέως ἀφέντες τὸ πλοῖον καὶ τὸν πατέρα αὐτῶν ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ.
verses.translit: oi de eutheos afentes to ploion kai ton patera auton ekoloythisan auto.
verses.translation: And they immediately left the ship and their father, and followed him.

verses.original: Καὶ περιῆγεν ⸂ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ Γαλιλαίᾳ⸃, διδάσκων ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς αὐτῶν καὶ κηρύσσων τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τῆς βασιλείας καὶ θεραπεύων πᾶσαν νόσον καὶ πᾶσαν μαλακίαν ἐν τῷ λαῷ.
verses.translit: Kai periegen en ole te Galilaia, didaskon en tais synagogais auton kai kirysson to euaggelion tes vasileias kai therapeyon pasan noson kai pasan malakian en to lao.
verses.translation: And Jesus went about all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing all manner of sickness and all manner of disease among the people.

verses.original: καὶ ἀπῆλθεν ἡ ἀκοὴ αὐτοῦ εἰς ὅλην τὴν Συρίαν· καὶ προσήνεγκαν αὐτῷ πάντας τοὺς κακῶς ἔχοντας ποικίλαις νόσοις καὶ βασάνοις ⸀συνεχομένους, δαιμονιζομένους καὶ σεληνιαζομένους καὶ παραλυτικούς, καὶ ἐθεράπευσεν αὐτούς.
verses.translit: kai apelthen e akoe autou eis olin ten Syrian* kai prosinegkan auto pantas tous kakos ehontas poikilais nosois kai vasanois synehomenoys, daimonizomenoys kai seliniazomenoys kai paralytikoys, kai etherapeysen autoys.
verses.translation: And his fame went throughout all Syria: and they brought unto him all sick people that were taken with divers diseases and torments, and those which were possessed with devils, and those which were lunatick, and those that had the palsy; and he healed them.

verses.original: καὶ ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ ὄχλοι πολλοὶ ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας καὶ Δεκαπόλεως καὶ Ἱεροσολύμων καὶ Ἰουδαίας καὶ πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου.
verses.translit: kai ekoloythisan auto ohloi polloi apo tes Galilaias kai Dekapoleos kai Ierosolymon kai Ioydaias kai peran tou Iordanoy.
verses.translation: And there followed him great multitudes of people from Galilee, and from Decapolis, and from Jerusalem, and from Judaea, and from beyond Jordan.

verses.original: Ἰδὼν δὲ τοὺς ὄχλους ἀνέβη εἰς τὸ ὄρος· καὶ καθίσαντος αὐτοῦ προσῆλθαν αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ·
verses.translit: Idon de tous ohloys anevi eis to oros* kai kathisantos autou proselthan auto oi mathitai autou*
verses.translation: And seeing the multitudes, he went up into a mountain: and when he was set, his disciples came unto him:

verses.original: καὶ ἀνοίξας τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ ἐδίδασκεν αὐτοὺς λέγων·
verses.translit: kai anoixas to stoma autou edidasken autous legon*
verses.translation: And he opened his mouth, and taught them, saying,

verses.original: Μακάριοι οἱ πτωχοὶ τῷ πνεύματι, ὅτι αὐτῶν ἐστιν ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν.
verses.translit: Makarioi oi ptohoi to pneymati, oti auton estin e vasileia ton ouranon.
verses.translation: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

verses.original: μακάριοι οἱ πενθοῦντες, ὅτι αὐτοὶ παρακληθήσονται.
verses.translit: makarioi oi penthountes, oti autoi paraklithisontai.
verses.translation: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.

verses.original: μακάριοι οἱ πραεῖς, ὅτι αὐτοὶ κληρονομήσουσι τὴν γῆν.
verses.translit: makarioi oi praeis, oti autoi klironomisoysi ten gen.
verses.translation: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.

verses.original: μακάριοι οἱ πεινῶντες καὶ διψῶντες τὴν δικαιοσύνην, ὅτι αὐτοὶ χορτασθήσονται.
verses.translit: makarioi oi peinontes kai dipsontes ten dikaiosynin, oti autoi hortasthisontai.
verses.translation: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.

verses.original: μακάριοι οἱ ἐλεήμονες, ὅτι αὐτοὶ ἐλεηθήσονται.
verses.translit: makarioi oi eleimones, oti autoi eleithisontai.
verses.translation: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.

verses.original: μακάριοι οἱ καθαροὶ τῇ καρδίᾳ, ὅτι αὐτοὶ τὸν θεὸν ὄψονται.
verses.translit: makarioi oi katharoi te kardia, oti autoi ton theon opsontai.
verses.translation: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.

verses.original: μακάριοι οἱ εἰρηνοποιοί, ὅτι αὐτοὶ υἱοὶ θεοῦ κληθήσονται.
verses.translit: makarioi oi eirinopoioi, oti autoi yioi theou klithisontai.
verses.translation: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.

verses.original: μακάριοι οἱ δεδιωγμένοι ἕνεκεν δικαιοσύνης, ὅτι αὐτῶν ἐστιν ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν.
verses.translit: makarioi oi dediogmenoi eneken dikaiosynis, oti auton estin e vasileia ton ouranon.
verses.translation: Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness’ sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

verses.original: μακάριοί ἐστε ὅταν ὀνειδίσωσιν ὑμᾶς καὶ διώξωσιν καὶ εἴπωσιν πᾶν ⸀πονηρὸν καθʼ ὑμῶν ψευδόμενοι ἕνεκεν ἐμοῦ.
verses.translit: makarioi este otan oneidisosin umas kai dioxosin kai eiposin pan poniron kath' umon pseydomenoi eneken emou.
verses.translation: Blessed are ye, when men shall revile you, and persecute you , and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake.

verses.original: χαίρετε καὶ ἀγαλλιᾶσθε, ὅτι ὁ μισθὸς ὑμῶν πολὺς ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς· οὕτως γὰρ ἐδίωξαν τοὺς προφήτας τοὺς πρὸ ὑμῶν.
verses.translit: hairete kai agalliasthe, oti o misthos umon polus en tois ouranois* outos gar edioxan tous profitas tous pro umon.
verses.translation: Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you.

verses.original: Ὑμεῖς ἐστε τὸ ἅλας τῆς γῆς· ἐὰν δὲ τὸ ἅλας μωρανθῇ, ἐν τίνι ἁλισθήσεται; εἰς οὐδὲν ἰσχύει ἔτι εἰ μὴ ⸂βληθὲν ἔξω⸃ καταπατεῖσθαι ὑπὸ τῶν ἀνθρώπων.
verses.translit: Umeis este to alas tes ges* ean de to alas moranthe, en tini alisthisetai; eis ouden ishyei eti ei me vlithen exo katapateisthai upo ton anthropon.
verses.translation: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.

verses.original: Ὑμεῖς ἐστε τὸ φῶς τοῦ κόσμου. οὐ δύναται πόλις κρυβῆναι ἐπάνω ὄρους κειμένη·
verses.translit: Umeis este to fos tou kosmoy. ou dynatai polis kryvenai epano oroys keimeni*
verses.translation: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.

verses.original: οὐδὲ καίουσιν λύχνον καὶ τιθέασιν αὐτὸν ὑπὸ τὸν μόδιον ἀλλʼ ἐπὶ τὴν λυχνίαν, καὶ λάμπει πᾶσιν τοῖς ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ.
verses.translit: oude kaioysin lyhnon kai titheasin auton upo ton modion all' epi ten lyhnian, kai lampei pasin tois en te oikia.
verses.translation: Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house.

verses.original: οὕτως λαμψάτω τὸ φῶς ὑμῶν ἔμπροσθεν τῶν ἀνθρώπων, ὅπως ἴδωσιν ὑμῶν τὰ καλὰ ἔργα καὶ δοξάσωσιν τὸν πατέρα ὑμῶν τὸν ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς.
verses.translit: outos lampsato to fos umon emprosthen ton anthropon, opos idosin umon ta kala erga kai doxasosin ton patera umon ton en tois ouranois.
verses.translation: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.

verses.original: Μὴ νομίσητε ὅτι ἦλθον καταλῦσαι τὸν νόμον ἢ τοὺς προφήτας· οὐκ ἦλθον καταλῦσαι ἀλλὰ πληρῶσαι·
verses.translit: Me nomisite oti elthon katalusai ton nomon e tous profitas* ouk elthon katalusai alla plirosai*
verses.translation: Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.

verses.original: ἀμὴν γὰρ λέγω ὑμῖν, ἕως ἂν παρέλθῃ ὁ οὐρανὸς καὶ ἡ γῆ, ἰῶτα ἓν ἢ μία κεραία οὐ μὴ παρέλθῃ ἀπὸ τοῦ νόμου, ἕως ἂν πάντα γένηται.
verses.translit: amen gar lego umin, eos an parelthe o ouranos kai e ge, iota en e mia keraia ou me parelthe apo tou nomoy, eos an panta genitai.
verses.translation: For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law, till all be fulfilled.

verses.original: ὃς ἐὰν οὖν λύσῃ μίαν τῶν ἐντολῶν τούτων τῶν ἐλαχίστων καὶ διδάξῃ οὕτως τοὺς ἀνθρώπους, ἐλάχιστος κληθήσεται ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τῶν οὐρανῶν· ὃς δʼ ἂν ποιήσῃ καὶ διδάξῃ, οὗτος μέγας κληθήσεται ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τῶν οὐρανῶν.
verses.translit: os ean oun lyse mian ton entolon toyton ton elahiston kai didaxe outos tous anthropoys, elahistos klithisetai en te vasileia ton ouranon* os d' an poiise kai didaxe, outos megas klithisetai en te vasileia ton ouranon.
verses.translation: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven: but whosoever shall do and teach them , the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.

verses.original: λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν ὅτι ἐὰν μὴ περισσεύσῃ ⸂ὑμῶν ἡ δικαιοσύνη⸃ πλεῖον τῶν γραμματέων καὶ Φαρισαίων, οὐ μὴ εἰσέλθητε εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τῶν οὐρανῶν.
verses.translit: lego gar umin oti ean me perisseyse umon e dikaiosyni pleion ton grammateon kai Farisaion, ou me eiselthite eis ten vasileian ton ouranon.
verses.translation: For I say unto you, That except your righteousness shall exceed the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees, ye shall in no case enter into the kingdom of heaven.

verses.original: Ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἐρρέθη τοῖς ἀρχαίοις· Οὐ φονεύσεις· ὃς δʼ ἂν φονεύσῃ, ἔνοχος ἔσται τῇ κρίσει.
verses.translit: Ekoysate oti errethi tois arhaiois* Ou foneyseis* os d' an foneyse, enohos estai te krisei.
verses.translation: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not kill; and whosoever shall kill shall be in danger of the judgment:

verses.original: ἐγὼ δὲ λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι πᾶς ὁ ὀργιζόμενος τῷ ἀδελφῷ ⸀αὐτοῦ ἔνοχος ἔσται τῇ κρίσει· ὃς δʼ ἂν εἴπῃ τῷ ἀδελφῷ αὐτοῦ· Ῥακά, ἔνοχος ἔσται τῷ συνεδρίῳ· ὃς δʼ ἂν εἴπῃ· Μωρέ, ἔνοχος ἔσται εἰς τὴν γέενναν τοῦ πυρός.
verses.translit: ego de lego umin oti pas o orgizomenos to adelfo autou enohos estai te krisei* os d' an eipe to adelfo autou* Raka, enohos estai to synedrio* os d' an eipe* More, enohos estai eis ten geennan tou pyros.
verses.translation: But I say unto you, That whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment: and whosoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be in danger of the council: but whosoever shall say, Thou fool, shall be in danger of hell fire.

verses.original: ἐὰν οὖν προσφέρῃς τὸ δῶρόν σου ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον κἀκεῖ μνησθῇς ὅτι ὁ ἀδελφός σου ἔχει τι κατὰ σοῦ,
verses.translit: ean oun prosferes to doron soy epi to thysiastirion kakei mnisthes oti o adelfos soy ehei ti kata sou,
verses.translation: Therefore if thou bring thy gift to the altar, and there rememberest that thy brother hath ought against thee;

verses.original: ἄφες ἐκεῖ τὸ δῶρόν σου ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου καὶ ὕπαγε πρῶτον διαλλάγηθι τῷ ἀδελφῷ σου, καὶ τότε ἐλθὼν πρόσφερε τὸ δῶρόν σου.
verses.translit: afes ekei to doron soy emprosthen tou thysiastirioy kai upage proton diallagithi to adelfo soy, kai tote elthon prosfere to doron soy.
verses.translation: Leave there thy gift before the altar, and go thy way; first be reconciled to thy brother, and then come and offer thy gift.

verses.original: ἴσθι εὐνοῶν τῷ ἀντιδίκῳ σου ταχὺ ἕως ὅτου εἶ ⸂μετʼ αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ⸃, μήποτέ σε παραδῷ ὁ ἀντίδικος τῷ κριτῇ, καὶ ὁ ⸀κριτὴς τῷ ὑπηρέτῃ, καὶ εἰς φυλακὴν βληθήσῃ·
verses.translit: isthi eunoon to antidiko soy tahu eos otoy ei met' autou en te odo, mipote se parado o antidikos to krite, kai o krites to upirete, kai eis fylaken vlithise*
verses.translation: Agree with thine adversary quickly, whiles thou art in the way with him; lest at any time the adversary deliver thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and thou be cast into prison.

verses.original: ἀμὴν λέγω σοι, οὐ μὴ ἐξέλθῃς ἐκεῖθεν ἕως ἂν ἀποδῷς τὸν ἔσχατον κοδράντην.
verses.translit: amen lego soi, ou me exelthes ekeithen eos an apodos ton eshaton kodrantin.
verses.translation: Verily I say unto thee, Thou shalt by no means come out thence, till thou hast paid the uttermost farthing.

verses.original: Ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἐρρέθη· Οὐ μοιχεύσεις.
verses.translit: Ekoysate oti errethi* Ou moiheyseis.
verses.translation: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not commit adultery:

verses.original: ἐγὼ δὲ λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι πᾶς ὁ βλέπων γυναῖκα πρὸς τὸ ἐπιθυμῆσαι αὐτὴν ἤδη ἐμοίχευσεν αὐτὴν ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: ego de lego umin oti pas o vlepon gynaika pros to epithymesai auten edi emoiheysen auten en te kardia autou.
verses.translation: But I say unto you, That whosoever looketh on a woman to lust after her hath committed adultery with her already in his heart.
