verses.original: γνοὺς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ⸀εἶπεν· Τί διαλογίζεσθε ἐν ἑαυτοῖς, ὀλιγόπιστοι, ὅτι ἄρτους οὐκ ⸀ἐλάβετε;
verses.translit: gnous de o Iisous eipen* Ti dialogizesthe en eaytois, oligopistoi, oti artoys ouk elavete;
verses.translation: Which when Jesus perceived, he said unto them, O ye of little faith, why reason ye among yourselves, because ye have brought no bread?

verses.original: οὔπω νοεῖτε, οὐδὲ μνημονεύετε τοὺς πέντε ἄρτους τῶν πεντακισχιλίων καὶ πόσους κοφίνους ἐλάβετε;
verses.translit: oupo noeite, oude mnimoneyete tous pente artoys ton pentakishilion kai posoys kofinoys elavete;
verses.translation: Do ye not yet understand, neither remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?

verses.original: οὐδὲ τοὺς ἑπτὰ ἄρτους τῶν τετρακισχιλίων καὶ πόσας σπυρίδας ἐλάβετε;
verses.translit: oude tous epta artoys ton tetrakishilion kai posas spyridas elavete;
verses.translation: Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?

verses.original: πῶς οὐ νοεῖτε ὅτι οὐ περὶ ⸀ἄρτων εἶπον ὑμῖν; ⸂προσέχετε δὲ⸃ ἀπὸ τῆς ζύμης τῶν Φαρισαίων καὶ Σαδδουκαίων.
verses.translit: pos ou noeite oti ou peri arton eipon umin; prosehete de apo tes zymis ton Farisaion kai Saddoykaion.
verses.translation: How is it that ye do not understand that I spake it not to you concerning bread, that ye should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees?

verses.original: τότε συνῆκαν ὅτι οὐκ εἶπεν προσέχειν ἀπὸ τῆς ζύμης ⸂τῶν ἄρτων⸃ ἀλλὰ ἀπὸ τῆς διδαχῆς τῶν Φαρισαίων καὶ Σαδδουκαίων.
verses.translit: tote synekan oti ouk eipen prosehein apo tes zymis ton arton alla apo tes didahes ton Farisaion kai Saddoykaion.
verses.translation: Then understood they how that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.

verses.original: Ἐλθὼν δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἰς τὰ μέρη Καισαρείας τῆς Φιλίππου ἠρώτα τοὺς μαθητὰς αὐτοῦ λέγων· ⸀Τίνα λέγουσιν οἱ ἄνθρωποι εἶναι τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου;
verses.translit: Elthon de o Iisous eis ta meri Kaisareias tes Filippoy erota tous mathitas autou legon* Tina legoysin oi anthropoi einai ton yion tou anthropoy;
verses.translation: When Jesus came into the coasts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Whom do men say that I the Son of man am?

verses.original: οἱ δὲ εἶπαν· Οἱ μὲν Ἰωάννην τὸν βαπτιστήν, ἄλλοι δὲ Ἠλίαν, ἕτεροι δὲ Ἰερεμίαν ἢ ἕνα τῶν προφητῶν.
verses.translit: oi de eipan* Oi men Ioannin ton vaptistin, alloi de Elian, eteroi de Ieremian e ena ton profiton.
verses.translation: And they said, Some say that thou art John the Baptist: some, Elias; and others, Jeremias, or one of the prophets.

verses.original: λέγει αὐτοῖς· Ὑμεῖς δὲ τίνα με λέγετε εἶναι;
verses.translit: legei autois* Umeis de tina me legete einai;
verses.translation: He saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am?

verses.original: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ Σίμων Πέτρος εἶπεν· Σὺ εἶ ὁ χριστὸς ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ ζῶντος.
verses.translit: apokritheis de Simon Petros eipen* Su ei o hristos o yios tou theou tou zontos.
verses.translation: And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.

verses.original: ⸂ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ⸃ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Μακάριος εἶ, Σίμων Βαριωνᾶ, ὅτι σὰρξ καὶ αἷμα οὐκ ἀπεκάλυψέν σοι ἀλλʼ ὁ πατήρ μου ὁ ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς·
verses.translit: apokritheis de o Iisous eipen auto* Makarios ei, Simon Variona, oti sarx kai aima ouk apekalypsen soi all' o patir moy o en tois ouranois*
verses.translation: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Blessed art thou, Simon Bar-jona: for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven.

verses.original: κἀγὼ δέ σοι λέγω ὅτι σὺ εἶ Πέτρος, καὶ ἐπὶ ταύτῃ τῇ πέτρᾳ οἰκοδομήσω μου τὴν ἐκκλησίαν, καὶ πύλαι ᾅδου οὐ κατισχύσουσιν αὐτῆς·
verses.translit: kago de soi lego oti su ei Petros, kai epi tayte te petra oikodomiso moy ten ekklisian, kai pylai adoy ou katishysoysin autes*
verses.translation: And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.

verses.original: ⸀δώσω σοι τὰς ⸀κλεῖδας τῆς βασιλείας τῶν οὐρανῶν, καὶ ὃ ⸀ἐὰν δήσῃς ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἔσται δεδεμένον ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς, καὶ ὃ ⸁ἐὰν λύσῃς ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἔσται λελυμένον ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς.
verses.translit: doso soi tas kleidas tes vasileias ton ouranon, kai o ean dises epi tes ges estai dedemenon en tois ouranois, kai o ean lyses epi tes ges estai lelymenon en tois ouranois.
verses.translation: And I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.

verses.original: τότε ⸀διεστείλατο τοῖς ⸀μαθηταῖς ἵνα μηδενὶ εἴπωσιν ὅτι αὐτός ⸀ἐστιν ὁ χριστός.
verses.translit: tote diesteilato tois mathitais ina mideni eiposin oti autos estin o hristos.
verses.translation: Then charged he his disciples that they should tell no man that he was Jesus the Christ.

verses.original: Ἀπὸ τότε ἤρξατο ⸂ὁ Ἰησοῦς⸃ δεικνύειν τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ ὅτι δεῖ αὐτὸν ⸂εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα ἀπελθεῖν⸃ καὶ πολλὰ παθεῖν ἀπὸ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων καὶ ἀρχιερέων καὶ γραμματέων καὶ ἀποκτανθῆναι καὶ τῇ τρίτῃ ἡμέρᾳ ἐγερθῆναι.
verses.translit: Apo tote erxato o Iisous deiknyein tois mathitais autou oti dei auton eis Ierosolyma apelthein kai polla pathein apo ton presvyteron kai arhiereon kai grammateon kai apoktanthenai kai te trite emera egerthenai.
verses.translation: From that time forth began Jesus to shew unto his disciples, how that he must go unto Jerusalem, and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised again the third day.

verses.original: καὶ προσλαβόμενος αὐτὸν ὁ Πέτρος ἤρξατο ἐπιτιμᾶν αὐτῷ λέγων· Ἵλεώς σοι, κύριε· οὐ μὴ ἔσται σοι τοῦτο.
verses.translit: kai proslavomenos auton o Petros erxato epitiman auto legon* Ileos soi, kyrie* ou me estai soi touto.
verses.translation: Then Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Lord: this shall not be unto thee.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ στραφεὶς εἶπεν τῷ Πέτρῳ· Ὕπαγε ὀπίσω μου, Σατανᾶ· σκάνδαλον ⸂εἶ ἐμοῦ⸃, ὅτι οὐ φρονεῖς τὰ τοῦ θεοῦ ἀλλὰ τὰ τῶν ἀνθρώπων.
verses.translit: o de strafeis eipen to Petro* Upage opiso moy, Satana* skandalon ei emou, oti ou froneis ta tou theou alla ta ton anthropon.
verses.translation: But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get thee behind me, Satan: thou art an offence unto me: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but those that be of men.

verses.original: Τότε ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ· Εἴ τις θέλει ὀπίσω μου ἐλθεῖν, ἀπαρνησάσθω ἑαυτὸν καὶ ἀράτω τὸν σταυρὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀκολουθείτω μοι.
verses.translit: Tote o Iisous eipen tois mathitais autou* Ei tis thelei opiso moy elthein, aparnisastho eayton kai arato ton stayron autou kai akoloytheito moi.
verses.translation: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

verses.original: ὃς γὰρ ⸀ἐὰν θέλῃ τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ σῶσαι ἀπολέσει αὐτήν· ὃς δʼ ἂν ἀπολέσῃ τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ἕνεκεν ἐμοῦ εὑρήσει αὐτήν.
verses.translit: os gar ean thele ten psyhen autou sosai apolesei autin* os d' an apolese ten psyhen autou eneken emou eurisei autin.
verses.translation: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it.

verses.original: τί γὰρ ⸀ὠφεληθήσεται ἄνθρωπος ἐὰν τὸν κόσμον ὅλον κερδήσῃ τὴν δὲ ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ζημιωθῇ; ἢ τί δώσει ἄνθρωπος ἀντάλλαγμα τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτοῦ;
verses.translit: ti gar ofelithisetai anthropos ean ton kosmon olon kerdise ten de psyhen autou zimiothe; e ti dosei anthropos antallagma tes psyhes autou;
verses.translation: For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?

verses.original: μέλλει γὰρ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἔρχεσθαι ἐν τῇ δόξῃ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ μετὰ τῶν ἀγγέλων αὐτοῦ, καὶ τότε ἀποδώσει ἑκάστῳ κατὰ τὴν πρᾶξιν αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: mellei gar o yios tou anthropoy erhesthai en te doxe tou patros autou meta ton aggelon autou, kai tote apodosei ekasto kata ten praxin autou.
verses.translation: For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then he shall reward every man according to his works.

verses.original: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ⸀ὅτι εἰσίν τινες ⸂τῶν ὧδε ἑστώτων⸃ οἵτινες οὐ μὴ γεύσωνται θανάτου ἕως ἂν ἴδωσιν τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐρχόμενον ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: amen lego umin oti eisin tines ton ode estoton oitines ou me geysontai thanatoy eos an idosin ton yion tou anthropoy erhomenon en te vasileia autou.
verses.translation: Verily I say unto you, There be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom.

verses.original: Καὶ μεθʼ ἡμέρας ἓξ παραλαμβάνει ὁ Ἰησοῦς τὸν Πέτρον καὶ Ἰάκωβον καὶ Ἰωάννην τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἀναφέρει αὐτοὺς εἰς ὄρος ὑψηλὸν κατʼ ἰδίαν.
verses.translit: Kai meth' emeras ex paralamvanei o Iisous ton Petron kai Iakovon kai Ioannin ton adelfon autou, kai anaferei autous eis oros upsilon kat' idian.
verses.translation: And after six days Jesus taketh Peter, James, and John his brother, and bringeth them up into an high mountain apart,

verses.original: καὶ μετεμορφώθη ἔμπροσθεν αὐτῶν, καὶ ἔλαμψεν τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ ὡς ὁ ἥλιος, τὰ δὲ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ ⸀ἐγένετο λευκὰ ὡς τὸ φῶς.
verses.translit: kai metemorfothi emprosthen auton, kai elampsen to prosopon autou os o elios, ta de imatia autou egeneto leyka os to fos.
verses.translation: And was transfigured before them: and his face did shine as the sun, and his raiment was white as the light.

verses.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ ⸀ὤφθη αὐτοῖς Μωϋσῆς καὶ Ἠλίας ⸂συλλαλοῦντες μετʼ αὐτοῦ⸃.
verses.translit: kai idou ofthi autois Moyses kai Elias syllalountes met' autou.
verses.translation: And, behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elias talking with him.

verses.original: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Πέτρος εἶπεν τῷ Ἰησοῦ· Κύριε, καλόν ἐστιν ἡμᾶς ὧδε εἶναι· εἰ θέλεις, ⸀ποιήσω ὧδε τρεῖς σκηνάς, σοὶ μίαν καὶ Μωϋσεῖ μίαν καὶ ⸂Ἠλίᾳ μίαν⸃.
verses.translit: apokritheis de o Petros eipen to Iisou* Kyrie, kalon estin emas ode einai* ei theleis, poiiso ode treis skinas, soi mian kai Moysei mian kai Elia mian.
verses.translation: Then answered Peter, and said unto Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if thou wilt, let us make here three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.

verses.original: ἔτι αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος ἰδοὺ νεφέλη φωτεινὴ ἐπεσκίασεν αὐτούς, καὶ ἰδοὺ φωνὴ ἐκ τῆς νεφέλης λέγουσα· Οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ υἱός μου ὁ ἀγαπητός, ἐν ᾧ εὐδόκησα· ⸂ἀκούετε αὐτοῦ⸃.
verses.translit: eti autou lalountos idou nefeli foteine epeskiasen autoys, kai idou fone ek tes nefelis legoysa* Outos estin o yios moy o agapitos, en o eudokisa* akoyete autou.
verses.translation: While he yet spake, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and behold a voice out of the cloud, which said, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear ye him.

verses.original: καὶ ἀκούσαντες οἱ μαθηταὶ ἔπεσαν ἐπὶ πρόσωπον αὐτῶν καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν σφόδρα.
verses.translit: kai akoysantes oi mathitai epesan epi prosopon auton kai efovithisan sfodra.
verses.translation: And when the disciples heard it , they fell on their face, and were sore afraid.

verses.original: καὶ ⸂προσῆλθεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ ἁψάμενος αὐτῶν⸃ εἶπεν· Ἐγέρθητε καὶ μὴ φοβεῖσθε.
verses.translit: kai proselthen o Iisous kai apsamenos auton eipen* Egerthite kai me foveisthe.
verses.translation: And Jesus came and touched them, and said, Arise, and be not afraid.

verses.original: ἐπάραντες δὲ τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτῶν οὐδένα εἶδον εἰ μὴ ⸀αὐτὸν Ἰησοῦν μόνον.
verses.translit: eparantes de tous ofthalmous auton oudena eidon ei me auton Iisoun monon.
verses.translation: And when they had lifted up their eyes, they saw no man, save Jesus only.

verses.original: Καὶ καταβαινόντων αὐτῶν ἐκ τοῦ ὄρους ἐνετείλατο αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγων· Μηδενὶ εἴπητε τὸ ὅραμα ἕως οὗ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐκ νεκρῶν ⸀ἐγερθῇ.
verses.translit: Kai katavainonton auton ek tou oroys eneteilato autois o Iisous legon* Mideni eipite to orama eos ou o yios tou anthropoy ek nekron egerthe.
verses.translation: And as they came down from the mountain, Jesus charged them, saying, Tell the vision to no man, until the Son of man be risen again from the dead.

verses.original: καὶ ἐπηρώτησαν αὐτὸν οἱ ⸀μαθηταὶ λέγοντες· Τί οὖν οἱ γραμματεῖς λέγουσιν ὅτι Ἠλίαν δεῖ ἐλθεῖν πρῶτον;
verses.translit: kai epirotisan auton oi mathitai legontes* Ti oun oi grammateis legoysin oti Elian dei elthein proton;
verses.translation: And his disciples asked him, saying, Why then say the scribes that Elias must first come?

verses.original: ὁ ⸀δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς ⸀εἶπεν· Ἠλίας μὲν ⸀ἔρχεται καὶ ἀποκαταστήσει πάντα·
verses.translit: o de apokritheis eipen* Elias men erhetai kai apokatastisei panta*
verses.translation: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Elias truly shall first come, and restore all things.

verses.original: λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν ὅτι Ἠλίας ἤδη ἦλθεν, καὶ οὐκ ἐπέγνωσαν αὐτὸν ἀλλὰ ἐποίησαν ἐν αὐτῷ ὅσα ἠθέλησαν· οὕτως καὶ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου μέλλει πάσχειν ὑπʼ αὐτῶν.
verses.translit: lego de umin oti Elias edi elthen, kai ouk epegnosan auton alla epoiisan en auto osa ethelisan* outos kai o yios tou anthropoy mellei pashein up' auton.
verses.translation: But I say unto you, That Elias is come already, and they knew him not, but have done unto him whatsoever they listed. Likewise shall also the Son of man suffer of them.

verses.original: τότε συνῆκαν οἱ μαθηταὶ ὅτι περὶ Ἰωάννου τοῦ βαπτιστοῦ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς.
verses.translit: tote synekan oi mathitai oti peri Ioannoy tou vaptistou eipen autois.
verses.translation: Then the disciples understood that he spake unto them of John the Baptist.

verses.original: Καὶ ⸀ἐλθόντων πρὸς τὸν ὄχλον προσῆλθεν αὐτῷ ἄνθρωπος γονυπετῶν αὐτὸν
verses.translit: Kai elthonton pros ton ohlon proselthen auto anthropos gonypeton auton
verses.translation: And when they were come to the multitude, there came to him a certain man, kneeling down to him, and saying,

verses.original: καὶ λέγων· Κύριε, ἐλέησόν μου τὸν υἱόν, ὅτι σεληνιάζεται καὶ κακῶς ⸀πάσχει, πολλάκις γὰρ πίπτει εἰς τὸ πῦρ καὶ πολλάκις εἰς τὸ ὕδωρ.
verses.translit: kai legon* Kyrie, eleison moy ton yion, oti seliniazetai kai kakos pashei, pollakis gar piptei eis to pur kai pollakis eis to udor.
verses.translation: Lord, have mercy on my son: for he is lunatick, and sore vexed: for ofttimes he falleth into the fire, and oft into the water.

verses.original: καὶ προσήνεγκα αὐτὸν τοῖς μαθηταῖς σου, καὶ οὐκ ἠδυνήθησαν αὐτὸν θεραπεῦσαι.
verses.translit: kai prosinegka auton tois mathitais soy, kai ouk edynithisan auton therapeusai.
verses.translation: And I brought him to thy disciples, and they could not cure him.

verses.original: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν· Ὦ γενεὰ ἄπιστος καὶ διεστραμμένη, ἕως πότε ⸂μεθʼ ὑμῶν ἔσομαι⸃; ἕως πότε ἀνέξομαι ὑμῶν; φέρετέ μοι αὐτὸν ὧδε.
verses.translit: apokritheis de o Iisous eipen* O genea apistos kai diestrammeni, eos pote meth' umon esomai; eos pote anexomai umon; ferete moi auton ode.
verses.translation: Then Jesus answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him hither to me.

verses.original: καὶ ἐπετίμησεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς, καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ τὸ δαιμόνιον· καὶ ἐθεραπεύθη ὁ παῖς ἀπὸ τῆς ὥρας ἐκείνης.
verses.translit: kai epetimisen auto o Iisous, kai exelthen ap' autou to daimonion* kai etherapeythi o pais apo tes oras ekeinis.
verses.translation: And Jesus rebuked the devil; and he departed out of him: and the child was cured from that very hour.

verses.original: Τότε προσελθόντες οἱ μαθηταὶ τῷ Ἰησοῦ κατʼ ἰδίαν εἶπον· Διὰ τί ἡμεῖς οὐκ ἠδυνήθημεν ἐκβαλεῖν αὐτό;
verses.translit: Tote proselthontes oi mathitai to Iisou kat' idian eipon* Dia ti emeis ouk edynithimen ekvalein auto;
verses.translation: Then came the disciples to Jesus apart, and said, Why could not we cast him out?

verses.original: ὁ δὲ ⸀λέγει αὐτοῖς· Διὰ τὴν ⸀ὀλιγοπιστίαν ὑμῶν· ἀμὴν γὰρ λέγω ὑμῖν, ἐὰν ἔχητε πίστιν ὡς κόκκον σινάπεως, ἐρεῖτε τῷ ὄρει τούτῳ· ⸂Μετάβα ἔνθεν⸃ ἐκεῖ, καὶ μεταβήσεται, καὶ οὐδὲν ἀδυνατήσει ⸀ὑμῖν.
verses.translit: o de legei autois* Dia ten oligopistian umon* amen gar lego umin, ean ehite pistin os kokkon sinapeos, ereite to orei toyto* Metava enthen ekei, kai metavisetai, kai ouden adynatisei umin.
verses.translation: And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.
Howbeit this kind goeth not out but by prayer and fasting.

verses.original: ⸀Συστρεφομένων δὲ αὐτῶν ἐν τῇ Γαλιλαίᾳ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Μέλλει ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου παραδίδοσθαι εἰς χεῖρας ἀνθρώπων,
verses.translit: Systrefomenon de auton en te Galilaia eipen autois o Iisous* Mellei o yios tou anthropoy paradidosthai eis heiras anthropon,
verses.translation: And while they abode in Galilee, Jesus said unto them, The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men:

verses.original: καὶ ἀποκτενοῦσιν αὐτόν, καὶ τῇ τρίτῃ ἡμέρᾳ ἐγερθήσεται. καὶ ἐλυπήθησαν σφόδρα.
verses.translit: kai apoktenousin auton, kai te trite emera egerthisetai. kai elypithisan sfodra.
verses.translation: And they shall kill him, and the third day he shall be raised again. And they were exceeding sorry.

verses.original: Ἐλθόντων δὲ αὐτῶν εἰς Καφαρναοὺμ προσῆλθον οἱ τὰ δίδραχμα λαμβάνοντες τῷ Πέτρῳ καὶ εἶπαν· Ὁ διδάσκαλος ὑμῶν οὐ τελεῖ τὰ δίδραχμα;
verses.translit: Elthonton de auton eis Kafarnaoum proselthon oi ta didrahma lamvanontes to Petro kai eipan* O didaskalos umon ou telei ta didrahma;
verses.translation: And when they were come to Capernaum, they that received tribute money came to Peter, and said, Doth not your master pay tribute?

verses.original: λέγει· Ναί. καὶ ⸀ἐλθόντα εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν προέφθασεν αὐτὸν ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγων· Τί σοι δοκεῖ, Σίμων; οἱ βασιλεῖς τῆς γῆς ἀπὸ τίνων λαμβάνουσιν τέλη ἢ κῆνσον; ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν αὐτῶν ἢ ἀπὸ τῶν ἀλλοτρίων;
verses.translit: legei* Nai. kai elthonta eis ten oikian proefthasen auton o Iisous legon* Ti soi dokei, Simon; oi vasileis tes ges apo tinon lamvanoysin teli e kenson; apo ton yion auton e apo ton allotrion;
verses.translation: He saith, Yes. And when he was come into the house, Jesus prevented him, saying, What thinkest thou, Simon? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute? of their own children, or of strangers?

verses.original: ⸂εἰπόντος δέ⸃· Ἀπὸ τῶν ἀλλοτρίων, ἔφη αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἄρα γε ἐλεύθεροί εἰσιν οἱ υἱοί.
verses.translit: eipontos de* Apo ton allotrion, efi auto o Iisous* Ara ge eleytheroi eisin oi yioi.
verses.translation: Peter saith unto him, Of strangers. Jesus saith unto him, Then are the children free.

verses.original: ἵνα δὲ μὴ σκανδαλίσωμεν αὐτούς, πορευθεὶς ⸀εἰς θάλασσαν βάλε ἄγκιστρον καὶ τὸν ⸀ἀναβάντα πρῶτον ἰχθὺν ἆρον, καὶ ἀνοίξας τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ εὑρήσεις στατῆρα· ἐκεῖνον λαβὼν δὸς αὐτοῖς ἀντὶ ἐμοῦ καὶ σοῦ.
verses.translit: ina de me skandalisomen autoys, poreytheis eis thalassan vale agkistron kai ton anavanta proton ihthun aron, kai anoixas to stoma autou euriseis statera* ekeinon lavon dos autois anti emou kai sou.
verses.translation: Notwithstanding, lest we should offend them, go thou to the sea, and cast an hook, and take up the fish that first cometh up; and when thou hast opened his mouth, thou shalt find a piece of money: that take, and give unto them for me and thee.

verses.original: Ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ὥρᾳ προσῆλθον οἱ μαθηταὶ τῷ Ἰησοῦ λέγοντες· Τίς ἄρα μείζων ἐστὶν ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τῶν οὐρανῶν;
verses.translit: En ekeine te ora proselthon oi mathitai to Iisou legontes* Tis ara meizon estin en te vasileia ton ouranon;
verses.translation: At the same time came the disciples unto Jesus, saying, Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?

verses.original: καὶ ⸀προσκαλεσάμενος παιδίον ἔστησεν αὐτὸ ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῶν
verses.translit: kai proskalesamenos paidion estisen auto en meso auton
verses.translation: And Jesus called a little child unto him, and set him in the midst of them,

verses.original: καὶ εἶπεν· Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἐὰν μὴ στραφῆτε καὶ γένησθε ὡς τὰ παιδία, οὐ μὴ εἰσέλθητε εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τῶν οὐρανῶν.
verses.translit: kai eipen* Amen lego umin, ean me strafete kai genisthe os ta paidia, ou me eiselthite eis ten vasileian ton ouranon.
verses.translation: And said, Verily I say unto you, Except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.

verses.original: ὅστις οὖν ταπεινώσει ἑαυτὸν ὡς τὸ παιδίον τοῦτο, οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ μείζων ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τῶν οὐρανῶν·
verses.translit: ostis oun tapeinosei eayton os to paidion touto, outos estin o meizon en te vasileia ton ouranon*
verses.translation: Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven.

verses.original: καὶ ὃς ⸀ἐὰν δέξηται ⸂ἓν παιδίον τοιοῦτο⸃ ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματί μου, ἐμὲ δέχεται.
verses.translit: kai os ean dexitai en paidion toiouto epi to onomati moy, eme dehetai.
verses.translation: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me.

verses.original: Ὃς δʼ ἂν σκανδαλίσῃ ἕνα τῶν μικρῶν τούτων τῶν πιστευόντων εἰς ἐμέ, συμφέρει αὐτῷ ἵνα κρεμασθῇ μύλος ὀνικὸς ⸀εἰς τὸν τράχηλον αὐτοῦ καὶ καταποντισθῇ ἐν τῷ πελάγει τῆς θαλάσσης.
verses.translit: Os d' an skandalise ena ton mikron toyton ton pisteyonton eis eme, symferei auto ina kremasthe mylos onikos eis ton trahilon autou kai katapontisthe en to pelagei tes thalassis.
verses.translation: But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea.

verses.original: οὐαὶ τῷ κόσμῳ ἀπὸ τῶν σκανδάλων· ἀνάγκη ⸀γὰρ ἐλθεῖν τὰ σκάνδαλα, πλὴν οὐαὶ τῷ ⸀ἀνθρώπῳ διʼ οὗ τὸ σκάνδαλον ἔρχεται.
verses.translit: ouai to kosmo apo ton skandalon* anagki gar elthein ta skandala, plen ouai to anthropo di' ou to skandalon erhetai.
verses.translation: Woe unto the world because of offences! for it must needs be that offences come; but woe to that man by whom the offence cometh!

verses.original: Εἰ δὲ ἡ χείρ σου ἢ ὁ πούς σου σκανδαλίζει σε, ἔκκοψον ⸀αὐτὸν καὶ βάλε ἀπὸ σοῦ· καλόν σοί ἐστιν εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὴν ζωὴν ⸂κυλλὸν ἢ χωλόν⸃, ἢ δύο χεῖρας ἢ δύο πόδας ἔχοντα βληθῆναι εἰς τὸ πῦρ τὸ αἰώνιον.
verses.translit: Ei de e heir soy e o poys soy skandalizei se, ekkopson auton kai vale apo sou* kalon soi estin eiselthein eis ten zoen kyllon e holon, e dyo heiras e dyo podas ehonta vlithenai eis to pur to aionion.
verses.translation: Wherefore if thy hand or thy foot offend thee, cut them off, and cast them from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life halt or maimed, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire.

verses.original: καὶ εἰ ὁ ὀφθαλμός σου σκανδαλίζει σε, ἔξελε αὐτὸν καὶ βάλε ἀπὸ σοῦ· καλόν σοί ἐστιν μονόφθαλμον εἰς τὴν ζωὴν εἰσελθεῖν, ἢ δύο ὀφθαλμοὺς ἔχοντα βληθῆναι εἰς τὴν γέενναν τοῦ πυρός.
verses.translit: kai ei o ofthalmos soy skandalizei se, exele auton kai vale apo sou* kalon soi estin monofthalmon eis ten zoen eiselthein, e dyo ofthalmous ehonta vlithenai eis ten geennan tou pyros.
verses.translation: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire.

verses.original: Ὁρᾶτε μὴ καταφρονήσητε ἑνὸς τῶν μικρῶν τούτων, λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν ὅτι οἱ ἄγγελοι αὐτῶν ἐν οὐρανοῖς διὰ παντὸς βλέπουσι τὸ πρόσωπον τοῦ πατρός μου τοῦ ἐν ⸀οὐρανοῖς.
verses.translit: Orate me katafronisite enos ton mikron toyton, lego gar umin oti oi aggeloi auton en ouranois dia pantos vlepoysi to prosopon tou patros moy tou en ouranois.
verses.translation: Take heed that ye despise not one of these little ones; for I say unto you, That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven.
For the Son of man is come to save that which was lost.

verses.original: τί ὑμῖν δοκεῖ; ἐὰν γένηταί τινι ἀνθρώπῳ ἑκατὸν πρόβατα καὶ πλανηθῇ ἓν ἐξ αὐτῶν, οὐχὶ ⸀ἀφήσει τὰ ἐνενήκοντα ἐννέα ἐπὶ τὰ ὄρη ⸀καὶ πορευθεὶς ζητεῖ τὸ πλανώμενον;
verses.translit: ti umin dokei; ean genitai tini anthropo ekaton provata kai planithe en ex auton, ouhi afisei ta enenikonta ennea epi ta ori kai poreytheis zitei to planomenon;
verses.translation: How think ye? if a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, doth he not leave the ninety and nine, and goeth into the mountains, and seeketh that which is gone astray?

verses.original: καὶ ἐὰν γένηται εὑρεῖν αὐτό, ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι χαίρει ἐπʼ αὐτῷ μᾶλλον ἢ ἐπὶ τοῖς ἐνενήκοντα ἐννέα τοῖς μὴ πεπλανημένοις.
verses.translit: kai ean genitai eurein auto, amen lego umin oti hairei ep' auto mallon e epi tois enenikonta ennea tois me peplanimenois.
verses.translation: And if so be that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoiceth more of that sheep , than of the ninety and nine which went not astray.

verses.original: οὕτως οὐκ ἔστιν θέλημα ⸀ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ πατρὸς ⸀ὑμῶν τοῦ ἐν οὐρανοῖς ἵνα ἀπόληται ⸀ἓν τῶν μικρῶν τούτων.
verses.translit: outos ouk estin thelima emprosthen tou patros umon tou en ouranois ina apolitai en ton mikron toyton.
verses.translation: Even so it is not the will of your Father which is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.

verses.original: Ἐὰν δὲ ἁμαρτήσῃ ⸂εἰς σὲ⸃ ὁ ἀδελφός σου, ⸀ὕπαγε ἔλεγξον αὐτὸν μεταξὺ σοῦ καὶ αὐτοῦ μόνου. ἐάν σου ἀκούσῃ, ἐκέρδησας τὸν ἀδελφόν σου·
verses.translit: Ean de amartise eis se o adelfos soy, upage elegxon auton metaxu sou kai autou monoy. ean soy akoyse, ekerdisas ton adelfon soy*
verses.translation: Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee, go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone: if he shall hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother.

verses.original: ἐὰν δὲ μὴ ἀκούσῃ, παράλαβε μετὰ σοῦ ἔτι ἕνα ἢ δύο, ἵνα ἐπὶ στόματος δύο μαρτύρων ἢ τριῶν σταθῇ πᾶν ῥῆμα·
verses.translit: ean de me akoyse, paralave meta sou eti ena e dyo, ina epi stomatos dyo martyron e trion stathe pan Rema*
verses.translation: But if he will not hear thee, then take with thee one or two more, that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.

verses.original: ἐὰν δὲ παρακούσῃ αὐτῶν, εἰπὸν τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ· ἐὰν δὲ καὶ τῆς ἐκκλησίας παρακούσῃ, ἔστω σοι ὥσπερ ὁ ἐθνικὸς καὶ ὁ τελώνης.
verses.translit: ean de parakoyse auton, eipon te ekklisia* ean de kai tes ekklisias parakoyse, esto soi osper o ethnikos kai o telonis.
verses.translation: And if he shall neglect to hear them, tell it unto the church: but if he neglect to hear the church, let him be unto thee as an heathen man and a publican.

verses.original: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ὅσα ⸀ἐὰν δήσητε ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἔσται δεδεμένα ⸀ἐν οὐρανῷ καὶ ὅσα ἐὰν λύσητε ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἔσται λελυμένα ⸁ἐν οὐρανῷ.
verses.translit: amen lego umin, osa ean disite epi tes ges estai dedemena en ourano kai osa ean lysite epi tes ges estai lelymena en ourano.
verses.translation: Verily I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever ye shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.

verses.original: Πάλιν ⸀ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἐὰν δύο ⸂συμφωνήσωσιν ἐξ ὑμῶν⸃ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς περὶ παντὸς πράγματος οὗ ἐὰν αἰτήσωνται, γενήσεται αὐτοῖς παρὰ τοῦ πατρός μου τοῦ ἐν οὐρανοῖς.
verses.translit: Palin amen lego umin oti ean dyo symfonisosin ex umon epi tes ges peri pantos pragmatos ou ean aitisontai, genisetai autois para tou patros moy tou en ouranois.
verses.translation: Again I say unto you, That if two of you shall agree on earth as touching any thing that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my Father which is in heaven.

verses.original: οὗ γάρ εἰσιν δύο ἢ τρεῖς συνηγμένοι εἰς τὸ ἐμὸν ὄνομα, ἐκεῖ εἰμι ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῶν.
verses.translit: ou gar eisin dyo e treis synigmenoi eis to emon onoma, ekei eimi en meso auton.
verses.translation: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.

verses.original: Τότε προσελθὼν ⸂αὐτῷ ὁ Πέτρος εἶπεν⸃· Κύριε, ποσάκις ἁμαρτήσει εἰς ἐμὲ ὁ ἀδελφός μου καὶ ἀφήσω αὐτῷ; ἕως ἑπτάκις;
verses.translit: Tote proselthon auto o Petros eipen* Kyrie, posakis amartisei eis eme o adelfos moy kai afiso auto; eos eptakis;
verses.translation: Then came Peter to him, and said, Lord, how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times?

verses.original: λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Οὐ λέγω σοι ἕως ἑπτάκις ἀλλὰ ἕως ἑβδομηκοντάκις ἑπτά.
verses.translit: legei auto o Iisous* Ou lego soi eos eptakis alla eos evdomikontakis epta.
verses.translation: Jesus saith unto him, I say not unto thee, Until seven times: but, Until seventy times seven.

verses.original: Διὰ τοῦτο ὡμοιώθη ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν ἀνθρώπῳ βασιλεῖ ὃς ἠθέλησεν συνᾶραι λόγον μετὰ τῶν δούλων αὐτοῦ·
verses.translit: Dia touto omoiothi e vasileia ton ouranon anthropo vasilei os ethelisen synarai logon meta ton doylon autou*
verses.translation: Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened unto a certain king, which would take account of his servants.

verses.original: ἀρξαμένου δὲ αὐτοῦ συναίρειν ⸀προσηνέχθη ⸂αὐτῷ εἷς⸃ ὀφειλέτης μυρίων ταλάντων.
verses.translit: arxamenoy de autou synairein prosinehthi auto eis ofeiletis myrion talanton.
verses.translation: And when he had begun to reckon, one was brought unto him, which owed him ten thousand talents.

verses.original: μὴ ἔχοντος δὲ αὐτοῦ ἀποδοῦναι ἐκέλευσεν αὐτὸν ὁ ⸀κύριος πραθῆναι καὶ τὴν ⸀γυναῖκα καὶ τὰ τέκνα καὶ πάντα ὅσα ⸀ἔχει καὶ ἀποδοθῆναι.
verses.translit: me ehontos de autou apodounai ekeleysen auton o kyrios prathenai kai ten gynaika kai ta tekna kai panta osa ehei kai apodothenai.
verses.translation: But forasmuch as he had not to pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.

verses.original: πεσὼν οὖν ὁ δοῦλος προσεκύνει αὐτῷ λέγων· ⸀Μακροθύμησον ἐπʼ ⸀ἐμοί, καὶ πάντα ⸂ἀποδώσω σοι⸃.
verses.translit: peson oun o doulos prosekynei auto legon* Makrothymison ep' emoi, kai panta apodoso soi.
verses.translation: The servant therefore fell down, and worshipped him, saying, Lord, have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.

verses.original: σπλαγχνισθεὶς δὲ ὁ κύριος τοῦ δούλου ἐκείνου ἀπέλυσεν αὐτόν, καὶ τὸ δάνειον ἀφῆκεν αὐτῷ.
verses.translit: splaghnistheis de o kyrios tou doyloy ekeinoy apelysen auton, kai to daneion afeken auto.
verses.translation: Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion, and loosed him, and forgave him the debt.

verses.original: ἐξελθὼν δὲ ὁ δοῦλος ἐκεῖνος εὗρεν ἕνα τῶν συνδούλων αὐτοῦ ὃς ὤφειλεν αὐτῷ ἑκατὸν δηνάρια, καὶ κρατήσας αὐτὸν ἔπνιγεν λέγων· ⸀Ἀπόδος εἴ τι ὀφείλεις.
verses.translit: exelthon de o doulos ekeinos euren ena ton syndoylon autou os ofeilen auto ekaton dinaria, kai kratisas auton epnigen legon* Apodos ei ti ofeileis.
verses.translation: But the same servant went out, and found one of his fellowservants, which owed him an hundred pence: and he laid hands on him, and took him by the throat, saying, Pay me that thou owest.

verses.original: πεσὼν οὖν ὁ σύνδουλος ⸀αὐτοῦ παρεκάλει αὐτὸν λέγων· Μακροθύμησον ἐπʼ ⸀ἐμοί, καὶ ἀποδώσω σοι.
verses.translit: peson oun o syndoylos autou parekalei auton legon* Makrothymison ep' emoi, kai apodoso soi.
verses.translation: And his fellowservant fell down at his feet, and besought him, saying, Have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ οὐκ ἤθελεν, ἀλλὰ ἀπελθὼν ἔβαλεν αὐτὸν εἰς φυλακὴν ἕως ⸀οὗ ἀποδῷ τὸ ὀφειλόμενον.
verses.translit: o de ouk ethelen, alla apelthon evalen auton eis fylaken eos ou apodo to ofeilomenon.
verses.translation: And he would not: but went and cast him into prison, till he should pay the debt.

verses.original: ἰδόντες ⸀οὖν οἱ σύνδουλοι αὐτοῦ τὰ γενόμενα ἐλυπήθησαν σφόδρα, καὶ ἐλθόντες διεσάφησαν τῷ κυρίῳ ἑαυτῶν πάντα τὰ γενόμενα.
verses.translit: idontes oun oi syndoyloi autou ta genomena elypithisan sfodra, kai elthontes diesafisan to kyrio eayton panta ta genomena.
verses.translation: So when his fellowservants saw what was done, they were very sorry, and came and told unto their lord all that was done.

verses.original: τότε προσκαλεσάμενος αὐτὸν ὁ κύριος αὐτοῦ λέγει αὐτῷ· Δοῦλε πονηρέ, πᾶσαν τὴν ὀφειλὴν ἐκείνην ἀφῆκά σοι, ἐπεὶ παρεκάλεσάς με·
verses.translit: tote proskalesamenos auton o kyrios autou legei auto* Doule ponire, pasan ten ofeilen ekeinin afeka soi, epei parekalesas me*
verses.translation: Then his lord, after that he had called him, said unto him, O thou wicked servant, I forgave thee all that debt, because thou desiredst me:

verses.original: οὐκ ἔδει καὶ σὲ ἐλεῆσαι τὸν σύνδουλόν σου, ὡς κἀγὼ σὲ ἠλέησα;
verses.translit: ouk edei kai se eleesai ton syndoylon soy, os kago se eleisa;
verses.translation: Shouldest not thou also have had compassion on thy fellowservant, even as I had pity on thee?

verses.original: καὶ ὀργισθεὶς ὁ κύριος αὐτοῦ παρέδωκεν αὐτὸν τοῖς βασανισταῖς ἕως οὗ ἀποδῷ πᾶν τὸ ⸀ὀφειλόμενον.
verses.translit: kai orgistheis o kyrios autou paredoken auton tois vasanistais eos ou apodo pan to ofeilomenon.
verses.translation: And his lord was wroth, and delivered him to the tormentors, till he should pay all that was due unto him.

verses.original: Οὕτως καὶ ὁ πατήρ μου ὁ ⸀οὐράνιος ποιήσει ὑμῖν ἐὰν μὴ ἀφῆτε ἕκαστος τῷ ἀδελφῷ αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τῶν καρδιῶν ⸀ὑμῶν.
verses.translit: Outos kai o patir moy o ouranios poiisei umin ean me afete ekastos to adelfo autou apo ton kardion umon.
verses.translation: So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also unto you, if ye from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐγένετο ὅτε ἐτέλεσεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς τοὺς λόγους τούτους, μετῆρεν ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας καὶ ἦλθεν εἰς τὰ ὅρια τῆς Ἰουδαίας πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου.
verses.translit: Kai egeneto ote etelesen o Iisous tous logoys toytoys, meteren apo tes Galilaias kai elthen eis ta oria tes Ioydaias peran tou Iordanoy.
verses.translation: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these sayings, he departed from Galilee, and came into the coasts of Judaea beyond Jordan;

verses.original: καὶ ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ ὄχλοι πολλοί, καὶ ἐθεράπευσεν αὐτοὺς ἐκεῖ.
verses.translit: kai ekoloythisan auto ohloi polloi, kai etherapeysen autous ekei.
verses.translation: And great multitudes followed him; and he healed them there.

verses.original: Καὶ προσῆλθον ⸀αὐτῷ Φαρισαῖοι πειράζοντες αὐτὸν καὶ ⸀λέγοντες· Εἰ ἔξεστιν ⸀ἀνθρώπῳ ἀπολῦσαι τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ κατὰ πᾶσαν αἰτίαν;
verses.translit: Kai proselthon auto Farisaioi peirazontes auton kai legontes* Ei exestin anthropo apolusai ten gynaika autou kata pasan aitian;
verses.translation: The Pharisees also came unto him, tempting him, and saying unto him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?

verses.original: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς ⸀εἶπεν· Οὐκ ἀνέγνωτε ὅτι ὁ ⸀κτίσας ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς ἄρσεν καὶ θῆλυ ἐποίησεν αὐτοὺς
verses.translit: o de apokritheis eipen* Ouk anegnote oti o ktisas ap' arhes arsen kai thely epoiisen autous
verses.translation: And he answered and said unto them, Have ye not read, that he which made them at the beginning made them male and female,

verses.original: καὶ εἶπεν· ⸀Ἕνεκα τούτου καταλείψει ἄνθρωπος τὸν πατέρα καὶ τὴν μητέρα καὶ ⸀κολληθήσεται τῇ γυναικὶ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἔσονται οἱ δύο εἰς σάρκα μίαν;
verses.translit: kai eipen* Eneka toytoy kataleipsei anthropos ton patera kai ten mitera kai kollithisetai te gynaiki autou, kai esontai oi dyo eis sarka mian;
verses.translation: And said, For this cause shall a man leave father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife: and they twain shall be one flesh?

verses.original: ὥστε οὐκέτι εἰσὶν δύο ἀλλὰ σὰρξ μία. ὃ οὖν ὁ θεὸς συνέζευξεν ἄνθρωπος μὴ χωριζέτω.
verses.translit: oste ouketi eisin dyo alla sarx mia. o oun o theos synezeyxen anthropos me horizeto.
verses.translation: Wherefore they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.

verses.original: λέγουσιν αὐτῷ· Τί οὖν Μωϋσῆς ἐνετείλατο δοῦναι βιβλίον ἀποστασίου καὶ ἀπολῦσαι ⸀αὐτήν;
verses.translit: legoysin auto* Ti oun Moyses eneteilato dounai vivlion apostasioy kai apolusai autin;
verses.translation: They say unto him, Why did Moses then command to give a writing of divorcement, and to put her away?

verses.original: λέγει αὐτοῖς ὅτι Μωϋσῆς πρὸς τὴν σκληροκαρδίαν ὑμῶν ἐπέτρεψεν ὑμῖν ἀπολῦσαι τὰς γυναῖκας ὑμῶν, ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς δὲ οὐ γέγονεν οὕτως.
verses.translit: legei autois oti Moyses pros ten sklirokardian umon epetrepsen umin apolusai tas gynaikas umon, ap' arhes de ou gegonen outos.
verses.translation: He saith unto them, Moses because of the hardness of your hearts suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it was not so.

verses.original: λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν ⸀ὅτι ὃς ἂν ἀπολύσῃ τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ μὴ ἐπὶ πορνείᾳ καὶ γαμήσῃ ἄλλην μοιχᾶται ⸂καὶ ὁ ἀπολελυμένην γαμήσας μοιχᾶται⸃.
verses.translit: lego de umin oti os an apolyse ten gynaika autou me epi porneia kai gamise allin moihatai kai o apolelymenin gamisas moihatai.
verses.translation: And I say unto you, Whosoever shall put away his wife, except it be for fornication, and shall marry another, committeth adultery: and whoso marrieth her which is put away doth commit adultery.

verses.original: Λέγουσιν αὐτῷ οἱ ⸀μαθηταί· Εἰ οὕτως ἐστὶν ἡ αἰτία τοῦ ἀνθρώπου μετὰ τῆς γυναικός, οὐ συμφέρει γαμῆσαι.
verses.translit: Legoysin auto oi mathitai* Ei outos estin e aitia tou anthropoy meta tes gynaikos, ou symferei gamesai.
verses.translation: His disciples say unto him, If the case of the man be so with his wife, it is not good to marry.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Οὐ πάντες χωροῦσι τὸν λόγον ⸀τοῦτον ἀλλʼ οἷς δέδοται.
verses.translit: o de eipen autois* Ou pantes horousi ton logon touton all' ois dedotai.
verses.translation: But he said unto them, All men cannot receive this saying, save they to whom it is given.

verses.original: εἰσὶν γὰρ εὐνοῦχοι οἵτινες ἐκ κοιλίας μητρὸς ἐγεννήθησαν οὕτως, καὶ εἰσὶν εὐνοῦχοι οἵτινες εὐνουχίσθησαν ὑπὸ τῶν ἀνθρώπων, καὶ εἰσὶν εὐνοῦχοι οἵτινες εὐνούχισαν ἑαυτοὺς διὰ τὴν βασιλείαν τῶν οὐρανῶν. ὁ δυνάμενος χωρεῖν χωρείτω.
verses.translit: eisin gar eunouhoi oitines ek koilias mitros egennithisan outos, kai eisin eunouhoi oitines eunoyhisthisan upo ton anthropon, kai eisin eunouhoi oitines eunoyhisan eaytous dia ten vasileian ton ouranon. o dynamenos horein horeito.
verses.translation: For there are some eunuchs, which were so born from their mother’s womb: and there are some eunuchs, which were made eunuchs of men: and there be eunuchs, which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven’s sake. He that is able to receive it , let him receive it.

verses.original: Τότε ⸀προσηνέχθησαν αὐτῷ παιδία ἵνα τὰς χεῖρας ἐπιθῇ αὐτοῖς καὶ προσεύξηται· οἱ δὲ μαθηταὶ ἐπετίμησαν αὐτοῖς.
verses.translit: Tote prosinehthisan auto paidia ina tas heiras epithe autois kai proseyxitai* oi de mathitai epetimisan autois.
verses.translation: Then were there brought unto him little children, that he should put his hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν· Ἄφετε τὰ παιδία καὶ μὴ κωλύετε αὐτὰ ἐλθεῖν πρός με, τῶν γὰρ τοιούτων ἐστὶν ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν.
verses.translit: o de Iisous eipen* Afete ta paidia kai me kolyete auta elthein pros me, ton gar toioyton estin e vasileia ton ouranon.
verses.translation: But Jesus said, Suffer little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.

verses.original: καὶ ἐπιθεὶς ⸂τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοῖς⸃ ἐπορεύθη ἐκεῖθεν.
verses.translit: kai epitheis tas heiras autois eporeythi ekeithen.
verses.translation: And he laid his hands on them, and departed thence.

verses.original: Καὶ ἰδοὺ εἷς προσελθὼν ⸂αὐτῷ εἶπεν⸃· ⸀Διδάσκαλε, τί ἀγαθὸν ποιήσω ἵνα ⸀σχῶ ζωὴν αἰώνιον;
verses.translit: Kai idou eis proselthon auto eipen* Didaskale, ti agathon poiiso ina sho zoen aionion;
verses.translation: And, behold, one came and said unto him, Good Master, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?

verses.original: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Τί με ⸂ἐρωτᾷς περὶ τοῦ ἀγαθοῦ; εἷς ἐστιν ὁ ἀγαθός⸃· εἰ δὲ θέλεις ⸂εἰς τὴν ζωὴν εἰσελθεῖν⸃, ⸀τήρησον τὰς ἐντολάς.
verses.translit: o de eipen auto* Ti me erotas peri tou agathou; eis estin o agathos* ei de theleis eis ten zoen eiselthein, tirison tas entolas.
verses.translation: And he said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is , God: but if thou wilt enter into life, keep the commandments.

verses.original: λέγει αὐτῷ· Ποίας; ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς ⸀εἶπεν· Τὸ Οὐ φονεύσεις, Οὐ μοιχεύσεις, Οὐ κλέψεις, Οὐ ψευδομαρτυρήσεις,
verses.translit: legei auto* Poias; o de Iisous eipen* To Ou foneyseis, Ou moiheyseis, Ou klepseis, Ou pseydomartyriseis,
verses.translation: He saith unto him, Which? Jesus said, Thou shalt do no murder, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness,

verses.original: Τίμα τὸν πατέρα καὶ τὴν μητέρα, καὶ Ἀγαπήσεις τὸν πλησίον σου ὡς σεαυτόν.
verses.translit: Tima ton patera kai ten mitera, kai Agapiseis ton plision soy os seayton.
verses.translation: Honour thy father and thy mother: and, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

verses.original: λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ νεανίσκος· ⸂Πάντα ταῦτα⸃ ⸀ἐφύλαξα· τί ἔτι ὑστερῶ;
verses.translit: legei auto o neaniskos* Panta tauta efylaxa* ti eti ustero;
verses.translation: The young man saith unto him, All these things have I kept from my youth up: what lack I yet?

verses.original: ἔφη αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Εἰ θέλεις τέλειος εἶναι, ὕπαγε πώλησόν σου τὰ ὑπάρχοντα καὶ ⸀δὸς πτωχοῖς, καὶ ἕξεις θησαυρὸν ἐν ⸀οὐρανοῖς, καὶ δεῦρο ἀκολούθει μοι.
verses.translit: efi auto o Iisous* Ei theleis teleios einai, upage polison soy ta uparhonta kai dos ptohois, kai exeis thisayron en ouranois, kai deuro akoloythei moi.
verses.translation: Jesus said unto him, If thou wilt be perfect, go and sell that thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come and follow me.

verses.original: ἀκούσας δὲ ὁ νεανίσκος τὸν ⸀λόγον ἀπῆλθεν λυπούμενος, ἦν γὰρ ἔχων κτήματα πολλά.
verses.translit: akoysas de o neaniskos ton logon apelthen lypoymenos, en gar ehon ktimata polla.
verses.translation: But when the young man heard that saying, he went away sorrowful: for he had great possessions.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ· Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ⸂πλούσιος δυσκόλως⸃ εἰσελεύσεται εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τῶν οὐρανῶν·
verses.translit: O de Iisous eipen tois mathitais autou* Amen lego umin oti ploysios dyskolos eiseleysetai eis ten vasileian ton ouranon*
verses.translation: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, Verily I say unto you, That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven.

verses.original: πάλιν δὲ λέγω ὑμῖν, εὐκοπώτερόν ἐστιν κάμηλον διὰ ⸀τρυπήματος ῥαφίδος ⸀εἰσελθεῖν ἢ πλούσιον ⸂εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ⸃.
verses.translit: palin de lego umin, eukopoteron estin kamilon dia trypimatos Rafidos eiselthein e ploysion eis ten vasileian tou theou.
verses.translation: And again I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

verses.original: ἀκούσαντες δὲ οἱ ⸀μαθηταὶ ἐξεπλήσσοντο σφόδρα λέγοντες· Τίς ἄρα δύναται σωθῆναι;
verses.translit: akoysantes de oi mathitai exeplissonto sfodra legontes* Tis ara dynatai sothenai;
verses.translation: When his disciples heard it , they were exceedingly amazed, saying, Who then can be saved?

verses.original: ἐμβλέψας δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Παρὰ ἀνθρώποις τοῦτο ἀδύνατόν ἐστιν, παρὰ δὲ θεῷ πάντα δυνατά.
verses.translit: emvlepsas de o Iisous eipen autois* Para anthropois touto adynaton estin, para de theo panta dynata.
verses.translation: But Jesus beheld them , and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.

verses.original: Τότε ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Πέτρος εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Ἰδοὺ ἡμεῖς ἀφήκαμεν πάντα καὶ ἠκολουθήσαμέν σοι· τί ἄρα ἔσται ἡμῖν;
verses.translit: Tote apokritheis o Petros eipen auto* Idou emeis afikamen panta kai ekoloythisamen soi* ti ara estai emin;
verses.translation: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Behold, we have forsaken all, and followed thee; what shall we have therefore?

verses.original: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ὑμεῖς οἱ ἀκολουθήσαντές μοι ἐν τῇ παλιγγενεσίᾳ, ὅταν καθίσῃ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐπὶ θρόνου δόξης αὐτοῦ, ⸀καθήσεσθε καὶ ⸀ὑμεῖς ἐπὶ δώδεκα θρόνους κρίνοντες τὰς δώδεκα φυλὰς τοῦ Ἰσραήλ.
verses.translit: o de Iisous eipen autois* Amen lego umin oti umeis oi akoloythisantes moi en te paliggenesia, otan kathise o yios tou anthropoy epi thronoy doxis autou, kathisesthe kai umeis epi dodeka thronoys krinontes tas dodeka fylas tou Israil.
verses.translation: And Jesus said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

verses.original: καὶ πᾶς ⸀ὅστις ἀφῆκεν ⸂οἰκίας ἢ⸃ ἀδελφοὺς ἢ ἀδελφὰς ἢ πατέρα ἢ μητέρα ἢ ⸂γυναῖκα ἢ⸃ τέκνα ἢ ⸀ἀγροὺς ἕνεκεν τοῦ ⸂ὀνόματός μου⸃, ⸀ἑκατονταπλασίονα λήμψεται καὶ ζωὴν αἰώνιον κληρονομήσει.
verses.translit: kai pas ostis afeken oikias e adelfous e adelfas e patera e mitera e gynaika e tekna e agrous eneken tou onomatos moy, ekatontaplasiona limpsetai kai zoen aionion klironomisei.
verses.translation: And every one that hath forsaken houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name’s sake, shall receive an hundredfold, and shall inherit everlasting life.

verses.original: πολλοὶ δὲ ἔσονται πρῶτοι ἔσχατοι καὶ ἔσχατοι πρῶτοι.
verses.translit: polloi de esontai protoi eshatoi kai eshatoi protoi.
verses.translation: But many that are first shall be last; and the last shall be first.

verses.original: Ὁμοία γάρ ἐστιν ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν ἀνθρώπῳ οἰκοδεσπότῃ ὅστις ἐξῆλθεν ἅμα πρωῒ μισθώσασθαι ἐργάτας εἰς τὸν ἀμπελῶνα αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: Omoia gar estin e vasileia ton ouranon anthropo oikodespote ostis exelthen ama proi misthosasthai ergatas eis ton ampelona autou.
verses.translation: For the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard.

verses.original: ⸂συμφωνήσας δὲ⸃ μετὰ τῶν ἐργατῶν ἐκ δηναρίου τὴν ἡμέραν ἀπέστειλεν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸν ἀμπελῶνα αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: symfonisas de meta ton ergaton ek dinarioy ten emeran apesteilen autous eis ton ampelona autou.
verses.translation: And when he had agreed with the labourers for a penny a day, he sent them into his vineyard.

verses.original: καὶ ἐξελθὼν περὶ τρίτην ὥραν εἶδεν ἄλλους ἑστῶτας ἐν τῇ ἀγορᾷ ἀργούς·
verses.translit: kai exelthon peri tritin oran eiden alloys estotas en te agora argoys*
verses.translation: And he went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace,

verses.original: καὶ ἐκείνοις εἶπεν· Ὑπάγετε καὶ ὑμεῖς εἰς τὸν ἀμπελῶνα, καὶ ὃ ἐὰν ᾖ δίκαιον δώσω ὑμῖν·
verses.translit: kai ekeinois eipen* Upagete kai umeis eis ton ampelona, kai o ean e dikaion doso umin*
verses.translation: And said unto them; Go ye also into the vineyard, and whatsoever is right I will give you. And they went their way.

verses.original: οἱ δὲ ἀπῆλθον. ⸀πάλιν ἐξελθὼν περὶ ἕκτην καὶ ἐνάτην ὥραν ἐποίησεν ὡσαύτως.
verses.translit: oi de apelthon. palin exelthon peri ektin kai enatin oran epoiisen osaytos.
verses.translation: Again he went out about the sixth and ninth hour, and did likewise.

verses.original: περὶ δὲ τὴν ⸀ἑνδεκάτην ἐξελθὼν εὗρεν ἄλλους ⸀ἑστῶτας, καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς· Τί ὧδε ἑστήκατε ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν ἀργοί;
verses.translit: peri de ten endekatin exelthon euren alloys estotas, kai legei autois* Ti ode estikate olin ten emeran argoi;
verses.translation: And about the eleventh hour he went out, and found others standing idle, and saith unto them, Why stand ye here all the day idle?

verses.original: λέγουσιν αὐτῷ· Ὅτι οὐδεὶς ἡμᾶς ἐμισθώσατο. λέγει αὐτοῖς· Ὑπάγετε καὶ ὑμεῖς εἰς τὸν ⸀ἀμπελῶνα.
verses.translit: legoysin auto* Oti oudeis emas emisthosato. legei autois* Upagete kai umeis eis ton ampelona.
verses.translation: They say unto him, Because no man hath hired us. He saith unto them, Go ye also into the vineyard; and whatsoever is right, that shall ye receive.

verses.original: ὀψίας δὲ γενομένης λέγει ὁ κύριος τοῦ ἀμπελῶνος τῷ ἐπιτρόπῳ αὐτοῦ· Κάλεσον τοὺς ἐργάτας καὶ ἀπόδος ⸀αὐτοῖς τὸν μισθὸν ἀρξάμενος ἀπὸ τῶν ἐσχάτων ἕως τῶν πρώτων.
verses.translit: opsias de genomenis legei o kyrios tou ampelonos to epitropo autou* Kaleson tous ergatas kai apodos autois ton misthon arxamenos apo ton eshaton eos ton proton.
verses.translation: So when even was come, the lord of the vineyard saith unto his steward, Call the labourers, and give them their hire, beginning from the last unto the first.

verses.original: ⸂καὶ ἐλθόντες⸃ οἱ περὶ τὴν ἑνδεκάτην ὥραν ἔλαβον ἀνὰ δηνάριον.
verses.translit: kai elthontes oi peri ten endekatin oran elavon ana dinarion.
verses.translation: And when they came that were hired about the eleventh hour, they received every man a penny.

verses.original: ⸂καὶ ἐλθόντες⸃ οἱ πρῶτοι ἐνόμισαν ὅτι ⸀πλεῖον λήμψονται· καὶ ἔλαβον ⸂τὸ ἀνὰ δηνάριον καὶ αὐτοί⸃.
verses.translit: kai elthontes oi protoi enomisan oti pleion limpsontai* kai elavon to ana dinarion kai autoi.
verses.translation: But when the first came, they supposed that they should have received more; and they likewise received every man a penny.

verses.original: λαβόντες δὲ ἐγόγγυζον κατὰ τοῦ οἰκοδεσπότου
verses.translit: lavontes de egoggyzon kata tou oikodespotoy
verses.translation: And when they had received it , they murmured against the goodman of the house,

verses.original: ⸀λέγοντες· Οὗτοι οἱ ἔσχατοι μίαν ὥραν ἐποίησαν, καὶ ἴσους ⸂αὐτοὺς ἡμῖν⸃ ἐποίησας τοῖς βαστάσασι τὸ βάρος τῆς ἡμέρας καὶ τὸν καύσωνα.
verses.translit: legontes* Outoi oi eshatoi mian oran epoiisan, kai isoys autous emin epoiisas tois vastasasi to varos tes emeras kai ton kaysona.
verses.translation: Saying, These last have wrought but one hour, and thou hast made them equal unto us, which have borne the burden and heat of the day.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς ⸂ἑνὶ αὐτῶν εἶπεν⸃· Ἑταῖρε, οὐκ ἀδικῶ σε· οὐχὶ δηναρίου συνεφώνησάς μοι;
verses.translit: o de apokritheis eni auton eipen* Etaire, ouk adiko se* ouhi dinarioy synefonisas moi;
verses.translation: But he answered one of them, and said, Friend, I do thee no wrong: didst not thou agree with me for a penny?

verses.original: ἆρον τὸ σὸν καὶ ὕπαγε· θέλω δὲ τούτῳ τῷ ἐσχάτῳ δοῦναι ὡς καὶ σοί·
verses.translit: aron to son kai upage* thelo de toyto to eshato dounai os kai soi*
verses.translation: Take that thine is , and go thy way: I will give unto this last, even as unto thee.

verses.original: ⸀οὐκ ἔξεστίν μοι ⸂ὃ θέλω ποιῆσαι⸃ ἐν τοῖς ἐμοῖς; ⸀ἢ ὁ ὀφθαλμός σου πονηρός ἐστιν ὅτι ἐγὼ ἀγαθός εἰμι;
verses.translit: ouk exestin moi o thelo poiesai en tois emois; e o ofthalmos soy poniros estin oti ego agathos eimi;
verses.translation: Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own? Is thine eye evil, because I am good?

verses.original: οὕτως ἔσονται οἱ ἔσχατοι πρῶτοι καὶ οἱ πρῶτοι ⸀ἔσχατοι.
verses.translit: outos esontai oi eshatoi protoi kai oi protoi eshatoi.
verses.translation: So the last shall be first, and the first last: for many be called, but few chosen.

verses.original: ⸂Καὶ ἀναβαίνων ὁ⸃ Ἰησοῦς εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα παρέλαβεν τοὺς δώδεκα ⸀μαθητὰς κατʼ ἰδίαν, ⸂καὶ ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ⸃ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς·
verses.translit: Kai anavainon o Iisous eis Ierosolyma parelaven tous dodeka mathitas kat' idian, kai en te odo eipen autois*
verses.translation: And Jesus going up to Jerusalem took the twelve disciples apart in the way, and said unto them,

verses.original: Ἰδοὺ ἀναβαίνομεν εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα, καὶ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου παραδοθήσεται τοῖς ἀρχιερεῦσιν καὶ γραμματεῦσιν, καὶ κατακρινοῦσιν αὐτὸν θανάτῳ,
verses.translit: Idou anavainomen eis Ierosolyma, kai o yios tou anthropoy paradothisetai tois arhiereusin kai grammateusin, kai katakrinousin auton thanato,
verses.translation: Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be betrayed unto the chief priests and unto the scribes, and they shall condemn him to death,

verses.original: καὶ παραδώσουσιν αὐτὸν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν εἰς τὸ ἐμπαῖξαι καὶ μαστιγῶσαι καὶ σταυρῶσαι, καὶ τῇ τρίτῃ ἡμέρᾳ ⸀ἐγερθήσεται.
verses.translit: kai paradosoysin auton tois ethnesin eis to empaixai kai mastigosai kai stayrosai, kai te trite emera egerthisetai.
verses.translation: And shall deliver him to the Gentiles to mock, and to scourge, and to crucify him : and the third day he shall rise again.

verses.original: Τότε προσῆλθεν αὐτῷ ἡ μήτηρ τῶν υἱῶν Ζεβεδαίου μετὰ τῶν υἱῶν αὐτῆς προσκυνοῦσα καὶ αἰτοῦσά τι ⸀παρʼ αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: Tote proselthen auto e mitir ton yion Zevedaioy meta ton yion autes proskynousa kai aitousa ti par' autou.
verses.translation: Then came to him the mother of Zebedee’s children with her sons, worshipping him , and desiring a certain thing of him.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτῇ· Τί θέλεις; λέγει αὐτῷ· Εἰπὲ ἵνα καθίσωσιν οὗτοι οἱ δύο υἱοί μου εἷς ἐκ δεξιῶν ⸀σου καὶ εἷς ἐξ εὐωνύμων σου ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ σου.
verses.translit: o de eipen aute* Ti theleis; legei auto* Eipe ina kathisosin outoi oi dyo yioi moy eis ek dexion soy kai eis ex euonymon soy en te vasileia soy.
verses.translation: And he said unto her, What wilt thou? She saith unto him, Grant that these my two sons may sit, the one on thy right hand, and the other on the left, in thy kingdom.

verses.original: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν· Οὐκ οἴδατε τί αἰτεῖσθε· δύνασθε πιεῖν τὸ ποτήριον ὃ ἐγὼ μέλλω ⸀πίνειν; λέγουσιν αὐτῷ· Δυνάμεθα.
verses.translit: apokritheis de o Iisous eipen* Ouk oidate ti aiteisthe* dynasthe piein to potirion o ego mello pinein; legoysin auto* Dynametha.
verses.translation: But Jesus answered and said, Ye know not what ye ask. Are ye able to drink of the cup that I shall drink of, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with? They say unto him, We are able.

verses.original: ⸀λέγει αὐτοῖς· Τὸ μὲν ποτήριόν μου ⸀πίεσθε, τὸ δὲ καθίσαι ἐκ δεξιῶν μου καὶ ἐξ ⸀εὐωνύμων οὐκ ἔστιν ⸀ἐμὸν δοῦναι, ἀλλʼ οἷς ἡτοίμασται ὑπὸ τοῦ πατρός μου.
verses.translit: legei autois* To men potirion moy piesthe, to de kathisai ek dexion moy kai ex euonymon ouk estin emon dounai, all' ois etoimastai upo tou patros moy.
verses.translation: And he saith unto them, Ye shall drink indeed of my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with: but to sit on my right hand, and on my left, is not mine to give, but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared of my Father.

verses.original: Καὶ ἀκούσαντες οἱ δέκα ἠγανάκτησαν περὶ τῶν δύο ἀδελφῶν.
verses.translit: Kai akoysantes oi deka eganaktisan peri ton dyo adelfon.
verses.translation: And when the ten heard it , they were moved with indignation against the two brethren.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς προσκαλεσάμενος αὐτοὺς εἶπεν· Οἴδατε ὅτι οἱ ἄρχοντες τῶν ἐθνῶν κατακυριεύουσιν αὐτῶν καὶ οἱ μεγάλοι κατεξουσιάζουσιν αὐτῶν.
verses.translit: o de Iisous proskalesamenos autous eipen* Oidate oti oi arhontes ton ethnon katakyrieyoysin auton kai oi megaloi katexoysiazoysin auton.
verses.translation: But Jesus called them unto him , and said, Ye know that the princes of the Gentiles exercise dominion over them, and they that are great exercise authority upon them.

verses.original: οὐχ οὕτως ⸀ἔσται ἐν ὑμῖν· ἀλλʼ ὃς ⸀ἂν θέλῃ ἐν ὑμῖν μέγας γενέσθαι ἔσται ὑμῶν διάκονος,
verses.translit: ouh outos estai en umin* all' os an thele en umin megas genesthai estai umon diakonos,
verses.translation: But it shall not be so among you: but whosoever will be great among you, let him be your minister;

verses.original: καὶ ὃς ⸀ἂν θέλῃ ἐν ὑμῖν εἶναι πρῶτος ⸀ἔσται ὑμῶν δοῦλος·
verses.translit: kai os an thele en umin einai protos estai umon doulos*
verses.translation: And whosoever will be chief among you, let him be your servant:

verses.original: ὥσπερ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου οὐκ ἦλθεν διακονηθῆναι ἀλλὰ διακονῆσαι καὶ δοῦναι τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ λύτρον ἀντὶ πολλῶν.
verses.translit: osper o yios tou anthropoy ouk elthen diakonithenai alla diakonesai kai dounai ten psyhen autou lytron anti pollon.
verses.translation: Even as the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐκπορευομένων αὐτῶν ἀπὸ Ἰεριχὼ ἠκολούθησεν αὐτῷ ὄχλος πολύς.
verses.translit: Kai ekporeyomenon auton apo Ieriho ekoloythisen auto ohlos polys.
verses.translation: And as they departed from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.

verses.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ δύο τυφλοὶ καθήμενοι παρὰ τὴν ὁδόν, ἀκούσαντες ὅτι Ἰησοῦς παράγει, ἔκραξαν λέγοντες· ⸂Κύριε, ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς⸃, ⸀υἱὸς Δαυίδ.
verses.translit: kai idou dyo tyfloi kathimenoi para ten odon, akoysantes oti Iisous paragei, ekraxan legontes* Kyrie, eleison emas, yios Dayid.
verses.translation: And, behold, two blind men sitting by the way side, when they heard that Jesus passed by, cried out, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou Son of David.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ ὄχλος ἐπετίμησεν αὐτοῖς ἵνα σιωπήσωσιν· οἱ δὲ μεῖζον ⸀ἔκραξαν λέγοντες· ⸂Κύριε, ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς⸃, ⸀υἱὸς Δαυίδ.
verses.translit: o de ohlos epetimisen autois ina siopisosin* oi de meizon ekraxan legontes* Kyrie, eleison emas, yios Dayid.
verses.translation: And the multitude rebuked them, because they should hold their peace: but they cried the more, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou Son of David.

verses.original: καὶ στὰς ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐφώνησεν αὐτοὺς καὶ εἶπεν· Τί θέλετε ποιήσω ὑμῖν;
verses.translit: kai stas o Iisous efonisen autous kai eipen* Ti thelete poiiso umin;
verses.translation: And Jesus stood still, and called them, and said, What will ye that I shall do unto you?

verses.original: λέγουσιν αὐτῷ· Κύριε, ἵνα ⸂ἀνοιγῶσιν οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ ἡμῶν⸃.
verses.translit: legoysin auto* Kyrie, ina anoigosin oi ofthalmoi emon.
verses.translation: They say unto him, Lord, that our eyes may be opened.

verses.original: σπλαγχνισθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἥψατο τῶν ⸀ὀμμάτων αὐτῶν, καὶ εὐθέως ⸀ἀνέβλεψαν καὶ ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ.
verses.translit: splaghnistheis de o Iisous epsato ton ommaton auton, kai eutheos anevlepsan kai ekoloythisan auto.
verses.translation: So Jesus had compassion on them , and touched their eyes: and immediately their eyes received sight, and they followed him.

verses.original: Καὶ ὅτε ἤγγισαν εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα καὶ ἦλθον εἰς Βηθφαγὴ ⸀εἰς τὸ Ὄρος τῶν Ἐλαιῶν, τότε ⸀Ἰησοῦς ἀπέστειλεν δύο μαθητὰς
verses.translit: Kai ote eggisan eis Ierosolyma kai elthon eis Vithfage eis to Oros ton Elaion, tote Iisous apesteilen dyo mathitas
verses.translation: And when they drew nigh unto Jerusalem, and were come to Bethphage, unto the mount of Olives, then sent Jesus two disciples,

verses.original: λέγων αὐτοῖς· ⸀Πορεύεσθε εἰς τὴν κώμην τὴν ⸀κατέναντι ὑμῶν, καὶ ⸀εὐθέως εὑρήσετε ὄνον δεδεμένην καὶ πῶλον μετʼ αὐτῆς· λύσαντες ⸀ἀγάγετέ μοι.
verses.translit: legon autois* Poreyesthe eis ten komin ten katenanti umon, kai eutheos eurisete onon dedemenin kai polon met' autes* lysantes agagete moi.
verses.translation: Saying unto them, Go into the village over against you, and straightway ye shall find an ass tied, and a colt with her: loose them , and bring them unto me.

verses.original: καὶ ἐάν τις ὑμῖν εἴπῃ τι, ἐρεῖτε ὅτι Ὁ κύριος αὐτῶν χρείαν ἔχει· ⸀εὐθὺς δὲ ⸀ἀποστελεῖ αὐτούς.
verses.translit: kai ean tis umin eipe ti, ereite oti O kyrios auton hreian ehei* euthus de apostelei autoys.
verses.translation: And if any man say ought unto you, ye shall say, The Lord hath need of them; and straightway he will send them.

verses.original: Τοῦτο ⸀δὲ γέγονεν ἵνα πληρωθῇ τὸ ῥηθὲν διὰ τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος·
verses.translit: Touto de gegonen ina plirothe to Rithen dia tou profitoy legontos*
verses.translation: All this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying,

verses.original: Εἴπατε τῇ θυγατρὶ Σιών· Ἰδοὺ ὁ βασιλεύς σου ἔρχεταί σοι πραῢς καὶ ἐπιβεβηκὼς ἐπὶ ὄνον καὶ ⸀ἐπὶ πῶλον υἱὸν ὑποζυγίου.
verses.translit: Eipate te thygatri Sion* Idou o vasileys soy erhetai soi praus kai epivevikos epi onon kai epi polon yion upozygioy.
verses.translation: Tell ye the daughter of Sion, Behold, thy King cometh unto thee, meek, and sitting upon an ass, and a colt the foal of an ass.

verses.original: πορευθέντες δὲ οἱ μαθηταὶ καὶ ποιήσαντες καθὼς ⸀συνέταξεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς
verses.translit: poreythentes de oi mathitai kai poiisantes kathos synetaxen autois o Iisous
verses.translation: And the disciples went, and did as Jesus commanded them,

verses.original: ἤγαγον τὴν ὄνον καὶ τὸν πῶλον, καὶ ἐπέθηκαν ⸀ἐπʼ αὐτῶν τὰ ⸀ἱμάτια, καὶ ἐπεκάθισεν ἐπάνω αὐτῶν.
verses.translit: egagon ten onon kai ton polon, kai epethikan ep' auton ta imatia, kai epekathisen epano auton.
verses.translation: And brought the ass, and the colt, and put on them their clothes, and they set him thereon.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ πλεῖστος ὄχλος ἔστρωσαν ἑαυτῶν τὰ ἱμάτια ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ, ἄλλοι δὲ ἔκοπτον κλάδους ἀπὸ τῶν δένδρων καὶ ἐστρώννυον ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ.
verses.translit: o de pleistos ohlos estrosan eayton ta imatia en te odo, alloi de ekopton kladoys apo ton dendron kai estronnyon en te odo.
verses.translation: And a very great multitude spread their garments in the way; others cut down branches from the trees, and strawed them in the way.

verses.original: οἱ δὲ ὄχλοι οἱ προάγοντες ⸀αὐτὸν καὶ οἱ ἀκολουθοῦντες ἔκραζον λέγοντες· Ὡσαννὰ τῷ υἱῷ Δαυίδ· Εὐλογημένος ὁ ἐρχόμενος ἐν ὀνόματι κυρίου· Ὡσαννὰ ἐν τοῖς ὑψίστοις.
verses.translit: oi de ohloi oi proagontes auton kai oi akoloythountes ekrazon legontes* Osanna to yio Dayid* Eulogimenos o erhomenos en onomati kyrioy* Osanna en tois upsistois.
verses.translation: And the multitudes that went before, and that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna to the Son of David: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord; Hosanna in the highest.

verses.original: καὶ εἰσελθόντος αὐτοῦ εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα ἐσείσθη πᾶσα ἡ πόλις λέγουσα· Τίς ἐστιν οὗτος;
verses.translit: kai eiselthontos autou eis Ierosolyma eseisthi pasa e polis legoysa* Tis estin outos;
verses.translation: And when he was come into Jerusalem, all the city was moved, saying, Who is this?

verses.original: οἱ δὲ ὄχλοι ἔλεγον· Οὗτός ἐστιν ⸂ὁ προφήτης Ἰησοῦς⸃ ὁ ἀπὸ Ναζαρὲθ τῆς Γαλιλαίας.
verses.translit: oi de ohloi elegon* Outos estin o profitis Iisous o apo Nazareth tes Galilaias.
verses.translation: And the multitude said, This is Jesus the prophet of Nazareth of Galilee.

verses.original: Καὶ εἰσῆλθεν ⸀Ἰησοῦς εἰς τὸ ⸀ἱερόν, καὶ ἐξέβαλεν πάντας τοὺς πωλοῦντας καὶ ἀγοράζοντας ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ καὶ τὰς τραπέζας τῶν κολλυβιστῶν κατέστρεψεν καὶ τὰς καθέδρας τῶν πωλούντων τὰς περιστεράς,
verses.translit: Kai eiselthen Iisous eis to ieron, kai exevalen pantas tous polountas kai agorazontas en to iero kai tas trapezas ton kollyviston katestrepsen kai tas kathedras ton poloynton tas peristeras,
verses.translation: And Jesus went into the temple of God, and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves,

verses.original: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς· Γέγραπται· Ὁ οἶκός μου οἶκος προσευχῆς κληθήσεται, ὑμεῖς δὲ αὐτὸν ⸀ποιεῖτε σπήλαιον λῃστῶν.
verses.translit: kai legei autois* Gegraptai* O oikos moy oikos proseyhes klithisetai, umeis de auton poieite spilaion leston.
verses.translation: And said unto them, It is written, My house shall be called the house of prayer; but ye have made it a den of thieves.

verses.original: Καὶ προσῆλθον αὐτῷ ⸂τυφλοὶ καὶ χωλοὶ⸃ ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ, καὶ ἐθεράπευσεν αὐτούς.
verses.translit: Kai proselthon auto tyfloi kai holoi en to iero, kai etherapeysen autoys.
verses.translation: And the blind and the lame came to him in the temple; and he healed them.

verses.original: ἰδόντες δὲ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς τὰ θαυμάσια ἃ ἐποίησεν καὶ τοὺς παῖδας ⸀τοὺς κράζοντας ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ καὶ λέγοντας· Ὡσαννὰ τῷ υἱῷ Δαυίδ, ἠγανάκτησαν
verses.translit: idontes de oi arhiereis kai oi grammateis ta thaymasia a epoiisen kai tous paidas tous krazontas en to iero kai legontas* Osanna to yio Dayid, eganaktisan
verses.translation: And when the chief priests and scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children crying in the temple, and saying, Hosanna to the Son of David; they were sore displeased,

verses.original: καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ· Ἀκούεις τί οὗτοι λέγουσιν; ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς λέγει αὐτοῖς· Ναί. οὐδέποτε ἀνέγνωτε ὅτι Ἐκ στόματος νηπίων καὶ θηλαζόντων κατηρτίσω αἶνον;
verses.translit: kai eipan auto* Akoyeis ti outoi legoysin; o de Iisous legei autois* Nai. oudepote anegnote oti Ek stomatos nipion kai thilazonton katirtiso ainon;
verses.translation: And said unto him, Hearest thou what these say? And Jesus saith unto them, Yea; have ye never read, Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings thou hast perfected praise?

verses.original: καὶ καταλιπὼν αὐτοὺς ἐξῆλθεν ἔξω τῆς πόλεως εἰς Βηθανίαν, καὶ ηὐλίσθη ἐκεῖ.
verses.translit: kai katalipon autous exelthen exo tes poleos eis Vithanian, kai iulisthi ekei.
verses.translation: And he left them, and went out of the city into Bethany; and he lodged there.

verses.original: ⸀Πρωῒ δὲ ⸀ἐπανάγων εἰς τὴν πόλιν ἐπείνασεν.
verses.translit: Proi de epanagon eis ten polin epeinasen.
verses.translation: Now in the morning as he returned into the city, he hungered.

verses.original: καὶ ἰδὼν συκῆν μίαν ἐπὶ τῆς ὁδοῦ ἦλθεν ἐπʼ αὐτήν, καὶ οὐδὲν εὗρεν ἐν αὐτῇ εἰ μὴ φύλλα μόνον, καὶ λέγει αὐτῇ· ⸀Μηκέτι ἐκ σοῦ καρπὸς γένηται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα· καὶ ἐξηράνθη παραχρῆμα ἡ συκῆ.
verses.translit: kai idon syken mian epi tes odou elthen ep' autin, kai ouden euren en aute ei me fylla monon, kai legei aute* Miketi ek sou karpos genitai eis ton aiona* kai exiranthi parahrema e syke.
verses.translation: And when he saw a fig tree in the way, he came to it, and found nothing thereon, but leaves only, and said unto it, Let no fruit grow on thee henceforward for ever. And presently the fig tree withered away.

verses.original: καὶ ἰδόντες οἱ μαθηταὶ ἐθαύμασαν λέγοντες· Πῶς παραχρῆμα ἐξηράνθη ἡ συκῆ;
verses.translit: kai idontes oi mathitai ethaymasan legontes* Pos parahrema exiranthi e syke;
verses.translation: And when the disciples saw it , they marvelled, saying, How soon is the fig tree withered away!

verses.original: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἐὰν ἔχητε πίστιν καὶ μὴ διακριθῆτε, οὐ μόνον τὸ τῆς συκῆς ποιήσετε, ἀλλὰ κἂν τῷ ὄρει τούτῳ εἴπητε· Ἄρθητι καὶ βλήθητι εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν, γενήσεται·
verses.translit: apokritheis de o Iisous eipen autois* Amen lego umin, ean ehite pistin kai me diakrithete, ou monon to tes sykes poiisete, alla kan to orei toyto eipite* Arthiti kai vlithiti eis ten thalassan, genisetai*
verses.translation: Jesus answered and said unto them, Verily I say unto you, If ye have faith, and doubt not, ye shall not only do this which is done to the fig tree, but also if ye shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; it shall be done.

verses.original: καὶ πάντα ὅσα ⸀ἂν αἰτήσητε ἐν τῇ προσευχῇ πιστεύοντες λήμψεσθε.
verses.translit: kai panta osa an aitisite en te proseyhe pisteyontes limpsesthe.
verses.translation: And all things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.

verses.original: Καὶ ⸂ἐλθόντος αὐτοῦ⸃ εἰς τὸ ἱερὸν προσῆλθον αὐτῷ διδάσκοντι οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι τοῦ λαοῦ λέγοντες· Ἐν ποίᾳ ἐξουσίᾳ ταῦτα ποιεῖς; καὶ τίς σοι ἔδωκεν τὴν ἐξουσίαν ταύτην;
verses.translit: Kai elthontos autou eis to ieron proselthon auto didaskonti oi arhiereis kai oi presvyteroi tou laou legontes* En poia exoysia tauta poieis; kai tis soi edoken ten exoysian taytin;
verses.translation: And when he was come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came unto him as he was teaching, and said, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority?

verses.original: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Ἐρωτήσω ὑμᾶς κἀγὼ λόγον ἕνα, ὃν ἐὰν εἴπητέ μοι κἀγὼ ὑμῖν ἐρῶ ἐν ποίᾳ ἐξουσίᾳ ταῦτα ποιῶ·
verses.translit: apokritheis de o Iisous eipen autois* Erotiso umas kago logon ena, on ean eipite moi kago umin ero en poia exoysia tauta poio*
verses.translation: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I also will ask you one thing, which if ye tell me, I in like wise will tell you by what authority I do these things.

verses.original: τὸ βάπτισμα ⸀τὸ Ἰωάννου πόθεν ἦν; ἐξ οὐρανοῦ ἢ ἐξ ἀνθρώπων; οἱ δὲ διελογίζοντο ⸀ἐν ἑαυτοῖς λέγοντες· Ἐὰν εἴπωμεν· Ἐξ οὐρανοῦ, ἐρεῖ ἡμῖν· Διὰ τί οὖν οὐκ ἐπιστεύσατε αὐτῷ;
verses.translit: to vaptisma to Ioannoy pothen en; ex ouranou e ex anthropon; oi de dielogizonto en eaytois legontes* Ean eipomen* Ex ouranou, erei emin* Dia ti oun ouk episteysate auto;
verses.translation: The baptism of John, whence was it? from heaven, or of men? And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say unto us, Why did ye not then believe him?

verses.original: ἐὰν δὲ εἴπωμεν· Ἐξ ἀνθρώπων, φοβούμεθα τὸν ὄχλον, πάντες γὰρ ⸂ὡς προφήτην ἔχουσιν τὸν Ἰωάννην⸃.
verses.translit: ean de eipomen* Ex anthropon, fovoymetha ton ohlon, pantes gar os profitin ehoysin ton Ioannin.
verses.translation: But if we shall say, Of men; we fear the people; for all hold John as a prophet.

verses.original: καὶ ἀποκριθέντες τῷ Ἰησοῦ εἶπαν· Οὐκ οἴδαμεν. ἔφη αὐτοῖς καὶ αὐτός· Οὐδὲ ἐγὼ λέγω ὑμῖν ἐν ποίᾳ ἐξουσίᾳ ταῦτα ποιῶ.
verses.translit: kai apokrithentes to Iisou eipan* Ouk oidamen. efi autois kai autos* Oude ego lego umin en poia exoysia tauta poio.
verses.translation: And they answered Jesus, and said, We cannot tell. And he said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.

verses.original: Τί δὲ ὑμῖν δοκεῖ; ἄνθρωπος εἶχεν τέκνα δύο. ⸀προσελθὼν τῷ πρώτῳ εἶπεν· Τέκνον, ὕπαγε σήμερον ἐργάζου ἐν τῷ ⸀ἀμπελῶνι.
verses.translit: Ti de umin dokei; anthropos eihen tekna dyo. proselthon to proto eipen* Teknon, upage simeron ergazoy en to ampeloni.
verses.translation: But what think ye? A certain man had two sons; and he came to the first, and said, Son, go work to day in my vineyard.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν· ⸂Οὐ θέλω· ὕστερον δὲ μεταμεληθεὶς⸃ ἀπῆλθεν.
verses.translit: o de apokritheis eipen* Ou thelo* usteron de metamelitheis apelthen.
verses.translation: He answered and said, I will not: but afterward he repented, and went.

verses.original: ⸂προσελθὼν δὲ⸃ τῷ ⸀δευτέρῳ εἶπεν ὡσαύτως· ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν· ⸂Ἐγώ, κύριε· καὶ οὐκ⸃ ἀπῆλθεν.
verses.translit: proselthon de to deytero eipen osaytos* o de apokritheis eipen* Ego, kyrie* kai ouk apelthen.
verses.translation: And he came to the second, and said likewise. And he answered and said, I go , sir: and went not.

verses.original: τίς ἐκ τῶν δύο ἐποίησεν τὸ θέλημα τοῦ πατρός; ⸀λέγουσιν· Ὁ ⸀πρῶτος. λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι οἱ τελῶναι καὶ αἱ πόρναι προάγουσιν ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ.
verses.translit: tis ek ton dyo epoiisen to thelima tou patros; legoysin* O protos. legei autois o Iisous* Amen lego umin oti oi telonai kai ai pornai proagoysin umas eis ten vasileian tou theou.
verses.translation: Whether of them twain did the will of his father? They say unto him, The first. Jesus saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you.

verses.original: ἦλθεν γὰρ ⸂Ἰωάννης πρὸς ὑμᾶς⸃ ἐν ὁδῷ δικαιοσύνης, καὶ οὐκ ἐπιστεύσατε αὐτῷ· οἱ δὲ τελῶναι καὶ αἱ πόρναι ἐπίστευσαν αὐτῷ· ὑμεῖς δὲ ἰδόντες ⸀οὐδὲ μετεμελήθητε ὕστερον τοῦ πιστεῦσαι αὐτῷ.
verses.translit: elthen gar Ioannis pros umas en odo dikaiosynis, kai ouk episteysate auto* oi de telonai kai ai pornai episteysan auto* umeis de idontes oude metemelithite usteron tou pisteusai auto.
verses.translation: For John came unto you in the way of righteousness, and ye believed him not: but the publicans and the harlots believed him: and ye, when ye had seen it , repented not afterward, that ye might believe him.

verses.original: Ἄλλην παραβολὴν ἀκούσατε. ⸀Ἄνθρωπος ἦν οἰκοδεσπότης ὅστις ἐφύτευσεν ἀμπελῶνα καὶ φραγμὸν αὐτῷ περιέθηκεν καὶ ὤρυξεν ἐν αὐτῷ ληνὸν καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν πύργον, καὶ ἐξέδετο αὐτὸν γεωργοῖς, καὶ ἀπεδήμησεν.
verses.translit: Allin paravolen akoysate. Anthropos en oikodespotis ostis efyteysen ampelona kai fragmon auto periethiken kai oryxen en auto linon kai okodomisen pyrgon, kai exedeto auton georgois, kai apedimisen.
verses.translation: Hear another parable: There was a certain householder, which planted a vineyard, and hedged it round about, and digged a winepress in it, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country:

verses.original: ὅτε δὲ ἤγγισεν ὁ καιρὸς τῶν καρπῶν, ἀπέστειλεν τοὺς δούλους αὐτοῦ πρὸς τοὺς γεωργοὺς λαβεῖν τοὺς καρποὺς αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: ote de eggisen o kairos ton karpon, apesteilen tous doyloys autou pros tous georgous lavein tous karpous autou.
verses.translation: And when the time of the fruit drew near, he sent his servants to the husbandmen, that they might receive the fruits of it.

verses.original: καὶ λαβόντες οἱ γεωργοὶ τοὺς δούλους αὐτοῦ ὃν μὲν ἔδειραν, ὃν δὲ ἀπέκτειναν, ὃν δὲ ἐλιθοβόλησαν.
verses.translit: kai lavontes oi georgoi tous doyloys autou on men edeiran, on de apekteinan, on de elithovolisan.
verses.translation: And the husbandmen took his servants, and beat one, and killed another, and stoned another.

verses.original: πάλιν ἀπέστειλεν ἄλλους δούλους πλείονας τῶν πρώτων, καὶ ἐποίησαν αὐτοῖς ὡσαύτως.
verses.translit: palin apesteilen alloys doyloys pleionas ton proton, kai epoiisan autois osaytos.
verses.translation: Again, he sent other servants more than the first: and they did unto them likewise.

verses.original: ὕστερον δὲ ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς αὐτοὺς τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ λέγων· Ἐντραπήσονται τὸν υἱόν μου.
verses.translit: usteron de apesteilen pros autous ton yion autou legon* Entrapisontai ton yion moy.
verses.translation: But last of all he sent unto them his son, saying, They will reverence my son.

verses.original: οἱ δὲ γεωργοὶ ἰδόντες τὸν υἱὸν εἶπον ἐν ἑαυτοῖς· Οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ κληρονόμος· δεῦτε ἀποκτείνωμεν αὐτὸν καὶ ⸀σχῶμεν τὴν κληρονομίαν αὐτοῦ·
verses.translit: oi de georgoi idontes ton yion eipon en eaytois* Outos estin o klironomos* deute apokteinomen auton kai shomen ten klironomian autou*
verses.translation: But when the husbandmen saw the son, they said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and let us seize on his inheritance.

verses.original: καὶ λαβόντες αὐτὸν ἐξέβαλον ἔξω τοῦ ἀμπελῶνος καὶ ἀπέκτειναν.
verses.translit: kai lavontes auton exevalon exo tou ampelonos kai apekteinan.
verses.translation: And they caught him, and cast him out of the vineyard, and slew him .

verses.original: ὅταν οὖν ἔλθῃ ὁ κύριος τοῦ ἀμπελῶνος, τί ποιήσει τοῖς γεωργοῖς ἐκείνοις;
verses.translit: otan oun elthe o kyrios tou ampelonos, ti poiisei tois georgois ekeinois;
verses.translation: When the lord therefore of the vineyard cometh, what will he do unto those husbandmen?

verses.original: λέγουσιν αὐτῷ· Κακοὺς κακῶς ἀπολέσει αὐτούς, καὶ τὸν ἀμπελῶνα ἐκδώσεται ἄλλοις γεωργοῖς, οἵτινες ἀποδώσουσιν αὐτῷ τοὺς καρποὺς ἐν τοῖς καιροῖς αὐτῶν.
verses.translit: legoysin auto* Kakous kakos apolesei autoys, kai ton ampelona ekdosetai allois georgois, oitines apodosoysin auto tous karpous en tois kairois auton.
verses.translation: They say unto him, He will miserably destroy those wicked men, and will let out his vineyard unto other husbandmen, which shall render him the fruits in their seasons.

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Οὐδέποτε ἀνέγνωτε ἐν ταῖς γραφαῖς· Λίθον ὃν ἀπεδοκίμασαν οἱ οἰκοδομοῦντες οὗτος ἐγενήθη εἰς κεφαλὴν γωνίας· παρὰ κυρίου ἐγένετο αὕτη, καὶ ἔστιν θαυμαστὴ ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς ἡμῶν;
verses.translit: Legei autois o Iisous* Oudepote anegnote en tais grafais* Lithon on apedokimasan oi oikodomountes outos egenithi eis kefalen gonias* para kyrioy egeneto auti, kai estin thaymaste en ofthalmois emon;
verses.translation: Jesus saith unto them, Did ye never read in the scriptures, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner: this is the Lord’s doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?

verses.original: διὰ τοῦτο λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἀρθήσεται ἀφʼ ὑμῶν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ δοθήσεται ἔθνει ποιοῦντι τοὺς καρποὺς αὐτῆς.
verses.translit: dia touto lego umin oti arthisetai af' umon e vasileia tou theou kai dothisetai ethnei poiounti tous karpous autes.
verses.translation: Therefore say I unto you, The kingdom of God shall be taken from you, and given to a nation bringing forth the fruits thereof.

verses.original: ⸂Καὶ ὁ πεσὼν ἐπὶ τὸν λίθον τοῦτον συνθλασθήσεται· ἐφʼ ὃν δʼ ἂν πέσῃ λικμήσει αὐτόν.⸃
verses.translit: Kai o peson epi ton lithon touton synthlasthisetai* ef' on d' an pese likmisei auton.
verses.translation: And whosoever shall fall on this stone shall be broken: but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.

verses.original: Καὶ ἀκούσαντες οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι τὰς παραβολὰς αὐτοῦ ἔγνωσαν ὅτι περὶ αὐτῶν λέγει·
verses.translit: Kai akoysantes oi arhiereis kai oi Farisaioi tas paravolas autou egnosan oti peri auton legei*
verses.translation: And when the chief priests and Pharisees had heard his parables, they perceived that he spake of them.

verses.original: καὶ ζητοῦντες αὐτὸν κρατῆσαι ἐφοβήθησαν τοὺς ὄχλους, ⸂ἐπεὶ εἰς⸃ προφήτην αὐτὸν εἶχον.
verses.translit: kai zitountes auton kratesai efovithisan tous ohloys, epei eis profitin auton eihon.
verses.translation: But when they sought to lay hands on him, they feared the multitude, because they took him for a prophet.

verses.original: Καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Ἰησοῦς πάλιν εἶπεν ⸂ἐν παραβολαῖς αὐτοῖς⸃ λέγων·
verses.translit: Kai apokritheis o Iisous palin eipen en paravolais autois legon*
verses.translation: And Jesus answered and spake unto them again by parables, and said,

verses.original: Ὡμοιώθη ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν ἀνθρώπῳ βασιλεῖ, ὅστις ἐποίησεν γάμους τῷ υἱῷ αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: Omoiothi e vasileia ton ouranon anthropo vasilei, ostis epoiisen gamoys to yio autou.
verses.translation: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a certain king, which made a marriage for his son,

verses.original: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν τοὺς δούλους αὐτοῦ καλέσαι τοὺς κεκλημένους εἰς τοὺς γάμους, καὶ οὐκ ἤθελον ἐλθεῖν.
verses.translit: kai apesteilen tous doyloys autou kalesai tous keklimenoys eis tous gamoys, kai ouk ethelon elthein.
verses.translation: And sent forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the wedding: and they would not come.

verses.original: πάλιν ἀπέστειλεν ἄλλους δούλους λέγων· Εἴπατε τοῖς κεκλημένοις· Ἰδοὺ τὸ ἄριστόν μου ⸀ἡτοίμακα, οἱ ταῦροί μου καὶ τὰ σιτιστὰ τεθυμένα, καὶ πάντα ἕτοιμα· δεῦτε εἰς τοὺς γάμους.
verses.translit: palin apesteilen alloys doyloys legon* Eipate tois keklimenois* Idou to ariston moy etoimaka, oi tauroi moy kai ta sitista tethymena, kai panta etoima* deute eis tous gamoys.
verses.translation: Again, he sent forth other servants, saying, Tell them which are bidden, Behold, I have prepared my dinner: my oxen and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready: come unto the marriage.

verses.original: οἱ δὲ ἀμελήσαντες ἀπῆλθον, ⸀ὃς μὲν εἰς τὸν ἴδιον ἀγρόν, ⸁ὃς δὲ ⸀ἐπὶ τὴν ἐμπορίαν αὐτοῦ·
verses.translit: oi de amelisantes apelthon, os men eis ton idion agron, os de epi ten emporian autou*
verses.translation: But they made light of it , and went their ways, one to his farm, another to his merchandise:

verses.original: οἱ δὲ λοιποὶ κρατήσαντες τοὺς δούλους αὐτοῦ ὕβρισαν καὶ ἀπέκτειναν.
verses.translit: oi de loipoi kratisantes tous doyloys autou uvrisan kai apekteinan.
verses.translation: And the remnant took his servants, and entreated them spitefully, and slew them .

verses.original: ⸂ὁ δὲ βασιλεὺς⸃ ὠργίσθη, καὶ πέμψας τὰ στρατεύματα αὐτοῦ ἀπώλεσεν τοὺς φονεῖς ἐκείνους καὶ τὴν πόλιν αὐτῶν ἐνέπρησεν.
