verses.translation: And let him that is on the housetop not go down into the house, neither enter therein , to take any thing out of his house:

verses.original: καὶ ὁ εἰς τὸν ⸀ἀγρὸν μὴ ἐπιστρεψάτω εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω ἆραι τὸ ἱμάτιον αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: kai o eis ton agron me epistrepsato eis ta opiso arai to imation autou.
verses.translation: And let him that is in the field not turn back again for to take up his garment.

verses.original: οὐαὶ δὲ ταῖς ἐν γαστρὶ ἐχούσαις καὶ ταῖς θηλαζούσαις ἐν ἐκείναις ταῖς ἡμέραις.
verses.translit: ouai de tais en gastri ehoysais kai tais thilazoysais en ekeinais tais emerais.
verses.translation: But woe to them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!

verses.original: προσεύχεσθε δὲ ἵνα μὴ ⸀γένηται χειμῶνος·
verses.translit: proseyhesthe de ina me genitai heimonos*
verses.translation: And pray ye that your flight be not in the winter.

verses.original: ἔσονται γὰρ αἱ ἡμέραι ἐκεῖναι θλῖψις οἵα οὐ γέγονεν τοιαύτη ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς κτίσεως ⸀ἣν ἔκτισεν ὁ θεὸς ἕως τοῦ νῦν καὶ οὐ μὴ γένηται.
verses.translit: esontai gar ai emerai ekeinai thlipsis oia ou gegonen toiayti ap' arhes ktiseos en ektisen o theos eos tou nun kai ou me genitai.
verses.translation: For in those days shall be affliction, such as was not from the beginning of the creation which God created unto this time, neither shall be.

verses.original: καὶ εἰ μὴ ⸂ἐκολόβωσεν κύριος⸃ τὰς ἡμέρας, οὐκ ἂν ἐσώθη πᾶσα σάρξ. ἀλλὰ διὰ τοὺς ἐκλεκτοὺς οὓς ἐξελέξατο ἐκολόβωσεν τὰς ἡμέρας.
verses.translit: kai ei me ekolovosen kyrios tas emeras, ouk an esothi pasa sarx. alla dia tous eklektous ous exelexato ekolovosen tas emeras.
verses.translation: And except that the Lord had shortened those days, no flesh should be saved: but for the elect’s sake, whom he hath chosen, he hath shortened the days.

verses.original: ⸀καὶ τότε ἐάν τις ὑμῖν εἴπῃ· ⸀Ἴδε ὧδε ὁ ⸀χριστός, ⸁Ἴδε ἐκεῖ, μὴ πιστεύετε·
verses.translit: kai tote ean tis umin eipe* Ide ode o hristos, Ide ekei, me pisteyete*
verses.translation: And then if any man shall say to you, Lo, here is Christ; or, lo, he is there; believe him not:

verses.original: ἐγερθήσονται γὰρ ψευδόχριστοι καὶ ψευδοπροφῆται καὶ δώσουσιν σημεῖα καὶ τέρατα πρὸς τὸ ἀποπλανᾶν εἰ ⸀δυνατὸν τοὺς ἐκλεκτούς·
verses.translit: egerthisontai gar pseydohristoi kai pseydoprofetai kai dosoysin simeia kai terata pros to apoplanan ei dynaton tous eklektoys*
verses.translation: For false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall shew signs and wonders, to seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.

verses.original: ὑμεῖς δὲ βλέπετε· ⸀προείρηκα ὑμῖν πάντα.
verses.translit: umeis de vlepete* proeirika umin panta.
verses.translation: But take ye heed: behold, I have foretold you all things.

verses.original: Ἀλλὰ ἐν ἐκείναις ταῖς ἡμέραις μετὰ τὴν θλῖψιν ἐκείνην ὁ ἥλιος σκοτισθήσεται, καὶ ἡ σελήνη οὐ δώσει τὸ φέγγος αὐτῆς,
verses.translit: Alla en ekeinais tais emerais meta ten thlipsin ekeinin o elios skotisthisetai, kai e selini ou dosei to feggos autes,
verses.translation: But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light,

verses.original: καὶ οἱ ἀστέρες ⸂ἔσονται ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ πίπτοντες⸃, καὶ αἱ δυνάμεις αἱ ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς σαλευθήσονται.
verses.translit: kai oi asteres esontai ek tou ouranou piptontes, kai ai dynameis ai en tois ouranois saleythisontai.
verses.translation: And the stars of heaven shall fall, and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken.

verses.original: καὶ τότε ὄψονται τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐρχόμενον ἐν νεφέλαις μετὰ δυνάμεως πολλῆς καὶ δόξης·
verses.translit: kai tote opsontai ton yion tou anthropoy erhomenon en nefelais meta dynameos polles kai doxis*
verses.translation: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.

verses.original: καὶ τότε ἀποστελεῖ τοὺς ⸀ἀγγέλους καὶ ἐπισυνάξει τοὺς ⸀ἐκλεκτοὺς ἐκ τῶν τεσσάρων ἀνέμων ἀπʼ ἄκρου γῆς ἕως ἄκρου οὐρανοῦ.
verses.translit: kai tote apostelei tous aggeloys kai episynaxei tous eklektous ek ton tessaron anemon ap' akroy ges eos akroy ouranou.
verses.translation: And then shall he send his angels, and shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven.

verses.original: Ἀπὸ δὲ τῆς συκῆς μάθετε τὴν παραβολήν· ὅταν ⸂ἤδη ὁ κλάδος αὐτῆς⸃ ἁπαλὸς γένηται καὶ ἐκφύῃ τὰ φύλλα, γινώσκετε ὅτι ἐγγὺς τὸ θέρος ἐστίν·
verses.translit: Apo de tes sykes mathete ten paravolin* otan edi o klados autes apalos genitai kai ekfye ta fylla, ginoskete oti eggus to theros estin*
verses.translation: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When her branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is near:

verses.original: οὕτως καὶ ὑμεῖς, ὅταν ⸂ἴδητε ταῦτα⸃ γινόμενα, γινώσκετε ὅτι ἐγγύς ἐστιν ἐπὶ θύραις.
verses.translit: outos kai umeis, otan idite tauta ginomena, ginoskete oti eggys estin epi thyrais.
verses.translation: So ye in like manner, when ye shall see these things come to pass, know that it is nigh, even at the doors.

verses.original: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐ μὴ παρέλθῃ ἡ γενεὰ αὕτη μέχρις οὗ ⸂ταῦτα πάντα⸃ γένηται.
verses.translit: amen lego umin oti ou me parelthe e genea auti mehris ou tauta panta genitai.
verses.translation: Verily I say unto you, that this generation shall not pass, till all these things be done.

verses.original: ὁ οὐρανὸς καὶ ἡ γῆ ⸀παρελεύσονται, οἱ δὲ λόγοι μου οὐ ⸀μὴ ⸁παρελεύσονται.
verses.translit: o ouranos kai e ge pareleysontai, oi de logoi moy ou me pareleysontai.
verses.translation: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.

verses.original: Περὶ δὲ τῆς ἡμέρας ἐκείνης ἢ ⸀τῆς ὥρας οὐδεὶς οἶδεν, οὐδὲ οἱ ἄγγελοι ⸀ἐν οὐρανῷ οὐδὲ ὁ υἱός, εἰ μὴ ὁ πατήρ.
verses.translit: Peri de tes emeras ekeinis e tes oras oudeis oiden, oude oi aggeloi en ourano oude o yios, ei me o patir.
verses.translation: But of that day and that hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels which are in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father.

verses.original: βλέπετε ⸀ἀγρυπνεῖτε, οὐκ οἴδατε γὰρ πότε ὁ καιρός ἐστιν·
verses.translit: vlepete agrypneite, ouk oidate gar pote o kairos estin*
verses.translation: Take ye heed, watch and pray: for ye know not when the time is.

verses.original: ὡς ἄνθρωπος ἀπόδημος ἀφεὶς τὴν οἰκίαν αὐτοῦ καὶ δοὺς τοῖς δούλοις αὐτοῦ τὴν ἐξουσίαν, ⸀ἑκάστῳ τὸ ἔργον αὐτοῦ, καὶ τῷ θυρωρῷ ἐνετείλατο ἵνα γρηγορῇ.
verses.translit: os anthropos apodimos afeis ten oikian autou kai dous tois doylois autou ten exoysian, ekasto to ergon autou, kai to thyroro eneteilato ina grigore.
verses.translation: For the Son of man is as a man taking a far journey, who left his house, and gave authority to his servants, and to every man his work, and commanded the porter to watch.

verses.original: γρηγορεῖτε οὖν, οὐκ οἴδατε γὰρ πότε ὁ κύριος τῆς οἰκίας ἔρχεται, ⸀ἢ ὀψὲ ἢ ⸀μεσονύκτιον ἢ ἀλεκτοροφωνίας ἢ πρωΐ,
verses.translit: grigoreite oun, ouk oidate gar pote o kyrios tes oikias erhetai, e opse e mesonyktion e alektorofonias e proI,
verses.translation: Watch ye therefore: for ye know not when the master of the house cometh, at even, or at midnight, or at the cockcrowing, or in the morning:

verses.original: μὴ ἐλθὼν ἐξαίφνης εὕρῃ ὑμᾶς καθεύδοντας·
verses.translit: me elthon exaifnis eure umas katheydontas*
verses.translation: Lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping.

verses.original: ⸀ὃ δὲ ὑμῖν λέγω πᾶσιν λέγω· γρηγορεῖτε.
verses.translit: o de umin lego pasin lego* grigoreite.
verses.translation: And what I say unto you I say unto all, Watch.

verses.original: Ἦν δὲ τὸ πάσχα καὶ τὰ ἄζυμα μετὰ δύο ἡμέρας. καὶ ἐζήτουν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς πῶς αὐτὸν ἐν δόλῳ κρατήσαντες ἀποκτείνωσιν,
verses.translit: En de to pasha kai ta azyma meta dyo emeras. kai ezitoyn oi arhiereis kai oi grammateis pos auton en dolo kratisantes apokteinosin,
verses.translation: After two days was the feast of the passover, and of unleavened bread: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him by craft, and put him to death.

verses.original: ἔλεγον ⸀γάρ· Μὴ ἐν τῇ ἑορτῇ, μήποτε ⸂ἔσται θόρυβος⸃ τοῦ λαοῦ.
verses.translit: elegon gar* Me en te eorte, mipote estai thoryvos tou laou.
verses.translation: But they said, Not on the feast day , lest there be an uproar of the people.

verses.original: Καὶ ὄντος αὐτοῦ ἐν Βηθανίᾳ ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ Σίμωνος τοῦ λεπροῦ κατακειμένου αὐτοῦ ἦλθεν γυνὴ ἔχουσα ἀλάβαστρον μύρου νάρδου πιστικῆς πολυτελοῦς· ⸀συντρίψασα ⸀τὴν ἀλάβαστρον κατέχεεν ⸀αὐτοῦ τῆς κεφαλῆς.
verses.translit: Kai ontos autou en Vithania en te oikia Simonos tou leprou katakeimenoy autou elthen gyne ehoysa alavastron myroy nardoy pistikes polytelous* syntripsasa ten alavastron kateheen autou tes kefales.
verses.translation: And being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at meat, there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment of spikenard very precious; and she brake the box, and poured it on his head.

verses.original: ἦσαν δέ τινες ἀγανακτοῦντες πρὸς ⸀ἑαυτούς· Εἰς τί ἡ ἀπώλεια αὕτη τοῦ μύρου γέγονεν;
verses.translit: esan de tines aganaktountes pros eaytoys* Eis ti e apoleia auti tou myroy gegonen;
verses.translation: And there were some that had indignation within themselves, and said, Why was this waste of the ointment made?

verses.original: ἠδύνατο γὰρ τοῦτο ⸂τὸ μύρον⸃ πραθῆναι ἐπάνω ⸂δηναρίων τριακοσίων⸃ καὶ δοθῆναι τοῖς πτωχοῖς· καὶ ἐνεβριμῶντο αὐτῇ.
verses.translit: edynato gar touto to myron prathenai epano dinarion triakosion kai dothenai tois ptohois* kai enevrimonto aute.
verses.translation: For it might have been sold for more than three hundred pence, and have been given to the poor. And they murmured against her.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν· Ἄφετε αὐτήν· τί αὐτῇ κόπους παρέχετε; καλὸν ἔργον ἠργάσατο ἐν ἐμοί·
verses.translit: o de Iisous eipen* Afete autin* ti aute kopoys parehete; kalon ergon ergasato en emoi*
verses.translation: And Jesus said, Let her alone; why trouble ye her? she hath wrought a good work on me.

verses.original: πάντοτε γὰρ τοὺς πτωχοὺς ἔχετε μεθʼ ἑαυτῶν, καὶ ὅταν θέλητε δύνασθε ⸀αὐτοῖς εὖ ποιῆσαι, ἐμὲ δὲ οὐ πάντοτε ἔχετε·
verses.translit: pantote gar tous ptohous ehete meth' eayton, kai otan thelite dynasthe autois eu poiesai, eme de ou pantote ehete*
verses.translation: For ye have the poor with you always, and whensoever ye will ye may do them good: but me ye have not always.

verses.original: ὃ ⸀ἔσχεν ἐποίησεν, προέλαβεν μυρίσαι ⸂τὸ σῶμά μου⸃ εἰς τὸν ἐνταφιασμόν.
verses.translit: o eshen epoiisen, proelaven myrisai to soma moy eis ton entafiasmon.
verses.translation: She hath done what she could: she is come aforehand to anoint my body to the burying.

verses.original: ἀμὴν ⸀δὲ λέγω ὑμῖν, ὅπου ⸀ἐὰν κηρυχθῇ τὸ ⸀εὐαγγέλιον εἰς ὅλον τὸν κόσμον, καὶ ὃ ἐποίησεν αὕτη λαληθήσεται εἰς μνημόσυνον αὐτῆς.
verses.translit: amen de lego umin, opoy ean kiryhthe to euaggelion eis olon ton kosmon, kai o epoiisen auti lalithisetai eis mnimosynon autes.
verses.translation: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world, this also that she hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her.

verses.original: ⸀Καὶ Ἰούδας ⸂Ἰσκαριὼθ ὁ⸃ εἷς τῶν δώδεκα ἀπῆλθεν πρὸς τοὺς ἀρχιερεῖς ἵνα αὐτὸν ⸂παραδοῖ αὐτοῖς⸃.
verses.translit: Kai Ioydas Iskarioth o eis ton dodeka apelthen pros tous arhiereis ina auton paradoi autois.
verses.translation: And Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, went unto the chief priests, to betray him unto them.

verses.original: οἱ δὲ ἀκούσαντες ἐχάρησαν καὶ ἐπηγγείλαντο αὐτῷ ἀργύριον δοῦναι. καὶ ἐζήτει πῶς ⸂αὐτὸν εὐκαίρως παραδοῖ⸃.
verses.translit: oi de akoysantes eharisan kai epiggeilanto auto argyrion dounai. kai ezitei pos auton eukairos paradoi.
verses.translation: And when they heard it , they were glad, and promised to give him money. And he sought how he might conveniently betray him.

verses.original: Καὶ τῇ πρώτῃ ἡμέρᾳ τῶν ἀζύμων, ὅτε τὸ πάσχα ἔθυον, λέγουσιν αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ· Ποῦ θέλεις ἀπελθόντες ἑτοιμάσωμεν ἵνα φάγῃς τὸ πάσχα;
verses.translit: Kai te prote emera ton azymon, ote to pasha ethyon, legoysin auto oi mathitai autou* Pou theleis apelthontes etoimasomen ina fages to pasha;
verses.translation: And the first day of unleavened bread, when they killed the passover, his disciples said unto him, Where wilt thou that we go and prepare that thou mayest eat the passover?

verses.original: καὶ ἀποστέλλει δύο τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς· Ὑπάγετε εἰς τὴν πόλιν, καὶ ἀπαντήσει ὑμῖν ἄνθρωπος κεράμιον ὕδατος βαστάζων· ἀκολουθήσατε αὐτῷ,
verses.translit: kai apostellei dyo ton mathiton autou kai legei autois* Upagete eis ten polin, kai apantisei umin anthropos keramion udatos vastazon* akoloythisate auto,
verses.translation: And he sendeth forth two of his disciples, and saith unto them, Go ye into the city, and there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water: follow him.

verses.original: καὶ ὅπου ⸀ἐὰν εἰσέλθῃ εἴπατε τῷ οἰκοδεσπότῃ ὅτι Ὁ διδάσκαλος λέγει· Ποῦ ἐστιν τὸ κατάλυμά ⸀μου ὅπου τὸ πάσχα μετὰ τῶν μαθητῶν μου φάγω;
verses.translit: kai opoy ean eiselthe eipate to oikodespote oti O didaskalos legei* Pou estin to katalyma moy opoy to pasha meta ton mathiton moy fago;
verses.translation: And wheresoever he shall go in, say ye to the goodman of the house, The Master saith, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?

verses.original: καὶ αὐτὸς ὑμῖν δείξει ἀνάγαιον μέγα ἐστρωμένον ἕτοιμον· ⸀καὶ ἐκεῖ ἑτοιμάσατε ἡμῖν.
verses.translit: kai autos umin deixei anagaion mega estromenon etoimon* kai ekei etoimasate emin.
verses.translation: And he will shew you a large upper room furnished and prepared: there make ready for us.

verses.original: καὶ ἐξῆλθον οἱ ⸀μαθηταὶ καὶ ἦλθον εἰς τὴν πόλιν καὶ εὗρον καθὼς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς, καὶ ἡτοίμασαν τὸ πάσχα.
verses.translit: kai exelthon oi mathitai kai elthon eis ten polin kai euron kathos eipen autois, kai etoimasan to pasha.
verses.translation: And his disciples went forth, and came into the city, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.

verses.original: Καὶ ὀψίας γενομένης ἔρχεται μετὰ τῶν δώδεκα.
verses.translit: Kai opsias genomenis erhetai meta ton dodeka.
verses.translation: And in the evening he cometh with the twelve.

verses.original: καὶ ἀνακειμένων αὐτῶν καὶ ἐσθιόντων ⸂ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν⸃· Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι εἷς ἐξ ὑμῶν παραδώσει με ὁ ἐσθίων μετʼ ἐμοῦ.
verses.translit: kai anakeimenon auton kai esthionton o Iisous eipen* Amen lego umin oti eis ex umon paradosei me o esthion met' emou.
verses.translation: And as they sat and did eat, Jesus said, Verily I say unto you, One of you which eateth with me shall betray me.

verses.original: ⸀ἤρξαντο λυπεῖσθαι καὶ λέγειν αὐτῷ εἷς κατὰ εἷς· Μήτι ⸀ἐγώ;
verses.translit: erxanto lypeisthai kai legein auto eis kata eis* Miti ego;
verses.translation: And they began to be sorrowful, and to say unto him one by one, Is it I? and another said, Is it I?

verses.original: ὁ ⸀δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· ⸀Εἷς τῶν δώδεκα, ὁ ἐμβαπτόμενος μετʼ ἐμοῦ εἰς ⸀τὸ τρύβλιον·
verses.translit: o de eipen autois* Eis ton dodeka, o emvaptomenos met' emou eis to tryvlion*
verses.translation: And he answered and said unto them, It is one of the twelve, that dippeth with me in the dish.

verses.original: ⸀ὅτι ὁ μὲν υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ὑπάγει καθὼς γέγραπται περὶ αὐτοῦ, οὐαὶ δὲ τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ ἐκείνῳ διʼ οὗ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου παραδίδοται· ⸀καλὸν αὐτῷ εἰ οὐκ ἐγεννήθη ὁ ἄνθρωπος ἐκεῖνος.
verses.translit: oti o men yios tou anthropoy upagei kathos gegraptai peri autou, ouai de to anthropo ekeino di' ou o yios tou anthropoy paradidotai* kalon auto ei ouk egennithi o anthropos ekeinos.
verses.translation: The Son of man indeed goeth, as it is written of him: but woe to that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! good were it for that man if he had never been born.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐσθιόντων αὐτῶν ⸀λαβὼν ἄρτον εὐλογήσας ἔκλασεν καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς καὶ εἶπεν· ⸀Λάβετε, τοῦτό ἐστιν τὸ σῶμά μου.
verses.translit: Kai esthionton auton lavon arton eulogisas eklasen kai edoken autois kai eipen* Lavete, touto estin to soma moy.
verses.translation: And as they did eat, Jesus took bread, and blessed, and brake it , and gave to them, and said, Take, eat: this is my body.

verses.original: καὶ ⸀λαβὼν ποτήριον εὐχαριστήσας ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς, καὶ ἔπιον ἐξ αὐτοῦ πάντες.
verses.translit: kai lavon potirion euharistisas edoken autois, kai epion ex autou pantes.
verses.translation: And he took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them: and they all drank of it.

verses.original: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Τοῦτό ἐστιν τὸ αἷμά μου ⸀τῆς διαθήκης τὸ ⸂ἐκχυννόμενον ὑπὲρ πολλῶν⸃.
verses.translit: kai eipen autois* Touto estin to aima moy tes diathikis to ekhynnomenon uper pollon.
verses.translation: And he said unto them, This is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many.

verses.original: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐκέτι οὐ μὴ πίω ἐκ τοῦ γενήματος τῆς ἀμπέλου ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ἐκείνης ὅταν αὐτὸ πίνω καινὸν ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τοῦ θεοῦ.
verses.translit: amen lego umin oti ouketi ou me pio ek tou genimatos tes ampeloy eos tes emeras ekeinis otan auto pino kainon en te vasileia tou theou.
verses.translation: Verily I say unto you, I will drink no more of the fruit of the vine, until that day that I drink it new in the kingdom of God.

verses.original: Καὶ ὑμνήσαντες ἐξῆλθον εἰς τὸ Ὄρος τῶν Ἐλαιῶν.
verses.translit: Kai umnisantes exelthon eis to Oros ton Elaion.
verses.translation: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.

verses.original: Καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὅτι Πάντες ⸀σκανδαλισθήσεσθε, ὅτι γέγραπται· Πατάξω τὸν ποιμένα, καὶ ⸂τὰ πρόβατα διασκορπισθήσονται⸃.
verses.translit: Kai legei autois o Iisous oti Pantes skandalisthisesthe, oti gegraptai* Pataxo ton poimena, kai ta provata diaskorpisthisontai.
verses.translation: And Jesus saith unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered.

verses.original: ἀλλὰ μετὰ τὸ ἐγερθῆναί με προάξω ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν.
verses.translit: alla meta to egerthenai me proaxo umas eis ten Galilaian.
verses.translation: But after that I am risen, I will go before you into Galilee.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ Πέτρος ἔφη αὐτῷ· ⸂Εἰ καὶ⸃ πάντες σκανδαλισθήσονται, ἀλλʼ οὐκ ἐγώ.
verses.translit: o de Petros efi auto* Ei kai pantes skandalisthisontai, all' ouk ego.
verses.translation: But Peter said unto him, Although all shall be offended, yet will not I.

verses.original: καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἀμὴν λέγω σοι ὅτι σὺ σήμερον ⸂ταύτῃ τῇ νυκτὶ⸃ πρὶν ἢ δὶς ἀλέκτορα φωνῆσαι τρίς ⸂με ἀπαρνήσῃ⸃.
verses.translit: kai legei auto o Iisous* Amen lego soi oti su simeron tayte te nykti prin e dis alektora fonesai tris me aparnise.
verses.translation: And Jesus saith unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this day, even in this night, before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ ⸂ἐκπερισσῶς ἐλάλει⸃· Ἐὰν ⸂δέῃ με⸃ συναποθανεῖν σοι, οὐ μή σε ⸀ἀπαρνήσομαι. ὡσαύτως δὲ καὶ πάντες ἔλεγον.
verses.translit: o de ekperissos elalei* Ean dee me synapothanein soi, ou mi se aparnisomai. osaytos de kai pantes elegon.
verses.translation: But he spake the more vehemently, If I should die with thee, I will not deny thee in any wise. Likewise also said they all.

verses.original: Καὶ ἔρχονται εἰς χωρίον οὗ τὸ ὄνομα Γεθσημανί, καὶ λέγει τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ· Καθίσατε ὧδε ἕως προσεύξωμαι.
verses.translit: Kai erhontai eis horion ou to onoma Gethsimani, kai legei tois mathitais autou* Kathisate ode eos proseyxomai.
verses.translation: And they came to a place which was named Gethsemane: and he saith to his disciples, Sit ye here, while I shall pray.

verses.original: καὶ παραλαμβάνει τὸν Πέτρον καὶ ⸂Ἰάκωβον καὶ⸃ Ἰωάννην μετʼ ⸀αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἤρξατο ἐκθαμβεῖσθαι καὶ ἀδημονεῖν,
verses.translit: kai paralamvanei ton Petron kai Iakovon kai Ioannin met' autou, kai erxato ekthamveisthai kai adimonein,
verses.translation: And he taketh with him Peter and James and John, and began to be sore amazed, and to be very heavy;

verses.original: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς· Περίλυπός ἐστιν ἡ ψυχή μου ἕως θανάτου· μείνατε ὧδε καὶ γρηγορεῖτε.
verses.translit: kai legei autois* Perilypos estin e psyhi moy eos thanatoy* meinate ode kai grigoreite.
verses.translation: And saith unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death: tarry ye here, and watch.

verses.original: καὶ ⸂προελθὼν μικρὸν ἔπιπτεν⸃ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, καὶ προσηύχετο ἵνα εἰ δυνατόν ἐστιν παρέλθῃ ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ ἡ ὥρα,
verses.translit: kai proelthon mikron epipten epi tes ges, kai prosiyheto ina ei dynaton estin parelthe ap' autou e ora,
verses.translation: And he went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass from him.

verses.original: καὶ ἔλεγεν· Αββα ὁ πατήρ, πάντα δυνατά σοι· παρένεγκε τὸ ποτήριον ⸂τοῦτο ἀπʼ ἐμοῦ⸃· ἀλλʼ οὐ τί ἐγὼ θέλω ἀλλὰ τί σύ.
verses.translit: kai elegen* Avva o patir, panta dynata soi* parenegke to potirion touto ap' emou* all' ou ti ego thelo alla ti sy.
verses.translation: And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee; take away this cup from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.

verses.original: καὶ ἔρχεται καὶ εὑρίσκει αὐτοὺς καθεύδοντας, καὶ λέγει τῷ Πέτρῳ· Σίμων, καθεύδεις; οὐκ ἴσχυσας μίαν ὥραν γρηγορῆσαι;
verses.translit: kai erhetai kai euriskei autous katheydontas, kai legei to Petro* Simon, katheydeis; ouk ishysas mian oran grigoresai;
verses.translation: And he cometh, and findeth them sleeping, and saith unto Peter, Simon, sleepest thou? couldest not thou watch one hour?

verses.original: γρηγορεῖτε καὶ προσεύχεσθε, ἵνα μὴ ⸀ἔλθητε εἰς πειρασμόν· τὸ μὲν πνεῦμα πρόθυμον ἡ δὲ σὰρξ ἀσθενής.
verses.translit: grigoreite kai proseyhesthe, ina me elthite eis peirasmon* to men pneuma prothymon e de sarx asthenis.
verses.translation: Watch ye and pray, lest ye enter into temptation. The spirit truly is ready, but the flesh is weak.

verses.original: καὶ πάλιν ἀπελθὼν προσηύξατο τὸν αὐτὸν λόγον εἰπών.
verses.translit: kai palin apelthon prosiyxato ton auton logon eipon.
verses.translation: And again he went away, and prayed, and spake the same words.

verses.original: καὶ ⸂πάλιν ἐλθὼν εὗρεν αὐτοὺς⸃ καθεύδοντας, ἦσαν γὰρ ⸂αὐτῶν οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ⸃ ⸀καταβαρυνόμενοι, καὶ οὐκ ᾔδεισαν τί ⸂ἀποκριθῶσιν αὐτῷ⸃.
verses.translit: kai palin elthon euren autous katheydontas, esan gar auton oi ofthalmoi katavarynomenoi, kai ouk edeisan ti apokrithosin auto.
verses.translation: And when he returned, he found them asleep again, (for their eyes were heavy,) neither wist they what to answer him.

verses.original: καὶ ἔρχεται τὸ τρίτον καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς· Καθεύδετε ⸀τὸ λοιπὸν καὶ ἀναπαύεσθε· ἀπέχει· ἦλθεν ἡ ὥρα, ἰδοὺ παραδίδοται ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου εἰς τὰς χεῖρας τῶν ἁμαρτωλῶν.
verses.translit: kai erhetai to triton kai legei autois* Katheydete to loipon kai anapayesthe* apehei* elthen e ora, idou paradidotai o yios tou anthropoy eis tas heiras ton amartolon.
verses.translation: And he cometh the third time, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: it is enough, the hour is come; behold, the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

verses.original: ἐγείρεσθε ἄγωμεν· ἰδοὺ ὁ παραδιδούς με ἤγγικεν.
verses.translit: egeiresthe agomen* idou o paradidoys me eggiken.
verses.translation: Rise up, let us go; lo, he that betrayeth me is at hand.

verses.original: Καὶ ⸀εὐθὺς ἔτι αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος παραγίνεται ⸀Ἰούδας ⸀εἷς τῶν δώδεκα καὶ μετʼ αὐτοῦ ⸀ὄχλος μετὰ μαχαιρῶν καὶ ξύλων παρὰ τῶν ἀρχιερέων καὶ τῶν γραμματέων καὶ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων.
verses.translit: Kai euthus eti autou lalountos paraginetai Ioydas eis ton dodeka kai met' autou ohlos meta mahairon kai xylon para ton arhiereon kai ton grammateon kai ton presvyteron.
verses.translation: And immediately, while he yet spake, cometh Judas, one of the twelve, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders.

verses.original: δεδώκει δὲ ὁ παραδιδοὺς αὐτὸν σύσσημον αὐτοῖς λέγων· Ὃν ἂν φιλήσω αὐτός ἐστιν· κρατήσατε αὐτὸν καὶ ⸀ἀπάγετε ἀσφαλῶς.
verses.translit: dedokei de o paradidous auton syssimon autois legon* On an filiso autos estin* kratisate auton kai apagete asfalos.
verses.translation: And he that betrayed him had given them a token, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he; take him, and lead him away safely.

verses.original: καὶ ἐλθὼν ⸀εὐθὺς προσελθὼν αὐτῷ λέγει· ⸀Ῥαββί, καὶ κατεφίλησεν αὐτόν.
verses.translit: kai elthon euthus proselthon auto legei* Ravvi, kai katefilisen auton.
verses.translation: And as soon as he was come, he goeth straightway to him, and saith, Master, master; and kissed him.

verses.original: οἱ δὲ ἐπέβαλαν ⸂τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῷ⸃ καὶ ἐκράτησαν αὐτόν.
verses.translit: oi de epevalan tas heiras auto kai ekratisan auton.
verses.translation: And they laid their hands on him, and took him.

verses.original: εἷς δέ ⸀τις τῶν παρεστηκότων σπασάμενος τὴν μάχαιραν ἔπαισεν τὸν δοῦλον τοῦ ἀρχιερέως καὶ ἀφεῖλεν αὐτοῦ τὸ ⸀ὠτάριον.
verses.translit: eis de tis ton parestikoton spasamenos ten mahairan epaisen ton doulon tou arhiereos kai afeilen autou to otarion.
verses.translation: And one of them that stood by drew a sword, and smote a servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

verses.original: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Ὡς ἐπὶ λῃστὴν ἐξήλθατε μετὰ μαχαιρῶν καὶ ξύλων συλλαβεῖν με;
verses.translit: kai apokritheis o Iisous eipen autois* Os epi lesten exilthate meta mahairon kai xylon syllavein me;
verses.translation: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Are ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and with staves to take me?

verses.original: καθʼ ἡμέραν ἤμην πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ διδάσκων καὶ οὐκ ἐκρατήσατέ με· ἀλλʼ ἵνα πληρωθῶσιν αἱ γραφαί.
verses.translit: kath' emeran emin pros umas en to iero didaskon kai ouk ekratisate me* all' ina plirothosin ai grafai.
verses.translation: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and ye took me not: but the scriptures must be fulfilled.

verses.original: καὶ ἀφέντες αὐτὸν ⸂ἔφυγον πάντες⸃.
verses.translit: kai afentes auton efygon pantes.
verses.translation: And they all forsook him, and fled.

verses.original: Καὶ ⸂νεανίσκος τις⸃ ⸀συνηκολούθει αὐτῷ περιβεβλημένος σινδόνα ἐπὶ γυμνοῦ, καὶ κρατοῦσιν ⸀αὐτόν,
verses.translit: Kai neaniskos tis synikoloythei auto perivevlimenos sindona epi gymnou, kai kratousin auton,
verses.translation: And there followed him a certain young man, having a linen cloth cast about his naked body ; and the young men laid hold on him:

verses.original: ὁ δὲ καταλιπὼν τὴν σινδόνα γυμνὸς ⸀ἔφυγεν.
verses.translit: o de katalipon ten sindona gymnos efygen.
verses.translation: And he left the linen cloth, and fled from them naked.

verses.original: Καὶ ἀπήγαγον τὸν Ἰησοῦν πρὸς τὸν ἀρχιερέα, καὶ ⸀συνέρχονται πάντες οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς.
verses.translit: Kai apigagon ton Iisoun pros ton arhierea, kai synerhontai pantes oi arhiereis kai oi presvyteroi kai oi grammateis.
verses.translation: And they led Jesus away to the high priest: and with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes.

verses.original: καὶ ὁ Πέτρος ἀπὸ μακρόθεν ἠκολούθησεν αὐτῷ ἕως ἔσω εἰς τὴν αὐλὴν τοῦ ἀρχιερέως καὶ ἦν συγκαθήμενος μετὰ τῶν ὑπηρετῶν καὶ θερμαινόμενος πρὸς τὸ φῶς.
verses.translit: kai o Petros apo makrothen ekoloythisen auto eos eso eis ten aulen tou arhiereos kai en sygkathimenos meta ton upireton kai thermainomenos pros to fos.
verses.translation: And Peter followed him afar off, even into the palace of the high priest: and he sat with the servants, and warmed himself at the fire.

verses.original: οἱ δὲ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ ὅλον τὸ συνέδριον ἐζήτουν κατὰ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ μαρτυρίαν εἰς τὸ θανατῶσαι αὐτόν, καὶ οὐχ ηὕρισκον·
verses.translit: oi de arhiereis kai olon to synedrion ezitoyn kata tou Iisou martyrian eis to thanatosai auton, kai ouh iuriskon*
verses.translation: And the chief priests and all the council sought for witness against Jesus to put him to death; and found none.

verses.original: πολλοὶ γὰρ ἐψευδομαρτύρουν κατʼ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἴσαι αἱ μαρτυρίαι οὐκ ἦσαν.
verses.translit: polloi gar epseydomartyroyn kat' autou, kai isai ai martyriai ouk esan.
verses.translation: For many bare false witness against him, but their witness agreed not together.

verses.original: καί τινες ἀναστάντες ἐψευδομαρτύρουν κατʼ αὐτοῦ λέγοντες
verses.translit: kai tines anastantes epseydomartyroyn kat' autou legontes
verses.translation: And there arose certain, and bare false witness against him, saying,

verses.original: ὅτι Ἡμεῖς ἠκούσαμεν αὐτοῦ λέγοντος ὅτι Ἐγὼ καταλύσω τὸν ναὸν τοῦτον τὸν χειροποίητον καὶ διὰ τριῶν ἡμερῶν ἄλλον ἀχειροποίητον οἰκοδομήσω·
verses.translit: oti Emeis ekoysamen autou legontos oti Ego katalyso ton naon touton ton heiropoiiton kai dia trion emeron allon aheiropoiiton oikodomiso*
verses.translation: We heard him say, I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and within three days I will build another made without hands.

verses.original: καὶ οὐδὲ οὕτως ἴση ἦν ἡ μαρτυρία αὐτῶν.
verses.translit: kai oude outos isi en e martyria auton.
verses.translation: But neither so did their witness agree together.

verses.original: καὶ ἀναστὰς ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς εἰς μέσον ἐπηρώτησεν τὸν Ἰησοῦν λέγων· Οὐκ ἀποκρίνῃ οὐδέν; τί οὗτοί σου καταμαρτυροῦσιν;
verses.translit: kai anastas o arhiereus eis meson epirotisen ton Iisoun legon* Ouk apokrine ouden? ti outoi soy katamartyrousin;
verses.translation: And the high priest stood up in the midst, and asked Jesus, saying, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?

verses.original: ὁ δὲ ἐσιώπα καὶ ⸂οὐκ ἀπεκρίνατο οὐδέν⸃. πάλιν ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς ἐπηρώτα αὐτὸν καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ· Σὺ εἶ ὁ χριστὸς ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ εὐλογητοῦ;
verses.translit: o de esiopa kai ouk apekrinato ouden. palin o arhiereus epirota auton kai legei auto* Su ei o hristos o yios tou eulogitou;
verses.translation: But he held his peace, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, and said unto him, Art thou the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?

verses.original: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν· Ἐγώ εἰμι, καὶ ὄψεσθε τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐκ δεξιῶν καθήμενον τῆς δυνάμεως καὶ ἐρχόμενον μετὰ τῶν νεφελῶν τοῦ οὐρανοῦ.
verses.translit: o de Iisous eipen* Ego eimi, kai opsesthe ton yion tou anthropoy ek dexion kathimenon tes dynameos kai erhomenon meta ton nefelon tou ouranou.
verses.translation: And Jesus said, I am: and ye shall see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ ἀρχιερεὺς διαρρήξας τοὺς χιτῶνας αὐτοῦ λέγει· Τί ἔτι χρείαν ἔχομεν μαρτύρων;
verses.translit: o de arhiereus diarrixas tous hitonas autou legei* Ti eti hreian ehomen martyron;
verses.translation: Then the high priest rent his clothes, and saith, What need we any further witnesses?

verses.original: ἠκούσατε τῆς βλασφημίας· τί ὑμῖν φαίνεται; οἱ δὲ πάντες κατέκριναν αὐτὸν ⸂ἔνοχον εἶναι⸃ θανάτου.
verses.translit: ekoysate tes vlasfimias* ti umin fainetai; oi de pantes katekrinan auton enohon einai thanatoy.
verses.translation: Ye have heard the blasphemy: what think ye? And they all condemned him to be guilty of death.

verses.original: καὶ ἤρξαντό τινες ἐμπτύειν αὐτῷ καὶ περικαλύπτειν ⸂αὐτοῦ τὸ πρόσωπον⸃ καὶ κολαφίζειν αὐτὸν καὶ λέγειν αὐτῷ· Προφήτευσον, καὶ οἱ ὑπηρέται ῥαπίσμασιν αὐτὸν ⸀ἔλαβον.
verses.translit: kai erxanto tines emptyein auto kai perikalyptein autou to prosopon kai kolafizein auton kai legein auto* Profiteyson, kai oi upiretai Rapismasin auton elavon.
verses.translation: And some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to buffet him, and to say unto him, Prophesy: and the servants did strike him with the palms of their hands.

verses.original: Καὶ ὄντος τοῦ Πέτρου ⸂κάτω ἐν τῇ αὐλῇ⸃ ἔρχεται μία τῶν παιδισκῶν τοῦ ἀρχιερέως,
verses.translit: Kai ontos tou Petroy kato en te aule erhetai mia ton paidiskon tou arhiereos,
verses.translation: And as Peter was beneath in the palace, there cometh one of the maids of the high priest:

verses.original: καὶ ἰδοῦσα τὸν Πέτρον θερμαινόμενον ἐμβλέψασα αὐτῷ λέγει· Καὶ σὺ μετὰ τοῦ Ναζαρηνοῦ ⸂ἦσθα τοῦ Ἰησοῦ⸃·
verses.translit: kai idousa ton Petron thermainomenon emvlepsasa auto legei* Kai su meta tou Nazarinou estha tou Iisou*
verses.translation: And when she saw Peter warming himself, she looked upon him, and said, And thou also wast with Jesus of Nazareth.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ ἠρνήσατο λέγων· ⸂Οὔτε οἶδα οὔτε ἐπίσταμαι σὺ τί⸃ λέγεις, καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἔξω εἰς τὸ προαύλιον ⸂καὶ ἀλέκτωρ ἐφώνησεν⸃.
verses.translit: o de ernisato legon* Oute oida oute epistamai su ti legeis, kai exelthen exo eis to proaylion kai alektor efonisen.
verses.translation: But he denied, saying, I know not, neither understand I what thou sayest. And he went out into the porch; and the cock crew.

verses.original: καὶ ἡ παιδίσκη ἰδοῦσα αὐτὸν ⸂ἤρξατο πάλιν⸃ λέγειν τοῖς ⸀παρεστῶσιν ὅτι Οὗτος ἐξ αὐτῶν ἐστιν.
verses.translit: kai e paidiski idousa auton erxato palin legein tois parestosin oti Outos ex auton estin.
verses.translation: And a maid saw him again, and began to say to them that stood by, This is one of them.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ πάλιν ἠρνεῖτο. καὶ μετὰ μικρὸν πάλιν οἱ παρεστῶτες ἔλεγον τῷ Πέτρῳ· Ἀληθῶς ἐξ αὐτῶν εἶ, καὶ γὰρ Γαλιλαῖος εἶ ⸂καὶ ἡ λαλιά σου ὁμοιάζει⸃·
verses.translit: o de palin erneito. kai meta mikron palin oi parestotes elegon to Petro* Alithos ex auton ei, kai gar Galilaios ei kai e lalia soy omoiazei*
verses.translation: And he denied it again. And a little after, they that stood by said again to Peter, Surely thou art one of them: for thou art a Galilaean, and thy speech agreeth thereto .

verses.original: ὁ δὲ ἤρξατο ἀναθεματίζειν καὶ ὀμνύναι ὅτι Οὐκ οἶδα τὸν ἄνθρωπον τοῦτον ὃν λέγετε.
verses.translit: o de erxato anathematizein kai omnynai oti Ouk oida ton anthropon touton on legete.
verses.translation: But he began to curse and to swear, saying , I know not this man of whom ye speak.

verses.original: καὶ ⸀εὐθὺς ἐκ δευτέρου ἀλέκτωρ ἐφώνησεν· καὶ ἀνεμνήσθη ὁ Πέτρος τὸ ῥῆμα ⸀ὡς εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὅτι Πρὶν ἀλέκτορα ⸂φωνῆσαι δὶς τρίς με ἀπαρνήσῃ⸃, καὶ ἐπιβαλὼν ἔκλαιεν.
verses.translit: kai euthus ek deyteroy alektor efonisen* kai anemnisthi o Petros to Rema os eipen auto o Iisous oti Prin alektora fonesai dis tris me aparnise, kai epivalon eklaien.
verses.translation: And the second time the cock crew. And Peter called to mind the word that Jesus said unto him, Before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice. And when he thought thereon, he wept.

verses.original: Καὶ ⸀εὐθὺς πρωῒ συμβούλιον ποιήσαντες οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς μετὰ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων καὶ γραμματέων καὶ ὅλον τὸ συνέδριον δήσαντες τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἀπήνεγκαν καὶ ⸀παρέδωκαν Πιλάτῳ.
verses.translit: Kai euthus proi symvoylion poiisantes oi arhiereis meta ton presvyteron kai grammateon kai olon to synedrion disantes ton Iisoun apinegkan kai paredokan Pilato.
verses.translation: And straightway in the morning the chief priests held a consultation with the elders and scribes and the whole council, and bound Jesus, and carried him away, and delivered him to Pilate.

verses.original: καὶ ἐπηρώτησεν αὐτὸν ὁ Πιλᾶτος· Σὺ εἶ ὁ βασιλεὺς τῶν Ἰουδαίων; ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς ⸂αὐτῷ λέγει⸃· Σὺ λέγεις.
verses.translit: kai epirotisen auton o Pilatos* Su ei o vasileus ton Ioydaion; o de apokritheis auto legei* Su legeis.
verses.translation: And Pilate asked him, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answering said unto him, Thou sayest it .

verses.original: καὶ κατηγόρουν αὐτοῦ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς πολλά.
verses.translit: kai katigoroyn autou oi arhiereis polla.
verses.translation: And the chief priests accused him of many things: but he answered nothing.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ Πιλᾶτος πάλιν ⸀ἐπηρώτα αὐτὸν λέγων· Οὐκ ἀποκρίνῃ οὐδέν; ἴδε πόσα σου ⸀κατηγοροῦσιν.
verses.translit: o de Pilatos palin epirota auton legon* Ouk apokrine ouden; ide posa soy katigorousin.
verses.translation: And Pilate asked him again, saying, Answerest thou nothing? behold how many things they witness against thee.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς οὐκέτι οὐδὲν ἀπεκρίθη, ὥστε θαυμάζειν τὸν Πιλᾶτον.
verses.translit: o de Iisous ouketi ouden apekrithi, oste thaymazein ton Pilaton.
verses.translation: But Jesus yet answered nothing; so that Pilate marvelled.

verses.original: Κατὰ δὲ ἑορτὴν ἀπέλυεν αὐτοῖς ἕνα δέσμιον ⸂ὃν παρῃτοῦντο⸃.
verses.translit: Kata de eorten apelyen autois ena desmion on paretounto.
verses.translation: Now at that feast he released unto them one prisoner, whomsoever they desired.

verses.original: ἦν δὲ ὁ λεγόμενος Βαραββᾶς μετὰ τῶν ⸀στασιαστῶν δεδεμένος οἵτινες ἐν τῇ στάσει φόνον πεποιήκεισαν.
verses.translit: en de o legomenos Varavvas meta ton stasiaston dedemenos oitines en te stasei fonon pepoiikeisan.
verses.translation: And there was one named Barabbas, which lay bound with them that had made insurrection with him, who had committed murder in the insurrection.

verses.original: καὶ ⸀ἀναβὰς ὁ ὄχλος ἤρξατο αἰτεῖσθαι ⸀καθὼς ἐποίει αὐτοῖς.
verses.translit: kai anavas o ohlos erxato aiteisthai kathos epoiei autois.
verses.translation: And the multitude crying aloud began to desire him to do as he had ever done unto them.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ Πιλᾶτος ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς λέγων· Θέλετε ἀπολύσω ὑμῖν τὸν βασιλέα τῶν Ἰουδαίων;
verses.translit: o de Pilatos apekrithi autois legon* Thelete apolyso umin ton vasilea ton Ioydaion;
verses.translation: But Pilate answered them, saying, Will ye that I release unto you the King of the Jews?

verses.original: ἐγίνωσκεν γὰρ ὅτι διὰ φθόνον παραδεδώκεισαν αὐτὸν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς.
verses.translit: eginosken gar oti dia fthonon paradedokeisan auton oi arhiereis.
verses.translation: For he knew that the chief priests had delivered him for envy.

verses.original: οἱ δὲ ἀρχιερεῖς ἀνέσεισαν τὸν ὄχλον ἵνα μᾶλλον τὸν Βαραββᾶν ἀπολύσῃ αὐτοῖς.
verses.translit: oi de arhiereis aneseisan ton ohlon ina mallon ton Varavvan apolyse autois.
verses.translation: But the chief priests moved the people, that he should rather release Barabbas unto them.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ Πιλᾶτος ⸂πάλιν ἀποκριθεὶς ἔλεγεν⸃ αὐτοῖς· Τί οὖν ⸀θέλετε ποιήσω ⸂ὃν λέγετε⸃ ⸀τὸν βασιλέα τῶν Ἰουδαίων;
verses.translit: o de Pilatos palin apokritheis elegen autois* Ti oun thelete poiiso on legete ton vasilea ton Ioydaion;
verses.translation: And Pilate answered and said again unto them, What will ye then that I shall do unto him whom ye call the King of the Jews?

verses.original: οἱ δὲ πάλιν ἔκραξαν· Σταύρωσον αὐτόν.
verses.translit: oi de palin ekraxan* Stayroson auton.
verses.translation: And they cried out again, Crucify him.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ Πιλᾶτος ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς· Τί γὰρ ⸂ἐποίησεν κακόν⸃; οἱ δὲ ⸀περισσῶς ἔκραξαν· Σταύρωσον αὐτόν.
verses.translit: o de Pilatos elegen autois* Ti gar epoiisen kakon; oi de perissos ekraxan* Stayroson auton.
verses.translation: Then Pilate said unto them, Why, what evil hath he done? And they cried out the more exceedingly, Crucify him.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ Πιλᾶτος βουλόμενος τῷ ὄχλῳ τὸ ἱκανὸν ποιῆσαι ἀπέλυσεν αὐτοῖς τὸν Βαραββᾶν, καὶ παρέδωκεν τὸν Ἰησοῦν φραγελλώσας ἵνα σταυρωθῇ.
verses.translit: o de Pilatos voylomenos to ohlo to ikanon poiesai apelysen autois ton Varavvan, kai paredoken ton Iisoun fragellosas ina stayrothe.
verses.translation: And so Pilate, willing to content the people, released Barabbas unto them, and delivered Jesus, when he had scourged him , to be crucified.

verses.original: Οἱ δὲ στρατιῶται ἀπήγαγον αὐτὸν ἔσω τῆς αὐλῆς, ὅ ἐστιν πραιτώριον, καὶ συγκαλοῦσιν ὅλην τὴν σπεῖραν.
verses.translit: Oi de stratiotai apigagon auton eso tes aules, o estin praitorion, kai sygkalousin olin ten speiran.
verses.translation: And the soldiers led him away into the hall, called Prætorium; and they call together the whole band.

verses.original: καὶ ⸀ἐνδιδύσκουσιν αὐτὸν πορφύραν καὶ περιτιθέασιν αὐτῷ πλέξαντες ἀκάνθινον στέφανον·
verses.translit: kai endidyskoysin auton porfyran kai perititheasin auto plexantes akanthinon stefanon*
verses.translation: And they clothed him with purple, and platted a crown of thorns, and put it about his head ,

verses.original: καὶ ἤρξαντο ἀσπάζεσθαι αὐτόν· Χαῖρε, ⸀βασιλεῦ τῶν Ἰουδαίων·
verses.translit: kai erxanto aspazesthai auton* Haire, vasileu ton Ioydaion*
verses.translation: And began to salute him, Hail, King of the Jews!

verses.original: καὶ ἔτυπτον αὐτοῦ τὴν κεφαλὴν καλάμῳ καὶ ἐνέπτυον αὐτῷ, καὶ τιθέντες τὰ γόνατα προσεκύνουν αὐτῷ.
verses.translit: kai etypton autou ten kefalen kalamo kai eneptyon auto, kai tithentes ta gonata prosekynoyn auto.
verses.translation: And they smote him on the head with a reed, and did spit upon him, and bowing their knees worshipped him.

verses.original: καὶ ὅτε ἐνέπαιξαν αὐτῷ, ἐξέδυσαν αὐτὸν τὴν πορφύραν καὶ ἐνέδυσαν αὐτὸν τὰ ἱμάτια ⸂τὰ ἴδια⸃. καὶ ἐξάγουσιν αὐτὸν ἵνα ⸀σταυρώσωσιν αὐτόν.
verses.translit: kai ote enepaixan auto, exedysan auton ten porfyran kai enedysan auton ta imatia ta idia. kai exagoysin auton ina stayrososin auton.
verses.translation: And when they had mocked him, they took off the purple from him, and put his own clothes on him, and led him out to crucify him.

verses.original: Καὶ ἀγγαρεύουσιν παράγοντά τινα Σίμωνα Κυρηναῖον ἐρχόμενον ἀπʼ ἀγροῦ, τὸν πατέρα Ἀλεξάνδρου καὶ Ῥούφου, ἵνα ἄρῃ τὸν σταυρὸν αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: Kai aggareyoysin paragonta tina Simona Kyrinaion erhomenon ap' agrou, ton patera Alexandroy kai Royfoy, ina are ton stayron autou.
verses.translation: And they compel one Simon a Cyrenian, who passed by, coming out of the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to bear his cross.

verses.original: καὶ φέρουσιν αὐτὸν ἐπὶ ⸀τὸν ⸀Γολγοθᾶν τόπον, ὅ ἐστιν ⸀μεθερμηνευόμενον Κρανίου Τόπος.
verses.translit: kai feroysin auton epi ton Golgothan topon, o estin methermineyomenon Kranioy Topos.
verses.translation: And they bring him unto the place Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, The place of a skull.

verses.original: καὶ ἐδίδουν ⸀αὐτῷ ἐσμυρνισμένον οἶνον, ⸀ὃς δὲ οὐκ ἔλαβεν.
verses.translit: kai edidoyn auto esmyrnismenon oinon, os de ouk elaven.
verses.translation: And they gave him to drink wine mingled with myrrh: but he received it not.

verses.original: καὶ ⸂σταυροῦσιν αὐτὸν καὶ⸃ διαμερίζονται τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ, βάλλοντες κλῆρον ἐπʼ αὐτὰ τίς τί ἄρῃ.
verses.translit: kai stayrousin auton kai diamerizontai ta imatia autou, vallontes kleron ep' auta tis ti are.
verses.translation: And when they had crucified him, they parted his garments, casting lots upon them, what every man should take.

verses.original: Ἦν δὲ ὥρα τρίτη καὶ ἐσταύρωσαν αὐτόν.
verses.translit: En de ora triti kai estayrosan auton.
verses.translation: And it was the third hour, and they crucified him.

verses.original: καὶ ἦν ἡ ἐπιγραφὴ τῆς αἰτίας αὐτοῦ ἐπιγεγραμμένη· Ὁ βασιλεὺς τῶν Ἰουδαίων.
verses.translit: kai en e epigrafe tes aitias autou epigegrammeni* O vasileus ton Ioydaion.
verses.translation: And the superscription of his accusation was written over, THE KING OF THE JEWS.

verses.original: καὶ σὺν αὐτῷ σταυροῦσιν δύο λῃστάς, ἕνα ἐκ δεξιῶν καὶ ἕνα ἐξ εὐωνύμων ⸀αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: kai sun auto stayrousin dyo lestas, ena ek dexion kai ena ex euonymon autou.
verses.translation: And with him they crucify two thieves; the one on his right hand, and the other on his left.
And the scripture was fulfilled, which saith, And he was numbered with the transgressors.

verses.original: Καὶ οἱ παραπορευόμενοι ἐβλασφήμουν αὐτὸν κινοῦντες τὰς κεφαλὰς αὐτῶν καὶ λέγοντες· Οὐὰ ὁ καταλύων τὸν ναὸν καὶ ⸂οἰκοδομῶν ἐν τρισὶν ἡμέραις⸃,
verses.translit: Kai oi paraporeyomenoi evlasfimoyn auton kinountes tas kefalas auton kai legontes* Oua o katalyon ton naon kai oikodomon en trisin emerais,
verses.translation: And they that passed by railed on him, wagging their heads, and saying, Ah, thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days,

verses.original: σῶσον σεαυτὸν ⸀καταβὰς ἀπὸ τοῦ σταυροῦ.
verses.translit: soson seayton katavas apo tou stayrou.
verses.translation: Save thyself, and come down from the cross.

verses.original: ὁμοίως καὶ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς ἐμπαίζοντες πρὸς ἀλλήλους μετὰ τῶν γραμματέων ἔλεγον· Ἄλλους ἔσωσεν, ἑαυτὸν οὐ δύναται σῶσαι·
verses.translit: omoios kai oi arhiereis empaizontes pros alliloys meta ton grammateon elegon* Alloys esosen, eayton ou dynatai sosai*
verses.translation: Likewise also the chief priests mocking said among themselves with the scribes, He saved others; himself he cannot save.

verses.original: ὁ χριστὸς ὁ ⸀βασιλεὺς Ἰσραὴλ καταβάτω νῦν ἀπὸ τοῦ σταυροῦ, ἵνα ἴδωμεν καὶ ⸀πιστεύσωμεν. καὶ οἱ συνεσταυρωμένοι ⸀σὺν αὐτῷ ὠνείδιζον αὐτόν.
verses.translit: o hristos o vasileus Israel katavato nun apo tou stayrou, ina idomen kai pisteysomen. kai oi synestayromenoi sun auto oneidizon auton.
verses.translation: Let Christ the King of Israel descend now from the cross, that we may see and believe. And they that were crucified with him reviled him.

verses.original: ⸂Καὶ γενομένης⸃ ὥρας ἕκτης σκότος ἐγένετο ἐφʼ ὅλην τὴν γῆν ἕως ὥρας ἐνάτης.
verses.translit: Kai genomenis oras ektis skotos egeneto ef' olin ten gen eos oras enatis.
verses.translation: And when the sixth hour was come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.

verses.original: καὶ τῇ ⸂ἐνάτῃ ὥρᾳ⸃ ἐβόησεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς φωνῇ ⸀μεγάλῃ· Ἐλωῒ ἐλωῒ ⸀λεμὰ σαβαχθάνι; ὅ ἐστιν μεθερμηνευόμενον Ὁ θεός μου ὁ θεός μου, εἰς τί ⸂ἐγκατέλιπές με⸃;
verses.translit: kai te enate ora evoisen o Iisous fone megale* Eloi eloi lema savahthani; o estin methermineyomenon O theos moy o theos moy, eis ti egkatelipes me;
verses.translation: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?

verses.original: καί τινες τῶν παρεστηκότων ἀκούσαντες ἔλεγον· ⸀Ἴδε Ἠλίαν φωνεῖ.
verses.translit: kai tines ton parestikoton akoysantes elegon* Ide Elian fonei.
verses.translation: And some of them that stood by, when they heard it , said, Behold, he calleth Elias.

verses.original: δραμὼν δέ ⸂τις καὶ⸃ γεμίσας σπόγγον ὄξους ⸀περιθεὶς καλάμῳ ἐπότιζεν αὐτόν, λέγων· Ἄφετε ἴδωμεν εἰ ἔρχεται Ἠλίας καθελεῖν αὐτόν.
verses.translit: dramon de tis kai gemisas spoggon oxoys peritheis kalamo epotizen auton, legon* Afete idomen ei erhetai Elias kathelein auton.
verses.translation: And one ran and filled a spunge full of vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink, saying, Let alone; let us see whether Elias will come to take him down.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς ἀφεὶς φωνὴν μεγάλην ἐξέπνευσεν.
verses.translit: o de Iisous afeis fonen megalin exepneysen.
verses.translation: And Jesus cried with a loud voice, and gave up the ghost.

verses.original: καὶ τὸ καταπέτασμα τοῦ ναοῦ ἐσχίσθη εἰς δύο ἀπʼ ἄνωθεν ἕως κάτω.
verses.translit: kai to katapetasma tou naou eshisthi eis dyo ap' anothen eos kato.
verses.translation: And the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom.

verses.original: ἰδὼν δὲ ὁ κεντυρίων ὁ παρεστηκὼς ἐξ ἐναντίας αὐτοῦ ὅτι ⸀οὕτως ἐξέπνευσεν εἶπεν· Ἀληθῶς ⸂οὗτος ὁ ἄνθρωπος⸃ υἱὸς ⸂θεοῦ ἦν⸃.
verses.translit: idon de o kentyrion o parestikos ex enantias autou oti outos exepneysen eipen* Alithos outos o anthropos yios theou en.
verses.translation: And when the centurion, which stood over against him, saw that he so cried out, and gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.

verses.original: Ἦσαν δὲ καὶ γυναῖκες ἀπὸ μακρόθεν θεωροῦσαι, ἐν ⸀αἷς καὶ ⸀Μαρία ἡ Μαγδαληνὴ καὶ Μαρία ⸀ἡ Ἰακώβου τοῦ μικροῦ καὶ ⸀Ἰωσῆτος μήτηρ καὶ Σαλώμη,
verses.translit: Esan de kai gynaikes apo makrothen theorousai, en ais kai Maria e Magdaline kai Maria e Iakovoy tou mikrou kai Iosetos mitir kai Salomi,
verses.translation: There were also women looking on afar off: among whom was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;

verses.original: ⸀αἳ ὅτε ἦν ἐν τῇ Γαλιλαίᾳ ἠκολούθουν αὐτῷ καὶ διηκόνουν αὐτῷ, καὶ ἄλλαι πολλαὶ αἱ συναναβᾶσαι αὐτῷ εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα.
verses.translit: ai ote en en te Galilaia ekoloythoyn auto kai diikonoyn auto, kai allai pollai ai synanavasai auto eis Ierosolyma.
verses.translation: (Who also, when he was in Galilee, followed him, and ministered unto him;) and many other women which came up with him unto Jerusalem.

verses.original: Καὶ ἤδη ὀψίας γενομένης, ἐπεὶ ἦν παρασκευή, ὅ ἐστιν ⸀προσάββατον,
verses.translit: Kai edi opsias genomenis, epei en paraskeyi, o estin prosavvaton,
verses.translation: And now when the even was come, because it was the preparation, that is, the day before the sabbath,

verses.original: ⸀ἐλθὼν Ἰωσὴφ ⸀ὁ ἀπὸ Ἁριμαθαίας εὐσχήμων βουλευτής, ὃς καὶ αὐτὸς ἦν προσδεχόμενος τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ, τολμήσας εἰσῆλθεν πρὸς ⸀τὸν Πιλᾶτον καὶ ᾐτήσατο τὸ σῶμα τοῦ Ἰησοῦ.
verses.translit: elthon Iosef o apo Arimathaias eushimon voyleytis, os kai autos en prosdehomenos ten vasileian tou theou, tolmisas eiselthen pros ton Pilaton kai etisato to soma tou Iisou.
verses.translation: Joseph of Arimathaea, an honourable counsellor, which also waited for the kingdom of God, came, and went in boldly unto Pilate, and craved the body of Jesus.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ Πιλᾶτος ἐθαύμασεν εἰ ἤδη τέθνηκεν, καὶ προσκαλεσάμενος τὸν κεντυρίωνα ἐπηρώτησεν αὐτὸν εἰ ⸀πάλαι ἀπέθανεν·
verses.translit: o de Pilatos ethaymasen ei edi tethniken, kai proskalesamenos ton kentyriona epirotisen auton ei palai apethanen*
verses.translation: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead: and calling unto him the centurion, he asked him whether he had been any while dead.

verses.original: καὶ γνοὺς ἀπὸ τοῦ κεντυρίωνος ἐδωρήσατο τὸ ⸀πτῶμα τῷ Ἰωσήφ.
verses.translit: kai gnous apo tou kentyrionos edorisato to ptoma to Iosif.
verses.translation: And when he knew it of the centurion, he gave the body to Joseph.

verses.original: καὶ ἀγοράσας ⸀σινδόνα καθελὼν αὐτὸν ἐνείλησεν τῇ σινδόνι καὶ ⸀ἔθηκεν αὐτὸν ἐν ⸀μνημείῳ ὃ ἦν λελατομημένον ἐκ πέτρας, καὶ προσεκύλισεν λίθον ἐπὶ τὴν θύραν τοῦ μνημείου.
verses.translit: kai agorasas sindona kathelon auton eneilisen te sindoni kai ethiken auton en mnimeio o en lelatomimenon ek petras, kai prosekylisen lithon epi ten thyran tou mnimeioy.
verses.translation: And he bought fine linen, and took him down, and wrapped him in the linen, and laid him in a sepulchre which was hewn out of a rock, and rolled a stone unto the door of the sepulchre.

verses.original: ἡ δὲ Μαρία ἡ Μαγδαληνὴ καὶ Μαρία ⸂ἡ Ἰωσῆτος⸃ ἐθεώρουν ποῦ ⸀τέθειται.
verses.translit: e de Maria e Magdaline kai Maria e Iosetos etheoroyn pou tetheitai.
verses.translation: And Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses beheld where he was laid.

verses.original: Καὶ διαγενομένου τοῦ σαββάτου ⸀Μαρία ἡ Μαγδαληνὴ καὶ Μαρία ⸂ἡ τοῦ⸃ Ἰακώβου καὶ Σαλώμη ἠγόρασαν ἀρώματα ἵνα ἐλθοῦσαι ἀλείψωσιν αὐτόν.
verses.translit: Kai diagenomenoy tou savvatoy Maria e Magdaline kai Maria e tou Iakovoy kai Salomi egorasan aromata ina elthousai aleipsosin auton.
verses.translation: And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, had bought sweet spices, that they might come and anoint him.

verses.original: καὶ λίαν πρωῒ ⸂τῇ μιᾷ τῶν⸃ σαββάτων ἔρχονται ἐπὶ τὸ μνημεῖον ἀνατείλαντος τοῦ ἡλίου.
verses.translit: kai lian proi te mia ton savvaton erhontai epi to mnimeion anateilantos tou elioy.
verses.translation: And very early in the morning the first day of the week, they came unto the sepulchre at the rising of the sun.

verses.original: καὶ ἔλεγον πρὸς ἑαυτάς· Τίς ἀποκυλίσει ἡμῖν τὸν λίθον ⸀ἐκ τῆς θύρας τοῦ μνημείου;
verses.translit: kai elegon pros eaytas* Tis apokylisei emin ton lithon ek tes thyras tou mnimeioy;
verses.translation: And they said among themselves, Who shall roll us away the stone from the door of the sepulchre?

verses.original: καὶ ἀναβλέψασαι θεωροῦσιν ὅτι ⸀ἀποκεκύλισται ὁ λίθος, ἦν γὰρ μέγας σφόδρα.
verses.translit: kai anavlepsasai theorousin oti apokekylistai o lithos, en gar megas sfodra.
verses.translation: And when they looked, they saw that the stone was rolled away: for it was very great.

verses.original: καὶ εἰσελθοῦσαι εἰς τὸ μνημεῖον εἶδον νεανίσκον καθήμενον ἐν τοῖς δεξιοῖς περιβεβλημένον στολὴν λευκήν, καὶ ἐξεθαμβήθησαν.
verses.translit: kai eiselthousai eis to mnimeion eidon neaniskon kathimenon en tois dexiois perivevlimenon stolen leykin, kai exethamvithisan.
verses.translation: And entering into the sepulchre, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, clothed in a long white garment; and they were affrighted.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ λέγει αὐταῖς· Μὴ ἐκθαμβεῖσθε· Ἰησοῦν ζητεῖτε τὸν Ναζαρηνὸν τὸν ἐσταυρωμένον· ἠγέρθη, οὐκ ἔστιν ὧδε· ἴδε ὁ τόπος ὅπου ἔθηκαν αὐτόν·
verses.translit: o de legei autais* Me ekthamveisthe* Iisoun ziteite ton Nazarinon ton estayromenon* egerthi, ouk estin ode* ide o topos opoy ethikan auton*
verses.translation: And he saith unto them, Be not affrighted: Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth, which was crucified: he is risen; he is not here: behold the place where they laid him.

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ὑπάγετε εἴπατε τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ καὶ τῷ Πέτρῳ ὅτι Προάγει ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν· ἐκεῖ αὐτὸν ὄψεσθε, καθὼς εἶπεν ὑμῖν.
verses.translit: alla upagete eipate tois mathitais autou kai to Petro oti Proagei umas eis ten Galilaian* ekei auton opsesthe, kathos eipen umin.
verses.translation: But go your way, tell his disciples and Peter that he goeth before you into Galilee: there shall ye see him, as he said unto you.

verses.original: καὶ ἐξελθοῦσαι ἔφυγον ἀπὸ τοῦ μνημείου, εἶχεν ⸀γὰρ αὐτὰς τρόμος καὶ ἔκστασις· καὶ οὐδενὶ οὐδὲν εἶπαν, ἐφοβοῦντο ⸁γάρ. ⟦Πάντα δὲ τὰ παρηγγελμένα τοῖς περὶ τὸν Πέτρον συντόμως ἐξήγγειλαν. μετὰ δὲ ταῦτα καὶ αὐτὸς ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀπὸ ἀνατολῆς καὶ ἄχρι δύσεως ἐξαπέστειλεν διʼ αὐτῶν τὸ ἱερὸν καὶ ἄφθαρτον κήρυγμα τῆς αἰωνίου σωτηρίας. ἀμήν.⟧
verses.translit: kai exelthousai efygon apo tou mnimeioy, eihen gar autas tromos kai ekstasis* kai oudeni ouden eipan, efovounto gar. Panta de ta pariggelmena tois peri ton Petron syntomos exiggeilan. meta de tauta kai autos o Iisous apo anatoles kai ahri dyseos exapesteilen di' auton to ieron kai aftharton kirygma tes aionioy sotirias. amin.
verses.translation: And they went out quickly, and fled from the sepulchre; for they trembled and were amazed: neither said they any thing to any man ; for they were afraid.

verses.original: ⟦Ἀναστὰς δὲ πρωῒ πρώτῃ σαββάτου ἐφάνη πρῶτον Μαρίᾳ τῇ Μαγδαληνῇ, ⸀παρʼ ἧς ἐκβεβλήκει ἑπτὰ δαιμόνια.
verses.translit: Anastas de proi prote savvatoy efani proton Maria te Magdaline, par' es ekvevlikei epta daimonia.
verses.translation: Now when Jesus was risen early the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had cast seven devils.

verses.original: ἐκείνη πορευθεῖσα ἀπήγγειλεν τοῖς μετʼ αὐτοῦ γενομένοις πενθοῦσι καὶ κλαίουσιν·
verses.translit: ekeini poreytheisa apiggeilen tois met' autou genomenois penthousi kai klaioysin*
verses.translation: And she went and told them that had been with him, as they mourned and wept.

verses.original: κἀκεῖνοι ἀκούσαντες ὅτι ζῇ καὶ ἐθεάθη ὑπʼ αὐτῆς ἠπίστησαν.
verses.translit: kakeinoi akoysantes oti ze kai etheathi up' autes epistisan.
verses.translation: And they, when they had heard that he was alive, and had been seen of her, believed not.

verses.original: Μετὰ δὲ ταῦτα δυσὶν ἐξ αὐτῶν περιπατοῦσιν ἐφανερώθη ἐν ἑτέρᾳ μορφῇ πορευομένοις εἰς ἀγρόν·
verses.translit: Meta de tauta dysin ex auton peripatousin efanerothi en etera morfe poreyomenois eis agron*
verses.translation: After that he appeared in another form unto two of them, as they walked, and went into the country.

verses.original: κἀκεῖνοι ἀπελθόντες ἀπήγγειλαν τοῖς λοιποῖς· οὐδὲ ἐκείνοις ἐπίστευσαν.
verses.translit: kakeinoi apelthontes apiggeilan tois loipois* oude ekeinois episteysan.
verses.translation: And they went and told it unto the residue: neither believed they them.

verses.original: Ὕστερον ⸀δὲ ἀνακειμένοις αὐτοῖς τοῖς ἕνδεκα ἐφανερώθη, καὶ ὠνείδισεν τὴν ἀπιστίαν αὐτῶν καὶ σκληροκαρδίαν ὅτι τοῖς θεασαμένοις αὐτὸν ⸀ἐγηγερμένον οὐκ ἐπίστευσαν.
verses.translit: Usteron de anakeimenois autois tois endeka efanerothi, kai oneidisen ten apistian auton kai sklirokardian oti tois theasamenois auton egigermenon ouk episteysan.
verses.translation: Afterward he appeared unto the eleven as they sat at meat, and upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they believed not them which had seen him after he was risen.

verses.original: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Πορευθέντες εἰς τὸν κόσμον ἅπαντα κηρύξατε τὸ εὐαγγέλιον πάσῃ τῇ κτίσει.
verses.translit: kai eipen autois* Poreythentes eis ton kosmon apanta kiryxate to euaggelion pase te ktisei.
verses.translation: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.

verses.original: ὁ πιστεύσας καὶ βαπτισθεὶς σωθήσεται, ὁ δὲ ἀπιστήσας κατακριθήσεται.
verses.translit: o pisteysas kai vaptistheis sothisetai, o de apistisas katakrithisetai.
verses.translation: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved; but he that believeth not shall be damned.

verses.original: σημεῖα δὲ τοῖς πιστεύσασιν ⸂ταῦτα παρακολουθήσει⸃, ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου δαιμόνια ἐκβαλοῦσιν, γλώσσαις λαλήσουσιν ⸀καιναῖς,
verses.translit: simeia de tois pisteysasin tauta parakoloythisei, en to onomati moy daimonia ekvalousin, glossais lalisoysin kainais,
verses.translation: And these signs shall follow them that believe; In my name shall they cast out devils; they shall speak with new tongues;

verses.original: ⸀ὄφεις ἀροῦσιν κἂν θανάσιμόν τι πίωσιν οὐ μὴ αὐτοὺς βλάψῃ, ἐπὶ ἀρρώστους χεῖρας ἐπιθήσουσιν καὶ καλῶς ἕξουσιν.
verses.translit: ofeis arousin kan thanasimon ti piosin ou me autous vlapse, epi arrostoys heiras epithisoysin kai kalos exoysin.
verses.translation: They shall take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it shall not hurt them; they shall lay hands on the sick, and they shall recover.

verses.original: Ὁ μὲν οὖν κύριος ⸀Ἰησοῦς μετὰ τὸ λαλῆσαι αὐτοῖς ἀνελήμφθη εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ ἐκάθισεν ἐκ δεξιῶν τοῦ θεοῦ.
verses.translit: O men oun kyrios Iisous meta to lalesai autois anelimfthi eis ton ouranon kai ekathisen ek dexion tou theou.
verses.translation: So then after the Lord had spoken unto them, he was received up into heaven, and sat on the right hand of God.

verses.original: ἐκεῖνοι δὲ ἐξελθόντες ἐκήρυξαν πανταχοῦ, τοῦ κυρίου συνεργοῦντος καὶ τὸν λόγον βεβαιοῦντος διὰ τῶν ἐπακολουθούντων ⸀σημείων.⟧
verses.translit: ekeinoi de exelthontes ekiryxan pantahou, tou kyrioy synergountos kai ton logon vevaiountos dia ton epakoloythoynton simeion.
verses.translation: And they went forth, and preached every where, the Lord working with them , and confirming the word with signs following. Amen.

verses.original: Ἐπειδήπερ πολλοὶ ἐπεχείρησαν ἀνατάξασθαι διήγησιν περὶ τῶν πεπληροφορημένων ἐν ἡμῖν πραγμάτων,
verses.translit: Epeidiper polloi epeheirisan anataxasthai diigisin peri ton pepliroforimenon en emin pragmaton,
verses.translation: Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us,

verses.original: καθὼς παρέδοσαν ἡμῖν οἱ ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς αὐτόπται καὶ ὑπηρέται γενόμενοι τοῦ λόγου,
verses.translit: kathos paredosan emin oi ap' arhes autoptai kai upiretai genomenoi tou logoy,
verses.translation: Even as they delivered them unto us, which from the beginning were eyewitnesses, and ministers of the word;

verses.original: ἔδοξε κἀμοὶ παρηκολουθηκότι ἄνωθεν πᾶσιν ἀκριβῶς καθεξῆς σοι γράψαι, κράτιστε Θεόφιλε,
verses.translit: edoxe kamoi parikoloythikoti anothen pasin akrivos kathexes soi grapsai, kratiste Theofile,
verses.translation: It seemed good to me also, having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first, to write unto thee in order, most excellent Theophilus,

verses.original: ἵνα ἐπιγνῷς περὶ ὧν κατηχήθης λόγων τὴν ἀσφάλειαν.
verses.translit: ina epignos peri on katihithis logon ten asfaleian.
verses.translation: That thou mightest know the certainty of those things, wherein thou hast been instructed.

verses.original: Ἐγένετο ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ⸀Ἡρῴδου βασιλέως τῆς Ἰουδαίας ἱερεύς τις ὀνόματι Ζαχαρίας ἐξ ἐφημερίας Ἀβιά, ⸀καὶ γυνὴ ⸀αὐτῷ ἐκ τῶν θυγατέρων Ἀαρών, καὶ τὸ ὄνομα αὐτῆς Ἐλισάβετ.
verses.translit: Egeneto en tais emerais Erodoy vasileos tes Ioydaias iereys tis onomati Zaharias ex efimerias Avia, kai gyne auto ek ton thygateron Aaron, kai to onoma autes Elisavet.
verses.translation: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judæa, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the course of Abia: and his wife was of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elisabeth.

verses.original: ἦσαν δὲ δίκαιοι ἀμφότεροι ⸀ἐναντίον τοῦ θεοῦ, πορευόμενοι ἐν πάσαις ταῖς ἐντολαῖς καὶ δικαιώμασιν τοῦ κυρίου ἄμεμπτοι.
verses.translit: esan de dikaioi amfoteroi enantion tou theou, poreyomenoi en pasais tais entolais kai dikaiomasin tou kyrioy amemptoi.
verses.translation: And they were both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless.

verses.original: καὶ οὐκ ἦν αὐτοῖς τέκνον, καθότι ⸂ἦν ἡ Ἐλισάβετ⸃ στεῖρα, καὶ ἀμφότεροι προβεβηκότες ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις αὐτῶν ἦσαν.
verses.translit: kai ouk en autois teknon, kathoti en e Elisavet steira, kai amfoteroi provevikotes en tais emerais auton esan.
verses.translation: And they had no child, because that Elisabeth was barren, and they both were now well stricken in years.

verses.original: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῷ ἱερατεύειν αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ τάξει τῆς ἐφημερίας αὐτοῦ ἔναντι τοῦ θεοῦ
verses.translit: Egeneto de en to ierateyein auton en te taxei tes efimerias autou enanti tou theou
verses.translation: And it came to pass, that while he executed the priest’s office before God in the order of his course,

verses.original: κατὰ τὸ ἔθος τῆς ἱερατείας ἔλαχε τοῦ θυμιᾶσαι εἰσελθὼν εἰς τὸν ναὸν τοῦ κυρίου,
verses.translit: kata to ethos tes ierateias elahe tou thymiasai eiselthon eis ton naon tou kyrioy,
verses.translation: According to the custom of the priest’s office, his lot was to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord.

verses.original: καὶ πᾶν τὸ πλῆθος ἦν τοῦ λαοῦ προσευχόμενον ἔξω τῇ ὥρᾳ τοῦ θυμιάματος·
verses.translit: kai pan to plethos en tou laou proseyhomenon exo te ora tou thymiamatos*
verses.translation: And the whole multitude of the people were praying without at the time of incense.

verses.original: ὤφθη δὲ αὐτῷ ἄγγελος κυρίου ἑστὼς ἐκ δεξιῶν τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου τοῦ θυμιάματος.
verses.translit: ofthi de auto aggelos kyrioy estos ek dexion tou thysiastirioy tou thymiamatos.
verses.translation: And there appeared unto him an angel of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense.

verses.original: καὶ ἐταράχθη Ζαχαρίας ἰδών, καὶ φόβος ἐπέπεσεν ἐπʼ αὐτόν.
verses.translit: kai etarahthi Zaharias idon, kai fovos epepesen ep' auton.
verses.translation: And when Zacharias saw him , he was troubled, and fear fell upon him.

verses.original: εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτὸν ὁ ἄγγελος· Μὴ φοβοῦ, Ζαχαρία, διότι εἰσηκούσθη ἡ δέησίς σου, καὶ ἡ γυνή σου Ἐλισάβετ γεννήσει υἱόν σοι, καὶ καλέσεις τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἰωάννην·
verses.translit: eipen de pros auton o aggelos* Me fovou, Zaharia, dioti eisikoysthi e deisis soy, kai e gyni soy Elisavet gennisei yion soi, kai kaleseis to onoma autou Ioannin*
verses.translation: But the angel said unto him, Fear not, Zacharias: for thy prayer is heard; and thy wife Elisabeth shall bear thee a son, and thou shalt call his name John.

verses.original: καὶ ἔσται χαρά σοι καὶ ἀγαλλίασις, καὶ πολλοὶ ἐπὶ τῇ ⸀γενέσει αὐτοῦ χαρήσονται·
verses.translit: kai estai hara soi kai agalliasis, kai polloi epi te genesei autou harisontai*
verses.translation: And thou shalt have joy and gladness; and many shall rejoice at his birth.

verses.original: ἔσται γὰρ μέγας ἐνώπιον ⸀τοῦ κυρίου, καὶ οἶνον καὶ σίκερα οὐ μὴ πίῃ, καὶ πνεύματος ἁγίου πλησθήσεται ἔτι ἐκ κοιλίας μητρὸς αὐτοῦ,
verses.translit: estai gar megas enopion tou kyrioy, kai oinon kai sikera ou me pie, kai pneymatos agioy plisthisetai eti ek koilias mitros autou,
verses.translation: For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord, and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink; and he shall be filled with the Holy Ghost, even from his mother’s womb.

verses.original: καὶ πολλοὺς τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ ἐπιστρέψει ἐπὶ κύριον τὸν θεὸν αὐτῶν·
verses.translit: kai pollous ton yion Israel epistrepsei epi kyrion ton theon auton*
verses.translation: And many of the children of Israel shall he turn to the Lord their God.

verses.original: καὶ αὐτὸς προελεύσεται ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ ἐν πνεύματι καὶ δυνάμει Ἠλίου, ἐπιστρέψαι καρδίας πατέρων ἐπὶ τέκνα καὶ ἀπειθεῖς ἐν φρονήσει δικαίων, ἑτοιμάσαι κυρίῳ λαὸν κατεσκευασμένον.
verses.translit: kai autos proeleysetai enopion autou en pneymati kai dynamei Elioy, epistrepsai kardias pateron epi tekna kai apeitheis en fronisei dikaion, etoimasai kyrio laon kateskeyasmenon.
verses.translation: And he shall go before him in the spirit and power of Elias, to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children, and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to make ready a people prepared for the Lord.

verses.original: καὶ εἶπεν Ζαχαρίας πρὸς τὸν ἄγγελον· Κατὰ τί γνώσομαι τοῦτο; ἐγὼ γάρ εἰμι πρεσβύτης καὶ ἡ γυνή μου προβεβηκυῖα ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις αὐτῆς.
verses.translit: kai eipen Zaharias pros ton aggelon* Kata ti gnosomai touto; ego gar eimi presvytis kai e gyni moy provevikyia en tais emerais autes.
verses.translation: And Zacharias said unto the angel, Whereby shall I know this? for I am an old man, and my wife well stricken in years.

verses.original: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ ἄγγελος εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Ἐγώ εἰμι Γαβριὴλ ὁ παρεστηκὼς ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ, καὶ ἀπεστάλην λαλῆσαι πρὸς σὲ καὶ εὐαγγελίσασθαί σοι ταῦτα·
verses.translit: kai apokritheis o aggelos eipen auto* Ego eimi Gavriel o parestikos enopion tou theou, kai apestalin lalesai pros se kai euaggelisasthai soi tauta*
verses.translation: And the angel answering said unto him, I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of God; and am sent to speak unto thee, and to shew thee these glad tidings.

verses.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἔσῃ σιωπῶν καὶ μὴ δυνάμενος λαλῆσαι ἄχρι ἧς ἡμέρας γένηται ταῦτα, ἀνθʼ ὧν οὐκ ἐπίστευσας τοῖς λόγοις μου, οἵτινες πληρωθήσονται εἰς τὸν καιρὸν αὐτῶν.
verses.translit: kai idou ese siopon kai me dynamenos lalesai ahri es emeras genitai tauta, anth' on ouk episteysas tois logois moy, oitines plirothisontai eis ton kairon auton.
verses.translation: And, behold, thou shalt be dumb, and not able to speak, until the day that these things shall be performed, because thou believest not my words, which shall be fulfilled in their season.

verses.original: Καὶ ἦν ὁ λαὸς προσδοκῶν τὸν Ζαχαρίαν, καὶ ἐθαύμαζον ἐν τῷ χρονίζειν ⸂ἐν τῷ ναῷ αὐτόν⸃.
verses.translit: Kai en o laos prosdokon ton Zaharian, kai ethaymazon en to hronizein en to nao auton.
verses.translation: And the people waited for Zacharias, and marvelled that he tarried so long in the temple.

verses.original: ἐξελθὼν δὲ οὐκ ⸀ἐδύνατο λαλῆσαι αὐτοῖς, καὶ ἐπέγνωσαν ὅτι ὀπτασίαν ἑώρακεν ἐν τῷ ναῷ· καὶ αὐτὸς ἦν διανεύων αὐτοῖς, καὶ διέμενεν κωφός.
verses.translit: exelthon de ouk edynato lalesai autois, kai epegnosan oti optasian eoraken en to nao* kai autos en dianeyon autois, kai diemenen kofos.
verses.translation: And when he came out, he could not speak unto them: and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple: for he beckoned unto them, and remained speechless.

verses.original: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἐπλήσθησαν αἱ ἡμέραι τῆς λειτουργίας αὐτοῦ, ἀπῆλθεν εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: kai egeneto os eplisthisan ai emerai tes leitoyrgias autou, apelthen eis ton oikon autou.
verses.translation: And it came to pass, that, as soon as the days of his ministration were accomplished, he departed to his own house.

verses.original: Μετὰ δὲ ταύτας τὰς ἡμέρας συνέλαβεν Ἐλισάβετ ἡ γυνὴ αὐτοῦ· καὶ περιέκρυβεν ἑαυτὴν μῆνας πέντε, λέγουσα
verses.translit: Meta de taytas tas emeras synelaven Elisavet e gyne autou* kai periekryven eayten menas pente, legoysa
verses.translation: And after those days his wife Elisabeth conceived, and hid herself five months, saying,

verses.original: ὅτι Οὕτως μοι ⸀πεποίηκεν κύριος ἐν ἡμέραις αἷς ἐπεῖδεν ⸀ἀφελεῖν ὄνειδός μου ἐν ἀνθρώποις.
verses.translit: oti Outos moi pepoiiken kyrios en emerais ais epeiden afelein oneidos moy en anthropois.
verses.translation: Thus hath the Lord dealt with me in the days wherein he looked on me , to take away my reproach among men.

verses.original: Ἐν δὲ τῷ μηνὶ τῷ ἕκτῳ ἀπεστάλη ὁ ἄγγελος Γαβριὴλ ⸀ἀπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ εἰς πόλιν τῆς Γαλιλαίας ᾗ ὄνομα Ναζαρὲθ
verses.translit: En de to mini to ekto apestali o aggelos Gavriel apo tou theou eis polin tes Galilaias e onoma Nazareth
verses.translation: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,

verses.original: πρὸς παρθένον ⸀ἐμνηστευμένην ἀνδρὶ ᾧ ὄνομα Ἰωσὴφ ἐξ οἴκου Δαυίδ, καὶ τὸ ὄνομα τῆς παρθένου Μαριάμ.
verses.translit: pros parthenon emnisteymenin andri o onoma Iosef ex oikoy Dayid, kai to onoma tes parthenoy Mariam.
verses.translation: To a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David; and the virgin’s name was Mary.

verses.original: καὶ ⸀εἰσελθὼν πρὸς αὐτὴν εἶπεν· Χαῖρε, κεχαριτωμένη, ὁ κύριος μετὰ ⸀σοῦ.
verses.translit: kai eiselthon pros auten eipen* Haire, keharitomeni, o kyrios meta sou.
verses.translation: And the angel came in unto her, and said, Hail, thou that art highly favoured, the Lord is with thee: blessed art thou among women.

verses.original: ἡ δὲ ⸂ἐπὶ τῷ λόγῳ διεταράχθη⸃ καὶ διελογίζετο ποταπὸς εἴη ὁ ἀσπασμὸς οὗτος.
verses.translit: e de epi to logo dietarahthi kai dielogizeto potapos eii o aspasmos outos.
verses.translation: And when she saw him , she was troubled at his saying, and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this should be.

verses.original: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ ἄγγελος αὐτῇ· Μὴ φοβοῦ, Μαριάμ, εὗρες γὰρ χάριν παρὰ τῷ θεῷ·
verses.translit: kai eipen o aggelos aute* Me fovou, Mariam, eures gar harin para to theo*
verses.translation: And the angel said unto her, Fear not, Mary: for thou hast found favour with God.

verses.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ συλλήμψῃ ἐν γαστρὶ καὶ τέξῃ υἱόν, καὶ καλέσεις τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦν.
verses.translit: kai idou syllimpse en gastri kai texe yion, kai kaleseis to onoma autou Iisoun.
verses.translation: And, behold, thou shalt conceive in thy womb, and bring forth a son, and shalt call his name JESUS.

verses.original: οὗτος ἔσται μέγας καὶ υἱὸς Ὑψίστου κληθήσεται, καὶ δώσει αὐτῷ κύριος ὁ θεὸς τὸν θρόνον Δαυὶδ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ,
verses.translit: outos estai megas kai yios Upsistoy klithisetai, kai dosei auto kyrios o theos ton thronon Dayid tou patros autou,
verses.translation: He shall be great, and shall be called the Son of the Highest: and the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David:

verses.original: καὶ βασιλεύσει ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον Ἰακὼβ εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας, καὶ τῆς βασιλείας αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἔσται τέλος.
verses.translit: kai vasileysei epi ton oikon Iakov eis tous aionas, kai tes vasileias autou ouk estai telos.
verses.translation: And he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever; and of his kingdom there shall be no end.

verses.original: εἶπεν δὲ Μαριὰμ πρὸς τὸν ἄγγελον· Πῶς ἔσται τοῦτο, ἐπεὶ ἄνδρα οὐ γινώσκω;
verses.translit: eipen de Mariam pros ton aggelon* Pos estai touto, epei andra ou ginosko;
verses.translation: Then said Mary unto the angel, How shall this be, seeing I know not a man?

verses.original: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ ἄγγελος εἶπεν αὐτῇ· Πνεῦμα ἅγιον ἐπελεύσεται ἐπὶ σέ, καὶ δύναμις Ὑψίστου ἐπισκιάσει σοι· διὸ καὶ τὸ γεννώμενον ἅγιον κληθήσεται, υἱὸς θεοῦ·
verses.translit: kai apokritheis o aggelos eipen aute* Pneuma agion epeleysetai epi se, kai dynamis Upsistoy episkiasei soi* dio kai to gennomenon agion klithisetai, yios theou*
verses.translation: And the angel answered and said unto her, The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee: therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God.

verses.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ Ἐλισάβετ ἡ ⸀συγγενίς σου καὶ αὐτὴ ⸀συνείληφεν υἱὸν ἐν γήρει αὐτῆς, καὶ οὗτος μὴν ἕκτος ἐστὶν αὐτῇ τῇ καλουμένῃ στείρᾳ·
verses.translit: kai idou Elisavet e syggenis soy kai aute syneilifen yion en girei autes, kai outos men ektos estin aute te kaloymene steira*
verses.translation: And, behold, thy cousin Elisabeth, she hath also conceived a son in her old age: and this is the sixth month with her, who was called barren.

verses.original: ὅτι οὐκ ἀδυνατήσει παρὰ ⸂τοῦ θεοῦ⸃ πᾶν ῥῆμα.
verses.translit: oti ouk adynatisei para tou theou pan Rema.
verses.translation: For with God nothing shall be impossible.

verses.original: εἶπεν δὲ Μαριάμ· Ἰδοὺ ἡ δούλη κυρίου· γένοιτό μοι κατὰ τὸ ῥῆμά σου. καὶ ἀπῆλθεν ἀπʼ αὐτῆς ὁ ἄγγελος.
verses.translit: eipen de Mariam* Idou e doyli kyrioy* genoito moi kata to Rema soy. kai apelthen ap' autes o aggelos.
verses.translation: And Mary said, Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.

verses.original: Ἀναστᾶσα δὲ Μαριὰμ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ταύταις ἐπορεύθη εἰς τὴν ὀρεινὴν μετὰ σπουδῆς εἰς πόλιν Ἰούδα,
verses.translit: Anastasa de Mariam en tais emerais taytais eporeythi eis ten oreinen meta spoydes eis polin Ioyda,
verses.translation: And Mary arose in those days, and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Juda;

verses.original: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὸν οἶκον Ζαχαρίου καὶ ἠσπάσατο τὴν Ἐλισάβετ.
verses.translit: kai eiselthen eis ton oikon Zaharioy kai espasato ten Elisavet.
verses.translation: And entered into the house of Zacharias, and saluted Elisabeth.

verses.original: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἤκουσεν ⸂τὸν ἀσπασμὸν τῆς Μαρίας ἡ Ἐλισάβετ⸃, ἐσκίρτησεν τὸ βρέφος ἐν τῇ κοιλίᾳ αὐτῆς, καὶ ἐπλήσθη πνεύματος ἁγίου ἡ Ἐλισάβετ,
verses.translit: kai egeneto os ekoysen ton aspasmon tes Marias e Elisavet, eskirtisen to vrefos en te koilia autes, kai eplisthi pneymatos agioy e Elisavet,
verses.translation: And it came to pass, that, when Elisabeth heard the salutation of Mary, the babe leaped in her womb; and Elisabeth was filled with the Holy Ghost:

verses.original: καὶ ἀνεφώνησεν ⸀κραυγῇ μεγάλῃ καὶ εἶπεν· Εὐλογημένη σὺ ἐν γυναιξίν, καὶ εὐλογημένος ὁ καρπὸς τῆς κοιλίας σου.
verses.translit: kai anefonisen krayge megale kai eipen* Eulogimeni su en gynaixin, kai eulogimenos o karpos tes koilias soy.
verses.translation: And she spake out with a loud voice, and said, Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb.

verses.original: καὶ πόθεν μοι τοῦτο ἵνα ἔλθῃ ἡ μήτηρ τοῦ κυρίου μου πρὸς ⸀ἐμέ;
verses.translit: kai pothen moi touto ina elthe e mitir tou kyrioy moy pros eme;
verses.translation: And whence is this to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?

verses.original: ἰδοὺ γὰρ ὡς ἐγένετο ἡ φωνὴ τοῦ ἀσπασμοῦ σου εἰς τὰ ὦτά μου, ἐσκίρτησεν ⸂ἐν ἀγαλλιάσει τὸ βρέφος⸃ ἐν τῇ κοιλίᾳ μου.
verses.translit: idou gar os egeneto e fone tou aspasmou soy eis ta ota moy, eskirtisen en agalliasei to vrefos en te koilia moy.
verses.translation: For, lo, as soon as the voice of thy salutation sounded in mine ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy.

verses.original: καὶ μακαρία ἡ πιστεύσασα ὅτι ἔσται τελείωσις τοῖς λελαλημένοις αὐτῇ παρὰ κυρίου.
verses.translit: kai makaria e pisteysasa oti estai teleiosis tois lelalimenois aute para kyrioy.
verses.translation: And blessed is she that believed: for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord.

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπεν Μαριάμ· Μεγαλύνει ἡ ψυχή μου τὸν κύριον,
verses.translit: Kai eipen Mariam* Megalynei e psyhi moy ton kyrion,
verses.translation: And Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord,

verses.original: καὶ ἠγαλλίασεν τὸ πνεῦμά μου ἐπὶ τῷ θεῷ τῷ σωτῆρί μου·
verses.translit: kai egalliasen to pneuma moy epi to theo to soteri moy*
verses.translation: And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.

verses.original: ὅτι ἐπέβλεψεν ἐπὶ τὴν ταπείνωσιν τῆς δούλης αὐτοῦ, ἰδοὺ γὰρ ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν μακαριοῦσίν με πᾶσαι αἱ γενεαί·
verses.translit: oti epevlepsen epi ten tapeinosin tes doylis autou, idou gar apo tou nun makariousin me pasai ai geneai*
verses.translation: For he hath regarded the low estate of his handmaiden: for, behold, from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.

verses.original: ὅτι ἐποίησέν μοι ⸀μεγάλα ὁ δυνατός, καὶ ἅγιον τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ,
verses.translit: oti epoiisen moi megala o dynatos, kai agion to onoma autou,
verses.translation: For he that is mighty hath done to me great things; and holy is his name.

verses.original: καὶ τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ εἰς γενεὰς ⸂καὶ γενεὰς⸃ τοῖς φοβουμένοις αὐτόν.
verses.translit: kai to eleos autou eis geneas kai geneas tois fovoymenois auton.
verses.translation: And his mercy is on them that fear him from generation to generation.

verses.original: Ἐποίησεν κράτος ἐν βραχίονι αὐτοῦ, διεσκόρπισεν ὑπερηφάνους διανοίᾳ καρδίας αὐτῶν·
verses.translit: Epoiisen kratos en vrahioni autou, dieskorpisen uperifanoys dianoia kardias auton*
verses.translation: He hath shewed strength with his arm; he hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.

verses.original: καθεῖλεν δυνάστας ἀπὸ θρόνων καὶ ὕψωσεν ταπεινούς,
verses.translit: katheilen dynastas apo thronon kai upsosen tapeinoys,
verses.translation: He hath put down the mighty from their seats, and exalted them of low degree.

verses.original: πεινῶντας ἐνέπλησεν ἀγαθῶν καὶ πλουτοῦντας ἐξαπέστειλεν κενούς.
verses.translit: peinontas eneplisen agathon kai ploytountas exapesteilen kenoys.
verses.translation: He hath filled the hungry with good things; and the rich he hath sent empty away.

verses.original: ἀντελάβετο Ἰσραὴλ παιδὸς αὐτοῦ, μνησθῆναι ἐλέους,
verses.translit: antelaveto Israel paidos autou, mnisthenai eleoys,
verses.translation: He hath holpen his servant Israel, in remembrance of his mercy;

verses.original: καθὼς ἐλάλησεν πρὸς τοὺς πατέρας ἡμῶν, τῷ Ἀβραὰμ καὶ τῷ σπέρματι αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.
verses.translit: kathos elalisen pros tous pateras emon, to Avraam kai to spermati autou eis ton aiona.
verses.translation: As he spake to our fathers, to Abraham, and to his seed for ever.

verses.original: Ἔμεινεν δὲ Μαριὰμ σὺν αὐτῇ ⸀ὡς μῆνας τρεῖς, καὶ ὑπέστρεψεν εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτῆς.
verses.translit: Emeinen de Mariam sun aute os menas treis, kai upestrepsen eis ton oikon autes.
verses.translation: And Mary abode with her about three months, and returned to her own house.

verses.original: Τῇ δὲ Ἐλισάβετ ἐπλήσθη ὁ χρόνος τοῦ τεκεῖν αὐτήν, καὶ ἐγέννησεν υἱόν.
verses.translit: Te de Elisavet eplisthi o hronos tou tekein autin, kai egennisen yion.
verses.translation: Now Elisabeth’s full time came that she should be delivered; and she brought forth a son.

verses.original: καὶ ἤκουσαν οἱ περίοικοι καὶ οἱ συγγενεῖς αὐτῆς ὅτι ἐμεγάλυνεν κύριος τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ μετʼ αὐτῆς, καὶ συνέχαιρον αὐτῇ.
verses.translit: kai ekoysan oi perioikoi kai oi syggeneis autes oti emegalynen kyrios to eleos autou met' autes, kai synehairon aute.
verses.translation: And her neighbours and her cousins heard how the Lord had shewed great mercy upon her; and they rejoiced with her.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῇ ⸂ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ὀγδόῃ⸃ ἦλθον περιτεμεῖν τὸ παιδίον, καὶ ἐκάλουν αὐτὸ ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ Ζαχαρίαν.
verses.translit: Kai egeneto en te emera te ogdoe elthon peritemein to paidion, kai ekaloyn auto epi to onomati tou patros autou Zaharian.
verses.translation: And it came to pass, that on the eighth day they came to circumcise the child; and they called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.

verses.original: καὶ ἀποκριθεῖσα ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ εἶπεν· Οὐχί, ἀλλὰ κληθήσεται Ἰωάννης.
verses.translit: kai apokritheisa e mitir autou eipen* Ouhi, alla klithisetai Ioannis.
verses.translation: And his mother answered and said, Not so ; but he shall be called John.

verses.original: καὶ εἶπαν πρὸς αὐτὴν ὅτι Οὐδείς ἐστιν ⸂ἐκ τῆς συγγενείας⸃ σου ὃς καλεῖται τῷ ὀνόματι τούτῳ.
verses.translit: kai eipan pros auten oti Oudeis estin ek tes syggeneias soy os kaleitai to onomati toyto.
