verses.translation: And they said unto her, There is none of thy kindred that is called by this name.

verses.original: ἐνένευον δὲ τῷ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ τὸ τί ἂν θέλοι καλεῖσθαι ⸀αὐτό.
verses.translit: eneneyon de to patri autou to ti an theloi kaleisthai auto.
verses.translation: And they made signs to his father, how he would have him called.

verses.original: καὶ αἰτήσας πινακίδιον ἔγραψεν λέγων· Ἰωάννης ⸀ἐστὶν ὄνομα αὐτοῦ. καὶ ἐθαύμασαν πάντες.
verses.translit: kai aitisas pinakidion egrapsen legon* Ioannis estin onoma autou. kai ethaymasan pantes.
verses.translation: And he asked for a writing table, and wrote, saying, His name is John. And they marvelled all.

verses.original: ἀνεῴχθη δὲ τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ παραχρῆμα καὶ ἡ γλῶσσα αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐλάλει εὐλογῶν τὸν θεόν.
verses.translit: aneohthi de to stoma autou parahrema kai e glossa autou, kai elalei eulogon ton theon.
verses.translation: And his mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue loosed , and he spake, and praised God.

verses.original: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐπὶ πάντας φόβος τοὺς περιοικοῦντας αὐτούς, καὶ ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ ὀρεινῇ τῆς Ἰουδαίας διελαλεῖτο πάντα τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα,
verses.translit: kai egeneto epi pantas fovos tous perioikountas autoys, kai en ole te oreine tes Ioydaias dielaleito panta ta Rimata tauta,
verses.translation: And fear came on all that dwelt round about them: and all these sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judæa.

verses.original: καὶ ἔθεντο πάντες οἱ ἀκούσαντες ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτῶν, λέγοντες· Τί ἄρα τὸ παιδίον τοῦτο ἔσται; καὶ ⸀γὰρ χεὶρ κυρίου ἦν μετʼ αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: kai ethento pantes oi akoysantes en te kardia auton, legontes* Ti ara to paidion touto estai; kai gar heir kyrioy en met' autou.
verses.translation: And all they that heard them laid them up in their hearts, saying, What manner of child shall this be! And the hand of the Lord was with him.

verses.original: Καὶ Ζαχαρίας ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ ἐπλήσθη πνεύματος ἁγίου καὶ ⸀ἐπροφήτευσεν λέγων·
verses.translit: Kai Zaharias o pater autou eplisthi pneymatos agioy kai eprofiteysen legon*
verses.translation: And his father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Ghost, and prophesied, saying,

verses.original: Εὐλογητὸς κύριος ὁ θεὸς τοῦ Ἰσραήλ, ὅτι ἐπεσκέψατο καὶ ἐποίησεν λύτρωσιν τῷ λαῷ αὐτοῦ,
verses.translit: Eulogitos kyrios o theos tou Israil, oti epeskepsato kai epoiisen lytrosin to lao autou,
verses.translation: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people,

verses.original: καὶ ἤγειρεν κέρας σωτηρίας ἡμῖν ⸀ἐν οἴκῳ ⸀Δαυὶδ παιδὸς αὐτοῦ,
verses.translit: kai egeiren keras sotirias emin en oiko Dayid paidos autou,
verses.translation: And hath raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David;

verses.original: καθὼς ἐλάλησεν διὰ στόματος τῶν ⸀ἁγίων ἀπʼ αἰῶνος προφητῶν αὐτοῦ,
verses.translit: kathos elalisen dia stomatos ton agion ap' aionos profiton autou,
verses.translation: As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets, which have been since the world began:

verses.original: σωτηρίαν ἐξ ἐχθρῶν ἡμῶν καὶ ἐκ χειρὸς πάντων τῶν μισούντων ἡμᾶς,
verses.translit: sotirian ex ehthron emon kai ek heiros panton ton misoynton emas,
verses.translation: That we should be saved from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us;

verses.original: ποιῆσαι ἔλεος μετὰ τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν καὶ μνησθῆναι διαθήκης ἁγίας αὐτοῦ,
verses.translit: poiesai eleos meta ton pateron emon kai mnisthenai diathikis agias autou,
verses.translation: To perform the mercy promised to our fathers, and to remember his holy covenant;

verses.original: ὅρκον ὃν ὤμοσεν πρὸς Ἀβραὰμ τὸν πατέρα ἡμῶν, τοῦ δοῦναι ἡμῖν
verses.translit: orkon on omosen pros Avraam ton patera emon, tou dounai emin
verses.translation: The oath which he sware to our father Abraham,

verses.original: ἀφόβως ἐκ χειρὸς ⸀ἐχθρῶν ῥυσθέντας λατρεύειν αὐτῷ
verses.translit: afovos ek heiros ehthron Rysthentas latreyein auto
verses.translation: That he would grant unto us, that we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies might serve him without fear,

verses.original: ἐν ὁσιότητι καὶ δικαιοσύνῃ ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ ⸂πάσαις ταῖς ἡμέραις⸃ ἡμῶν.
verses.translit: en osiotiti kai dikaiosyne enopion autou pasais tais emerais emon.
verses.translation: In holiness and righteousness before him, all the days of our life.

verses.original: καὶ σὺ ⸀δέ, παιδίον, προφήτης Ὑψίστου κληθήσῃ, προπορεύσῃ γὰρ ⸀ἐνώπιον κυρίου ἑτοιμάσαι ὁδοὺς αὐτοῦ,
verses.translit: kai su de, paidion, profitis Upsistoy klithise, proporeyse gar enopion kyrioy etoimasai odous autou,
verses.translation: And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest: for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways;

verses.original: τοῦ δοῦναι γνῶσιν σωτηρίας τῷ λαῷ αὐτοῦ ἐν ἀφέσει ἁμαρτιῶν αὐτῶν,
verses.translit: tou dounai gnosin sotirias to lao autou en afesei amartion auton,
verses.translation: To give knowledge of salvation unto his people by the remission of their sins,

verses.original: διὰ σπλάγχνα ἐλέους θεοῦ ἡμῶν, ἐν οἷς ⸀ἐπισκέψεται ἡμᾶς ἀνατολὴ ἐξ ὕψους,
verses.translit: dia splaghna eleoys theou emon, en ois episkepsetai emas anatole ex upsoys,
verses.translation: Through the tender mercy of our God; whereby the dayspring from on high hath visited us,

verses.original: ἐπιφᾶναι τοῖς ἐν σκότει καὶ σκιᾷ θανάτου καθημένοις, τοῦ κατευθῦναι τοὺς πόδας ἡμῶν εἰς ὁδὸν εἰρήνης.
verses.translit: epifanai tois en skotei kai skia thanatoy kathimenois, tou kateythunai tous podas emon eis odon eirinis.
verses.translation: To give light to them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace.

verses.original: Τὸ δὲ παιδίον ηὔξανε καὶ ἐκραταιοῦτο πνεύματι, καὶ ἦν ἐν ταῖς ἐρήμοις ἕως ἡμέρας ἀναδείξεως αὐτοῦ πρὸς τὸν Ἰσραήλ.
verses.translit: To de paidion iuxane kai ekrataiouto pneymati, kai en en tais erimois eos emeras anadeixeos autou pros ton Israil.
verses.translation: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, and was in the deserts till the day of his shewing unto Israel.

verses.original: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις ἐξῆλθεν δόγμα παρὰ Καίσαρος Αὐγούστου ἀπογράφεσθαι πᾶσαν τὴν οἰκουμένην·
verses.translit: Egeneto de en tais emerais ekeinais exelthen dogma para Kaisaros Augoystoy apografesthai pasan ten oikoymenin*
verses.translation: And it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from Cæsar Augustus, that all the world should be taxed.

verses.original: (⸀αὕτη ἀπογραφὴ πρώτη ἐγένετο ἡγεμονεύοντος τῆς Συρίας Κυρηνίου·)
verses.translit: (auti apografe proti egeneto egemoneyontos tes Syrias Kyrinioy*)
verses.translation: ( And this taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria.)

verses.original: καὶ ἐπορεύοντο πάντες ἀπογράφεσθαι, ἕκαστος εἰς τὴν ⸀ἑαυτοῦ πόλιν.
verses.translit: kai eporeyonto pantes apografesthai, ekastos eis ten eaytou polin.
verses.translation: And all went to be taxed, every one into his own city.

verses.original: Ἀνέβη δὲ καὶ Ἰωσὴφ ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας ἐκ πόλεως Ναζαρὲθ εἰς τὴν Ἰουδαίαν εἰς πόλιν Δαυὶδ ἥτις καλεῖται Βηθλέεμ, διὰ τὸ εἶναι αὐτὸν ἐξ οἴκου καὶ πατριᾶς Δαυίδ,
verses.translit: Anevi de kai Iosef apo tes Galilaias ek poleos Nazareth eis ten Ioydaian eis polin Dayid etis kaleitai Vithleem, dia to einai auton ex oikoy kai patrias Dayid,
verses.translation: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judæa, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of the house and lineage of David:)

verses.original: ἀπογράψασθαι σὺν Μαριὰμ τῇ ⸂ἐμνηστευμένῃ αὐτῷ⸃, οὔσῃ ἐγκύῳ.
verses.translit: apograpsasthai sun Mariam te emnisteymene auto, ouse egkyo.
verses.translation: To be taxed with Mary his espoused wife, being great with child.

verses.original: ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῷ εἶναι αὐτοὺς ἐκεῖ ἐπλήσθησαν αἱ ἡμέραι τοῦ τεκεῖν αὐτήν,
verses.translit: egeneto de en to einai autous ekei eplisthisan ai emerai tou tekein autin,
verses.translation: And so it was, that, while they were there, the days were accomplished that she should be delivered.

verses.original: καὶ ἔτεκεν τὸν υἱὸν αὐτῆς τὸν πρωτότοκον, καὶ ἐσπαργάνωσεν αὐτὸν καὶ ἀνέκλινεν αὐτὸν ⸀ἐν φάτνῃ, διότι οὐκ ἦν αὐτοῖς τόπος ἐν τῷ καταλύματι.
verses.translit: kai eteken ton yion autes ton prototokon, kai esparganosen auton kai aneklinen auton en fatne, dioti ouk en autois topos en to katalymati.
verses.translation: And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.

verses.original: Καὶ ποιμένες ἦσαν ἐν τῇ χώρᾳ τῇ αὐτῇ ἀγραυλοῦντες καὶ φυλάσσοντες φυλακὰς τῆς νυκτὸς ἐπὶ τὴν ποίμνην αὐτῶν.
verses.translit: Kai poimenes esan en te hora te aute agraylountes kai fylassontes fylakas tes nyktos epi ten poimnin auton.
verses.translation: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.

verses.original: ⸀καὶ ἄγγελος κυρίου ἐπέστη αὐτοῖς καὶ δόξα κυρίου περιέλαμψεν αὐτούς, καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν φόβον μέγαν·
verses.translit: kai aggelos kyrioy epesti autois kai doxa kyrioy perielampsen autoys, kai efovithisan fovon megan*
verses.translation: And, lo, the angel of the Lord came upon them, and the glory of the Lord shone round about them: and they were sore afraid.

verses.original: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ ἄγγελος· Μὴ φοβεῖσθε, ἰδοὺ γὰρ εὐαγγελίζομαι ὑμῖν χαρὰν μεγάλην ἥτις ἔσται παντὶ τῷ λαῷ,
verses.translit: kai eipen autois o aggelos* Me foveisthe, idou gar euaggelizomai umin haran megalin etis estai panti to lao,
verses.translation: And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.

verses.original: ὅτι ἐτέχθη ὑμῖν σήμερον σωτὴρ ὅς ἐστιν χριστὸς κύριος ἐν πόλει Δαυίδ·
verses.translit: oti etehthi umin simeron soter os estin hristos kyrios en polei Dayid*
verses.translation: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.

verses.original: καὶ τοῦτο ὑμῖν ⸀τὸ σημεῖον, εὑρήσετε βρέφος ἐσπαργανωμένον ⸀καὶ κείμενον ἐν φάτνῃ.
verses.translit: kai touto umin to simeion, eurisete vrefos esparganomenon kai keimenon en fatne.
verses.translation: And this shall be a sign unto you; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger.

verses.original: καὶ ἐξαίφνης ἐγένετο σὺν τῷ ἀγγέλῳ πλῆθος στρατιᾶς ⸀οὐρανίου αἰνούντων τὸν θεὸν καὶ λεγόντων·
verses.translit: kai exaifnis egeneto sun to aggelo plethos stratias ouranioy ainoynton ton theon kai legonton*
verses.translation: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God, and saying,

verses.original: Δόξα ἐν ὑψίστοις θεῷ καὶ ἐπὶ γῆς εἰρήνη ἐν ἀνθρώποις ⸀εὐδοκίας.
verses.translit: Doxa en upsistois theo kai epi ges eirini en anthropois eudokias.
verses.translation: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἀπῆλθον ἀπʼ αὐτῶν εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν οἱ ἄγγελοι, ⸀οἱ ποιμένες ⸀ἐλάλουν πρὸς ἀλλήλους· Διέλθωμεν δὴ ἕως Βηθλέεμ καὶ ἴδωμεν τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο τὸ γεγονὸς ὃ ὁ κύριος ἐγνώρισεν ἡμῖν.
verses.translit: Kai egeneto os apelthon ap' auton eis ton ouranon oi aggeloi, oi poimenes elaloyn pros alliloys* Dielthomen de eos Vithleem kai idomen to Rema touto to gegonos o o kyrios egnorisen emin.
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as the angels were gone away from them into heaven, the shepherds said one to another, Let us now go even unto Bethlehem, and see this thing which is come to pass, which the Lord hath made known unto us.

verses.original: καὶ ἦλθαν σπεύσαντες καὶ ἀνεῦραν τήν τε Μαριὰμ καὶ τὸν Ἰωσὴφ καὶ τὸ βρέφος κείμενον ἐν τῇ φάτνῃ·
verses.translit: kai elthan speysantes kai aneuran tin te Mariam kai ton Iosef kai to vrefos keimenon en te fatne*
verses.translation: And they came with haste, and found Mary, and Joseph, and the babe lying in a manger.

verses.original: ἰδόντες δὲ ⸀ἐγνώρισαν περὶ τοῦ ῥήματος τοῦ λαληθέντος αὐτοῖς περὶ τοῦ παιδίου τούτου.
verses.translit: idontes de egnorisan peri tou Rimatos tou lalithentos autois peri tou paidioy toytoy.
verses.translation: And when they had seen it , they made known abroad the saying which was told them concerning this child.

verses.original: καὶ πάντες οἱ ἀκούσαντες ἐθαύμασαν περὶ τῶν λαληθέντων ὑπὸ τῶν ποιμένων πρὸς αὐτούς,
verses.translit: kai pantes oi akoysantes ethaymasan peri ton lalithenton upo ton poimenon pros autoys,
verses.translation: And all they that heard it wondered at those things which were told them by the shepherds.

verses.original: ἡ δὲ ⸀Μαρία πάντα συνετήρει τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα συμβάλλουσα ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτῆς.
verses.translit: e de Maria panta synetirei ta Rimata tauta symvalloysa en te kardia autes.
verses.translation: But Mary kept all these things, and pondered them in her heart.

verses.original: καὶ ὑπέστρεψαν οἱ ποιμένες δοξάζοντες καὶ αἰνοῦντες τὸν θεὸν ἐπὶ πᾶσιν οἷς ἤκουσαν καὶ εἶδον καθὼς ἐλαλήθη πρὸς αὐτούς.
verses.translit: kai upestrepsan oi poimenes doxazontes kai ainountes ton theon epi pasin ois ekoysan kai eidon kathos elalithi pros autoys.
verses.translation: And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, as it was told unto them.

verses.original: Καὶ ὅτε ἐπλήσθησαν ἡμέραι ὀκτὼ τοῦ περιτεμεῖν αὐτόν, καὶ ἐκλήθη τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦς, τὸ κληθὲν ὑπὸ τοῦ ἀγγέλου πρὸ τοῦ συλλημφθῆναι αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ κοιλίᾳ.
verses.translit: Kai ote eplisthisan emerai okto tou peritemein auton, kai eklithi to onoma autou Iisous, to klithen upo tou aggeloy pro tou syllimfthenai auton en te koilia.
verses.translation: And when eight days were accomplished for the circumcising of the child, his name was called JESUS, which was so named of the angel before he was conceived in the womb.

verses.original: Καὶ ὅτε ἐπλήσθησαν αἱ ἡμέραι τοῦ καθαρισμοῦ αὐτῶν κατὰ τὸν νόμον Μωϋσέως, ἀνήγαγον αὐτὸν εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα παραστῆσαι τῷ κυρίῳ,
verses.translit: Kai ote eplisthisan ai emerai tou katharismou auton kata ton nomon Moyseos, anigagon auton eis Ierosolyma parastesai to kyrio,
verses.translation: And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were accomplished, they brought him to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord;

verses.original: καθὼς γέγραπται ἐν νόμῳ κυρίου ὅτι Πᾶν ἄρσεν διανοῖγον μήτραν ἅγιον τῷ κυρίῳ κληθήσεται,
verses.translit: kathos gegraptai en nomo kyrioy oti Pan arsen dianoigon mitran agion to kyrio klithisetai,
verses.translation: (As it is written in the law of the Lord, Every male that openeth the womb shall be called holy to the Lord;)

verses.original: καὶ τοῦ δοῦναι θυσίαν κατὰ τὸ εἰρημένον ἐν ⸀τῷ νόμῳ κυρίου, ζεῦγος τρυγόνων ἢ δύο νοσσοὺς περιστερῶν.
verses.translit: kai tou dounai thysian kata to eirimenon en to nomo kyrioy, zeugos trygonon e dyo nossous peristeron.
verses.translation: And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.

verses.original: Καὶ ἰδοὺ ⸂ἄνθρωπος ἦν⸃ ἐν Ἰερουσαλὴμ ᾧ ὄνομα Συμεών, καὶ ὁ ἄνθρωπος οὗτος δίκαιος καὶ εὐλαβής, προσδεχόμενος παράκλησιν τοῦ Ἰσραήλ, καὶ πνεῦμα ἦν ἅγιον ἐπʼ αὐτόν·
verses.translit: Kai idou anthropos en en Ieroysalem o onoma Symeon, kai o anthropos outos dikaios kai eulavis, prosdehomenos paraklisin tou Israil, kai pneuma en agion ep' auton*
verses.translation: And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon; and the same man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Ghost was upon him.

verses.original: καὶ ἦν αὐτῷ κεχρηματισμένον ὑπὸ τοῦ πνεύματος τοῦ ἁγίου μὴ ἰδεῖν θάνατον πρὶν ⸂ἢ ἂν⸃ ἴδῃ τὸν χριστὸν κυρίου.
verses.translit: kai en auto kehrimatismenon upo tou pneymatos tou agioy me idein thanaton prin e an ide ton hriston kyrioy.
verses.translation: And it was revealed unto him by the Holy Ghost, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.

verses.original: καὶ ἦλθεν ἐν τῷ πνεύματι εἰς τὸ ἱερόν· καὶ ἐν τῷ εἰσαγαγεῖν τοὺς γονεῖς τὸ παιδίον Ἰησοῦν τοῦ ποιῆσαι αὐτοὺς κατὰ τὸ εἰθισμένον τοῦ νόμου περὶ αὐτοῦ
verses.translit: kai elthen en to pneymati eis to ieron* kai en to eisagagein tous goneis to paidion Iisoun tou poiesai autous kata to eithismenon tou nomoy peri autou
verses.translation: And he came by the Spirit into the temple: and when the parents brought in the child Jesus, to do for him after the custom of the law,

verses.original: καὶ αὐτὸς ἐδέξατο αὐτὸ εἰς τὰς ⸀ἀγκάλας καὶ εὐλόγησεν τὸν θεὸν καὶ εἶπεν·
verses.translit: kai autos edexato auto eis tas agkalas kai eulogisen ton theon kai eipen*
verses.translation: Then took he him up in his arms, and blessed God, and said,

verses.original: Νῦν ἀπολύεις τὸν δοῦλόν σου, δέσποτα, κατὰ τὸ ῥῆμά σου ἐν εἰρήνῃ·
verses.translit: Nun apolyeis ton doulon soy, despota, kata to Rema soy en eirine*
verses.translation: Lord, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace, according to thy word:

verses.original: ὅτι εἶδον οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου τὸ σωτήριόν σου
verses.translit: oti eidon oi ofthalmoi moy to sotirion soy
verses.translation: For mine eyes have seen thy salvation,

verses.original: ὃ ἡτοίμασας κατὰ πρόσωπον πάντων τῶν λαῶν,
verses.translit: o etoimasas kata prosopon panton ton laon,
verses.translation: Which thou hast prepared before the face of all people;

verses.original: φῶς εἰς ἀποκάλυψιν ἐθνῶν καὶ δόξαν λαοῦ σου Ἰσραήλ.
verses.translit: fos eis apokalypsin ethnon kai doxan laou soy Israil.
verses.translation: A light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of thy people Israel.

verses.original: καὶ ἦν ⸂ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ⸃ καὶ ἡ ⸀μήτηρ θαυμάζοντες ἐπὶ τοῖς λαλουμένοις περὶ αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: kai en o pater autou kai e mitir thaymazontes epi tois laloymenois peri autou.
verses.translation: And Joseph and his mother marvelled at those things which were spoken of him.

verses.original: καὶ εὐλόγησεν αὐτοὺς Συμεὼν καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς Μαριὰμ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ· Ἰδοὺ οὗτος κεῖται εἰς πτῶσιν καὶ ἀνάστασιν πολλῶν ἐν τῷ Ἰσραὴλ καὶ εἰς σημεῖον ἀντιλεγόμενον,
verses.translit: kai eulogisen autous Symeon kai eipen pros Mariam ten mitera autou* Idou outos keitai eis ptosin kai anastasin pollon en to Israel kai eis simeion antilegomenon,
verses.translation: And Simeon blessed them, and said unto Mary his mother, Behold, this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel; and for a sign which shall be spoken against;

verses.original: καὶ σοῦ ⸀δὲ αὐτῆς τὴν ψυχὴν διελεύσεται ῥομφαία, ὅπως ἂν ἀποκαλυφθῶσιν ἐκ πολλῶν καρδιῶν διαλογισμοί.
verses.translit: kai sou de autes ten psyhen dieleysetai Romfaia, opos an apokalyfthosin ek pollon kardion dialogismoi.
verses.translation: (Yea, a sword shall pierce through thy own soul also,) that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.

verses.original: Καὶ ἦν Ἅννα προφῆτις, θυγάτηρ Φανουήλ, ἐκ φυλῆς Ἀσήρ (αὕτη προβεβηκυῖα ἐν ἡμέραις πολλαῖς, ζήσασα ⸂μετὰ ἀνδρὸς ἔτη⸃ ἑπτὰ ἀπὸ τῆς παρθενίας αὐτῆς,
verses.translit: Kai en Anna profetis, thygatir Fanoyil, ek fyles Asir (auti provevikyia en emerais pollais, zisasa meta andros eti epta apo tes parthenias autes,
verses.translation: And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser: she was of a great age, and had lived with an husband seven years from her virginity;

verses.original: καὶ αὐτὴ χήρα ⸀ἕως ἐτῶν ὀγδοήκοντα τεσσάρων,) ἣ οὐκ ⸀ἀφίστατο τοῦ ἱεροῦ νηστείαις καὶ δεήσεσιν λατρεύουσα νύκτα καὶ ἡμέραν.
verses.translit: kai aute hira eos eton ogdoikonta tessaron,) e ouk afistato tou ierou nisteiais kai deisesin latreyoysa nykta kai emeran.
verses.translation: And she was a widow of about fourscore and four years, which departed not from the temple, but served God with fastings and prayers night and day.

verses.original: ⸀καὶ αὐτῇ τῇ ὥρᾳ ἐπιστᾶσα ἀνθωμολογεῖτο τῷ ⸀θεῷ καὶ ἐλάλει περὶ αὐτοῦ πᾶσιν τοῖς προσδεχομένοις ⸀λύτρωσιν Ἰερουσαλήμ.
verses.translit: kai aute te ora epistasa anthomologeito to theo kai elalei peri autou pasin tois prosdehomenois lytrosin Ieroysalim.
verses.translation: And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord, and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem.

verses.original: Καὶ ὡς ἐτέλεσαν ⸀πάντα τὰ κατὰ τὸν νόμον κυρίου, ⸀ἐπέστρεψαν εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν ⸀εἰς πόλιν ἑαυτῶν Ναζαρέθ.
verses.translit: Kai os etelesan panta ta kata ton nomon kyrioy, epestrepsan eis ten Galilaian eis polin eayton Nazareth.
verses.translation: And when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.

verses.original: Τὸ δὲ παιδίον ηὔξανεν καὶ ἐκραταιοῦτο ⸂πληρούμενον σοφίᾳ⸃, καὶ χάρις θεοῦ ἦν ἐπʼ αὐτό.
verses.translit: To de paidion iuxanen kai ekrataiouto pliroymenon sofia, kai haris theou en ep' auto.
verses.translation: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, filled with wisdom: and the grace of God was upon him.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐπορεύοντο οἱ γονεῖς αὐτοῦ κατʼ ἔτος εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ τῇ ἑορτῇ τοῦ πάσχα.
verses.translit: Kai eporeyonto oi goneis autou kat' etos eis Ieroysalem te eorte tou pasha.
verses.translation: Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover.

verses.original: καὶ ὅτε ἐγένετο ἐτῶν δώδεκα, ⸀ἀναβαινόντων ⸀αὐτῶν κατὰ τὸ ἔθος τῆς ἑορτῆς
verses.translit: kai ote egeneto eton dodeka, anavainonton auton kata to ethos tes eortes
verses.translation: And when he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast.

verses.original: καὶ τελειωσάντων τὰς ἡμέρας, ἐν τῷ ὑποστρέφειν αὐτοὺς ὑπέμεινεν Ἰησοῦς ὁ παῖς ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ, καὶ οὐκ ⸂ἔγνωσαν οἱ γονεῖς⸃ αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: kai teleiosanton tas emeras, en to upostrefein autous upemeinen Iisous o pais en Ieroysalim, kai ouk egnosan oi goneis autou.
verses.translation: And when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; and Joseph and his mother knew not of it .

verses.original: νομίσαντες δὲ αὐτὸν ⸂εἶναι ἐν τῇ συνοδίᾳ⸃ ἦλθον ἡμέρας ὁδὸν καὶ ἀνεζήτουν αὐτὸν ἐν τοῖς συγγενεῦσιν ⸀καὶ τοῖς γνωστοῖς,
verses.translit: nomisantes de auton einai en te synodia elthon emeras odon kai anezitoyn auton en tois syggeneusin kai tois gnostois,
verses.translation: But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a day’s journey; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance.

verses.original: καὶ μὴ ⸀εὑρόντες ὑπέστρεψαν εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ ⸀ἀναζητοῦντες αὐτόν.
verses.translit: kai me eurontes upestrepsan eis Ieroysalem anazitountes auton.
verses.translation: And when they found him not, they turned back again to Jerusalem, seeking him.

verses.original: καὶ ἐγένετο μετὰ ἡμέρας τρεῖς εὗρον αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ καθεζόμενον ἐν μέσῳ τῶν διδασκάλων καὶ ἀκούοντα αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπερωτῶντα αὐτούς·
verses.translit: kai egeneto meta emeras treis euron auton en to iero kathezomenon en meso ton didaskalon kai akoyonta auton kai eperotonta autoys*
verses.translation: And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions.

verses.original: ἐξίσταντο δὲ πάντες οἱ ἀκούοντες αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τῇ συνέσει καὶ ταῖς ἀποκρίσεσιν αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: existanto de pantes oi akoyontes autou epi te synesei kai tais apokrisesin autou.
verses.translation: And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers.

verses.original: καὶ ἰδόντες αὐτὸν ἐξεπλάγησαν, καὶ ⸂εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτὸν ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ⸃· Τέκνον, τί ἐποίησας ἡμῖν οὕτως; ἰδοὺ ὁ πατήρ σου καὶ ἐγὼ ὀδυνώμενοι ⸀ἐζητοῦμέν σε.
verses.translit: kai idontes auton exeplagisan, kai eipen pros auton e mitir autou* Teknon, ti epoiisas emin outos; idou o patir soy kai ego odynomenoi ezitoumen se.
verses.translation: And when they saw him, they were amazed: and his mother said unto him, Son, why hast thou thus dealt with us? behold, thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing.

verses.original: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς· Τί ὅτι ἐζητεῖτέ με; οὐκ ᾔδειτε ὅτι ἐν τοῖς τοῦ πατρός μου δεῖ εἶναί με;
verses.translit: kai eipen pros autoys* Ti oti eziteite me; ouk edeite oti en tois tou patros moy dei einai me;
verses.translation: And he said unto them, How is it that ye sought me? wist ye not that I must be about my Father’s business?

verses.original: καὶ αὐτοὶ οὐ συνῆκαν τὸ ῥῆμα ὃ ἐλάλησεν αὐτοῖς.
verses.translit: kai autoi ou synekan to Rema o elalisen autois.
verses.translation: And they understood not the saying which he spake unto them.

verses.original: καὶ κατέβη μετʼ αὐτῶν καὶ ἦλθεν εἰς Ναζαρέθ, καὶ ἦν ὑποτασσόμενος αὐτοῖς. καὶ ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ διετήρει πάντα τὰ ῥήματα ⸀ταῦτα ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτῆς.
verses.translit: kai katevi met' auton kai elthen eis Nazareth, kai en upotassomenos autois. kai e mitir autou dietirei panta ta Rimata tauta en te kardia autes.
verses.translation: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and was subject unto them: but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.

verses.original: Καὶ Ἰησοῦς προέκοπτεν ⸂σοφίᾳ καὶ ἡλικίᾳ⸃ καὶ χάριτι παρὰ θεῷ καὶ ἀνθρώποις.
verses.translit: Kai Iisous proekopten sofia kai elikia kai hariti para theo kai anthropois.
verses.translation: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and man.

verses.original: Ἐν ἔτει δὲ πεντεκαιδεκάτῳ τῆς ἡγεμονίας Τιβερίου Καίσαρος, ἡγεμονεύοντος Ποντίου Πιλάτου τῆς Ἰουδαίας, καὶ τετρααρχοῦντος τῆς Γαλιλαίας Ἡρῴδου, Φιλίππου δὲ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ τετρααρχοῦντος τῆς Ἰτουραίας καὶ Τραχωνίτιδος χώρας, καὶ Λυσανίου τῆς Ἀβιληνῆς τετρααρχοῦντος,
verses.translit: En etei de pentekaidekato tes egemonias Tiverioy Kaisaros, egemoneyontos Pontioy Pilatoy tes Ioydaias, kai tetraarhountos tes Galilaias Erodoy, Filippoy de tou adelfou autou tetraarhountos tes Itoyraias kai Trahonitidos horas, kai Lysanioy tes Avilines tetraarhountos,
verses.translation: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Cæsar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judæa, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and of the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene,

verses.original: ἐπὶ ἀρχιερέως Ἅννα καὶ Καϊάφα, ἐγένετο ῥῆμα θεοῦ ἐπὶ Ἰωάννην τὸν Ζαχαρίου υἱὸν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ.
verses.translit: epi arhiereos Anna kai Kaiafa, egeneto Rema theou epi Ioannin ton Zaharioy yion en te erimo.
verses.translation: Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests, the word of God came unto John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness.

verses.original: καὶ ἦλθεν εἰς ⸀πᾶσαν περίχωρον τοῦ Ἰορδάνου κηρύσσων βάπτισμα μετανοίας εἰς ἄφεσιν ἁμαρτιῶν,
verses.translit: kai elthen eis pasan perihoron tou Iordanoy kirysson vaptisma metanoias eis afesin amartion,
verses.translation: And he came into all the country about Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins;

verses.original: ὡς γέγραπται ἐν βίβλῳ λόγων Ἠσαΐου τοῦ ⸀προφήτου· Φωνὴ βοῶντος ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ· Ἑτοιμάσατε τὴν ὁδὸν κυρίου, εὐθείας ποιεῖτε τὰς τρίβους αὐτοῦ.
verses.translit: os gegraptai en vivlo logon EsaIoy tou profitoy* Fone voontos en te erimo* Etoimasate ten odon kyrioy, eutheias poieite tas trivoys autou.
verses.translation: As it is written in the book of the words of Esaias the prophet, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.

verses.original: πᾶσα φάραγξ πληρωθήσεται καὶ πᾶν ὄρος καὶ βουνὸς ταπεινωθήσεται, καὶ ἔσται τὰ σκολιὰ εἰς ⸀εὐθείαν καὶ αἱ τραχεῖαι εἰς ὁδοὺς λείας·
verses.translit: pasa faragx plirothisetai kai pan oros kai voynos tapeinothisetai, kai estai ta skolia eis eutheian kai ai traheiai eis odous leias*
verses.translation: Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low; and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough ways shall be made smooth;

verses.original: καὶ ὄψεται πᾶσα σὰρξ τὸ σωτήριον τοῦ θεοῦ.
verses.translit: kai opsetai pasa sarx to sotirion tou theou.
verses.translation: And all flesh shall see the salvation of God.

verses.original: Ἔλεγεν οὖν τοῖς ἐκπορευομένοις ὄχλοις βαπτισθῆναι ὑπʼ αὐτοῦ· Γεννήματα ἐχιδνῶν, τίς ὑπέδειξεν ὑμῖν φυγεῖν ἀπὸ τῆς μελλούσης ὀργῆς;
verses.translit: Elegen oun tois ekporeyomenois ohlois vaptisthenai up' autou* Gennimata ehidnon, tis upedeixen umin fygein apo tes melloysis orges;
verses.translation: Then said he to the multitude that came forth to be baptized of him, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

verses.original: ποιήσατε οὖν καρποὺς ἀξίους τῆς μετανοίας· καὶ μὴ ἄρξησθε λέγειν ἐν ἑαυτοῖς· Πατέρα ἔχομεν τὸν Ἀβραάμ, λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν ὅτι δύναται ὁ θεὸς ἐκ τῶν λίθων τούτων ἐγεῖραι τέκνα τῷ Ἀβραάμ.
verses.translit: poiisate oun karpous axioys tes metanoias* kai me arxisthe legein en eaytois* Patera ehomen ton Avraam, lego gar umin oti dynatai o theos ek ton lithon toyton egeirai tekna to Avraam.
verses.translation: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, That God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.

verses.original: ἤδη δὲ καὶ ἡ ἀξίνη πρὸς τὴν ῥίζαν τῶν δένδρων κεῖται· πᾶν οὖν δένδρον μὴ ποιοῦν καρπὸν καλὸν ἐκκόπτεται καὶ εἰς πῦρ βάλλεται.
verses.translit: edi de kai e axini pros ten Rizan ton dendron keitai* pan oun dendron me poioun karpon kalon ekkoptetai kai eis pur valletai.
verses.translation: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: every tree therefore which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐπηρώτων αὐτὸν οἱ ὄχλοι λέγοντες· Τί οὖν ⸀ποιήσωμεν;
verses.translit: Kai epiroton auton oi ohloi legontes* Ti oun poiisomen;
verses.translation: And the people asked him, saying, What shall we do then?

verses.original: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ⸀ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς· Ὁ ἔχων δύο χιτῶνας μεταδότω τῷ μὴ ἔχοντι, καὶ ὁ ἔχων βρώματα ὁμοίως ποιείτω.
verses.translit: apokritheis de elegen autois* O ehon dyo hitonas metadoto to me ehonti, kai o ehon vromata omoios poieito.
verses.translation: He answereth and saith unto them, He that hath two coats, let him impart to him that hath none; and he that hath meat, let him do likewise.

verses.original: ἦλθον δὲ καὶ τελῶναι βαπτισθῆναι καὶ εἶπαν πρὸς αὐτόν· Διδάσκαλε, τί ⸀ποιήσωμεν;
verses.translit: elthon de kai telonai vaptisthenai kai eipan pros auton* Didaskale, ti poiisomen;
verses.translation: Then came also publicans to be baptized, and said unto him, Master, what shall we do?

verses.original: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς· Μηδὲν πλέον παρὰ τὸ διατεταγμένον ὑμῖν πράσσετε.
verses.translit: o de eipen pros autoys* Miden pleon para to diatetagmenon umin prassete.
verses.translation: And he said unto them, Exact no more than that which is appointed you.

verses.original: ἐπηρώτων δὲ αὐτὸν καὶ στρατευόμενοι λέγοντες· ⸂Τί ποιήσωμεν καὶ ἡμεῖς⸃; καὶ εἶπεν ⸀αὐτοῖς· Μηδένα διασείσητε μηδὲ συκοφαντήσητε, καὶ ἀρκεῖσθε τοῖς ὀψωνίοις ὑμῶν.
verses.translit: epiroton de auton kai strateyomenoi legontes* Ti poiisomen kai emeis; kai eipen autois* Midena diaseisite mide sykofantisite, kai arkeisthe tois opsoniois umon.
verses.translation: And the soldiers likewise demanded of him, saying, And what shall we do? And he said unto them, Do violence to no man, neither accuse any falsely; and be content with your wages.

verses.original: Προσδοκῶντος δὲ τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ διαλογιζομένων πάντων ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις αὐτῶν περὶ τοῦ Ἰωάννου, μήποτε αὐτὸς εἴη ὁ χριστός,
verses.translit: Prosdokontos de tou laou kai dialogizomenon panton en tais kardiais auton peri tou Ioannoy, mipote autos eii o hristos,
verses.translation: And as the people were in expectation, and all men mused in their hearts of John, whether he were the Christ, or not;

verses.original: ἀπεκρίνατο ⸂λέγων πᾶσιν ὁ Ἰωάννης⸃· Ἐγὼ μὲν ὕδατι βαπτίζω ὑμᾶς· ἔρχεται δὲ ὁ ἰσχυρότερός μου, οὗ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἱκανὸς λῦσαι τὸν ἱμάντα τῶν ὑποδημάτων αὐτοῦ· αὐτὸς ὑμᾶς βαπτίσει ἐν πνεύματι ἁγίῳ καὶ πυρί·
verses.translit: apekrinato legon pasin o Ioannis* Ego men udati vaptizo umas* erhetai de o ishyroteros moy, ou ouk eimi ikanos lusai ton imanta ton upodimaton autou* autos umas vaptisei en pneymati agio kai pyri*
verses.translation: John answered, saying unto them all, I indeed baptize you with water; but one mightier than I cometh, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire:

verses.original: οὗ τὸ πτύον ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ ⸀διακαθᾶραι τὴν ἅλωνα αὐτοῦ καὶ ⸀συναγαγεῖν τὸν σῖτον εἰς τὴν ἀποθήκην αὐτοῦ, τὸ δὲ ἄχυρον κατακαύσει πυρὶ ἀσβέστῳ.
verses.translit: ou to ptyon en te heiri autou diakatharai ten alona autou kai synagagein ton siton eis ten apothikin autou, to de ahyron katakaysei pyri asvesto.
verses.translation: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and will gather the wheat into his garner; but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable.

verses.original: Πολλὰ μὲν οὖν καὶ ἕτερα παρακαλῶν εὐηγγελίζετο τὸν λαόν·
verses.translit: Polla men oun kai etera parakalon euiggelizeto ton laon*
verses.translation: And many other things in his exhortation preached he unto the people.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ Ἡρῴδης ὁ τετραάρχης, ἐλεγχόμενος ὑπʼ αὐτοῦ περὶ Ἡρῳδιάδος τῆς γυναικὸς τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ καὶ περὶ πάντων ὧν ἐποίησεν πονηρῶν ὁ Ἡρῴδης,
verses.translit: o de Erodis o tetraarhis, eleghomenos up' autou peri Erodiados tes gynaikos tou adelfou autou kai peri panton on epoiisen poniron o Erodis,
verses.translation: But Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias his brother Philip’s wife, and for all the evils which Herod had done,

verses.original: προσέθηκεν καὶ τοῦτο ἐπὶ πᾶσιν, ⸀καὶ κατέκλεισεν τὸν Ἰωάννην ⸀ἐν φυλακῇ.
verses.translit: prosethiken kai touto epi pasin, kai katekleisen ton Ioannin en fylake.
verses.translation: Added yet this above all, that he shut up John in prison.

verses.original: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῷ βαπτισθῆναι ἅπαντα τὸν λαὸν καὶ Ἰησοῦ βαπτισθέντος καὶ προσευχομένου ἀνεῳχθῆναι τὸν οὐρανὸν
verses.translit: Egeneto de en to vaptisthenai apanta ton laon kai Iisou vaptisthentos kai proseyhomenoy aneohthenai ton ouranon
verses.translation: Now when all the people were baptized, it came to pass, that Jesus also being baptized, and praying, the heaven was opened,

verses.original: καὶ καταβῆναι τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον σωματικῷ εἴδει ⸀ὡς περιστερὰν ἐπʼ αὐτόν, καὶ φωνὴν ἐξ οὐρανοῦ ⸀γενέσθαι· Σὺ εἶ ὁ υἱός μου ὁ ἀγαπητός, ἐν σοὶ εὐδόκησα.
verses.translit: kai katavenai to pneuma to agion somatiko eidei os peristeran ep' auton, kai fonen ex ouranou genesthai* Su ei o yios moy o agapitos, en soi eudokisa.
verses.translation: And the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape like a dove upon him, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.

verses.original: Καὶ αὐτὸς ⸀ἦν Ἰησοῦς ⸂ἀρχόμενος ὡσεὶ ἐτῶν τριάκοντα⸃, ὢν ⸂υἱός, ὡς ἐνομίζετο⸃, Ἰωσὴφ τοῦ Ἠλὶ
verses.translit: Kai autos en Iisous arhomenos osei eton triakonta, on yios, os enomizeto, Iosef tou Eli
verses.translation: And Jesus himself began to be about thirty years of age, being (as was supposed) the son of Joseph, which was the son of Heli,

verses.original: τοῦ Μαθθὰτ τοῦ Λευὶ τοῦ Μελχὶ τοῦ Ἰανναὶ τοῦ Ἰωσὴφ
verses.translit: tou Maththat tou Leyi tou Melhi tou Iannai tou Iosef
verses.translation: Which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi, which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Janna, which was the son of Joseph,

verses.original: τοῦ Ματταθίου τοῦ Ἀμὼς τοῦ Ναοὺμ τοῦ Ἑσλὶ τοῦ Ναγγαὶ
verses.translit: tou Mattathioy tou Amos tou Naoum tou Esli tou Naggai
verses.translation: Which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Amos, which was the son of Naum, which was the son of Esli, which was the son of Nagge,

verses.original: τοῦ Μάαθ τοῦ Ματταθίου τοῦ Σεμεῒν τοῦ ⸀Ἰωσὴχ τοῦ Ἰωδὰ
verses.translit: tou Maath tou Mattathioy tou Semein tou Ioseh tou Ioda
verses.translation: Which was the son of Maath, which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Semei, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Juda,

verses.original: τοῦ Ἰωανὰν τοῦ Ῥησὰ τοῦ Ζοροβαβὲλ τοῦ Σαλαθιὴλ τοῦ Νηρὶ
verses.translit: tou Ioanan tou Risa tou Zorovavel tou Salathiel tou Niri
verses.translation: Which was the son of Joanna, which was the son of Rhesa, which was the son of Zorobabel, which was the son of Salathiel, which was the son of Neri,

verses.original: τοῦ Μελχὶ τοῦ Ἀδδὶ τοῦ Κωσὰμ τοῦ Ἐλμαδὰμ τοῦ Ἢρ
verses.translit: tou Melhi tou Addi tou Kosam tou Elmadam tou Er
verses.translation: Which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Addi, which was the son of Cosam, which was the son of Elmodam, which was the son of Er,

verses.original: τοῦ ⸀Ἰησοῦ τοῦ Ἐλιέζερ τοῦ Ἰωρὶμ τοῦ Μαθθὰτ τοῦ Λευὶ
verses.translit: tou Iisou tou Eliezer tou Iorim tou Maththat tou Leyi
verses.translation: Which was the son of Jose, which was the son of Eliezer, which was the son of Jorim, which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi,

verses.original: τοῦ Συμεὼν τοῦ Ἰούδα τοῦ Ἰωσὴφ τοῦ Ἰωνὰμ τοῦ Ἐλιακὶμ
verses.translit: tou Symeon tou Ioyda tou Iosef tou Ionam tou Eliakim
verses.translation: Which was the son of Simeon, which was the son of Juda, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Jonan, which was the son of Eliakim,

verses.original: τοῦ Μελεὰ τοῦ Μεννὰ τοῦ Ματταθὰ τοῦ Ναθὰμ τοῦ Δαυὶδ
verses.translit: tou Melea tou Menna tou Mattatha tou Natham tou Dayid
verses.translation: Which was the son of Melea, which was the son of Menan, which was the son of Mattatha, which was the son of Nathan, which was the son of David,

verses.original: τοῦ Ἰεσσαὶ τοῦ Ἰωβὴλ τοῦ Βόος τοῦ ⸀Σαλὰ τοῦ Ναασσὼν
verses.translit: tou Iessai tou Iovel tou Voos tou Sala tou Naasson
verses.translation: Which was the son of Jesse, which was the son of Obed, which was the son of Booz, which was the son of Salmon, which was the son of Naasson,

verses.original: τοῦ ⸂Ἀμιναδὰβ τοῦ Ἀδμὶν τοῦ Ἀρνὶ⸃ τοῦ Ἑσρὼμ τοῦ Φαρὲς τοῦ Ἰούδα
verses.translit: tou Aminadav tou Admin tou Arni tou Esrom tou Fares tou Ioyda
verses.translation: Which was the son of Aminadab, which was the son of Aram, which was the son of Esrom, which was the son of Phares, which was the son of Juda,

verses.original: τοῦ Ἰακὼβ τοῦ Ἰσαὰκ τοῦ Ἀβραὰμ τοῦ Θάρα τοῦ Ναχὼρ
verses.translit: tou Iakov tou Isaak tou Avraam tou Thara tou Nahor
verses.translation: Which was the son of Jacob, which was the son of Isaac, which was the son of Abraham, which was the son of Thara, which was the son of Nachor,

verses.original: τοῦ Σεροὺχ τοῦ Ῥαγαὺ τοῦ Φάλεκ τοῦ Ἔβερ τοῦ Σαλὰ
verses.translit: tou Serouh tou Ragau tou Falek tou Ever tou Sala
verses.translation: Which was the son of Saruch, which was the son of Ragau, which was the son of Phalec, which was the son of Heber, which was the son of Sala,

verses.original: τοῦ Καϊνὰμ τοῦ Ἀρφαξὰδ τοῦ Σὴμ τοῦ Νῶε τοῦ Λάμεχ
verses.translit: tou Kainam tou Arfaxad tou Sem tou Noe tou Lameh
verses.translation: Which was the son of Cainan, which was the son of Arphaxad, which was the son of Sem, which was the son of Noe, which was the son of Lamech,

verses.original: τοῦ Μαθουσαλὰ τοῦ Ἑνὼχ τοῦ Ἰάρετ τοῦ Μαλελεὴλ τοῦ Καϊνὰμ
verses.translit: tou Mathoysala tou Enoh tou Iaret tou Maleleel tou Kainam
verses.translation: Which was the son of Mathusala, which was the son of Enoch, which was the son of Jared, which was the son of Maleleel, which was the son of Cainan,

verses.original: τοῦ Ἐνὼς τοῦ Σὴθ τοῦ Ἀδὰμ τοῦ θεοῦ.
verses.translit: tou Enos tou Seth tou Adam tou theou.
verses.translation: Which was the son of Enos, which was the son of Seth, which was the son of Adam, which was the son of God.
